tei:div.tei:p: — yo ltos / bas rdza sa pa bu —rang la na sunga'athum ( go gu pa/ ) / khye tsho ༅ 4 / mtsho sngon mi rigs dpe skrun khang / 4 tsho 4 /

༅ tsa bo bla(01ba)ma༅zakhyesgyu༅maza(zakhrizo༅zo lo+ojokhrozayomalornye 2002 4132ma7—5420—0874—9—ma1 bh+yo sashā9bhū6 ṭ+wāṃ3sgo//lkom skomo0stsa —mjargadzalor+ṣa༅goyo 12 mtshophoja(2002)sbram28123d+ngha

dkar chagachos bshad gzhan phan nor bu zhes /ste/ /ba /ba(rde/cas/spras/ /ces (1)legs bshad gser gyi thur ma zhes /ste/ /ba /ba((/rngon05 res// (529)legs bshad bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun zhes /bya/ /ba /ba(rdo/rnga/05 res// (549)'od gsal rdzogs pa chen po'i khregs chod lta ba'i glu dbyangs lam ma lus myur du bgrod pa'i rtsal ldan mkha' lding gshog rlabs zhes bya ba bzhugs so// (581)'od gsal rdzogs pa chen po'i lhun grub thod rgal gyi glu dbyangs ting 'dzin sgo 'phar brgya phrag gcig char 'byed pa'i lde'u mig ces bya ba bzhugs so// (635)thod rgal gnad kyi zhal shes mgur dbyangs bdud rtsi'i bum bzang zhes bya ba bzhugs so// (687)

༄༅/ /chos bshad gzhan phan nor bu zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /༄༅/ /na mo gu ru mañdzu gho ṣa ya/ /phyogs bcu'i zhing khams mtha' yas mu med pa'i/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas sras bcas tshad med kyis/ /'jig rten khams kyi 'gro ba grangs med la/ /zab rgyas chos kyi 'khor lo dpag med bskor/ /stong gsum 'od kyis 'geng bzhin chos 'khor bskor/ /sangs rgyas de rnams 'gro kun gtan gyi skyabs/ /gdul bya'i don du slar yang bcom ldan 'das/ /rgyan drug mchog gnyis grub chen brgyad cu sogs/ /sgur sprul bstan pa 'dzin skyong spel mkhas pa'i/ /rgya gar mkhas grub kun gyi gtsug gi nor/ /bsil ldan ljongs 'dir bstan pa snga dar dus/ /bde gshegs sprul pa rje 'bangs nyer lnga dang / /phyi dar dus kyi mar pa mi la sogs/ /bod kyi mkhas grub bstan 'gro yongs kyi rgyan/ /khyad par bod yul don du sangs rgyas slar/ /grub dbang skur sprul lha srin sde brgyad btul/ /sngon med sangs rgyas bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan bsgreng / /1

zla bral pad 'byung bod la bka' drin che/ /pad 'byung slar yang mkhas grub gnyis 'dzom tshul/ /bzung nas sangs rgyas bstan pa'i dri ma bsal/ /dri bral bstan pa sngar bas 'phel par mdzod/ /mnyam med jo bo bka' drin shin tu che/ /jo bo slar yang kun mkhyen paṇ+ḍi ta'i/ /tshul bzung thos bsam 'chad rtsod rtsom gsumyo/ sgos/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa dar zhing rgyas par mdzad/ /kun mkhyen blo bzang bka' drin gzhal bar dka'/ /bde gshegs snyigs ma'i dus 'dir bdag gzhan gyi/ /snang ngor tha mal mi yi tshul bzung nas/ /zab dang rgya che'i chos ston dge ba'i bshes/ /rang rang ngos nas sangs rgyas las kyang lhag /rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa snyigs dus 'dir/ /rgyal blon paṇa grub spyon pa sprang slong sogs/ /gang 'dul skur bstan 'gro ba'i don mdzad gsungs/ /de dag rnams kyang mchod bstod bkur bar 'os/ /chos kyang gsung rab mdo rgyud man ngag dang / /gtam rgyud phyi rol bstan bcos mo bon sogs/ /sna tshogs bstan nas 'gro don mdzad gsung sa na/ /kun la dad gus dag snang cis mi sbyongs/ /rdul re khyon na sa yi rdul rnyed kyi/ /grangs dang mnyam pa'i zhing khams rab 'byams dang / /rgyal ba sras bcas dpag med bzhugs par gsungs/ /phyogs 2

bcur bzhugs tshad brjod kyis ga la lang / /dad gus dag snang sbyangs na las snang kun/ /dag nas zhing khams rab 'byams rgyal ba sras/ /mthong par ma zad ma dag snod bcud kyang / /mi de'i snang ngor dag pa'i zhing du 'char/ /ma dag snang ba snod bcud lcags phye kun/ /dag snang rin chen gser du bsgyur mkhas pa'i/ /dad gus dag snang gser 'gyur rtsi mchog 'di/ /yod na yon tan gser gzhin yod dang mtshungs/ /sngon byon da lta'i skyes bu dam pa yi/ /gang zag mchog dman 'bring gsum mthong tshad dang / /chos lugs rab 'bring tha gsum go tshad la/ /dad gus dag snang sbyong ba'i rgyu mtshan de/ /'o sko/la rnams kyis blang dor mi shes bzhin/ /chos dang gang zag mthong thos bzang ngan phyes/ /chos spong rtsa ltung las la nan tan 'bad/ /ngan song skye rgyu bsags la dgos pa ci/ /de phyir kun la ston pa'i 'du shes bzhag /spyi bor len pa rgyal sras lag len 'gas/ /bdag lus bye ba grangs med sprul byas nas/ /bstod dbyangs bcas te yongs la gus phyag 'tshal/ /dngos su 'byor tshad yid sprul las byung ba'i/ /kun bzang mchod sprin nam mkha' gang bas mchod/ /bdag gzhan sngar byas sdig sgrib nyes ltung kun/ /rab tu 'gyed pas spyan sngar mthol zhing 3

bshags/ /rgyal ba sras bcas mdzad pa mtha' yas pa/ /kun la snying nas rjes su yi rang bya/ /'gro ba yongs la gang 'dul skur bstan nas/ /dpag med chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar bskul/ /'gro kun sangs rgyas go 'phang ma thob bar/ /rgyal kun mya ngan mi 'da' bzhugs gsol 'debs/ /bdag gzhan rnam dkar dge ba ci mchis kun/ /mkha' mnyam rgyal kun thugs dgongs rdzogs phyir bsngo/ /bstan 'dzin rnams kyis phyogs ris chags sdang spangs/ /bshad sgrub bstan pa 'dzin skyong spel ba dang / /'gro ba kun gyis ma dad log lta srungs/ /dad gus dag snang byed par byin gyis rlobs/ /rang gi bla ma rnams dang dam pa'i chos/ /gzhan gyi gang zag chos lugs sna tshogs pa/ /kun la dad gus dag snang sbyongs dgos tshul/ /mdo rgyud dam pa'i gsung bzhin 'dir bshad bya/'o de yang nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad kyi don du yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang rin po che ci nas kyang myur ba myur du thob par bya/ de'i phyir du dam pa'i lha chos gsan par bgyi'o snyam pa'i bsam pa bzang bo'i sgo nas gsan dgos te/ lung las/ rtog pa thams cad legs par bsdus nas ni/ /shin tu bsam pa bzang bo ldan 4

pas nyon/ /brjed nges blo la rdo rje sems dpa' sogs/ /bde bar gshegs pa rnams kyis byin mi rlobs/ /zhes gsungs pa bzhin du kun slong kun spyod thams cad gsal btab ste gsan par 'tshal/ de yang 'o skol rnams skye dka' ba gling bzhi yi nang nas mchog tu gyur pa/ lho 'dzam bu gling sangs rgyas byon pa'i zhing khams 'dir skyes/ thob par dka' ba'i dal 'byor tshang ba'i mi lus rin po che thob/ mjal bar dka' bas sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa/ mtshan ldan bla ma dang mjal ba'i dus 'dir/ gtan gyi btsan sa zhig zin par ma byas na/yang nas yang du dal 'byor gyi mi lus mi thob/ thob kyang rgyal ba'i bstan pa dang mi mjal ste/ ston pa sangs rgyas kyi zhal nas/ 'jig rten khams ni grangs mang kyang / /'dzam gling sog khar skye ba dkon/ /gtsang ma'i mi lus shin tu dka'/ /zhes dang / slob dpon klu sgrub kyis/ thob dka' 'dzam gling mi yi lus/ /de thob dus su ngan song rgyu/ /rab tu bsgribs te bcad par bya/ /zhes dang / slob dpon pad+mas/ yang yang rnyed dka' u dum wa ra 'di/ /rnyed pa don che yid bzhin nor bu 'dra/ /zhes dang / slob dpon zhi ba lhas/ rgya mtsho cher g.yeng gnya' shing gi /bu gar rus sbal mgrin chud ltar/ /mi nyid shin tu 5

thob dka' gsungs/ /zhes dang / pha dam pas/ spyi sems tsam gyi lus mthong na/ /mi lus thob pa med pa tsam/ /zhes gsungs/rje mi las/ mi khom brgyad po spangs pa yi/ /dal 'byor tshang ba'i mi lus dka'/ /zhes dang / kun mkhyen klong chen pas/ /dal 'byor 'di ni thob pa brgya lam tsam/ /de bas chos dang mjal ba nyin skar tsam/ /zhes dang / rje rin po ches/ mi yi lus dang bstan dang mjal ba ni/ /yang yang mi rnyed da re tsam lags shing / /'di na don chen sgrub pa'i gnas yod pa'i/ /tshul 'di soms la mi lus snying bo longs/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ dal 'byor don ldan zhig mdzad dgos/ de yang sang bya gnang bya'i ngang la phyi bshol du mi 'jog par rdar ma'i pang du sbrul lhung ba ltar/ myur du brtson pas 'bad dgos/ de yi rgyu mtshan/ 'dus byas thams cad mi rtag pa'i rang bzhin/ /snod bcud thams cad 'pho 'gyur gyi khor yug /khyad par sha khrag gi lus 'di ni chu yi lbu ba lta bu/ tshe srog dang dbugs ni la kha'i na bun bzhin du yal bar sla ste/ bu mo sa le 'od kyis/lus sdong rul 'dra ste 'gyel dang snyam/ /dbugs na bun 'dra ste yal la khad/ /sems bsam blo btang bas blo ma bde/ /gsungs/ gang shar rang grol gyis/ tshe srog 'di snum zad mar 6

me 'dra/ /brtan brtan 'dra 'dug kyang myur du 'jig /ces dang / rgya cher rol pa las/ skyes bu'i tshe 'gro nam mkha'i glog 'dra ste/ /ri gzar 'bab chu bzhin du myur mgyogs 'gro/ /zhes dang / slob dpon pad+mas/ /tshe ni mi rtag ston kha'i sprin dang 'dra/ /mdza' bshes gnyen 'dun tshong 'dus mgron po 'dra/ / zhes dang / jo bo rjes/ tshe thung nad mang longs spyod dman/ /rkyen ngan bar chad mang ba yi/ /yun ring sdod pa'i mthu med pas/ /zhes dang / rin chen phreng ba las/ 'chi bdag rkyen gyi nang gnas pa/ /rlung dmar nang 'dug mar me bzhin/ /gsungs/ des na do nub tsam yang mi 'chi snyam pa'i blo gtad ci yang ma mchis te/ /slob dpon zhi ba lhas/ de ring kho na mi 'chi zhes/ /bde bar 'dug pa rigs ma yin/ /zhes dang /tshoms las/ sang dang 'jig rten phyi ma gnyis/ /sngon du gang 'ong gtol med pas/ /zhes dang / sku gsum don thig las/sang dgung do nub 'chi'am mi shes pa'i/ /phyi rtsis blo sna mang po'i ci zhig bya/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ 'chi ba'i rkyen ni glo bur thog ltar 'byung zhing / de la 'bros shing bzung ba'i thabs ni gang yang med de/ 'chi ba'i dus la bab pa'i tshe stobs dang mnga' thang 'khor los bsgyur ba'i rgyal bo yod kyang / rang la 7

phan pa rdul tsam yang mi 'byung zhing / nor dang longs spyod rnam thos sras kyi 'byor ba lta bu yod kyang til 'bru tsam yang 'khyer dbang ni med/ pha ma gnyen bshes grogs mched 'bum phrag mang pos bskor kyang / mar gyi dkyil nas spu bton pa ltar/rang nyid gcig pur rgyus med cha med kyi bar do'i 'phrang ring la skyabs med mgon med du 'gro dgos/ song ba tsam du ma zad/bar do'i 'khrul snang 'jigs skrag drag po bsam gyis mi khyab pa myong zhing / de dus phan pa dam pa'i chos dang / 'dren mkhan bla ma dkon mchog ma gtogs/ tshe 'di'i gnyen bshes zas nor gang gis kyang phan pa spu tsam med de/ ljon shing gi mdo las/ gcig pur myur du 'gro dgos na/ /blo gtad thub pa'i grogs yod dam/ /lo brgyad thub pa'i zas yod kyang / /'chi ba'i nangs par ltogs par 'gro/ /lo brgya 'dangs pa'i gos yod kyang / /'chi ba'i nangs par gcer bur 'gro/ /zhes dang / 'jam dpal rnam rol las/ tha ma khyod kyi skyabs ma yin/ /mdza' bshes rtsa lag rnams kyang min/ /de dag gis ni khyod bor nas/ /rang nyid gcig pur phyi mar 'gro/ /zhes dang /slob dpon pad+mas/ zas nor bro zan gcig dang 'grogs dbang med/ /mar gyi dkyil nas spu bton bzhin du 'gro/ /zhes 8

dang / bla ma zhang gis/ bla ma mdangs drongs zer tsa na/ /'bral mi phod pa'i phun tshogs 'di/ /rang dbang med par lings kyis bor/ /rmi lam bzhin du phyod kyis song / /gsungs/shi ba'i 'og tu rtswa phung ske la bsregs pa ltar/ rgyun chad nas mi 'gro skye ba zhig len dgos/ slar las nyon gyi dbang gis 'khor ba'i gnas 'dir skyes phyin chad/ sdug bsngal ma gtogs bde ba'i go skabs skad cig tsam yang med de/ dmyal bar skyes na tsha grang gi sdug bsngal bzod dka'/ yi dwags la bkres skom gyi sdug bsngal nyam thag dud 'gro la gsod za bkol spyod glen rmongs kyi sdug bsngal yi mug mi la skye rga na 'chi'i sdug bsngal du bro/ lha ma yin la 'thab rtsod kyi sdug bsngal yang / lha la 'chi 'pho ltung ba'i sdug bsngal sogs sdug bsngal bsam gyis mi khyab/ dper na me che chung gang gis bsregs kyang sdug bsngal 'byung ba ltar/ 'khor ba'i gnas 'di'i mtho dman gang du skyes kyang sdug bsngal gyi gnas/ su dang 'grogs kyang sdug bsngal gyi grogs/ ci la longs spyad kyang sdug bsngal gyi longs spyod/ bya ba ci byas kyang sdug bsngal sgrub pa'i thabs 'ba' zhig las ma 'das te/ dran pa nyer bzhag las/ 'khor ba khab kyi rtse tsam na/ /bde ba nam yang yod ma yin/ /zhes dang / don thig 9

las/ rigs drug rnams la 'gyur dang 'du byed dang / /sdug bsngal sdug bsngal dag gis mnar ba dag /legs par brtag na sdug bsngal phung bo ste/ /zhes dang / bshes springs las/ na dang rga sogs sdug bsngal du ma yi/ /'byung gnas 'khor ba 'di la skyo mdzad cing / /zhes dang /rje btsun byams pas/ mi gtsang ba la dri zhim med bzhin 'gro lnga dag na bde ba med/ /gsungs/ po to bas/ 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal mthar ma phyin na/bde ba'i sa ni gang na yang med/ ces dang / klong chen rab 'byams pas/ 'khor ba'i gnas na bde ba med/ /sdug bsngal chu bo'i gnyer ma 'dra/ /zhes dang /jo bo rjes/ grogs dag 'khor ba'i 'dam rdzab 'di na skyid med thar ba'i skam sar gshegs/ /bla ma'i gdams ngag tshul bzhin sgoms la 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal chu bo skoms/ /gsungs/des na nag can btson dong nas 'bros pa ltar/ da re 'khor ba sdug bsngal gyi rgya mtsho las nyon gyi rba rlabs drag tu 'khrug cing sdug bsngal gye chu srin 'jigs su rung bas gang ba 'di las thar/ thabs shig ci nas kyang byed dgos/ de yang rang nyid gcig pu thar ba tsam gyis mi chog ste/ rang gi tshe 'khor ba thog ma ma mchis pas na/sems can thams cad kyi tshe rabs sngon ma rnams su rang gi ma 10

ma byas pa gcig med de/ bshes springs las/ ma yi thug mtha' rgya shug tshi gu tsam/ /ril bur bgrangs kyang sa yis lang mi 'gyur/ /zhes dang / slob springs las/ gang gi lhor ma nyal ba'i sems can de med na gsungs/gzhan yang / sems can gcig gis ma byas pa'i/ /nu zho 'thung ba gang yin pa/ /rgya mtsho chen po bzhi la yang / /de yi tshad tsam yod ma yin/ /gsungs/ma nam byas grangs kyis tshe 'di'i mas bskyangs pa bzhin/ drin gyes bskyangs pa sha stag yin pas/ de rnams yal bar dor nas rang nyid gcig pu ci thar byed na/ de bas khrel med ma rabs shig med de/ slob springs las/ byis pa pang na btsas pa ci yang mi nus pas/ /gang gi nu zho byams pa'i shugs kyis gzags 'thung ba/ /ngal ba mang brten byams la brten pa de dag 'dir/ /shin tu ma rabs shig na'ang spong bar su zhig spro/ /gsungs/ rgyal ba skal bzang rgya mtshos/ bdag drin gyis bskyangs pa'i ma rgan rnams/ /gnas 'jigs rung 'khor ba'i rgya mtshor lhung / /sdug nyam thag ngang tshul ma bsam na/ /bu'i don snying gting nas rul bas na/ /gsungs/ des na ma rnams 'khor ba las sgol ba'i khur rang nyid kyis 'khyer dgos te/ rje skal bzang rgya mtshos/ rang skyid 'dod blo sna lings kyi/ sa 11

bor/ /gzhan phan bde thabs dgu snying la bcing / /gsungs/don thig las/ 'gro ba drug gi sems can thams cad ni/ /bdag gi pha mar ma gyur gcig kyang med/ /pha ma 'di dag 'khor 'khyams snying re rje/ /brtse bas bu gcig shi ba'i ma bzhin du/ /'khor ba'i mtsho las sgol bar dam bca' zhing / /zhes dang / rje rin po ches/ rang nyid srid mtshor lhung ba dzi bzhin du/ /ma gyur 'gro ba kun kyang de 'dra bar/ /mthong nas 'gro ba sgol ba'i khur 'khyer bas/ /gsungs pa ltar/ sems can rnams 'khor ba las sgrol bar 'dod pa'i byang chub sems dpas/ thog mar rang nyid skyon kun zad yon tan kun rdzogs sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par bya dgos/ sangs rgyas kyi sku'i yon tan ni/ mtshan bzang po sum cu/ dpe byad bzang po brgyad cus kun nas mdzes pa/ zhal mthong ba tsam gyis dad pa'i spu long g.yo zhing /byang chub mchog gi sa bon rgyud la bskrun nus/ gsung gi yon tan yan lag drug cu dang ldan pa'i gsung dbyangs shin tu snyan cing / skad re re'i sgo nas chos bstan kyang sems can rang rang gi skad du go nus/ thugs kyi yon tan shes bya ji lta ba dang / ji snyed pa thams cad mngon sum du sa ler gzigs shing / sems can thams cad la ma yi bu rnams 12

la brtse ba ltar/ thugs rje chen po nye ring med par 'jug pas/gdul bya 'dul ba'i dus las skad cig kyang mi 'da'/ 'phrin las kyi yon tan 'bad med lhun gyis grub cing / sku gsung thugs kyi 'od zer re re tsam spros pas kyang sems can dpag tu med pa thams cad mkhyen pa'i go 'phang la 'god nus pa sogs/ mdor na skyon gyi rigs mtha' dag zad cing / yon tan gyi rigs mtha' dag dang ldan pa ste/ bstod pa brgyad cu las/ gang zhig la ni nyes pa kun/ /gtan nas yongs ye mi mnga' zhing / /gang la rnam pa thams cad du/ /yon tan thams cad gnas gyur pa/ /zhes dang / 'phags pa dpa' bos/bdag ni ston pa gzhan spangs nas/ /bcom ldan khyod la skyabs su mchi/ /de ci'i slad du zhe na khyed/ /skyon mi mnga' la yon tan ldan/ /gsungs/ de lta bu'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob pa'i thabs dam pa'i lha chos yin/ chos de bla ma dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyi zhal las thos dgos/ de thos pa la/ bla ma dad pas bsten dgos pa ste/ mnyam med po to bas/ sdug bsngal 'byung gnas srid pa'i rgyu spangs shing / /bde ba'i 'byung gnas byang chub bsgrub par bya/ /byang chub de yang chos la rag las gsungs/ /de nyid bla ma'i zhal la rag las la/ /de yang 13

dad pa'i mthu la rag las gsungs/ /des na yon tan thams cad kyi 'byung gnas bla ma dang chos la dad gus byed pa gal che ste/ dkon mchog ta la'i mdo las/ dad pa sngon 'gro ma ltar bskyed pa ste/ /yon tan thams cad bsdud cing 'phel bar byed/ /dogs pa sel zhing chu bo rnams las sgrol/ /dad pa bde legs grong khyer mtshon byed yin/ /dad pa snyog pa med cing sems dwangs byed/ /nga rgyal spong zhing gus pa'i rtsa ba yin/ /dad pa nor dang gter dang rkang pa'i mchog /lag pa bzhin du dge bsdud rtsa ba yin/ /zhes dang / chos bcu pa las/ gang gi 'dren pa nges 'byung la/ /dad pa theg pa'i mchog yin te/ /de phyir blo dang ldan pa'i mis/ /dad pa'i rjes su 'brang ba bstan/ /zhes dang / gshed dmar gye rgyud las/ yang na blun po dad pa can/ /de la sbyor ba'i dngos grub nye/ /zhes dang /mgon po byams pas/ rang byung rnams kyi don dam ni/ /dad pa kho nas rtog bya yin/ /nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor 'od 'bar la/ /mig med pa ni mthong ba med/ /ces dang / rgyal ba garma pa bdud 'dul rdo rjes/ sa chu 'dzom na ci yang skye/ /dad can slob ma mos gus can/ /dam chos yon tan myur du skye/ /zhes dang / pad+ma bka' thang las/ dad pa can la bde 'byung sgo 14

nyal yod gsungs/ o rgyan gsol 'debs las/ dad ldan mi re'i mdun na pad 'byung re/ /rtag par bzhugs nas byin gyis brlab po gsungs/ /ting nge 'dzin rgyal po las/ lus dang ngag dang yid rab dwangs pa yis/ /rtag tu sangs rgyas dag gis bsngags pa brjod/ /de ltar des ni sems kyi rgyun bsgoms pas/ /nyin mtshan du yang 'jig rten mgon po mthong / /zhes dang / lung gzhan las/ gang gis mos pa gtso byas pa/ /de yi mdun na thub pa bzhugs/ /gsungs/ o rgyan rin po ches/yid khyed shes kyi dad pas byin rlabs 'jug /sems the tshom bral bas ci bsam 'grub/ /ces dang / ma cig gis/ dad pa yod pa'i mi rnams la/ /dgos 'dod thams cad 'byung bar 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs/ sngon zhing ba lnga brgya dang / dud 'gro stong gis sangs rgyas kyi sku mthong tshe dad pa skyes/ sangs rgyas la dad bzhin du tshe dus byas nas lhar skyes/ slar sangs rgyas dang mjal nas bde ba mthong / yang yi dwags lnga brgyas sangs rgyas la chu bslangs pas/ rdzu 'phrul gyis blangs nas byin to / /kun tshim par byas pas yi dwags rnams sangs rgyas la dad bzhin tshe dus byas nas lhar skyes/ yang sangs rgyas la byis pa chung chung zhig gis dang ba'i sems kyis sa snyim pa gang phul 15

bas/ chos rgyal mya ngan med ces bya ba'i rgyal po chen por skyes/yang sngon sprul gnyis dang khyung gnyis bzhi bos sangs rgyas la dad pas skyabs su song bas/ phyi'i rgyal chen sde bzhir skyes/yang tshong pa mang po rgya mtsho'i nang gi chu srin gdug pa can gyi kha nang du chud pas sangs rgyas la dad pas skyabs 'gro byas pas chu srin gyi kha nas thar/ yang lho kha'i phyogs kyi rgad po dad can zhig gis tshe gang bor badz+ra gu ru bton pas dung phyur gcig lhag tsam song / phyis 'chi nad kyis thebs tshe mtshan mo rmi lam du o rgyan rin po che byon/ zhal nas/ rigs kyi bu/ sang nangs par nyi shar la zangs mdog dpal ri bo'i rtse mo nas 'dir dar yug gcig 'jen pas/ dar de'i sne la 'jus yar shog gsung ba rmis pa nye 'khor la bshad/ phyi nyin nyi shar la rgad po tshe dus byas song / de dus lho nub phyogs nas 'ja' tshon kha dog lnga ldan snam bu brgyangs pa lta bu zhig khang steng du zug pa mi kun gyis mthong skad/ yang ci yang mi shes pa'i ra rdzi blun po dad can zhig gis/ tshe gang bor ma ṇi rgyun chad med par bton nas/ phyis shi tshe ro las 'ja' tshon byung nas/steng phyogs kyi nam mkha' la thim pa nye 'khor ba 'ga' res mthong /thod pa'i mtha' la yi ge drug ma rang byung du 'khor ba byung skad/16

yang dbus phyogs kyi bla ma dge bshes sems rgyud bzang zhing /rje bdag nyid chen po la dad pa zhig gis kha ton gyi gtso bo dmigs brtse ma la byas pas/ rmi lam du rje rin po che zhal gzigs/ gshegs nas gdung bzhu dus steng phyogs nas sprin dkar bo zhig dar yug bzhin gdung khang steng du 'then/ rus pa'i steng du dmigs brtse ma'i yi ge rang byon du byung skad/ yang a rig rgad po zhig gis skyabs mgon rgyal ba rin po che la nyin re bzhin gsol btab pas/ phyis 'chi nad kyis thebs tshe gnyid ma gnyid kyi mtshams sogs la rgyal ba rin po che sngas mgo na bzhugs pa'i dag snang byung / gnad gcod chen po med par shi song skad/ dad pa yod na de 'dra 'byung / dad pa med pa'i mi de'i rgyud la yon tan gang yang mi 'byung ste/ rje rgod tshang pas/ dad pa med pa'i tha rgod la/ /yon tan myu gu sgye mi srid/ /nyams rtog ston thog ci la smin/ /gsungs/ chos bcu ba'i mdo las/ ma dad pa yi mi dag la/ /dkar bo'i chos rnams mi 'byung ste/ /sa bon me yis tshig pa la/ /myu gu sngon po ji bzhin no/ /dad dang ldan pa'i mi dag la/ /sangs rgyas las rnams 'grub 'gyur te/ /sngags rnams thams cad khyad par du/ /dad pa med la mi 'grub bo/ /gang yang 'jig rten lha dag 17

dang / /de bzhin 'jig rten 'das pa dag /dad ldan kun la 'grub 'gyur te/ /sdig pa kun dang bral phyir ro/ /zhes dang /rje nā ro pas/ bu dad pa'i rtsa ba mi brtan na/ /gnyis med kyi rtsa ba brtan mi 'gyur/ /gsungs/ zhang g.yu brag 'gro mgon gyis/ bla ma sangs rgyas tha mi dad/ /rang gi snang ba ma dag na/ /spyan ras gzigs kyang khye ror mthong / /par ti ka yi grub thob bzhin/ /rang gi snang ba dag gyur na/ /'jag mig srin 'bu chos skur mthong / /zhes dang / rje spyan snga pas/ mkhris nad can gyis dung dkar ser por mthong / /log rtog can gyis sangs rgyas zog por mthong / /dad ldan mi yis thams cad sangs rgyas mthong / /'di la 'dam kha gyes shig shākya'i sras/ /sangs rgyas su bsgoms sangs rgyas byin rlabs 'jug /zog por bsgoms na zog po'i byen rlabs 'jug /byin rlabs 'di yang mos gus rjes 'brang yin/ /'di la 'dam kha gyis shig shākya'i sras/ /gsungs/ des na dam pa gong ma 'ga' res/ dad pa yod na dkar bo'i chos yod/ dad pa med na dkar bo'i chos med/dad pa 'phel na dkar bo'i chos 'phel/ dad pa 'grib na dkar bo'i chos 'grib/ gsungs/ bod ston 'ga' res skad chen pos a ti sha la gdams ngag zhu zhes zhus pa na/ te te kho 18

bo rna ba bzang po bzang po bdog ste/ man ngag bya ba dad pa yin/ dad pa dad pa gsungs/ yang 'brom rin po ches jo bo la/ bod la sgom sgrub byed mkhan mang po yod pa la/ yon tan khyad par can brnyes pa mi bdog zhus pas/ jo bo'i zhal nas/theg chen gyi yon tan che skyes chung skyes thams cad bla ma la brten nas 'byung ba la/ khyed bod la bla ma la tha mal pa'i 'du shes las med pas yon tan zhig ga la skyes gsungs/ dad pa la rnam grangs mang yang / mnyam med po to ba chen pos/ dang ba'i dad pa/ 'dod pa'i dad pa/ yid ches pa'i dad pa/ phyir mi ldog pa'i dad pa bzhi dgos gsungs/ dang ba'i dad pa/chos dang bla ma dam pa'i mdzad spyod mthong na yid 'phrog pa'i dang ba/ dper na 'dod ldan gyi bu mo mdzes ma mthong ba lta bu zhig dgos/ 'dod pa'i dad pa/ skye 'chi sogs 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal gyis yid gdungs nas/ chos dang bla ma snying la 'dod pa/ dper na skom pa chu 'dod pa lta bu zhig dgos/yid ches pa'i dad pa/ bla ma sangs rgyas dngos yin chos gang gsungs rdo rje'i tshig 'khrul ba med pa yin snyam yid ches pa/dper na ma dang bu 'phrad pa lta bu zhig dgos/ phyir mi ldog pa'i dad pa/ bla ma bsten nas chos la thos bsam sgom gsum 19

gang byed mthar ma thon gyi bar du rkyen bzang ngan gang gis bar mi chod pa/ dper na nyi mas gdungs pa'i glang chen pad mtshor 'jug pa lta bu zhig dgos/ de bzhi'i nang nas bla ma dge ba'i bshes gnyen sangs rgyas dngos dang / zhal nas gang gsungs zab rgyas gdams pa yin snyam yid ches kyi dad pa 'di shin tu gal che ste/ lag na rdo rje dbang bskur ba'i rgyud las/ gsang ba'i bdag po slob dpon la ji ltar blta bar bya zhe na/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das la ji lta ba de bzhin du bgyi'o zhes gsungs/ 'o na bla ma sangs rgyas dngos yin pa'i rgyu mtshan gang yin zhe na/ rnga bo che'i mdo las/ mya ngan ma byed kun dga' bo/ /nga ni phyi ma'i dus su ni/ /dge ba'i bshes gnyen nyid sprul nas/ /khyod la sogs pa'i don byed 'gyur/ /zhes dang / rdo rje gur las/ gang nyid rdo rje sems dpa' zhes/ /de nyid slob dpon gzugs su 'dzin/ /sems can phan gdags dmigs nas ni/ /tha mal pa yi gzugs su gnas/ /zhes dang / gzhan yang/ /bla ma sangs rgyas bla ma chos/ /de bzhin bla ma dge 'dun ste/ /kun gye byed po bla ma yin/ /zhes pa dang / sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i sku/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa'i ngo bo nyid/ /dkon mchog gsum gyi rtsa ba ste/ /zhes 20

gsungs so/ /des na snyigs dus gdul bya'i snang ngor sangs rgyas tha mal mi yi gzugs su shar ba yin/ 'o na bla ma sangs rgyas dngos yin na skyon 'di dang 'di 'dra snang / skyon yod pa'i sangs rgyas shig mi srid snyam na/ dper na mkhris nad can gyis dung dkar bo ser por mthong ba dang / mig shas ngan pas stongs sang gi nam mkha' la bltas na rab rib du mthong ba ltar/ de bla ma'i skyon ma yin te/ rang gi las nyon gyi sgrib pa ma dag pa'i skyon yin/ las sgrib ma dag na bla ma sangs rgyas dngos yin kyang / rang gis sangs rgyas dngos su mthong ngaka' ste/ sngon 'phags pa thogs med kyis rje btsun byam sa pa khobacu gnyis kyi bar du bsgrubs kyang / rtags gang yang ma byung /nyin gcig song bas lam zhig na khye mo ro smad 'bus g.yengs pa zhig gzigs nas snying rje chen po skyes/ khong gi brla'i sha zhig bcad nas 'bu rnams phyag gis blangs na 'chi snyam/ljags kyis 'jam po byas tshur brla sha'i steng du len par rtsom pa na/ khye mo gar song med par song / rje btsun byams mgon mdun du byon pas zhal gzigs tshe/ lo de tsam zhig gi bar du bsgrubs kyang zhal mi gzigs pa thugs rje re chung zhes zhus pa na/ rje btsun byams pas/ nga dang po nas khyed rang gi rtsar 21

byon nas yod pa yin te/ khyod kyi las sgrib ma dag pas ma mthong / cung zad tsam dag pas khyi mor mthong / khye mo la snying rje chen po skyes pas las sgrib thams cad dag pas da nga dngos su mthong ba yin gsungs/ des na bla ma sangs rgyas dngos yin kyang rang gi las sgrib ma dag pas/ yon tan ma mthong ba yin/skyon ci mthong ba rang gi las sgrib kyi skyon yin snyam du dad pa byed dgos/ bla mas rang la mtshang 'bru brnyas smod bsdigs brdung gang byas kyang thugs khros pa yin bsam mi rung ste/ rang la nad gdon bgegs 'dra yod pa zhi ba'i phyir/ thugs khro ba ltar mdzad nas bka' bsgodang byen rlabs byas pa yin snyam lan du khro ba phar zhog lhag par dad pa byed dgos te/ dge bshes lha bzo la/ stong lung pas/ mjal res bzhin bka' bkyon 'byon pa la/ lha bzo'i slob ma nyag mo pas/ slob dbon 'di 'o skol la sdang bzhin 'dug byas pas/ khyod kyis bka' bkyon du go'am/ kho bo la 'dis 'di lta bu re mdzad res kyi he ru ga'i byin gyis brlabs pa 'dra ba re byung gsungs/ yang bla ma'i bya ba las don mi thub mi 'gyu ni gcig phyir gcig mthud nas bcol yang khong gi don yin bsam mi rung ste/ sngon lho brag mar pas/ rje mi la la sras mkhar dgu thog brtsig tu 22

bcug pa phar bltas na lho brag mar pa'i sras kyi ched ltar snang yang / don gye rje mi la'i las sgrib sbyong phyir bsam bzhin du byas pa ltar/ bla ma'i bya ba las don ci bcol phar bltas na khong gi ched lta bur snang yang / don gyis rang gi las sgrib 'dag phyir bla mas bsam bzhin byas pa yin snyam du lhag par dad pa byas spro bzhin bsgrub dgos/ dpal ldan bla mas rnam par thar ba la/ /skad cig tsam yang log lta mi skye zhing / /ci mdzad legs par mthong ba'i mos gus kyi/ /bla ma'i byin rlabs sems la 'jug par shog /gsungs pa ltar bla ma'i mdzad pa gang la log lta spu tsam yang mi skye bar 'gyur med kyi dad gus yod na bla ma'i byen rlabs rgyud la 'jug pa la tshegs med/dad gus che na bla ma bzang po yin na sgos ci dgos/ bla ma shin tu ngan yang rdo rje 'chang sogs phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba sras bcas bla ma ngan pa de'i lus la zhugs nas/ slob mas mchod pa gang phul bzhes rgyud smin cing grol bar byen gyis rlobs te/sbyan snga pas/ bla ma mchod tshe sangs rgyas kun byon nas/ /mchod pa bzhes te slob ma byen gyes rlobs/ /sangs rgyas mchod kyang de ltar yongs nges med/ /mchod yul bla ma bzang ngo shākya'i sras/ /zhes dang / 'jam dpal zhal lung las/ 'di yi 23

don ldan 'ga' zhig la/ /nga ni de yi lus gnas te/ /sgrub po gzhan las mchod pa len/ /zhes dang / tsi lu ba'i gsang 'dus kyi 'brel ba las/ sangs rgyas rnams ni rdo rje slob dpon gyi lus la zhugs nas/ sems can gyi don mdzad par gsungs/ sngon rgya gar gyi mi gcig gis dug gsum gyi dbang gis mi 'tshams pa'i las rang gi pha dang ma gnyis snga phyi byas bsad/ phyis dbul bor gyur sprang la song / lam kha zhig na dge slong zhig shi song ba'i ro shun 'phangs yod pa gyon nas yul gzhan zhig tu song / mi 'ga' res khyod ci zhig yin dris pas/ kho bo ni sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa la rab tu byung bsnyen par rdzogs pa'i dge slong dgra bcom pa'i go 'phang thob pa zhig yin/ gzhan don du phyogs 'dir 'ong ba yin zhes rdzun smras/ de kun gyis bden par gzung / dad gus tshad med byas/yul phyogs 'di'i mi rnams la chos gsungs nus pas/ kho rang gis sngar chos shes pa rnams bshad pas/ slob ma dgra bcom pa mang po byung / phyis kho rang lo lon nas mtshams med las pha ma bsad pa'i rnam smin gyis shi ma thag nas dmyal bar lhung snyam gnong 'gyod 'jigs skrag skyes/ kha nas a tsha tsam ma shor bas/slob ma 'ga' res go nas/ khyed kyis mtshan mo tsho skabs re a 24

tsha ma gsungs pa ci yin lags zhus tshe/ de kho bos ngan song gi sems can rnams kyi sdug bsngal bsams nas snying rje chen po skyes pa'i shugs kyis kha nas shor song ba yin zhes dzun bshad/slob ma kun gyis bden snyam lhag par dad pa byas/ bla ma shi nas slob ma dgra bcom pa gcig gis mngon shes kyis/ bla ma rin po che sangs rgyas kyi zhing gang na yod bltas pas/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing khams gang nas kyang bla ma ma mthong / lha mi'i yul na 'gro don mdzad pa e yin snyam bltas pas kyang bla ma ma mthong / ngan song gsum na 'gro don mdzad pa e yin snyam bltas tshe/ dmyal ba'i gshin rje mang pos lcags kyi zangs chen zhig gi nang du khro chu bskol nas bla ma 'tshod pa mthong /'jigs shing skrag nas kun la nged rang tsho'i bla ma dmyal bar lhung 'dug ces bla ma'i don du dmigs nas slob ma kun gyis tshogs gsog sgrib sbyong byas pas/ bla ma'i pha ma bsad pa'i rnam smin byang zhing dag nas/ dag zhing zhig tu sgyes skad/ des na slob ma dad gus che na bla ma ngan yang / slob ma de 'dra byung ba yin/ sngon bla ma skyabs 'gro tsam min mi shes pa gcig la rgan mo dad can zhig gis chos zhig gnang dgos zhus pas/ mi shes bshad kyang yang yang nan gyis zhus tshe/ bla mas chos mi shes 25

pa'i shugs kyis/ kha nas mi shes pa 'di sdug bsngal zhes shor song ba/ rgan mos chos su go mi shes pa 'di gsungs pa ma rig pa red/ sdug bsngal gsungs pa de ma rig pa'i dbang gis sdug bsngal 'byung gsungs pa red/ chos zab mo zhig gnang byung bka' drin che snyam snam bu zhig phul/ yul du 'ong nas sdug bsngal gye rtsa ba ma rig pa spangs pas/ dgra bcom pa'i go 'phang thob skad/ yang sngon a mdo phyogs kyi ma bu gnyis kyi bu dbus su mjal du 'gro ba la/ mas a ma nga na so rgas pas dbus su 'gro ma nus pa la dad rten du bu khyod kyis lha sa'i rdo zhig khyer shog dang / jo bo'i 'du shes bzhag nas phyag 'tshal smras pa/ bu dbus su slebs tshe lha sa'i rdo 'khyer dgos pa brjed nas/ mar rma chu'i khar 'ong nas dran tshe/ rma 'gram gye rdo zhig khyer 'ong / yul du thon tshe ma la dbus kyi rdo yin zhes rdzun smras nas byen/ mas bden par bzung / dad pa byas mgo thog tu bzhag de nas gong gi mtho sa zhig tu bzhag nas/ jo bo'i sku'i 'du shes bzhag nyin re bzhin du phyag mchod byas pas/nyin gcig ma bu gnyis 'khon nas/ bu yis ma la/ rma rdo la phyag 'tshal nas/ ma khyod kyis dbus rdo yin e snyam smras pas/mas rdo de lag tu blangs/ sa la brgyab pas rdo chags pa'i nang 26

nas sangs rgyas kyi sku tshon gang ba zhig byung skad/ yang rgad po dad can gdugs dkar 'don mkhan zhig gis gdugs dkar 'don bzhin du bla ma zhig gi drung du song bas/ bla mas bltas tshe rgad po de'i mgo na gdugs dkar bo zhig kyi li li 'khor ba mthong / rgad po drung du thon nas mjal tshe/ rgad po khyod kyi kha ton du ci 'don gsungs pa'i lan du/ gdugs dkar 'don lags zhus pas/ bla mas 'o na khyod kyis gcig thon dang gsungs/ rgad pos bton pas sngags mi dag pa mang po byung / bla mas de ma red mi dag pa mang po snang gsungs tshe/rgad po 'gyod nas kho bos sngar tshe sa/nga bor bton tshad ma dag pa byung / da ci bya snyam sems sdug bla mas bslab pa ltar 'don gyin song dus/ bla mas phyi nas bltas tshe mgo yi gdugs ma mthong / rgad bo phyir bos nas/ nga 'chug 'dug khyod kyis sngar bton pa de dag gi de ltar thon gsungs pas/ rgad po dga' bzhin sngar ltar 'don gyin song / bla mas phyi nas bltas tshe gdugs sngar bzhin 'khor ba mthong skad/ yang sngags kyi rnal 'byor pa zhig gis bud med thams cad ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro dngos yin snyam/ gang mthong la dad gus dag snang gis phyag bskor byas gsol ba btab pas/ nyin gcig bud med 27

zhig gis ba glang 'ga' ded nas 'ong ba zhig dang 'phrad pas/de la yang phyag bskor byas/ gsol ba btab/ bud med des mo rang gi gsang ba'i bha ga nas/ la phug 'dra ba zhig blangs nas byen pa mgo thog tu bzhag la tshur khyer 'ong / chu kha zhig tu slebs nas/ grogs gcig yod pa de la/ me thongs dang de ring 'di dngos grub zhig yin las che/ nged gnyis kyis btsos nas za smras/ btsos nas tshos tshe/ grogs des 'ongs dma' ba la skyug log nas ma zos/ kho rang gis zos tshar 'phro/ gzan la gshog pa mdzad nas mkha' la yar gyen du 'phur/ glu gar byed bzhin je mtho je mthor gyur nas sku lus ma spangs par mkha' spyod dag pa'i zhing du song skad/ yang sngags kyi rnal 'byor pa gcig gis bud med thams cad la rdo rje phag mo'i 'du shes bzhag dad gus dag snang sbyangs/ phyag bskor byed bzhin song bas/ nyin gcig sba chung ser po zhig gis sgor slong du song /nang nas rgan mo bzhin mi sdug cing 'jigs su rung ba gcig gis/ snod ngan zhig gi nang du zas ngan btsog pa zhig khyer 'ong nas byen pa/ 'di ni rdo rje phag mos dngos grub gnang ba yin snyam zos pas ro phun sum tshogs pa byung zos tshar 'phro/rgan mo de yang gnas 'gyur nas rdo rje phag mor gyur/ snyan 28

brgyud kyi gdams pa gnang bas rnal 'byor pa des bsgom pas/tshe der mchog gi dngos grub thob skad/ yang mi gcig bla ma zhig la gdams ngag zhu ru song pas/ bla mas gdams pa gnang gnang / kha dang ngo tsho bltas na rak+ka'i phreng ba 'dra 'dra bo/zhes ku re zhig gsungs pa/ mi des gdams ngag gnang ba yin snyam/ yul du 'ong nas de bton bton nas ngag nus can zhig tu song / nad pa mang po sngags btab nas drag pa byung /lo gcig bla ma de'i mgrin pa'i nang du rma 'bras zhig byung /thabs gang byas kyang phan ma thogs/ 'ga' res khyed kyi slob ma de gcig byung na phan zhus pas/ khrid shog gsungs/ 'ong tshe bla mas khyod la khong gi rma 'bras 'di la phan pa'i gdams pa 'dra e yod dris pas/ kho na re/ gdams pa gnang gnang kha dang ngo tsho bltas na rak+ka'i phreng ba 'dra 'dra bo zhes hus zer mchi ma zhig btab pas/ bla ma sang shed kyis cig bzhad nas rma 'bras dral nas drag song skad/ yang sngon phur ba'i rnal 'byor pa/badz+ra kyi li kyi la ya zhes sngags bgrang pas grub pa thob pa gcig la/ gzhan bla ma gcig gis kyi la ma red ki la red smras tshe/rked na phur ba zhig yod pa brag la brdabs nas/ sngon yang badz+ra kyi li kyi la yin/ da yang badz+ra kyi li kyi la zer gsungs/29

slar brag nas phur ba tshur blangs skad/ yang slob dpon klu sgrub la rngon pa khye khrid pa zhig gis gdams pa zhus pas/ slob dpon gyis yid ches kyi dad pa yod med kyi snod brtag dgongs/khyod kyi mgo la yang rwa ldem me gnyis skyes yod par sgoms gsungs/ bsgoms pas nga brag khung gi phyi nang du 'thog nas sgur dgos pa byung zhus pas/ yang rwa de gnyis je thung du gyur nas med par sgoms gsungs/ bsgoms pas rwa gnyis mgo nas med par song / de ltar bsgoms pas bskyed rdzogs kyi snod rung du gyur/ phyis gdams pa dngos bstan nas bsgoms pas rgya gar skad du na ga bo rnyi/ bod skad du klu'i byang chub zhes bya ba'i zas la rtsol ba mi dgos pa'i grub thob chen po zhig byung skad/ des na dad gus dag snang che na de 'dra 'ong ba sha stag yin/ dad pa med na bla ma sangs rgyas dngos yin kyang / rang rgyud la yon tan gang yang 'ong mi srid/ dper na brag phug kha byang bstan la nyi ma mi 'char ba dang 'dra/ sngon legs pa'i skar mas ston pa sangs rgyas lo mang po'i bar du dngos su bsten/ mdo sde mang po blo la bzung yang / dad pa med pas ston pa sangs rgyas kyis gdul bya lung bstan pa zog byas par mthong ba sogs ci mdzad thams cad skyon 'ba' zhig tu sems 30

dad log byas pas/ phyis sogs nas tshe der dmyal ba mnar med du lung gsungs/ des na chos 'brel bzhag tshad kyi bla ma dang / chos thos tshad la dad pa byed pa gal che/ 'o na de ltar rang gi bla ma dang chos la dad gus zhig skyes na de tsam gyis chog gam snyam na mi chog ste/ phyogs med kyi dad gus dag snang chen po zhig ma skyes na/ phyogs cha can gyi dad pa zhig skyes kyang /'gyur ldog che zhing / chags sdang gi rgyur song nas khong khros rang gzhin gye rgyud bsreg las ngan pa bsags nas ngan song du lhung nyen che ste/ rin chen 'phreng ba las/ dad pa can ni bzung nyes pas/ /gcig shos sdang phyir khros pa yis/ /dad pa can yang bsreg bshad na/ /sdang ba'i phyir phyogs smos ci dgos/ /gsungs/des na gzhan gang zag mchog dman 'bring gsum chos lugs rab 'bring tha gsum gang yang smad cing mi spong bar kun la dad gus dag snang sbyong ba gnad shin tu zab te/ de'i rgyu mtshan gang yin zer na/ stong gsum mi mjed kyi zhing khams 'di ston pa sangs rgyas kyi gdul bya'i zhing yin te/ mdo las/mi mjed kyi 'jig rten gyi khams 'di ni de bzhin gshegs pa shākya thub pa'i zhing khams so/ /de bas na de bzhin gshegs pa 31

gang yin pa de ni yi dam gyi lha'o/ /yi dam gyi lha gang yin pa de bzhin gshegs pa'o gsungs/ sangs rgyas ni thabs mkhas la thugs rje che ba yin pa'i sna tshogs thabs kyi dngos sam brgyud nas thugs rjes ma bzung ba'i sems can gcig kyang med de/sangs rgyas kyi zhal nas/ nga'i thugs rjes yongs su ma bzung ba'i sems can ni 'jig rten gye khams na gcig kyang rnyed par sla ba ma yin no gsungs/ bsngags 'os bsngags bstod las/ khyod kyis gang las 'gro ba dag /ma drangs rgud pa de gang mchis/ /gang dang 'jig rten ma sprad pas/ /phun tshogs de yang gang zhig mchis/ /gsungs/ /khyad par snyigs ma'i dus 'dir sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das ni tshangs pa/ brgya byen/rgyal po blon po/ bla ma dge skos/ dge slong ban+de/ pho skyes/ bud med/ bdud dang srin po/ glen pa zhwa bo/ spyon pa sprang slong la sogs bzang ngan sna tshogs par sprul nas 'gro ba'i don mdzad pa yin te/ yab sras mjal ba'i mdo las/ brgya byin tshangs pa'i cha byad dang / /la lar bdud kyi cha byad kyis/ /sems can rnams kyi don mdzad de/ /'jig rten rnams kyis rtogs mi nus/ /bud med cha byad spyod pa mdzad/ /dud 'gro'i skye gnas na'ang gda'/ /'dod chags mi mnga' chags pa'i tshul/ /32

'jigs pa mi mnga' 'jigs pa ltar/ /rmongs med rmongs pa'i tshul bstan te/ /smyon pa ma lags smyon pa'i tshul/ /zha ba ma lags zha ba ltar/ /rnam par 'phrul ba sna tshogs kyis/ /sems can rnams ni 'dul bar mdzad/ /zhes dang / mdo sde phal bo che las/ chos dbyengs dam par bde bar gshegs pa ni/ /sems can khams dang mnyam nyid mnyam par 'gyur/ /bsam pa sna tshogs rgyal ba'i chos rnams la/ /bsam gyis mi khyab dri med rab tu 'jug /ces dang / mu stegs can gyi gnas rnams thams cad du/ /mu stegs can gyis slob dbon mkhas par ston/ /lta ba ngan la gnas pa'i mu stegs can/ /kun la phra ba'i gzhi dang thabs tshul gyes/ /nge dag rnams la bden pa ston par byed/ /mu stegs can gyis sdug bsngal spang bar 'dul/ /zhes dang / bzhi brgya ba las/ thub pa ma gtogs ji lta'i dngos/ /de bzhin gshegs las gzhan yod min/ /zhes dang / brtag gnyis las/ sems can rnams ni sangs rgyas nyid/ /ces dang / mdo sde gzhan las/ bde gshegs snying bos 'gro ba yongs la khyab/ /'gro ba 'di dag ma lus sangs rgyas nyid/ /ces dang / ba tshwa can gyi chu klung gi mdo las/ lnga brgya dus kyi tha ma la/ /nga nyid dge ba'i bshes su byon/ /nga yin snyam du blos zungs la/ /de 33

tshe de la gus pa bskyed/ /ces dang / mkha' 'gro ma rdo rje gur gye rgyud las/ sangs rgyas 'jig rten skyabs bzhed pas/ /glu dang gar la dga' ba yi/ /srog chags rnams ni drangs pa'i phyir/ /sangs rgyas gar mkhan rol pa mdzad/ /ri bong stag dang seṅge dang / /glang chen la sogs du ma ru/ /snying rjes phan pa'i sems kyi ni/ /phyag rgya sgrub pas skye bar 'gyur/ /zhes dang /dpal ye shes grub pa las/ sems can kun gyi yid khyab phyir/ /rdo rje sems dpa' rang nyid bzhugs/ /de ltar bsams nas rnal 'byor gyi/ /dbang bos gang la brnyas mi bya/ /zhes dang / 'phags pa lhas/ khams gsum 'di dag gzhal yas khang / /srog chags 'di dag dkyil 'khor ba/ /zhes dang / rdo rje dril bu pas/ /khams gsum 'di dag rang bzhin gyis/ /grub pa'i dkyil 'khor gnyis med pa'o/ /zhes dang / sgon gsal gye rgyud du drangs pa las/ pha rol rgol ba mu stegs gang yang rung / /mtshan ma'i dbye ba'i gnas pa rnams/ /de 'dir brnyas par mi bya ste/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i rnam 'phrul yin/ /zhes gsungs/ sngon mi rkang bzhi yod pa zhig rkun ma 'gas khyer nas lha gnod sbyin zhig yod pa sha khrag gis mchod snyam nas/ gsod grabs byas tshe/ mi des sangs rgyas la skyabs 'gro byas pas/34

sangs rgyas gnod sbyin de 'dra zhig tu sprul nas song / rkun ma rnams la mi 'di nga la gson por phul cig gsungs pa'i tshe/phul nas thar ba'i lo rgyus dang / sngon spyan ras gzigs kyi rnam 'phrul rgyal po srong btsan sgam pos/ dmu rgod gdul dka'i bod 'bangs bde la 'god pa'i thabs su nyes can mang po dang de la khrims gcod pa'i sdig blon mang po sprul pa'i lo rgyus dang / mtsho skyes rdo rjes rgya gar gye paṇ+ḍi ta mang pos rab gnas zhig mdzad pa'i sar btsun rgan gcig tu sprul/ gsang yum btsun rgan ma gcig tu byas/ byis pa gnyis rgyab tu khur nas mnyam du 'big di ri ri song ba'i lo rgyus dang / rje btsun byams mgon gyis 'phags pa thogs med kyi gzigs ngor/ sku lus khye mo ro smad 'bus g.yeng ba zhig tu sprul pa dang / rdo rje phag mos/ dge bshes tshom bu pa'i snang ngor sku lus mdze mo zhig tu sprul pa dang / te lo pas/ paṇa chen nā ro pa'i snang ngor/nya gson sreg byed par sprul pa dang / rje btsun mi las/ yon bdag 'ga' zhig gi snang ngor sku lus bsa' zhig tu sprul nas/pha bong zhig gi steng nas gzigs pa dang / lha 'dre 'ga' zhig gi snang ngor sku lus chu 'khyel zhig tu sprul pa dang / ras chung pa'i snang ngor sku lus nad can gyi sprang slong nyam thag zhig tu 35

sprul nas g.yu rdog chen po zhig bslangs pa dang / dwags po lha rje'i snang ngor/ sprang bo zhig tu sprul nas lam sna khrid pa dang /sku gshegs khar yang zhi ba 'od sogs bu slob la/ dad gus can gyis gsol ba btab na/ de yi mdun du nga nyid bzhugs nas/gang bsam 'dod pa'i don stsol ba yin gsungs/ sngon grub chen lnga ba pa tsa rir phebs dus nye gnas bhu su ka bya bas chos nyid rnam par dag pa'i sngags 'dren cing song bas/ bud med nyer gcig dang 'phrad pas kho sems gzhan zhig tu yengs pa'i bar la bud med gtso mo de med par song / lag tu la phug zhig byung / de khyer 'ong nas slob dpon la zhus pas/ legs par khrus/ gshog la tshos gsungs/ chos nas ci byed zhus pas/khong la phor ba gang drongs/ khyod kyis phor ba gang 'byung gsungs/ khong la drangs nas/ kho rang gis mi sha yin snyam ma 'thung / rang skal khye zhig yod pa la bkru bshal dang lhan du byen pas slob dpon dang / khye gnyis mkha' spyod ri'i rtse mo la byon/ mkha' spyod du gshegs/ nye gnas kho bo shul du lus tshe smre sngags 'don dgos pa byung / bud med de mkha' 'gro ma la ghi yin zhes kun mkhyen pad+ma dkar pos gsungs/ sngon jag pa mi 'gas/ ri sul zhig na bud med gcig gis sgom byed pa la/36

btsan thabs byas chags pa sbyad/ spyad ma thag nas jag pa rnams kyi lus la bde ba sems la dga' ba bsam gyis mi khyab cing / lus shing bal bya sgro bas kyang yang zhing nam mkha' la 'phur nus pa byung / bud med de mkha' 'gro ye shes mtsho rgyal yin zhes rnam thar yod skad/ yang sngon bla ma gcig gis mngon shes kyis gzigs tshe lha sa'i mtha' na rgan mo bdag med ma/nyin par zas skom kyang mi la mi slong bar rgyun du nyal nas 'dug pa gcig yod pa/ mtshan mo rnams su mkha' 'gro ma mang po'i tshogs dpon mdzad nas tshogs la rol bar 'dug ces gsungs skad/ yang sngon rdo rje rnal 'byor ma dngos su yod pa'i bla ma zhig la/ nye gnas kyis bdag gis khyed kyi nye gnas lo mang byas pas/ kho bo da mkha' spyod du 'khrid par zhu zhus pas/bla mas phyi nas nged gnyis lhan du 'gro gsungs pas/ kho bo da lta 'gro ba zhig cis kyang mdzad dgos zhus pas/ de yin na yongs rdo rje rnal 'byor ma la khyod 'dren du 'jug pas je tshom med par gsol ba thob gsungs/ khong gis rdo rje rnal 'byor mar zhus pas/ rdo rje rnal 'byor ma bud med gzhon nu ma zhig tu sprul nas song / nga ni rdo rje rnal 'byor ma yin/ khyod kyis nga la chags pa zhig spyod dang mkha' spyod du bgrod pa'i nus pa 37

'byung gsungs/ kho the tshom skyes nas/ khyed rdo rje rnal 'byor ma yin na sgu dngos shig ston dang / de nas chags pa spyod smras pas/ sku dngos ston mi rung khyod kyis sku'i gzi brjid mi bzod par shi 'gro bas/ thog mar chags pa zhig spyod dang / de nas sku dngos bstan kyang chog gsungs/ de la ma nyan par cis kyang sngon du sku dngos shig ston zhus pas/ bud med de skad cig gi gnas 'gyur nas rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i sku gzi brjid 'od zer 'bar ba ji lta ba bzhin bstan pas yid ches kyang / sku'i gzi brjid ma bzod par shi song / lus ma spangs par mkha' spyod du 'gro ba'i skal ba ma byung / rnam shes mkha' spyod du drangs zhes rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i lo rgyus shig na bshad yod skad/ yang sngon rje rgod tshang pa sku gshegs zin pas/ khyed kyi sngon tsam la kho bo gshegs zhing khams gzhan nas mjal bar zhu zhes bya rgod dkar mo zhig tu sprul nas lho phyogs su 'phur song zhes rje de'i rnam thar nas gsungs/ rje rgod tshang pa'i zhal nas/ nga'i lus kyis sprul pa dpag tu med pa zhig bkye nas/'dzam gling thams cad du gang la gang 'dul gyi 'gro don mdzad de/ sus kyang nga rang du ngo ma shes pa byung / phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad na yang nga yi sprul pas 38

khyab par yod gsungs/ dus gsum sangs rgyas nga rang yin/ /'khor lo bde mchog nga rang yin/ /sprul sku mthar thug nga rang yin/ /nga yi sprul pa sna tshogs kyis/ /phyogs bcu'i zhing khams kun la khyab/ /gsungs/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dpa' bo mkha' 'gro ma rnams snyigs dus 'dir lhag par tha mal pa'i tshul 'dzin pa mang zhes dam pa mang pos gsungs/ tha na gru dang zam pa chu chen lam 'phrang gcan gzan jag rkun ma rungs pa sogs su sprul nas 'gro ba'i don mdzad pa bsam gyis mi khyab pas na/ sangs rgyas rol ba bsam mi khyab gsungs pa dang / gang la gang 'dul de la der ston pa gsungs pa sogs kyi rgyu mtshan don rnams shes na go rgyu chen po zhig yod/ des na rang la mngon shes med bzhin du/ skya ser pho mo su la yang / 'di ni ngan zhes thag bcad nas brnyas smod byed mi rung ste/ sangs rgyas kyis nga dang lta bu ma gtogs/ gang zag gi tshod gang zag gis bzung bar mi bya'o/ /gsungs/legs grub las/ rang bzhin ngan pa'i mi dag la/ /brnyas pa yang ni mi bya'o/ /zhes dang / /rje mi las/ pha rol sems rgyud mi shes pas/ /chos dang gang zag ma smod cig /rlom sems ltung bas phog nyen gda'/ /zhes dang / rgyal sras thogs med 39

kyis/ nyon mongs dbang gis rgyal sras gzhan dag gi /nyes pa gleng na rang nyid nyams 'gyur bas/ /theg pa che la zhugs pa'i gang zag gi /nyes pa mi smra rgyal sras lag len yin/ /gsungs/dge bshes glang ri thang pas/ gang zag gi tshod gang zag gis mi zin pas su la yang skur ba mi gdab gsungs/ spyan snga pas/gzhan su la'ang tshod 'dzin mi bya/ byas na skyon cha du ma nas bskyed gsungs/ rje dge legs bstan 'dzin gyis/ skyes bu dam pa su yin mi shes pas/ /gzhan la skur ba ma 'debs shes ldan rnams/ /gsungs/ grub thob gling ras pas/ chos kyi spyan dang mi ldan par/ /gang zag rgyud tshod mi shes pas/ /don med sdig pa mi bsags 'tshal/ /gsungs/ dpung bzang las/sems can gzhan la smad par mi bya'o/ /gsungs/ des na 'o sgol rnams kyis gang zag gi bzang ngan shes dka' bas/sems can mchog dman 'bring gsum gang la yang mi smod par/thams cad la ston pa'i 'du shes bzhag nas gus pa khyad par can byed dgos te/ byang chub sems dpa' nor bu'i 'phreng ba las/ las dang po nga yi sems can la/ /ston pa'i 'du shes bskyed par bya/ /zhes dang / spyan snga pas/ sems can kun la'ang ston pa'i 'du shes kyi/ /dag snang dgos pa mdo rgyud 40

kun nas gsungs/ /zhes dang / rje garma pa dbang phyug rdo rjes/rje mnyam med dwags po bka' rgyud kyi/ /chos man ngag gzhung lugs mang lags kyang / /mdor dril na mos gus su 'dus zhes gsungs/ /sman dkar bo gcig thub de la zer/ /'di rang rgyud la 'dres shing gnad jeb na/ /chos gcig shes kun grol yin par gda'/ /don des na 'di la gcig dril gyis/ /gsungs/ /rje bud+ngha badz+ra gyis/ gang zag rgyud tshod brtag dka' bas/ /kun la dag snang sbyong ba zab/ /gsungs/ 'ba' ra bas/thams cad bde gshegs snying bo can/ /chu bur sgye bo'i mig 'di yis/ /sprul sku gang yin mi shes kyi/ /dag snang sbyongs shig rgyal mtshan dpal/ /gsungs/ rgyal ba dge 'dun grub kyis/spyir lus can kun la dka' drin soms/ /sgos chos mdzad yongs la dag snang sbyongs/ /gsungs/ dpa' bor 'gro ba'i ting nge 'dzin gyi mdo las/ sems can thams cad la ston pa'i 'du shes bskyed par bgyi'o/ /zhes dang / dam chos pad+ma dkar bo nas kyang / de bzhin du gsungs/ 'phags pa dri ma med par grags pa'i mdo las/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing dag par yongs su skye bar bya ba'i phyir/ sems can thams cad la ston pa ltar gces par byed do/ /zhes dang / dad pa'i stobs bsgyed pa'i 41

mdo las/ bdag ni sems can thams cad kyi slob mar khas len cing / gzhan dag kyang slob mar khas len du gzung ngo / /zhes dbugs 'byen pa rnyed do/ /de bzhin du 'dud pa dang rab tu 'dud do/ /zhes dang / lhag bsam bskul ba'i mdo las/ byang chub sems dpas gang zag thams cad la phyag bgyi'o/ /de bas na sangs rgyas thams cad bslus par 'gyur ro/ /'di ni nges pa'i don no/ /zhes dang / bde mchog rgyud las/ bud med thams cad mthong ba na/ /g.yon nas lan gsum bskor bya zhing / /spyi bos phyag ni byas nas kyang / /lan gsum bar du gsol yang gdab/ /gsungs/ spyod 'jug las/sems canarnams dang rgyal ba la/ /sangs rgyas chos 'grub 'dra ba la/ /rgyal la gus byed de bzhin du/ /sems can rnams min ci yin tshul/ /zhes dang / jo bo rjes/ rang dge ma bsam gzhan dge soms la kun la bran bzhin gus par mdzod/ /gsungs/ rgyal sras thogs med kyis/ 'gro mang 'dus pa'i dbus su 'ga' zhig gis/ /mtshang nas brus shing mi snyan smras na yang / /de la dge ba'i bshes kyi 'du shes kyis/ /gus pas 'dud pa rgyal sras lag len yin/ /zhes dang / rje rin po ches/chos mdzad 'dug tshad rnams la mos gus gyis/ /gsungs/42

dam pa gong ma 'ga' res/ mos gus bsgom gyi mgo bo yin/ /zhen log bsgom gyi rkang ba yin/ /gsungs/ des na sems can mchog dman gang la skyon brjod mi rung ba smos ci dgos/ ston pa'i 'du shes bzhag nas/ rab tu dad cing gus pas/ bla ma dge bshes la sogs par lus kyi phyag byar 'os pa rnams la lus kyis dngos su phyag 'tshal mchod bstod bkur/ skyes pho mo ban chung sogs la lus kyis dngos su phyag byas na/ gzhan mi dad pa la yid kyis phyag bya dgos/ tha na sprang slong zhig yan chad mthong na/ 'di yang sangs rgyas kyi sprul pa zhig yin na'ang go shes med snyam/ ston pa sangs rgyas kyi 'du shes bskyed nas/yid kyis phyag bya dgos/ mi dga' ba nam yang mi bya ste/ spyan snga pas/ tha na khye rgan gcig la'ang mi snyan pa nam yang brjod mi rung gsungs/ bka' gdams bla ma gong mas lam srang gi lhan pa ser po yan chad gus pas spyi bor len skad/ gzhan smos ci dgos/ rje rgod tshang pa'i rnam thar las/ mtho dman 'bring gsum med pa'i lus kyi 'og nas rang gi lus 'dzul zhing /drung du gzhan su dang su 'phrad byung kyang / lus kyi sgo nas/gong dang zhabs tog dang bkur sti mdzad de/ gral gong du khong bzhag gral 'og tu rang bsdad/ zas la sogs pa ro bda' 43

ba khong la drangs/ mi bda' ba rang gis gsol zhing / sdod sa dga' ba la khong bzhag mi dga' bar rang bsdad de/ mdor na drung du su dang byung yang / ma dad pa dang ma gus pa ci yang mi mdzad par/ dad cing gus pa'i sgo nas zhabs tog mdzad/yang gsung gis kyang mtho dman 'bring gsum med pa'i ngag gi 'og tu 'dzul te/ de yang drung du su dang su 'dra byung yang /gsungs dad cing mos pas/ 'thab pa dang gshe ba sogs med par/ snyan pa dang / bstod pa thams cad khong la mdzad/ smad pa dang / mi snyan pa thams cad rang la mdzad cing / gsungs 'jam zhing snyan pas tshig rtsub dang / ngag 'khyal la sogs pa ci yang mi gsung bar/ snyan pa dang / bstod ra la sogs mdzad cing / thams cad mnyes par mdzad do/ /yang thugs kyis mtho dman 'bring gsum med pa'i yid kyi 'og nas 'dzul te/de'ang drung du su byung yang / de la thugs dad pa dang / mos pa dang / yi rangs par mdzad cing / mi mos pa dang / mi dad pa dang / log par lta ba dang / brnab sems dang / gnod sems sogs mi mdzad par/ mos shing dad pas thams cad mnyes par mdzad do/ /mdor na dus dang rnam pa thams cad du rang gi bde ba dang / gzhan gyi sdug bsngal brje ba la thog badzis 44

dang / nyam nga med par bde sdug ro snyoms mdzad cing / gzhan gye phus ngag yid gsum gyi 'og nas/ rin po che rang gi sku gsurnga thugs kyis 'dzul ba'i thugs dam yang mdzad gsungs/der rje rgod tshang pa'i zhal nas/ nga'i lus ngag yid gsum gyes mtho dman med pa'i 'og nas 'dzul zhing / mdzad spyod thams cad de ltar byas pas/ yon tan thams cad mi 'dod kyang / spungs pa bzhin du byung ba yin/ khyed rnams kyis pha garma'i gral gyi mgo la ma thon gyis dogs/ rang nyid gral gzhug tu lus kyis dogs/ gzhan la bsnyen bkur dang / 'bul 'degs byung gis dogs/ rang la ma byung gis dogs/ gzhan la bstod ra dang snyan pa ches kyis dogs/ rang la smad ra dang mi snyan pa byung gis dogs/ mdor na yon tan thabs dang ldan pa mthong na/ blo kyog ril ril yang ba'i mdzad spyod 'di la/ yon tan rang ci ltar skye'am gsungs/ 'di 'dra'i rgyal ba'i gsung rab dang / dam pa gong ma'i rnam thar la sgo bstun na snyigs dus bla ma grub chen/ dge bshes/ mkhas btsun bzang po'i gzugs brnyan bdag dang bdag 'dra'i mdzad spyod 'dis gang yang ma phyin par 'dug pas/ rang gzhan yongs kyis chos ma shes pa'i mtshang zhig la/ 'di bas che 45

ba zhig gzhan zhig na yod ma sems/ da chos bzhin byed na mtshang de bton nas/ rgyal ba rnams kyi gsung dang / dam pa gong ma'i rnam thar bzang po/ de ltar lag len la ci thebs byed pa gces so/ /'o na phyi rol pa dang / bon po/ hwa shang /shan pa/ yugs sa ma/ khye rgan sogs la'ang phyag byed dgos sam zer na/ cis mi dgos/ de sems can ma yin nam/dngos sam yid gang rung gis phyag byed dgos/ 'o na phyi rol pa sogs la phyag byas na skyabs 'gro'i bslab bya dang mi 'gal lam zer na/ ci la 'gal/ ston pa sangs rgyas kyi 'du shes bzhag nas phyag byas pas/ skyabs 'gro'i bslab bya dang 'gal ba phar zhog shin tu mthun nyes pa yod pa phar zhog sangs rgyas la phyag phul ba lta bu'i bsod nams thob par 'gyur/ deng sang gsar rnying gi bla ma chags sdang can 'ga' res/ gcig gis gcig mthong na/ pha bsad kyi bu dang lag dmar gnyis kyis gcig gis gcig mthong ba ltar/ zhen log che ba ya mtshan che yang / mos gus bsgos gyi mgo bo yin/ /zhes gsungs pa de bden no/ /mgo med pa'i byang chub sems dpa' 'dra e yod dam/ thugs bsam re thongs/ yang grwa ba 'ga' res/ kho dge lugs pa yin/ rnying ma'i bla mar phyag byas mjal na/ dam can 46

chos rgyal mi dgyes bka' chad 'ong zer ba dang / yang 'ga' res kho rnying ma yin/ gsar ma'i bla ngan bstan bshig tsho mjal na/ rā hu la sogs chos skyong mi dgyes/ bka' chad 'ong tsho zer/de bzhin du sa 'brug dkar dwags sogs grub mtha' gang na'ang / de dang de 'dra smra ba mang po 'dug kyang / de dus gsum rgyal ba dgyes pa'i chos ldan gyi bya ba byas na/ chos skyong srung ma mi dgyes bka' chad 'ong / dus gsum rgyal ba mi dgyes pa'i chos min gyi bya ba byas na chos skyong srung ma dgyes zhes/ don gyi chos skyong la sgro skur ngan pa btab pa yin pas/bka' chad gang nas 'ong mi shes pas gzab 'tshal/ smyon pa 'dra ba'i lad mo byas/ de 'dra'i lab lob kha nas smras sam/dngos su lag len la de ka 'debs na/ chos ma shes pa'i rang mtshang phyir bstan pa yin pas/ ye shes spyan ldan gyi chos skyong rnams thugs gting nas khrel ba'i bzhad gad byed pas gzhan ma sems/ yang sngon sangs rgyas thugs rje can gye sgu yi 'od kyis stong gsum 'gengs bzhin/ rgya gar 'phags pa'i yul nas 'gro la chos kyi 'khor lo rgya chen bskor dus/ rgya gar gyi sang kri ta'i skad lta bu gcig gi sgo nas chos gsungs kyang / lha klu gnod sbyin grul bum mi la sogs pa'i sems can thams 47

cad kyis rang rang gi skad du go ba yin pas/ dus gcig la sems can thams cad kyi skad du chos bstan pa yin te/ bzang spyod las/ lha yi skad dang klu dang gnod sbyin skad/ /grul bum dag dang mi yi skad rnams dang / /'gro ba kun gyi sgra rnams ji tsam pa/ /thams cad skad du bdag gis chos bstan to/ /gsungs/ chos gcig gsungs kyang sems can rang rang gi blo kha dang 'tshams pa'i chos su go ste/ dpal dur khrod rgyan gyi rgyud las/ gzhan yang nga yis gsungs pa'i bka'/ /dus gcig nyid du gsungs gyur kyang / /du ma nyid du so sor snang / /chos tshul du ma'i bye brag dang / /'du shes du ma'i bye brag gis/ /theg pa'i mtha' la thug pa med/ /ces dang / lung gzhan las/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i bstan pa ni/ sems can gyi mos pa ji lta ba bzhin du 'byung ngo / /zhes dang / mdo sde lang shar gshegs pa las/ ji srid 'du shes ma zad par/ /theg pa'i mtha' la zad pa med/ /ces dang / bla ma zhang rin po che'i zhal nas/ gdul bya sems can gye rnam par rtog pa'i bye brag zad pa med pa la/ sems can gyi rnam par rtog pa dang mthun par sangs rgyas kyi theg pa'i mtha' la zad pa med cing thug pa med do/ /sgrung dang / mo dang / bon la sogs rim gyis 48

drangs pa'i theg pa byung ba yin la/ theg pa gzhan lta smos kyang ci dgos/ zhes gsungs/ sangs rgyas kyi gsung gcig la go lugs tha dad du byung tshul ni/ sngon sangs rgyas thugs rje can gyes sprid pa sangs pa'i sgra/ nad pa dang sman pa/ nad g.yog gsum gyis so sor go ste/ nad pas rin chen srog dang ma bral na/ /sgyu ma'i nor rdzas btsal pas rnyed/ /ces par go /sman pas/ yon gyis chog ni snying rje ste/ /de bas snying rje ldan par byos/ /zhes par go /nad g.yog chung mas/ snga ma de la nan tan bskyed/ /phyi ma ci 'gyur cha med kyi/ /zhes par go skad/sangs rgyas kyi gsung chos la go lugs mi 'dra ba 'byung ba smos ci dgos/ 'jig rten pa'i kha ta byas pa la yang go lugs mang po 'ong ste/ sngon khyung bo skye ba la/ mas gos lwa bzo ba/ gos legs po ma byung na/ ltad mo byung na ngo tsha ba yin/ rta gsos/rta ma gsos na ltad mo byung tsa na bzhon du mi 'ong / bzhon du byung kyang ngo tsha/ zas kun rtswa zos kyang chog ces zhal ta byas pa/ kho rang gis zhal ta ru go pha spun gcig la gos med pas/ nga la kha brgyag bshad pa yin snyam/ g.yog mos mo la za rgyu mi ster ba'i bsnyad pa yin snyam/ zhang bos kho la rdzun gcig yod pa la zer ba yin snyam/ go lugs mi 'dra ba bzhi byung skad/ sngon 49

sangs rgyas kyis sems can grangs med pa la chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba yin pas/ de thams cad kyis go lugs mi 'dra bas/chos lugs mi 'dra ba mtha' yas/ des na chos lugs gang yin yang khas gtong mi rung bar dad pa byed dgos zer ba'i rgyu mtshan yang de yin/ gzhan yang sangs rgyas kyis phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams dpag tu med par sku dngos dang sprul pa grangs med par phye nas chos kyi rnam grangs mtha' yas pa bstan te/ phal mo che las/ 'jig rten khams ni stong dag tu/ /ngas ni mdo sde mang bshad kyang / /tshig 'bru tha dad don gcig te/ /de dag brjod par nus ma yin/ /zhes dang / mtshan brjod las/ theg pa sna tshogs thabs tshul gyis/ /'gro ba'i don la mkhas pa'o/ /gsungs/ mdo rgya cher rol pa'i chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba'i le'u las/ byams pa chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba 'di ni/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i yon tan bsngags pa'i phyogs la 'jug pa cung zad tsam zhig mdor bstan du zad de/ byams pa/ rgyas par bya ba ni de bzhin gshegs pas bskal pa'am/bskal pa las kyang lhag par bshad kyang / bstan pa 'di ni mthar mi phyin to/ /de nas de tshe bcom ldan 'das kyis tshigs su bcad pa 'di dag dka' bstsal to/ /zab cing blta dka' 50

phra ba yi/ /chos kyi 'khor lo rab bskor te/ /de la pha rol mu stegs can/ /kun dang bdud kyis mi chud do/ /kun gzhi med cing spros med pa/ /skye ba med cing 'byung med la/ /dben zhing rang bzhin gyes stong pa'i/ /chos kyi 'khor lo rab bskor ro/ /blangs pa med cing dor med pa/ /mtshan ma med cing mtshan nyid med/ /mnyam pa nyid kyi chos bstan pa'i/ /'khor lo sangs rgyas kyis bskor ro/ /ji ltar sgyu ma smig rgyu dang / /rmi lam brag cha chu zla dang / /de dag 'dra ba'i 'khor lo ni/ /'jig rten mgon pos rab bskor ro/ /brten pa'i chos la 'jug byed pa/ /chad min rtag pa ma yin pa/ /lta ba thams cad chad pa ni/ /chos kyi 'khor lo yin zhes brjod/ /rtag tu nam mkha' dang 'dra zhing / /rnam par mi rtog 'od gsal ba/ /mtha' dang dbus med bstan pa ni/ /chos kyi 'khor lo 'dir brjod do/ /yod dang med las rnam grol zhing / /bdag dang bdag nyid rnams spang la/ /rang bzhin ma sgyes bstan pa ni/ /chos kyi 'khor lo 'dir brjod do/ /yang dag mtha' ni mtha' min pa/ /de bzhin nyid la de bzhin nyid/ /gnyis su med pa'i chos bstan pa/ /chos kyi 'khor lor brjod pa yin/ /mig ni ngo bo nyid kyi stong / /de bzhin sna dang rna ba dang / /lce dang lus 51

dang ngag sems ni/ /snod pas bdag med g.yo ba med/ /'di lta bu yi 'khor lo ni/ /chos kyi 'khor lo zhes brjod de/ /zhes gsungs/ gzhan yang / sngon rgyal po in+d+ra bo rnyis sangs rgyas la chos ston drangs nas/ tshe 'dir sangs rgyas pa'i gdams ngag zhus pas/ de ltar 'dod na rab tu byung cig gsungs pas/'di las thabs gzhan med na/ 'dod yon spangs par dka' zhes zhus nas/ cung ma mos tshe/ sangs rgyas kyis gzhan rgyud mkhyen cing / thabs la mkhas pas/ rgyal po 'khor bcas sngags kyi snod rung du mkhyen nas/ khang ba de nyid skad cig gis dkyil 'khor lha'i gzhal yas khang / sangs rgyas 'khor bcas gsang 'dus kyi lha tshogs su sprul nas/ lhan skyes kyi dga' bde la rol bzhin gsang sngags chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bas/ rgyal po 'khor bcas kyi/ tshe der mchog gi dngos grub thob nas/chos bya ba 'dod yon ma spangs par lam du khyer nas sangs rgyas pa 'di 'dra dgos bshad pa yin/ zhes bla ma dam pa 'ga' res gsungs/ gzhan yang rnam snang mngon byung las/nga yi bstan pa rnam gnyis te/ /dam pa mu stegs theg pa dang / /mchog gyur sangs rgyas theg pa'o/ /zhes gsungs/ sngon sangs rgyas kyis rang gi bstan pa'i che ba 'byin phyir/ rgyal po rkang ba 52

brgyad pa'i sras su sku'i sgye ba bzhes pa'i tshul bstan nas/ mu stegs pa'i gzhung lugs thams cad gsungs pa yin skad/des na gsar ma dang rnying ma/ sa skya/ garma/ 'brug pa/ dwags po/ 'bri gung / jo nang / bon po/ hwa shang / tha na phyi rol pa'i chos lugs la yang dad gus dag snang byed pa ma gtogs/ smad cing spang mi rung ste/ rnam snang mngon byang las/ mu stegs can la smad mi bya/ /mu stegs can la smad gyur na/ /rnam par snang mdzad ring ba'i rgyu/ /zhes dang / bde mchog rtsa rgyud las/sems can mos pa bsam mi khyab/ /sangs rgyas rol ba bsam mi khyab/ /rang gi gzhung dang ma mthun yang / /smad cing spang bar mi bya ste/ /nam zhig go bar smon lam thob/ /ces dang /zhang g.yu brag 'gro mgon gyes/ 'o skol rang cag chos dang chos min zhes/ /khyad du mi gsod ris su mi bcad cing / /thams cad thub dbang sras bcas rnam 'phrul du/ /shes par bya zhing mi spang khur bgyi'o/ /zhes dang / rje skal ldan rgya mtshos/ gzhan chos lugs grub mtha' sna tshogs la/ /yid g.yo ba'i dad pa sgyes na rab/ /de min kyang dag snang sbyong ba dang / /don med par mi smod dam bca' yin/ /zhes dang / rje btsun mi la ras pas/thos bsam phyogs med ma byas pas/ /theg pa gzhan la ma smod 53

cig /chos spong gis rang rgyud bsreg nyen gda'/ /zhes dang /rje bud+ngha badz+ra gyis/ mu stegs la yang smad byas na/ /rnam par snang mdzad ring ba'i rgyu/ /gsung na mchog gsum 'bangs gyur rnams/ /snying nas smod la smos ci dgos/ /zhes dang / zab chos nyams su ma lon kyang / /kun tu mi spong skur mi 'debs/ /zhes dang / grub thob gling ras pas/ bka' sde snod khyad du mi bsad 'tshal/ /sde snod khyad du bsad pa na/ /chos la log lta skye ba yin/ /gsungs/ spyan snga pas/ mu stegs lam gyi gtso bo rnams kyang / sangs rgyas byang sems kyis bstan pa yin pas smod par mi bya gsungs/ de rnams la dgongs nas/ bdag gi yongs 'dzin dam pa a rig dge bshes rin po che'i zhal nas/nga phyi rol pa dang bon po la yang dad pa yod gsungs pa chos pa dga' mo tsho'i blo la yang ma shong bar/ de'i dus khas gtong dgos pa byung / da blo gros can gyis bsam shes na/ de gdams ngag gi mchog gcig yin snang / de yang sangs rgyas ni thabs mkhas la thugs rje che ba yin pas/ sprul pa bkye nas/phyi rol mu stegs pa'i gzhung lugs brtsams pa la yang phan pa'i dgongs gzhi che ste/ 'brug pa pad+ma dkar pos/ mu stegs byed la sogs pa'ang lam gong ma la bags kyis bkri ba'i ched 54

du shes par bya'o/ /gsungs/ phyi rol pa theg dman gyi chos lugs de yod na/ nang ba'i ston pa dang / bstan pa bzang ba'i che ba 'byin cing / thun mong gi dngos grub la phyi rol pa myur/thun mong gi dngos grub la brten nas/ sems can gnas skabs bde zhing skyid la/ skyid na chos yong / chos byas na skye ba de'am/ ma 'ongs pa'i skye ba bzang po brgyud nas/ mchog gi dngos grub kyang thob par 'gyur/ shes na phyi rol pa yang nang ba sangs rgyas kyi bstan dgra zhig ma yin/ chos dang gang zag gi grogs zhig yin pas/ skyes bu dam pa rnams kyis khas mi gtong ba'i rgyu mtshan de sogs shin tu mang / des na khas gtong mi rung / yang bon chos rnams kyang bzang po yin pas sgod mi rung / g.yung drung bon gye ston pa gshen rab kyi gsung gser 'od nor bu 'od 'bar las/ sems bskyed don dang ma ldan na/ /sa 'khyag nas 'bru gtor ba 'dra/ /sa 'khyag nas 'bru gtor gyur na/ /'bras bu smin pa'i dus ma mchis/ /de phyir gzhi la sems bskyed gces/ /gzhi la sems bsgyed ldan gyur na/ /'bru bcud rlan drod 'phrad pa 'dra/ /de nas 'bru bcud 'bras drug smin/ /de phyir sems bskyed ldan par mdzod/ /sems bskyed don dang ldan gyur na/ /'bras bu 'grub ste 55

mngon sangs rgyas/ /de phyir gzhi las sems bskyed gces/ /zhes dang / thams cad gang yang mi rtag nges/ /'jig rten khams su dar rgud yod/ /nyi zla kun la 'char nub srid/ /sangs rgyas la yang 'das 'khrungs srid/ /bzang ngan las la rgyu 'bras yod/ /ces dang / 'jig rten khams ni mi rtag 'jig /thams cad rtag par mi 'dzin cing / /mi rtag rgyud la khel ba gces/ /byams sems snying rje ldan par mdzod/ /ces dang /stong pa nyid kyi don rtogs na/ /mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas so/ /zhes dang / snyan rgyud rin chen gsal sgron las/ lta ba'i gdengs bskyed snying rje rtsi yis bzung / /zhes pa la sogs gsungs pa la ltos dang / 'o skol ston pa'i gsung rab dgongs 'grel dang bcas par shin tu mthun la/ des na spyan snga pa rin po che'i zhal nas/ bod du dar ba'i bon po rnams lta ba grub mtha'i gzhung ngo bo la/ theg pa che chung dang khyad par med de/ chos kyi de nyid 'don pa bsgyur ba tsam du 'dug pa/ /kho rang mdo rgyud du 'dod pa rnams la bltas na ches gsal bar snang ngo / /kho rang tsho yang chos dang bon nang gses kyi khyad par rnams min pa/ lta grub dang gzhi lam 'bras gsum la khyad par med par snang ngo / /phyi nang gi khyad 'byed ni/ lta ba bka' rtag 56

gi phyag rgya bzhi dang / skyabs 'gro byed par grags shing / bon po'ang / 'dus byas thams cad mi rtag pa/ zag bcas sdug bsngal/ chos thams cad bdag med/ myang 'das zhi ba'i phyag rgya dang bzhi/ chos dang bon ming tsam ma gtogs/ don 'dra bas dkon mchog gsum la skyabs 'gro dang / nges 'byung dang /byang chub kyi sems dang / phyin drug dang / gnas lugs stong pa nyid sogs/ phyi rol par nam yang med pa'i nang ba'i khyad chos rnams khas len par snang bas/ nang ba la je bar mngon no gsungs/ rje blo bzang chos kyi nyi mas/ bon dang chos byas 'gal ba'i tshad byed byang / /chos la bon 'dres bon la chos 'dres pas/ /chos mig rdul bral mig ldan bdag lta bu/ /chos bon rnam dbye 'byed la sgyid lug gyur/ /bon zhes smod kyang gal la thug pa'i dus/ /bon po ju thig can la blangs dor 'dri/ /bon ltar gyer la dga' zhing gto thabs sogs/ /bon gyi bcos gas phan par kun gyis re/ /gsungs/ sngon bon nyams su blangs nas/ bon po mang pos mchog thun gyi dngos grub brnyes pa'i rtags/ gzhan gyi skyid sdug shes pa'i mngon shes dang / rta la zhon nas nam mkha' la bya ltar 'gro ba sogs dzu 'phrul ya ma zung mang po bstan pa mang / gsar rnying gis 57

kyang / sngon sangs rgyas pa rnams kyis de phan bstan rabs med/deng sang yang khri ga'i phyogs na bon bo gcig gis 'pho ba grong 'jug lan gsum gyi bar du mdzad pa gcig 'dug deng sang nged tsho'i gsar snying phyag chen pas/ bu kho yin zer mkhan zhig gis kyang / grong 'jug gsum mi dgos gcig thub ni med/e yod gcig ltos dang / de 'dra yin kyang bon po mi bzang zhes smad na/ mkhas pa rnams kyis gsan na bzhad gad 'chor te/ rje bud+dha badz+ra gyis/ bon dang mu stegs byed sogs kyis/ /thun mong dngos grub thob na de/ /grub thob yin par lhun grub pa/ /de phyir mi mthun ga la yod/ /lhun gyis ma grub pa de nyid/ /grub thob yin zhes smras rung ngan/ /lhun gyis grub te grub min du/ /bzhed pa legs bsam a re mtshar/ /gsungs/de mi bzang na khyed tshos bzang po de ci 'dra zhig la zer/ chags sdang gis bdag bstod gzhan smod byed pa la zer ba e yin zhes dris na/ lan du ji skad zer dgos soms dang / yang bon mi bzang ba'i stabs kyis o rgyan rin po ches/ gsol 'debs bar chad lam sel na/ /gdon gzugs bon gyi bstan pa bsnubs/ /chos sku dri med rin chen gter/ /skal ldan sangs rgyas sa la bkod/ /de nas o rgyan yul du byon/ /gsungs 58

'dug zer na/ de gdon chen po zhig gis bon po'i gzugs bzung nas/ chos log dar du bcug pa de bsnubs/ zhes gsungs pa red/ bon thams cad chos log yin pas de kun bsnubs gsungs pa ga la yin/ o rgyan rin po che bod du byon nas/ bon chos ngan pa rnams nyams su bcug thabs mkhas kyis 'o skol tsho'i chos rnams bon chos su bsgyur yod skad/ da lta bon po rnams kyis 'don pa'i chos dang / 'o tsho'i chos ming mi gcig pa ma gtogs don gyi gcig pas/ de la smad na don gyi o rgyan dang rang gi chos la smad pa dang 'dra bas nyes pa che/des na bla ma zhang rin po ches/ 'o skol bon la res chod mi bgyi'o/ /zhes gsungs/ chos kyi bzang ngan de thams cad mkhyen pa ma gtogs/ nged tsho 'dra bas shes dka'/ mi shes pa la gang la dad gus dag snang byas/ rang nyid gang mos chos de nyams su len pa las/ khe che zhing nyen chung ba zhig gzhan na med/ chos thams cad sems kyi 'phrul yin pas/ bsgyed rim ra/khan gyis rnal 'byor bsam dag snod bcud thams cad dag par bsgoms na/ dag pa'i 'khor lo 'ba' zhig tu 'char ba bzhin/ chos dang gang zag thams cad bzang po yin snyam dag snang 'ba' zhig mdzad na/ mi bzang ba rnams kyang / mi de'i 59

snang ngor bzang po sha stag tu 'gyur te/ sngon lho brag mar pa'i sras dar ma mdo sde gshegs dus/ bskyed rim gsal btab tshe/der 'tshogs pa kun gyis kyang sku ma mthong bar/ yi dam lha'i rten dang brten pa'i dkyil 'khor du khra lam me mthong gsungs/rgyal ba rgod tshang pas/ ngas dang po dbang thob pa nas/ rang gzhan snang srid thams cad lha'i dkyil 'khor du ngo sprad pa de'i don spyir ma lus nyams su blangs pas/ da khye dang sprang bo bya dang ri dwags la sogs pa gang mthong yang yi dam du krong nge yod/ ji ltar brjed kyang skad cig ma gsum 'gyangs/ da ma dag pa'i snang ba skad cig kyang med dus skal ba bzang po rgyun chad med gsungs/ yang 'khor srol tu 'jug pa'i zhal bskos dang / spyod lam mi legs pa kun la bka' kyon 'dra yang mdzad par zhu zhus pas/ ngas thams cad la dag snang sbyangs pas/ thams cad ngo mtshar che ba 'ba' zhig las/ spyod pa ma legs pa'i skyon can rang ma mthong bas/ zhal bskos bya ba dang bka' kyon btang sam mthong gsungs/ yang chos gcig la/dag snang ci dgu gong du 'khur ba 'di las zab pa'i chos gcig kyang med/ dag snang 'byongs pa dang sangs rgya ba dus mnyam du yong ba yin/ snying rje gnas skabs mthar thug gnyis 60

ga dag ma dag pa'i khyad par che ba yongs pa yin te/ kun la dag snang sbyong ba 'di ngas bsam bsam pa'i nyams myong yin gsungs/ log lta byas na/ bzang po rnams kyang ngan par 'gyur te/ sngon wa ra ṇa si'i rgan mo zhig gis rang lus stag gcig tu bsgoms pas stag tu gyur/ grong khyer gyi mi rnams kyis kyang stag tu mthong pros pas grong khyer stongs sang gsungs/sngon 'phan yul gyi sngags pa zhig gis/ bu shi bas kho dus thams cad du bu yid la byas ngus pas/ lan cig bu de mdun du mthong ba'i snang ba byung skad/ phyi rol pa zhig gis nam mkha' brag tu bsgoms pas skabs shig lag pas reg na/thogs rgyu yod pa byung skad/ des na log lta 'di dug dang mtshungs pas spong ci thub ltos/ dad gus dag snang 'di bdud rtsi dang 'dra bas 'thung ci thub gyis dang 'tsheng / yang hwa shang yang bzang po yin pas smod mi rung / hwa shang gis sangs rgyas kyi gsung phal po che sogs/ mdo sde mang po blo la bzung /nyams len ci bya mdo sde'i steng nas byed skad/ sngon ka ma la shī la dang / hwa shang gnyis gas rtsod pa byas tshe yang / ka ma la shī las phyag shing klad la bskor nas/ 'khor bar 'khor ba'i rgyu gang yin dris tshe/ ber gyi thu bas mgo btums nas ma rig pa 6 1

yin zhes brda' lan bstan skad/ nged rang tsho las kyang shes rab rno myur gsal bar 'dug des na hwa shang gis so sor rtogs pa'i shes rab spangs nas/ bya rgod bzhin kha rog par bsdad yod par ma sems/ kho rang gi lta ba yin tshul/ mdo sde'i lung khungs brgyad cu drangs nas sgrub skad/ slob dpon ka ma la shī las de bas mang zhig drangs nas sgrub rabs med/mdo sde'i lung khungs brgyad cu drangs pa thams cad min du chug kyang / hwa shang gi las ngan na ma gtogs gcig min zer tshul med/ de dbang po rnon po yin no de red/ nyams len ci bya mdo sde'i steng nas byed na/ de 'chug yod med blta rgyu yod de/ gzhan rgyud mkhyen pa'i grub dbang 'brug pa kun legs kyis/ bsam yas su hwa shang chen po'i gzhung thams cad yum glegs bam la bcol bar 'dug pas phyogs mnga' mdzad mkhan tshos/ phyogs mnga' ma longs sam/ yum sher phyin 'khrul na ni ma shes/ gzhan slob dpon ka ma la shī la ni dbu ma rang rgyud par 'dug pas/ de'i grub mtha' yang rnam dag yin min jo bo dge ldan pa la dri ba zhu lags gsungs/ mkhyen brtse rin po ches kyang / gang dran pa med cing yid la byar med pa la/ so sor rtogs pa'i shes rab spangs pa'i nyes pa 'jug na/ skyon 62

'di rgyal ba'i yum la 'jug pas/ don dam par hwa shang gi lta ba yin min rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kho nas mkhyen gyis gzhan gyis ma yin no gsungs/ khyed tshos hwa shang 'di ci'i a kha zhig yin ma snyam dang / sngon gnas brtan bcu drug gi sbyin bdag gi gtso bo che shos hwa shang red/ da lta gnas brtan bcu drug gi gral na zhal mar bsgyur nas bzhugs pa/ 'e tsho'i mchog dman bar gsum gyis phyag mchod brgya stong 'bul ba de/ a kha zhig yin nas phul ba yin nam bsam blo thongs/ 'o na hwa shang gis khye dkar bos bzung na bzung ni yin/ nag pos bzung yang bzung ni yin/ nam mkha' sprin dkar pos bsgribs kyang sgrib yin/ nag pos bsgribs kyang sgrib ni yin/ rnam rtog bzang po skyes kyang 'khor bar 'ching / ngan pa skyes kyang 'khor bar 'ching / smras pa de/ ci yin zer na/ de skad smras ni e yin ci shes/ dbang po su mi snang / 'on kyang smras ni yin kyang /rig pas dpyad na 'gal ba med de/ dper na dug rdzas sngags sman sogs med par/ bya dang bye'us rang gar sbyad na 'chi ba bzhin/ spyir rnam rtog bzang ngan gyi lam khyer/ byang sems yang dag pa'i lta ba sogs gdams pa med pas rnam rtogs bzang ngan gyis 'khor ba ngan song gi las bsags nas/63

de'i dbang gis 'khor bar skyes ba la dgongs nas de skad smras pa yin pas/ 'e tsho dge lugs pas kyang 'dod la/ /dper na rma byas dug zos na 'chi ba phar zhog lhag par sgro mdongs ches cher mdzes pa ltar/ byed brag byang chub kyi sems stong nyid bskyed rdzogs sogs kyi gdams ngag mkhan la/ nyon mongs rnam rtog byang chub kyi grogs su 'gyur bas/ de 'dra'i rigs la bshad par ma sems/ yang cha gcig na/ dper na byes pa zhig gis ma'i nu zho'am/ zas mi za bar sgo dang sgo ru rgyug na/ nang du bsdad nas zas za ba'i thabs su/ mas sgo la ma 'gro/ song na sprang slong zhig 'dug des khyod khyer 'gro zhes skrag slong ba ltar/ gdul bya 'ga' re rnam rtog gi 'khor lo bskor/ sems rnal du ma phebs par/ yon tan gang yang mi thob pa'i gegs byas tshe/ zhi gnas lhag mthong bskyed rdzogs lta bu zhig mngon du 'gyur ba'i thabs lta bu la yang dmigs nas/ de skad smra bar rigs la/ spyir bzang ngan gyi rnam rtog gang yin yang gtan nas skye mi rung/ khor bar 'ching byed yin zhes bshad pa min te/ de yin na hwa shang kho rang shes rab rno/ mdo sde nyams su len na dpyad pa mang po dgos/ slob ma rnams kyi sngon du kho rang 'khor bar 'ching tshar 'dug phyis kho 64

rang gis slob ma rnams la chos re bshad grangs kyi kho rang gi 'ching ba je dam du song nas chos bshad 'grub tshe/ slob ma grol yang kho rang gi 'ching ba grol dka' ba'i phyir ro/ /'o na hwa shang gis gnas lugs lta ba rtogs nas/ spyod phyogs phyag bskor mchod sbyin sogs byas na/ rgyal po khri las babs nas phyag bdar byas pa dang 'dra/ de gnas lugs ma rtogs pa'i skye bo blun po'i chos lugs yin bshad pa de ci yin zer na/ de yang dper na/ mi zhig rgyal por gyur tshe/ khri khar bzhugs bzhin 'khor g.yog rnams mngags nas so nam rgyu nom 'tsho skyong byed du bcug na/ stobs 'byor cher rgyas pa ltar gnas lugs kyi lta ba rtogs nas/ de'i rtsis zin bzhin pa'i ngang nas/ mchod sbyin sogs byas na legs kyi dper na rgyal po khri khar mi bzhugs par mar babs nas/ phyag dar sogs la brtson pa ltar/ lta ba spangs nas phyag bskor mchod sbyin sogs la brtson na/ lta ba ma rtogs pa'i dus kyi sgye bo blun po dang khyad par med pas/ de skye bo blun po'i chos lugs yin zhes smad pa yin/ de la 'e tshos kyang smod ste/ rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug dpal sa ra has/ gnas lugs rtogs nas dam pa nyid byed na/ /rgyal po khri las babs nas phyag dar byed pa bzhin/ /65

zad mi shes pa'i bde ba chen po nyid spangs nas/ /gang zhig 'khor ba'i bde la reg pa nyid kyis 'ching / /zhes gsungs/hwa shang gis spyod phyogs rnams nyams su mi lon pa ma yin te/tshogs bsags sgrib sbyong byed pa mthong thos kyang yod la/nyams su mi len na kho rang la mdo sde'i steng na nyams su len rgyu ci yod/ blo tsho bzung nas nyams su len zer ba dang yang 'gal ba'i phyir/ deng sang 'e tshos sangs rgyas kyi sprul sku yin zer ba la yang chos thams cad slar slob dgos na/ de ba sang las chos thams cad shes pa'i mkhas pa zhig 'khur nas 'ong mi srid/ tha na ka kha yan chad bslabs nas rim pas mkhas par 'gyur dgos/ de yin phyin chad mdo sde na ci gsungs nyams su len dgos/ ma blangs pas thabs med/ des na sngar bshad pa'i hwa shang gi tshig re re tsam la brten nas smod mi rung / paṇa chen rin po che rgya nag du phebs dus hwa shang gi mkhan po zhig la dri ba mdzad pa'i lan/ 'e tsho dang mthun par thogs pa med par rgyab byung tshe/ ngo mtshar bzang po red gsungs skad/ 'o na rje bdag nyid chen pos/ lam rim gyi thog mtha' bar gsum na hwa shang tshad gyis bzhag nas smad smad yod pa de ci yin zer na/ de sngon sangs rgyas nyid kyis 66

chos dang de nyams su len pa'i gang zag gtsigs che zhing dga' spro 'phel ba nyams len la brtson pa sogs la phan par dgongs nas/ me tog tsam pa ka ni rgas gyur kyang / /me tog phal pa rnams kyi do zla min/ /nga yi rab byung tshul khrims 'chal gyur kyang / /mu stegs phal pa rnams kyi do zla min/ /zhes pa la sogs gsungs/ phyi rol pa tshad gis bzhag nas/ chos dang gang zag las sngags brjod gnang ba ltar/ rje rin po ches kyang / rjes 'jug gdul bya la dgongs/ rje rang nyid kyis mdzad pa'i gdams pa 'di nyid hwa shang sogs gzhan dang mi 'dra ba'i khyad chos can zhig yin rgyu red snyam/ gtsigs che zhing 'di dang mjal ba skal bzang snyam dga' zhing spro bzhin/ thos bsam bsgom la brtson pa sogs la phan par dgongs nas/ de skad gsungs pa yin pas thugs kyi gting nas smad pa ma yin te/ chos gsungs pa po dang chos kyi che ba brjod pa'i skabs sogs su/ mdo rgyud bstan bcos na de 'dra gsungs pa mtha' yas pas/ de rnams kyang ngan shos su 'dod dgos/ de ltar 'dod na bod na chos bzang po zhig med pa'i tshul 'og nas 'chad pas der rtogs par gyes/ rgyal sras byang chub sems dpa' rnams thabs mkhas la thugs rje che bas bstan 'gro la 67

phan pa'i dgos pa che na/ dper na mi zhig gis sems can zhig gsod snyam 'tshol du 'ongs nas/ khyed kyis e mthong dri sa pa lta bu la mthong rung ma mthong zer ba sogs phan pa'i rdzun smra rung te/ kun bzang snying thig las/ rang 'dod ma yin par sems can gyi blo chos la bsgyur pa'i stabs byung na/ thabs du mas rdzun bshad/ srog dang 'jigs pa las skyob phyir shes rab kyis rdzun bshad/ gsang sngags kyi lta spyod zab mo snod min la mi ston pa'i phyir gab pa'i rdzun bshad/ des ni nyes pa mi 'go zhing 'gro don mthar phyin pa'i dgos pa che'o gsungs/ sngon ma skyes dgras pha bsad par 'gyod nas/ sangs rgyas kyi drung du 'gyod bshags byed du 'ong ba la/ thog mar pha ma bsad na nyes dmigs che tshul brjod na/ de ma thag snying gas nas dmyal bar skye ba mkhyen nas/ ma sgyes dgra la/ pha dang ma ni bsad bya yin/ /gsungs nas bag phebs su bcug de nas rim pas 'gyod bshags byed du bcug pas/ sdig pa dag nas dgra bcom pa'i go 'phang thob gsungs/ rje mi la'i las sgrib 'dag phyir/ lho brag mar pas brdeg brdung mdzad pa ltar/phan pa'i dgos pa che na/ brdeg brdung kyang byed/ de bzhin du bstan 'gro phan pa'i dgos pa che na/ byang chub sems dpas 68

lus ngag gi mi dge ba bdun la sogs bya ba ma yin pa yang bya ste/ rgyud las/ gnyis med ye shes sems ldan pas/ /mi bya ba ni ci yang med/ /ces dang / sems can bslu ba spangs nas ni/ /bya ba ma yin thams cad bya/ /zhes dang / de bzhin du mdo las/ rgyal sras rnams kyis mi slob pa'i/ /dngos te gang na yod min te/ /de ltar shes pa'i mkhas pa la/ /bsod nams mi 'gyur gang yang med/ /gsungs/ des na byang chub sems nga) pa' rnams kyi mdzad pa thams cad kyi dgongs pa lon dka' ste/ paṇa chen thams cad mkhyen pas/ 'phags pa'i sgye bo rnams kyi mdzad pa rnam thar rnams so so'i sgye bo rnams kyi yul las 'das gsungs/ de thugs shin tu mad de/ rje rin po che lta bu'i sa thob kyi byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i sku dang gsung gi mdzad pa mtha' yas pa ston pa'i thugs kyi dgongs gzhi/ 'e tsho'i lon pa phar zhog deng sang gi bla ma dge bshes 'ga' res mdzad spyod kyi dgongs pa yang lon dka' ste/ deng sang bla ma 'ga' re ser sna che ba ltar snang yang / sku gsungs thugs rten bzhengs/ dge 'dun gyi sde mchod/ bsdu bzhi'i gzhan don bya dgongs nas rgyu nom bsags pa yang mang bas na/ ser sna che ni e yin mi shes/69
