'ga' res 'dod chags che na sdom pa shor song ba ltar snang yang / bskyed rdzogs kyi rtogs pa mthon por slebs nas/bsten na skyon gyis mi gos pa yang mang bas/ de yang sdom pa shor ni e yin mi shes/ yang bla ma 'ga' res grub mtha' gzhan ngan tshul ngan rab brjod nas dgag pa gtong ba de yang / de 'dra'i dogs pa bslangs na/ slar mkhas pas de la yin tshul yin rab zhes lan 'debs nges/ lan btab na bstan pa'i gad dar du 'gro dgongs nas kyang / de skad gsungs pa mang bas/ de yang thugs kyi gting nas yin min mi shes/ 'e tshos bla ma dam pas mdzad pa ston tshad kyi dgongs pa lon pa phar zhog tha na g.yag btang ba tsam gyi dgongs pa yang lon dka' ste/ sngon grub thob 'brug pa kun legs kyis/dgon pa zhig la song nas tshogs 'tshogs pa'i gral bar gyen du spos 'grims byed gsungs/ g.yag gtong gyin phyin pas grwa pa 'ga' res kha sna zum 'dzum rgod 'phya smod byas tshe/ spos pas kyang lhag pa'i dri bzang po 'thul ba byung skad/ yang bla ma zhig gis g.yag zhig btang nas/ dkon mchog mchod gsungs/ grwa ba kun gyis bla ma zog byed par 'dug ces 'dzum tshe/ ngo mtshar dri zhim bzang pos phyogs kun khyab par byung skad/70

des na po to ba rin po ches theg pa chen po'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyi thugs tha mal pas mi rtogs/ phyi ltar mnyes mnyes mdzad pa mnyes pa'i nges pa med/ mi mnyes pa'i rnam 'gyur ci mdzad kyang mi mnyes pa'i nges pa med/ gang la dgongs ste mdzad pa yin mi shes pas gzab dgos gsungs/ phyag rdor dbang bsgur gyi rgyud las/ skyes bu dam pa rnams ni rang gi yon tan ji lta ba gzhan gyi ngor/ mngon sum du mi mdzad/ ci tsam gyis gdul bya mgu bar 'gyur ba de tsam zhig de dag la ston par 'gyur ro/ /zhes gsungs/ des na byang chub sems dpas bzang ngan gyi mdzad pa mtha' yas ston pa de bstan 'gro la dngos sam brgyud nas phan pa'i dgongs gzhi yod pa yin/ 'e tshos khong rnam pa tsho'i lad mo byas na/ rang gzhan la dngos sam brgyud nas/ gnod pa chen po 'byung bas mi rung /dper na rgyal po chen po zhig gis 'khor 'bangs la zhi drag mang po byas pa'i lad mo bran g.yog gis byed mi rung ba dang 'dra/ rgyal pos ci byas thams cad bran g.yog la lad mo byed phyir byas pa yin pa ltar/ rgyal sras byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis mdzad pa sna tshogs kyis ston pa thams cad la 'e tshos lad mo gyes zhes bstan pa ma yin pa'i ha go dgos/ ma go 71

na seng ge mchongs sar wa lding pa ltar/ thams cad kyi lad mo byas na mgo tsho cig re 'ong nges pas/ blo gros dang ldan pas gzab 'tshal/ yang 'ga' res a ha ha/ da 'e tshos kha rog la nyan bsdad na chos mi shes snyam nas/ 'e tsho'i tshod byas rgod rgyu lu rgyu 'ong ba'i mtshar re rkyang pa khong gis gsung gi byang chub sems dpas rdzun smras sogs zer skur 'debs byas/ o rgyan dang rje bdag nyid chen pos gtan nas khas ma blangs pa'i bon po dang / hwa shang sogs grub mtha' gang gi gang ngan rnams bzang zhes khas blangs pa de/ dper na rang gi mgo'i zhwa phud nas/ gzhan gyi rkang gi lham gon/ gzhan gyi mi gtsang bsal dor ba yar longs dang dgos zer ba dang 'dra bas/ sngar ma go ba'i chos bshad cig go ba ya mtshan che/ nga khong ri khrod 'gol sa tsho'i ga ler bzhugs na bzang ga khyed kyis nged tsho'i mgo'i log rtog bsal rgya zer/ khong gi mgo la de'i che zhig len gi o rgyan dang rjo rin po che la mkhyen rgya khyed kyi che zhig yod rabs yod/ nged tsho'i mi shes dang a khu dro khrod pa zer na/a ho ho/ de ngas bshad shes kyang khyed tsho'i nyan mi shes pa yin te/ dper na a phas mgo yi zhwa smras na/ a mas rkang gi lham e yin zer ba ltar go log go 'dug da yang ngas bshad/ 'o ngas 72

byang chub sems dpas rang dgar rdzun smras bshad pa ga la yin/ gzhan la phan pa'i dgos pa che na gsungs/ zhes smras pa yin/ phan na rdzun la nyes pa med de/ dam tshig rdo rje'i rnams bshad las/ rdzun du smra ba 'gro ba skyob pa dang / /gsang tshig gab dang 'gro la phan gyur na/ /thabs kyis rdzun du smras la nyes pa med/ /gsungs/ ngas o rgyan dang rje rin po che'i gsung de ma red bshad ni ga la yin/ gsung de yin par ma zad/ de'i dgongs gzhi 'di 'dra red ces lhag par je gsal du btang nas smras pa yin/ khyed tshos 'di ltar ha ma go bar/nga la sgos ci dgos/ bla ma gong ma tsho la yang skur 'debs mkhan red/ skyag pa ngan yang dgos pa yod ni byas na ci la med/ lo tog bzang po skyag pa yod na/ lhag par skye stobs che/ grub mtha'i bzang ngan shes dka' mod/ 'on kyang khyed tshos smras pa ltar grub mtha' gzhan ngan pa yin pa'i dbang du byas kyang /dgos pa yod ni byas na ci la med/ grub mtha' bzang po la dman pa yod na lhag par bstan pa'i che khyad thon pas bzang ste/ phyi rol pa yod na nang ba sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa'i che khyad thon pa lta bu'o/ /de ngas bsam pa yin na mig ldan lta bu'i o rgyan dang rje rin po ches dgos pa byung na brag 'phrang tshor 73

phebs pa ltar/ dgongs gzhi can gyi gsung de 'dra byon pa/khyed tsho zhar ba lta bu'i lam de yang bde snyam pa ltar/ gsung de yang bden snyam sgra ji bzhin par bzung nas/ tsham tshom med par brag 'phrang la rgyug pa bzhin/ ngo nag po byas/ grub mtha' gzhan smad na/ brag g.yangs la khyod ring nge lhung ba ltar/dmyal ba'i min nga tsho skad ngan ring de lhung song na mi bzang gide bas ma lhung gong du zhar ra rnams kyis rang tshod bzung nas ga ler bsdad na e bzang snyam nas smras pa yin te/ sngon bla ma zhig gis/ nga yis bltas na khyod re spyo/ /khyod kyis bltas na nga re spyo/ /nga smyo ba chos kyi dbyengs su smyo/ /khyod smyo ba 'khor ba'i 'dam du spyo/ /gsungs pa ltar/ ngas bltas na khyed tshos ma shes brjod ga khyed tshos bltas na ngas ma shes brjod gi snyam kyang /bzang ni ngas bshad pa ltar byas na bzang snyam/ 'o na/ bon po 'ga' res lung bstan na/ o rgyan dang rje rin po che la smon lam log pa'i bdud sprul lag na mug thod dang khas ka bzung ba gcig dang / sna che rna ba ring ba gnyis kyis/ nged tsho'i bstan pa la gnod zer ba'i lung bstan yod skad/ slob dpon chos grags kyi spun phyi rol pa la dad pa gcig gis/ klu sgrub bdud kyi sprul pa ste/ /a jo de yi rjes su 'brang / /smras skad/ de 74

ci yin zer na/ de la dgongs gzhi yod kyang thang / 'on kyang phal cher rgyu mtshan ma shes pa'i blun po re gnyis kyis phyogs ris chags sdang gi dbang gis spras pa yin pas/ thams cad kyis de skad smra bar ma sems/ da lta bon po mang pos rgya gar paṇa chen dang / dmigs brtse ma la thugs dam mdzad pa mang po snang / ma shes pa'i dbang gis de 'dra'i tshig ngan smras te/bod kyi gsar ma ba yin zer ni 'ga' res/o rgyan rin po che'i sku rdzus skyes ma yin mngal skyes yin/ bod du 'ongs nas lha 'dre dang 'thab 'thabs pas/ phal cher ma thub par lag gi rdo rje sa la lhung re ba mang / thams cad dam la btags zer ba dzun yin/ mthar mang yul gung thang la khar shi song /'chi rgyu ma de lho nub srin yul du phebs song zer ba yang rdzun yin/ deng sang 'ga' re'i lag na o rgyan gyi phyag mtshan yin zer ba'i rdo rje mang ba'i rgyu mtshan de yin/ bstan pa'i srol btsugs pa'ang legs po zhig ma byung tsho zer/ 'o tsho rgod rgyu lu rgyu 'ong ni rkyang bshad/ yang rnying ma yin zer ni 'ga' res/ rje rin po che 'jam dbyangs kyi sprul pa yin zer ba rdzun yin/ legs skar gyi sprul pa yin/ bod du 'ongs nas jo bo shākya mu ne sku'i dbu la/longs sku'i dbu rgyan bskon go log byas/ mdo sde gang nas de 75

'dra ma gsungs/ de bzhin du rgyal ba'i bka' la 'grel log rkyang rgyab/ gsung gi snying bo rnams min zhes dor bas/ deng sang sngon ltar grub thob med pa'i rgyu mtshan de yin/ snying bo'i bstan pa la gnod chen po rkyal tsho zer/ 'e tsho rgod rgyu lu rgyu 'ong ni rkyang bshad/ de rnams brag phug kha byang bstan la nyi ma mi 'char ba bzhin/ sangs rgyas de rnams kyi zhal mthong / gsung thos pa'i las dang smon lam med pa'i skal med dang / dper na mkhris nad can gyis dung ser por mthong ba ltar/ 'ga' re las dang nyon mongs pa'i gting du lhung nas/ dam pa de rnams kyi yon tan ma mthong bar kho rang gi skyon dam pa de rnams kyi skyon ltar mthong nas/ de skad smras pa yin pas/snying rje'i yul las gzhan 'os ci yod/ phyin chad de 'dra'i lab lob smras pa'i byis pa 'dra byung na/ mkhas pa rgan bo lung rigs kyi lus stobs can rnams kyis 'og tu chug la/ kha nang du 'gal ba'i khye skyag yang dang yang du rdzongs la mag se dog(thongs)/ ces gsol ba 'debs/ yang cha gcig na skyes bu dam pa de 'dra la/ bzang ngan 'brel ba gang bzhag kyang legs legs te/ rje rgod tshang pas/ byang chub sems dpa' dga' byed la/ tshong dpon gyi bu chags pa skyes te lus rngul nas shi 76

bas/ yi dwags su skyes ba'i las dag na sa sum cu rtsa gsum du skye bar bshad/ gang la gnod pa byas na bde 'brel ba/ /bde ba'i 'byung gnas de la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes gsungs/ 'on kyang ngan 'brel bzhag pa phugs su bzang kyang / 'phral du rnam smin sdug bsngal myong srid ste/ sngon rje mi lar skur 'debs byed mkhan dar lo log lta'i dbang gis shi ba phugs su 'khor ba mtha' can du 'gyur zhes rje mi las gsungs 'dug ste/ shi ma thag nas gdon chen bo 'jigs su rung ba zhig tu skyes pa lta bu'o/ /des na 'o skol rnams kyis skyes bu dam pa de 'dra thams cad la mtha' gcig tu mchod bstod bkur nas bzang 'brel 'jog pa gces so/ /spyir sangs rgyas thams cad thugs chos sku nam mkha' lta bu'i ngang du bzang ngan tha dad med/ gdul bya'i snang ngor gzugs sku 'ja' tshon bzhin du bzang ngan 'bring gsum so sor bstan kyang don gyis gcigakhyad par o rgyan dang / jo bo rje/ rje rin po che gsum thugs rgyud gcig ste/ skyabs mgon rgyal ba dge 'dun rgya mtshos/rigs 'dzin grub pa'i dbang phyug pad+ma 'byung / /lnga brgya'i gtsug rgyan dpal ldan mar me mdzad/ /rdo rje 'chang dbang blo bzang grags pa'i dpal/ /sna tshogs sprul pa'i gar mdzad de 77

la 'dud/ /gu ru o rgyan gling pas bsam yas mchims phu nas gdan drangs pa'i bka' thang bsdus pa las/ thub pa'i lung bstan mdo khams smad zhig tu/ /a ti sha yi sprul pa blo bzang grags/ /skyes bu de byon bod la bde skyid 'ongs/ /zhes dang /'bri gung pa rin po che'i zhal nas/ grub pa'i dbang phyug pad+ma 'byung gnas dang / /de yi rnam 'phrul rgyal ba tsong kha pa/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi thugs sprul o rgyan rin po che slar mnyam med jo bo chen po'i skur sprul nas 'ong / de nas kun mkhyen blo bzang grags pa'i skur sprul nas 'ong ste/ bstan 'gro'i don mdzad pa yin zhes tshad ldan gye mkhas grub du mas gsungs/ des na ma shes pa'i dbang gis sangs rgyas gcig la smad kyang / dngos sam brgyud nas sangs rgyas thams cad la skur btab par 'gyur bas/ rgyal ba rnams kyi thugs kyi dgongs pa bskang ma nus kyang / thugs kyis mi khrel ba zhig ci nas kyang gyes zhes thar 'dod yongs la snying gtam byas pa yin pas thugs la shong ni gyes/ o rgyan dang rje rin po che lta bu'i sgyes bu dam pa rnams kyi sgu tshe brje mi dgos/sku tshe re re la'ang sgu gsung thugs kyi mdzad pa mi 'dra ba mtha' yas ston te/ o rgyan rin po ches sngon rgya gar gyi yul gcig na 78

paṇ+ḍi ta mang pos sku gsung thugs rten la rab gnas byed pa gcig gzigs nas/ khong rang btsun rgan gcig tu sprul/phyag rgya ma btsun rgan ma gcig tu byas/ rdo rje dril bu gnyis bu tsha ming sring gnyis su sprul te/ rgyab tu khur nas mnyam du 'big di ri ri phyin pa dang / khong rnams kyis sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa 'di 'dra bas bshig pa yin zer/ der dpon slob la/rab gnas kyi rog bya'am byas pas/ nged kyi rab gnas kyi rog bya mi dgos kyi/ bu tsha ming sring du ma bar gyis shig zer/btsun rgan gyis rogs gcig tsam byed zer/ rde'u bdun nam rnyal gye khar bskyur bas/ man ji kha brgyan dang bcas pa bdun byung / steng gi nam mkha' la mthu byas mchil ma btab pas gdugs dkar po gser gyi yu ba can zhig byung bas/ khong rnams ngo mtshar bar gyur skad/ rje rin po ches yang sngags nyams su bzhes nas rtogs pa mthon por slebs pa'i skabs tha mal pa'i tshul bzung nas/ dbyangs can ma'i sprul pa'i las rgya mtshan ldan btsal/ gsang spyod mdzad nas rdzogs rim gye rtogs pa mngon du byas skad/ des na khong rnams kyi mdzad pa mtha' yas/ gzhan su yin yang khas gtong mi rung / yab sras mjal ba'i mdo las/ smyo ba ma lags smyo ba'i tshul/ /zha ba ma 79

lags zha ba ltar/ /rnam par 'phrul ba sna tshogs kyis/ /sems can rnams ni 'dul bar mdzad/ /gsungs pa la mnyam re zhog dang / sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i rnam 'phrul bsam gyes mi khyab/ des na gang snang thams cad rang la chos ston pa'i bla ma slob dpon gyi 'du shes/ sgra skad thams cad chos kyi rang sgra/ mdor na snod bcud thams cad dag pa'i 'khor lo 'ba' zhig tu mos pa byas/ tha mal gyi snang ba skad cig kyang mi skye bar dus rgyun du dag snang sbyangs na/ skabs shig las ngan pa'i dbang gis byung rba'i ma dag pa'i snang ba thams cad dag nas/ dag pa'i snang ba 'ba' zhig tu 'char ste/rje rgod tshang pas/ nga yi bla mas sgrub pa byas pas/ snang srid thams cad bla ma'i sku ru shar nas phyogs ris bya mi dgos/thams cad la mos gus mnyam por byas pas byen rlabs kyang che ba byung / da ni rgod tshang pas/ phyogs ris kyi sgrog grol/bdag 'dzin gyi mkhar zhig chos brgyad kyi sbrul mdud grol/rang 'dod kyi rtsa ba chod nas gda'o/ /gsungs/ nga la cir snang thams cad bla ma sku gsum du krong nge ba 'di yong / 'di dran pas bzung dgos med pas/ nga la las ngan pa bsags don 'dug ge gsungs/ rje mi las/ g.yo bskol byed snod kyi rdza 80

rbab tu 'dril nas chag dus/ 'dus byas mi rtag par ston pa'i slob dpon du shar nas/ mgur bzhes pa/ rdza da lta yod pa da lta med/ /dpe 'dis kyang 'dus byas kyi chos kun mtshon/ /khyad par dal 'byor gyi mi lus mtshon/ /nor yod dgu 'dus pa mkho bo'i rdza/ /rdza da lan chag pa bla mar byung / /chos mi rtag bshad pa ngo mtshar che/ /gsungs/ sngon jo bo rje la/ nye gnas khong khro tshig rtsub che ba zhig yod pa/ gzhan gyes nye gnas 'di mi bzang bar gda'/ bzang po zhig bzhag na lags zhes zhus tshe/ jo bo'i zhal nas/ 'di bas nye gnas bzang po zhig med/'di ngas bzod pa'i phar phyin rdzogs par byed pa'i slob dpon gye che shos yin gsungs skad/ de ltar go na mig gcig gis dus rgyun du khong khro slong kyang / bzod pa bsgom nus na/ bzod pa'i phar phyin rdzogs par byed pa'i slob dpon/ gzhan rkyen ngan pa ci byung yang sdug bsran byas na sngon las ngan pa zad du 'jug pa'i slob dpon/ lha 'dre cho 'phrul ci bstan yang lam du 'khyer nus na/ lta ba la bogs 'don byed pa'i slob dpon sogs slob dpon du ma gyur pa gcig kyang med/ des na dam pa gong mas mos gus dag snang 'di la thugs dam gyi mthil byas te/ rje rgod tshang pas/ ngas ri khrod gnas chen la sogs 81

gang du phyin kyang / chos sam sgrub pa la mos gus dag snang byas/bla ma mthong tshad la chos kyi 'brel ba zhus/ da dung de'i dus kyi chos tsho ma brjed par skad de yod/ grogs su dang 'grogs kyang dman sa bzung nas g.yog byas gsungs/ des na kun la dad gus dag snang byas/ mchod bstod bkur nas chos 'brel 'jog pa/ 'o skol chos pa kun gyis thugs dam gye mthil du 'dzin pa gces so/ /gzhan yang rje bdag nyid chen pos mdzad pa'i sa gsum gyi sgron me chen po/ byang chub lam rim chen mo'i che ba bzhi la/ bstan pa thams cad 'gal med du rtog pa'i che ba/ gsung rab ma lus gdams par 'char ba'i che ba/ rgyal ba'i dgongs pa bde blag tu rnyed pa'i che ba/ nyes spyod chen po rang 'gags su 'gro ba'i che ba zhes gsungs pa 'di la go rgyu chen po zhig yod de/ bstan pa thams cad gsungs pa/ shes rab sgron ma'i rgya cher 'grel mdzad pa las/ bcom ldan 'das kyi gsung rab ces bya ba yin gsungs/ rje rin po ches kyang /rgyal ba'i legs par bshad pa ji snyed pa'o gsungs/ des na bstan pa zer ba 'di rjes 'jug 'o skol rnams kyis rgya chung chung zhig tu go mi rung ste/ sangs rgyas thugs rje can gyis sems can gyi nyon mongs brgyad khri bzhi stong gi gnyen por 82

chos kyi phung bo brgyad khri bzhi stong gsungs pa de rgya chung chung zhig yin rabs med/ 'di rgya chung chung zhig tu go na/ sngon sangs rgyas kyi rgya gar 'phags pa'i yul nas sku yi 'od kyis stong gsum 'gengs bzhin/ lha mi'i gtso byas 'gro ba yongs la chos kyi 'khor lo dpag tu med pa bskor gsungs pa mi bden/sprul pa dpag med bkye nas/ chos grangs med bstan nas/'gro ba'i don 'das ma 'ongs da lta dus gsum po mdzad ces gsungs pa de yang rdzun yin zhes don gye skur ba btab par 'gyur la/ bod du dar ba'i bka' 'gyur 'di ma gtogs gzhan sangs rgyas kyi gsung rab med par sems pa de/ khron pa'i sbal bas phyi'i rgya mtsho nas 'ong ba'i sbal ba la/ phyi'i rgya mtsho na/ kho bos khron pa'i chu 'di las lhag med smras pa dang mtshungs pas/ mkhas pa'i bzhad gad kyi gnas yin te/ chos phung gi che chung mtha' gcig tu ma nges kyang / che ba tshon shog bu shin tu srab pa'i phyi nang gnyis ka snyug gu khab rtse lta bus yi ge phra mo byas/ bar mtshams med par bris pa'i po ti glang chen dar ma'i rgyab khal re yod skad/ de yin na bod la chos phung gcig tsam gyi tshod yang ma 'ong bar gda'/ rgya gar gyi dgon pa gcig na/ rnying rgyud kyi chos gcig pu brtsigs yod pa'i rgyab 83

yig gcig pu 'bri rgyu yin yang / bka' 'gyur tsam zhig yod skad/ jo bo rje rin po ches kyang / bod na mdo sde la blta rgyu med pas kho bo'i dad pa 'grib gsungs skad/ de rnams la dgongs nas/ phyag na pad+mo dngos rgyal dbang lnga pa rin po ches/skal bzang rnam 'dren bzhi pa shākya'i tog /thag snyems tshems dkar 'dzum pa'i zhal sgo las/ /mtha' klas chos kyi phung bo gsungs so cog /grangs med skye dgu'i nyer 'tsho rtsi sman ljon/ /'gro kun nyon mongs gaṅgā'i klung rdul bzhin/ /phra mor 'byed nus sangs rgyas kho na'i yul/ /yin phyir snying bo'i gsung rab pha mtha'i tshad/ /tshur mthong byes blos gzhal bar ga la nus/ /gsungs/ des na bstan pa thams cad zer ba de stong gsum mi mjed 'jig rten gye zhing khams yangs pa 'di ni/ston pa sangs rgyas kyi gdul bya'i zhing gi gtso bo yin pas/'di na sa skya/ dge lugs/ rnying ma/ bka' brgyud pa sogs chos lugs mi 'dra ba sna tshogs dar yod pa 'di thams cad la bstan pa zer dgos/ 'di thams cad sangs rgyas kyis dngos su gsungs pa dang / gzhan sangs rgyas dang / byang chub sems dpa' chos rgyal paṇa grub sogs kyi skur sprul nas bstan pa sha stag yin/ 'di la bstan pa mi zer na gang la zer/ 'o na 84

bstan pa thams cad 'gal med du ji ltar rtogs dgos zer na/ chos shig yin phyin chad sems can rnams 'khor ba dang /khyad par ngan song du lhung nas sdug bsngal myong ba'i rgyu skyon gyi rigs thams cad 'gog thabs dang / mngon mtho lha mi'i go 'phang / nges legs thar pa dang / thams cad mkhyen pa'i go 'phang thob nas bde skyid myong ba'i rgyu/ yon tan gyi rigs mtha' dag bsgrub pa'i thabs sha stag yin pas/ chos gang bsgrub kyang / skyon sna re 'gog pa dang / yon tan sna re mi bskyed pa'i chos gcig tsam yang med la/ chos lugs thar/sa cad skyon 'gog pa dang / yon tan bsgrub pa'i thabs su gcig pas phan tshun don gyi mi 'gal la/ gdul bya mtha' yas pa'i dbang gis skyon chos gcig gis ma nus pa gcig gis 'gog nus pa dang / yon tan chos gcig gis bsgrub ma nus pa gcig gis bsgrubs nus pa yod srid/ sngags nas 'dod yon lnga dang / las rgya bsten pa sogs gnang ba/ mdo 'dul ba nas bkag pa lta bu'i gnang bkag mi 'dra ba mang po yod pa rnams kyang / gang zag gi blo kha'i mtho dman/ dgos pa che chung / gnang bkag gi so mtshams gang yin sogs shes na/bstan pa thams cad nang phan tshun 'gal ba phar zhog gcig 85

grogs su gcig 'gro/ bstan pa thams cad 'gal med du rtogs pa de la zer dgos te/ bsngags 'os bsngags bstod las/ gnang ba dang ni bkag pa la/ /khyod bka' la lar gcig tu nges/ /la lar nges pa ma lags la/ /phan tshun 'gal ba'ang ma mchis so/ /gsungs/ paṇa chen thams cad mkhyen pa blo bzang chos rgyan gyis/ lhan cig skyes sbyor ga'u ma/ /lnga ldan ro snyoms yi ge bzhi/ /zhi byed gcod yul rdzogs chen dang / /dbu ma'i lta khrid la sogs pa/ /so sor ming 'dogs mang na yang / /nges don lung rigs la mkhas shing / /nyams myong can gyis rnal 'byor pas/ /dpyad na dgongs pa gcig tu 'bab/ /ces dang / grub thob 'brug pa kun legs kyis/ rdzogs chen dang phyag chen dbu ma gsum/ /mkhas pas bltas na gcig tu 'dug /blun po chos spong mdzad 'dod rnams/ /so sor phyes la nga yis bsgoms/ /dam pa'i chos rnams dgongs pa gcig /ces gsungs/ de ltar bstan pa thams cad 'gal med du rtogs na rgyal ba'i gsung rab thams cad sems can la 'phral yun gyi phan bde sgrub pa'i thabs su 'dug nang na 'di su la mi mkho zhes 'dor rgyu gcig tsam yang mi 'dug snyam/ bla ma gong ma rnams kyi rnam thar bzhin bka' thams cad gdams 86

par 'char ste/ jo bo'i slob ma sgom pa rin chen bla mas/ a ti sha'i gdams ngag la stan thog gcig tu lus ngag yid gsum rdul du brlag pas/ gzhung lugs thams cad gdams ngag tu go ba zhig byung gsungs/ rnal 'byor pa byang chub rin chen gyes/ gdams ngag la nang byan tshud pa zhes pa ni be'u bum lag mthil tsam zhig la nges pa rnyed pa la mi zer gyes/ gsung rab thams cad gdams ngag tu go ba la zer gsungs/ 'brom ston pa rin po ches/ bstan pa thams cad gru bzhi lam gyes 'khyer shes pa nga'i bla ma zhes gsungs te/ tshig 'di dpyad gzhi shin tu che ba yin no zhes rje thams cad mkhyen pas gsungs/yang nyid kyi zhal nas/ dang po rgya chen thos pa mang du btsal/ /bar du gzhung lugs thams cad gdams par shar/ /tha ma nyin mtshan kun tu nyams su blangs/ /gsungs/ kun mkhyen klong chen rab 'byams pas/ thos bsam byas nas lo shas song / /da lta gzhung lugs kun la mkhas/ /phyogs gcig kha 'dzin bdag la med/ /bde skyid mtsho mo rdol ba lags/ /gsungs/ rgyal ba skal bzang rgya mtshos/ rnam thar gtsang ma dge ldan bka' rgyud/ /phyogs re 'dzin pa'i grub mtha' min no/ /gsung rab thams cad gdams par shar bas/ /bshad 87

sgrub bstan pa'i nying khu lags so/ /gsungs/ rgyal dbang lnga pas/ de ltar mchog dman theg pa'i rnam grangs kun/ /ma 'dres nyams su len la mthu zhan yang / /bstan pa thams cad dgongs don 'gal med du/ /gdams par shar nas rgyud thog 'gal ba gnad/ /gsungs/ de ltar gsung rab thams cad gdams par shar na/ rgyal ba'i bka' 'di ni skyon 'od 'gog pa'i thabs dang / 'di ni yon tan 'di bsgrub pa'i thabs red snyam/ rgyal ba'i bka' thams cad kyi dgongs don bde blag tu rnyed/ de ltar rgyal ba'i bka' rnams kyi dgongs pa rnyed na/chos 'di bzang 'di ngan zhes 'dor ba'i chos spong gi nyes spyod chen po rang 'gags su 'gro/ de ltar nyes spyod rang 'gags su song na log rtog gi mun pas nam yang sgrib mi nus par/ grub mtha' thams cad la dad gus dag snang gi nyi ma phyogs med du 'char bar 'gyur bas gnad shin tu che/ de ltar go bar rjes 'jug 'o skol rnams kyis chos la bzang ngan phyes/ chags sdang gi dbang gis gzhan gyi grub mtha' smad na/sa gsum gyi sgon me lam rim chen mo'i che ba bzhi yang 'chor du bcug pa yin pas/ rjes 'jug chos pa rnams kyi mtshang du de bas che zhig gzhan na yod par ma sems/ deng sang 'ga' re 88

chos lugs re re tsam la zhen nas/ gzhan gye grub mtha' la dgag pa gtong ba chos ma shes pa'i rang mtshang phyir bstan pa yin te/ 'gog rgyu yin na/ bod kyi grub mtha' 'di cha bo bkag pas ci la phan/ 'gro ba yongs kyi skyabs mgon sangs rgyas thugs rje can la/ khyed kyi snga sor 'gro ba yongs la chos kyi 'khor lo mtha' yas pa bskor snang / gcig bskor mdo/mang po bskor nas ci bya/ da phyin chad 'jig rten khams su sprul pa dpag med 'gyed nas chos grangs med ma ston/ zhal rog ge bzhugs zhes chu mgo nas 'ong gi ma 'jug sangs rgyas kyi gdul bya'i zhing stong gsum 'jig rten gyi khams kyi grub mtha' gzhan na yod tshad po khog nga'i bsam na khyod kyis grub mtha' de thams cad 'gog nus pa phar zhog stod rgya gar nas smad rgya nag yul yan chad la dar yod pa yang 'gog mi nus/ de phar zhog bod gangs can khrod kyi grub mtha' kun kyang 'gog mi nus/ gal te khyod kyi ring la cung zad 'gog nus kyang / shi ma thag nas slar ldang bas je dar du 'ong / tshe thung nam 'chi cha med/ sngon gye dam pa skyes mchog gong ma rnams kyi gsung bzhin dad gus dag snang gi lde mig gis thar ba'i sgo chen phye nas/ yar thams cad mkhyen pa'i drung du 'gro 89

mi thub kyang / chos spong gi 'byed shing brgyab nas dmyal ba'i zangs chen gyi kha yang phyes khro chu khol ma'i nang du mig zum nas mar la ldang ma bzhag na bzang / sngon grub pa zhig gis kho bzang tshul bzang rabs brjod/ gzhan khong rnam pa 'ga' re la smad ra btang tshe/ grwa ba kha rgod cig gis/ khyod rta brgya'i khyu'i rta mchog ma red da/ ra brgya'i khyu'i ra bo red smras pa ltar/da lta grub mtha' phyogs zhen che ba rnams bstan 'dzin gye gtso bo ma red da/ bstan pa bshig gi dpon po yin par 'dugasngon gyi rgyal sras byang chub sems dpa'i rnam thar ltar/ /thabs mkhas bsdu bzhi'i sgo nas bstan pa dang sems can la phan zhig ma thogs na/ mi sems la tshig ngan dang / g.yag sems la gri ma 'jog zer ba ltar/ tshig ngan smras nas gzhan la phan mi thogs/ khong khro skye ru bcug nas ci bya/ rang nam 'chi cha med pas/ sor bcu snying khar khrom/ khong yig nang nas klog dang / de la don go spu tsam med/ chos yin min 'gog dgos mi dgos/ las rgyu 'bras brtsi mi brtsi'i steng nas 'jogalas rgyu 'bras brtsi na sus ji skad zer yang chos yin 'gog mi dgos/ mi brtsi na gang yin yang chos log yin pas 'gog dgos te/ mdo las/ sdig pa ci yang mi bya zhing / /dge ba 90

phun sum tshogs par spyad/ /rang gis sems ni yongs su 'dul/ /'di ni sangs rgyas bstan pa yin/ /gsungs/ deng sang bla ma 'ga' res/ 'gog na snying rje chen po'i sgo nas bsod snyoms byed dus/ yon bdag rnams kyis ra lug brgya stong mang po gsod pa dang / gcod sngags rnams kyis grong chog byed dus ra lug gi don snying blangs/ g.yang gzhi brgyangs pa dang/ gtsug lag khang dang dgon pa'i thag nye na/shan pas rwa'i khang ba phug sha'i ri brtsigs/ khrag gi mtsho bskyil ba dang / khyem pa pho mo rna mas kyis chos sam/ 'jig rten gye kha gso ma shes par srog gcod rku 'phrog sogs mi dge ba'i las la rtag tu rngams nas/ nang ba sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa'i ming ma 'gyur ba ma gtogs/ don gyi gnas 'gyur nas/phyi rol pa phal cher gyis ci bya lag len la 'debs pa 'di rnams khog dang / rang gzhan la phan pa'i bde 'byung bas nang ba sangs rgyas kyi bstan 'dzin de la zer/ 'di rnams ma khog na phyi nang gnyis la don gye khyad par med par ma zad/ phyi rol pa kha cig gis sdig la 'dzem pas legs te/ spyan snga pas/mu stegs rnams kyi rgyang 'phen pa nam yang tha chad pa yin pas/spyod pa yang phal cher mi dge ba nyid yin la/ kha cig 'tshe ba 91

chos su smras pa sogs dge mi dge 'dres mar spyod pa dang /gcer bu pa sogs sems can la gnod 'tshe gtan nas mi rung bar 'dod de/ lug dang srin bu sogs la mi gnod pa'i phyir/ gos yang mi gon par 'dod la/ mu stegs bsam gtan thob pa rnams ni nam yang mi dge ba spang pa yin no/ /gsungs/des na las rgyu 'bras la mi 'dzem par chags sdang gis gzhan gye grub mtha' smad na/ rang gzhan la sdig sdug gtam ngan khyes gyong pham kha sogs mi 'dod sna dgu yong bas/ bstan bshig de la mi zer na su la zer/ de 'dra'i chags sdang mkhan thams cad bstan 'dzin yin na/ phyis bod bsod nams che tshad red/ khye dang phag gnyis kyang mi 'grigs par/ mchu gnyer nas bstan pa 'dzin par snang / sngon 'ga' res grub mtha'i la rgya brtsad nas gzhan la mthu byas tshe/ 'brug pa kun legs kyis/ de ring gi gtor rgyag 'di ngas byed/ ces gtor ma lag tu phyar nas/ hūṃ nga ni spyon pa gza' ro yin/ /khyod ni rtsam pa log tho yin/ /su la phan zhing su la gnod/ /khye rgan rgya bo tshim gyur cig /ces 'phangs zer ba ltar/ deng sang phyogs ris chags sdang gi gza' gdon gyis myos nas/ bdag bstod gzhan smod kyi rtsam zor 'phen pa/ bstan pa su la phan nas su 92

la gnod/ kho rang gi 'dod pa de tshim gyur cig ces mkhas pa rnams kyis de 'dra'i gtam brgya stong go yang btang snyoms su 'jog pa gdams ngag gi che shos shig yin/ mi ngan gye kha ma rlog rul ma'i snod ma rlog zer ba dang / bshad tshad mi bden/ bshas tshad mi tsho/ zer ba dang / kha dbyen gyi rjes ded na 'khon 'dzings kyi rgyun mi chad zer ba dang / kha kha rog bsdad na kha mchu med/ /mgo lag gis skyor na gcog ni med/ /zer ba dang / kha ni kha mchu kun gyi rtsa ba yin/ /'di la sgo lcags yod na ci ma runge / /zer ba sogs la rtog dpyod zhib tu thongs/ mi la rtog dpyod med na dud 'gro yin/ /rta la gom 'gros med na bong bu yin/ /mi zer ram/ sngon grwa ba zhig gis phor ba chen po zhig tshogs la khyer 'ongs tshe/ dge skos kyis khyed tshos phor ba kha nas hos btab na zhabs nas mi go ba re bzung nas/ zhes tshogs gtam btang tshe/ grwa ba gzhan zhig gis phor ba che ba 'dzin mkhan de la/ ka khyod la bshad pa red smras tshe/ de na re/ kho bo la bshad ni ma yin par ma zad/ 'du khang nang 'dir 'tshogs pa yongs la bshad ni ma red/ de'i rgyu mtshan 'du khang gi rgya mthong kha nas ku btab na nang gi go giphor ba'i kha nas hos btab na zhabs nas mi go ba'i chen po 93

zhig tshogs nas 'dzin tshul ye med pa'i phyir ro/ /zhes smras pa ltar/ dbu rdzogs phyag rgya ba re re tsam gyis rgyal ba'i bka'i dgongs pa ma lon par nyes bshad glen gtam khrom du bsgrags tshe/ mkhas grub 'ga' res dbu ma rtog ge ba'am/ phyag rdzogs pa blun po 'dis zhes brnyas smod byed pa de/ kun la bshad ni ma yin pa'i ha go dgos/ de'i rgyu mtshan dbu rdzogs phyag rgya ba'i skyes bu dam pa rnams la nor 'khrul zhig ye mi srid pa'i phyir ro/ /'o na grub mtha' thams cad kyis gcig gis gcig la dad gus dag snang zhig mi 'ong bar/ phyogs ris chags sdang bdag bstod gzhan smod byed pa 'di gang gis lan zer na/ 'o de mdo rgyud bstan bcos kyi dgongs gzhi can gyi gsung 'di 'dra'i dgongs pa ma lon par phyin ci log tu go bas lan pa yin te/ rgyud chen dgyes pa rdo rje las/ gang zhig dgyes rdor mi shes pa/ /de ni ngal ba don med yin/ /zhes dang / rje btsun dus 'khor zhabs kyi zhal nas/ dus kyi 'khor lo zhes pa 'di ma shes na/ chos gang dang gang gis kyang sangs rgyas mi srid/ces dang / 'khor lo bde mchog las/ snying bo 'di ni mi shes pa/ /gzhan dag snying bo med rtsar mtshungs/ /zhes dang / bde mchog 'khor lo mi shes pa/ /blun po phub ma brdung dang 94

mtshungs/ /zhes dang / rgyal ba'i yum las/ rgyal ba 'das dang ma 'ongs da lta gang bzhugs pa/ /kun la pha rol phyin pa 'di yin gzhan ma yin/ /zhes dang / rgyal po srong btsan sgom pos mdzad pa'i ma ṇi bka' 'bum las/ chos 'di ni 'bras bu dang 'dra/ gzhan thams cad phub ma dang 'dra gsungs/ te lo pa'i zhal nas/ sngags su smra dang pha rol phyin pa dang / /'dul ba mdo sde sde snod la sogs pa/ /rang rang gzhung dang grub pa'i mtha' yis ni/ /'od gsal phyag rgya chen po rtogs mi nus/ /zhe 'dod 'dzin pa'i 'od gsal mthong mi 'gyur/ /rtog pa'i bsrung sdom dam tshig don las nyams/ /zhes dang /o rgyan rin po che'i rig pa gcer mthong ngo sprod las/ 'di nyid ma rtogs paṇ+ḍi ta yang 'khrul/ /theg dgu'i bshad pa shes byar mkhas gyur kyang / /ma mthong rgyang gi gtam rgyud bsnyad pa zhig /sangs rgyas sa la skad cig nye mi 'gyur/ /zhes dang /ma cig gi zhal nas/ byas pas phung / bsgoms pas srol/ bsam pas brlag skyur la thongs/ glod la zhog yan par zhogasangs rgyas thob/ byang chub 'grub/ ces dang / sam+bu tri'i rgyud las/ chos kyi phung bo brgyad khri dang / /bzhi stong dag gi tshogs la ni/ /lus kyi de nyid mi shes pas/ /de dag thams cad 'bras 95

bu med/ /gsungs/ lho brag dmar pa lo tsā'i zhal nas/ bod kyi gdams ngag thams cad phyogs gcig tu bsdoms kyang /nga'i lus gnad gcig pu la yang mi do gsungs skad/ slob dpon zla ba grags pa'i zhal nas/ slob dpon klu sgrub zhabs kyi lam las ni/ /phyi rol gyur la zhi ba'i thabs med do/ /de dag kun rdzob de nyid bden las nyams/ /de las nyams pas thar ba 'grub yod min/ /zhes dang / 'das rjes don khrid las/ yang gsang snying thig mngon sum man ngag 'di/ /gang gis reg pa myang 'das dngos la sbyor/ /theg brgyad a ti theg dgu skor gsum gyis/ /de nyid don la reg pa ma yin no/ /zhes dang / rnying ma'i btags grol rgyud las/ rgyud 'di ma rtogs dge ba bcu/ /sbyad kyang 'khor ba las mi grol/ /de sngar mtshams med lnga spyad kyang / /'di 'phrang ngan song lhung mi srid/ /ces dang / pha rol phyin bcu snying bo'i rgyud/ /yang dag rgyud 'di ma rtogs na/ /dus gsum kun tu sangs mi rgya/ /zhes dang / rim lnga las/ bdag la byin gyes brlabs pa'i rim/ /gang gis rnyed par ma gyur pa/ /mdo sde rgyud dang rtog pa la/ /de yi ngal ba don med 'gyur/ /bdag la byen rlabs rim thob pas/ /gtso bo sangs rgyas kun bdag nyid/ /tshe 'di nyid la 96

sangs rgyas ni/ /the tshom med par thob par 'gyur/ /zhes dang /don gsal me long las/ 'di med gang zag gzhan spyod pa/ /bskal par nyan bsam bsgom bsgrubs kyang / /bskal par sangs rgyas re ba med/ /ci'i phyir mngon sum gnad ma rtogs/ /theg gsum theg dgu'i chos rnams kyi/ /'di nyid don la reg pa med/ /'di ni kun las khyad par 'phags/ /zhes dang / rdzob/sa chen pad+ma gsang thig las/ nyams len gnad dril 'di 'dra srid pa tsam/ /rgyal dbang pad+ma'i thugs kyi yang thig te/ /nyams su sus blangs tshe gcig 'jal lus 'grub/ /lung thob tsam gyis bde chen zhing du bgrod/ /ces dang / mi g.yo ba'i rtogs pa las/ byang chub sems ni brtan byas nas/ /sngags kyi dngos grub gsungs pa ste/ /gzhan du sngags grub cho ga yi/ /bya ba thams cad 'bras bu med/ /dngos po thams cad mdor bsdus pas/ /rang bzhin med nyid bsam pa las/ /byang chub sems ni nges par thob/ /gzhan du 'ba' zhig 'gyur ba min/ /zhes dang / rje mi las/ mi mngon nam mkha'i dbyings shed na/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas zhal rdzun mkhan/ /drang don gyi bslu khrid gsung gsungs nas/ /nges pa'i don la rtogs dus med/ /tha snyad spongs shig ras chung 97

pa/ /zhes dang / yang rje mi lar/ brag srin mos zhus pa/ chos drang don theg dman mgo bskor 'dis/ /las nyon mongs thul bar dka' bar mchis/ /kha bshad stong pa'i mtshor mgron de/ /rkyen sdug bsngal byung na 'bros par nges/ /zhes dang / dpal sa ra ha'i zhal nas/ gang zhig bla ma'i man ngag bdud rtsi'i chu/ /gdungs sel bsil ba ngoms par mi 'thung bar/ /de ni bstan bcos don mang mya ngan gyi/ /thang la skom pas gdungs te 'chi bar zad/ /ces dang / bla ma zhang gis/ rang gi shes pa rnal ma la/ /skad cig tsam yang yengs ma bshig /ma yengs pa ni sangs rgyas rnams/ /ma lus pa yi lam gcig po/ /lam de spangs pas sangs rgyas ni/ /gcig kyang rnyed nga/ mi srid do/ /zhes dang / birlu ba'i zhal nas/ sangs rgyas mchod rtsol rnams la don mi 'byung / /'dod dang rtsol ba yod na sangs mi rgya/ /byin rlabs bla ma'i ngang gis nyams myong 'phel/ /zhes dang /lam rim chen mo las/ mdzad pa po jo bo'i che ba brjod pa'i skabs su/ spyir na gangs ri'i khrod du bstan pa snga dar la/dpal zhi ba mtsho dang / pad+ma sam+bha bas bstan pa'i srol btsugs pa la/ stong pa nyid kyi go ba gnad du me song ba la brten nas/ thabs kyi cha la skur zhing yid la byed pa thams 98

cad 'gog pa'i rgya nag gi mkhan po hwa shang gi bstan pa 'grib par byas pa/ slob dpon chen po ka ma la shī las legs par bkag nas rgyal ba'i dgongs pa gtan la phab pa'i sku drin shin tu che la/ phyi dar la rgyud sde'i don log par bzung ba la brten nas paṇ+ḍi ta dang rnal 'byor par rlom pa 'ga' zhig gis bstan pa'i rtsa ba tshangs par spyod pa la gnod chen po byas pa/ skyes bu dam pa 'dis legs par bkag cing / gzhan yang log par bzung ba rnams nub par byas nas/ phyin ci ma log pa'i bstan pa 'phel bar mdzad pas kha ba can pa thams cad la sku drin gyis khyab par mdzad do/ /zhes pa la sogs pa mdo rgyud bstan bcos na 'di 'dra mang po yod pas dgongs gzhi ni gang yin zer na/ dper na/ khrom chen po zhig la mi 'ga' zhig gis rta bzang bo mang po btsong du khyer na/ rta thams cad gang gi gang bzang yin kyang / khrom pa'i mi rnams la/ kho bo'i rta 'di bzang tshul bzang rab brjod/ rta 'di la bltas na rta gzhan tsho bong bu dang 'dra/ rgyug gam gom 'gros med sogs smras na/ gzhan 'ga' res yid 'phrog nas rin chen po byen nas myur du nyo/ nyos nas rta 'di bzang snyam shin tu rtsis che legs par gso ba sogs phan pas dgos ched kyi 99

dbang gis de skad smras pa ma gtogs/ des bar rta gzhan rnams thams cad bong bu bzhin ngan nas de skad smras pa ma yin pa ltar/ chos thams cad bzang bo yin kyang gdul bya la/chos mdzad pa bo dang / chos kyi che ba brjod nas gdams pa 'di la bltas na/ gzhan phub ma sogs dang 'dra zhes gdams pa gzhan dman dman zhig byas na/ gdul bya 'ga' res yid 'phrog nas rab tu dad pas myur du nyan pa dang / nyan nas gdams pa la rtsis che zhing rgyun du nyams su len pa sogs la phan che bar dgongs nas/ dgos ched kyi dbang gis de skad gsungs pa ma gtogs/ nges par chos gzhan thams cad phub ma rtswa bzhin bzang po min nas/ de skad gsungs pa ma yin te/de yin na soms dang / rgya bod na chos rnam dag cig yod mi srid pa'i phyir ro/ /yang dgyes rdor/ bde mchog yum las gsungs pa sogs ni/ lam de rnams thabs shes zung 'brel gyi lam yin pas/ gzhan thabs shes ma bral nyams su blangs kyang /ngal ba yin/ 'bras bu sku gnyis mi 'byung / lam rnam dag min gsungs pa yin zhes bla ma zhang rin po ches gsungs/ de yang thugs shin tu mad de/ dper na bya nam mkha' la 'phur ba la gshog gnyis ka dgos pa ltar/ mthar thug gzugs sku 100

chos sku gnyis thob pa la/ da lta thabs shes zung 'brel lam/tshogs gnyis zung 'brel gyi lam ma nor ba la slob dgos te/dper na gshog pa g.yas med pa'i bya bzhin/ thabs shes ya bral gyi lam la bslab pas mi 'ong / thabs shes sam tshogs gnyis zung 'brel dgos pa'i lung khungs ni/ rnam snang mngon byang las/ gsang ba'i bdag po thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes ni snying rje rtsa ba las byung / byang chub kyi sems kyi rgyu las byung /thabs kyi mthar phyin pa yin no/ /zhes dang / gsang ba bsam gyes mi khyab pa'i mdo las/ ye shes kyi tshogs kyis ni nyon mongs pa thams cad spong bar 'gyur ba lags so/ /bsod nams kyi tshogs kyis ni sems can thams cad nye bar 'tsho bar 'gyur ba lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das de ltar lags pas byang chub sems dpa' chen pos bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tshogs la brtson par bgyi'o/ /'phags pa nam mkha'i mdzod las kyang / shes rab kyi shes pas ni/ nyon mongs pa thams cad yongs su 'dor ro/ /thabs kyi shes pas ni sems can thams cad yongs su mi gtong ngo / /zhes dang / ga ya gau ri las/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi lam ni mdor bsdu na 'di gnyis te/ gnyis gang zhe na 'di lta ste/ thabs dang shes 101

rab bo/ /zhes dang / dpal mchog dang po las/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ni ma yin no/ /thabs la mkhas pa ni pha yin no/ /zhes dang / 'od srung gis zhus pa las/ dper na blon pos zin pa'i rgyal po rnams dgos pa thams cad byed pa de bzhin du/ byang chub sems dpa'i shes rab thabs mkhas pas yongs su zin pa'ang / sangs rgyas kyi mdzad pa thams cad byed do/ zhes dang / de bzhin gshegs pa skye ba 'byung ba'i mdo las/ gang de bzhin gshegs pa 'byung ba de ni/ rgyu gcig pus ma yin no/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kye rgyal ba'i sras/de bzhin gshegs pa rnams ni/ yang dag par 'grub pa'i rgyu mtshan med pa 'bum phrag bcus yang dag par 'grub ste/ bcu gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/ bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tshogs tshad med pa'i mi ngoms pa yang dag pa'i rgyu dang / zhes rgya cher gsungs/ dri ma med par grags pas bstan pa las/ kye grogs po dag de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku ni bsod nams brgya las nges par skyes pa'o/ /dge ba'i chos thams cad las nges par skyes pa'o/ /dge ba'i lam tshad med pa las nges par skyes pa'o/ /zhes rgyas par gsungs/ 'phags mchog mgon po klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa'i rin chen phreng ba las/ gang tshe sangs 102

rgyas gzugs sku yi/ /rgyu yang de ltar 'jig rten bzhin/ /gzhal med de tshe chos sku yi/ /rgyu lta ji ltar gzhal du yod/ /ces dang / sangs rgyas rnams kyi gzugs sku 'di/ /bsod nams tshogs las byung ba ste/ /chos kyi sku ni mdor bsdu na/ /rgyal po ye shes tshogs las 'khrungs/ /de lta bas na tshogs 'di gnyis/ /sangs rgyas nyid ni thob pa'i rgyu/ /de ltar 'dod na bsod nams dang / /ye shes 'di ni rtag bsten mdzod/ /ces dang / rig pa drug cu pa las/ dge ba 'di yi skye bu kun/ /bsod nams ye shes tshogs bsags pa/ /bsod nams ye shes las byung bas/ /dam pa sku gnyis thob par shog /ces dang /rdo rje gur las/ thabs dang shes rab bsdu byas na/ /de ni sangs rgyas bstan pa gnas/ /zhes gsungs so/ /thabs dang shes rab ya bral gyi gar yang mi phyin pa'i lung khungs ni/ dri ma med par grags pa bstan pa'i mdo las/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi 'ching ba ni gang / thar ba ni gang zhe na/ /thabs med par srid par 'gro ba yongs su 'dzin pa ni byang chub sems dpa'i 'ching ba'o/ /thabs kyis srid pa'i 'gro bar 'gro ba ni thar ba'o/ /shes rab med par sred par 'gro ba yongs su 'dzin pa ni byang chub sems dpa'i 'ching ba'o/ /shes rab kyis srid pa'i 103

'gro bar 'gro ba ni thar ba'o/ /thabs kyis ma zin pa'i shes rab ni 'ching ba'o/ /thabs kyis zin pa'i shes rab ni thar ba'o/ /shes rab kyis ma zin pa'i thabs ni 'ching ba'o/ /shes rab kyis zin pa'i thabs ni thar ba'o/ /zhes rgya cher gsungs/rnam par 'thag pa bsdus pa'i mdo las/ byams pa byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa drug yang dag par sgrub pa 'di ni rdzogs pa'i byang chub kyi phyir yin na/ de la skye bo de dag 'di skad du/ byang chub sems dpa'i shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa kho na la/ bslab par bya yi/ pha rol tu phyin pa lhag ma rnams kyis ci zhig bya zhes zer zhing / de dag pha rol tu phyin pa gzhan la sun 'byen par sems so/ /zhes dang / mi blun po de dag 'di skad du/ tshul gcig kho na'i byang chub ste/'di lta ste/ stong pa nyid kyi tshul gyis so zer te/ de dag ni spyod pa yongs su ma dag par 'gyur ro/ /zhes dang / mdo kun las btus pa las/ 'dus ma byas la'ang so sor rtogs la/'dus byas kyi dge bas yongs su skyob pa ni bdud kyi las so/ /byang chub kyi lam yang rab tu shes la/pha rol tu phyin pa'i lam yang yongs su mi 'tshol ba ni bdud kyi las so/ /zhes dang /'phags pa dgongs 'brel las kyang / sems can gyi don la 104

shin tu mi phyogs pa dang / 'du byed mngon par 'du bya ba thams cad la shin tu mi phyogs pa ni/ bla mchod pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu ngas lung ma bstan to/ /zhes gsungs/ de rnams la dgongs nas/ rje rin po ches/ de ltar mthong nas phyogs res lam gyi ni/ /tshims pa med pa skal bzang rnams kyi lugs/ /gsungs/ de yang chos sku'i rgyu shes rab stong pa nyid kyi don phyin ci ma log pa rnyed nas myur du mngon du 'gyur ba la/ thabs kyi cha rnams sngon du song na shin tu legs te/ rje rin po che'i zhal nas/ 'di ltar dper na gser dang dngul ni mgar ba mkhas pas yang dang yang du mer bsregs shing / yang dang yang du chur bkrus na/ dri ma dang snyigs ma thams cad sbyangs te shin tu mnyen zhing las su rung bar 'gyur bas/ des na rna rgyan la sogs pa'i rgyan cha ci 'dod 'dod du bsgyur bas chog pa bzhin/ sngon la nyon mongs dang nyo ba'i nyon mongs dang nyes spyod rnams la nag bo'i las 'bras dang / 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs bsgoms pa la sogs pa'i skabs nas 'byung ba ltar/ so sor rtogs pa'i shes rab kyis/ de dag gi nyes dmigs yang dang yang du bsgoms pas/sems kun tu gdungs par 'gyur ba'am/ skyo bar 'gyur ba'i 105

yid byed kyis gser mer bsreg pa bzhin du/ nag phyogs rnams las yid phyir phyogs par byed cing / dri ma de dag sbyongs la/ bshes gnyen gyi yon tan dang / dal 'byor don che ba dang / dkon mchog gsum gyi yon tan dang / dkar bo'i las 'bras dang / byang chub kyi sems kyi phan yon la sogs pa'i skabs nas 'byung ba ltar/ so sor rtogs pa'i shes rab kyis de dag gi yon tan yang yang bsgoms pas/ sems brlan par 'gyur ba'am/ dwangs par 'gyur ba'i yid byed kyis gser 'gyur 'khru ba ltar/ dkar phyogs rnams yid mngon du phyogs pa dang dga' bar byas nas/ dge ba'i chos kyis sems brlan par byed do/ /de ltar gyur na zhi lhag gang sgrub par 'dod pa de la/ yid gtad pa na tshegs med par 'grub pas/ de lta bu'i dpyad bsgom ni mi rtog pa'i ting 'dzin bsgrub pa'i thabs kyi mchog yin zhes gsungs/ de bzhin du 'phags pa thogs med kyi zhal nas/ dper na mgar ba'am/ mgar ba mkhas pa'i slob ma mkhas pa zhig gis gang gi tshe/ gser ram dngul zhig gi dri ma dang snyigs ma thams cad sbyangs pa'i phyir/ dus dus su mer bsregs shing chus bkrus na rgyan de dag tu bya ba mnyen zhing / las su rung ba'i 106

tshul gyes mngon sum du byas par 'gyur te/ de la mgar ba'am mgar ba'i slob ma mkhas pa de dang mthun pa'i bzo shes pa des mgar dpyad kyis rgyun gyi rnam pa ci 'dod pa de bsgyur bar byed pa de bzhin du/ rnal 'byor pas kyang gang gi tshe/sems de brnab sems la sogs pa dri ma dang snyigs ma la mi phyogs pa nyid kyis skyo bar byas la/ nyon mongs pa can gyis yid ma bde ba la mi phyogs pa nyid dang / dge ba'i phyogs la mngon par dga' ba la mngon du phyogs pa nyid kyis mngon par dga' bar byas na/ rnal 'byor pa des sems de zhi gnas kyi phyogs sam/ lhag mthong gi phyogs gang dang gang la nges par sbyor bar byed pa de dang de dag la shin tu nyer bar 'byor ba dang / shin tu rnal du dbab pa dang / mi g.yo ba dang mi 'gul bar 'gyur zhing / ji ltar bsam pa'i don yang dag par 'grub pa'i phyir/ 'gro bar yang 'gyur ro/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/dbu rdzogs phyag chen sogs kyi mtshan ldan bla ma rnams kyis gang zag las dang po ba la thabs kyi cha rnams rim par bstan nas sems las su rung tshe/ shes rab kyi cha yang dag pa'i lta ba legs par bstan nas/ slob ma de thabs shes zung 'brel gyi lam nas thams cad mkhyen pa'i sa la 'khrid pa yin la/ des 107

na gzhan thabs shes ya bral gyi lam rnams smad pa tsam ma gtogs/ dbu rdzogs phyag gsum sogs thabs shes zung 'brel gyi rnam dag lam bzang rnams/ nam yang smad par ma sems shig 'jig rten na yang blo ldan grogs kyis gzhan la phan pa'i dgos pa che dus/ bstod smad kyi tshig smras na/ 'jig rten pa'i mi dang mi 'gal bar ma zad/ lhag par de skad smras pas phan thogs byung tshe/ drin can pos de skad smras pas/ bzang po byung zer tshig gi gtang rag yan chad thob pa ltar/ rgyal ba sras bcas rnams thabs mkhas la thugs rje che ba yin pas/gdul bya rnams la phan pa'i dgos pa ches dus/ de 'dra'i bstod smad kyi gsung byon pa chos dang mi 'gal bar ma zad/lhag par de 'dra gsungs pas gdul bya la phan thogs mang po 'byung bas na/ bka' drin che zhes dad pa byed dgos/ rgyal ba'i gsung de dang de 'dra la bstan pa dang sems can la dngos sam brgyud nas phan pa'i dgongs gzhi de dang de 'dra mang po yod pas dgongs pa lon dgos/ gal te blo gros kyi mthu chung nas dgongs pa lon dka' yang / sgra ji bzhin par bzung nas/ chos dang gang zag gzhan khas gtong mi rung /sngon bud med cig gis bu btsa' dus na tsha zug gzer drag po 108

byung 'chi la khad byas tshe/ pho skyes na re/ yang na khong ma bu gsum red/ yang na dri bo kho gcig pu red smras pa ltar/ bla ma 'ga' zhig gis grub mtha' gzhan ngan tshul zhes lung rig gi char phab pa mthong thos tshe/ ngas sngar bshad pa ltar dgongs pa lon na/ pho skyes kyis khong ma bu gsum red smras pa ltar/grub mtha' gang la'ang phyogs med kyi dad gus dag snang gsum rgyun du skyes pas phun sum tshogs la/ de ltar dgongs pa ma lon na/ dri bo kho gcig pu red smras pa ltar dad pa phyogs re ba tsam min mi skyes/ de yang 'gyur ldog che bas mi brtan la/ma bu gnyis shi ba'i ro bas kyang lci bas/ chos spong dang nyes 'gal gye khur gyis non par 'gyur ro/ /sngar chos pa dga' mo tshos kyang de dang de 'dra'i dgongs pa ma lon par/ log rtog gi gdon gyis 'khrul nas/ chos log sun 'byen zer ba'i nyes bshad brtsams nas kun la bshad/ sngar med pa'i dpe ngan gtam ngan shul du bzhag chos la brten pa'i sdig sdug gtam ngan gyi khur chen po rgyab tu khur nas/bar do'i 'phrang ring bo brgal/ zhal thur du bsgyur nas/ dmyal ba'i zangs chen gyi khar song ba'i bla ma 'khur shed can mang po byung / zhes zhang g.yu brag 'gro mgon sogs skyes bu dam pa mang pos gsungs/109

des na 'di 'dra'i dgongs pa lon pa shin tu gal che/ spyir rgyal ba rnams kyis sems can da bang po rab 'bring tha gsum mtha' yas pa'i blo kha dang mthun pa'i chos rab 'bring tha gsum mi 'dra ba mtha' yas pa gsungs/ gsung rab mdo rgyud kyi chos re re la'ang don mi 'dra ba sna tshogs 'byung ste/dgongs pa lung ston gye rgyud las/ tshig gcig la ni sna tshogs don/ /gsungs/ des na rgya bod kyi paṇ+ḍi ta mang pos mdo rgyud kyi tshig re la yang / don 'grel mi 'dra ba mang po gnang /khyad par man ngag gab pa dang / lung gcus pa dang / rgyud dkrug pa mang pas/ de dag gi dgongs pa/ 'e tsho 'dra bas lon dka' ste/ rje sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta'i zhal nas/ mkhas pa kun gyi dgongs pa 'di yin mod/ /da dung blun po rnams kyis rtogs par dka'/ /gsungs/ 'o na sus shes na/ sangs rgyas kyi sprul pa zhig gam/ yang na/ rgyal sras byang chub sems dpa' mkhas pa zhig gis/ de dag gi dgongs pa mkhyen te/ bde mchog rtsa rgyud las/ rdzogs sangs rgyas dang de yi sras/ /bdag nyid chen po rnams kyis mkhyen/ /gsungs/ /de lta bu'i mkhas pas kyang mtha' gcig tu mi 'dzin par tshig de re re'i dgongs pa gang yin dpyad dgos te/ chos rje rin po ches/110

'di mtha' 'di tsam kho na gnas so zhes/ /de mtha' de tsam kho na rjes dpag na/ /'gro ba'i bla ma'i gsung la brgal ba ste/ /des na mtha' min dgongs pa dpyad par bya/ /gsungs/dpyad pa de yang mtha' drug tshul bzhi'i sgo nas zhib tu dpyad dgos te/ rje bud+ngha badz+ra gyis/ mtha' drug dang ni bshad tshul bzhi'i/ /gang gang 'dul ba de la de/ /ston shes bla ma mkhas pa ste/ /gsungs/ de ltar dpyad nas/ rgyal ba'i gsung rab dgongs 'grel 'di ni/ nges pa'i don la dgongs nas gsungs pa red/ 'di ni drangs pa'i don la dgongs/ 'di ni thabs/ 'di ni shes rab/ 'di ni gang zag dbang bo rab/'di ni 'bring / 'di ni tha ma/ 'di ni las dang po ba/ 'di ni brtan pa thob pa/ 'di ni shin tu brtan pa thob pa la de dgongs nas gsungs pa red/ 'di ni gab pa/ 'di ni gcus pa/ 'di ni dkrug pa red/ 'di ni spyir btang du gsungs pa red/ 'di ni bye brag dmigs bsal can gye gsungs red/ces de dag gi don so sor bkral nas gsung rgyu 'dra zhig yin na/ mdo rgyud man ngag thams cad nang phan tshun tshig gi ngos nas 'gal ba ltar snang yang / don gyi ngos nas 'gal ba phar zhog gcig grogs su gcig 'gro ba sha stag yin/ deng sang 111

kun gyis rgyal po glang dar gyis bstan pa la gnod bskyal zhes gleng ba la/ phyag na pad+mo'i rnam 'phrul 'brom ston rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas kyis/ rgyal po glang dar gyis bstan pa la phan btags zhes bka' gdams glegs bam las gsungs/ de gnyis tshig gi ngos nas 'gal ba ltar snang yang / don gyi ngos nas dpyad na/ kun gyis bstan pa la gnod ces zer ba/phugs su phan kyang 'phral du bstan par gnod pa ltar byung ba yin pas/ cha gcig na de bden pas/ de skad smras par rig pa/ 'brom rin po ches phan btags gsungs pa de/ rgyal po glang dar yan chad la/ sdom ldan nyin skar bzhin re gnyis tsam ma gtogs dkon/ rab byung thams cad ser khyem du shor nas/khyem dang rab byung gang yin ngo mi shes pa lta bu byung bstan pa 'chol song yod pa yin pas/ de dag kun rgyal po glang dar skye rgyu min na/ da dung de bas je ngan je ngan du song nas da lta bstan pa'i ming tsam yang med tshod yin/ rgyal po glang dar a ma'i bu rgod po skyes nas/ dper na khyem pa 'ga' res zhing steng du ldum bu 'phyur yod tshad sa bshags pa'i thams cad rtsa ba nas 'don pa ltar/ khrims 'chal/ de thams cad tshar bcad nas rtsa ba nas med pa bzos/ steng ldum bu skyes pa'i 112

shul du 'ga' res gro nas btab pa/ ston lo yag gi snye ma gang gi gang bzang 'khrungs pa/ mgo gug nas 'jam ldem me gnas pa la bltas na nyams dga' ba ltar/ sngar gyi khrims 'chal rnams kyi shul du khrims ldan skyes bu dam pa 'ga' zhig gis sdom rgyun gtsang ma spel nas/ 'dul khrims gtsang sing nge bsrung mkhan gyi sdom brtson gang gi gang bzang byung / zhi zhing dul bar bltas na dngas pa 'dren cing / bstan pa sngar bas je bzang je legs su song / da lta sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa nyi ma bzhin shar yod pa/ rgyal po glang dar gyi khrims 'chal tshar bcad pa'i drin yin pas/ rgyal po des 'phral du bstan pa la gnod pa ltar snang yang / phugs su bstan pa la phan chen po btags 'dug dgongs pa de skad gsungs pa yin pas/ de yang cha gcig na thugs shin tu mad pa ra gda'/ de ltar dgongs pa lon tshe/ gang yin yang bden gi snyam/ 'dor len mi byed par ma zad/ dad gus 'ong ba'i rgyu zhig yin par gda'/ de ltar mgo na tshig de gnyis kyi gcig red gcig ma red ces 'dor len byed dgos pa byung / des na tshig re ma mthun tshe/ gzhan smad cing spang mi rung ba'i rgyu mtshan de sogs shin tu mang / de la dgongs nas/ rje bdag nyid chen pos/113

shes rab med pa la 'gal ba/ shes rab can la mi 'gal ba mtha' yas gsungs pa/ de la go rgyu chen po zhig yod pas/ blo gros can rnams kyis de 'dra'i tshig gi 'gal 'grel ma brtsi bar/ don gye 'gal mi 'gal brtsi dgos/ des na rgyal ba rnams kyi gsung de 'dra'i dgongs don gang yin 'tshol ba la 'bod ces snying gtam smras pa yin pas de lugs gyis/ rgyal ba'i gsung rab mdo rgyud bstan bcos kyi dgongs pa lon na/thams cad nyams su blangs 'os kho na yin te/ rgyal dbang lnga ba rin po ches/ 'phags bod mkhas grub nam mkha'i skar tshogs kyi/ /rnam dag so so'i lugs bzhin yongs bstar bas/ /dus gsum rgyal rnams gshegs shul nyer bgrod pa/ /mar byung nyams su blangs 'os kho na'i yul/ /'on te rkang 'thung khrod na yongs 'dus ltar/ /shing rta che gnyis bzhed gzhung skyes bu gsum/ /lam gyi rim pa dī pa ka ra nas/ /yongs brgyud bka' gdams bstan pa'i grags pa 'bar/ /zhes gsungs so/ /yang rgyal dbang rin po ches/ 'jam mgon chos kyi rgyal po tsong kha pa chen pos/ tshad ma rnams kyis thar ba dang thams cad mkhyen pa'i lam bstan par bzhed pa la/ stag tshang lo tsā bas/rig gnas kun shes rtsa 'grel du dgag pa mdzad pa ni/ lo tsā 114

ba mkhas pa chen po yin pas dgongs pa can gye gsung yin mchis/ de ltar min na sa paṇa gyis/ chos kyi grags pa'i gsung rab dri ma med ces 'gyur 'byung du mdzad pas/ gsung rab yin phyin/ sde snod dang / de'i dgongs 'grel gang rung las ma 'das shing / de gang rung yin phyin/ thar ba dang thams cad mkhyen pa'i lam brjod byar mi byed pa mi srid pas don med kyi dgag pa mi mdzad par zhu/ gzhan yang dpang los/ mngon pa lung gi mngon pa dang / rig pa'i mngon pa gnyis su bzhed pas kyang / rje bla mas dgongs pa'i rgyab skyor du 'gro'o/ /dwags rgyud pa ci rigs kyis/ stag tshang ba'i gsung de dag la brten nas/ rje bla ma la zur za bar 'dod pa'i tshig gi sbyor ba byed pa ni/ sa dge'i mkhas pa lung rigs kyi lus stobs rdzogs pa'i stag seng kha 'thab pa'i bar du/bka' rgyud pa'i sgom chen wa skyes lta bu dag rgyu ba ni shin tu mtshang che bas bag yod par byos shig gsungs/ spyan snga pas/zhi ba 'od kyi sngags log sun 'byen nas/ kun byed rgyal po sogs sems sde ma bu bco brgyad kyi skor rnams/ drang ba shag tshul gyis/ nyang stod kyi nyang ro khro gang du brtsams zhes dang /'gos lo tsā ba chen po'i sngags log sun 'byen nas/ rma rin 115

chen mchog dang / bai ro tsa na dang / gnubs sangs rgyas ye shes/ a ro ye 'byung dang / zur chung shes rab grags kyis/rdzogs chen la rdzus ma mang du byas/ de'i phyir rgyal po'i chad pas bcad de/ bai ro tsa na tsha ba'i rong du spyugs/ rma rin chen mchog bros nas nyang stod nyang ror 'das/ nyang stod du she'u ston byang bya bas/ rdzogs chen a ma na so'i chos bskor dzun ma brtsams/ jo bo'i sngon du a tsa ra dmar po babs/ phyag chen thig le'i rgyud dang / rim lnga'i 'grel rdzus/ kun rig gi cho ga kun snying gis mdzad zer ba sogs chos log mang du brtsams/zhes dang / mchims kyi 'byams yig na de 'dra mang po dang /dge bshes ston pas sgrub pa'i kha bzung ba la brten nas shes rab kyi bslab pas bstan pa la gnod pa byas zer de/ de ltar na chos rgyud thams cad kyis bstan pa la gnod pa bskyal zer dgos pas rang nyid kyis ma go bar zad do/ /zhes dang / chos rje red mda' ba'i slob ma kun mkhyen sher 'od kyis/ rgyal po srong btsan sgam po yan la bon med/ de nas rang bzo byas/bon byung khri srong lde'u btsan gyi dus hwa shang bskrad kyang / slob ma 'gas rdzogs chen brtsams/ de la brkus nas bon gyis theg pa rim dgu brtsams/ /zhes dang / da lta'i rdzogs chen pa dang 116

'dod lugs gcig par bshad de/ rdzogs chen gyi rnam bzhag rgya che zhing / bon gyi rtsa ba'i gzhung gi gnad rtogs na/ rdzogs chen gyi lta sgom spyod gsum dang 'dra sa mi 'dug la/ bon gye rtsa ba rnams rdzogs chen la brkus pa'ang 'ong mi 'dug go gsungs/kun mkhyen thu'u kwan blo bzang chos kyi nyi ma'i zhal nas/ 'ga' zhig gis slob dpon pad+ma bod du zla ba kha shas las ma bzhugs shing / /de'i ring la lha srin 'dul ba dang / bsam yas kyi rab gnas mdzad pa tsam las chos mang du gsungs/ slob dbon phyir gshegs rjes/ mu stegs pa zhig slob dpon du dzus nas mgo la rgod sgro btsugs pa sogs/ deng sang o rgyan za hor mar grags pa 'di'i cha byad kyis bod du 'ong nas/ rnying ma'i chos sna tshogs pa 'di dar bar byas so/ /zer ba ni chags sdang gi gtam yin par mngon no/ /yang 'ga' zhig gis/ rnying ma'i chos rnams su gu ru chos dbang gis byas pa yin/ deng sang o rgyan za hor mi zhes grags pa 'di yang gu ru chos dbang gi cha byad yin zer ba ni/ gu ru chos kyi dbang phyug dus phyis byung ba'i gter ston zhig yin pas/ dus kyang mi mtshungs bar ma shes pa'i bab bcol smra bar zad do/ /ces ngang / lo chen rin chen bzang bo'i chos dang chos min rnam 'byed dang / lha 117

bla ma ye shes 'od dang / zhi ba 'od/ tsa mi lo tsā/ chag lo rnams kyi spring yig dang / rngog gi gze ma ra mgo paṇa chen gyi sdom gsum rab dbye rnams su rnying ma la dmigs phug pa'i skyon brjod mi gsal yang / bod du dar ba'i chos lugs ma dag pa ris med la dgag pa mdzad pa'i gseb tu/ rnying ma la dbu phog zhabs phog gi gsung re gnyis yod par snang / 'gos khug pa lhas btsas dang / 'bri gung dpal 'dzin gnyis kyis sgrub byed mang du bkod nas/ rnying ma chos rnam dag ma yin par sgrub cing / shākya mchog ldan dang / garma mi bskyod rdo rjes kyang de'i rjes zlos byas 'dug bu ston gyis mdzad pa yin khul zhig 'dug pa/ gsung 'bum gyi dkar chag rnams su mi snang zhing / tshig sbyor la dpag kyang mkhas pas gsung gi nyams mi 'dug pas/ blun po zhig gis bris nas/ bu ston rin po che la kha g.yar bar zad do/ /lo tsā ba rong zom bzang po/ kun spangs thugs rje brtson 'grus/ garma rang byung rdo rje/grub thob o rgyan pa/ bcom ldan ral gri/ thar lo nyi ma rgyal mtshan/ phyis kyi 'brug pa pad+ma dkar po/ dpa' bo gtsug lag la sogs grub mtha' gzhan gyi mkhas par grags pa dang /'khon ston dpal 'byor lhun grub dang / gong sa rnga ba chen po 118

sogs rang phyogs pa 'ga' zhig gis kyang chos rnam dag tu 'chad gsungs/ 'brug pa kun legs kyis/ sdom gsum rab dbye de tsho phyi yag po 'dug la la ma go ba sogs dad pa log nyen 'dug go ba tsho'ang tshig pa za le'ang 'dug blo bral la de yin/ de ma yin zer ba de 'dra 'dug de'ang de ma yin zer ba 'di zhe log po/ rnam rtog gi bcos pa'i rkub skam shes rab che che mo/ dbye dwangs shes shes mo 'ga' re zer ba'ang snang gsungs/ bu ston thams cad mkhyen pas/ snga 'gyur gsang sngags rnying ma ni/ lo tsā ba rin chen bzang po dang / lha bla ma ye shes 'od dang / pho brang zhi ba 'od dang / 'gos khug pa lhas btsas la sogs pa yang dag ma yin par smras la/ kho bo'i bla ma skad gnyis smra ba nyi ma'i mtshan can dang / rig ngal ba sogs bsam yas nas rgya dpe rnyed phyir dang / phur ba rtsa ba'i dum bu'i rgya dpe bal bor yang snang bas/ rgyud yang dag go /zhes gsungs/ kho bos ni/ yid kyi nyes pa rang bzhin 'dug pa ste/ /mi rig pa yis gzugs la'ang mi rigs na/ /the tshom za ba'i chos la smos ci dgos/ /de phyir btang snyems bzhag la nyes pa med/ /ces gsungs/ rje gzhon nu dpal gyi rnam thar las/ mkhan chen bsod rin pa de 'bri gung dpal 119

'dzin gyi grogs mched du 'dug pas/ 'phros gtam gyi zhor la/rnying ma la zhal mang du gtong zhing 'dug khyad par gsar rnying na/ tsheg ni shes rab ming du smra zer ba yod/ rgya gar gye yi ge la tsheg mi yong / des kyang rgya gar ma yin pa grub zer bas/gzhan sus kyang lan mi gsungs la/ de'i lan mdzad de/dpung bzang nas/ bzlas brjod byed tshe mi dal mi myur zhing / /gug bsgyed tsheg bar klad gor nyams pas min/ /zhes tsheg bar yod par yang gsungs/ ngo bo nyid med pas mdzad pa'i mdo sde rgyan gye 'grel bshad na/ i ni dbang phyug chen po'o/ /zhes bya ba ni yi ge gcig ma yin te/ tsheg gis bcad par bya ba'i phyir ro/ /zhes bshad 'dug gsungs pas khong ci yang mi gsungs/ yang khong na re/ de dus yin na 'dus byas yin pa la/ gsar rnying ba rnams 'dus ma byas kyi dus khas len par 'dug zer bas/ gsar rnying ni 'dus ma byas kyi dus bya ba bshad pa med/ dus gsum gyi steng du 'byung bar ma nges pa zhes bya ba zhig dang bzhir bshad de/ de ma 'ongs pa la 'byung nges pa gcig dang / ma nges pa gcig gnyis su phye ba yin gsungs pas/ yang ci yang mi gsung bar 'dug ces dang /tsheg rgya dpe la lar 'dug thams cad la yod pa'i nges pa mi 120

'dug ste/ des skyon bzung ma bzung med/ dus la'ang 'dus ma byas kyi dus yong mi yong las/ 'dus ma byas kyi 'khor ba yod pa yang dpal phreng gi mdo las gsungs/ zhes gsungs/des na snga sor dbu ru stod kyi 'bri gung dpal 'dzin dang /phyis kyi a mdo phyogs kyi dge bshes sum bha rin po che la sogs/gsar ma'i bla ma dge bshes mang pos rnying ma bka' rgyud pa zhi byed gcod sogs kyi grub mtha' rnams chos rnam dag min tshul gye/ shes byed kyi lung rigs mang po bkod nas dgag pa btang ba la/ kun mkhyen klong chen rab 'byams pa dang / thu'u kwan blo bzang chos kyi nyi ma la sogs kyis/ chos rnam dag yin tshul gyis shes byed mang po bkod nas lan btab pa dang / stag tshang lo tsā ba/ 'bar chung pa bkra shis rgya mtsho sogs/ rnying ma bka' rgyud pa sogs kyi slob ma mang pos/ dge lugs pa'i grub mtha' 'di/ chos rnam dag min tshul gyi shes byed mang po bkod nas smad pa la/ gsar ma'i bla ma dge bshes du mas yin tshul gye lung rig brgya phrag mang po'i sgrub tshul rnams la bltas na/ bstan pa'i gad bdar la de gcig pus chog bka' drin che bsam gi des na bla ma skyes bu dam pa rnams kyis gcig gis gcig la dogs pa bslangs nas/ bstan pa thams 121

cad la byi dor byas pa yin pas/ thugs kyi gting nas smad pa ma yin/ de ma yin pa'i rtags su/ dgag pa gtong mkhan gyi bla ma de rnams kyis legs bshad gzhan brtsams yod pa'i nang na/ rgyal ba'i gsung rab gang yin kyang / khas gtong mi rung /thams cad gdams par 'char dgos/ tha na khye rgan mgo ser zhig yan chad la ston pa'i 'du shes bzhag dag snang sbyangs dgos zhes gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /yang kha cig la de 'dra'i dgos gzhi gang yang med par log lta chags sdang phrag dog rnyed bkur sogs kyi gdon khog tu zhugs/ shes pa rang dbang ma thob par myos nas/ grub mtha' gzhan dang / de 'dzin pa'i skyes bu dam pa yongs la sgo skur ngan pa btab pa'ang yod sred de/ sngon legs skar dang lhas sbyin phyi rol pa sogs kyi thub pa'i dbang bo zol zog mkhan zhes sgro skur btab pa dang /yang 'ga' res chags sdang gi dbang gis o rgyan za hor ma mu stegs pa zhig yin zer ba dang / phrag dog gi dbang gis ston pa dar lo dang lo ston gnyis kyis/ rje btsun mi la la/ mu stegs chos log pa yin smras pa dang / dgon pa 'ga' res/chad lta ba yin smras pa dang / phyag rdzogs pa 'ga' zhig gis rje rgyal ba gnyis pa legs pa'i skar ma yin/ mdo rgyud bstan 122

bcos blang dor mang du byas pa'i rnam smin gyis sku tshe thung du song / nad ngan pa klu nad kyi snyung nas gshegs song zer ba dang / 'brom gyi jo bo rje'i sngags gsung gi ma bcug pa'i rnam smin gyis sku tshe mjug yang klu nad kyis gshegs zhes skyes bu dam pa de tsho la skur ba 'debs na gzhan gyis smos ci dgos/skal chad log lta can gyi kha sangs rgyas kyis kyang mi chod/ des na 'o skol rnams kyi lad mo byas/ kha khog gnyis gas gzhan gang la'ang smod ga la rung / bla ma dam pa rnams kyis bstan pa dang sems can la phan pa'i dgongs gzhi yod nas gsungs pa dang / 'ga' zhig gis phyogs ris chags sdang phrag dog gi gdon gyis smyos nas lab pa gang yin mi shes/ rgyal ba'i gsung rab rnam dag yin min de kun mkhyen sangs rgyas zhig yin na ma gtogs/ 'o skol rnams kyis chos 'di bzang ka ngan zhes thag bcad nas spang blang blo gros can su zhig gis byed/ri bong cal sgrogs bzhin bla ma 'ga' res tshig de gsung ba bden par bzung nas/ chos dang gang zag la skur ba btab na/ rang nyid shi ma thag nas kha thur du bltas mar dmyal bar 'gro nges pas gzab 'tshal/ dper na dbu rdzogs phyag gsum gye grub mtha' pha ma bu gsum dang 'dra/ rnying ma'i bstan pa 123

kun gyi sngon du dar bas na pha/ de'i 'phror phyag chen dar bas na ma/ de gnyis kyi 'phro la gsar ma dge lugs pa dar bas bu yin/ 'jig rten na pha ma bu gsum bzang rung ngan rung 'grigs na bzang ba ltar/ dbu rdzogs phyag gsum po bzang rung ngan rung 'grigs mthun na bzang / pha rgod po sha zan la bu khwa ta skyag zan skyes kyang / pha bzang pos bu la lhag par byams/ pha kha bcad la bu kha phyur skyes kyang bu bzang pos pha ma gnyis la lhag par byams dgos pa ltar/ phyag rdzogs pa gnyis bzang nas/ dbu ma tshang ngan kyang dbu mas nga la lhag par byams dgos/ dbu ma sang bzang nas/ phyag rdzogs pa ngan kyang lhag par byams dgos sdang mi rung / dper na pha ma bu gsum 'dzoms na gcig gcig gi rgyan du song / phyi'i dgra 'dul kyang thul/ nang gi gnyen skyong yang 'khyongs pa ltar/dbu rdzogs phyag gsum po bod du 'dzoms nas ma nyams par bsdad na/ gcig gcig gi rgyan du song / phyi rol rgol ngan lta bu zhig tshar gcod dgos byung yang / brtson pa nus mthu gang gi sgo nas btul kyang thul/ nang ba'i bstan pa dang 'gro ba'i don gang mdzad kyang yongs/ dper na pha ma bsad nas bus pha ma'i ro shun gon pa dang / bu bsad nas pha mas bu'i ro shun 124

gyon bsdad na mtshang zhig min/ dge zhig med pa ltar/ phyag rdzogs kyi dgon pa gtor nas/ dge lugs pas shul bdag tu 'dzin pa dang / dge lugs pa'i dgon pa nyams gi bcug nas phyag rdzogs pas shul bzung na bstan pa yin pas bzung na snyam/ dper na pha ma bu gsum gyi gcig gis gcig gang bsad kyang shul lus de la dme bo zer ba ltar/ dbu rdzogs phyag gsum gyi bstan pa gang nyams gi 'jug mkhan la bstan bshig zer dgos/ dper na pha ma bu gsum gang yin yang zas gos kyis phongs tshe/ gcig gis gcig la phan 'dogs pa ltar/dbu rdzogs phyag gsum gyi bstan pa gang yin yang nyams dma' tshe/ gcig gis gcig la phan 'dogs dgos/ dper na pha ma bu gsum kyi su la yang gcig gis phan thogs na/ de la drin can zer bzhin/ dbu rdzogs phyag gsum gyi bstan pa gang yin yang 'dzin skyong spel gsum byed mkhan la bstan 'dzin zer/des na skyes bu blo gros can rnams kyis bstan pa thams cad kyi bdag po/ skye 'gro kun gyi phyag mchod gsol ba 'debs pa rnams gshegs kyang / mtshan bskal par mi nub pa sngon gyi dam pa gong ma'i mdzad pa lta bu zhig gyis/ spyir tshe thung rang nam 'chi cha med tshe phyed shor song / tshe lhag la mgo'i nyi zer lta bu'i 125

yud tsam zhig 'dug ring la gtan gyi btsan sa sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob pa'i thabs chos rnam dag zhig mi byed par/chags sdang gi gzhi ma dgon khog gcig brtsigs nas ci zhig bya/ dus gtan du 'khor ba sdug bsngal gyi rgya mtsho'i nang du mi lhung bar thar ba'i btsan sa zhig tshe 'dir zin par 'dod na/chos sgrub pa'i bar chad bdud la dgon gzhi 'di las che ba zhig gzhan na med pas/ bdud lha ru mi mthong bar/ bdud la bdud du ngo shes pa 'di shin tu gal che ste/ rje rgod tshang pas/bsod nams kyi ci byed/ chos zhe nas byed na/ 'tsho ba bsod snyoms byas kyang chog yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyis/ dgos 'dod thams cad sgo rtsar 'ong ba mkhyen te/ ma mdzad par bsod snyoms mdzad pa lags mod/ dgon chung 'dzin pa kun bdud kyis khyer ba yin/ zhes dang / tshe blos btang nas grub thob gcig byed pa yin/ 'khor ba ma stongs bar du gzhi dgon gyi bdag 'dzin mi byed/ so nam mi byed gsungs/ bka' gdams pa bla ma gong ma 'ga' res/ snyigs ma'i dus su dgon pa zhig btab pa las/ gang zag gcig gi rgyud la phan btags pa bsod nams che gsungs/ rje btsun mi la ras pas/ grong ltag gi dgon chung khra bo de/ /ming dgon 126

par btags kyang grong pa yin/ /bka' gdams kyi btsun chung srang rdo mgo /ming btsun par btags kyang lus bsgyur yin/ /gsungs pa yang / cha la lar bltas na thugs mad de/deng sang bla ma dge bshes dben par bsgom na tshe 'dir lam sna zin tshod 'dug pa 'ga' zhig gis kyang / gdul byar phan du re nas dka' las 'o brgyal myangs nas dgon pa btab pa phal cher la bltas na/ phyogs ris chags sdang nga rgyal phrag dog ser sna sogs nyon mongs khyem pa bzhin che/ 'jig rten chos brgyad dkar nag khra gsum mi dge bcu sogs/ 'khor ba ngan song du lhung ba'i rgyu las ngan pa'i phyogs la so nam bzhin rem pa mthong na/ khyem pa dang khyad par med pa'i ha go nas nges shes 'drongs par gda'/ yang gter ston 'ga' res ma 'ongs lung bstan na/ snyigs ma'i dus su bla ma res bdag tu bzung ba'i dgon pa re btab/ dgon pa'i sa bdag tu bzung ba'i sbyin bdag re btsal/ dgon pa gnyis res yon bdag re re brtsad nas 'khon 'dzing mthu gtad sogs bsam ngan sbyor rtsub byas/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa bshig skad/ de yang cha gcig na thugs mad par snang / deng sang dgon pa gnyis res sa cha'am sbyin bdag re brtsad nas rgyab 'dres brgyab/ mi 127

bsad rta ded byas zer ba mthong thos kyang mang po yod la/ de la dgongs nas/ rje mi las bu rgyud rnams la/ bdag tu bzung ba'i dgon pa ma 'debs gsungs/ spyan snga pas/ chos dang 'jig rten gnyis ka med/ /'og nas 'og tu lhung srid pas/ /dgon gog gzhi ma dgra ltar ltos/ /gsungs/ gang shar rang grol gyis/ dgon gnas grwa tshang la chags pa'i bla ma yi tshogs rnams/ /tshe mjug don med du zad tshe gang 'dra rang byed dam/ /gsungs/ rje skal ldan rgya mtshos/ sngon rgyal pos bskyong tshe grwa tshang btsugs/ /de ba har rgyas thabs mi byed par/ /khong sangs rgyas byang sems mnyes phyir du/ /bdag 'di ru mi sdod ri la 'gro/ /gsungs/ bka' gdams gsung sgos thor bu las/ri khrod dgon pa mi 'grims par/ /'khor ba'i mun khang brtsigs pa 'di yang 'khrul/ /gcig pu don nyid mi sems par/ /'khor mang nang du chos 'chad 'di yang 'khrul/ /des na bdag 'dra'i bla ma sgom chen pa'i sems la gang 'char mi shes pas/thugs bsam zhib tu gtong dgos 'khrul mi rung ste/ gang shar rang grol gyes/ phyogs med rgyal khams yangs pa'i sa phyogs su/ /ltos med slong zhing rang rgyud mi 'dul bar/ /skyes med dgon chung re la zhen nas sdod/ /snying med po tsho da ni mno 128

bsam thongs/ /gsungs/ da ngas bsam blo btang na/ deng sang bla ma dge bshes 'ga' zhig gis/ rang gi tshe gang bor thos bsam sgom gsum byed dgos pa thams cad blos btang ba phar zhog tha na zhag bdun gye mtshams yang ma bsdams par/ dang po dgon pa 'debs rgyu yin zer/ sde la khral dang 'u lag mang po bzhag mi phyugs mang pos sa rdo shing mang po blangs/ bran g.yog mang po ngal/ khal rta mang po sgal ba btod/ rwa lug dang 'bu srin mang po bsad/ bar du dgon pa skyong rgyu yin zer/ mi rta mang po dang bcas yon bdag mang po'i sgor song nas dkor mang po bsdus 'ong / tha mar 'gyed phogs mang po btang kyang / bla ma la skog na grwa ba mang pos ngan smras mang bo byas/ de'i rnam smin gyes dmyal bar 'gro ba mang ba snang /des na deng sang snyigs dus 'dir bde skyid snyan gsum 'dod nas/ bla ma 'ga' res dgon pa brtsigs pa sdig sdug gtam ngan gyi gzhi ma/ chung ma bdud mo zhig blangs pa las kyang thu/dgon ngan gyes phar re tshur re ma byen len/ mi chos bla ma'i dzun sogs smras/ rtsa bzhi'i sdom pa yan chad shor/ mthar thug gi thob bya sdig sdug gtam ngan gsum ma gtogs/ 'di phyir bde skyid kyi yongs sgo mchod cig ma mthong / de bas dgon 129

khog re bdag tu ma bzung bar spangs na skyid che ste/ skyid pa'i rgyangs glu las/ bdag 'dzin dgon pa ni mi 'dug /dngos po'i gsog bsrung ni mi snang / /mi ngan ngo bsrung dang bral ba'i/ /kun spangs blo bde tsho skyid pa/ /zhes dang / bya btang mgrin pa yi mdzod nas/ /skyid glu de 'dra zhig thal song / /tshig don snying dbus su zungs dang / /skyid pa'i nyi ma zhig 'char nges/ /gsungs/ 'di la blo gros can gyis dpyad shes na snying gtam smras pa yin te/ rje bsod nams seng ges/ sna tshogs thabs kyis 'khor mang bsdus nas ni/ /mthun rkyen 'dzom pa'i dgon gzhi 'dzin pa yang / /rtsod pa'i gzhi dang bdag sems zhen pa'i rgyu/ /gcig pur sdod pa kho bo'i snying gtam yin/ /gsungs/ snying gtam de sngon yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas nas bzung / da lta'i skyes bu dam pa yan chad kyi bar byon pa'i bla ma dam pa gong ma thams cad kyi tsham thar dang zhal gsung 'khrul med yin pas/ gdams ngag gi che shos shig yin te/ sngon ston pa sangs rgyas kyis dgon gzhi zhig brtsigs nas slar bshig pa phar zhog sku tshe gang bor dgon pa tshwa 'bum gyi khang pa tsam zhig kyang ma brtsigs par/dus rgyun du gnas bla gab med pa'i shing drung sogs la brten 130

nas 'tsho ba bsod snyoms mdzad pa yin la/ dgon pa zhig brtsig dgos na khong gi ma 'dzoms pa dang / ma mkhyen pa yang min te/ rjes 'jug 'o skol rnams kyi phyi nas khong gi lad mo byas/ dgon gzhi bdag tu bzung / gsog 'jog byas/ chags sdang gis las ngan pa bsags nas ngan song du 'gro ba mkhyen nas ma mdzad pa yin pas shes na 'o skol rnams la bka' drin che/ de bzhin du rje mi la sogs/ sngon byon sgyes chen dam pa thams cad kyis sangs rgyas thugs rje can gyi rnam thar ltar dgon gzhi ma bzung bar/ ri khrod dben pa bsten/ mi nor zas gsum spangs/ sgrub pa snying bo byas pa/ 'o skol rnams kyi kha mig yar blta byed pa'i slad du byas pa yin pas shin tu drin che ste/ rgyal ba rgod tshang pas/ nga'i lus longs spyod gzhis dgon yon bdag la sogs pa bdag 'dzin mi bya ba 'di/ khyed bu slob rnams la drin che ba yin/ nga la gang shar chos skur 'char bar 'dug ste/ tshe gang bo sgrub pa byed pa khyed tsho'i don yin gsungs/ yang sangs rgyas thugs rje can gyes/ 'dod yon shig tsam rer brten nas/ sdug bsngal ri tsam re steng du 'ong ba mkhyen nas/ rjes 'jug 'o skol rnams la rgyu nom gyi gsog 'jog phar zhog gser dngul la reg mi rung ba la 131

sogs pa'i bcas pa mdzad/ gnas shing drung zas bsod snyoms gyis zhes gsungs pa ma gtogs/ rjes 'jug rnams kyis khong gi rnam thar 'di ltar byed mi dgos/ de mi nus/dgon pa brtsigs/ gsog 'jog la rem dang / rang gzhan bstan 'gro'i don thams cad shugs kyis 'grub ces nam yang ma gsungs la/ des na tshe thung nam 'chi cha med soms la/las nyon bsog pa'i gzhi ma dgon khog 'dzin pa'i bsam sbyor sngar skyes ba'am/ phyis gsar du skyes kyang bor la/ bdag cag gi ston pa'i rnam thar zhal gsung ltar dam pa gong ma'i gdan sa mi med dben dgon gye lngon shing bsil grib tu/ zas skom ngan ngon bsod snyoms tsam re la brten nas dge sbyor rnam dag byed dgos te/ klong chen rab 'byams pas/ mang po'i nang na 'du 'dzi'i g.yengs/ /sde dgon yin yang phan pa med/ /phyogs ris chags sdang zag pa 'phel/ /ri khrod dben pa 'grim du gshegs/ /zhes dang / bla ma zhang gis/ lar sgom chen pa gsha' ma gcig byed na/ grong ltag gi dgon pa dkar khra shig ge ba la blo rtse gtad pas mi 'ong / ri khrod du ri dwags bzhin sdod dgos pa yin gsungs/ de ltar byas na rgyal ba gong ma'i rnam thar dang gdan sa bzung / gsung bsgrub/ thugs 132

dgongs bskang / gdung 'tsho ba bstan pa bzung ba yin pas/ming don mthun pa'i bstan 'dzin de la zer bas de lugs gyis dang bzang / yang kha cig na re/ 'o na sngar gyi rgya bod kyi chos rgyal paṇa grub mang pos dgon pa btab nga dang / da lta'i bla ma rnams kyis dgon brtsegs gsog 'jog byed ched 'di kun/ bdag cag gi ston pa'i rnam thar bcas pa dang 'gal nas bdud kyi dbang du song ba yin nam zer na/ ngas khyod la bye brag phyed par bshad kyis/ legs par nyon la yid la zungs/'o sangs rgyas thugs rje can gyis 'o skol las dang po ba shes rgyud tha mal las ma 'phags pa rnams kyi/ thar ba'i btsan sa zin pa'i bar chad du 'gro bar dgongs nas/ de skad gsungs pa yin la/ dus gsum sangs rgyas kyi sprul pa bla ma dge ba'i bshes gnyen rgyal ba paṇa chen rnam gnyis lta bu dang / sku tshe snga ma'am tshe 'dir mdo sngags kyi lam la sbyangs nas/ sa lam thams cad mthar phyin nas chags zhen sogs skyon gye rigs mtha' dag sprin ltar dag mkhyen brtse nus gsum gyi yon tan thams cad nyi zla gza' skar ltar rgyas/ dus rtag tu thugs chos sgu nam mkha' lta bu'i ngang las ma g.yos bzhin du/ gang la gang 'dul gye sku dang gsung gi bkod pa mtha' yas pa 1 33

bstan nas 'gro ba'i don mdzad nus pa'i bla ma dge ba'i bshes gnyen rnams kyis bstan 'gro'i bde skyid kyi dpal du 'gyur ba mkhyen nas/ rang 'dod kyi dri ma spu tsam med par gzhan phan gyi lhag bsam dung ltar dkar ba'i sgo nas/ dgon brtsigs pa bdud kyi dbang du song ba yin zhes gsungs pa ga la yin/ de yin na dgon pa'i gzims khang gi ming yang spos nas bdud khang zer dgos par 'gyur/ khyod kyi 'di ltar bye brag ma phyed par cig re mgo'i 'dug mkhan tsho red/ a dzi'i da ci drag da dung gdams pa zab mo ston pas/ log pa'i 'du shes rgyang ring bor sgongs la/ dar cig gson dang kho re/bstan pa dang 'gro ba la phan na/ sngon sangs rgyas kyis ma mdzad pa ma gsungs pa'i bya ba zhig byas kyang / don gyis rnam thar gsung dang mi 'gal bar ma zad/ rnam thar bzung /gsung rnams bsgrubs pa yin te/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ sangs rgyas kyi sku dang gsung gi mdzad pa dang gsung rab rnams bstan 'gro la phan thabs sha stag yin la/ de ji bzhin sgrub pa yin pa'i phyir ro/ /yang bstan 'gro dang / rang gis thar ba bsgrub pa'i bar chad du 'gro na/ sangs rgyas kyi rnam thar gsung dang mthun mthun 'dra yang / don gyi gsung rab dang rgyab 134

'gal che bas bdud kyi dbang du song ba yin te/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ sangs rgyas kyis nam yang sems can la gnod pa'i bya ba phar bltas na bzang ba ltar snang yang mi byed cing / rjes 'jug rnams la yang ma byed gsungs pa'i phyir/ de dang 'gal nas bstan 'gro la phan 'dogs pa ltar byas/ pham glan na bdud kyi dbang du song ba yin te/ de min na bdud dbang du shor ba de ci 'dra zhig la zer shod smras na/ ljags thung ngur 'gyur nges/ yang gsog 'jog ma byed ces sangs rgyas kyi bcas pa mdzad pa de yang / 'o skol chags zhen rdo la ri mo bris pa bzhin yod pa bstan 'gro'i don gang yang mi 'ong ngan song gi rgyur 'gyur ba rnams la bcas pa mdzad pa ma gtogs gzhan sa thob kyis sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i sprul pa/ bla ma dge ba'i bshes gnyen chags zhen gtan nas zad pa bstan 'gro'i don rgya chen mdzad pa rnams la bcas pa mdzad pa ma yin te/ de yin na dad can gyi nor rdzas sogs tshogs gsog phyir phul kyang bzhes nas sangs rgyas kyi bcas pa dang 'gal bas mi rung zer dgos pas de mi 'grigs/ da yang ngas khyod la bshad kyis/ de dper na lha sku'i mdun du mchod rdzas bzhag pa ltar/ bla ma 'dod sred chags zhen gtan nas 135

med na nor rdzas ri rab tsam spungs pa'i dkyil gos dar gye nang na dbu tsho thung tsog ge gnas kyang phan gnod spu tsa ma mi 'byung / sngon sangs rgyas kyis chos 'khor bskor dus/ thog mar gdul bya bkres skom pa la zas skom gyi char phab nas tshim par byas/ de nas tshangs pa'i dbyangs kyis chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba ltar/ bla ma dam pa rnams kyis thabs mkhas bsdu ba rnam bzhi'i sgo nas 'gro don byas nas sangs rgyas kyi rnam thar gsung rnams dang mi 'gal bar ma zad shin tu mthun la nyes pa med par ma zad/ bsod nams kyang mang du 'phel/ de 'dra ma yin par mi nor zas gsum gang la 'dod sred che/ rang don kho na ma gtogs gzhan bstan 'gro la phan pa'i don du nor rdzas gcig kyang mi gtong na/ gos dar gyi nang na dbu tsho thung tsog ge bzhugs pa kun kyang bdag cag gi ston pa'i rnam thar gsung rab kun dang rgyab 'gal yin pas gzhan ma sems/dper na sta re dang ral gri rnon po sogs mtshon cha thams cad kyi dgos pa pha rol shing sogs dngos po che chung gang gcod 'bug pa'i thabs su gcig pa ltar/ rgyal ba'i gsung rab theg pa che chung thams cad kyi dgos pa/ bdag 'dzin 'dul ba'i thabs su gcig la/ mtshon cha 'phyar nas brgya dbyug kyang /136

dug sdong gi phyogs su ma song bar sbom ye re lus song ba ltar/chos brgya byas kyang bdag 'dzin phung rgan gyi phyogs su ma song bar sbom ye re lus na/ byas tshad don med du song ba yin pas/de chos pa yin zhes mkhas pa su zhig gis smra/ dper na mtshon gyis brgyab nas dug sdong rtsa ba bcad nas bsgyel tshe/ yal ga lo ma 'phel ba'i gnas med pa ltar/ chos byas tshad bdag 'dzin gyi gnyen por song nas rtel tshe/ chags sdang sogs nyon mongs pa mi skye/ nyon mongs ma sgyes na 'khor ba ngan song gi rgyu las ngan pa mi gsog de ma bsags na 'khor bar 'khyams dogs med pas/ chos gang byas don yod du song ba yin la/chos pa de la mi zer na gang la zer/ nang blo yi dri ma mtha' dag sbyong ba'i thabs sa dge rnying 'brug sogs kyi chos gang yin yang rgyud la skyes pa'i rtags khyad par can zhig 'di yin la/ chos gang nyams su blangs kyang / chos su song ma song gi khyad par 'di na yod pas/ blo gros can gyis rang gzhan rgyal ba'i gsung rab dang mthun mi mthun/ rnam thar dang 'gal mi 'gal/ chos nyon mongs pa'i gnyen por song ma song chos pa rnam dag yin nam ma yin/ bzang ngan skyon yon gang yod shes par 'dod na/ 'di chos pa srang la 'jal ba'i rgya ma yin 137

pas/ btegs na gsal bar mngon te/ blo sbyong don bdun las/ theg pa che chung gi chos rnams kyi dgos pa bdag 'dzin 'dul bar 'dus pas/ bdag 'dzin gyi gnyen por ma song na/chos byas tshad don du song ba yin/ chos byas tshad bdag 'dzin gyi gnyen por 'gro yin 'dug na blo sbyong rgyud la skyes pa'i rtags yin/ chos chos su song ma song gi khyad par 'di na yod pas/ 'di chos pa srang la 'jal ba'i rgya ma yin gsungs so/ /'on kyang yab sras mjal mdor/ la lar bdud kyi cha byad kyis/ /sems can rnams ni 'dul bar mdzad/ /'jig rten pa rnams rtogs mi nus/ /gsungs pas na/ rgya mar 'gyogs mi rung / ngas ku re byas pa yin pas/ bden par ma 'dzin/ deng sang gang zag 'ga' res chags zhen med rung zhen pa'i tshul mdzad pa sogs mang / bla ma dge bshes sgom chen chos pa 'ga' zhig gis phyi'i lta spyod la bltas nas/ nang gi thugs dgongs lon dka'/ spyod lam rgyal ba'i gsungs rab dang 'gal ba ltar snang yang / bstan 'gro la phan pa'i dgos pa can shin tu mang / rang nyid kun mkhyen sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang ma thob bar du/ gzhan bla ma dge bshes grogs mched kyi gtso byas/ gang zag mchog dman 'bring gsum/ chos 138

lugs rab 'bring tha gsum gang gi skyon mthong kyang / dper na mkhris nad can gyis dung ser por mthong ba ltar/ rang snang ma dag pa'i dbang gis byung ba yin/ 'di rnams la skyon med pa tsam du ma zad/ dper na dung dkar bo yin pa ltar/ dkar po'i yon tan kyang yod srid de/ rang gi las nyon gyi sgrib pa 'thug drags pas ci tsam bltas kyang mthong ba'i skal ba ma byung ba yin/ 'di nadra'i bya ba mi mdzes pa mdzad pa bstan 'gro la dngos sam yang na brgyud nas phan pa'i dgos pa yang yod srid/ sangs rgyas byang sems kyi rnam 'phrul bsam gyes mi khyab pas na don la 'di rnams sangs rgyas byang sems kyi rnam 'phrul/ gang smras thams cad bdag dang 'gro ba yongs la phan pa'i gdams pa sha stag yin/ log lta byed mi rung snyam du/log lta brnyas smod khyad gsod sun 'byin sogs pha rol po'i rgyud la gnod pa'i las skad cig tsam yang mi byed par kun la ston pa'i 'du shes bzhag dad gus dag snang 'ba' zhig mdzad/ dngos sam yid gang rung gis phyag bskor mchod bstod bkur ba la brtson pa gces so/ /yang 'ga' res/ rje rin po ches mdzad pa'i lam rim che chung gang la yang brgyud pa med/ rje yan chad la brgyud pa med bzhin du ston pa sangs 139
