rgyas kyi bar du brgyud pa 'jog pa dang / lam rim gye mgo na/'di'i gzhung ni/ byang chub lam gyi sgron ma yin pas/ de mdzad pa po/ 'di'i yang mdzad pa po gsungs/ mjug na 'di ni mang du thos pa'i dge slong sgong ba pa shar tsong kha pa blo bzang grags pa'i dpal gyis ri bo dga' ldan du sbyar gsungs pa/ dgongs gzhi che yang 'gal ba shin tu che ste/ dam pa'i chos thams cad rgyal ba'i gsung rab dang paṇ+ḍi ta'i bstan bcos gnyis su 'du la/ lam rim 'di bstan bcos yin zhes smras na/ rgyal ba'i gsung yin zer ba bud/ de bud na/rgyal ba nas mkhas grub 'di 'dra brgyud yongs zer/ brgyud pa ltar snang bzhag yod pa de yang 'bud dgos/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ paṇ+ḍi ta'i bstan bcos yin pa'i phyir ro/ rgyal ba'i gsung rab yin zer na/ nam tshod gsungs pa'i khungs ston/ yang rgyal ba'i gsung rab dang mthun pas rgyal ba nas brgyud zer na/ de yin na dgongs 'grel thams cad rgyal ba'i gsung rab dang shin tu mthun pas de kun kyang rgyal ba nas brgyud ces khas longs/ de khas len na mdo dang bstan bcos zhes ming gnyis kyang mi dgos/ klu sgrub dang thogs med kyis mdzad ces pa'i bstan bcos kyang des mdzad gsungs pa rdzun yin zhes 140

khas longs/ de khas len na kho bos kyang rgyal ba'i gsung dang mthun pa zhig brtsams nas/ rgyal ba'i gsung yin rgyal ba nas brgyud pa bzhag chog pa sogs ha cang thal ches par 'gyur/yang lam rim rje rin po ches mdzad pa yin na/ mgo na 'di'i mdzad pa po/ jo bo rje yin zhes pa 'gal bas de bud/ jo bo rjes mdzad par khas len na/ mjug na shar tsong kha pa blo bzang grags pa'i dpal gyes mdzad zer ba de bud/ yang lam sgon dang mthun pas de'i mdzad pa po 'dis kyang mdzad pa po zhes pa yin zer na/ kho bos kyang lam rim chen mo dang mthun pa zhig brtsams nas rje rin po ches mdzad pa yin zhes brjod na chog par khas longs/ de chog zer na mdzad pa po khrig khrig med ces khas longs/ de khas len na khyod kyi snying khams 'dra ma bde ba ma yin nam/ sems rnal du phobs la lan drang po thobs shog ya tsho zer na/ a dzi'i snying rje/ rang gi gro gros dman pas rgyal ba blo bzang grags pa'i gsung gi dgongs pa ma lon par 'di 'dra smra phod pa 'jigs rgyu zhig dang / ma shes pa'i dbang gis smras pa los yin snyam snying rje rgyu zhig gnyis dus gcig la byung / khyod kyis 'di sngar nas bsam pa yin nam/ da dran byung / rje rin po che blo gros dman pa'i stabs 141

kyis 'di 'phyugs yod pa de khyod bden/ 'di dag gi don rnams rjes 'jug mkhas grub rnams kyis brgya dgos na stong gsungs 'dug khyod kyi ma go'am/ 'o na khyod kyi mi go khag med log rtog gi rlung stabs kyis shes rab kyi rna ba 'on pa'i phyir ro/ /da ngas khyod kyi log lta'i rlung nad sel phyir legs bshad sman thun chung ngu zhig 'phangs pa med par ster bas/khyod 'on pa'i rna bas yang sngar bzhin sgra log ma go bar legs po gyis nyon cig 'o sa gsum gyi sgon me chen mo byang chub lam rim chen mo la/ brgyud pa yod tshad dpe'i sgo nas ston/ ci 'dra zhig yin zer na/ dper na rgyal byed tshal nas sman thams cad kyi nang nas cung zad re blangs nas sman thun byas/gzhan nad pa la byin na/ de sman pa'i lag nas thon kyang rgan gzhon bar ma su zhig gis/ sman thun de 'ong ba'i khungs rgyal byed tshal min/ de tshong ba 'di 'dra zhig gi lag brgyud nas 'ong zer ba rdzun yin/ sman pa kho rang gi lag nas byung ba yin mi zer ba ltar/ yul rgya gar 'phags pa'i yul gyi mnyam med ston pa shākya'i rgyal bo'i gsung rab rnams rgyal ba rang dang sa bcu'i byang chub sems dpa'i sprul pa lo tsā ba dang / mkhas grub dpag med kyis bod yul mtha' 'khob tu gdan drangs pa 142

rnams/ bstan pa'i bdag po rgyal ba gnyis pa'i phyag tu 'byor tshe/ rgyal ba'i gsung rab kun gyi bcud bsdus pa byang chub lam rim mdzad nas gdul bya la gnang ba rje rin po che'i zhal las thon kyang / mkhas blun bar ma su zhig gis/ byang chub lam rim de 'ong ba'i khungs rgyal ba'i gsung rab min/ mkhas grub bar ma chad du brgyud nas 'ong zer ba rdzun yin/ rje rin bo che'i rang bzo yin zhes khyod ma gtogs su zhig gis smra spobs/khyod kyi gtam de dpe bzhag na/ sman pa mkhas pas sman sbyor ba/ khong gi lag gam lus kyi cha shas zhig las byung / rgyal byed tshal sogs nas 'ong ba min smras pa dang mtshungs so/ /yang byang chub lam rim la brgyud pa med na/ sngon o rgyan pad+mas gdul bya la blo dman le lo can rnams kyi ched du gsang sngags kun gyi bcud bsdus pa yin tsho zer/ sngags chos mang po/gter ston 'ga' res gter nas bton/ o rgyan nas kun bzang gi bar brgyud pa 'jog pa de yang brgyud pa ltar snang tsam yin/ nges don gyi brgyud pa zhig med ces khas len dgos pas/ de yin na khyod kyis rang gi bla ma brgyud pa dang bcas pa yang rdzun du btang byung bas/ da brgyud pa yod med de tsam gye chog ni gyis/ blo gros can rnams kyis bsam na/ khyod kyi ha go143

gtam sngon chad mkhas pas ma thos pa/ /gtam de 'dra smra mkhan khyod min su/ /gtam de 'dra thos tshe mkhas grub kun/ /gtam smra ba bzhag nas cis mi bzhad/ /ces glu len par rigs so/ /yang dper na/ sman sna mang thun byas yod pa'i nang na/ rgyal byed tshal nas 'ong ba'i sman mang na/ de rgyal byed tshal nas yin/ dus kun 'di ltar nyos/ mi 'di 'dra brgyud nas 'ong / bshad kyang mi 'gal ba ltar/ paṇ+ḍi ta'i bstan bcos lam rim yin kyang / rgyal ba'i gsung rab kyi trīlung 'dren mang na/ rgyal ba'i gsung ra ba yin/ dus 'di 'dra ༄ zhig la gsungs zhes sngon gyi lo rgyus dang / mkhas grub 'di 'dra zhig la brgyud gsungs pa 'gal ba spu tsam med pas/rgyal ba'i gsung yin mkhas grub mang po brgyud 'ong smra ba 'bud ci dgos/ dper na sman brdung ba dang ma brdung ba don gye gcig kyang / sman pas brdung ba'i sman thun du byas pa de rgyal byed tshal nas brdung nas brgyud 'ong ba yin zer ci la dgos/ sman brdung ba dang ma brdung ba zhes ming gnyis btags pa 'gal ba med pa ltar rgyal ba'i gsungs rab dgongs 'grel gnyis don gyi gcig kyang / paṇ+ḍi ta'i rgyal ba'i dgongs pa ji bzhin bkral ba'i bstan bcos de rgyal ba'i 144

gsung yin rgyal ba nas brgyud ga la zer dgos/ mdo bstan bcos zhes ming gnyis so sor btags pa 'gal ba med pas/mdo bstan bcos zhes ming gnyis btags pa gcig dgos pa dang / klu sgrub thogs med sogs kyis bstan bcos mdzad pa po khong gnyis min/ rdzun yin zhes khas len dgos pa'i khyab pa ci yod/ dper na rgyal po zhig gi gsung ji bzhin pa bran g.yog zhig gis bsgrags kyang / rgan po thams cad kyis de rgyal po'i tshig red/ blon 'bangs brgyud nas go ba red/ ces khas len pa ltar/ da khyod kyi/ sa kyang rgyal ba'i gsung rab kyi dgongs don ji bzhin pa'i legs bshad/ byang chub lam rim lta bu zhig rtsom nus na rgyal ba'i gsung red/ rgyal ba nas mkhas grub brgyud nas 'ong ba red/ ces dbu ma sang gis kyang khas len/ yang lam rim gyi mdzad pa po jo bo 'es zhal 'phangs mdzad nas/ jo bo rje'i bsngags brjod du gsungs pa de la dgongs gzhi che/ de skad gsungs na chos khungs btsun par 'gyur ba'i phyir yin pas 'gal ba med/ khong jo bo rje dngos yin zhing / lam rim kyang jo bos mdzad pa'i lam sgon tshur lung du drangs gzhung shing lta bur byas/ mdo rgyud man ngag gis brgyan nas je gsal du btang ba ma gtogs don gyi gcig 145

yin pas/ khong rnam gnyis kyi su'i gsung yin zhes bshad kyang 'gal ba med par ma zad/ shugs kyis khong yang jo bo rje'i sprul pa yin par zhal gyis bzhes/ byang chub lam rim khungs shin tu btsun par byas pa blo gros can rnams kyis bsam na/rje bla mar dad gus khyad par can snye ba'i rgyu zhig 'di na snang /gzhan yang nyams mgur las/ gzhung bzang stong gi chu bo 'du ba'i phyir/ /dpal ldan legs par bshad pa'i rgya mtsho'ang yin/ /gsungs pa ltar/ spyir byang chub lam gyi rim pa rgyal ba'i gsung rab mdo rgyud bstan bcos thams cad 'dus pas/mdzad pa po rje rnam gnyis yin zhes brjod pa mi 'gal bar ma zad/ yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas nas bzung /sngon byon rgya bod kyi mkhas grub thams cad kyis mdzad pa yin zhes brjod kyang don gyi 'gal ba med/ des na lam rim gyi mgo na jo bos mdzad gsungs/ mjug na khong gis mdzad gsungs pa/gang yin kyang 'bud ci la dgos/ khyod kyis jo bo rje dang rje rnam gnyis kyi dgongs don ji bzhin pa'i legs bshad brtsams nas/ jo bo rje dang rje rin po ches gsungs zhes brjod na don gyi 'gal ba med pas ches legs te/ chu dang 'o ma bsres pa bzhin yin ni brgya'i nang du min ni stong bsres/146

legs bshad nyes bshad kyis brdzad pa'i sngon med lam rim zhig brtsams nas/ 'di'i mdzad pa po rje rin po che yin zhes khye'i ming la seṅge mi 'byor ba ni rab 'byor btags na chog par sems pa mkhas pa'i bzhad gad kyi gnas yin pas gzhan ma sems/ da ngas bsam na khyod kyi skad gseng mthon pos de yin na gcig mar bud tsho zer/ smyo gtam kyang lab tshul 'di tsho bltas na/ khyed sang gi snying khams shig ma bde ba e yin/sems rnal du phob/ bsam blo zhib tu thongs la/ phyin chad 'di 'dra'i smra ba'i rigs bcad na legs ste/ rje btsun bsod nams seng ges/ rang phyogs skyong zhing gzhan phyogs dgag pa'i rgyu/ /sgo gleng chos kyi gad bdar yin mod kyang / /de la brten nas nyon mongs skye ba'i rgyu/ /smra bcad byed pa kho bo'i snying gtam yin/ /gsungs/ /yang 'ga' res rnying ma ba 'dis/ gter ston chung nas bzhag pa'i skra rnying tshe dud par song nas/ rnying dris mi tshad dud dri chang gi 'gro ba mang pos/deng sang sa 'og rdo 'og nas ser por 'gro rag bar du bzhag pa'i chos rnying ba bton nas gter gsar zer/ brlan dri ma yal ba mkha' 'gro'i kha rlangs ma yal ba'i zab chos tsho zer/blun po'i mgo bskor ba 'di ya mtshan/ 'di la brgyud pa'i 147

khungs shig 'jog na/ sa zad gi rnga ma rdo thug zer ba ltar/brgyud pa'i thugs po phar 'ded rgyu yin na/ sa'am rdo zhig red/ ha ha khams che sa snang / 'di tsho'i 'di'i brgyud pa gang yin zer ram/ gcig 'dri rgyu yod gi zer na/ 'o de khyod bden 'dri rgyu yod na de la bshad rgyu yang yod pas/ khyod gzhung lugs la sbyangs sbyangs pa'i mkhas pa zhig gis glen gtam smras ha ha tsho zer glen dgod byas/ blun po'i lad mo byed par mi rigs ste/ sde gzhan tsho'i go na ngo re tsha/kha rog par nyon dang / ngas dpe bzhag nas shes tshod cig bshad kyis/dper na 'brog pa'i bud med mdzangs ma zhig gis mdzo 'bri brgya stong gi 'o ma rnams bzhos sgogs nas mar blangs nas/ de la 'khod pa'i nye 'khor rnams la yang byin/ phyi 'dangs brgyab nas mar de kun chud zos su mi 'gro ba'i phyir snod du bcug nas mdzod du sbas/ phyis dgos dus su mo rang ngam yang na mar yod pa cha rgyus che ba'i nye 'khor gyi mi zhig gis blangs nas/dgos don sgrub pa ltar/ slob dpon chen po pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis gdul bya blo dman le lo can la phan pa'i slad du/ gsang sngags kyi chos thams cad kyi snying bo phyogs gcig tu bsdus pa'i gdams pa mkha' 'gro ye shes 'tsho rgyal rlangs chen dpal 148

gye seng ge sogs las can dag pa'i 'khor rnams la bstan/ phyi rabs gdul bya'i don du gdams pa bzang po chud zos su mi 'gro ba'i phyir/ rin chen gter gyi sgom bur bcug nas ri brag sogs la sbas/ phyis gdul bya'i dus la bab tshe khong gi sprul pa'i gter ston nam/ mtsho rgyal/ dpal seng sogs rje 'bangs nyer lnga'i sprul pa'i gter ston 'khrul med kyis blangs tshe/ sprul pa'i gter ston chen po de la slob dpon rin po che dngos sam nyams gang rung la gter chos de'i dbang lung khrid dang bcas pa gnang ba'i byin rlabs kyi drod ma yal ba/ de skal bzang gi gdul bya la spel ba yin la/ o rgyan rin po che spyir sangs rgyas thams cad kyi thugs sprul yin pas/ chos dang brgyud pa thams cad 'dus yod/ 'on kyang gdul bya'i snang ngor 'og min man chad kyi zhing khams thams cad du dzu 'phrul gyis byon nas/dpal kun tu bzang po man chad kyi sangs rgyas dang / byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi gsung gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa'i chos thams cad kyi dbang lung khrid gsum gsan pa'i tshul gnang / rgya gar dur khrod brgyad sogs su bka' brgyud sgrub pa mdzad/ dngos grub brgyad thob gu ru mtshan brgyad du grags/bod du rgyal po khri srong gi sku bsod kyis spyan 'drongs/ rje 149

'bangs nyer lnga sogs skal bzang gi gdul bya la gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa'i chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba yin pas/ 'di las chos dang brgyud pa khungs btsun pa zhig gzhan su la med ces skad gseng mthon pos bsgrags nas ngom chog pa'i tshod yin/khyod kyis rnying ma'i gter chos 'di'i brgyud pa phar ded na sa'am rdo red tsho zhes ha ha zer ba de/ dper na ded dpon zhig gis rgya mtsho'i gling gi rin po che khyer 'ong nas/ rdo shing gi snod lta bu zhig tu sbas nas snod mdzod du bzhag yod pa/ phyis ded dpon de'am nye 'khor zhig gis bton dus/ glen pa'am byis pa ci yang mi shes pa zhig gis rin bo che rnams/ dang po 'ong ba'i khungs rdo shing ka red snyam kha nas tshig de skad bton pa dang 'dra bas/ de 'dra'i gtam blun po la smras na ci shes/mkhas pa'i drung du smras na bzhad gad kyi gnas yin pas gzhan ma sems/ slob dpon pad+mas mdzad pa'i gsang sngags kyi bcud lta bu'i gter chos la brgyud pa med smras na/ khyod kyis nyams su mi lon rung blo gtod sa/ rje rin po ches mdzad pa'i mdo sngags kyi bcud lta bu'i byang chub lam rim la yang brgyud pa med ces/ khas rnying ma bas nga la bshad bshad cig ma byas pa tsam ma gtogs mkhas pas dpyod dang / don gyis skur ba 150

btab par 'gyur/ de yin na/ khyod sngar med pa'i mi brjod bdag brjod byed pa'i mkhas pa zhig gsar du byung ba yin pas khyod kyi ha go mi brjod bdag brjod mkhas pa zhig /mi khyod ma gtogs gzhan na gang / /mi rnams mkhas pa'i ngo la bltas/ /mi zad bzhad gad cis mi byed/ /ces glu len par rigs so/ /yang 'ga' res kho a dur gi mkhas pa a dzi 'jigs pa sus mdun nas kha grags mi thub pa zhig bca' snyam nas/ spyir gter zer ba zhig gtan nas med/ rnying ma sang 'di pas rdza ba dzu be byas gter zer ni zhig 'thon gi de 'don tshad nyams su len tshad thams cad sa 'og rdo 'og gi sdom sdig sogs 'bu srin mi sdug par skye/ 'don mi rung tsho zer ba de la phan pa'i dgongs gzhi che na ma gtogs/ gzhan rang dgar smras pa yin na mi de la sems med dam/ yang na sems mgo cig gis bkab/ rna ba 'on nam/ yang na kha cig gis bcad/ mig zhar ram/ yang na btsums nas bsdad pa zhig gis gtam yin te/ chos dang noms gter rgya bod kyi rgyal blon paṇa grub rnams kyis phar sbas pa dang / tshur blangs pa'i lo rgyus brgya dgos na stong dang / stong dgos na khri yod/ pad+ma bka' thang / thang yig sde lnga dang / mkhas grub du ma'i lung 151

bstan na/ ma 'ongs pa na yang gter 'don rgyu mtha' yas pa yod par gsungs/ 'di rnams ma shes ma go ma mthong na/ khyod la sems med 'on long mi zer na su la zer/ deng sang 'e tsho'i kyang rin chen sman sna bsdus nas gter bum pa sogs la mi 'jug gam/ de la yang gter gyi ming thogs pas/ gter zer ni zhig gtan nas 'jig rten na med zer ba'i gtam ngan de khyod ma gtogs gzhan su zhig gis smras/ gter sngar yod pa'e rtags su 'jig rten rgan rgon rnams kyi gtam dpe tsho yang / de mi mdzad pa'i gter ma red/ phar gter bzhin sbas/ tshur gter bzhin bton nas zhes gtam dpe ru mi bshad dam/ da gter zer ni zhig yod med/ gzhan la 'dri mi dgos/ khyod song la grong gi rgan rgon byis par dris dang bshad yong / yang kho bos noms gter med bshad ni min/ chos gter med ces bshad ni yin zer na/ a ho/ khyod ci'i glen pa zhig red/rgyal sras bcas kyis ngan skyugs ltar smad pa'i gnas/ nor rdzas kyi gter yod na/ rgyal bas yang yang bsngags pa'i gnas 'jig rten khams na yid bzhin nor las dkon pa'i dam pa'i chos kyi gter yod pa smos ci dgos/ gter la ngan pa sbed dam bzang po sbed bsam blo thongs gi thongs gi shod dang /152

gter chos spyad na 'bu srin gye sgye zhes rgyal ba'i gsung nas ma mthong / gtam ngan de 'dra smras na sa 'og rdo 'og gi sdig pa rwa co can tsho'i skye zhes rgyal ba'i gsung rab na mang po snang bas khyod kyis gzab 'tshal/ des na bla ma skyes bu dam pa rnams kyis de 'dra'i gtam 'dra smras byung yang dgongs gzhi yod/rang dgar smras don med/ dam pa de rnams kyi de dgongs pa gang yin cha med bzhin lad mo byas/ gcig gis gcig la brgyud pa med khungs mi dag tsho zer ba/ ri bong cal sgog gis bslus pa yin pas/ seṅge mchongs sar wa skyes lding ba bzhin rang gzhan bslu bar gdon mi za'o/ /yang 'ga' res ma cig lab sgon nas brgyud pa'i gcod kyi gdams pa zab mo 'di la yang brgyud pa skabs shig chad song / da brgyud pa med/khungs yang mi dag zer ba sogs byung / deng sang sems can bsod nams dman pa'i stabs kyis chos dang gang zag bzang bo thams cad la sgo skur 'debs mkhan mang bas/ blo gros can rnams kyis phyin chad de 'dra'i gtam la nam yang yid brtan mi bya'o/ /spyir chos khungs btsun pa'i phyir brgyud nga/ dgos mod/ 'on kyang dus gsum sangs rgyas kyi sprul pa mtshan ldan gyi bla ma zhig yin na/ don gyi brgyud pa yod par ma zad 153

nye ste/ sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i sku/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa'i ngo bo nyid/ /ces pa dang / bla ma med pa'i gong rol na/ /sangs rgyas bya ba'i ming yang med/ /ces dang / bla ma sangs rgyas yin pa ma shes par/ /brgyud pa nye ring byas pa mthol lo bshags/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /gzhan yang gnas lugs chos sku'i dgongs pa mngon du gyur pa'i bla ma'i thugs rgyud la/ rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma sogs 'khor 'das kyi chos thams cad rdzogs ste/ rin chen sems las phyir gyur pas/ /sangs rgyas med cing sems can med/ /ces pa dang / sems nyid gcig pu kun gyi sa bon ste/ /gang la srid dang mya ngan 'da' 'phro ba/ /ces pa dang / mkha' 'gro kun spyod las/ des na te ru ka dpal rgyud/ /sems rgyud dri med yin par bshad/ /ces pa la sogs lung mtha' yas/ des na rje rin po che dang / sngon byon gter ston sogs sangs rgyas dngos yin pas/ gang ltar na'ang brgyud pa yod pas/ rang la dad gus dag snang yod na rtsa brgyud bla ma'i byin rlabs 'jug par ma zad/ phyogs bcu dus gsum gye rgyal ba sras bcas kyi byen rlabs zhugs nas brgyud pa thams cad kyi bdag por 'gyur ba gdon mi za'o/ /dad gus med na brgyud pa gcig tu ma zad dgu brtsegs byas 154

yod kyang / rang rgyud la byin rlabs til 'bru tsam 'byung ba rgyal ba sras bcas kyis ma gsungs/ des na gang la sgro skur mi 'debs par thams cad gong du khur na legs te/ rje btsun bsod nams seng ges/ bla ma bka' brgyud grub mtha' la sogs pa/ /phyogs ris la 'dzin zhabs tog yin snyam yang / /bdag bstod gzhan smod chags sdang ngag gi rgyu/ /thams cad gong khur kho bo'i snying gtam yin/ /gsungs/ yang phyag rdzogs pa 'ga' res/ rje mi la sogs sngon byon dam pa 'ga' re'i gsung gi dgongs gzhi gang yin mi 'tshol/ tshig sgra ji bzhin par bzung / dgos pa mchod cig med bzhin glen gtam du dbu ma rtog ge ba 'di rnams kyis tshe gang bor 'gal 'brel rtsis nas rtsod pa rkyang byas pas/ chos la log lta yid gnyis je tshom skye ba ma gtogs/ don gi ci yang mi snang ste/zhang g.yu brag 'gro mgon gyes/ rtog spyod 'khrul ba'i yal ga yin/ /kha bshad tshig gi lo ma yin/ /rtog ges ma brtags dgu brtags kyang / /zhen nga/sa 'ching las grol mi srid/ /zhes dang /rje mi las/ tha snyad mkhan gyi ston chen rnams/ /tshig la mkhas te don la brtul/ /gsungs/ bka' thang las/ /tshig la mkhas pa mkhas pa ma yin te/ /mi g.yo don la mkhas na mkhas pa 155

yin/ /gsungs/ gshed dmar gyi rgyud las/ rtog cing dpyod pa'i rtog ge ba/ /de la sbyor ba'i dngos grub ring / /gsungs/sgom thun tsam ma byas par/ mi tshe bzang bo don med cig gi ngang du zad nas shi 'gro ba 'di rnams snying rje bya ba de'i btsog ang / don go ci byung tsho zer/ go log gi snying rje byed pa de/dbu ma'i chos la rgyus che ba'i phyag rdzogs dbu gsum sogs kyi mkhas grub kyi snyan gyis gsan ma thag nas/ shed gi bzhad rgyu zhig kyang 'ong ba'i 'phro lu rgyu zhig 'ong ba'i rgyu zhig yin par gda'/ dbu ma rtog ge ba las ngan cha bos mi tshe bzang po sdug gzan byas ni red/ khyod kyis 'dod yon dug chu lta bu la bag med du spyod zhor la/ 'dre 'dul grong chog sogs byas/ mi tshe gang bo skyid la zad gi yod pa de su la bshad/ gzhan sde dbu ma ba a ma'i bu rgod sang gis/ dper na rta gsar ba shed can 'ga' res rtswa bzang bo gcod ldad mid gsum dus gcig la byed pa ltar/ thos bsam sgom gsum thams cad stan thog gcig nas byas/ snyigs dus kyi tshe thung re re la kun mkhyen sangs rgyas dang mnyam par byas/ bshad sgrub kyi bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan sred pa'i rtse mo'i bar du bsgrengs nas/ mthar ngo mtshar ba'i ltas bzang bo dang bcas bde ba can dang dga' 156

ldan sogs dag pa'i zhing khams nyams dga' ba gzhan la bu pha khyem dang bu mo ma khyem du 'gro ba las kyang spro bzhin gshegs 'gro ba'i las la khyod gcig 'gyod no bzang / gsar ma khrel med red/ phyi nas yod pa thams cad dga' ba ma gtogs 'gyod pa spu tsam yang mi byed par 'dug khyod kyi go bcad g.yang rgan po bzang / yang gsar ma ba 'ga' res/ dpal ldan sa skya pa sogs dam pa gong ma 'ga' res gsung gi dgongs pa ma lon/ dgos pa mchod cig med bzhin du glen gtam du/ phyag rdzogs pa blun po 'di rnams kyis tshe gang bo la 'dod yon lnga dang khyad par bud med la dbyar gyi glang dang /ston gye khye bzhin bag med du byed/ zhi gnas kyi gsal cha tsam zhig la lhag mthong du 'khrul nas sems bzung bzung nas dud 'gro'i rgyu sgrub pa tsho snying rje/ rje sa skya'i legs bshad las/bsgom na thos pa mi dgos zhes/ /blun po thos rgya chung rnams smras/ /thos pa med par bsgom pa tsam/ /'bad kyang dud 'gro'i sgrub thabs yin/ /zhes pa dang / sdom gsum rab dbye las/ blun po phyag rgya che bsgom pa/ /phal cher dud 'gro'i rgyu ru gda'/ /gsungs/ 'bar ra bas/ gnas lugs sgro 'dogs ma chod na/ /thos chung glen bsgom dud 'gro'i rgyu/ /chos lam du 157

'gro ba shin tu dka'/ /sgro 'dogs chod na chos pa yin/ /gsungs pa dang / mu tig phreng ba las/ blo gros med la thos med ma thos pa'ang bsam pa med/ /gnyis bral rnal 'byor med cing rnal 'byor med la dngos grub med/ /gsungs/ so sor thar ba'i mdo las/ byang chub tu sems bskyed nas thos pa mang po la mi brtson pa gang yin pa de ni/ bdud sdig can gyis byen gyes brlabs pa nyid yin no/ /gsungs/ thos bsam spu tsam ma byas par shi 'gro ba'i bya ba des btsog ang / sdig pa'i bshes gnyen dang 'phrad na de 'dra 'byung rgyu red/ de 'drar ma skyes pas skyid la mi skye ba'i smon lam thob ang zer/gcig 'khun nas 'dug pa/ phyag rdzogs pa'i chos la rgyus yod pa dbu rdzogs phyag gsum gyi mkhas grub rnams kyis mthong thos na/ dgod rgyu lu rgyu brtseg gi brtseg gi 'ong ba'i rgyu zhig yin par gda'/ phyag rdzogs pa'i blun po rnams kyis 'dod yon la bag med du spyad nas/ mi tshe don med du zad par ma zad/ da dung de'i steng du phal cher gyis dud 'gro'i rgyu bsgrub ni red/khyod 'dod yon dkor nag dug chu'i 'dam rdzab tu lhung nas ske tsho thung tsog ge bsdad/ chags sdang gi mig hrig hrig dgra gnyen la bltas/ mi tshe skyid la zad/ bde 'gro'i rgyu bsgrub 158

gi yod pa de su la bshad/ gzhan sde phyag rdzogs pa a ma'i bu rgod sang gis/ tshe 'di thed lwa bor/ mtshan ldan bla ma bsten/mdo sngags zab chos zhus/ bskyed rim gyes tha mal snang zhen bcad/ gang snang lha skur bsgyur/ rdzogs rim gyis dbu ma'i rtsa mdud grol/ 'od gsal nyams su myong / 'dod yon rgyan du rol bzhin/ nyin re re la ting nge 'dzin gye sgo 'phar brgya phrag phyes/ ngo mtshar ba'i ltad mo dpag med la nyin mtshan 'khor mo yug tu ngoms med bltas/ mthong thos dran reg gi gdul bya skal bzang bye ba ther 'bum smin grol gyi lam la bkod pa'i mthar/ ngo mtshar phul du byung ba'i ltas dang cho 'phrul dpag med bcas 'ja' lus 'od skur grol ba'am/ yang na sku lus ma spangs par mkha' spyod du gshegs pa dang / yang na gzugs phung rnam snang gdul bya la dad rten du bzhag nas/ 'ja' 'od rol mo me tog gi char dang bcas 'og min mkha' spyod sogs zhing khams gzhan du gshegs nas/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing khams gcig nas gcig tu byon/ phyogs bcu'i zhing khams rab 'byams 'grims nas/ ngo mtshar ba'i ltad mo blta zhing /rigs kyi bdag po rnams kyi zhal mthong / gsung thos/ zab rgyas kyi chos gsan nas sangs rgyas thar/sa cad kyi sras kyi thu 159

bor gyur pa/ khyod kyis snying rje ba ya mtshan/ smon lam btab pa de yang khyod kyi thos bsam gnad la song ba'i lag rjes yin par snang / phyag rdzogs pa blun po rnams kyi rjes su yi rang ma gtogs/ snying rje zer mkhan dang smon lam de 'dra zhig 'debs mkhan gcig mi snang / khyod kyis go bcad/ drin can po bzang / ngo tsha rgyu su la yang med/ mi ngan kha nas gtam ngan zer ba ltar/deng sang gi mi ngan 'ga' res tshig ngan 'di 'dra smras pa mang / legs bshad las/ khwa tas mi gtsang zos pa'i mchu/ /sa gtsang dag la 'bad pas phyi/ /gsungs pa ltar/ rang gis log ltas mi gtsang zos nas sgo skur gyi mchu tshad ldan gye chos dang gang zag sa gtsang lta bu la phyis nas/ dad gus can gyi zhen pa ldog gi ma 'jug mi gtsang mkha' la gto ra gyur na/ /'thor mkhan po yi spyi bor 'bab/ /gsungs pa ltar/gzhan chos dang gang zag dri med nam mkha' lta bur sgo skur tshig ngan mi gtsang ba gtor na rang thog tu mi snyan gtam gyi mi gtsang ba'i char 'bebs nges/ gzhan la blta ba'i mig yod kyang / /rang la blta na me long dgos/ /gsungs pa ltar/gzhan chos dang gang zag gi skyon yon la blta ba'i shes rab kyi mig yod kyang / rang gi skyon yon la blta na rgyal ba'i gsung 160

rab mdo rgyud bstan bcos kyi me long 'di la ltos/rje skal ldan rgya mtshos/ gzhan skyon ma 'tshol rang gi skyon la ltos/ /skyon mtshang rang la yod do ri khrod pa/ /gsungs pa ltar/ /rang la bltas na yon tan thams cad kyi rtsa ba dad gus dag snang sdom gsum sogs yon tan sna re yang med/ phyogs ris chags sdang nga rgyal phrag dog 'jig rten chos brgyad kyi snang shes sogs skyon mtshang che/ des na blo gros can rnams kyis phyin chad/ dus gsum rgyal ba sras bcas kyi thugs kyis khrel zhing / chos rgyus che ba'i bla ma mkhas pa rnams kyi bzhad gad kyi gnas/ rang thog tu mi snyan gtam ngan gyi sna 'dren pa'i rgyu/ skur 'debs kyi tshig ngan 'di 'dra khog tu shar yang kha sgo nas phar ma 'don dang bzang / yang 'ga' res phyag rdzogs pa 'dis skabs re/ 'khor ba'i chos yod do cog grol byed kyi rgyu yin/ rnam rtog ci tsam mang yang chos sku'i grogs yin tsho zer/ dga' bzhin/ 'khor bar gnas kyang nyam nga med/ /'khor ba byang chub lam du bde/ /rnam rtog ngo bo chos dbyings yin/ /byung na dga' ste bsgul 'debs bzang / /zhes skyid glu blangs/ yang skabs re 'khor ba sdug bsngal rgya mtsho thar ba'i gegs/ bzang ngan gye rnam rtog 'di 'khor bar sgyur mkhan gye dgra yin zer/ hwa shang gi tshig 161

ngan de yang kha nang du 'phred gi bzung skyo bzhin du/ 'khor ba'i gnas na bde ba med/ /sdug bsngal chu bo'i gnyer ma 'dra/ /rnam rtog ma rig chen po ste/ /'khor ba'i rgya mtshor ltung byed yin/ /zhes skyo glu blangs/ nges 'jog med par spyon pas bshad bshad byas/ gang la nyan rgyu mi shes par 'dug khyed phyag rdzogs pa'i snying khams 'dra ma bde ba yin nam/ sems rnal du phob la lan thongs shog zer na/ ya legs so/ /khyed dbu ma ba sang gis phyag rdzogs pa'i smyon pa cha bo ma bsdigs snying rje/ khyed sang byams snying rje byang chub kyi sems ma bor sbyangs sbyangs yod pa/skad gseng mthon po byas shed gis ma bsdigs/ rgyal sras byang chub sems dpa' tshos go song na ngo re tsha/ smyon pa yin no khyod bden te/ rje mi las/ pha smyo bu smyo brgyud pa smyo/ /brgyud pa rdo rje 'chang chen smyo/ /yang mes tai lo shes bzang spyo/ /mes po nā ro paṇa chen spyo/ /pha rgan mar pa lo tsā smyo/ /nga rang mi la ras pa smyo/ /gsungs/ smyo tshul mi 'dra ste/ bla ma gcig gis/ nga smyo ba chos kyi dbyengs su smyo/ /khyod smyo ba 'khor ba'i 'dam du spyo/ /gsungs/ ngas bltas na khyed sang la yang smyo zhad cig 'dugaskad gseng mtho gi spyo lugs gang yin mi shes par gda'/'on kyang khyed sang ma smyos pa gyis/ shes bzhin phyag rdzogs pa'i 162

sbyon pa tsho'i kha klong ni los yin/de la lan smyon pa tshos 'di skad zer/ 'khor ba'i chos rnams grol byed kyi rgyu/ rnam rtog chos sku'i grogs yin zer ba ni/ dper na rdzas sngags sman sogs yod na dug thams cad phung bo gso ba'i zas su 'gyur ba dang / gser 'gyur gyi rtsi yod na lcags rnams rin thang che ba'i gser du 'gyur ba ltar/ byams snying rje byang chub kyi sems/'khor ba dang rnam rtog gzhi med stong pa nyid dang / ma dag snod bcud dag pa'i 'khor lor bsgyur ba'i bsgyed rdzogs rdzogs chen sogs kyi gdams pa yod cing nyams su len pa rnams phung khams sgye mched/ 'dod yon lnga la sogs grol byed kyi rgyu yin zhes smras pa yin la/ dper na rdzas sngags sman dang gser 'gyur med pa ltar/ sngar bshad pa lta bu'i gdams pa zab mo dang mi ldan pa la/ 'khor ba sdug bsngal bzang ngan gye rnam rtog kyis las bzang ngan bsags nas 'khor ba mtho dman du 'khor bas/ thar ba'i gegs yin zhes bshad pa yin pas sems rnal du ci la 'bebs dgos/ de la sems rnal du 'bebs dgos na/ khyed dbu ma sang gis yang bsgyed rdzogs kyi skabs su/ bud med byang chub kyi grogs yin tshul brjod/ spro bzhin/sgyu ma dag ni thams cad las/ /bud med sgyu ma khyad par 163

'phags/ /pad+mar rdo rje rab bcug la/ /gyen du byang sems rgyun du 'bab/ /zer/ yang 'dul ba'i skabs su/ bud med byang chub thob pa'i gegs yin tshul brjod/'jigs bzhin/ 'jig rten 'di dang pha rol du/ /'jigs byed nang na bud med 'jigs/ /dug sbrul shin tu khro ba ltar/ /mkhas pas de ni rnam par spangs/ /zhes 'di 'dra'i 'gal gtam khyed sang gis yang mi byed dam/ 'di 'dra rgyal ba'i gsung rab dgongs 'grel na mang bas/ khyed sang gis kyang sems rnal du phob/ ma rnams tsho yang khyed sang gis rnal du phob zhus dang / phyag rdzogs pa smyo ba tsho rnal du 'bebs dgos na ci'i phyir mi 'bebs 'bebs nges/ da ngas bsam na 'gal 'brel brtsi mi rung / gdul bya sems can ni nam mkha'i mtha' mnyam// dbang bo rab 'bring tha gsum ni mtha' yas/ rgyal ba'i gsung rab mkha' ltar rgya che/rtsi shing ltar grangs mang bas/ mkhas pa zhig gis mi 'ga' zhig la ya/nga / 'gal ba phud nus/ 'gal ba zhig kyang mi 'gal bar byed nus ste/ sngon gye gsar ma'i bla ma zhed po tsho'i gsung gi legs bshad 'di bden snyam pa la/ phyag rdzogs kyi lam mkhas pa rnams kyis rgyal ba'i gsung rab dgongs 'grel dang 'gal yod dam/ 'grel yod dpyad nas 'gal ba du ma 164

phud tshul la bltas na de bden gi snyam/ de la slar yang gsar ma'i lung rig la sbyangs pa'i mkhas pa rnams kyis khyod 'khrul 'dug 'di yin tshul zhes 'gal 'brel mang bo bzhag pa la bltas na de yang bden gi snyam/ de bzhin du gsar ma'i bla ma 'ga' res phyag rdzogs pa'i bla ma mkhas pa'i gsung gi 'gal 'brel brtsis nas 'gal ba'i khur chen btegs pa de yang bden gi snyam/ de la slar yang phyag rdzogs pa'i mkhas pas/ lan btab tshul la bltas na de yang bden gi snyam pa mang bas/'gal mi 'gal de gsung rab la rag ma las/ rang gi blo gros kyi mthu che chung la rag las 'dug des na rang gi rtog ngan sa rdul mi gtsang ba re rgyal ba'i gsung rab dgongs 'grel 'dzam bu chu bo'i gser bzang bo tsho'i steng du bkab nas/ 'di rnam dag ma 'dod ces rgyal ba'i gsung rab gser sbyangs btso ma nam yang ma smod dang bzang / yang 'ga' res/ rgyal ba'i gsung rab dgongs 'grel tshad ldan thams cad na/ 'khor ba thog ma med ces thag bcad nas yang yang gsungs pa la/rdzogs chen na thog ma zhig bzhag yod pa 'di gnyis 'gal ba che ba ci yin zer na/ 'o de thun mong ma yin pa'i lam rdzogs chen gye bzhed srol zhig yin par gda'/ thun mong 165

gi bzhed tshul dang mi mthun yang / de'i dgongs pa lon na/don gyi 'gal ba med/ de ltar tshig gi ngos nas mi mthun pa 'gal ba ltar snang ba/ rgyal ba'i gsung rab dgongs 'brel mkhas grub kyi gsung rgyun na mang ste/sangs rgyas kyi zhal nas/ nga ni bskal pa dpag tu med pa'i yang ches dpag tu med pa'i sngon rol nas sangs rgyas zin pa gcig yin gsungs/ rgyud las/ 'og min stug po bkod dga' bar/ /yang dag sangs rgyas der sangs rgyas/ /sgrub pa bo gcig 'dir sangs rgyas/ /gsungs/ sang shis snang ba rgyan gyi mdo las/ de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams ni/ mngon par rdzogs par sangs ma rgyas/ sangs mi rgya/ mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgya bar mi 'gyur ro/ /gsungs/ bsngags 'os bsngags bstod las/ khyod kyis gang las 'gro ba dang / /ma drangs rgud pa de gang mchis/ /gang dang 'jig rten ma sprad pa'i/ /phun tshogs de yang gang zhig mchis/ /zhes dang / mdo las/ thub rnams sdig pa chu yis mi 'khru zhing / /'gro ba'i sdug bsngal phyag gis mi sel la/ /nyid kyi rtog pa gzhan la 'pho mi nus/ /gsungs/ ting 'dzin rgyal po las/ zla ba skar ma bcas pa gnas lhung zhing / /ri dang grong 166

du bcas pa'i sa zhig la/ /nam mkha'i khams ni rnam pa gzhan gyur kyang / /khyod ni mi bden pa yi tshig mi gsungs/ /zhes dang / lha'i bu blo gros rab gnas kyis zhus pa'i mdo las/lha'i bu chos thams cad ni rdzun pa sgyu ma lta bu'o/ /nga yang de bzhin du ston par byed/ des na nga ni rdzun du smra ba'o/ /gsungs/ yum las/ rgyal ba 'das dang ma 'ongs da lta gang bzhugs pa/ /kun lam pha rol phyin pa 'di yin gzhan ma yin/ /zhes dang / rje btsun dus 'khor zhabs kyis/ dus kyi 'khor lo zhes pa 'di ma shes na/ chos gang dang gang gis kyang sangs rgyas mi srid gsungs/ ting 'dzin rgyal po las/ lus dang ngag dang yid rab dwangs pa yis/ /rtag tu sangs rgyas dag gi bsngags pa brjod/ /de ltar yang ni sems kyi rgyun bsgoms pas/ /nyin mtshan du yang 'jig rten mgon po mthong / /zhes dang / sum brgya ba las/ gang gis nga la gzugs su mthong/ /gang gis nga la sgrar shes pa/ /log pa'i lam du zhugs pa de/ /skye bo de yis nga ma mthong / /gsungs/ rje nā ro pas/ bla ma med pa'i gong rol na/ /sangs rgyas bya ba'i ming yang med/ /ces dang / sangs rgyas lag 'chang las/ bla ma med pa'i gong rol na/ /sangs rgyas kun tu bzang po yod/ /gsungs/ slob dpon 167

klu sgrub kyis/ sgyu ma dag ni thams cad las/ /bud med sgyu ma khyad par 'phags/ /ye shes gsum gyi dbye ba yi/ /gsal ba de la mtshon pa'o/ /zhes dang / bud med chags pa phal cher ni/ /bud med gzugs gtsang sems las byung / /bud med gzugs la don du ni/ /gtsang ba cung zad yod ma yin/ /gsungs/ kye rdor las/ dbang bo gnyis ni mnyam sbyar bas/ /sangs rgyas byang chub thob par 'gyur/ /zhes dang / rgyud chen dgyes pa rdo rje las/ 'dod la chags par 'gyur ba dang / /bud med dbang phyug shin tu sbyor/ /zhes dang / slob dpon bai ro tsa nas/ bud med bya ba las kyi srin mo yin/ /sems can gang gis 'khor yang la 'ur 'chi/ /zhes dang / dran pa nyer bzhag las/ gal te bde ba mchog 'dod na/ /de ltar bud med rnam par sgongs/ /gsungs/ jo bo rje'i zhal nas/'dod pa'i gzhi la chags pa'i rgyus/ /sgrub pa'i spyod las nyams pa'i mi 'jig rten 'das dang 'jig rten gyi/ /phun sum tshogs pa thams cad las/ /shin tu ring ba kho nar 'gyur/ /'khor ba'i btson ra nyam nga ru/ /nyon mongs 'ching ba sna tshogs kyis/ /rab tu bsdams pas nyam thag cing / /'khor ba'i sdug bsngal dpag med kyis/ /de yi rgyud gdungs mi bder 'gyur/ /zhes dang /168

dran pa nyer bzhag las/ ri mor bris pa'i bud med la'ang / /mig gis blta bar mi byed do/ /zhes dang / dus 'khor rtsa brgyud las/ chags bral las ni sdug bsngal 'byung / /sdug bsngal las ni skyes bu'i khams/ /zad las 'chi ba zhes su brjod/ /shi las de nas slar yang srid/ /srid pa las ni slar 'chi 'pho/ /zhes dang / rnal 'byor bla med rgyud chen las/ slob dpon smad par mi bya ste/ /bud med sangs rgyas spangs mi rung / /gsungs/ mdo las/ sdig pa ci yang mi bya zhing / /dge ba phun sum tshogs par spyad/ /rang gi sems ni yongs su 'dul/ /'di ni sangs rgyas bstan pa yin/ /zhes dang / lung gzhan las/ de nyid rig pa'i rnal 'byor pas/ /mi bya ba ni cung zad med/ /de nyid shes nas de nas ni/ /dpa' bo 'dod pa lnga la spyod/ /gsungs/ mdo las/ chos rnams thams cad rgyu las byung / /de rgyu de bzhin gshegs pa'i gsungs/ /zhes dang /pad+ma sam bha was/ rdo rje tshig drug ma shes na/ /rgyu la 'bad pas 'bras mi 'byung / /gsungs/ rje ral ba chen po'i zhal nas/rgyu la ma brten gye 'bras bu dka'/ /brlan la ma brten gyi me tog dka'/ /zhes dang / rje te lo pas/ rgyu las ma byung 'bras bu ni/ /med ces thub pas mdo ru gsungs/ /rgyu med 169

'bras bu dag pa ni/ /khyod kyi yul min bden pa'i dka'/ /gsungs/ zhang g.yu brag mgon rin po che'i zhal nas/rgyu dang 'bras bu dus mtshungs shing / /mtshan ma rang sar 'gro ba yin/ /zhes dang / slob dpon zhi ba lha'i zhal nas/ gal te rgyu la 'bras gnas na/ /zan za mi gtsang za bar thal ras kyi rin gyis ras bal gyi/ /sa bon nyos la bgo bar gyis/ /gsungs/ shes rab snying bo las/ phung bo lnga bo de dag la yang rang bzhin gyes stong pa rnam par yang dag par rjes su blta'o/ /zhes dang / saspu ṭa las/ stong dang mi stong 'dzin pa las/ /tha mal pa yi rnam rtog skye/ /stong pa zhes bya rnam rtog ste/ /des na de nyid spang bar bya/ /gsungs/ ting 'dzin rgyal po las/ so sor de brtag gal te bsgom byed pa/ /de ni mya ngan 'das thob 'bras bu'i rgyu/ /zhes dang / tshangs pas zhus pa las/dpyod pa ji snyed pa de thams cad ni rtog pa'o/ /yongs su mi rtog pa ni byang chub gsungs/ 'bar ra bas/ dang po lta ba'i phu thag bcad/ /lta ba mtha' bral 'di la byas/ /zhes dang /thal 'gyur las/ lta ba'i ngo bo mthong ba la/ /yid dpyod tshig gi 'gyu ba med/ /gsungs/ rje skal ldan rgya mtshos/ don de phyir ston pa sangs rgyas kyis/ /chos lta ba'i sgo mo mtha' yas 170

gsungs/ /zhes dang / sa skya paṇa chen gyis/ pha rol phyin pa'i lta ba las/ /lhag pa'i lta ba yod na ni/ /lta de spros pa can du 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs/ slob dpon zhi ba lhas/ don dam blo yi spyod yul min/ /blo ni kun rdzob yin par 'dod/ /ces dang /'phags pa sgra gcan 'dzin gyes yum la bstod pa las/ smra bsam brjod med shes rab pha rol phyin/ /ma skyes mi 'gags nam mkha'i ngo bo nyid/ /so sor rang rig ye shes spyod yul pa/ /gsungs/ sam+bu ṭa las/ rnam rtog ma rig chen po ste/ /'khor ba'i rgya mtsho ltung byed yin/ /zhes dang / slob dpon mda' bsnun gyes/ rnam rtog ye shes chen po ste/ /'khor ba'i rgya mtsho skem byed yin/ /gsungs/ klong chen pas/ 'khor ba'i gnas na bde ba med/ /sdug bsngal chu bo'i gnyer ma 'dra/ /zhes dang /ras chung pas/ 'khor bar 'khyams kyang nyam nga med/ /'khor ba byang chub lam du bde/ /gsungs/ sgom rim las/de kho na nyid la dpyod pa gang yin pa de ni lhag mthong yin gsungs /lung gzhan las/ bla ma dam pas dpyad pa med/ /gsungs/birlu bas/ sangs rgyas mchod sogs rnams la don mi 'byung / /'dod dang rtsol ba yod na sangs mi rgya/ /zhes dang / dkon mchog brtsegs pa las/ chos rnam thams cad rkyen bzhin du/ /171

'dun pa'i rtsa la rab tu gnas/ /gang gi smon lam ci btab pa/ /de 'dra'i 'bras bu smin par 'gyur/ /gsungs/ gso sbyong las/ deng nas srog gcod mi bya zhing / /ma byen par yang blangs mi bya/ /'khrigs pa'i chos kyang mi spyad cing / /dzun gyi tshig kyang mi smra 'o/ /zhes dang / kye rdor las/ /khyod kyis srog chags bsad par bya/ /('di ni nges par srog gcog sogs bgyis zhes pa ma red/)ma byin par yang blangs par bya/ /gzhan gyi bud med longs spyod cing / /dzun gye tshig kyang smra bar bya/ /gsungs/ gsang rgyud las/ ma dang bu mo sring mo la/ /'dod pa'i sems kyi spyad byas na/ /('di ni nges bar ma dang sring mo sogs la spyod gsungs pa ma red/)pad+ma rigs kyi zhing du skye/ /zhes dang / 'brom ston rin po ches/ nye du bdun rgyud tshun chad la mi tshangs pa spyod mi rung / spyad na ngan 'gror ltung gsungs/ gsang 'dus rgyud las/ rdo rje gsang chen 'di lta bu'i/ /sems can thams cad bsad na ni/ /mi bskyod sangs rgyas zhing dag tu/ /rgyal ba'i sras su skye bar 'gyur/ /zhes dang / mdo las/ sdig pa chung ngu byas pas kyang / /'jig rten pha rol 'jigs chen dang / /phung khrol chen po byed 'gyur te/ /khong bar song pa'i dug bzhin no/ /zhes gsungs/ 'od gsal gyi rgyud seṅge rtsal rdzogs las/ dkon 172

mchog gsum po rgyab phyogs na/ /('di yang nges par dkon mchog gsum po rgyab phyogs gsungs pa ma red/) zhing khams thams cad mthong bar 'gyur/ /zhes dang / pha dam pas/ blo snying brang gsum dkon mchog gsum la gtod/ /byin rlabs shugs la 'byung ngo ding ri ba/ /gsungs/ 'dul ba lung las/ pha ma la phan par bya yi/gnod pa ma byed cig gsungs/ ma skyes dgras pha bsad pa la/ pha dang ma ni bsad bya yin/ gsungs/ zla ba sgron me'i mdo las/ smad par bya ba'i khyem na gnas pa des/ /nam yang bla med byang chub mchog mi thob/ /ces dang / brtag gnyis las/'khor ba gzhan du spangs nas ni/ /mya ngan 'das pa rtogs mi 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs/ gsang ba'i sdom pa gsum bstan pa'i mdo las/ 'od srung gang bla na med pa'i byang chub don du gnyer ba de la ni/ byang chub kyi ci zhig bya ste/ de dag mi mtho ris kyi bde ba dang yang rings so/ /zhes dang / jo bos/ rdo rje gdan la bskor ba mdzad nas/ ji ltar byas na/ myur du rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thob snyam du dgongs pa na/ sku gzugs chung ba rnams bzhengs nas che ba la phyag byas/ myur du sangs rgyas par 'dod pas gang la bslab par bya zhes dris pa na/ byang chub kyi sems la bslab par bya'o/ /gsungs/ ye shes snang ba rgyan gye 173

mdo las/ gang yid la byed pa'i chos thams cad ni mi dge ba'o/ /gang yid la mi byed pa'i chos thams cad ni dge ba'o/ /zhes dang / kun bzang smon lam las/ cir yang dran med thom me ba/ /de ka ma rig 'khrul ba'i rgyu/ /gsungs/ bu mo zla ba mchog gis zhus pa las/ bdag gis sngon chad khyed rnams thams cad bsad/ /bdag kyang khyed kyis sngon chad gshag cing gtubs/ /kun kyang phan tshun dgra dang gsod pa yin/ /khyed chags ji ltar 'dod chags sems kyang skye/ /zhes dang / sku gsum don thig las/ 'gro ba drug gi sems can thams cad ni/ /bdag gi pha mar ma gyur gcig kyang med/ /pha ma 'di dag 'khor 'khyams snying re rje/ /gsungs/ mdo las/ sbyin sogs drug la mngon par zhen pa bdud kyi las so/ /zhes dang /rje rin po ches/ sbyin pa 'gro ba'i re skong yid bzhin nor/ /gsungs/ rgyal ba'i yum las/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis ni nyan thos kyi lam gang yin pa dang / rang sangs rgyas kyi lam gang yin pa dang / sangs rgyas kyi lam gang yin pa thams cad bsgyed par bya zhing / lam thams cad shes par bya'o/ /de dag kyang yongs su rdzogs par bya zhing / de dag gi lam gyi bya ba yang bya la/ zhes dang / lung las/ dmyal bar 'gro ba sangs 174

rgyas la/ /gtan gyi gegs byed ma yin te/ /rang sangs rgyas kyi sa rnams dang / /nyan thos sa yi gegs byed do/ /zhes dang /phar phyin bsdus pa las/ /'jig rten don sgrub tshul la mthu med pas/ /theg pa gnyis po gtan du spangs byas shing / /thub rgyal theg pa snying rje bstan pa la/ /gzhan phan ro gcig rang bzhin de dag 'jug /gsungs/ rje rin po ches/ dal ba'i rten 'di yid bzhin nor las lhag /'di 'dra rnyed pa da re tsam zhig yin/ /zhes dang / rje mi las/ phung bo mi gtsang rdzas kyi rgyal ba la/ /bzang 'dod byi dor byed pa shin tu glen/ /gsungs/ rje rgod tshang pas/ smad ra dang / mi snyan pa thams cad rang la mdzad gsungs/ legs grub las/ bdag la smad par mi bya zhing / /rang la mi dga' mi bya ste/ /gsungs/ jo bo rjes/ dang bo'i sangs rgyas rgyud chen las/ /'bad pas rab tu bkag pa'i phyir/ /gsang ba shes rab dbang bskur ba/ /tshangs par spyod pas blangs mi bya/ /gal te dbang bskur de 'dzin na/ /tshangs spyod dka' thub la gnas pas/ /dkag pa spyad par 'gyur ba'i phyir/ /dka' thub sdom pa de nyams te/ /brtul zhugs can de pham pa yi/ /ltung ba dag ni 'byung 'gyur zhing / /de ni ngan song de ltung bas/ /grub pa nam yang yod ma 175

yin/ /zhes dang / bla ma zhang gis/ gsang chen bla na med pa yi/ /dkyil 'khor cho ga thams cad las/ /dang po so sor thar ba dang / /theg chen sdom pa gnyis byen pas/ /de ma thag tu bum pa'i dbang / /de rjes gsang ba'i dbang bskur nas/ /yol ba sogs kyis dben byas te/ /las kyi phyag rgya der gtad nas/ /thabs kyis gdong ni g.yogs pa dang / /shes rab gdong yang g.yogs byas la/ /bo la ka ko la sbyar bas/ /gsum pa nyams su myong byas la/ /gong gi dka' thub sdom pa de/ /ma nyams steng du slar 'phel ba/ /mchog thob rnams la myong bas grub/ /gsungs/ o rgyan rin po ches/ pad 'byung srin po 'dul du 'gro ba la/ /mya ngan ma byed zhal gdams 'di nyid ni/ /nga nyid bzhugs dang khyad med sems la chongs/ /sngags pa 'phung byed rgyu ni chang nag yin/ /chang la 'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug dang / /nga rgyal phrag dog nyon mongs ma lus pa/ /slong ba'i rgyu kun 'di la tshang bas na/ /de phyir chang nag ma 'thung zhal gdams yin/ /zhes sogs nyes dmigs che tshul gye zhal gdams gsungs/ kun mkhyen klong chen rab 'byams pas/chang gi mes po drug pa rdo rje 'chang / /bla ma yid dam mkha' 'gro'i tshogs rnams mchod/ /skal bzang rnams kyi btung ba'i 176

mchog gyur pa'i/ /bdud rtsi chang gi yon tan bshad kyis nyon/ /yid 'ong mtho ris lha yi grong khyer las/ /bdud rtsi'i thigs pa mchog gcig lhung ba ni/ /'dzam gling skye bo yongs kyi bsod nams las/ /'bru rnams bcud chags chang gi dwangs mar gyur/ /kha dog ro ldan sbrang rtsi lta bu la/ /dri bsung phun tshogs lha yi 'dud rtsi bzhin/ /mthong na yid dga' bsten pas 'bral mi phod/ /zhim mngar chang gi yon tan phun sum tshogs/ /zhes sogs yon tan che tshul gye mgur bdud rtsi zil mngar ma zhes bya ba gsungs/ ra lo'i zhal nas/ sha chang za ba tshogs kyi 'khor lo yin/ /rig ma bsten pa las kyi phyag rgya yin/ /dgra bgegs sgrol ba sngags kyi dam tshig yin/ /gsungs/kha rag sgom chung pas/ shes pa 'phyo la lus la gnod/ /mkhas btsun rnams kyis smad pa'i gnas/ /nyes pa thams cad 'byung ba'i rgyu/ /chang dang bud med spongs shig ang / /gsungs/ rje mi las/ bsnyen sgrub tshad du skyol nas kyang / /snying rje chen pos kun bslangs nas/ /yi dam gsal ba'i ting 'dzin gyis/ /bstan pa'i spyi don ma lags pa'i/ /mthu dang ngan sngags ma byed ang / /las kyi srin por skye nyen gda'/ /zhes dang / yo rgyan rin po ches/ las su mthu sgrub bran du lha 'dre bskos/ /177

nor du rdzas sogs mtshon du klu gtad rgyob/ /lto ru dgra zo gos su sgrub khang gyon/ /grogs su ma mo mkha' 'gro dam can bos/ /mthu dang chos su ldan par 'gro don gyes/ /gsungs/ spyan mnga' pas/ 'jig rten pa dang 'jig rten 'das/ /yon tan ci snyed thams cad ni/ /mi rtog ma yengs pa yi su/ /bsam las 'byung ngo zhes gsungs shing / /sems ni mi rtog nyams bzhag na'ang / /yang dag ji bzhin shes 'gyur zhes/ /phan yon gzhan dang gzhan dag kyang / /dpag tu med pa mdo rgyud dang / /bstan bcos kun las gsal bar bshad/ /ces dang /ci yang mi rtog ting 'dzin la/ /mdo rgyud kun nas rab bsngags shing / /gangs can khrod kyi sgrub brgyud kyi/ /bshes gnyen kun gyes mgrin gcig tu/ /bstod cing nyams su blangs pa'i phyir/ /'di la 'bad pa bskyed cig ces/ /bdag ni gsol ba 'debs par byed/ /ces dang / yang / ci yang mi rtog 'ba' zhig la/ /sgo 'dogs sel bar nus pa yi/ /rnam dpyod shes rab med phyir dang / /gnyid 'thug dag dang khyad med cing / /nyon mongs spong ba mi nus par/ /mngon sum du ni mthong phyir dang / /zhes dang / ci yang yid la mi byed pa'i/ /hwa shang lta sgom mthar thug byed/ /de ltas phyogs rnams phal 178

cher khyad/ /rang nyid legs su 'dod pa yis/ /chos kyi rgyal po tsong kha pa'i/ /gzhung lugs legs par sbyangs byas na/ /gsungs/ rje rin po ches/ byang chub lam rim gyi mgo na/'di'i gzhung ni/ byang chub lam gyi sgon ma yin pas/ de mdzad pa po 'di'i yang mdzad pa pa'o/ /gsungs/ mjug na/'di ni mang du thos pa'i dge slong spong ba pa shar tsong kha pa blo bzang grags pa'i dpal gyis ri bo dge ldan du sbyar ba'o/ /gsungs/ jo bo rjes/ tshe 'di yun thung shes bya rnam pa mang/ /tshe yi tshad kyang ci tsam mi shes pas/ /ngang ba chu las 'o ma len pa ltar/ /rang gi 'dod pa dang du blangs par bgyi/ /zhes dang / rje btsun byams pas/ rig pa'i gnas lnga dag la mkhas par ma byas na/ /'phags mchog gis kyang thams cad mkhyen pa mi thob ste/ /de bas gzhan dag tshar bcad rjes su bzung phyir dang / /rang nyid kun shes bya phyir de la de brtson bya/ /gsungs/ mdo las/ zas ma mchis na srog ma mchis/srog ma mchis na chos kyang ma mchis so/ /gsungs/ spyan snga pas/ snying nas dam chos bya 'dod na/ /skyid 'dod tshe 'di blos thongs la/ /mi yi khyu nas ro ltar bud/ /za 'dod 'thung 'dod dug ltar spongs/ /gsungs/ rje mi las/ byang chub 179

bsgoms nas thob pa la/ /sgom chen slob gnyer byed pa phangs/ /gdams ngag snod bzang ldug rgyu la/ /skal med rnams la ster ba phangs/ /zhes dang / sa skya paṇa chen gyis/bsgom na thos pa mi dgos zhes/ /blun po blo rgya chung rnams smras/ /thos pa med par bsgom pa de/ /'bad kyang dud 'gro'i sgrub thabs yin/ /gsungs/ kha rag sgom chung pas/ /tshe la long med tha snyad thug pa med/ /de bas dam pa'i dgongs pa longs mdzod la/ /'du 'dzi spangs pas dpen gnas zhi ba brten/ /bse ru lta bur gcig pur gnas par bya/ /zhes dang / sa skya rin po ches/ rig pa nangs par 'chi yang slob/ /tshe 'dir mkhas par mi gyur kyang / /phyi ma'i dus na bcol ba yi/ /nor la rang nyid len pa 'dra/ /gsungs/ rje mi las/ grub mtha'i kha 'dzin chos la smod/ /thar ba'i 'ju thag chad pa yin/ /zhes dang / rtsa lhung 'grel ba las/'dul ba'i bsam pas/ gzhan grub mtha' smad pa ni/ nyes pa med de bsod nams kyang mang du 'phel lo gsungs/ dam pa 'ga' res/ bla ma bzang pos slob ma phan/ /slob ma bzang po bla ma'i rgyan/ /gsungs/ spyan snga pas/ slob ma gcig yod sdug bsngal du ma yod/ /slob ma brgya yod sdug bsngal brgya phrag 180

yod/ /gsungs/ /mdo las/ bzod pa dka' thub bzod pa dam pa ni/ /mya ngan 'das pa mchog ces sangs rgyas gsungs/ /gsang 'dus las/ dka' thub sdom pa mi zad pa/ /brten kyang 'grub par mi 'gyur ro/ /gsungs/ spyan snga pa rin po ches/ ja thud sha mar la sogs pa/ /bkra mi shis pa de dag gis/ /khyod la ltas ngan gtong 'gyur gyes/ /sprul dug de dag myur spong la/ /dpag tshad brgya yi pha rol song / /gsungs/ gzhan las/ dpon slob mi 'bral lhan cig 'dzom/ /sgu tshe mi 'gyur sra zhing brtan/ /ja chang bzhes srol rgyun mi chad/ /skyid la chos 'phel bkra shis shog /gsungs/ zla ba'i snying po'i mdo las/ 'dod pa thams cad yongs spangs na/ /mchog tu bde ba thob par 'gyur/ /zhes dang / gsang 'dus las/ 'dod pa'i yon tan thams cad la/ /brten na myur du 'grub par 'gyur/ /gsungs/ sngon jo bo bod la phebs dus/ ja drangs pa thugs mnyes/ ja 'di 'thung na smra lce bde zhing / phung bo la phan pa dang rig pa dwangs ba sogs yon tan mang po snang gsungs bsngags pa brjod skad/ sbyan snga pas / ja yis nad sna du ma bskyed tshul sogs nyes pa du ma yod tshul gyi gtam smyo chu sun 'byin 181

gsungs/ bka' gdams gsung sgros thor bu las/ gcig pur don nyid ma sems par/ /'khor mang nang du chos 'chad 'khrul/ /zhes dang / khyim bdag drag shul can gyes zhus pa'i mdo las/ grong dang grong khyer dang grong rdal dang / ljongs dang yul 'khor dang pho brang dag tu zhugs de chos bstan par bya'o/ /gsungs/ gzhung phal cher na/ rab bskal chen grangs med du tshogs bsags nas sangs rgyas/ 'bring dang tha ma de bas kyang ring gsungs/gzhung 'ga' re na/ de bzhin gshegs pa chos thams cad kyi tshul las rnam par 'khrul ba nges par sel ba gzi brjed 'byung ba'i rgyal po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes brjod na/ tshe gcig lus gcig la 'tshang rgya'o/ /gsungs/yum chen mo las/sangs rgyas rjes su dran pa ni dran pa med pa dang / yid la byed pa mang pa'o/ /gsungs/ gzhung gzhan las/ sangs rgyas rjes su mi dran/ yid la mi byed na/ rjes dran ga la yin gsungs/ dkon mchog brtsegs pa las/sangs rgyas kyi 'du shes med/ chos kyi 'du shes med/ dge 'dun gyi 'du shes med/ yang dag pa'i mchod pa'o gsungs/gzhung gzhan nas/ dkon mchog gsum la dkon mchog gsum yin pa'i 'du shes tsam yang med na/ de mchod par ga 182

la 'gyur/ gsungs/ tshangs pa sems kyis zhus pa'i mdo las/mi 'dzin pa ni sbyin pa'o/ /mi bsrung ba ni tshul khrims so/ /mi gnas pa ni bzod pa'o/ /mi brtson pa ni brtson 'grus so/ /mi bsam pa ni bsam gtan no/ /mi dmigs pa ni shes rab bo/ /gsungs/ gzhung gzhan nas/ mi bsrung ba tshul khrims dang /mi brtson pa brtson 'grus ga la yin/ gsungs/ thal 'gyur las/bsrung mtshams kun las rgyal ba na/ /dam tshig kun gyi rtse mor bshad/ /gsungs/ gzhung gzhan nas/ dam tshig bsrung rgyu med na/ dam tshig kun gyi rtse mor phar zhog tha ma yang min gsungs/ ma cig gis/ byas pas 'phung / bsgoms pas gol/bsam pas brlag skyur la thongs/ glod la zhog yan par zhog sangs rgyas 'thob/ byang chub 'grub gsungs/ lung gzhan las/ thos bsam bsgom byas na/ byang chub thob/ bzhag pas mi thob par gsungs/ sdom gsum bstan pa'i mdo las/gang yid la byed pa yod pa de la ngar 'dzin pa yod do gsungs/gzhung gzhan las/ yid la byed pa yod tshad la ngar 'dzin lhan skyes yod par ma gsungs/ brtag gnyis las/ sems can rnams ni sangs rgyas nyid/ /gsungs/ gzhung gzhan las/sangs rgyas ga la yin rgyu tsam zhig yin gsungs/ bka' 1 83

gdams bla ma 'ga' res/ 'gro 'dug mang po dge sbyor gyis dang / 'dug sa gnon pa man ngag yin/ gsungs/ yang dam pa 'ga' res/phyogs med kyi ri khrod 'grims/ ma 'dug gsungs/ spyan snga pas/ dge bshes sam/ sgom chen pa su yin yang yon tan cung drag tu song ba na chos bshad byed 'dod 'dis brlag tu bcug gsungs/ gzhung gzhan las/ chos bshad byas na mi brlag par ma zad yon tan mtha' yas pa bskyed gsungs/ de 'dra phar bltas na 'gal ba ltar snang ba/rgyal ba'i gsung rab na brgya dgos na stong yod/ 'dir mang du dogs nas de tsam las ma bris/ de rnams kyi dgongs gzhi dgos ched/ gdul bya'i mtho dman gang la gsungs/ drang don nges don/ gab sbas/ gcus dkrug sogs gang yin gyi dgongs pa lon na tshig 'gal ba ltar snang yang / don la mi 'gal bar ma zad bstan 'gro la dngos sam brgyud nas phan thogs rgya chen 'byung bas/dgos pa du ma yod pas/ khas gtong ba phar zhog rgyal sras byang chub sems dpa' rnams thabs mkhas thugs rje ci zhig che ni red snyam/ dad gus skye ba'i rgyu zhig yin/ 'di rnams dang 'di 'dra'i dgongs pa ma lon par phyin ci log tu go na shin tu nyen che la/ de bas 184

rdzogs chen pas 'khor ba thog ma zhig bzhag pas gdul byar ma phan kyang ye mi gnod pas nyen chung /lar 'khor ba thog ma yod med de kun mkhyen ma gtogs nga 'dras thag bcad nas bshad par mi rigs mod/ 'on kyang 'khor ba tha ma yod na thog ma zhig kyang yod ces bshad kyang mi chog rgyu med la/ gal te thog ma med rung gdul bya la phan pa'i dgos pa che na thog ma zhig yod ces gsung srid de/ sangs rgyas kyis gdul bya 'ga' zhig la gang zag gi bdag med rung bdag yod gsungs pa lta bu'o/ /dper na byis pa zhig ri rtse zhig tu 'khrid pa la/kho 'gro 'dod med na/ blo ldan mi rgan 'ga' res/ byes pa la yar ltos dang / ri rtse ya ki na gnam sa gnyis thug 'dug zla ba yang ri mgo dang thag nye bar 'duga'e tshos ci 'dra zhig red ltad mo blta ru 'gro bshad na/ byis pas yar cig blta la/bden gi snyam/ mgyogs por song ri rtse la slebs pa ltar/byis pa lta bu'i gdul bya blo kha dman pa/ ri rtser 'gro ba lta bus thams cad mkhyen pa'i go 'phang thob 'dod kyi blo med pa la/ mi rgan lta bus thabs mkhas rgyal dang rgyal sras byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis/ gnam sa thug med rung /thug 'dug zer ba ltar/ 'khor ba thog ma med rung / thog ma'i gzhi 185

'di 'dra yin zhes thog ma zhig bzhag ci 'dra zhig red blta ru 'gro zer ba ltar/ da lam 'di ltar nyams su len dgos gsungs na/ byes pas bden gi snyam lam du zhugs nas mgyogs por 'gro ba ltar/ gdul bya rnams kyis mthar thug gi 'bras bu thams cad mkhyen pa'i go 'phang thob par 'gyur nges/ de rgyal ba'i gsung rab dang yang mi 'gal mthun te/sangs rgyas kyis bskal pa dpag tu med pa'i yang ches dpag tu med pa'i sngon rol nas sangs rgyas zin zin pa zhig yin gsungs pa dang / bar du bskal chen grangs med gsum du tshogs bsags gsungs pa dang / nam mkha' mtha' med rung /nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad gsungs pa dang mtshungs pa'i phyir ro/ /de 'gal na bskal pa dpag tu med pa la sngon bzhag pa/ bskal chen grangs med gsum bzhag pa/ nam mkha' mtha' med pa mtha' bzhag pa yang 'gal bar 'gyur ro/ /da ban rgan ngas bsam pa yin na/'khor ba thog ma yod dang med ces gsungs pas lam gang nyams su blangs kyang 'khor ba mtha' can byed nus na/ don gyi dgongs pa phyogs gcig tu babs 'dug pas 'gal ba spu tsam yang med/ chos gang yin yang nyams su blangs na thar ba 186

bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang rab kyis tshe gcig lus gcig 'bring gis bar do/ tha mas kyang ma 'ongs pa'i skye ba bzang bo brgyud nas thob nus pa sngon chad kyang rgya bod kyi mkhas grub pho mo nam mkha'i skar tshogs tsam byung bas shes nus/ da lta yang byung ba mthong thos mang la/ma 'ongs pa na'ang 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /chos gang gi 'khor ba mtha' med mtha' can byed na/ 'e tsho de dgos pa lags mod/ 'khor ba thog ma yod yang rung med yang rung da bar 'khor tshar 'dug da des ci bya/ 'di 'dra'i mi mthun pa cung zad re mthong tshe dgongs pa ma lon tsha grang ltar 'gal bar 'dzin pa rang gi blo gros kyi mthu chung ba dang / mthu che yang zhib tu dpyod ma nus par rtog pa rtsing ba yin te/ rje rin po ches/ gnang bkag mi 'dra ba'i cha than thun re mthong nas tsha grang ltar thams cad du 'gal bar 'dzin pa ni/ rtog pa shin tu rtsing bar gsal lo gsungs/ yang 'ga' res/theg pa'i yang rtse bka' rdzogs pa chen po ni rgyu 'bras rtsol sgrub las 'das pa'i chos yin zer ba/ theg pa kun gyi yang rtse yin na/ de'i gong na chos gang yang mi snang shin tu legs ste/ las rgyu 'bras med/ sgo gsum gyi rtsol sgrub mi dgos na/ de'i man na 187

chos shig mi snang shin tu btsog gi sgo gsum gyi 'bad rtsol ci yang mi dgos par kha rog par nyal bsdad na/ grol zer ba/rgya nag gi mkhan po hwa shang gi lugs gzhan dang ma 'dres pa kho nar snang mod/ de'i kha rgya ston sngags bsgyur dad mkhan tshos dud ser du 'gro rag bar du sbas/ da dung zad zad bar du klog skal bzang thar 'dod rnams la mkho ba med zer na/ de gtan nas ma go ba'i cal col chen po zhig smras pa yin te/rdzogs chen la las rgyu 'bras med pas 'dor len gyi rtsol sgrub sogs gtan nas mi dgos zhes bshad pa ga la yin/ rgyu pha rol tu phyin pa'i theg pa dang / 'bras bu rdo rje theg pa'i rgyud sde 'og ma tsho ltar sgo gsum gyi rtsol sgrub ha cang chen po mi dgos par/ tshogs chung ngu'i sgo nas sangs rgyas pa'i chos yin zhes gdul bya dwangs pa 'dren phyir chos kyi che ba brjod pa yin te/rgyal dbang rin po ches kyang / pad 'byung bi ma la dang bai ro dang / /bka' gter las 'ong snga 'gyur rdzogs pa che/ /mkhas blun bar ma gang gis nyams blangs kyang / /tshegs chung don che 'phrul gyi gnad gsang zab/ /gsungs/ de ltar ma go bar phyin ci log tu go nas theg pa chen po'i chos la/de man na chos zhig mi snang zhes skur ba 'debs nus pa smyos pa 188

min nam/ a dzi'i/ phyin chad blo gros can rnams kyis/ mkhas pa'i ming bzung nas don gyi blun po'i go sa na 'gying ba'i kha nas 'di 'dri'i cal col gyi gtam go na 'khrul bar mi bya ste/rdzogs chen pas las rgyu 'bras 'dor len mi byed na rdzogs chen gye gzhung du ma na/ las rgyu 'bras kyi rnam bzhag mtha' yas gsungs pa ci la dgos/ rtsol sgrub gtan nas mi dgos na rdzogs chen bsgom dus lus gnad lta stangs sogs sgo gsum gye rtsol ba mang po byed dgos pa dang yang 'gal ba'i phyir ro/ /des na 'di dang 'di 'dra'i gsung ji bzhin ma go bar/ phyin ci log tu go nas chos spong gi las ngan pa'i khur gyis non nas/yar thar ba'i lam la ma phyin par/ mar ngan song gi rbab tu 'gril song ba mang bas gzab 'tshal/ yang 'ga' res rje bdag nyid chen po dang / rgyal dbang thams cad mkhyen pa'i gsung 'ga' res dgongs pa ma lon par/ bstan pa thams cad 'gal med du rtogs pa'i che ba gsungs pa de/ 'e tsho'i dge lugs pas nyams su len pa'i mdo sngags kyi chos/'jam mgon dpal ldan bla ma tsong kha pa rin po ches/ klu sgrub thog med kyi dgongs pa bzhin phyin ci ma log par bkral nas bstan pa 'di la bstan pa thams cad zer/ de las gzhan phyi 189

rol pa dang hwa shang dang rjes mthun phyag rdzogs kyi lta ba sogs lta ba ltar snang rnams/ 'jam dbyangs mi yi tshul 'dzin khams gsum chos kyi rgyal po tsong kha pa dang / phyag na pad+mo 'dzin pa mi'i gzugs su shar ba rgyal dbang thams cad mkhyen pa gnyis kyis dgag pa mang po btang ba ma gtogs zhal gyi ma bzhes pas bstan pa'i gral du bzhag na/ gser dngul khrod du slog hrul bzhag pa bzhin mi mdzes par 'gyur bas/ nam yang bstan pa'i gral du mi chud de/ sa gsum gyi sgron me byang chub lam rim chen mo las/ ci yang mi rtog pa'i bsgom pa thams cad stong pa nyid bsgom pa'i nyams len du 'dod pa ni/mkhas pa'i bzhad gad kyi gnas yin la/ zhes dang / des na stong pa nyid bsgom pa'i mi rtog pa zhig dang / stong pa nyid cung zad kyang ma rtog pa'i mi rtog pa gnyis yod pas/ bde gsal mi rtog pa byung tshad thams cad stong pa nyid kyi bsgom du bzung bar mi bya'o/ /zhes dang / mi rtog par 'jog pa'i ting 'dzin 'ga' zhig la/ srid pa'i rtsa ba gcod pa'i lhag mthong du 'khrul nas/ de la dmigs med du rlom nas/ dus rnams 'da' bas rang gzhan bslu bar gdon mi za'o/ /zhes dang / ci yang mi rtog pa lhag mthong zab mo'i don bsgom par 190

byed pa ni/ rgya nag gi mkhan po hwa shang gi lugs gzhan dang ma 'dres pa kho nar snang ba sogs gzhan lugs kyi 'dod pa brjod nas dgag pa mtha' yas gsungs/ yang gser gyi yang zhun lta bu'i lam rim chen mo'i snying khu bsdus pa 'jam dbyangs kyi zhal gyi bum bzang las gsar du thon pa lta bu'i legs bshad 'khrul med 'chi med tshe'i bdud rtsi lta bu/'khrul rtog gi dra ba gcod pa la 'jam dbyangs sprul pa'i ral gri las rno zhing / skyes bu gcig gi 'dod don ma lus pa yongs su skong ba la 'jam dbyangs sprul pa'i glegs bam dang rnam pa kun tu mtshungs pa mtshan snyan gang gi rna bar son na dad pa'i spu long g.yo zhing byang chub mchog gi sa bon rgyud la bskrun nus pa'i ngo mtshar phul byung zla med byang chub lam rim 'jam dpal zhal lung zhes bya ba las/ ji skad du/ dper na yul thag ring po zhig tu 'gro na 'gro ba'i lam gyi gnas tshul mtha' dag rang stobs sam/ gzhan la brten pa gang rung gis rgyus yod pa zhig nges par dgos kyi/ tham thom du phyin pas don mi 'grub pa ltar/ bsgom gye skyon sel bogs 'don gyi gnad mi shes par lus gnad bsrangs pa dang mig btsums nas sdod pa'i snying rus la grub pa'i dbang phyug chen por re ba 191

mtha' dag sdom gsum du/ blun po'i phyag rgya chen po bsgom pa phal cher dud 'gro'i rgyu ru gda' gsungs/ zhes pa'i don thog tu babs par snang mod/ deng dus ni rang gzhan kun la ngang tshul 'di dag gis dbyar gyi srin bu'i grangs bzhin khyab cing 'phel ba'i phyir thams cad mkhyen pa'i bus/ bdag gis chos min smra ru chos dang 'gal/ /chos bzhin smras na bod rnams dgra ru ldang / /zhes sgro gleng mang ba rang nyid bya rog lus dkar sgrub par zad de/ zhes dang / yang sa dwags sogs mkhas blun mang pos rtog pa yod na lta ba min/ zhes lta ba bsgom par rtog pa'i 'phro 'du med pa zhig dgos/ zhes dang / la la dag lta bas dpyad pa tshar re sngon du btang nas/mthar ci yang yid la mi byed pas/ de kho na nyid skyong ba dang /'ga' zhig sngar dpyad pa byas pa'i lta ba de dran pa tsam gyes steng du 'jog pa sogs rnam grangs mang du byung na'ang / zhi gnas skyong tshul las dmigs pa khyad par ba ma byung / zhes dang / sgom chen du rlom pa mang po zhig gis/ rig pas dpyad nas lta ba gtan la phab/ bsgom pa'i dus mi rtog pa 'ba' zhig gis bsgom zer ba ni/ gzhi la sdod dus rta legs par gsos nas/ byes la 'gro dus rkang thang du 'gro zer ba 192

dang khyad par ci yang med pa'i zhi gnas la brten nas lhag mthong sgrub tshul gye gnad cung zad ma go ba'i rang mtshang du zad do/ /zhes dpe bzhag lung drangs nas bshad 'dugaphyag rdzogs sa skya sogs rkang thang pa thams cad kyis de khar chug thugs rje can sang gsung de ci zhig rno ni red/ kha grag rgyu med ni bcos 'dugaha ha ha tsho zer na/ shed gi dgod mi dgos/ ban rgan ngas je rnam gnyis kyi dgongs pa cung zad cig bshad pas/ khyod nyon dang / 'o de 'dzam gling mkhas pa yongs kyi gtsug rgyan snyan pa'i ba dan dkar bo 'gro ba yongs kyi rna lam du lhang lhang grag pa'i 'phags pa klu sgrub dang thogs med kyi dgongs pa ji bzhin dbu ma'i lta ba gtan la 'bebs dus/ phyag rdzogs sogs grub mtha' gzhan gyi lta ba gtan la phab nas/ skyongs tshul dang cung zad mi mthun pas/ gzhan de rnams dbu ma rang lugs kyi lta ba'i bzhed srol min zhes gsungs pa ma gtogs/ gzhan rnams lta ba gtan nas min zhes gsungs pa ga la yin/ rje bdag nyid chen po dang / rgyal dbang thams cad mkhyen pa gnyis kyis phyag rdzogs pa'i lta ba rnam dag yin zhes zhal gyis bzhes pa tsam du ma zad/ nyams su bzhes pas mkhas par ma zad/193

grub pa'i dbang phyug chen por gyur pa yin la/ de yang rje bdag nyid chen pos lta ba rnam dag yin zhes zhal gyis bzhes pa'i tshul ni/ lam rim chen mo las/ 'o na bsgom par bya ba'i lhag mthong du zhig yod snyam na/ 'di na sa mthon po'i skabs kyi lhag mthong rnams re zhig gtso bor mi ston gyis/ so so'i skye bo'i dus kyi bsgom par bya ba'i lhag mthong gtso cher ston pa yin no/ /zhes shugs kyis zhal bzhes snang la/ rim lnga gsal sgron sogs nas/ do ha sogs nas bshad pa rnams sngags lam mthon po'i skabs kyi nyams len yin zhes dngos su zhal gyes bzhes te/ slob dpon chen po 'phags pa klu sgrub la sogs rgya gar mkhas grub bye ba'i slob dpon/ sa gsum na 'gran zla ma mchis pa grub thob kyi 'khor los bsgyur ba snyan pa lha mi yongs kyis yang yang gleng zhing / da dung yang mtshan bskal pa bye ba bsam yas su yang nub par mi 'gyur ba'i dpal sa rā ha chen pos bslu med bden pa'i tshig do ha rdo rje'i glu mdzad pa las/bram zes skud pa mkhel ba bzhin/ /rnal 'byor shes pa lhod la zhog /'jur bus bcings pa'i sems nyid ni/ /glod na grong bar the tshom med/ /ces dang / so ma ma bcos lhug par bzhag /sogs 'di 'dra'i rdo rje'i glu 194

gsungs pa mtha' yas/ rje nyid kyis do ha sogs zhes gsungs pa'i sogs khongs su de 'dra'i tshad ldan gyi mkhas grub thams cad kyi gsung 'dus pa yin/ 'o na tshad ldan gyi mkhas grub gang gi gsung 'dus zer na/ 'dir zur tsam zhig brjod pas nyon cig ngo mtshar rmad byung sangs rgyas thams cad kyi thugs sprul gdul bya'i snang ngor sangs rgyas las kyang sku'i che ba'i yon tan mang la skyon gye dri mas ma gos par dri bral mdangs ldan pad+ma'i ge sar rtse las 'khrungs/ 'chi med rdo rje'i sku brnyes o rgyan pad+ma 'byung gnas zhes/ mtshan byes pa lo gnyis yan chad kyis shes shing / rgan gzhon sa la 'gyel ba tsam la yang o rgyan mkhyen zhes nyin mtshan med par skye 'gro yongs kyis gsol 'debs snyan mo'i sgra di ri ri phyogs phyogs su sgogs pa mtshan nyi zla ltar yongs su grags pa'i mtshungs med 'gro mgon/ byang phyogs mun pa'i smag rum du sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa'i sgron me chen po sbor nas/ deng sang 'phags yul las kyang ches cher gsal bar mdzad mkhan/ bo da la sangs rgyas las kyang bka' drin che ba'i bla ma mtsho skyes rdo rje rin po che'i zhal gyi bum bzang las/ rang rig snang ba mtha' yas su/ /gzung 'dzin bral ba'i sems la ltos/ /snang ba 195

mtha' yas logs na med/ /rang mig chos sku ngo mtshar che ma 'gags ma gsal thugs rje che/ /smra brjod bral ba'i sems la ltos/ /thugs rje chen po logs na med/ /rang byung longs sku ngo mtshar che/ /dran rtogs rang grol pad+ma 'byung / /'dzin med zang thal ngang la zhog /pad+ma 'byung gnas logs na med/ /rang byung sprul sku ngo mtshar che/ /gsungs/ yang 'khor 'das ji ltar snang ba 'di dag rang gi sems/ sems stong pa spros bral/ spros bral gye ngo bo chos sku'i ngang du blos ma bcos/'dzin pas ma bcings par bzhag gsungs/ rgyal ba'i gsung rab kyi bcud lta bu'i dam chos sdug bsngal zhi byed kyi gdams pa'i mdzod 'dzin 'jag ma bdun gyi rtse la sku bdun sprul nas skyil krung byas/ 'jag ma'i rtse mo cung zad tsam gug pa med par brtan par bzhugs/ rje mi las sprul pa'i tshogs 'khor phul ba tshim pa dug ldan du mdzad pa sogs dzu 'phrul dpag tu med pa ston pa'i grub thob kyi 'khor los bsgyur ba chen po pha dam pa'i zhal nas/ gcig pur lkog tu nyal zhe na/ /rig pa rjen par 'jog pa yin/ /mang po'i gseb tu sdod tsa na/ /gang shar nga la lta ba yin/ /byeng na phaṭa kyis gseng ba yin/ /'phro na rtsa ba gcod pa yin/ /rgod na dbyings su 'jog pa yin/ /la 196

sogs rje mi las dris lan du gsungs/ gzhan yang pha dam pas/ sangs rgyas zer ba'i sgra po che/ g.yer bo che/ gtsigs po che/ de yang ye gdod ma nas/ nga dang bdag med/ phyogs dang ris med/ bzung ba dang 'dzin pa med/ bzung bas ma bzung / btang bas ma thongs/ bzhag pas ma zhog bshig pas ma shig khral bas ma khrol/ de khyed rang gi gan na 'dug pa'i shes pa wal le 'khyug ge ba 'di rang yin no/ /gsungs/ dus gsum rgyal ba thams cad bskyed pa'i yum chen thugs sprul mi ma yin pa'i ye shes mkha' 'gro ma gnas gcig nas gcig tu 'pho tshe nam mkha' la bya ltar 'byon bzhud mdzad pa sogs dzu 'phrul dpag tu med pa la mnga' brnyes pa'i pha rol phyin pa'i grub thob ma/ gang gi zhal mthong gsung thos pa mdun du 'khod pa tsam gyis chags sdang nyon mongs thams cad rang sar grol nas/ mi rtog pa'i ye shes kyi ngang du lhan 'gro ba'i skal ldan kun gye rgyud grol/ gdul bya skal bzang bye ba phrag brgya gcod yul gye sgo nas smin grol gye lam la bkod nas/ zhal chems glu dbyangs su blangs nas brtse ba'i spyan gyis gdul bya la gzigs shing / zhal 'dzum zhing bzhad bzhin du mkha' spyod dag pa'i zhing du gshegs pa'i ma cig 197

lab kyi sgron ma'i zhal nas/ gang yang yid la ma byas na/ /gol sa ltung ba ci las 'byung / /bsam med bsgom pa ma nor na/ /chos sku byang chub the tshom med/ /sems la gnyis su ma mchis ste/ /blta ru med pa'i tshul du blta/ /bltas pas rang gi sems mi mthong / /ma mthong ba de chos mthong yin/ /mthong ba med pa'i ngang la zhog /mthong ba'i chos nyid don mi rig /de bas blta bar bya ba ni/ /rdul tsaca/ grub pa ma yin no/ /gang yang yid la ma byas na/ /bag chags mi 'byung sa lam rdzogs/ /zhes dang / nyal ba'i chog pa'i chos yin kyang / /bu slob thams cad nyal ma nus/ /des na rgan mo yid ma ches/ /zhes gsungs/ rje bdag nyid chen po pa bka' drin che shos kyi rtsa ba'i bla ma dpal gsang ba'i bdag bo dang tha mi dad kyang / gdul bya'i snang ngor tha mal mi yi gzugs bzung nas dpal gsang ba'i bdag po'i drung nas dngos su zab rgya'i gdams pa gsan cing / 'das ma 'ongs da lta dus gsum gye lung gang ston kyang kha dang lag pa gnyis sprad pa las kyang 'phags pa med pa/ sku las me 'bar chu 'bab pa 'dod dgur bsgyur nus pa sogs rdzu 'phrul gang ston kyang thogs pa med par ston nus pa'i grub pa'i dbang phyug chen po mtshan 198

snyan lho brag nam mkha' rgyal mtshan rin po che zhes/ lha mi yongs kyis da dung gleng zhing ma 'ongs pa nas gleng bar 'gyur ba gang de'i zhal gyi bum bzang las/ lus rnam snang chos bdun dang ldan pa'i sgo nas/ khyung chen nam mkha' la lding ba bzhin/ ma bcos gnyug ma'i ngang la rtsol sgrub med par bzhaganyi ma sprin dang bral ba bzhin kun gsal mdangs dang ldan par bzhag bu chung gis lha khang la bltas pa ltar gsal cha 'gags la 'dzin pa med par bzhag nya rgya mtsho'i rlabs dang bral ba ltar sems g.yo 'gul med par bzhag rgya mtshor chu phran thim pa ltar byung tshor thams cad sems su shes par byas la bzhag nam mkha' la bya 'phur ba bzhin rig pa rjes med du bzhag ces dang / don dam par sems la skye shi med par thag bcad/ phyag rgya chen po la bsgom rgyu med par thag bcad/bsgom med kyi ngang la ma yengs par bzhag pas ye shes zang thal du song nas bar do med par 'tshang rgya'o/ /zhes gsungs/yang g.yag dang lug gu'i ro sogs la 'pho ba grong 'jug dngos su mdzad nas tha mal skye bo'i ma dad log lta bsgyur/ ri rwa ba khang khyim rtsig pa la thogs rdugs med par thol byung du 'gro zhing / sku dgyes pa rdo rje 'khor lo bde mchog gsang ba 199

'dus pa sogs su sprul nas skal ldan gye slob ma la ston pa sogs rdzu 'phrul mtha' yas/ gshegs pa'i tshe bu kun 'pho ba 'di ltar gyis zhes/ 'pho ba'i spar chog gsungs pa'i mthar hig brjod tshe dbu gcug nas 'od zer kha dog lnga ldan gyi gong bu bya ma gsar gyi sgong nga lta bu gcig yar thon nas nam mkha' la thim pa/ skal bzang gdul bya phal cher gyis mthong zhing me tog gi char rol mo'i sgra dang bcas ngo mtshar phul du byung ba'i ltas dang cho 'phrul dpag med bcas dag pa mkha' spyod du gshegs pa'i lho brag mar pa lo tswa'i zhal nas/ gdod nas dag pa'i sems rgyud 'di/ /glo bur rkyen gyis ma bslad na/ /nam mkha' bzhin du 'dus ma byas/ /phyin ci ma log gnas lugs yin/ /yid la bya rgyu rdul dang bral/ /bzung du rdul tsam mi dmigs kyang / /man ngag rgyud la goms pa yi che yi 'du byed gtong ba'i tshe/ /pha rol phyin pa'i dbyengs su thim/ /de la skye ba yod ma yin/ /nam mkha' lta bu'i rang sems de/ /na bun rtog pas ma bslad cig /rje nā ro paṇa chen 'di skad gsungs/chos tshul bzhin nyams su len pa'i tshe/ /sgyug dong bcugs pa'i sbrul bzhin du/ /rtsol ba bral bas lus mi 'gul/ /yid la chags pa'i mya ngan rnams/ /200

gnad la phog pa'i zug rngu ltar/ /bya ba btang bas sems mi yengs/ /sems nyid gnyug ma'i rang bzhin gdod nas stong / /tho bas dngos po 'joms pa bzhin/ /mthong dang reg dang dran pas grol/ /don du legs par go bar mdzod/ /'di phyag rgya chen po'i bsgom dbyangs yin/ /gsungs/ yang /byang phyogs mun pa'i smag rum du/ /gangs la nyi ma shar 'dra ba'i/ /mtshan snyan thos pa dga' zhes bya ba'am/ gangs ri'i khrod na seng ge dkar mo srab med du 'phyo ba bzhin srid zhi'i 'jigs pa dang bral zhing / nam mkha' la bya ltar 'phur/ chu la nya ltar rgyug pha bong 'dam ltar brdzi/ lus lha'i sku dpag tu med par sprul nas sgye bo tha mal pa'i mig lam du ston pa sogs rdzu 'phrul ya ma zung dpag tu med pa bstan nas/ sgrub rgyud bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan srid rtse'i bar du bsgrengs mkhan rnal 'byor gye dbang phyug chen po rje btsun mi la ras pa'i zhal nas/rnal 'byor mi la ras pa ngas/ /cer gyis bltas pas ngo bo mthong / /spros bral nam mkha' lta bur mthong / /cog gis bzhag pas gnas lugs rtogs/ /dngos kun stong pa'i ngo bor rtogs/ /lhod kyis glod pas rang sa zin/ /rig pa'i chu bo dwangs snyigs phyes/ /lings kyis bor bas dran rtog chad/ /201

rigs drug g.yang sa rbad kyis chod/ /sangs rgyas sems su ngo shes pas/ /zhe 'dod bsgrub bya ma mchis so/ /rtogs pa nang nas shar tsa na/ /mun la nyi ma shar ba bzhin/ /nyon mongs rnam par rtog pa'i tshogs/ /bcos med rang sar yal nas thal/ /zhes dang /bdag gis phyag rgya chen po bsgoms tsa na/ /don yin lugs kyi steng du rtsol med bzhag /ma yengs ngang du glod nas bzhag /stong pa'i ngang du gsal bar bzhag /bde ba'i ngang du rig par bzhag /mi rtog ngang du lhan ne bzhag /sna tshogs ngang du mnyam par bzhag /de ltar bzhag pas sems nyid la/ /'gag med nges shes sna tshogs 'khrungs/ /rang gsal rtsol med phrin las grub/ /'bras bu yid smon du ma lus blo re bde/ /re dogs gnyis 'dzin dang bral ba nyams re dga'/ /'khrul ba ye shes su shar ba dang re spro/ /zhes dang / lta ba'i sems la stong nyid shar/ /lta rgyu'i ngo bo rdul tsam med/ blta bya lta byed stor nas thal/ /lta ba'i rtog tshul bzang nas byung /bsgom pa 'od gsal chu bo'i rgyun/ /bsgom pa'i thun mtshams bzung du med/ /bsgom bya sgom byed stor nas thal/ /bsgom pa'i snying rus bzang nas byung / /gsungs/ rje ras pa chen po'i slob ma nyi ma lta bu yin zhes mkha' 'gro'i lung bstan thob 202

pa/ gdams pa bstan nas nyams su blangs pas/ rlung lag sor du 'grems pa sogs zab mo'i lam bzang rgyud la sgye ba'i rtags myur du ston cing mngon shes rdzun 'phrul mnga' ba/mnyam med dwags po lha rje rin po che'i zhal nas/ e ma rang rig ye shes skyong 'dod na/ /ras bal bzhin du shes pa glod la zhog /bya ba thongs la sems la brten ma bca'/ /shes pa ched du ma 'gug yan par thongs/ /bying rgod byung na de nyid rang la ltos/ /sems la gnod pa'i las rnams khad kyis spongs/ /zhe 'dod byung na bdud du shes par gyis/ /ma bcos bzhag pa'i sems ni sangs rgyas yin/ /bcos ma'i sems ni rgyal ba'i dbo/ngas pa min/ /nyin mtshan 'gro 'chag kun tu lhug por zhog /de ltar bzhag pa'i sems nyid de/ /gsal la 'dzin med nam mkha' 'dra/ /phyogs su ma lhung lta ba yin/ /nyam nga med pa shugs las byung / /dag cing dri med shel sgong 'dra/ /gsal la 'dzin med bsgom pa yin/ /rgyun chad med pa shugs las byung / /ma bcos lhug pa bu chung 'dra/ /zhen pa bral ba spyod pa yin/ /dgag sgrub med pa shugs las byung / /rgyu 'bras dus mtshungs a bṛ ta/ /re dogs med nga 'bras bu yin/ /gsungs/rje mi las slob ma zla ba lta bu rta mchog kha 'bab chu chen po la 203

ras gos rkyang gcig gi gru btang nas brgal ba sogs dzu 'phrul dpag med ston pa'i grub pa'i dbang phyug chen po mthar sku lus ma spangs par mkha' spyod du gshegs pa'i ras chung rdo rje grags pa'i zhal nas/ ras chung pa la lta ba med/ /lta ba nam mkha'i mthongs su shor/ /mtha' dbus med par shor te thal/ /shor kyang phyi rjes bcad ri shi/ /ras chung pa la bsgom pa med/ /bsgom pa mtsho mo'i gting du shor/ /kha gting med par shor te thal/ /shor kyang phyi rjes bcad ri shi/ /ras chung pa la spyod pa med/ /spyod pa skyi ser rlung la shor/ /ngos bzung med par shor te thal/ /shor kyang phyi rjes bcad ri shi/ /ras chung pa la dam tshig med/ /dam tshig shel gong rtsa ru shor/ /phyi nang med par shor de thal/ /shor kyang phyi rjes bcad ri shi/ /ras chung pa la 'bras bu med/ /'bras bu rin chen rtsa ru shor/ /dgos 'dod 'byung gin shor te thal/ /shor kyang phyi rjes bcad ri shi/ /zhes gsungs/ spyan dang mngon shes rdzu 'phrul dpag med la mnga' brnyes sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa rin po che'i khur khyer ba la nam yang mi ngal ba'i grub pa'i dbang phyug chen po zhang g.yu brag 'gro mgon rin po che'i zhal nas/phyag rgya chen po bsgom pa la/ /'di zhes tig po mi bdog gi /204

thog ma bar dang mtha' med par/ /nam dran dus su glod la zhog /shes pa lhod kyis glod pa'i tshe/ /gsal la rtog pa med pa'i nyams/ /bar snang dag pa'i dkyil ltar 'char/ /de ni 'od gsal chos sku yin/ /gsungs/ rje 'bangs nyer lnga'i mchog gyur las can dag pa'i 'khor lnga'i nang nas kyang phul byung / tshul khrims mig gi 'bras bu ltar bsrung ba'i sdom brtson kun gyi khyu mchog mdo sngags chos kun bsgyur mkhas lo tsā ba brgya rtsa brgyad kyi mchog gyur/ mgar bas dug mda' rgyab pas ma phug slar mda' gzhu gser dang g.yu ru bsgyur nas gnang ba sogs ngo mtshar ba'i rdzu 'phrul dpag med ston pa'i grub thob kyi 'khor los bsgyur ba slob dpon bai ro tsā na zhes snyan pa'i ba dan srid pa gsum na lhang nge ba de nyid kyi zhal gye bum bzang las/ /d+dhi ru med pa'i chos dbyings chen po las/ /bsam du med pa'i rig pa ma yengs zhog /zhes gsungs/ snga 'gyur o rgyan chen po'i gsang sngags kyi bstan pa la/ o rgyan las kyang sku drin ches lhag pa/sngon med legs bshad mdzod bdun shing rta gsum sogs brtsams tshe/ o rgyan rin po che dang mkha' 'gro'i gtso mo ye shes mtsho rgyal/ mkhyen rab 'jam dbyangs dang / ngag dbang lha mo dbyangs can ma sogs kyi phyag 205

tu bsnams/ zhu dag mdzad pa'i tshul nyan pa/ dbyangs can ma'i phyag tu bsnams nas ri rab gling bzhi gling phran la bskor ba byas pa bstan cing /bskal bzang gi gdul bya bgrangs las 'das pa smin grol gyi lam la bkod pa'i mthar gshegs pa'i tshe me tog gi char rol mo'i sgra gdung dang ring bsrel sogs/bar dor mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas pa'i rtags ma tshang ba med par bstan nas/ thugs re zhig chos kyi dbyings su gzigs pa'i kun mkhyen klong chen rab 'byams pa zhes snyan grags dbyar gyi rnga bo che phyogs kun tu lding ba de nyid kyi zhal nas/ sems nyid ma skyes gnyug ma'i don/ /rang bzhag yongs grol nam mkha' 'dra/ /bsam med ye nas rdzogs pa che/ /'du 'bral med pa'i chos nyid do/ /zhes dang / phyi ru mi spro nang du mi bsdu la/ /yid la mi byed dmigs gtad blo las 'das/ /bsgom dang mi bsgom bsam las 'das pa'i ngang / /rang byung ye shes rjen par zang thal lo/ /thun mtshams byar med rgya yan rig pa'i 'gros/ /rang gsal rjen pa dmigs gtad bsam dang bral/ /phyi nang yul med chos dbyengs gdod ma'i ngang / /byar med phyal ba chos skur zang thal lo/ /zhes dang / 'dzin pas ma bcing bzung ba'i yul las 'das/ /206

dmigs gtad chos med har sangs rgya yan pa/ /ma yengs dran pa zad pa'i dgongs pa ni/ /mkha' ltar phyal yas bsgom dang mi bsgom med/ /'di ni kun bzang dgongs pa'i klong chen po/ /zhes gsungs/ mi med pa'i gangs dang ri sul rnams su mdo rgyud spyi dang khyad par bskyed rdzogs rdzogs chen gyi gdams pa nyams su bzhes pas dbu ma'i snying ga'i rtsa mdud ma lus par grol ba'i 'od gsal stong pa chos sku'i ngang du nyin mtshan khor yug tu gnas shing / mgrin pa'i rtsa mdud grol nas rdo rje glu'i mtsho rdol nas gang gsungs thams cad rdo rje'i glu ru len pa'i rig 'dzin gang shar rang grol gyi zha'/ nas/ rang sems gsal stong 'dzin pa med pa 'di/ /rang sar bzhag nas rang la bltas pa'i tshe/ /skye 'gag gnas gsum bral ba'i chos sku ru/ /'bad pa med par 'char ro mched grogs ma/ /nyon mongs rnam rtog phra rag ci byung yang / /ma spangs ma yal ngo bor bltas tsa na/ /stong pa las gzhan rnam rtog ye med pas/ /gsal stong rjen par 'char ro mched grogs ma/ /zhes dang /ngas re 'ga' rig stong mnyam par bzhag /rig stong la mnyam par bzhag tsa na/ /gnyis med kyi ye shes khong nas rgyas/ /lus ngag gi dge sbyor rgyang la bskyur/ /'di gzhan mas bltas na 207

)snyoms las 'dra/ /mi nga rang gis bsam na don dang ldan/ /stong gsal gyi rig pa rjen pa 'di/ /'od gsal rdzogs chen gye snying bor 'dug /ces gsungs pa la sogs sngon gye mkhas grub da pag tu med pa'i gsung 'di 'dra'i rigs/ sngon sbyangs las 'phro can gyi grol la khad/ gang zag dbang bo yang rab gcig char ba dang / sngon goms cha med pa'i skyes bu gang zag dbang bo rtul po rim gyis pa rnams lam la rim gyis bslabs nas lta ba mthon por song ba'i skabs kyi nyams su len tshul yin zhes rje bdag nyid chen pos zhal gyis bzhes pa yin no/ /de ltar mi 'dod na rje rin po ches zhal gyis bzhes pa yang khyod kyis ma bzhes zhes khas len dgos par 'gyur zhing / khas blangs na/ rje rin po ches khong gi bka' drin che shos rtsa ba'i bla ma lho brag nam mkha' rgyal mtshan gyi gsung sogs sngar bshad pa'i tshad ldan gyi mkhas grub thams cad kyi gsung zhal gyis ma bzhes/ chos spong gi mi tshad/ bla ma yang spangs/ rje nyid kyi gsung rab sa gsum sgon me byang chub lam rim chen mo yang / mun khang gi sgon me bzhin chung / bstan pa thams cad 'gal med du mi rtogs/ gsung rab thams cad gdams par 'char mi nus zhes khas ma smras pa ma 208

gtogs/ don gyis skur ba btab pa yin pas/ rje rin po che'i bstan pa smad nas de yan gi gnod chen po skyel tshul med/'jig rten gtam dpe 'then dus/ bstod mi shes ni zhig gis bstod rag gisgrod mi shes ni zhig gis smad na dga' zer ba ltar/ khyod kyi 'di las phyag rdzogs sogs kyi 'ga' res rje rin po che smod rgyu yin byas/ sgod ma shes bstod ra brjod 'dug da khyod kyis rje bdag nyid chen po bstod nas dga' ldan na thugs dgyes yod ma bsam/ de'i ldog phyogs yod pa de soms dang / nges nges po de yin sa snang / rje bdag nyid chen pos phyag rdzogs kyi lta ba rnam dag yin zhes zhal gyis bzhes par ma zad nyams su bzhes pa'i tshul ni/ rje rin po che khong gis gzhan mdo sngags kyi dka' gnad thams cad kyi dogs pa mtha' dag chod kyang /lta ba'i skabs 'ga' zhig gi dogs pa ma chod par rgya gar du phebs dgongs tshe/ khong gi bla ma lho brag nam mkha' rgyal mtshan rin po ches da khyod kyi lta ba'i dogs pa de dag gis yi dam gsang ba'i bdag po la zhu/ de nas dogs pa ma sel na khong rgya gar la phebs kyang yongs gsungs nas/ dpal gsang ba'i bdag po la zhus pas/gsang bdag gis zhus lan gnang dgos pa thams cad la lan 209
