gnang / mi dgos pa de khong rgyus che gsungs/ de'i mtshan du zhus lan bdud rtsi sman mchog tu btags/ de dar gyis dril nas rje rin po che la bskur ba'i dus/ nam mkha' nas dpa' bo mkha' 'gro mang pos/ las kyi rdo rje bla ma'i mchog/phyag na rdo rje yi dam mchog /'dud rtsi sman mchog chos kyi mchog /blo bzang grags pa slob ma'i mchog /zhes bsngags brjod mang po gnang / gsang bdag gi zhal rlangs ma yal ba'i zhus lan bdud rtsi sman mchog rje rin po che'i phyag tu 'byor/ thugs nyams su bstar bas lta ba'i dogs pa mtha' dag chod nas/rab dga'i sa thob lta bu'i thugs spro ba'i shugs kyis/ gsang bdag gsung gi bdud rtsi yis/ /yid kyi re ba rdzogs par byas/ /nyon mongs nad las rgyal bar gyur/ /lcang lo can du phyin pa snyam/ /zhes pa la sogs pa'i bsngags brjod rgya chen po mdzad skad/ 'o na zhus lan bdud rtsi sman mchog na ji 'dra gsungs yod zer na/ mgon yab kun tu bzang po'i dgongs pa/ yul kun tu bzang mo'i snying gtam rdo rje 'dzin pa bdag gi gsang tshig sman chen po sgrub pa la sems nyid 'od gsal gye rtsad chod cig gsungs/ bar zhig na/ las kyi rdo rje/ rig pa'i ngo bo stong pa 'di sus kyang ma bcos pa rgyu med pa rkyen 210

med pa ye gdod ma nas gnas pa yin gsungs/ 'di la bca' bcos gang yang ma mdzad par kho rang gang 'dug gi steng du zhog dang / gol sa med ka dag gi klong du 'tshang rgya ba yin/ de bzhin du rang bzhin gsal ba 'di/ ye nas stong pa nyid dang dbyer med du lhun gyis grub/ de'i rtsal thugs rje 'gag med gang shar kyang rang bzhin gyis ma grub pas gsum ka zung 'jug chen por shes par gyis dang / dbyer med du 'tshang rgya ba yin no/ /gsungs/ mjug na/ sman 'di dang po gdul bya rnams kyi dang khar mi 'gro ba'i dpe yod/ bar du dang khar song na skyug pa'i dpe yod/ sman 'di dang po gsol nas bar du mi skyugs par zhu/ de ltar mdzad na 'khor ba'i gcong nad 'di las myur du grol bar 'gyur gsungs pa sogs la ltos dang / phyag rdzogs kyi lta ba ji bzhin gsungs 'dugade las lhag cig phyag rdzogs sogs na yang gsungs med pa'i phyir ro/ /des na khyed tshos phyag rdzogs kyi lta ba 'di brgya ngan bshad kyang rje bdag nyid chen po'i lta ba'i skabs kyi dogs pa thams cad 'dis bcad song / khong gis gsang bdag gsung gis chod gsungs pa ma gtogs/ gzhan zhig gis chod ces ma gsungs 'dug sngon mi gcig gis/ bshad mi dgos a 211

bo'i sems na yod/ /'don mi dgos yi ge ngo na yod/ /ces bshad pa ltar/ lta ba'i bzang ngan bshad mi dgos gsung 'di gcig pus shes nus/ de yang gsang bdag gis lung bstan ltar/ dam chos kyi sman mchog 'di nyon mongs gcong nad tshab chen gyis thebs pa'i ga dul bya'i dang khar mi 'gro ba mang kyang / rje bdag nyid chen pos gsol dus dug cig min las che/ rjes 'jug blo gros dang ldan pas rje yi rnam thar ltar gsang ba'i tshul du cung zad re bsten dang / rang gi nyon mongs kyi nad zhi zhing / rje rin po che'i phyi nang gsang ba'i rnam thar mtha' dag kyang zin pa yin pas/ phyogs re tsam 'dzin pa zhig tu ma gyur par mdzod/ yang sngags kyi dbang lung khrid gsum gang yod bum pa gang byo'i tshul du rje rin po cher gnang zhing / khyad par gsang bdag gi gsung la khong gis 'grel ba gnang ba'i phyag rgya chen po khrid yig sogs bka' 'bum gang yod kyi chos bdag gi bka' babs gsang ba'i tshul du nyams su bzhes zhes gsung ste/ tsong kha brgyad cu pa las/ lho brag grub chen las kyi rdo rje la/ /gsang ba'i bdag po'i snyan rgyud gdams ngag dang / /mdo rgyud lam gyi rim pa gsan pa yi/ /rgyud pa'i bka' babs thob pa'i tsong kha 212

pa/ /gsungs/ gsang sngags gsang nas sgrub dgos pa thugs shin tu mad de/ gsang sngags gsang nas sgrub dgos pa/ /sngags la skyon yod ma yin te/ /dbang bo rtul po rnams la gsang / /gsungs pa dang / yongs su ma smin sems can la/ /gsang ba sgrogs pa bdun pa yin/ /zhes pa dang / thal 'gyur las/ gnas lugs 'dug tshul 'di lta bu/ /bshad na nyan thos sangs rgyas kyang / /rab tu skrag te brgyal bar 'gyur/ /des na mchog tu gsang bar bya/ /gsungs pa dang /rin chen spungs pa las/ tshig 'di dag ni nyan thos dang /rang sangs rgyas la sogs pa'i nang du rdul tsam yang brjod par ma byed cig de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de rnams kyis tshig 'di kun thos pas skrag pa dang/ dngangs pa dang brgyal bar 'gyur te/ de'i rnam par smin pas sems can dmyal ba chen po nyams su myong bar 'gyur bas na/ bstan cing thos pa dag lta ci smos te/ rlung phyogs tsam du yang brjod par mi bya'o/ /zhes gsungs pa la sogs rgyud mang po nas gsang sngags gsang nas nyams su len dgos zhes nan tan du gsungs so/ /des na rje rin po che thabs mkhas la thugs rje che zhing sku gsung thugs kyi phyi nang gsang ba'i rnam thar mtha' yas pas/ bla 213

ma'i gsung dang / rgyud kyi dgongs don ltar gsang sgrogs kyi nyes pa sogs mi 'byung ba'i slad du shin tu gsang ba'i tshul du nyams su bzhes pas/ sngar mkhas pa yin par ma zad/ phyis grub pa'i dbang phyug chen por song / mkhas grub gnyis 'dzoms su gyur nas/ bstan pa dang sems can la phan thogs pa'i rgyu rkyen rten 'brel kyang de yin zhes bla ma dam pa'i gsung sgos las byung / rgyal dbang thams cad mkhyen pas phyag rdzogs zhal gyis bzhes par ma zad/ thugs nyams su bzhes pa'i tshul yongs la grags che bas smos ci dgos/ nyams su bzhes rtags su/ rig 'dzin chen po mtsho sgyes rdo rje'i zhal gyi bum bzang las gser du thon pa lta bu'i zab mo'i gdams pa myong grol 'chi med bdud rtsi dang mtshungs pa'i sngon med legs bshad/ mtshan snyan pa bskyed rdzogs rdzogs pa chen po'i khrid yig rig 'dzin zhal lung zhes bya ba'i yid bzhin gyi nor las lhag pa zhig rjes 'jug skal bzang gdul bya yongs la mi 'dzad pa'i gter du 'jog pa byas/ bsngags brjod rgya chen po mdzad de/ pad 'byung bi mā la dang bai ro dang /bka' gter las 'ong nges don rdzogs pa che/ /mkhas rmongs bar ma gang gis nyams blangs kyang / /tshegs chung don che 214

'phrul gye man ngag zab/ /dper na mi pham mgon po ches rgan pa/ /bai ros tshe der byang chub lam du 'khrid/ /rgya bod gnyis ka rtogs grol dus gcig tu/ /byung ba'i ngo mtshar lo rgyus pha mtha' yas/ /gsungs pa sogs mang la/ da khyed kyis bsam blo thongs dang / smad ni red e snyam gi ma shes gcig re mgo'i bsdad ni sngar mang po byung / da blo gros can rnams kyis de'i rjes lam shor ba zhig byed pa gal che/ rje rin po che dang rgyal dbang thams cad mkhyen pa gnyis bskal pa dpag tu med pa'i sngon rol nas sangs rgyas te/ skal bzang gdul bya'i snang ngor sangs ma rgyas par sa bcu'i dbang phyug byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po mkhyen rab 'jam dbyangs dang / thugs rje'i gter chen spyan ras gzigs kyi tshul bzung / de nyid tha mal gdul bya'i snang ngor/ ngur smig 'chang ba'i tshul bzung ba yin pas/ rje rnam gnyis kyi thugs ni nam mkha' ltar rgya che/ dgongs pa mtsho ltar gting zab/sku gsung thugs kyi phyi nang gsang ba'i mdzad pa ni rdul ltar grangs mang / gdul bya'i snang ngor/ phyag chen pa rdzogs chen pa bka' gdams pa zhes mtshan gsum btags pa ma gtogs/phyag dang mchod pa'i zhing mchog thub dbang rdo rje 'chang sogs 215

kyi gsung rab dgongs 'grel rgya chen po rnams nyams su bzhes pas don gyi phyag chen pa/ rgyal ba'i gsung rab dgongs 'grel yongs su rdzogs pa skyes bu chen po'i lam rim gyi khongs su bsdus nas nyams su bzhes pas don gyi rdzogs chen pa/ rgyal ba'i gsung rab yi ge na gcig yan chad 'dor rgyu med par gdams pa'i mchog tu mthong nas thugs su bzhes/ gdul bya skal bzang bye ba ther 'bum la de ltar 'doms pas don gyi bka' gdams pa chen po yin pas/ deng sang snyigs dus kyi dbu rdzogs phyag chen gyi rnal 'byor pa ming khyog skam po'i g.yu 'brug la 'ur grags nas/ gdul bya'i zhing sar lung rtogs yon tan gyi sbrang char gtan nas 'bab rgyu med par/ chags sdang gi glog 'khyug bdag bstod gzhan smod kyi skad drag tu ldir/ dad can byes pa skrag gi bcug bsam ngan sbyor rtsub kyi ser drag phab/ thog 'phangs nas/ rgyal ba'i bstan pa'i lha khang legs bshad log bris du mas mdzes par byas pa rnams rtsa ba nas bshig mthar gnong 'gyod kyi skad ngan khyog ring ring byas/ mar 'khor ba ngan song gi rdzogs pa tsho song nas mag se bsdad 'dug pa dang ga la gcig rje rin po che'i sku gsung thugs kyi phyi nang gsang ba'i yon tan ni/ dpal gsang 216

ba'i bdag po khong gis kyang mtha' rtogs dka' gsungs ste/rje gzhon nu dpal gyi zhal nas/ gsang ba'i bdag pos las kyi rdo rje la gsungs pa/ 'di'i yon tan gyi mtha' nged kyis kyang mi rtogs gsungs pa/ de las lhag pa'i bsngags pa brjod rgyu zhig mi snang na'ang / rjes su zhugs pa rnams zhus lan bdud rtsi'i sman mchog la de tsam gyis rtsis med/ rje rin po che de gdul bya phyogs gcig pa tsho gcig 'dul du byon par 'dug pas/ grub pa'i mtha' rnams kyang gdul bya'i bsam pa'i dbang gis 'byung ba yin te/ dper na gnas der drang nges rnam 'byed gsungs pa'i skabs su/ 'dir bshad pa dang 'gal ba min pas/ drang nges kyi 'byed lugs shig theg pa chen po rgyud bla ma nas bshad 'dug ces tshogs su gsungs na'ang / gdul bya rnams la'ang de'i snod med pa'i phrin las de 'dra la gsung de byung ba'i dus su maṇ+ḍal phul nas gsol ba 'debs mi gcig kyang ma byung gsungs/ 'ga' res zhus lan bdud rtsi sman mchog gi lta ba 'di klu sgrub thogs med kyi bzhed srol/ rje rang nyid kyi phyin ci ma log par gsal bar bkral ba'i dbu ma'i lta ba skyong tshul dang gtan nas mi mthun par 'dug pas/ 'di lta ba rnam dag yin nam min/ rje bdag 217

nyid chen pos 'di ltar nyams su bzhes ma bzhes mi shes 'dug pas/ blo gros can rnams kyis yid ches kyi gnas su bzung bar mi bya'o zer na/ dbu ma'i lta ba las dang po pas thog mar skyong tshul dang mi mthun pa cung khyod bden yang /yid ches kyi gnas su bzung mi rung gsungs pa khyod 'khrul 'dug snyigs dus kyi tshe thung gcig la sangs rgyas nas/bskal mang tshogs bsags pa'i sangs rgyas rnams ya mtshan du 'jug pa'i bod gangs can khrod kyi seng gcig rnal 'byor gye dbang phyug rje mi la'i zhal nas/ da lta rnal 'byor pa rnams kyi nyams su len pa'i stong nyid/ mnyam nyid/ brjod med/ mi rtogs pa rnams dbang bzhi dang mthun pas/ gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa'i lam rim gyi lta ba yin gsungs pa khyod yid ma ches sam/ gal te khyod de la yid mi ches na/ dpal sa rā has gsung nas bzung ngas sngar bshad tshad thams cad kyi gcig la yang yid brtan mi rung ba'i nyes pa khyod la 'bab/ rje dang rgyal dbang gi zhal gyes bzhes/ nyams su blangs/ bsngags brjod mdzad pa la yang 'gal bar 'gyur/ de dang 'gal na khyod kyi steng du nyes 'gal mi gtsang gi char ba 'bab par 'dug pas/ khyod kyi thugs lam bde ba zhig byung ba'am/218

sems rnal du phob cig de ci'i phyir zhe na/ gsung rab thams cad dang 'gal ba'i phyir ro/ /da khyod nyon dang /ngas khyod kyi mgo nyes 'gal gyi mi gtsang bas khebs 'dug pa/blo gros kyi mthu zhan rung yod tshod kyis cig phyi/ phyis nas ma dag na khyod kyi las red/ spyir lta ba zer ba 'di la bzang ngan mang /ngan pa 'dir mi spro la/ bzang po kun rdzob kyi ngos nas/bla ma la sangs rgyas dngos su lta ba/ las rgyu 'bras bden par lta ba/ don dam pa'i ngos nas/ mnyam bzhag nam mkha' lta bu'i lta ba/ rjes thob sgyu ma lta bu'i lta ba/ grub mtha'i ngos nas/dbu ma rang rgyud pa'i lta ba/ sems tsam pa'i lta ba/ thal 'gyur ba'i lta ba/ rdzogs chen gyi lugs la/ sems sde'i lta ba/klong sde'i lta ba/ man ngag sde'i lta ba/ de bzhin du phyag rgya ba/sa skya sogs la yang lta ba'i dbye ba mang / lta ba zer ba rgya chung chung zhig la go mi rung / gang zag la mchog dman 'bring gsum yod pa bzhin/ lta ba la yang mchog dman 'bring gsum mtha' yas ste/ rje skal ldan rgya mtshos/ tshe snga mar stod phyogs ting 'dzin la/ /yun ring goms bag chags sad pa la/ /chos lta ba'i nyams rtog 'char sla yang / /de lta bu 'dzam gling 'di na dkon/ /sngon goms chags med pa'i skyes bu la/ /chos stong 219

nyid kyi gtam de blor shong dka'/ /don de phyir ston pa sangs rgyas kyis/ /chos lta ba'i sgo mo mtha' yas gsungs/ /zhes dang / nyan sa las/ lhag mthong dang rjes su mthun pa'i bshad pa mang ba/ de tsam du ni lhag mthong mang ba yin no/ /ci tsam du ni lhag mthong mang ba/ de tsam du zhi gnas mang ba yin no/ /zhes dang / spyan snga pas/ lhag mthong yang mtha' yas grangs med pa yod gsungs na/ lhag mthong rgya chung chung des ci byed/ skyes bu rnams gsungs/ 'phags pa yul 'khor skyong gis zhus pa'i mdo las/ stong pa zhi ba skye ba med pa'i tshul/ /ma shes pas ni 'gro ba 'khyams gyur pa/ /de dag thugs rje mda' bas thabs tshul dang / /rig pa brgya phrag gis ni 'jug par mdzod/ /ces gsungs pas na/ lta ba thams cad mtha' gcig tu nges par 'dzin pa de/ nas 'bru gcig lag tu bzung nas 'bru thams cad 'di 'dra 'ba' zhig go /zhes smras pa dang mtshungs pas mkhas pas go na bzhad gad kyi gnas yin pas gzhan ma sems/ lta ba de thams cad kyis dngos sam brgyud nas gnas lugs stong pa nyid kyi lta ba rtogs nas mngon du gyur te/ rje rin po ches/ spyir rgyal ba'i gsung rab thams cad ni la las dngos su de kho na nyid ston/ dngos su mi 220

ston pa rnams kyang brgyud nas de la gzhol zhing 'bab pa kho na yin gsungs/ jo bo rjes/ chos kyi phung bo brgyad khri dang / /bzhi stong gsungs pa thams cad kyang / /chos nyid 'di la gzhol zhing 'bab/ /gsungs/ paṇa chen rin po ches/ so sor ming 'dogs mang na yang / /des don lung rigs la mkhas shing / /nyams myong can gyi rnal 'byor pas/ /dpyad na dgongs pa gcig tu 'bab/ /gsungs/ 'o na kun mkhyen sa skya paṇa chen rin po ches/ pha rol phyin dang gsang sngags la/ /lta ba'i khyad par bshad pa med/ /pha rol phyin pa'i lta ba las/ /lhag pa'i lta ba yod na ni/ /lta de spros pa can du 'gyur/ /gsungs pa de ci yin zer na/ de lta ba thams cad stong nyid lta ba rtogs nas mngon du 'gyur ba'i thabs su don gyi gcig yin pas na/ rdzun du mi 'gyur/ dper na blo ldan sbyin gtong mkhan gyis sprang bo nyam chung nad pa 'ga' rer zas tshod cig ma byin na mi 'ju bar gnod pa shes nas/zas mang po yod kyang 'di min med zer ba ltar gang zag 'ga' re la phan pa'i dgongs gzhi gcig yod nas de skad gsungs pa yin te/ de min na khong gis dbang bzhi re re la lta ba re gsungs nas bzhi 'dug ces spyan snga pa lha gzigs 221

'bar gyis gsungs/ de gnyis 'gal bar 'gyur ba'i phyir ro/ /khyad par klu sgrub thogs med kyi bzhed srol zab mo dbu ma'i lta ba yang thog mar dpyad bsgom gtso bor byed kyang /bar du dpyad 'jog spel ma/ tha ma 'jog bsgom gtso bor byed/ ces zab mo dbu ma'i rnal 'byor nyi zer la chos gos bkal nas gung tshigs kyi gsol ja bskol bar mdzad pa sogs dbu ma'i lam mngon du gyur pas/ ngo mtshar phul du byung ba'i rdzu 'phrul ston cing / reb gong mun pa'i gling lta bu rje rin po che'i bstan pa'i sgron me sbar nas skal ldan gyi gdul bya rgya mtsho tsam smin grol gyi lam la bkod pa'i mthar las can dag pa'i 'khor 'ga' re'i snang ngor/ seng ge dkar mo rgyan du mas brgyan pa zhig la chibs nas mkha' spyod dag pa'i zhing du gshegs pa'i tshul bstan pa'i 7 rje btsun skal ldan rgya mtsho'i zhal nas/ lar dang po dpyad pa gtso cher byed/ /dus bar du dpyad 'jog spel mar byed/ /dus tha ma 'jog bsgom gtso bor byed/ /gsungs/ de bzhin du bka' gdams bstan pa'i srog shing / snang ba dpe char shar nas gang gsungs dpe yi sgo nas 'chad pa'i mnyam med po to ba chen po'i zhal nas/gcig dang du bral rten 'brel la sogs/ /gang la goms pas 222

so sor rtogs shing / /cung zad mi rtog nyid du gnas bya/ /zhes dang / snyan pa lha mi yongs kyis sgogs pa'i jo bo rje'i zhal nas/ lung dang rig pa dag gis ni/ /chos rnams thams cad sgye med pa'i/ /rang bzhin med par shes byas nas/ /rnam par rtogs med bsgom par bya/ /zhes dang / rang gzhan gyi grub mtha' rgya mtsho lta bu mkhyen pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa sku tshe de nyid la sku lus ma spangs par rigs 'dzin gyi gnas su gshegs pa'i slob dpon mkhas pa dpal ldan a bha bas/ slob dbon chen po 'phags pa klu sgrub kyi gsung bzhin mdzad pa'i dbu ma rin chen sgron me las/ dpyad bsgom byed tshul bshad ma thag pa'i 'jug tu/ bar skabs der shes pa ci la yang mi gnas/ci la yang mi rtog ci la yang sems pa med pa/ mthar thams cad la mi gnas pa/ shes pa ci'i ngo bor yang ma skyes pa/ci yang ma yin par bsgom par bya'o/ /zhes dang / zung 'jug gi sku brnyes dgung lo drug brgya'i bar du bzhugs nas bstan pa dang 'gro ba'i don rgya chen po mdzad cing sku gsung thugs kyi yon tan bskal par brjod kyang rdzogs pa'i yul las 'das pa snyan pa'i ba dan 'gro na lhang nge ba slob dpon klu sgrub kyis do ha rdo je'i glu mdzad pa las/ gang yang ma rtog ci yang ma 223

sems par/ /bca' bcos ma byed rang bzhin lhug par zhog /shes rab pha rol phyin chog gnyis med lam/ /dus gsum sangs rgyas kun gyi gshegs shul yin/ /gshegs pa bcings grol med pa'i chos nyid la/ /don yengs med dran pa'i bya ra bas/ /blos bsgom du med pa'i ngang la ni/ /yul yul can gnyis kyi rtsis gdab bral/ /'di phyag chen bsgom gyi skyongs tshul yin/ /gsungs/ rim lnga las/ ji ltar chu la chu bzhag dang / /mar la mar nyid bzhag pa bzhin/ /chos nyid spros dang bral ba la/ /shes pa spros dang bral bar bzhag /ces dang / mgon po byams pas/ 'di la bsal bya ci yang med/ /bzhag par bya ba cung zad med/ /yang dag nyid la yang dag lta/ /yang dag mthong bas rnam par grol/ /gsungs/ rje btsun 'jam dpal dbyangs kyis lta ba'i man ngag lnga gsungs pa'i lnga ba des na/ skabs 'dir dpyad 'jog bsgom pa'i zhar la lta thog nas rtse gcig pa'i de kho na nyid bsgom pa la 'jog gsungs/ rje bdag nyid chen po'i dgongs pa yang yin te/ lam rim chung ngu las/ lus la gnad du bsnun pa'i nus pa thob pa'i rdzogs rim pa'i mnyam bzhag tu/ de nyid skyong ba na/ lta thog tu bzhag nas bsgom pa nges par dgos kyang /224

lhag mthong gi dpyad pa gzhung gzhan nas byung ba ltar mi byed do/ /gsungs/ lam rim chen mo'i zhi lhag zung 'brel thob tshul bshad ma thag pa'i mjug tu/ 'di dag gi sgo nas zhi lhag gi skyong tshul la'ang khyad par du ma zhig 'byed dgos par snang mod kyang / tshig mang pos 'jigs nas ma bris so/ /zhes gsungs/ snga sor dpyad bsgom byed tshul bstan zin pas/ da skabs 'di nas bzung 'jog bsgom byed dgos zhes shugs kyis bstan pa yin la/ lhag mthong skyong tshul la mi 'dra ba du ma zhig byed dgos gsungs pa thugs shin tu mad de/ las dang po pa'i skabs cung zad brtan pa thob pa'i skabs/ brtan pa rab tu thob pa'i skabs kyi skyong tshul dang / rgyud la skye tshul mi 'dra ste/ dang po 'di ltar bskyangs na thog mtha' bar gsum 'di ltar skyong dgos zhes mtha' gcig tu 'dzin pa ni/ byis pa gzhon nu mi rgan gyi dus kyi kha zas na tshod cig yin zhes smras pa dang 'dra bas/ rje bdag nyid chen po'i lam rim che chung gi dgongs pa phyin ci ma log par lon pa'i rgyal dbang thams cad mkhyen pa sogs dbu ma'i gzhung la sbyangs pa mkhas pa'i bzhad gad kyi gnas yin pas gzhan ma sems/ rgyal dbang rin po ches rtsol ba la ma ltos pa'i zhi lhag zung 'brel gyi mgo 225

brtsams pa nas bzung / zhi gnas chu mi 'gul ba la/ lhag mthong nye'u chung 'khyug pa de 'dra rang lugs su mi 'dod pas/zhes dang / rjes 'bangs rnams kyis kyang lam rim che chung gi dgongs pa ma rnyed pa'i ri bong cal sgog gis bslus par zad mod/ lam bsgom pa'i thog mtha' bar gsum nyams len byed tshul dang / rgyud la 'char tshul gyi phra zhib kyi dbye ba mi phyed par/ gcig tu zhan pa ni byes pa btsas ma thag pa dang / lo brgya lon pa gnyis la lus kyi lang tsho dar rgud la khyad par med ces smras pa dang 'dra bas legs par soms shig gsungs/ de 'e tshos bsam na shin tu bden te/ dper na ma bzang mo zhig gis bu chung zhig gso na/ chung dus rtag tu blta rtog byed dgos/ yar lo bzhi lnga song tshe sngar gyi de 'dra tsam mi dgos/bcu nyi shu gyur tshe mel tshe gang yang mi dgos par kho rang gis rang tshugs zin pa mig gis mthong ba la ltos/ mi 'ga' zhig gis me zhig 'bud rgyu yin na/ dang po me kha gso dus dang /bar du me kha sos/ tha ma me 'bar dus kyi rtsol sgrub la drag zhan che chung mtha' gcig tu ma nges pa dang 'dra ba'o/ /de ltar skyong shes na nyon mongs dang shes sgrib gnyis dang bral ba'i mthar thug thob bya chos sku'am sangs rgyas kyi thugs rnam par 226

mi rtog pa'i ye shes mngon du byed dgos te/ dbu ma rin chen sgon ma las/ dper na shing gnyis drag tu drud pa las me byung bas shing 'tshig par gyur pa na/ ske nyid kyang shi ba bzhin du/shes rab kyang med par 'gyur ro/ /'di'i don yang 'phags pa 'od srung gis zhus pa'i mdo las byung ba dang / gzhan 'phags pa rgyan stug po'i mdo las kyang / ji ltar bsreg par byed pa'i me/ /bsreg bya med pas mi gnas so/ /de bzhin bsreg bya'i lta tshig la/ /stong nyid me yang 'gag par 'gyur/ /lta ba 'gog pa'i dus su yang / /ye shes me yang mi 'byung ste/ /nyon mongs thams cad bsreg par byed/ /nyon mongs bsreg na rnam par mdzes/ /zhes gsungs so/ /bde ba chen po'i zhal snga nas kyang / lta ba'i bud shing phung bo rags/ /stong nyid me yis bsreg byas nas/ /'dir ni zhi ba la gnas na/ /de bzhin nyid kyi me yang 'gag /zhes gsungs/ jo bo rjes/ rnam rtog las byung srid pa 'di/ /rnam par rtog pa'i bdag nyid de/ /de phyir ma lus rtog spangs pa/ /mya ngan 'das pa mchog yin no/ /zhes dang / rje rgya ras pas/ bsgom sked chen po sangs rgyas sa/ /bya rtsol thams cad bral ba yin/ /zhes gsungs so/ /des na dbu ma'i lta ba mthon por gyur pa'i skabs kyi skyong tshul phyag rdzogs 227

dang khyad med/ phyag rdzogs lta ba rnam dag yin pa tsam du ma zad/ lta ba mthon po yin te/ rje bla ma'i rnam thar chen mo las/rdzogs chen gyi lta ba rnam dag yin min zhus pa la/ rje'i zhal nas/ rnam dag yin gsungs/ grub chen las kyi rdo rje'i gsang bdag la dris pas/ gsang ba'i bdag po'i zhal nas/ rdzogs chen lta ba mthon po yin gsungs/ rdzogs chen gyi lta ba rnam dag yin na phyag chen pa dag shugs kyis 'byung te/ phyag rdzogs kyi lta ba khyad par med/ dper na skas rkang zhig la 'dzeg nas steng du 'gro ba la/skas rkang 'og ma thog ma'i grogs dang / thog ma 'og ma'i grogs su 'gro ba bzhin/ shes na dbu rdzogs phyag gsum gyi lta ba gcig grogs su gcig 'gro ste/ rje btsun mi las/ so sor rtogs pa'i shes rab kyis dpyod pa ltag mthong rtogs pa'i thabs med mi rung skas rkang 'og ma dang 'dra gsungs/ gzhan las/ thabs 'di rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyis/ /skas kyi rim pa lta bur gsungs/ /des na blo gros can rnams kyis thog mar dbu ma'i lta ba la bag chags ci thebs byas/ de nas phyag rdzogs kyi lta ba bsnan na shin tu ngo mtshar/des na gsar rnying su yin yang lam zhugs rnams sngon tsho 'dra ba ma yin par sud sud cig gis song dbugs zad/ chos kyi 228

mgo rnga ma zhig ma 'dzom pa 'dra ba e yin thugs bsam re thongs/ gcig gis gcig spangs na skas rkang 'og ma bcag nas 'phangs pa dang 'dra bas mkhas par ma bsam/ de'i ldog phyogs de soms dang yin/thabs dang shes rab rnams gcig grogs su gcig 'gro na/ lta ba gong 'og rnams gcig grogs su gcig 'gro ba sgos ci dgos/ des na phyag rdzogs 'di bstan pa'i gral du chud par ma zad/ gral rim zhig bsgrig rgyu zhig gi dbang du song na/ gral gyi gong zhig na yod tshod du 'dugayang 'ga' res rje rin po che'i bstan pa 'di rgya chung chung zhig tu bzung nas/ phyag rdzogs pas kyang / khong tsho bkag yod pa ma gtogs gral na med snyam/ rje rin po che dang / lam rim sngags rim tsho khas gtong ba de/ dper na rang gi rin po che rgyal po'i dkor mdzod du bzhag nas yod pa ngo ma shes par mi 'dug phangs zer sems khral byas/ phyug po ser sna che'i mdzod na rin po che med hral hrul yin zer khas gtong ba dang mtshungs/ gsar ma bas kyang phyag rdzogs sogs gzhung bzang mtha' dag bstan pa'i gral du ma chud tsho zer/ gral dbu na yod pa ma shes par phyag rdzogs par khas gtong ba de/ mgron po khyim du chud kyang khye rgan sga nas zug pa dang 'dra bas/ de'i kha 229

rtsad gcod sus byed/ de rang gzhan gnyis gas rje rin po che'i dgongs pa ma lon par rje dang rje'i gsung rab la smad pa yin pas bstod par ma sems/ rje rin po che'i zhal gyi bum bzang las/ 'dzam gling mkhas pa yongs kyi gtsug gi rgyan/ /snyan pa'i ba dan 'gro na lhang nge ba/ /klu sgrub thogs med gnyis las rim bzhin du/ /legs brgyud byang chub lam gyi rim pa yis/ /skye dgu'i 'dod don ma lus skong bas na/ /gdams pa rin chen dbang gi rgyal po ste/ /gzhung bzang stong gi chu bo 'du ba'i phyir/ /dpal ldan legs par bshad pa'i rgya mtsho'ang yin/ /bstan pa thams cad 'gal med rtog pa dang / /gsung rab ma lus gdams par 'char ba dang / /rgyal ba'i dgongs pa bde blag rnyed pa dang / /nyes spyod chen po'i g.yang sa las kyang bsrung / /de phyir rgya bod mkhas pa'i skye bo ni/ /skal bzang du mas bsten pa'i gdams pa mchog /skyes bu gsum gyi lam gye rim pa yis/ /yid rab mi 'phrog dpyod ldan su zhig yod/ /gsungs pa rnams la phyag rdzogs dbu gsum gyi blo gros can rnams kyis zhib tu soms dang / nang na go rgyu chen po yod/'di rgya chung chung zhig min/ dper na gangs chu rdza chu bsil ma sogs/ sa steng gi chu phran thams cad rgya mtshor 'dus pa chu 230

phran 'di zhes ming so sor btags/ tha dad du rgya mtsho'i nang na rme gnas kyang rgya mtsho'i kha zhabs phyogs mtshams na 'dres nas yod pa bzhin/ rje bdag nyid chen po'i bstan pa 'di'i nang du gzhung bzang mtha' dag 'dus pas/ phyag rdzogs zhes so sor ming btags nas/ legs bshad nang na ma 'dres par tha dad du med kyang / lam rim sngags rin chen mo rim lnga gsal sgon sogs/ rje nyid kyi gsung 'bum gyi thog mtha' bar gsum na mi mngon par 'dres nas rgyas par yod pas/rang gzhan su yin yang 'di la ma 'dus lus yod ni zhig yod ma bsam/ dper na sman pa mkhas pa zhig gis rjes 'jug slob mas sman ngo shes pa'i slad du/ nad bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi'i gnyen po'i sman gyi rigs mtha' dag bsdus nas shog thum byas yod pa/ de 'dra'i sman gyi rigs gzhan na ri bzhin brtsigs yod tshad shog thum nang gi sman de chung kyang ngo shes tshe sman pa mkhas pa'i slob ma blo gros can gyis de dug red ces 'dor ba phar zhog 'di na da sman mang po 'dug zer teb langs ci thub len pa ltar/ rje rin po ches rjes 'jug gdul bya rnams kyis chos ngo shes pa'i slad du/ sems can gyi nyon mongs brgyad khri bzhi stong gi gnyen po/ mdo rgyud bstan bcos thams cad kyi 231

nang nas cung zad re blangs nas phyogs gcig tu bsdus te glegs bam byas yod pa yin/ de 'dra'i mdo rgyud bstan bcos rgya chen po yang / rje bdag nyid chen po'i legs bshad la brten nas gdams ngag yin par ngo shes tshe/ rje nyid kyi rjes 'jug blo gros can gyis de chos log red ces khas gtong ba phar zhog 'di na da gdams ngag zab mo 'dug ces dad pa byas nyams su ci lon byed dgos/ rje rin po che sangs rgyas tshar nas gdul bya'i snang ngor ngur smrig 'dzin pa'i tshul bzung ba yin pas/ rgyal ba'i gsung 'di la nyams len ma mdzad/'di mi mkhyen zhes bya ba cung zad kyang med pas grub mtha' gcig gi kha 'dzin mdzad pa'i skyes bu ma yin/ grub mtha' thams cad kyi bdag po yin/ phyag rdzogs sogs gzhan grub mtha' bzang bzang mtha' dag tha na phyi rol pas kyang gzhung bzang sgra snyan dngags sogs gang bzang thams cad rje rin po che bstan pa rin po che'i 'di'i khungs su 'dus/ sngon bod du sngags pa tshan gcig gis chang phud gtor ba la khrel nas/sngags pa lha mo 'bar bya bas chang phud gtor nas/ dkon mchog gsum po bzhes/ chos skyong srung ma bzhes/ dus gsum bla ma bzhes/ 'gro drug sems can bzhes/ da lus rgyu cang 232

gda' ye zer ba bzhin/ rje rin po che'i bstan pa 'di la rgyal ba'i gsung rab mdo rgyud man ngag gang yang ma 'dus pa med/de ltar 'dod na/ lam rim bsdus don dbyangs byas nas/skye dgu'i 'dod don ma lus skong bas na/ /gdams pa rin chen dbang gi rgyal po ste/ /zhes bton na shin tu bden/ ming don mthun pas rje rin po che yang thugs kyi dgongs pa mtha' dag skong pa yin pas thugs dgyes/ de ltar mi 'dod na dbyangs byas/ gzhung bzang stong gi chu bo 'du ba'i phyir/ /dpal ldan legs par bshad pa'i rgya mtsho'ang yin/ /zer ba kha stong nang gi tshig stong yin/ stong mi dgos bcu yang mi 'dus soms dang / ha go yongs/ dper na bu ngan 'ga' res sa zhing gzhi ma mkhar khang / rgyu nor mang po yod pa kho'i min zhes khas btang nas gzhan la khyer du bcug pa dang 'dra bas/ bu skyes ni ma yin rul ni yin/ rje bdag nyid chen po yang thugs mi bde bar gtad pa yin pas/ thugs mnyes par ma sems de la thugs mnyes na phyag rdzogs pa'i cang mi shes pa'i blun po khas gtong mkhan la cis mi mnyes/ khas btang pa la khyad med pa'i phyir ro/ /da ngas bsam na phyag rdzogs dbu gsum su yin yang / rje rin po che'i bstan pa 'di rgya chung chung zhig la 233

go mi rung snyam ste/ blo gros can gyis soms dang / 'di na kun la dad pa skyes pa'i gnad zab mo zhig snang / de bzhin du klong gsal las/ ston pa thugs rje chen po yis/ /'dul byed theg pa mang gsungs kyang / /bsdu na rdzogs pa chen por 'dus/ /gsungs pa ltar rdzogs chen gyi lam bzang kun mkhyen klong chen rab 'byams pas phye ba'i mdzod bdun shing rta gsum sogs na'ang / rje bdag nyid chen po'i legs bshad mtha' dag 'dus nas yod/ ming gi khyad min med/ mkhas grub thams cad kyis rgyal ba'i gsung rab la gzhi byas/ legs bshad rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum brtsams nas/ gdul bya la bstan pa mi rgyas pa thams cad gang na rgyas pa yod sa nas kha bkang dgos/'di e rung snyam dgos mi dgos chos thams cad bu ram gyi sgor mo dang mtshungs/ phyogs gang nas zos kyang zhim pa bzhin/ gang nyams su blangs kyang 'tshengs pa yin/ blo gros can rnams kyis phyag rdzogs dbu gsum gyi dpe cha la blta dgos par ma zad/ gzhan bon po yan chad kyi dpe cha la ltos dang / thos rgyu rig rgyu go rgyu gcig re yod/ khron pa'i sbal bas chu 'khyil de yar rnyogs mar rnyogs byas bsdad nas/ rgya mtsho khas gtong ba bzhin/ grub mtha' rer zhen nas/ de 234

phar rdzogs tshur rdzogs byas/ 'di las zab pa zhig yod rgyu ma red snyam/ gzhan gyi gzhung bzang mtha' dag khas ma gtong dang bzang / yang 'ga' res/ khyed kyis dper na/ nor gye rmig pa dang rwa gnyis mthun shas che gi snyam nas/ rmig pa phud nas mgo la bzhag mgo'i rwa rdzogs nas rkang mgor btags nas sngar bas btsog bcos pa ltar/ phyag rdzogs pa dang dbu ma'i lta ba mthon por song ba'i skabs kyi skyong tshul gnyis mthun gi snyam nas/ phyag rdzogs pa'i lta ngan mtho zer na dbu ma'i lta ba'i gong du bzhag rgyal dbang lnga bas/ dbu rdzogs phyag gsum lta ba bod 'dir grags/ /dbu ma klu sgrub bzhed srol lta ba'i rtse/ /gsungs pa 'gab tu bzhag nas/ sngar bas btsog pa byas 'dug pa/ grub mtha' thams cad gcig gis gcig la dad gus dag snang zhig byung na ci ma rung snyam nas/lhag bsam bzang bo'i sgo nas bshad ni yin na/ byis pas pha ma la bslab bya smras na snying rje nas sgrub pa ltar/ skyon mi snang mthun 'gyur byed/ de ma yin par phyogs lhung gis kun nas bslang dbu ma'i lta ba smad ni yin na khyod la ga ler byas 'dri rgyu mang po snang / khyed kyis pho dpa' med rgya skad kha na yod/ /dgra la la shom gyis thul yang thang / /zer ba ltar khyed kyis 235

nged tsho blo gros chung / chos chen po la ma sbyangs pas lan pa yin tsho zer/ shom byas chum rgyab pa/ la las bden snyam yang /ma bcang wa rnga sbom po/ bcang na wa rnga sud po zer ba ltar/'di ltar bshad dus khyed blo gros che che 'dug ste/ 'ga' rtsod rgyu yin na blo gros su che/ chos chen po sus sbyangs blta rgyu yod/sde gzu gtam mkhan gyi mi 'ga' res kha 'cham byed dus gzhan des ma smras pa'i gtam snyan smra gi zhes 'dra 'dra 'grig 'grig bshad na phal cher 'grigs/ phal cher gyes de bshad mi bshad kho'i yid la yod zer ha bgad byed pa ltar/ khyod kyis dbu rdzogs phyag gsum e 'grig snyam/ gcig gcig gis khas mi len pa yang len gi zhes 'dra 'dra 'grig 'grig gi chos bshad mang po bshad pa la blun po mgo bo 'khor nas gcig gcig la dad kyang blo gros can rnams mgo bskor ga la nus/lhag par bzhad gad kyi gnas yin/ mdo las kyang / bsreg bcad brdar ba'i gser bzhin du/ /legs par brtags la nga yi bka'/ /blangs par bya yi gus phyir min/ /gsungs/ lung las/ rgyal ba nyid kyi tha ma'i bka' chems su'ang / mdo sde dang mi mthun/ 'dul ba na mi snang / chos nyid dang 'gal na sus smras kyang dor zhing / lung rigs dang mthun na legs par 236

blangs gsungs/ rang ga khye dang glo ba 'phrad pa bzhin/ chos zhig gi ming thog tshad la rub gtong ga la rung / a khu ri khrod pa zer na/ 'o /ba thur du 'gro ltas/ ra rbab du 'gril zer ba ltar/khyod kha dmyal bar 'gro ltas/ dpe 'jo ga sa de'i btsog re ltos/ khyod kyis su bstod nas su smad ni yin zer a kha kha/ 'e tsho'i shes rgyud g.yag rwa bzhin gyong 'dug tshul 'dir bltas na/rwa 'dra ba'i chos zhig nyams su len gi yod ni zhig dang rig giban+dhe gcig la bla rgan gcig gis chos bslabs nas bla rgan tshig pa zos spro langs nas/ dpe chas badhe'i mgo la brgyab pas glegs shing dkyil nas chags tshe/ badhe na re/ a ho 'di nga la nyan rung chos rdo rje gcod pa e nyan nam smras pa ltar/ ngas bla ma dam pa'i gsung bzhin kun la dad gus skye phyir lung rigs kyi lam nas chos cung zad bshad pa/ yar gyi rwa sne dang mar gye rmig sne brjes zhes dpe ngan bzhag nas bshad pa 'di nga la nyan rung / rje bdag nyid chen po dpal gsang ba'i bdag po sogs kyi lta ba rnam dag mthon po yin zhes zhal gyis bzhes pa dang / dbu rdzogs phyag gsum gyi chos bzang po la/'di zer e nyan nam/ rgyal dbang rin po ches/ nam mkha'i pha mtha' gzhal dka'i sems can gyi/ /dbang po dang 'tshams 237

sgrib gnyis gnyen po ru/ /rgyal bas legs gsungs bgrang yas chos phung tshogs/ /bsdu na rgyu 'bras theg pa gnyis su 'du/ /mtha' dag 'gro la sman pa sha stag las/ /don med don log ston par mi srid kyang / /myur du sangs rgyas sgrub thabs gsang sngags kyi/ /nye lam 'di ko gzhan las khyad par 'phags/ /de yi nang nas theg pa kun gyi rtse/ /a ti rdzogs pa chen po'i man ngan gis/ /phung bo 'od skur tshe 'dir grol nus pas/ /lam 'di bde gshegs rnams kyi byon pa'i shul/ /zhes rnying phyogs gsungs dus rdzogs chen theg pa kun gyi yang rtse yin zhes gsungs 'dug 'di khyod blo gros che/ chos rgya chen po sbyangs pa'i stabs kyis ma go ba e yin/ khong rnams kyis 'di 'dra gsungs pa thams cad la gdul bya la phan pa'i dgongs gzhi mang po yod pa yin yang / khyod kyis rgyal dbang gis kyang gnyis bshad byas 'dug ces khas ma gtong / phyag 'tshal/sku mkhyen/ khyod kyi blo gros che zhing / chos rgya chen po sbyangs pa'i ha da ga na ro go de yin na khyod kyis mgo 'jig rten chos brgyad ma gtogs gzhan nga 'dra'i chos bshad kyis bskor ga la nus/da khyod spro ma ldangs dang nged gnyis kyi blo gros lcags ngan ma rig log rtog gi g.ya' zhen pa'i sag brdar rtul po 'di 238

'dra'i rgyal ba'i gsung rab dgongs 'grel 'dzam bu chu bo'i gser sbyangs btso ma lta bu brtag dpyad kyis brdar nas blangs pa yin ma snyam/ brdar zer ba gcig go ba bzang gi khyad dang nged gnyis kyi blo gros brdar ngan gyis/ gsung rab gser sbyangs ma chod tshe/ bzang kyang 'phang nyen che bas/ de bas blo gros ngan pa'i brdar ngan su la ma ston par sbos/ yin rung min rung gsung rab yin zer tshad blangs na nyen chung snyam/ mdo sde dang mi mthun/ 'dul ba la mi snang / chos nyid dang 'gal ni khyod nged gnyis kyis nyin bzhin bca' gi 'dug ste sus smras kyang / de mi dor bar bltas na kha rjes che gi lung rigs dang mthun na longs gsungs pa nged gnyis kyi bya spyod la bltas na/ gcig kyang mi mthun par 'dug pas len rgyu zhig mi snang / da khyod kyis bshad pa ltar khyi dang glo ba 'phrad pa ltar/rnyed bkur gyi steng du rub dang bzang / chos kyi steng du rub ga la rung / de khyod bden/ zhe 'dod dang lag len phyin ci log tu song ba'i phyir ro/ /yang khyod kyis bshad pa phal cher lung rib/sa dang cung mthun pas khas len/ da phyag rdzogs pa'i lta ba rnam dag yin zhes gtan nas khas len mi thub/ khyed kyi sems la ma gnod/ sngon mi zhig gi glu blangs nas/ 'brong bre 239

ser blo phug rdza la gtad/ /rdza 'go rdugs yin nam ma snyam 'dug /stag dar ma'i blo phug nags la gtad/ /nags 'dab zad yin nam ma snyam 'dug /mi snyom chung blo phug dpon la gtad/ /dpon gnya' gnon yin nam ma snyam 'dug /zer ba ltar phyag rdzogs pas kho bo'i 'di bzang snyam/blo phug gtad pa'i lung 'dren thams cad la rje thams cad mkhyen pas 'di gsungs 'dug sa khu ri khrod pa khyed kyis bshad bshad nas ngal yod/ bar skabs 'dir ga le gyis/ snyan tshur cig g.yor dang zhu rgyu snang / gang yin shod dang ang zer na/ kha sbyor las/ stong pa bsgom par mi bya ste/ /stong min bsgom par mi bya'o/ /stong pa mi spongs rnal 'byor pas/ /stong min yongs su mi spong ngo / /stong dang mi stong bzung ba la/ /rtogs pa nyung min skye bar 'gyur/ /zhes stong mi stong gang du mi 'dzin par gsungs pa de/ kun rdzob tu yang ma grub pa'i chad stong dang / don dam par mai stong par 'dzin pa'i rtog pa gnyis bsgom pa bkag pa yin gyis/ rang bzhin med pa'i stong nyid du'ang bzung mi rung bar ston pa min te/ lung de'i gong du/chos dbyings shin tu mnyam pa nyid/ /chu shing lta bur yod pa yongs su bzung / /zhes snying bo'am rang bzhin med par 240

bzung bar gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /byang chub sems 'grel las/skye med dang ni stong nyid dang / /bdag ces bya ba stong pa nyid/ /bdag nyid dman pa gang bsgoms pa/ /de de bsgom par byed pa min/ /gsungs pa de/ stong nyid bdag med pa'i don la/ bden par 'dzin mi rung gsungs pa yin te/'jig rten las 'das par bstod pa las/ kun brtag thams cad bsal ba'i phyir/ /stong nyid bdud rtsi stong mdzad na/ /gang zhig de la zhen gyur pa/ /de nyid khyod kyis shin tu smad/ /ces gsungs/ rang bzhin med par bzung mi rung gsungs pa ma yin te/ de yin na sher snying las/ phung bo lnga bo de dag la'ang rang bzhin gyis stong pa rnam par yang dag par rjes su blta'o/ /zhes gsungs pa la sogs pa'i lung du ma dang 'gal ba'i phyir ro/ /lung 'di 'dra'i rigs phyin ci log tu go nas/hwa shang gi rjes su 'brangs mkhan mang / zhes gsungs 'dug pas/phyag rdzogs pa bsam blo thongs/ lta stangs mtho rung lta ba mtho rgyu mi snang / ya da a khu ri khrod pa thams cad mkhyen pa mi mkhyen dgu mkhyen sang la phyag 'tshal lo/ /skyabs su mchi'o/ /lan gsungs dang ga le byas nyan zer na/ 'dod/ dar cig gson dang / mi mkhyen dgu mkhyen ltar ma mkhyen rung / re re 241

gnyis gnyis shes yang thang / khyod kyis phyag rdzogs pa bsam blo thongs tsho zer shed kyis ma bshad dang / phyag rdzogs pas gsar ma ba sang ma skyes pa'i sngon zhig nas bsam blo btang btang ba zhig red/ de 'chug dogs med/ o rgyan pad+ma yang rig pa'i gnas lnga mkhyen pa'i paṇ+ḍi ta zhig yin rab yod/bsam blo btang btang nas 'chi med rdo rje'i sku brnyes song /rje btsun mi la ras pa yang kun shes gcig sdug cig yin rab med/ gcig shes kun grol zhig yin rab yod/ bsam blo btang btang bas tshe gcig lus gcig la zung 'jug gi sku brnyes song / de bzhin du phyag rdzogs pa'i bsam blo gtong mkhan la de'i cha 'dra byung 'dug pas/ rje bdag nyid chen po'i gsung re'i dgongs pa ma lon par phyag rdzogs zhes gzhan thams cad spyi bsdus byas khas ma gtong dang bzang / rje rin po che'i gdul bya blo kha rab 'bring tha gsum thad ka thad gar dgongs nas gsungs pas gong 'og tu khyer mi chog pa mang po yod/ rje nyid gyi gsung re re tsam rgyal ba'i gsung rab thams cad kyi thog mtha' bar gsum du 'khyer na e 'grig bsam blo thongs/ skyes bu gsum gyi lam gyi rim pas kyang / skyes bu chung ngu'i bde 'gro don gnyer gyi blo/ skyes bu 'bring la 'khrid dus 242

bde 'gro don gnyer gyi blo de 'dor dgos sam mi dgos/skyes bu 'bring gi zhi bde don gnyer gyi blo skyes nas/ skyes bu chen por 'khrid dus skyes bu 'bring gi skabs kyi rang nyid zhi bde don gnyer gyi blo 'dor dgos sam mi dgos/ skyes bu chung 'bring gi blo de ma dor bzhin du/ khyed tsho'i byang chub gyi sems bskyed pa e yin/ 'jig rten na'ang rgan gzhon byes pa'i kha zas gcig yin nam/ tha dad yin/ de bzhin du lta ba yang las dang po ba dang / cung zad brtan pa thob/ rab tu brtan pa thob pa'i skyong tshul mi 'dra zhes sngar rgyal dbang thams cad mkhyen pas ma gsung ngam/ bsam blo mi gtong bar glen pas u tshugs byas pa de 'gro sa gcig dang mi 'gro sa kun yod/ de bzhin lta ba'i skyong tshul thams cad mtha' gcig tu bzung na/ de 'gros brgya dang mi 'gros stong yod/ gzhan khas ma gtong btang na/ bu ngan skyes na pha la brdung ba ltar/ o rgyan pad+mas bstan pa btsugs pa la skur ba btab nas drin log par gzhal bar yang 'gyur/ dper na chu mgo nas rnyog yod na mjug lhag par mi dwangs pa bzhin/ o rgyan pad+ma'i lta ba gnad du ma song na/ khyed sang yang mi dag par 'gyur/gang la yid ches blo gtad gcig med par 'gyur/ sngon mas ma 243

mkhyen smra na ngo yang tsha/ o rgyan dang rje 'bangs thams cad kyis lta ba gnad du ma song bar/ 'e tshos gnad du song ba de su la bshad/ grol song na gnad du ma song / ma grol na gnad la song ba yin nam zhes dris na khyod kyis ci zer bsam blo thongs/khyed kyis dris lan dngos la phyag rdzogs pa 'ga' res 'di skad zer 'dug khong tsho'i 'di tshig don ji bzhin pa yin pas 'jug dogs med/ ma 'chug pa'i rtags su khong sang la gangs can 'dzin ma'i khyon 'di dogs por bgyi nus pa'i grub pa'i dbang phyug chen po nam mkha'i skar tshogs tsam byung / rgyal dbang gis kyang / rgya bod gnyis ka rtogs grol dus gcig tu/ /byung ba'i ngo mtshar lo rgyus pha mtha' yas/ /gsungs/bshad na brjod kyi mi lang / 'chug yod med grub thob kyi mang nyung brtsis/ bsam blo gtong rgyu mchod cig med/ khyed sang gi 'di 'dra'i rigs mang po mkhas pa bca' rgyu yin zer/ phyin ci log tu go nas/ yar bskyed las mar bskyed che ba byung /khyed sang kha snga ba ma gtogs/ bsam blo gtong na khyed sang la nged tshos thongs zhes bshad dgos pa'i ched du 'dug zer/ da ngas bsam na de yang ma red/ 'o na khyod kyi ci zer zer na ngas de thams cad bden zer/ ya rgyu mtshan shod dang nyan nas 244

bsdad yod zer na/ spyir mi rtog pa gsungs pa de yang / dge ba'i phyogs la nyin mtshan du rtog cing dpyod pa las/ gzhan mi dge phyogs nam yang yid la mi byed pa'i mi rtog pa/ so sor rtogs pa'i shes rab kyis dpyad nas chos thams cad ming gis phar btags pa ma gtogs/ rang bzhin grub pa rdul tsam yang med par stong par nges pa'i nges shes de nyid kyi rgyun skyong ba las/ gzhan chos thams cad tshugs thub bden grub tu 'dzin pa'i blo thams cad yid la mi byed pa'i mi rtog pa/ chos thams cad rang bzhin gyis ma grub par gnas lugs stong par gtan la phab nas bsgom mkhan gye blo de yang rang bzhin gyis e grub dpyad nas/ rang bzhin rdul tsam med par stong par gyur pa'i ngang la shes pa lhod kyis glod tshe/ stong pa yin pa la gsal zhing dwangs pa/ gsal stong dbyer med pa la kha mthon pe nas ston gnam g.ya' dag pa la bltas pa lta bu'i gsal sing nge ba zhig phar blo yis bcos pa ma yin par/ tshur rang bzhin shugs kyis 'char ba'i ngang du mnyam par 'jog pa las/gzhan stong mi stong sogs bzang ngan gye rtog pa phra rags gang yang yid la mi byed pa'i mi rtog pa sogs mang bas mtha' gcig tu 'dzin pa ni/ dper na nas 'bras shig lag tu bzung 245

nas 'bras thams cad 'di 'dra yin dgos/ 'di dang mi mthun pa 'bras ma yin zhes 'bras gzhan dor ba dang 'dra bas/ chos spong gi las ngan pa gsog pa'i rtsa ba yin la/ de bzhin du thabs dang shes rab lta bsgom spyod pa 'bras bu sogs kyang mtha' yas mtha' gcig tu bzung nas/ gzhan 'dor ba ni thub pa'i bstan dgra ma rungs pa zhig byung ba yin pas gzhan ma sems/ sgos su sangs rgyas kyi gsung re re la yang go lugs mi 'dra ba tha dad byung / go lugs mi 'dra ba rnams kyang go log go ba ma yin/ dper na sbyin gtong mkhan gyis mi dbul bo che chung mang po la zas sna tshogs kyis sbyin pa btang na/spyir mi thams cad 'tsho ba'i zas yin pa dang / mi thams cad la zo zhes byin ni'ang yin mod/ 'on kyang byes pas de'i tshod kyi zas zos/ rgan pas de'i tshod kyi zas ma zos na/ rgan pa'i za rgyu sha thud/ byes pa'i kha nang du brdzang na zas bzang kyang log par song nas 'chi bar pha mas shes nas re zhig gi bar du sha thud mi ster bar rtsam nyogs sogs byin nas gso ba ltar/rgyal bas gdul bya rnams la spyir lta ba'i sgo mo mtha' yas pa gsungs pa gdul bya grol ba'i lta ba yin mod/ de bzhin nyams su longs zhes gsungs pa'ang yin mod/ 'on kyang tshe snga mar 246

stong phyogs la gtan nas blo kha ma phyogs/tha na rna bas kyang ma go ba'i skal dman dang / tshe 'dir yang chos la blo kha ma phyogs/khyad par chos thams cad rang bzhin gyis ma grub pa'i gnas lugs cung zad kyang ma rtogs pa'i byis pa lta bu la/ lta ba mthon po'i skabs kyi skyong tshul sha thud lta bu bstan na log pa yin pa mkhyen nas/ rje rin po ches/ de 'dra'i gdul bya snyigs dus 'dir mang bas phan che bar dgongs nas/ de skad gsungs pa yin/ de yang thugs shin tu mad de/ blo bzang chos kyi nyi ma'i zhal nas/ mthon po'i lta ba de lta bu ni/o rgyan chen po sogs byon pa'i dus skabs bzang bo'i gdul bya dbang bo yang rab tu gyur pa de dag la rgyud tshod dang 'tshams pa'i dbang gis/ mngon du gyur par snang yang / deng sang gi skye bo shes rgyud tha mal las cung zad kyang ma 'phags pa dag la/lta ba mthon po de lta bus phan pa las/ cig shos su 'gyur ba'i nyen che bar sems gsungs/ dpon ston rin chen sgang pas/chos rgyud dang 'tshams par mi byed par/ /theg pa la mtho snyegs byed pa 'di/ /rta rgod la bu chung bskyon pa 'dra/ /rang rgyud dang 'tshams pa 'di gal re che/ /zhes dang / mdo las kyang / byes dang rgan pa'i kha zas tha dad bzhin/ /de yi chos 247

kyi rang bzhin tha dad do/ /zhes dang / gzhan yang / rnal 'byor pa yi blo khyad kyi/ /gong ma gong ma dag gis gnod/ /gsungs so/ /de 'dra'i rigs can la phyag rdzogs pa'i bla ma mkhas pas kyang / lam la rim pas slob tu 'jug pa'i dgongs pa mthun no/ /dper na mas chung nas bskyangs pa'i bu gzhon nu lang tsho dar la babs/ bsam shes gang du song nas bsdad kyang rang tshugs thub/ blang dor shes pa la sha thud sogs ster ba ltar/ tshe sngon mar lam la yang dang yang du sbyangs sbyangs pas grol la khad kyi skal ldan las 'phro can dang /tshe 'dir yang mtshan ldan gyi bla mas lam thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pas rgyud sbyangs/ chos thams cad sgyu ma rmi lam ltar rang bzhin gyes ma grub cing / nam mkha'i brda' sprin ltar sems kyi rol ba yin pa la/ lung rig gis nges shes drangs/'khor 'das kyi rtsa ba rang sems skye 'gag gnas gsum dbyibs kha dog gang du yang ma grub par/ nam mkha' ltar stong gsal 'dzin med du sgo 'dogs bcad/ nges shes 'drongs nas 'khor 'das gang la nyam nga bag tsha med pa'i rnal 'byor du gyur tshe khyung chen nam mkha' la lding ba bzhin gnas lugs stong gsal mtha' dbus dang bral ba'i mnyam bzhag nam 248

mkha' lta bu'i ngang der blos 'dzin rtsol dang bral bar 'jog bsgom byed du 'jug pa yin te/ de la dgongs nas/ bram ze chen po sa rā ha'i zhal nas/ dngos po ra lta ba phyugs dang 'dra ba ste/ /dngos med lta ba de las shin tu blun/ /zhes dang /rtog ge dgos pa med kyi sngar bas chog par zad/ /gang la dmigs kyang dmigs pa de yis thar ba bsgrib/ /bzang por btags kyang de yi nad kyis dman par ltung / /dman pa'i las la spyad pa'i rnam smin rgyun mi chad/ /ces dang / gang zhig rtog ge'i lam nas chos nyid la 'khrid na/ /de nyid thub pa'i bstan la chos srid nyams pa'ang yin/ /gsungs/ rje mi las/ lar bsgom pa nyid kyang rtog pa la/ /mi bsgom pa yang rtog pa ste/ /bsgom dang mi bsgom gnyis su med/ /gnyis 'dzin lta ba 'khrul ba'i gzhi/ /mthar thug don la lta ba med/ /'di kun sems kyi mtshan nyid de/ /nam mkha'i mtshan nyid dper bzhag nas/ /don chos nyid gtan la 'bebs pa yin/ /da khyod lta ba blo 'das kyi don la ltos/ /sgom pa yengs med kyi ngang du zhog /spyod pa shugs 'byung 'gags med skyongs/ /'bras bu re dogs tha snyad spongs/ /gsungs/ dwags po chen po'i zhal nas/ bsgom bya sgom byed gnyis dang bral/ /249

gnyis 'dzin mdud pa zhig te thal/ /zhes dang / grub chen gling ras pas/ nam mkha' lta bu'i rnal 'byor pas/ /sems spros dang bral ba'i ngang la zhog /ces dang / mdo sdud pa las/phung 'di stong zhes rtog na'ang byang chub sems dpa' ni/ /mtshan ma la spyod skye med gnas la dad ma yin/ /zhes dang / skye ba med dang skye ba gnyis gar mi rtog pa/ /'di ni shes rab pha rol phyin mchog spyod pa yin/ /zhes dang / gsang ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i rgyud las/ bzung ba dang ni 'dzin pa yi/ /dmigs pa thams cad rnam spangs te/ /sems nyid bsam du med pas na/ /ci yang bsam par mi bya'o/ /sems nyid stong par bcug nas ni/ /stong pa'ang sems su rab bcug nas/ /stong dang mi stong sogs rnam rtog /bcom pas nam mkha' lta bur 'gyur/ /bsgom pa nyid kyang rtog pa ste/ /mi bsgom pa yang rtog pa yin/ /bsgom du rdul tsam med pa la/ /yengs su skad cig med pa'o/ /'od gsal de la sems zin na/ /gzung 'dzin dgra yi g.yul rnams 'joms/ /phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten khams bcas pa'i/ /dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i mchod pa'i gnas/ /zhes dang / sam+bu ṭa las/ stong pa nyid du mi bsgom ste/ /mi stong pa yang bsgom pa min/ /stong dang mi stong 'dzin 250

pa las/ /tha mal pa yis rnam rtog skye/ /stong pa zhes bya'ang rtog pa ste/ /mi stong pa'ang rtog pa yin/ /des na 'di gnyis spang bar bya/ /'dzin pa gnyis ni yongs btang na/ /rnam par dag cing grol ba'i gnas/ /gang na'ang bsgom pa po med de/ /bsgom pa gang na'ang yod ma yin/ /bsgom bya cung zad yod min pas/ /de ni de nyid bsgom par brjod/ /rnam rtog rmongs pa chen po ste/ /'khor ba'i rgya mtshor lhung byed yin/ /mi rtog ting 'dzin la gnas na/ /mkha' bzhin dri ma med par 'gyur/ /zhes stong 'dzin gye blo de dang khrol la/ stong gsal mtha' dbus bral ba'i nyams de'i ngang la zhog ces gsal bar gsungs te/ stong nyid dngos por 'dzin mi rung / rang bzhin gyis ma grub par zungs zhes gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /'di yang 'di'i skabs ma gtogs gang zag rab 'bring tha gsum gyis thog mtha' bar gsum du 'di ltar gyis zhes gsungs pa ma yin pa'i ha go dgos/ skabs/ 'di'i skyong tshul ni zab mo dbu ma'i lta ba mthon por son skabs kyi skyong tshul ji bzhin pa dang /rje bdag nyid chen po'i dgongs pa thun mong ma yin pa'i nyams bzhes kyang yin ste/ rje bdag nyid kyi do ha sogs nas bshad pa sngags lam mthon po'i skabs kyi nyams len yin zhes 251

zhal gyis bzhes shing / khong gis lta ba'i dogs pa ma chod pa gsang bdag gis gsung bdud rtsi sman mchog nyams bzhes su gnang nas chod pa yin/ de phyag rdzogs kyi lta ba ji bzhin pa yin pa'i phyir ro/ /yang 'ga' res zhus lan bdud rtsi sman mchog la/ rdzogs chen pa gcig gi chu dang 'o ma bzhin bsre slad rgyab 'dug zer ba de la/ dgongs gzhi 'dra yod nas de skad smras pa yin na skyon mi gda'/ de min na chos rgya chen po ma sbyangs pas rang mtshang phyir bstan pa yin pas btsog te/khyod kyi rnam rtog rab rib dang mi mthun pa thams cad min na/chos phung brgyad khri bzhi stong khyod kyi sngon du 'jog rgyu yin na/min ni mang po 'bud sa snang / yang 'o na paṇa chen thams cad mkhyen pa blo bzang chos kyi rgyal mtshan gye sngon med legs bshad snyan rgyud phyag rgya chen po'i khrid yig na/ phyag rdzogs sogs zhi gnas kyi phyogs la bsdur rung tshom 'jog lta ba ltar snang thams cad la zhi gnas mdzad nas/ de sems kyi kun rdzob ngo sprod tshul yin zhes tshos kyi rgyal mtshan smras gsungs pa de khyod kyis phyag rdzogs kyi lta ba 'di mtho sar bzhag nas bzang tshul bzang rab brjod tshul 'di la bltas na/ paṇa chen thams cad mkhyen pas kun mkhyen kyang 'di ma mkhyen na 'chug 252

song ni yin rgyu red/ khong la ci byung / a ho gong du 'jog rgyu red no/ khyod kyis bzhag pa da bzang / khyod sngar med pa'i mi mkhyen dgu mkhyen pa'i ltas ngan ral pa can zhig byung / dge slong chos gos ral pa can/ /zhwa ser yongs kyi ltas ngan yin/ /de yang dmar chen gtor mas bzlog /ces lag pa thal mo brdab nas ha bgad ring thung mang po byas/ lan thongs shog ya zer na/ a ho/ khyod ci la bgad ni yin/ ngas khyod la sngar sgyes bu dam pa'i dgongs pa lon dka'/ mi lon brjod la zhes yang yang ma bshad dam/ da khyod kyis paṇa chen rin po che'i gsung gi dgongs pa ma lon par nga la mi mkhyen dgu mkhyen gyis ltas ngan sang tsho zer khas btang nas ha bgad byas kyang / chad na spad sgra dang / lhung na sdig sgra mi grag pa khyod kyi khe yin mod/ 'on kyang paṇa chen rin po che'am yang na dpal sa rā ha sogs sngon byon dam pa mang po'i gsung smad na/dkon mchog gi dbu 'phang smad par 'gyur bas/ khyod las go da bgod bgod pa'i mthar phyi nas ngu rgyu zhig mi 'ong ba'i phyir/ yang ngas khyod la lhag bsam bzang po med rung yod yod ltar byas nas/ sangs rgyas snang ba mtha' yas kyi sprul pa paṇa chen thams cad mkhyen pa mtshan snyan pa blo bzang chos kyi rgyal 253

mtshan gyi zhabs la phyag byas nas/ dgongs pa cung zad bshad pas/ khyod kyis khog nas snying khyes gtong mod/ 'on kyang rna bas dar cig nyon dang / khyod la mi phan kyang gzhan la phan yang thang / paṇa chen gyi gsung de phyag rdzogs gzhan grub mtha' spyi yongs su rdzogs pa zhi gnas tsam yin pas zhi gnas byas/ bde gsal mi rtog pa'i ting 'dzin byung tshad thams cad po sems kyi kun rdzob ngo sprod tshul yin nas de skad gsungs pa ga la yin/ khong gis mdzad pa'i phyag chen khrid yig gi lta ba'i thad na/ gzhan lugs thams cad kyi 'dod pa brjod nas/'di thams cad kyis dngos sam brgyud nas/ mthar thug rnam par mi rtog pa'i ye shes sam/ chos sku mngon du byed pa'i thabs sha stag yin pas don gyi dgongs pa phyogs gcig tu 'bab/ zhes gsungs/ khyad par dpal sa rā has mdzad pa'i do ha sogs ni sngags lam mthon po'i skabs kyi nyams len yin/ zhes rje rin po ches gsungs pa khong gis kyang thag bcad nas zhal bzhes gnang ba'i phyir ro/ /khyod kyis paṇa chen rin po che'i gsung phyag rgya chen po sngon med legs bshad yin zhes che ba brjod pa ya mtshan che yang / nyams su len pa phar zhog zhib tu yang gcig ma bltas dgongs pa ma lon par/254

paṇa chen gyi gsung ngam gzhan gang rung zhig khas gtong dgos byung ba khyod kyi mtshang du che/ de khyod la khag med/ nga rgyal gyi ri mtho/ chags sdang rmongs gsum gyi sprin 'thug phrag dog gi rlung 'tshub/ phyogs ris chags sdang gi char 'bab gi bsdad nas/ khyod kyi shes rab kyi mig gis ci tsam bltas kyang / paṇa chen thams cad mkhyen pa'i legs bshad dri med kyi nam mkha' sngo kyil le yod pa la/ grub mtha' che chung nyi zla gza' skar thams cad so sor ma 'dres par bkra sa le shar ba khyod kyis ma mthong ba yin pas/ da ngas khyod la rjen la phud nas ston pas ltos shig paṇa chen rin po ches/ de gang la dgongs nas gsungs na/ rgyal dbang thams cad mkhyen pas phyag chen gyi blun po kha gcig legs lam la 'god phyir lhag bsam bzang bo'i smod tshig tu sdom gsum gyi lung 'dren/ blun po phyag rgya che bsgom pa/ /phal cher dud 'gro'i rgyu ru gda'/ /gsungs pa dang / khong gis/ deng dus phyag chen zer ba'ang sems gnas tsam/ /lta ba yin gyis phyag chen dngos gnas min/ /gsungs pa dang / rje rin po ches stong nyid bsgom pa'i mi rtog pa gang zhig dang / stong nyid cung zad kyang ma rtogs pa'i mi rtog pa gnyis yod gsungs pa'i nang nas/ stong nyid cung 23 5

zad kyang ma rtogs pa'i mi rtog par 'jog pa de la dgongs nas de skad gsungs pa yin la/ de ltar mi 'dod na/ rje rin bo ches/ stong nyid bsgom pa'i mi rtog par bzhag pa blang byar bstan pa de yang min/ do ha sogs nas bshad pa lta ba mtho zhes khong rnam gnyis kyis zhal bzhes gnang ba de yang min/ sa rā ha pa/ pad+ma 'byung gnas/ mi la ras pa/ pha gcig dam pa/ma cig lab sgron/ nam mkha' rgyal mtshan sogs sngon mkhas grub tshad ldan gyi lta ba yang zhi gnas tsam yin/ sems kyi kun rdzob tsam min pa ma gtogs zhes skur ba btab par 'gyur bas/ khyod kyis go lugs de khams re che ga khyed la slob ma 'dra yod na gdams pa bstan pa tsam gyis dad gus dag snang tsho bral gi bral gi 'gro sa snang / gdams ngag zab bam mi zab rang gi rgyud steng nas 'jog ste/ rje skal ldan rgya mtshos/chos rang rang mos pa'i don zab/ /gsungs/ gang shar rang grol gyis/ gdams ngag zab mi zab de/ rang gi snying rus che chung yin/ gsungs pa ltar dad mos snying rus che na chos gang yin yang zab/ khyed nged gnyis kyi rgyud la bltas na/ paṇa chen rin po ches gsungs pa'i gdams pa zab mo/ don dam gye lta ba yang / nyams su len rgyu 'dra zhig yin na/ kun rdzob 256

las mi tshad/ kun dzun du gtong sa snang / paṇa chen rin po ches/ sems kyi kun rdzob ngo sprod tshul yin gsungs pa de yang ngan shos shig min te/ dper na ral gri'i 'phrul 'khor shes par 'dod pas thog mar shing gi ral gri la ma bslab par ga la shes/de bzhin du kum rdzob la ma brten par don dam rtogs ga la nus/ des kyang nam zhig rtogs zhes shugs kyis gsungs pa yin/ dper na me zhig gi steng du rtswa shing chag chog mang po bzhag nas yun ring rmugs na ser bu cung zad re'i rkyen byas 'ur gyes 'bar ba'am/ yang na khol mo gnyis tsam brgyab pas me lce 'ur gyis 'bar nas dngos po bsreg pa ltar/ rang sems me lta bu'i steng du/ zhi gnas rtswa shing chag chog lta bus bkang / rnam rtog me stag lta bu 'chal du bcug sems nang du bsdus nas me dar langs pa ltar byas pa/ bla ma'i byin rlabs ser bu lta bus rkyen byas/ lhag mthong me lta bu 'ur gyis sbar ba'am/ ma langs kyang so sor rtogs pa'i dpyad pa khol mo lta bu gnyis gsum tsam brgyab pas dka' las med par lhag mthong me lta bu 'bar nas nyon mongs pa'i bud shing ma lus bsreg par 'gyur ba'i phyag rdzogs blun po tsho yang / khyod kyis ma shes log rtog dug chu 'thung / chags sdang gi na zug 257

drag po langs/ ngan smras tshig rtsub kyi gshang gci dbang med du shor/ mi brdzod bdag brdzod byed pa las dga' ba yin/da rang sems glang chen smyon pa rnyed bkur glang mo'i phyir du rgyug zhor la/ rang gzhan dge ba'i pad tshal ma bcom dang bzang /khyod kyis gzhan skyes bu dam pa mkhas grub du mas mi mkhyen pa'i brnab sems gnod sems log lta gsum/ 'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug gsum/ nga rgyal phrag dog ser sna gsum dang /dgu bo 'di khyod kyis ma byen nas rgyun du lag len la 'debs par 'dug pas/ khyod la bltas na nga la dad gus dag snang gsum min mi snang bas/ mi mkhyen dgu mkhyen gye cho lo 'di nga bas khyod la mdzes rgyu med rung / 'byor bar 'dug pas bar skabs kyi khyod kyis longs dang / ngas khyod kyi lad mo byas bzlog pa rgyag bh+yo/ dge sbyong mgo bregs chags sdang can/ /dge ldan bstan pa'i ltas ngan yin/ /de yang dmar chen gtor mas bzlog /dge sbyong chos gos bud med can/ /dge 'dun yongs kyi ltas ngan yin/ /de yang dmar chen gtor mas bzlog /dge bshes dad med log lta can/ /dge sgrub yongs kyi ltas ngan yin/ /de yang dmar chen gtor mas bzlog /de ma yin pa'i khyod kyis nga la bshad pa de 'dra'i ltas 258

ngan bzlog bsgyur brgya dgos na stong 'dug ste/ 'di gsum rtsa ba yin pas bzlog nus na gzhan shugs kyis khag 'gro bas ma bshad/ shes na nga ltas ngan chung khyod ltas ngan che 'dis ri bo dge ldan pa'i bstan pa la gnod mi gnod the tshom med/ blo gros can thams cad kyis bzlog pa 'di la 'bad pa gal che/ da kha shags 'thab nas ci bya/ khyod kyi byang khog stod kyi brag khung smug nag tu log lta'i 'ug rgan mgo ser tshud nas gzhan mig tu ma song / blo la ma babs par/ 'khun lhag lhag bgad nas rang gzhan yongs la ltas ngan a kha gtong ba 'di/ dad gus dag snang gi bzlog pa gyes la myur du phud dang bzang yang 'o na/ khyod la 'dri rgyu 'ga' snang / khyod kyi cha lugs mu stegs skra'i lwa ba can las ngan pa 'di 'dra'i chos pa sngar ma mthong /'di chos pa gang gi cha lugs yin zer na/ sngon mdzes se la/rje btsun mi la la/ khyed kyi cha lugs sprang po las ngan pa 'di 'dra'i chos pa sngar ma mthong / 'di theg pa chen po gang gi cha lugs yin dris pas/ rje btsun gyi zhal nas/'di theg pa kun gye mchog rab tshe 'dir sangs rgyas sgrub phyir/ chos brgyad rlung la bskur ba zhes bya ba'i jeg pa'i cha lugs yin gsungs pa ltar/ nga'i cha lugs 'di yang / cha lugs kun gyi mchog gyur 259

tshe 'dir sangs rgyas sgrub phyir/ chags sdang rlung la bskur ba'i cha lugs yin/ 'o na khyod kyi cha lugs 'di/ zhwa dmar ser sogs chos pa gzhan kun gyi cha lugs dang mi mthun par 'dugakhyod chos pa kun dang rgyab log byed pa ma yin nam zer na/ rje mi las/ mdzes se la/ nga'i spyod pa mi kun dang rgyab log byed pas/ da nga la mi ma re zhig byas pas/ mo na re/ 'o na khyod chos pa kun dang rgyab log mdzad dam zer ba la/ rje btsun gyi zhal nas/ dang po bsam pa 'jig rten gye che thabs khong du bcug nas/ sbyor ba po ti 'ga'i tshig bshad bslabs te/ da lta'i bsam pa rang phyogs rgyal na dga' zhing / gzhan phyogs pham na dga' ba khong du 'tsheng bas/ sbyor ba nor ci gsog dang / snyan grags ci thob byed pa'i chos par ming btags pa'i gos ser po gyon pa tsam pa 'di kun dang rgyab log yin yang yin/ byed yang byed/ de min pa'i chos pa rnams theg pa so so'i cha lugs su rung / bsam sbyor gong ltar med na don la mthun pas rgyab log mi shes/ zhes gsungs pa ltar/ bsam pa rang che thabs khong du bcug nas/ sbyor ba 'gal 'brel gyi tshig bshad bslabs te/ da lta'i bsam pa rang phyogs rgyal na dga' zhing / gzhan phyogs pham na dga' ba khong du 'tsheng ba'i sbyor 260

ba bdag bstod cing / gzhan thabs du mas smod ci thub byed pa'i chos pa kun dang rgyab log yin yang yin/ byed dang byed/de min pa'i chos pa rnams theg pa so so'i cha lugs gang yin rung / bsam sbyor gong ltar med na/ don la mthun pas rgyab log mi shes/ 'o na khyod chos lugs gang yin zer na/ nga'i chos lugs 'di chos dang gang zag yongs la dad gus dag snang sbyong dgos pa'i nang ba sangs rgyas pa'i chos lugs yin/'o na khyod kyi pha yul dgon pa nye 'brel gang yin/ nyams su ci len/ ming la ci zer zer na/ nga'i pha yul rgyal khams phyogs med/ dgon gnas nges med ri khrod/ nye 'brel rigs drug sems can/ nyams len dad gus dag snang / ming la gangs can bod kyi glu dbyangs mkhan zer bas/ ngas glu zhig len khyod nyon/ skal ldan lam sna 'dren mdzad pa'i/ /skal bzang sangs rgyas stong rtsa mkhyen/ /bskal pa snyigs ma'i mtha' ma la/ /skal dman 'ga' res 'di skad zer/ /dbu ma chen po'i bstan dang gcig /rdzogs pa chen po'i bstan dang gnyis/ /phyag rgya chen po'i bstan dang gsum/ /'di gsum 'dzin la bstan bshig zer/ /phyogs ris chags sdang bstan dang gcig /nga rgyal phrag dog bstan dang gnyis/ /bdag bstod 261

gzhan smod bstan dang gsum/ /'di gsum 'dzin la bstan 'dzin zer/ bstan pa bzang ngan 'byed la 'jigs/ /bstan 'dzin chags sdang byed la 'jigs/ /bstan bcos nyes bshad rtsom la 'jigs/ /bstan pa nub tu nye la 'jigs/ /phyogs med 'gro ba'i don mdzad pa'i/ /phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba sras bcas dgongs/ /phyogs 'di'i grub mtha' thams cad kyis/ /phyogs ris chags sdang byed la 'jigs/ /brtse med khrel med bstan 'dzin la/ /dpon med g.yog med nga re 'jigs/ /dgra med gnyen med rgyal khams 'grims/ /mi sked khye med dben par 'gro/ /rtsi shing nang na 'bras bu yod/ /sa rdo'i nang na gser dngul yod/ /sems can nang na sangs rgyas yod/ /ku re nang na don dam yod/ byis pa'i kha nas bslab bya byung / /khu byug kha nas rnar snyan byung / /lug rdzi'i kha nas man ngag byung / /rnal 'byor kha nas legs bshad byung / /kun spangs bod kyi glu ba ngas/ /kun la ku re byas pa lags/ /kun mkhyen go 'phang ma thob par/ /kun gyis ma brjed yid la zungs/ /'o de tsam gye chog ni gyes/ /spyir sangs rgyas thugs rje can gyes chos la rtsod pa byas na/ gang zag gi rgyud la phyogs ris chags sdang nga rgyal phrag dog 'gran sems yid 262

gnyis the tshom log lta sogs skyes/kha nas brnyas smod khyad gsod sun 'byin skur 'debs ngag 'khyal sogs spras nas/mthar 'khon 'dzings 'thab rtsod 'khrug slong sogs byed kyis dogs nas/rtsod pa bya mi rung zhes nan tan gsungs te/ dam chos pad+ma dkar po las/ chos brtsad par mi bya ste/ chos la brtsad par dga' bar mi bya'o/ /zhes dang / dpung bzang las/ theg pa chen po pa dag dang / /shes rab can gyis rtsod mi bya/ /byang chub sems dpa' mthu chen dag /thos nas sun yang mi dbyung ngo / /sngags kyi sgrub pa po dag dang / /lhan cig nam yang 'gran mi bya/ /zhes dang / bzhi brgya ba las/ chos 'di de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyis rtsod pa'i phyir du ma gsungs te/zhes dang / 'jug pa las/ bstan bcos las brtsams rtsod la chags pa'i phyir/ /ma mdzad rnam grol phyir na de nyid bstan/ /zhes dang / sharnyi bas/ bdag gzhan chos zhes pa ni/ rang dang gzhan gyi grub pa'i mtha'i chos la bya ste/smad mi bya zhes pa ni/ rtsod pas sun dbyung bar mi bya ste/gsungs/ rgyud bla ma las/ gang phyir rgyal las ches mkhas 'jig rten 'di na yod min te/ /ma lus de nyid mchog ni tshul bzhin kun mkhyen gyis mkhyen gzhan min pa/ /de phyir drang 263

srong rang nyid kyis bzhag mdo sde gang yin de mi dkrug /thub tshul gzhig phyir de yang dam chos la ni gnod pa byed par 'gyur/ /zhes sogs lung mtha' yas so/ /deng sang snyigs ma'i dus kyi mi rang bzhin gyis nyon mongs rags/snod bcud sdig pa'i 'bras bu sa yongs su gang ba'i dus 'dir/ rtsod pa byas na nyon mongs slong ba dang las ngan pa gsog pa thugs shin tu mad de/ rtsod pa byas na zhe sdang langs/ ngo mdangs dmar por song / skad mgo je mthor song / ngan ma tshang la lag 'jog mkhan shin tu mang / snga sor chos rtsod byas/ chos pa dga' mo tshos phung rdzogs sdom pa shor ba mthong thos mang bo yod pa kun gyi thugs na mnga' ba de red/ gsal btab pa ma gtogs zhu ci la dgos/ mdor na chos la thos bsam sgom gsum 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum gang byas kyang nyon mongs pa'i gnyen por song na ngo mtshar che la/ nyon mongs pa'i grogs su shor na kun gyis khrel ba'i rgyu yin/ don chung ste/ rje dge 'dun grub kyi gsung shar gangs ri ma sogs la ltos dang ha go yong/ rje rin po che dang rgyal dbang gis 'e tsho'i bshad bshad/phyag rdzogs pa blun po 'di tsho zhes kun spyi bsdus byas/ mdzad pa po kun bzang rdo rje 'chang / pad+ma 'byung gnas man chad/264

rang gi drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma yan chad la smod tshig tu 'gyur ba'i chos spong gi las ngan pa bsags pa lta bu ma yin te/gzhan lugs smad pa lta bu de la dgongs gzhi dmigs bsal yod de/ rje rin po ches sngar ci yang mi rtog pa'i bsgom thams cad stong pa nyid bsgom pa'i nyams len du 'dod pa ni mkhas pa'i bzhad gad kyi gnas yin gsungs pa de yang / rgan rgon tsho'i gtam bshad dus/mgon oṃ dang rnga ma na swā hā med gi zhes gtam dpe tsho 'jen pa ltar/ phyag rdzogs pa blun po kha cig gis mgo rnga rked gsum gang du yang so so/ra rtogs pa'i shes rab kyis dpyad pa spangs nas/ chos thams cad kyi gnas lugs sto nga pa nyid yin pa khong du ma chud/ rgod pa ma gtogs bying ba byung yang bsgom du bzung / gnyid ni bzhin mag ge khyi rgan bzhin hon ne/ byis pa bzhin hed de/ rtog pa'i 'phro 'du thams cad bkag pa'i tshom 'jog byas 'dug pa rnams la smad nas bshad pa yin pas/ de la phyag rdzogs pa'i kyang mkhas pa thams cad bzhad gad byed pa'i gnas yin/ de ma yin par phyag rdzogs pa'i rnal 'byor pas thabs bsod nams kyi tshogs rgya chen bsags/ shes rab rno myur gsal ba mi 'dra ba brgya phrag mang po spros/ 'khor 'das bde sdug myong mkhan chos 265

kun rtsa ba rang sems la brtag dpyad nas ming gis phar btags pa tsam ma gtogs/ rang bzhin gyis grub pa rdul tsam yang ma rnyed stong par gyur tshe/ stong gsal mtha' dbus dang bral ba'i mnyam bzhag nam mkha' lta bu'i ngang der/ la kha mthon po nas sprin med nam mkha' dwangs pa'i dkyil du bltas pa ltar gsal sang nge ye re ba de nyid 'jog bsgom byed/ stong nyid rtogs pa'i ngang du mi rtog par bzhag pa yin pas/ 'di la rje rin po ches nam yang ma smad de gong gi lung de na stong nyid rtogs pa'i mi rtog pa zhig yod pa blang byar bstan pa'i phyir ro/ /de bzhin du rgyal dbang gis kyang / blun po phyag rgya che bsgom pa/ /phal cher zhes bye brag phye ba'i phyir ro/ /des na phyag rdzogs pa yin zer tshad thams cad la/ 'e tsho'i ltar byas smad par ma sems/ 'on kyang dper na dge bskos mkhas pas grwa ba re gnyis 'grig lam kun spyod la ma mthun pa byung tshe/tshogs gtam spyi la gtong ba ltar/ rje de rnam/gnyis kyis phyag rdzogs pa blun po 'ga' re legs lam la 'god phyir/ phyag rdzogs pa zhes spyi la gsungs pa'ang yod kyang 'khrul bar mi bya'o/ /'jig rten na bshad sa bu mo dang nyan sa mna' ma zer ba ltar/ dmigs bsal can yin pas spyi la gsungs par ma 266

sems/ yang rgyal dbang gis/ sgom chen du rlom pa mang po zhig gis rig pas dpyad nas lta ba gtan la phab nas/ bsgom dus mi rtog pa 'ba' zhig sgoms zer ba de gzhi la sdod dus rta gsos nas/ byes la 'gro dus rkang thang du 'gro zer ba 'dra zhes gsungs pa de/ phyag rdzogs pa sogs grub mtha' gzhan rkang lta bu las/ dbu ma'i lta ba 'di rta la zhon nas rgyug pa dang 'dra zhes che ba brjod na gdul bya dang ba 'dren pa la phan par dgongs nas de skad gsungs pa yin pas/ nges par phyag rdzogs pa rnams rkang thang du song ba 'dra zhes smad pa ma yin/phyag rdzogs pas rta gsos nas rkang thang du song ba dang ga la 'dra/ gsar ma bas kyang phyag rdzogs pa'i lta ba 'di rta gsos nas zhon nas song ba dang ches shin tu mthun te/ dang po rta gsos nas shed phud pa ltar so sor rtogs pa'i shes rab kyis dpyad nas stong gsal 'dzin med kyi ye shes lhag ger shar/bar du rta yi steng du zhon pa ltar gnas lugs stong gsal de'i ngang du zang thal ler bzhag tha ma steng nas mi ltung bar zhon nas 'gro ba ltar byeng rgod dang bral bar rtag tu skyong bas/'di la bltas na dbu ma'i lta ba 'di rta gsos te zhon nas song ba dang mi 'dra/rta gsos nas shed bud kyang steng du ma zhon rkang 267

thang du khrid nas rtswa ster gyin song ba dang 'dra/ zhes smras na chog pas tshod du 'dug khong gis 'di gdul bya dwangs pa 'dren phyir gsungs pa yin pa'i rtags su/ rnying ma'i chos rgyud 'dzin pa'i bu slob rnams kyi ched du/rdzogs chen rig 'dzin lung lung gsungs pa'i lta ba'i thad ka sogs na dbu ma pa sogs gzhan la ma grags pa'i khyad chos shig 'dir mchis so/ /zhes grub mtha' gzhan thams cad dman dman zhig byas/rdzogs chen la bsngags brjod mang po mdzad/ rdzogs chen las lhag cig gzhan na med pa 'dra ba zhig gsungs 'dugade yin na dbu ma sogs chos gzhan thams cad rdzogs chen la bltas na ngan shos su 'dod dgos pa'i phyir ro/ /de ltar 'dod na yang gsar rnying sogs chos gang yin yang rnam dag ma yin par 'dug ces chos thams cad la skur ba 'debs dgos/dad gus skye dka'/ yang na rgyal dbang 'dis thams cad mkhyen kyang / khu byug gis rgya la song nas rgya skyid/ bod sdug bod la 'ong nas bod skyid/ rgya sdug zer ba ltar zhal phar phyogs nas gcig gsungs/ zhal tshur bsgyur nas gcig gsungs/ zhal gcig gi nang gi gsung gnyis byon nas/ gang la yang blo gtad rgyu yin mi shes par 'dug ces rgyal dbang 268

la yang skur ba 'debs dgos par 'gyur bas/ a dzi'i de gnyis kyi gang min zhes blo gros can sus skur 'debs/ sngon ser 'bras kyi grwa ba 'ga'i nang nas gcig gis/ khos gsang mtshan langs du bcug nas/ lha sa'i bud med mgo la mu tig gi zhwa gyon pa zhig gi lag tu nyin par 'jog thub gis bshad tshe/grwa ba gzhan thams cad kyis de mi thub smras/ de yin na zhes cha bos rgyal bzhag nas/ phyi nyin cha bo lha sar 'ong nas da zhog bshad tshe/ grwa ba des g.yu bzang po zhig lag na yod pa bud med mu tig gi zhwa gyon pa zhig la bstan nas 'di btsong rgyu yin pa/ e nyo smras tshe/ gzhon nu ma des nyo rin ṭaṃ ka ci tsam yin smras tshe/ grwa ba des sa la bsdad nas/ bud med la kha nas bshad mi dgos/ lag pa 'dir thongs dang gtam smra/ bud med gzhon nu mas lag pa brkyangs pa gzan gyi 'og thur du khyer nas/ gsang mtshan lag tu bzhag tshe/ gzhon nu mas a dzi'i/dge slong la smras tshe/ grwa ba na re/ de ma red bshad ni e yin/rin de ma 'ong na btsongs rgyu ma red/ ces 'dzum bzhin langs song / rgyal bzhag pa thob zer ba ltar/ khyed lung rigs smra ba'i mkhas pa rnams kyis/ g.yu bzang po lta bu'i rang chos ngom nas bshad/ gsang mtshan lag tu bzhag pa ltar/ thabs sna 269

tshogs kyis gzhan chos smad/ bud med kyis a dzi'i smras pa ltar/dad can skrag gi ma 'jug rgyal lon pa bzhin rnyed dang bkur sti byung kyang 'grig lam kun spyod bshig pa ltar/ chos spong dang rtsa lhung gi nyes pa 'byung bas/ rig pa rno yang bya ba ngan pa de 'dra ma byed dang bzang / 'brug pa kun legs kyis/ mkhas pa rnams kyis drang nges 'chad pa'i grub mtha' zung la/ chos spong dang khyad gsod ma byed gsungs/ sngon mtsho zhig gi nang du shing zhig gi 'bras bu'i lo ma lhung bas cal zhes sgra grag pa/ ri bong skrag nas cal zer ni zhig 'ong gi zhes ri dwags tshogs la bsgrags tshe/ kun gyis rgyu mtshan ma shes kyang seṅge dang stag la sogs pa yang bros pa ltar/ rgyal dbang sogs skyes chen dam pa dpag bsam ljon shing lta bu las/ dgongs gzhi can gyi gsung 'bras bu lo ma lta bu/ legs bshad rgya mtsho lta bu'i nang du lhung ba/ ci yin ma shes par rmongs pa 'gong ri kha sho lta bu skrag nas/ chos mdzad ri dwags lta bu yongs la bsgrags tshe/ chos pa dga' mo stag seng lta bus yang de'i rgyu mtshan ma go bzhin du/sngar yang log lta'i nags gseb tu bros/ chags sdang gi mche ba gtsigs nas gzhan smod kyi nga ro cher bsgrags pa mang / da dung yang 'byung nyen che bas blo gros can gyes de 'dra'i 270

dgongs pa lon pa gal che/ yang 'ga' res phyag rdzogs 'di bzang bo zhig yin na/ rje rin po ches gcig gsungs sa snang /gang yang ma gsungs pa 'di la bltas na/ skyon zhig 'dugarnam dag ma red tsho zer ba de glen gtam bshad ni yin/ rje rin po ches ma gsungs pa thams cad chos rnam dag ma yin par ga la 'gyur/ de yin na rgyal ba'i gsung rab mdo rgyud/ rgya bod kyi paṇ+ḍi tas bstan bcos 'dzam gling bye ba phrag brgya na/ston pa bye ba phrag brgyas chos bye ba phrag brgya gsungs pa yang rje rin po ches ma gsungs/ de thams cad kyang rnam dag ma yin par 'dod dgos pas ha cang thal che bar 'gyur ro/ /da ngas khyod la bshad/ rje rin po ches phyag rdzogs ma gsungs pa ga la yin/dper na gos rnying ba slar gsos nas gos gsar zhes ming btags pa ltar/ sngon gyi lo paṇa mkhas grub kyis bsgyur ba'i phyag rdzogs kyi chos thams cad yod par ma zad phal cher rgyas par gsungs yod/ blo gros can gyis ltos dpyod dang / gsar ma'i chos dang rnying ma zhes so sor ming gnyis yod kyang / don gyi gcig yin pa'i ha go yong/'on kyang rdzogs pa chen po/ phyag rgya chen po zhes ming btags/phyag rdzogs kyi lta ba rtsal bton nas/ po ti kha ser ra mang po ma mdzad pa de nyid snyigs dus 271

'dir de'i gdul bya skal ldan las 'phro can dbang po yang rab dkon pas na/ sku tshegs ma gtogs phan chung bar dgongs/ gal te re gnyis yod srid kyang sku tshe snga mar o rgyan sogs kyi skur bzhengs nas/ skal bzang gi gdul bya du ma la rgyas par bka' bstsal ba des chog par dgongs nas lan mang ma gsungs pa yin/ khyed tshos khung ma dag nas ma gsungs ma snyam/ log rtog de'i dbang gis gzhan khas btang na/ spyir chos spong gi las ngan pa yin la/ khyad par rje dang o rgyan pad+ma gnyis thugs rgyud gcig yin pas/ don gyi rang gi rje bla ma la yang skur ba btab par 'gyur bas de mi 'grigs/ yang o rgyan dang rje rin po che gnyis thugs rgyud mi gcig zer na/ rgyal ba paṇa chen sogs mkhas grub du mas gcig yin zer ba la/ de dzun zhes skur ba btab par 'gyur bas/ khyod sngar med pa'i kun mkhyen zhig go /'o na khyod kyis de khas mi len na/ rje rin po che rigs gsum mgon po dang thugs rgyud gcig e zer/ de zer dgos snyam/ deng sang yongs la grags de zer na/ /o rgyan rin po che spyir sangs rgyas thams cad kyi thugs sprul sgos snang ba mtha' yas dang thugs rje chen po'i sprul pa dngos yin pas/ de na da de rnams la bsam blo thongs dang thugs rgyud 272

gcig mi gcig go sla/ /o rgyan dang rje rin po che zhes mtshan mi gcig kyang / thugs rgyud gcig pa dang gsar rnying gi chos zhes ming ma gcig kyang / don gyis gcig pa dang / rje rin po che'i legs bshad na rgyal ba'i gsung rab thams cad 'dus yod pa ma shes par/ sngon bla brang bkra shis 'khyil ba'i phyogs kyi dge bshes gcig gis o rgyan gyi bris thang zhig mthong nas/rje blo bzang grags pa'i bstan dgra ka 'jog mi rung zhes blangs nas sgo jem du bzhagasteng du sta re yis brgyab/ ya khyod la 'di dgos/ khyod dang po me la mi 'tshig zer/ da e 'tshig blta zer me nang du bzhag zer skad/ sngon lho kha'i phyogs kyi bla ma zhig gis o rgyan gyi bris sku zhig rdzogs chen pa zhig gis bshams yod pa gdan du bting / rdzogs chen gyi shul da yongs su rdzogs na bzang zer/ rdzogs chen gyi dpe cha zhig yod pa chu la bskur bas kha nas khrag bskyugs nas shi song skad/ yang sngon lho kha'i phyogs kyi bla ngan gcig gis/ rje rin po che'i sku zhig mthong nas khyod kyis rnying ma sang gi las yongs ni ang / bstan bshig khyod la 'di dgos zer/ sku 'dra'i dbu bcad/lam rim zhig yod pa/ nyab nyob 'di stan byas na bzang zer 'og tu bting bas spyos nas shi song skad/ de 'dra'i chos spong 273

gi las ngan pa bsags pa mang po byung / deng sang yang 'ga' res de 'dra mi byed kyang / de'i cha 'dra byed mkhan mang / o rgyan gyi 'dra sku zhig mthong kyang mi dad pa 'ga' res ka ci 'dra'i sku red dris na/ de sngon zhig la bod la 'ong ba'i o rgyan pad+ma zer ba de red/ nged tshos mi shes ka rnying ma tsho cha rgyus che zer gcig mjal yang mi mjal/ rdzogs chen gyi dpe cha zhig mthong kyang / de lta sa zhig min lta ngan gyi grib 'phog tsho zer khas btang / yang 'ga' res rje rin po che'i 'dra sku zhig mthong kyang / blo bzang grags pa zhig ga na yang 'dug zer/mjal ba phar zhog gcig gi mgo la 'jog rgyu 'dra zhig yin na mgo phar 'khyer ba'i tshod tsam byas/ lam rim zhig mthong kyang / nyag nyog mang po des ci bya/ dgos pa chung / nged tsho rdzogs chen nye lam 'di gas yongs zer/ de chos ma shes pa'i rang mtshang phyir bstan pa yin te/ tha na sems can thams cad la ston pa'i 'du shes bskyed/ dngos sam yid gang rung gis phyag byas/ phyi rol pa'i chos lugs yan chad nyams su mi len kyang dad gus bya ba ma gtogs brnyas smod bya mi rung zhes mdo rgyud bstan bcos thams cad nas yang yang gsungs na/o rgyan dang rje rin po che la smos ci dgos/ phyin chad gsar 274

rnying gi blo gros can gyis 'di ltar chos ma shes pa'i rang mtshang phyir bstan nas/ dus gsum rgyal ba thams cad thugs khrel/chos skyong srung ma thams cad kyi bka' chad 'ong / chos spong gi las kyis dmyal ba rdo rje gdan du lhung nas/ rgyal ba'i gsung rab kyi ming tsam yang bskal par mi thos pa'i bya spyod ngan pa ma byed/ gzhan byed mkhan la yang / o rgyan dang rje rin po che'i sku gsung thugs kyi yon tan brjod/ thugs rgyud gcig tshul brjod la thabs mkhas kyis legs lam la bkod dang / rgyal ba dgyes pa'i mchod pa la 'di lhag gzhan na med/ gsar rnying gi chos skyong srung mas bu bzhin skyong / bstan dang 'gro ba'i gtsug rgyan tu 'gyur bar gdon mi za'o/ /dper na zhar ras mi mthong kyang pho tshod byas song na log nas rang gi 'thung phor bcag rkang lag bshus/ gzhan gyi bza' btung rdzogs tshe zhar ra zhar lkog khye zhar dmus long ka zer/brdeg nas rig sa mthong sa med pa ltar/ rang gi blo gros kyi mig long nas/ chos dang gang zag la skur ba btab/ rang gi bsod nams zad/ rtsa ltung chos spong gi nyes pas gos/ gzhan gye bstan pa nyams gi bcug bstan bshig ka zer/ kun gyis rig sa mthong sa med ni ma bco/ khye tshe lo dgu mi thub/ mgo nag mi dang stong 'gres 275

zer ba ltar/ mi tshe glog 'gyu tsam 'di la gzhan kun la ma 'gres dang bzang / deng sang snyigs dus 'dir/ gsar rnying gang la gzhan khas gtong mkhan mang rab 'dug de kun sangs rgyas byang sems kyi sprul pa 'dra yin/ rang gzhan gyi grub mtha' tsho phan pa'i dgongs pa chen po yod nas de skad gsungs pa yin na/ ngo mtshar/ ngas ngo ma shes pas bzod par bzhes/ da yang grub mtha' yongs la dad gus dag snang sbyong dgos tshul gyi zhal gsung snyan mo byon/ snyigs dus 'dir sngar gye gsung de 'dra 'byon nyan pa'i dus tshod ma red ces gsol ba 'debs/ sangs rgyas byang sems 'dra min/ gzhan phan gyi dgos pa 'dra med na/ bla ngan khyi rgan mang pos chags sdang gi mche ba rnon po bzhi bzhi gtsigs/ bdag bstod gzhan smod kyi nga ro ches cher bsgrags nas/ bstan 'dzin byang chub sems dpa' chen pos 'gro ba'i don byed par 'gal rkyen ma byed par/ rnyed bkur gyi skyag pa 'khyur mid gyis/ kha rog par sdod dang / khyod khyi rgan rgya bo de phan/ gzhan byang chub sems dpa'i mi thams cad la dge ba yin sa snang / da 'e tshos chos dang gang zag rnams tshad gcig la brgyab nas khas gtong mi rung / chos dang gang zag rigs mi 'dra ba mtha' yas chos 276

la las bskal pa mang po'i 'phror sangs rgyas/ la la snyigs dus kyi tshe thung gcig la yang sangs rgyas pa yod/ dper na a mdo pa dbus su 'gro ba lho kha brgyud nas rkang thang du song ba dang / byang kha gyen du rta la zhon nas song ba gnyis nye ring che ba lta bu'o/ /gang zag la chos yun ring bsgoms pas grol/ la la chos thos pa tsam gyis grol ba thob pa'ang yod/ rje 'bangs nyer lnga'i phal cher gyis yun ring bsgoms pas grol/ kha cig gis thos pa tsam nas grol ba thob tshul dang / rgyal ba rgod tshang pa'i zhal nas/ rje te lo pas/ rje nā ro pa la tshig gcig tsam yang ma gsung bar/ mos gus gcig pu la brten nas/ phyi nang gi chos thams cad thugs su chud/ rje sna bu pas/ dpal phag mo grub pa'i zhabs drung du zhag bdun las ma bzhugs te/mkhyen pa gnyis ldan gye rtogs pa rgyud la 'khrungs gsungs/de la skal ldan las 'phro can zer/ bla ma zhang rin po che'i zhal nas/ gzhan yang rab tu bshad bya ba/ /dpag med bskal par sbyangs sbyangs pas/ /skye ba 'di la'ang mngon sum du/ /dbang sogs cho ga ci ma tshang / /bla ma la yang ma ltos par/ /zhabs la tog rtse phog pa yi/ /skad cig de la bzhi ba'i don/ /ma lus rdzogs par thugs su chud/ /theg pa kun gye bdag por gyur/ /277

skal ldan dpag med 'dren par mdzad/ /rje btsun tog rtse pa zhes grags/ /de lta bu yang srid kyin gda'o/ /lam 'bras nas ni 'di skad du/ /las 'phro can gyi gang zag rnams/ /bla ma'i dbang dang gdams ngag sogs/ /gang la yang ni ma ltos par/ /tshe rabs snga ma'i las 'phro yi/ /rang dbang med par khams 'dus te/ /ting 'dzin nyams myong rtogs pa sogs//mthar thug phyogs med skye bar bshad/ /de la sogs te phyogab/ med pas/ /rang rang la'ang mngon zhen pas/ /'di nyid yin gyis gzhan min zhes/ /phan tshun lam la smad mi bgyi/ /gang nas zhugs kyang 'dod sar slebs/ /e ma ngo mtshar rmad kyi chos/ /lam zhugs thams cad rgyal gyur cig /gsungs/ mnyam med po to ba chen po'i zhal nas/ theg pa che chung grub mtha' thams chad kyang / /gang zag blo nyams che chung khyad par yin/ /'khor ba mya ngan 'das pa thams cad kyang / /sems nyid rtogs dang ma rtogs khyad par yin/ /sa dang lam gyi rim pa thams cad kyang / /rtogs pa 'phel ba'i ming gi rnam grangs yin/ /zhes gsungs/ tshe sngon sbyangs sbyangs pa'i skal ldan las 'phro can gyis chos zab mo thos pa tsam gyis rtogs grol dus gcig tu song nas bsgom mi dgos pa yang yod srid/ de rnams la 278

bsgom lam sogs med ces khas gtong rgyu spu tsam med/dper na shog gu mang po mdas dus gcig tu phug pa ltar sa lam thams cad gcig char du bgrod pa yin pas don gyis tshang ste/ btags grol rgyud las/ rang rig rnam dag sa gcig la/ /theg pa kun 'dus sa lam rdzogs/ /zhes dang /'jam dpal mtshan brjod las/ skad cig gcig gis rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /skad cig gcig gis bye brag phyed/ /ces dang /de bzhin gshegs pa'i gsung rab las/rtogs bcu bzhi'i sa la rgyun du gnas/ /zhes dang / yum chen pha rol phyin pa las/dang po sems bskyed pa nyid kyis yang dag par rdzogs pa sangs rgyas nas chos 'khor bskor ba sogs yod gsungs/des na rje skal ldan rgya mtsho'i zhal nas/ dam pa'i chos la mi zab gang zag med/ /don med kha sdig ma gsog ri khrod pa/ /gsungs/ yang gcig na re/ klong chen rab 'byams pas ma bsam ma dpyad brdal ba chen po'i gzhi/ /dbyings las ma g.yos chos sku rang mal lam/ /rang rig dri med mngon gyur 'bras bu'i ngang / /zhes dang / rang byung ka nas dag pa'i gzhi/ /ma bgrod ye nas nye ba'i lam/ /ma sgrub lhun gyis grub pa'i 'bras/ /'od gsal chos skur rdzogs pa lags/ /zhes dang/279
