rje mi las/ gzhi ma bcos khyab gdal chen bor shar/ /lam ma bcos zang thal chen por shar/ /'bras ma bcos phyag rgya chen por shar/ /zhes gsungs pa 'di 'dra'i rigs la 'ga' res a mtshar bo 'di rgyal bas gsung rab dang rgyab 'gal che gi gang dang mthun na/ hwa shang sang dang mthun gi thabs kyi cha gtan nas mi dgos pa hwa shang lags mod/ 'di 'dra'i gzhi lam 'bras gsum yod mi srid a kha zer na/ 'o de/ rje de rnam gnyis la sogs kyis thabs kyi phyogs kyi rdo je'i glu mas phyir kun tu lam du mar blangs tshar bas/ 'dir lta ba'i mgur dbyangs 'then dus lta ba kho rang gi ngos nas gzhi lam 'bras gsum la de bas lhag cig mi dgos par de gas chog pa la dgongs nas/de skad gsungs pa yin la/ gzhan hwa shang bzhin thabs kyi cha rnams mi dgos 'di gcig pus chog ces gsungs pa ga la yin/ de yin na rgyal ba'i gsung rab dgongs 'grel na de 'dra mang ste/ thos pa'i tshoms las/ thos pas chos rnams shes par 'gyur/ /thos pas sdig las ldog par 'gyur/ /thos pas don ma yin pa spong / /thos pas mya ngan 'das pa thob ces gsungs pa de yang chos thos pa tsam gyis chog par 'dug de bzhin du slob dpon klu sgrub kyis/ mchod pa thams cad yongs 280

spangs nas/ /bla ma mchod la yang dag brtsams/ /de mnyes pas ni kun mkhyen gyi/ /ye shes mchog de thob par 'gyur/ /zhes dang / sangs rgyas thugs rje can gyis/zla ba yar gyi tshes brgyad dang / /cho 'phrul gyi ni zla ba la/ /bsnyen gnas yan lag brgyad bsrung na/ /de ni nga dang 'dra bar 'gyur/ /gsungs/chos yang dag par bsdud pa las/ bcom ldan 'das byang chub sems dpa'i chos rab tu mang po la bslab par mi bgyi'o/ /bcom ldan 'das byang chub sems dpa'i chos gcig rab tu bzung zhing rab tu rtogs par bgyes na/ sangs rgyas kyi chos thams cad de'i lag pa'i mthil na mchis pa lags so/ /chos gcig pu gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/ snying rje chen po'o/ / gsungs/skyabs 'gro lan cig tsam byas kyang myur du sangs rgya ba sogs phan yon mtha' yas pa gsungs/ sangs rgyas la dmigs nas me tog gcig nam mkhar gtor na/ mthar sangs rgyas thob pa snying rje pad dkar las gsungs/ sngon sangs rgyas stong gi 'ga' res/ shing bu/ rde'u/ rtswa'i sgon me/ skud pa'i chun po/ras kyi kha tshar sogs phul nas/ sems bskyed pas sangs rgyas par gsungs/ sngon bud med dbul mo gnyen dga' mos/sangs rgyas la mar me chung ngu zhig phul nas smon lam btab 281

pas/ sangs rgyas kyis khyod ma 'ongs pa na sangs rgyas te/mtshan mar me 'od ces bya bar 'gyur zhes lung bstan gsungs/de bzhin gshegs pa zla ba'i dkyil 'khor rnam par dag pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes brjod na myur du 'tshang rgya gsungs/ de bzhin gshegs pa chos thams cad kyi tshul las rnam par 'khrul ba nges par sel ba gzi brjid 'byung ba'i rgyal po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes brjod na tshe gcig lus gcig la 'tshang rgya'o/ /gsungs/ oṃ aḥ bhi ra hūṃ khe tsa ra/ 'di dran pa tsam gyis mtshams med pa lnga byang zhing / myang 'das thob bo/ /ta t+ya thā/oṃ k+ṣi/ 'di rab tu gsang nas bzlas na don dang las thams cad 'grub bo gsungs/ 'di 'dra mtha' yas/ de re res kyang chog pa lta bur gsung 'dug pas/ de rnams kyis kyang hwa shang ltar thabs kyi cha gzhan mi dgos/ 'di gcig pus 'bras bu sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang mngon du byed pa yin zhes gsung pa yin zer dgos/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ rje de rnams kyi gsung dang de rnams la khyad par med pa'i phyir ro/ /de yin zer na/ chos gsung pa sangs rgyas kyi bskal chen grangs med gsum du tshogs bsags pa dang / mnyam med jo bo rje/ rje bdag nyid chen po sogs kyis mdo sngags kyi lam rnams skyes bu gcig sangs rgyas 282

pa'i cha rkyen du bstan pa rnams ma mkhyen 'dug sngon gyi bla ma skyes bu dam pas de bzhin nyams su bzhes pas ngal ba blang ba red ces khas len dgos pas de mi 'grigs/ da khyod kha rog par sdod dang bzang / gzhan thabs kyi cha spyod phyogs rnams mi dgos sus zer/ dgos pa'i rtags su rje rnam gnyis kyis lam thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa'i gdams pa zab cing rgya che ba rnams nyams su bzhes nas grub pa mchog brnyes pa'i tshul rnams rnam thar na snang / rje mi las lho brag mar pa'i drung du rtogs 'bul kyang 'di ltar byas te/ rdo rje 'chang dang dbyer med pa'i bla ma yab yum sras dang bcas pa'i 'phrin las rnam par dkar ba dang / thugs rje tshad med pa'i byen rlabs nus mthu dang / 'khor ba med pa'i bka' drin la brten nas 'bangs bdag la/ go yul gye rtogs pa cung zad yod pa rnams phul bas/ thugs chos nyid 'gyur ba med pa'i ngang nas snyan cung zad gsan du gsol/ thog mar ma rig pa'i rkyen gyis 'du byed la sogs pa rten 'brel bcu gnyis kyis bsdus pa'i lus/ rnam smin sha khrag gdos bcas rnam par shes pa dang bcas pa 'di/ bsod nams can thar ba 'dod pa rnams kyi dal 'byor lus kyi gru chen/ las ngan sdig pa gsog pa rnams 283

kyi ngan 'gror 'khrid pa'i sna 'dren/ yar 'gro mar 'gro'i sa mtshams/ 'dun ma gtan legs dang gtan nyes kyi khe nyen shin tu che bas dus kye ma pa cig yin par go zhing / de yang 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho sdug bsngal gye 'byung gnas shin tu thar dka' ba 'di la/da lan rje 'gro ba'i ded dpon khyed kyi mthu la brten nas sgrol du re ba la/ thog mar bla ma dkon mchog la skyabs zhus nas/ bslab bya rnams tshul bzhin du slob pa dang /de'i nang nas kyang bde legs thams cad kyi 'byung gnas bla ma yin par 'dug pas/ ci gsung dang du len cing dam tshig ma nyams par byed pa 'di gal che ba'i gnad dang po yin par go lags/ de rjes dal 'byor rnyed dka' dang 'chi ba mi rtagalas rgyu 'bras 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs rnams rtag tu bsam pas blo rang dbang med par khul nas/ 'khor ba las thar bar 'dod pas so sor thar ba'i sdom pa gang yang rung zhig la brten dgos te/ rten sa gzhi dang 'dra la/ de la brten nas theg pa rim gyis 'jeg cing khas blangs pa'i bslab bya mig 'bras ltar bsrung ba dang / gal te nyams na phyir 'chos shing /rang zhi bde don du gnyer ba theg pa dman par go nas/sems can 'khor ba mtha' dag las sgol bar 'dod pas byang 284

chub tu sems bskyed nas/ byams pa dang snying rje'i ci byed thams cad gzhan don du bsngo ba theg chen sems bskyed yin par go lags/ nyan rang gi lam spangs nas theg pa chen po'i lam du 'jug pa la lta ba rnam dag gis gzhir bzung nas/ bla med rdo rje theg pa'i lam du 'jug ste/ de yang lta ba rnam dag rtogs par byed pa la/ bla ma mtshan nyid dang ldan pa gcig gis/ dbang bzhi rnam par dag pa'i cho ga ma nor ba la brda' 'phrod pa'i thabs shes dang ldan pa zhig dgos/ dbang bya ba zab mo lta ba la dbang bas/ da bzod rim pa bzhin bsgoms te/ de yang mtshan nyid theg pa dang thun mong pa gang zag gi bdag med 'tshol ba la 'bad de/ lung dang rig pa gnyis ka la dpe dang rgyu mtshan du ma'i sgo nas btsal bas bdag ma rnyed pa dang / gang zag gi bdag med rtogs pa/ de ltar gang zag ma rnyed pa dang / sems mnyam par 'jog dgos te/ rgyu mtshan du ma'i sgo nas bzhag pa'i tshe/ rnam rtog rgyun chad nas sems rtog med du lhan song ste/ lo dang zla ba zhag la sogs pa ci tsam song yang / rang gis mi shes pas gzhan gyis tshod 'dzin dgos pa byung na zhi gnas skyes pa yin/ de la dran shes kyis bskyangs nas/ bying rmugs su ma song bar rig pa'i ngar 'don 285

byas pas/ snang la rang bzhin med par gsal la rtog pa med pa/ rjen yer re/ gsal sing nge ba de zhi gnas kyi nyams yin/de la lhag mthong du 'dzin rung / so so skye bo la lhag mthong mtshan nyid pa mi 'char bas/ sa dang po thob pa dang lhag mthong dang mjal ba yin snyam lags/ des na dmigs pa la brten nas rnam pa lam du byed pa yin/ gzhan zhi gnas kyi nyams snang lha sku sogs/ mthong snang sna tshogs byung ba rnams bsgoms pa'i rtags tsam yin gyi snying bo gang yang med snyam lags/ mdor na zhi gnas bzang po'i nyams ngar 'don dang bcas pa dang / so sor rtogs pa'i shes rab zab mos dpyod pa dang bcas pa 'di/ lhag mthong thob par byed pa'i thabs med mi rung / skas la 'dzeg pa'i skas them 'og ma dang 'dra bsam lags/ zhi gnas bsgom pa sogs/ mtshan bcas mtshan med gang byed thams cad byams snying rjes kun nas bslang ste ci byed gzhan don du dmigs pa'i sems bskyed kyis zin pa dang / bar du lta ba rnam par dmigs med du sbyong ba dang / tha ma gzhan don du bsngo ba smon lam gyi rgyas 'debs dmigs med kyi ngang nas byed pa lam thams cad kyi mchog yin par go lags/ mi ltogs pa la gzan gon pas mi chog za dgos/ stong 286

nyid rtog pa la don go bas mi chog bsgom dgos par go lags shing / khyad par lhag mthong rtogs pa'i thabs rjes thob tu bsags sbyangs gnyis la yengs med du 'bad dgos par go lags/ don dril ba la da lta rnal 'byor pa nyams su len pa'i stong nyid/ mnyam nyid/ brjod med/ mi rtog pa rnams dbang bzhi dang mthun pa'i gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa'i lam rim gyi lta ba yin par go lags/ go ba rnams mngon du byed pa la lus la bab skur/ lto la gyong skur/ sems la las skur nas/ snang ba gdong 'ded/ 'chi nus thog 'gal/ ci byung ro snyoms nas/bka' drin 'khor thabs med pa'i bla ma yab yum gyi drung du/zang zing gi zhabs tog 'bul rgyu ma byung bas/ sgrub pa'i mchod pa ji srid 'tsho'i bar du 'bul zhing / mthar thug gi rtog pa 'og min chos kyi pho brang du 'bul bar zhu/ zhes zhus pas bla ma'i zhal nas bu khyod la de tsam zhig re yang re ste byung yang byung 'dug gsung thugs mnyes mnyes mdzad gsungs/des na de'i dus su yang sngar bshad pa de gcig pus chog par go lags zhes ma zhus pa'i phyir ro/ /kun mkhyen klong chen rab 'byams pas kyang / rgyu pha rol tu phyin pa'i theg pa nas 'bras bu rdo rje theg pa'i bar gyi rgyal ba'i gsung rab rnams skyes bu 287

gcig 'tshang rgya ba'i tshul la nges pa rnyed nas/ yongs rdzogs nyams su len pa'i rim pa rdzogs pa chen pos sems nyid ngal gsos 'grel ba shing rta chen po brtsams pa yin te/ des na sngar gsungs pa de gcig pus 'bras bu sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang mngon du byed na/ de yang mdzad mi dgos pa'i phyir ro/ /des na 'di 'dra'i rigs kyi dgongs pa ma lon par phyin ci log tu go nas/ phyag rdzogs pa'i chos kun la log par bltas/ hwa shang gi phyogs su bzhag nas brnyas sgod byed pa de shes rab bzang ba'i mig dang ldan pa'i pho tshod mkhan gyis long gtam smras pa yin pas/ shes rab sbyan ldan rnams 'khrul bar mi bya'o/ /phyag rdzogs dang hwa shang gi 'dod tshul la khyad par gnam sa bas kyang che mod kyang 'dir tshig mang du dogs nas ma smros la/ gzhi lam 'bras gsum gyi rnam bzhag mdor tril gyis dril na/ gzhi rang sems yid bzhin nor bu lta bu la glo bur sgrib gnyis 'dam lta bus gos pa/ lam tshogs gnyis nyams len chu ras lta bus bye dor byas/ 'bras bu sku gsum ye shes lnga dgos 'dod ltar 'byung bar 'dod la/ de yang dbu ma'i chos thams cad bden gnyis zung 'brel du gtan la phab nas/ lam thabs shes zung 'brel du nyams su blangs/ 'bras 288

bu sku gnyis zung 'brel du thob par 'dod pa dang / tshig gi cung zad mi mthun pa re snang yang / don gyi mi mthun pa cung zad tsam yang med ces tshad ldan gyi mkhas grub thams cad kyis mgrin gcig dbyangs gcig ltar gsungs so/ /dper na mi 'ga' res gtam drang por bshad kyang 'ga' res go log tu go nas 'khon 'dzings byed pa ltar/ 'di 'dra'i dka' gnas la mkhas pas/ thugs nyams ma bzhes bog par go na rang gzhan gnyis 'phung 'byung bas mi rung / dper na byis pas go log go nas spo langs nas ngus rung pha mas rgyu mtshan bshad nas ma nyan na snying rje'i gnas las gzhan sked pa ltar/blun pos log par go nas gzhan khas gtong rung mkhas pas rgyu mtshan bshad nas ma nyan na snying rje'i gnas yin pas de'i khar rtsad gcod ci yod/ 'jig rten gtam dper/ mkhas pa 'chug na 'doms gang / glen pa 'jug na mtho gang yin zer/des na mkhas pas zhib tu rtog dpyod btang / rgyal ba'i gsung rab kyi dgongs pa lon par byas/ blun po la bshad cing /blun pos rang gi log rtog dug chu rgyang ring du dor nas/ mkhas pa'i gsung gi bdud rtsi 'thung na 'chi med zung 'jug rdo rje 'chang gi go 'phang brnyes par 'gyur ro/ /yang 'ga' res/289

deng sang bdag med rtogs pa'i shes rab kyi ral gris/bde dge thams cad 'phrog nas/ mi 'dod sna dgu bcol ba'i nyes can bdag 'dzin nyon mongs dug lnga'i mgo bo gcod thub min lta bar/ mgar ngan gyes brdungs pa'i gri ngan gyis phan tshad med btags/ gnod pa tshad med las bskyabs pa'i drin can pha mar lug rnams kyi mgo bo gcod la dpa' ba'i gcod sngags snying khams can 'ga' res gcod gtong dus/ 'khor bar 'khyams pa'i dogs gcod ma/ /thar ba 'dod pa'i re gcod ma/ /gnyis 'dzin 'khrul ba gcod mdzad ma/ /ma lab sgon mar phyag 'tshal lo/ /zer mig btsums skad gseng mthon pos dbyangs ring po byas 'don pa de/ las dang nyon mongs pa'i dbang gis da bar 'khor bar 'khyams/ da dung bdag 'dzin blos ma thongs pa'i dbang gis nyon mongs langs nas/mi dge bcu nyin rer spyod tshul 'dis/ spyir 'khor ba dang khyad par ngan song gsum du sgyes nas sdug bsngal tshad med pa myong bar 'dug snyam pa'i dogs pa de thabs mkhas gcod kyi gdams pa zab mo'i sgo nas/ gcod mdzad ma zhes pa yin na de ka legs te/ thar bar 'dod pa'i re gcod ma zhes pa 'di ma cig lab sgon la bstod pa ma red smad pa red/ thar ba'i re 290

ba ma cig gis ma bcad kyang gcod sngags 'ga' res bya ba la bltas na re thag chad yod gi khas bshad tshul dang lag len la 'debs tshul gnyis mthun 'dug ya mtshan che/ thar bar re mi nyan na thob ga la rung / sngon chad thar ba thob song ba tsho'i sdug ang / ha ha ha tsho zer/ 'o de 'dra zhig ma dgod dang / de la 'ga' res lta ba mnyam par 'jog dus re dogs dang bral bar 'jog dgos pas/ de'i dus su re dogs kyi blo byung ba dang / skye med chos dbyings kyi ngang du gcod mdzad ma yin zhes zer la/ 'on kyang ngas khyod la de'i rgyu mtshan shes tshod cig bshad kyis/ 'o de dper na/ yid bzhin gyi nor bu 'dam gyis gos pa byi dor byas/ rgyal mtshan gye rtse mor bzhag mchod bstod bkur/ gsol ba btab na/ nor bu de las dgos 'dod 'byung bar ma shes par/ nor bu mchod bstod sogs byas na/ dgos 'dod phyogs gzhan zhig nas 'byung du re ba ltar/ gcod pa rnams kyi blo kha nang du phyogs nas rang sems la bltas/ sngar mi dge ba'i sems skyes pa spangs/ ma skyes pa rnams mi bskyed/ dge ba'i sems ma sgyes pa bskyed/ skyes pa rnams gong 'phel du btang / khyad par 'khor 'das bde sdug legs nyes kun gye rtsa ba sems kyi gzhi rtsa bcad nas/ gnas 291

lugs stong gsal zang thal 'dzin med mtha' bral chos dbyings byas na/ rang sems las 'bras bu thar ba bla na med pa sgu gsum ye shes lnga'i bdag nyid yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'byung bar ma shes par/ zab mo gcod kyi gdams pa nyams su blangs na thar ba'i go 'phang de phyogs gzhan zhig nas 'ong du re ba'i 'khrul ba'i blo de gcod mdzad ma zhes pa yin pas/ dus kun thar 'dod kyi blo bskyed mi rung / rang bzhin gyi thar 'dod kyi re ba 'dra skyes song yang sangs rgyas pa'i gegs yin pas/ de gcod mdzad ma zhes pa yin snyam nas phyin ci log tu go nas 'khul bar mi bya ste/ rgyal dbang thams cad mkhyen pas/ sems 'di ma rtogs ma rig 'khor bar 'khyams/ /rtog na rig pa'i ngo bo kun tu bzang / /rkang 'khyams rgyal po'i bu bzhin rang nyid la/ /gnas phyir sangs rgyas phyi rol nas 'tshol ba/ /rkun bu nang bzhag phyi ru rtsad gcod 'dra/ /zhes dang / 'od gsal chos sku rang la gdod ma nas/ /gcer mthong ngo sprod a ti rdzogs pa che/ /theg pa'i yang rtse 'dzin la goms 'dris na/ /sangs rgyas gzhan nas 'tshol ba'i re ba skyungs/ /gsungs/ rje mi las/ 'khor ba gzhan du spang du med/ /mya ngan 'das pa sgrub tu med/ /rang 292

sems sangs rgyas su blo thag chod/ /ces dang / yang / sangs rgyas sems su ngo shes pas/ /zhe 'dod sgrub bya ma mchis so/ /gsungs/ zhang g.yu brag 'gro ba'i mgon pos/ rang sems sangs rgyas cer gyes mthong / /sangs rgyas rtsol ba'i nad dang bral/ /zhes dang / mnyam med dwags po lha rjes/ de ltar rang sems sangs rgyas ma lags pa/ /phyogs bcu dus gsum ma lus gang la yang / /sangs rgyas phyi nas btsal bas rnyed mi 'gyur/ /de bas rang gi sems la blta ba goms par gyis/ /zhes dang / dgyes pa rdo rje las/ sems ni rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas nyid/ /sangs rgyas gzhan nas btsal du med/ /ces dang / 'dir mang smra bas ci zhig bya/ /sems rtogs pa nyid sangs rgyas nyid/ /ces dang / grub chen las kyi rdo rje'i zhal nas/ yar sangs rgyas la re na gol bas/ rang sems las logs na sangs rgyas med par thag bcad/ mar ngan song du lhung du dogs na gol bas/ sems gzhi med 'khor ba'i rgyu dang bral bar thag bcad/ las rgyu 'bras khyad du gsod na gol bas/ g.yo med kyi btsan sa ma zin bar du las rgyu 'bras khyad du mi gsod par thag bcad gsungs/ 'bar ra bas/'bras bu gzhan nas thob byar mi sems par rang la rang 293

chas yod pa'i chos sku 'di/ /goms par byas na sangs rgyas 'thob nas 'ong / /gsungs/ gcod kyi bshags pa las/rang sems yid bzhin nor bu la/ /dgos 'dod 'byung bar ma shes par/ /'bad rtsol gzhan du re ba yang / /ma sprul pa'i sgu la mthol lo bshags/ /gsungs/ de yin pa'i rtags su gcod gzhung thams cad na/ thog mar dal 'byor rnyed dka'/'chi ba mi rtag las 'bras 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs sogs bsams nas/ thar 'dod kyi blo shugs drag bsgyed/ de nas de las skyob pa'i skyabs dkon mchog gsum sogs la skyabs 'gro byas/ de nas rang nyid 'khor ba 'dir lhung nas sgye rga na 'chi sogs sdug bsngal ba bzhin/ ma gyur 'gro ba kun kyang de 'dra bar mthong nas/ rang nyid gcig pu 'khor ba las ci thar byed pa'i bsam sbyor thams cad bor nas/ byams pa dang snying rje chen pos/ sngon gyi rgyal ba'i tshogs kyis ma bsgral ba'i sems can thams cad rang nyid gcig pus 'khor ba 'di las ci sgrol zhig byed snyam/ da lta'i gnas skabs su rang la sems can gcig tsam sgrol ba'i nus pa mi 'dug sems can kun sgol ba la/ thog mar rang nyid skyon kun zad yon tan kun ldan sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob dgos par 'dug da ni ma 294

sems can thams cad kyi don du yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang rin po che myur ba myur du thob na ci ma rung / ci nas kyang thob par bya/ de'i ched du zab mo gcod kyi gdams pa nyams su len par bgyi'o snyam pa'i byams snying rje byang chub kyi sems rin po che'i sgo nas gcod nyams su len dgos zhes nan tan gsungs pa yin la/ thar ba re mi nyan na/de 'dra gsung don med pa'i phyir ro/ /khyod kyis gcod sngags 'di cha bos ra lug gi mgo gcod tshul min mi shes/ 'di 'dri dang kha na lce dbyung rgyu min med mod/ ci zhig zer gi blta snyam nas nyams tshad pa yin na skyon cher mi 'dug ste/ de ma yin par nges par de ltar 'dod nas dris pa yin na khyod kyi bsam pa la/ ngas mtshan ldan bla ma 'dod 'jo ba mo lta bu bsten nas/ gzhung lugs rab 'byams 'o ma lta bu lo mang po'i bar du ngoms med du 'thung / thos bsam sgom gsum gyi lus stobs rgyas nas/ gsung rab kyi thang yangs pa na 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum gyi rtsed 'jo byed pas/ rgyal ba'i gsung rab kyi don ma shes na/ gzhan khyod 'dra'i bla ma ltas ngan gla ba lta bu las gdams ngag gla rtsi tsam zhig thob/ brag phug kha khung lta bu nas/ gcig pur gla phrug bzhin du nyal 'dug pa zhig gis 295

yon tan ci shes zhes nga la snying khyes btang nas dgod mod/'on kyang ngas bltas na/ khyod kyis mtshan ldan bla ma bsten nas gzhung lugs la lo mang sbyangs pa zhig dang mi rig gi ba rgan ma gnyang rkyal zhig gi 'og gi gnyang dri bro ba'i 'o ma 'thung mkhan gyi glang phrug rgyab ser zhig dang mtshungs byung / khyod la bltas na ngas nyon mongs dug sbrul 'joms pa'i dam chos kyi rtsi sman cung zad thogs nas/ ri khrod dben pa'i bsil grib na/dge sbyor gye dri ngad chil le nyal 'dug pa dga' rab byung /dper na blun pos gtam 'ga' re'i rgyu mtshan nges nges po ma shes/ phyin ci log tu go nas/ gzhan gtan nas dgod rgyu mi 'ong ba la yang / kho shed gis lhag lhag bgad tshe/ de'i thag nye na 'khod pa'i blo ldan bsam shes kyis blun pos rgyu mtshan ma shes bgad pa shes nas/ kho la khog gis snying khyes btang mig gis ngor bltas bzhad gad byas/ rgyu mtshan bshad na gzhan de na yod tshad kyis cis glen pa zhig red zer ha dgad cher byed pa ltar/ rgyal ba'i gsung rab kyi 'di dang 'di 'dra'i rigs kyi dgongs pa ma lon par phyin ci log tu go nas/ gzhan gyis brnyas smod nam yang mi 'ong ba'i chos zab mo gcod sogs grub mtha' rnams la brnyas smod byas/ chos ma go ba'i mtshang 296

gzhan mas ston mi dgos bzhin rang gis bstan nas bgad na/mi mngon dbyengs na bzhugs pa'i ma cig lab sgon sogs sngon byon rgya bod kyi mkhas grub rnams kyi lha'i snyan gyes gsan ye shes kyi spyan gyis gzigs tshe/ dgongs pa ma lon par 'dug dgongs thugs gting nas khrel ba'i rtags su bzhad gad byas/rgyu mtshan gsungs na zhing de kun na bzhugs pa'i skal bzang gi byang chub sems dpa' bye ba ther 'bum gyis khyod la bltas bzhad gad byas/ phyogs bcu'i zhing khams rab 'byams bzhad gad kyis 'gengs shing / da lta'i gcod sngags rnams kyis yang go na/ ra lug gi mgo gcod zhor la khyod la bltas ha bgad byed pas gzhan ma sems/ yang 'ga' res rang gi be'u bum lag mthil tsam re bltas nas/ dge lugs pa 'dis/bdag med gnas lugs rtogs pa'i thabs so sor rtogs pa'i shes rab la lhag mthong zer ba 'di 'gal ba che ste/ dper na mtshan mo mun pa bsal nas/ lha sgur lta ba'i thabs mar me la lha sku'i ming btags pa dang mtshungs pas de shin tu mi rig ste/rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug mi la ras pa'i zhal nas/ mdor na zhi gnas bzang po'i nyi mas ngar 'don dang bcas pa dang /so sor rtogs pa'i shes rab zab mo'i dpyod pa dang bcas pa 297

'di/ lhag mthong rtogs pa'i thabs med du mi rung skas la 'dzeg pa'i skas them 'og ma dang 'dra zhes gsungs pa ma gtogs lhag mthong yin zhes ma gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /des na chos thams cad kyi gnas lugs stong gsal 'dzin med lhag ger mthong ba lhag mthong zer gyis/ de rtogs thabs rtog dpyod byed pa la lhag mthong zer na/ phyi rol gyi gzugs mthong mkhan gyi mig gi ming la gzugs/ de bzhin nyan mkhan gyi rna ba'i ming la sgra/ snom mkhan gyi sna la dri yin zer dgos pa sogs/ ha cang thal bar 'gyur/ rtog dpyod thams cad lhag mthong du 'dod na/ khye dang phag khwa ta dang skya ka sogs sems can thams cad kyis lhag mthong rkyang bsgom par 'dod dgos/ de yin na sems can thams cad grol bar rigs te/de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de rnams la yang rtog dpyod kyi spro bsdu mang ba'i phyir ro/ /zer na/ 'o de khyod kyis gtan nas ma go 'dug glen pa'i nang gi glen pa khyod nyon dang / da ngas kyang mi shes glen pa yin mod/ 'on kyang shes tshod cig khyod la bshad kyis/ sngon glen pa zhig bla ma gcig gi drung du song nas skad cha'i zhor gcig la chos thams cad sgyu ma lta bu red ces kha nas shor song ba/ bla ma des so so'i skye bo phal ba rnams kyi nang 298

na'ang chos thams cad sgyu ma lta bur rtog pa'i gang zag yod kyi red snyam/ dag snang zhig byung nas/ mi de la gnang sbyin zhig byas/ khos bsam pa/ de ring chos thams cad sgyu ma lta bu red bshad tshe 'di gnang dus/ nangs par song nas g.yos lta bu red zhus na/ 'di bas che zhig gnang rgyu red snyam/ phyi nyin song nas chos thams cad g.yos lta bu red lags smras pas/khong bzhad gad shor/ yid chad song zer ba ltar/ khyod kyis gnas lugs stong nyid kyi ngo bo lhag ger mthong ba la lhag mthong zer zhes bshad pa khyod bden/ gzhan mkhas pas de red zer khas len kyang / de gcig pu min lhag mthong zer ni med/ so sor rtogs pa'i shes rab la lhag mthong gtan nas mi zer bshad pa mkhas pas bzhad gad dang / yid chad pa'i gtam zhig tu zad/ lhag mthong zer ba de rgyu chung chung gcig gnyis tsam zhig ma yin te/ lhag mthong la bzang ngan rab 'bring tha gsum mtha' yas/ 'jig rten 'ga' zhig gis/bzang ngan gyi dngos po gang mthong ni yin yang rung / ngas sngar gyi de bas lhag zhig mthong / yang de bas lhag zhig mthong / yang de bas kyang lhag zhig mthong tsho zer ba ma go'am/rje mi las gsungs pa de/ chos thams cad kyi gnas lugs 299

stong pa nyid rnam dag mthong med kyi lhag mthong rtogs pa'i thabs so sor rtogs pa'i shes rab yin zhes gsungs pa ma gtogs/ so sor rtogs pa'i shes rab de lhag mthong min zhes ma gsungs te/ khong gis ras pa sangs rgyas skyabs la sems khrid gnang nas mgur gsungs pa/ rje dkon mchog la gsol ba 'debs bzhin du/ /chos thos bsam gyi phu thag bcad nas ni/ /bdag med go yul gye sor rtog lhag mthong la/ /zhi gnas ngar 'don gyi srog thag bzang bo btags/ /byams dang snying rje yi skyes bu stobs ldan gyis/ /gzhan phan sems bskyed kyi rtsal stobs drag po yis/ /smon lam rnam dag gis gyen du drangs pa las/ /mthong lam rnam par dag pa mngon sum du/ /rnam dag mthong med kyi lhag mthong rtogs te mchi/ /blo re dogs kyi rang mtshang de dus rig /ma phyin par sangs rgyas sa ru slebs/ /ma bltas par chos sku de dus mthong / /ma sgrub par 'dun ma lhun gyis grub/ /bu dge bsnyen sems la de ltar zhog /gsungs/ mgur de'i nang na/ bdag med go yul gye sor rtog lhag mthong la/ /zhes so sor rtogs pa'i shes rab la lhag mthong zhes gsal bar gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /dpal ldan ma khol gyis/ shes rab nang na kun mkhyen ltar/ /zhes 300

gsungs pas/ zhi gnas sogs phar phyin gzhan las so sor rtogs pa'i shes rab lhag mthong yin zhing / des bltas na blang dor gyi gnas mi mthong ba med/ bltas gi bltas gi sngar gyi de bas lhag de bas kyang lhag mthong bas na/ de la lhag mthong mi zer na ci la zer/ dper na mi bas lhag gi lha zhig mthong ba la lha mthong mkhan mi zer bar 'dre mthong mkhan khyed kyis zer ram/ gal te khyod kyis 'dod pa ltar yin kyang / so sor rtogs pa'i shes rab/ don dam gnas lugs dang gang gi ming la lhag mthong btags kyang 'gal ba med de/ dper na pha ri'i ngos la song nas/ tshur ri'i ri la pha ri/ tshur ri la 'ong nas sngar song ba'i ri de la yang phar ri zer ba dang /'ga' res nyi ma'i 'od zer ri mgo la phog pa nyi ma shar 'dug zer ba dang / nyi ma kho rang la yang nyi ma zer ba dang mtshungs pa'i phyir ro/ /rtogs dpyod gang byas kyang 'dod chags las lhag zhe sdang yin par mthong / byams snying rje las lhag byang chub kyi sems yin pa mthong bas mtshon bzang ngan gang yin de bas lhag de bas lhag mthong bas/ mi dge ba mthong ba ma spangs na grol bar mi 'gyur ba khyod bden yang / lhag mthong gi ming tsam/ de la yang btags na chog ste/ ci'i phyir zhe na/301

lhag pas lhag pa byas mthong ba'i phyir ro/ /so sor rtogs pa'i shes rab la lhag mthong / rgyal ba'i gsung rab dgongs 'grel tshad thub du ma nas yang yang gsal bar gsungs ste/ ston pa'i dgongs 'grel gyi mdo las/ shes bya'i don rnam par 'byed pa dang / rab tu rnam par 'byed pa dang / yongs su rtogs pa dang / yongs su dpyod pa dang / bzod pa dang / 'dod pa dang / bye brag 'byed pa dang / lta ba dang / rnam par rtog pa gang yin pa de ni lhag mthong zhes bya ste gsungs/ 'phags pa dkon mchog sprin las/ zhi gnas ni sems rtse gcig pa'o/ /lhag mthong ni yang dag par so sor rtogs pa'o/ /zhes dang /rje btsun byams pas/ lhag mthong lam ni de don rnams/ /rnam par dpyod par shes par bya/ /zhes dang / rje btsun thogs med kyis/ ji ltar bsam pas chos de nyid kyi mtshan ma yid la byed cing / 'byed pa dang rab tu rnam par 'byed pa dang / chos rab tu rnam par 'byed pa nas rgyas pas mkhas pa dang shes rab kyis 'jug pa'i bar gang yin pa de ni lhag mthong zhes bya'o/ /zhes dang / slob dpon ka ma la shī las/ de kho na la rnam par dpyod pa gang yin pa de ni lhag mthong yin gsungs/slob dpon sharnyi bas/ rtog pa dang bcas pa'i gzugs brnyan 302

du gyur pa ni lhag mthong gi dmigs pa'o gsungs/ rje bdag nyid chen po'i zhal nas/ log pa'i yul la g.yeng ba zhi byed cing / /yang dag don la tshul bzhin dpyod pa yi/ /zhi gnas lhag mthong zung du 'brel ba'i lam/ /zhes gsungs so/ /des na khyod kyis gsung de rnams ma red ces smra phod dam/ byis pa 'ga' res rgan pa'i gtam yin ni zhig la de ma red smras na pha ma sogs kyis snying rje/ 'ga' res bltas ha bgad rkyang byed pa ltar/ khyod kyis rgyal ba rnams kyi gsung de ma red smras pa/ rgyal dang rgyal sras rnams kyis gsan na snying rje skye zhing / deng sang mkhas pa rnams kyis go na/ 'o de min na 'di e red/ ka e red ces phyin ci log mang po bshad pa 'phya smod bzhad gad kyi gnas yin pas/ da khyod kyis ang dge lugs pas ci zer ginyams tshad ni yin zhes rdzu bag la brten dang mdzes/ yang phyag rdzogs pa 'ga' res/ 'bras bu rgyu'i rjes su 'gro bas khong tsho'i lta ba 'di/ rnam par mi rtog pa'i ye shes dang ches shin tu mthun pas 'khrul med po yin la/ dbu ma pas me 'dod nas chu len pa ltar/ mthar thug 'bras bu rnam par mi rtog pa'i ye shes 'dod nas/ lam skabs su rnam rtog rkyang sgrub pa/ zhe 'dod dang lag len phyin ci log tu song ba yin te/ rdo rje 303

snying 'grel las/ rgyu 'dra de las skye ba yi/ /'bras bu thams cad du mthong gi /ko ḍa pa yi sa bon las/ /sa lu'i 'bru ni 'byung ba med/ /rnam rtog sa bon las byung ba'i/ /'bras bu rnam rtog bcas par 'gyur/ /rnam par mi rtog las skyes pa'i/ /'bras bu rnam par mi rtog 'gyur/ /gsungs 'dug zer na/ de chos rgya chen po lam sbyangs par re re tsam la nges pa ltar snang re rnyed tshe glen gtam khrom du ngom pa yin te/'bras bu rgyu'i rjes su 'gro ba khyod bden yang / mtha' gcig tu de 'dra zhig dgos pa'i nges pa med de/ de yin na/ lam zag bcas las/ 'bras bu zag med kyi bde ba mi 'byung bar 'gyur zhing so so skye bos 'phags pa yang thob par mi 'gyur te/de ci'i phyir zhe na/ rgyu 'bras mi 'dra ba'i phyir ro/ /de bzhin sa bon skya bo las myu gu sngon po 'byung ba dang / me las du ba skye ba dang / bud med las bu skyes pa sogs rnam pa mi 'dra bas/rgyu 'bras mtha' yas pa zhig snang ba'i phyir ro/ /khyod kyis 'di tsho yang da bar ma mthong ngam/ dbu ma sang rgyu 'bras ches shin tu mthun te/ 'od srung gi le'u las/dper na shing gnyis rlung gis drud pa de las me 'byung ste/byung nas shing gnyis bsreg pa de bzhin du 'od srung yang dag par so sor rtogs pa yod na/304

'phags pa shes rab kyi dbang bo skye ste/ de skyes pas yang dag pa'i so sor rtogs pa de nyid bsreg par byed do/ /gsungs/sgom rim bar ba las/ de ltar shes rab kyis rnam par dpyad de/ gang gi tshe rnal 'byor pas/ dngos po gang gi ngo bo nyid don dam par mi 'dzin pa de'i tshe rnam par mi rtog pa'i ting nge 'dzin la 'jug go gsungs/ sgom rim tha ma las/de rnam par rtog pas ngo bo nyid yin du zin kyang / tshul bzhin yid la byed pa'i ngo bo nyid yin pa'i phyir/ rnam par mi rtog pa'i ye shes 'byung bar 'gyur bsan/ye shes de 'dod pas de la brten par bya'o gsungs/ gal te de ltar mi 'dod pa'i phyag rdzogs pa'i rkang 'dren rang gzhan gnyis 'phung byed pa'i blun po wa skyes re gnyis yod na/ dbu ma thos bsam sgom gsum gye rtsal gsum rdzogs shing / lung rig rab dkar rno ba'i mche ba bzhi gtsigs pas/ stag seng rtsod pa'i kha 'thab pa'i bar du song la khyed sang gi 'dod pa de ma red/ 'di yin gyis la mchu gnyer dang / lung rig gi mche ba rnon pos brdabs nas/ kha len gye wa skad shor/ 'gal ba'i rma kha mang po bton tshe kha nang na le yang phyir dbyung rgya med par kha btsams nas 'khun sha(15 ra ri da ri dgos tshod yong pas/ de bas grong sde'i lung stong 'grims la/305

rnyed bkur 'dod yon gyi zas kyis 'grangs tshe/ sbyin bdag gi stan gyi steng nas 'gying / za chog gi nga ro bsgrags na mjes/yang dbu ma pa kha cig gis/slob dpo na ka ma la shī las/ rnam par mi rtog par 'jug pa'i gzungs las/ yid la mi byed pa'i gzugs la sogs pa'i mtshan ma spong ngo / /zhes gsungs pa gang yin pa de yang shes rab kyis brtags na mi dmigs pa gang yin pa der yid la byed par dgos kyis/ yid la byed pa med pa tsam ni ma yin te/ 'du shes med pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa ltar/ thog ma med pa'i dus nas gzugs la sogs pa mngon par zhen pa yid la byed pa spangs pa tsam gyis sgong pa ma yin te/ zhes dang / gang zhig shes rab kyis dngos po'i ngo bo nyid so sor brtags nas mi bsgoms gyis/ yid la byed pa yongs su spang pa tsam 'ba' zhig bsgom par byed pa des rnam par rtog pa nam yang mi bzlog cing / ngo bo nyid med pa nyid nam yang rtogs par mi 'gyur te/ shes rab kyi snang ba med pa'i phyir ro/ /zhes dang / yang dag par so sor rtogs pa nyid kyi dran med pa dang / yid la byed pa med pa/ byed nus kyis gzhan du ma yin no/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ phyag rdzogs blun po rnams kyis mi rtog par bzhag pas gar yang mi 306

phyin par 'dug zer na/ 'o de skad ma zer dang / dngos po re re thabs mi 'dra ba mang po'i sgo nas lon pa ches shin tu mang ba bzhin/ rnam par mi rtog pa'i ye shes gsar ma sang gi thabs 'di gcig pus ma gtogs gzhan gyis mngon du byed mi nus zhes khyed sang mkhas pa zhig dang mi rig ga phyag rdzogs pa'i blun po tsho'i lad mo byas glen gtam byed ga la rung /dper na me gcig pu len pa la yang gtsub shing gtsub pa las kyang lon/ me shel nyi ma la bzung bas kyang lon/ me lcags brdab pas kyang lon pa ma mthong ngam/ rje nag po spyod pas/rnam mi rtog las sangs rgyas yin/ /de bzhin rnam rtog bcas las kyang / /shin tu rnam dag yongs shes na/ /mkhas pa rnams ni 'gyur ba nyid/ /gsungs/ da ngas bsam na phyag rdzogs dbu gsum su yin kyang sangs rgyas kyi dgongs pa rnam par mi rtog pa'i ye shes mngon du byed nges snyam pa ma gtogs log lta spu tsam 'char rgyu mi snang / slob dpon ka ma la shī la sogs skyes chen rnams kyi gsung na de gcig pus min/ gzhan gang gis ma rtog pa 'dra gsungs pa rnams la dgongs gzhi dmigs gsal yod pas/ gzhan gyis gtan nas mi rtogs zhes gsungs pa'i tshig tu 'khrul bar mi bya'o/ /dper na spa ba me shel nyi ma 307

'phrod du bcug nas g.yo 'gul med par bzung na me 'bar ba ltar/ phyag rdzogs pas so sor rtogs pa'i shes rab kyi dpyad pa sngon du btang nas/ gnas lugs stong gsal chos sku ngo 'phrod nas/ gsal stong spros bral nam mkha' lta bu'i ngang der glod nas 'jog bsgom byas na/ rnam par mi rtog pa'i ye shes mngon du byed de/ rnam par mi rtog pa la 'jug pa'i gzungs las/ theg pa chen po'i chos zab mo la thos bsam kyi shes rab sngon du 'gro ba'i rgyal ba'i sras pos/ mtshan mar 'dzin pa'i 'gal ba'i phyogs/ rnam par mi rtog bsam zhing bsgom par gyur na mtshan ma la spyod pa'i rnam par rtog pa'i dra ba bgrod par dka' ba las rnam par 'das te/ rim gyis rnam par mi rtog pa'i ye shes thob par 'gyur ro gsungs/ de slob dpon ka ma la shī la'i dgongs pa dang mthun te/ khong gis chos la dran pa med cing yid la byed pa med pa de yang / yang dag par so sor rtogs pa sngon du 'gro ba yin gsungs pa dang / sems gang yin pa de yang btsal na stong par rtogs so/ /sems gang gis rtog pa de yang ngo bo nyid kun tu btsal na stong par rtogs so/ /de ltar rtog pa'i mtshan ma med pa'i rnam 'byor la 'jug go gsungs pa ltar/ sngon du so sor rtogs pa'i shes rab 308

kyis dpyad nas gnas lugs gtan la phab nas/ mtshan 'dzin gyi spros pa mtha' dag dang bral ba'i mtshan ma med pa'i gnas lugs stong gsal zang thal gyi ngang la ma nyam par bzhag pa'i phyir ro/ / dper na tshes gsum gyi zla ba bco lnga'i zla ba dngos ma yin kyang / zla ba'i ming thob cing rim gyis bco lnga zla ba nya gang bar 'gyur ba bzhin/ phyag rdzogs pa'i lta ba 'di rnam par mi rtog pa'i ye shes dngos ma yin kyang / rjes su mthun pa'i bying rgod dang bral bar bskyangs pa'i mthar rnam par mi rtog pa'i ye shes mtshan nyid pa mngon du byed de/ rnam par mi rtog pa dang rjes su mthun pa'i phyir ro/ /de ltar mi 'dod na 'bras bu rgyu'i rjes su 'gro ba'i rgyu 'bras thams cad 'chol bar 'gyur te/nas las nas/ chags pa goms pa las chags pa/ chags bral goms pa las chags bral mi 'byung dgos pa sogs ha cang thal bar 'gyur/ gnas lugs kyi ngang la mi rtog par mnyam par bzhag pa la/ mthar thug 'bras bu chos sku'am/ sangs rgyas kyi thugs rnam par mi rtog pa'i ye shes mngon du byed pa mdo rgyud bstan bcos thams cad nas gsungs pa khyod kyis bsnyon du med de/ kun byed las/ sngar bas 'das pa'i sangs rgyas thams cad kyang / /rang gi sems 309

las gzhan du chos btsal med/ /ji bzhin pa las 'chos par byed ma mthong / /ting 'dzin rnam par rtog pa bsgom ma myong / /rang sems mi rtog pa yi 'grub pa yin/ /da lta bzhugs dang slad kyi 'byon pa yi/ /rtog med mnyam pa nyid kyis 'grub par 'gyur/ /zhes dang / rgyud sasbu ṭa las/ 'dzin pa gnyis ni yongs btang na/ /rnam par dag cing grol ba'i gnas/ /zhes dang / tshangs pas zhus pa'i mdo las/ dpyod pa ci rnyed pa thams cad ni rtog pa'o/ /yongs su mi rtog pa ni byang chub bo/ /zhes dang / bla ma gser gling pas/ shigs se shigs la 'bol le zhog /des na mi 'ching grol bar 'gyur/ /zhes dang / ma cig gis/ bsam med bsgom pa ma nor na/ /chos sku byang chub the tshom med/ /ces dang / spyan snga rin po che'i zhal nas/ 'jig rten 'di dang 'jig rten 'das/ /yon tan ci rnyed thams cad ni/ /mi rtog ma yengs pa yi su/ /bsam las byung ngo zhes gsungs zhing / /sems ni mi rtog mnyam bzhag na/ /yang dag ji bzhin shes 'gyur zhes/ /phan yon gzhan dang gzhan dag kyang / /dpag tu med pa mdo rgyud dang / /bstan bcos kun las gsal bar bshad/ /gsungs/ 'di 'dra'i lung brgya dgos na stong yod/ de rnams la dgongs nas/310

rje rin po ches kyang / sems kyi ngo bo la bltas pa'i zhi gnas de la stong nyid rtog pa'i lhag mthong ltar ngo sprod pa yang yod do zhes gsungs/gal te de ltar mi 'dod pa'i dbu ma'i bla btsongs mi 'gyes bdag 'gyes byed pa'i rtog ge pa'i khye rkun re gnyis yod na/ phyag rdzogs kyi rnal 'byor pa mdo rgyud man ngag gi go mtshon thogs nas tshe 'dir nyon mongs pa'i dgra bo cham la 'bebs pa'i snying stobs mchog gi pha rol tu son pa'i dang 'a bo bsgom byung rtog pa'i shes rab kyi spu gri rnon po thogs nas/ gdul bya'i ma rtogs log rtog the tshom gyi dra ba gcod pa'i mkhas pa mthu nus lung rigs kyi rdo dang dbyug pas/ phyi rol rgol ngan khye rkun thams cad tshar gcod pa'i mkhas grub gnyis 'dzoms kyi drung du song la/ khyed tsho'i 'dod pa de ma red gyis mchu gnyer la der lung rigs kyi rdo dang dbyug pa'i char phab tshe/ khyod kyi rigs pa 'khyag 'khyog gi skad ngan phul nas brgya stong zug kyang / sdes khyod sngags phyogs su yar ded nas brdungs/ mdo phyogs su mar ded nas brdungs tshe/'gal ba'i na zug mang po byung ba ma bzod par/ 'chal gtam gye gcin dang tshig ngan gye skyag pa shor tshe khyod bzhag btang na/ngan smras lkog shub kyi skad sna nas 'don bzhin 'ong dgos 311

pas/ de bas rtog ge ngan pa'i khye rkun rnga lu tsho/ dbu ma pa lung rigs dri med smra ba'i mkhas pa'i go sa khang thog nas kha mig thur bltas bsdad na mdzes/ 'o na phyag rdzogs pas so sor rtogs pa'i shes rab kyis thog mar gnas lugs gtan la phab dus stong pa'i nges shes shig sgyes kyang mnyam bzhag skabs la stong pa'i nges shes med pas/ stong nyid bsgom pa'i phyogs su yong ma song 'dug zer na/ de khyod kyis gtan nas ma go ba yin/ rngas shes ci la med/ dper na mkhar rnga brdung na rnga sgra lhang nger grags pa'i thar sgra je chung je chung la song nas mi mngon pa de/ gtan med du song ba ma yin te/ rnga nang na mi mngon pa'i tshul du/ gdangs ma 'gags par yod de/ yod rtags su phyis sa rdo shing sogs kyi rkyen dang 'phrad tsam gyis sgra lhang nger grags nas yang mi mngon par 'gro ba ltar/ phyag rdzogs pa'i gnas lugs gtan la phab dus kyi stong pa'i nges shes rnga sgra lta bur lhang nger skyes pa de/ stong nyid kho rang gi gnas lugs ji ba'in pa stong gsal 'dzin med kyi mnyam bzhag rnga lta bu'i ngang du dngos su med kyang bag la zha nas mi mngon pa'i tshul du yod pas gtan med ma yin te/ yod pa'i rtags su phyis bdag 'dzin nyon mongs 'khrul snang 'jigs 312

skrag gi rkyen sa rdo shing lta bu 'phrad tshe/ de ma thag bden med stong pa'i nges shes rnga sgra lta bu lhang lhang 'char ba myong bas kyang grub la/ skyes nas yang gnas lugs stong gsal mtha' dbus dang bral ba'i mnyam gzhag nam mkha' lta bu'i ngang du mi mngon par 'gyur ro/ /dper na ras sngon po'i steng du shel dkar po bzhag na shel de mi snang ba lta bur 'gro ste/ shel la snon 'brid byas pa med/ de bzhin du sems nyid stong gsal 'dzin med zang thal gyi ngang la mi rtog par bzhag dus/ so sor rtogs pa'i shes rab kyis dpyad pa'i stong pa'i nges shes dam spring nge ba mi snang ba lta bur 'gro yang nges shes la dgag sgrub gang yang byas pa med/ des na mnyam bzhag de sngar gyi stong pa'i nges shes kyi rtsis dang ma bral bar yod smras pa 'gal ba spu tsam med de/ rje rin po che'i zhal nas/ des na lta bas zin pa'i spyod pa dang / thabs kyis zin pa'i shes rab ni dper na bu sdug shi ba'i mya ngan gyes mnar ba'i ma de gzhan dang smra ba sogs la 'jug pa'i tshe/ blo ci sgyes kyang mya ngan gye shugs kyis ma btang yang blo thams cad mya ngan gyi blo ma yin pa bzhin du/ stong nyid rtogs pa'i shes rab shugs drag pas sbyin pa gtong ba dang /phyag dang bskor ba sogs byed pa'i tshe/ de dag 313

la dmigs pa'i blo de rnams stong nyid rtogs pa min yang / de'i shugs dang ldan pa'i 'jug pa mi 'gal la/ thun mgo lta bur byang chub kyi sems shugs drag po sngon du btang nas/stong nyid kyi ting 'dzin la bzhag pa'i tshe/ byang chub kyi sems de dngos su med kyang / de'i rtsis zin pa mi 'gal te/ thabs shes ya ma bral ba'i tshul yang de ltar ro/ /gsungs pa dang mtshungs pa'i phyir ro/ /dper na rta zhig sngon nas bor song ba/lung ba'i phu mdo bar gsum du btsal bas rnyed tshe/ kho bo'i rta 'di na 'dug red snyam pa'i nges shes skyes pa tsam du ma zad/skyes bzhin pa'i ngang nas rta kho rang kha dog dbyibs mngon sum rjen cer gyis mthong ba de la phar 'jus nas bzung /steng du zhon nas blo sems bde 'bol le ldem ldem gang 'dod gnas su 'gro ba ltar/ phyag rdzogs pas chos kun gyi rtsa bar rang sems kyi gnas lugs sngon nas stor ba/ byung gnas 'gro gsum/ gnas 'gyu rig gsum gye sgo nas rtsad bcad nas/gnas lugs stong pa nyid du mthong tshe/ sems kyi gnas lugs stong pa nyid red snyam pa'i nges shes skyes pa tsam du ma zad/skyes bzhin pa'i ngang nas/ stong nyid kho rang gi 'dug tshul gsal stong rjen pa/ spros dang bral ba mtha' dbus med pa nam 314

mkha' sprin med kyi dkyil du bltas pa ltar gnas pa mngon sum du rjen cer gyis mthong ba'i ngang la shes pa lhod nas bzhag pa yin pas/ dbu ma las lhag gi khyad chos shig 'dir mchis so/ /des na phyag rdzogs pa'i lta ba la stong pa nyid kyi nges shes kyi rgyun skyong rgyu med gi zhes 'phya smod byed rgyu spu tsam yang mi snang bar gda'/ de la 'phya smod byed na/ sangs rgyas thugs rje can rnams kyis/ gdul bya med pa'i skabs 'ga' re la/ sgu dang ye shes/ zla ba dang zer lta bu/ thugs chos sku nam mkha' lta bu'i ngang du/ gnam stong gi zla ba lta bur mi mngon par bzhugs dus su yang / khyod kyis rgyun chad par khas len dgos la/ khyed dbu ma sang gi mthar thug 'bras bu rnam par mi rtog pa'i ye shes mngon du byas dus kyang / stong pa nyid kyi nges shes 'dzin stangs dam spring nge ba de yod dgos la/de ltar 'dod na dper na dgra bsad kyang da dung mtshon cha nyin mtshan med par lag tu bsdams nas 'dzin dgos zhes smras pa dang 'dra bas/ khyod sngar bod du ma grags pa'i dbu ma gsar ba zhig go /de skad smras pa gsan na/ bstan pa'i bdag po rgyal ba gnyis pa sogs kyis bzhad gad 'chor te/de'i rgyu mtshan dper na shing la me yang yang sbar nas shing kun 315

la me 'bar tshe sngar ltar sbar mi dgos chog pa ltar/ dpyad 'jog gi bsgom yang yang byas pas/ bdag 'dzin nyon mongs kyi nges shes 'dzin stangs kun zhig tshe dpyad pa yang rdzogs pa yin pas sngar ltar dpyad mi dgos te/ rje bdag nyid chen po'i zhal nas/ snang brten 'brel bslu ba med pa dang / /stong pa khas len bral ba'i go ba gnyis/ /ji srid so sor snang ba de srid du/ /da dung thub pa'i dgongs pa rtogs pa med/ /nam zhig res 'jog med par gcig char du/ /rten 'brel mi bslur mthong ba tsam nyid nas/ /nges shes yul gyi 'dzin stangs kun 'jig na/ /de tshe lta ba'i dpyad pa rdzogs pa lags/ /gsungs/da khyod kyis de tshe lta ba'i dpyad pa ma rdzogs lags zer dgos pa'i gnas su ma gyur pa zhig gyes sku mkhyen/ dper na shing kun 'tshig tshe me yang rang sar zhi 'gro ba ltar/ bdag 'dzin nyon mongs kun zad 'phro/ stong pa'i nges shes kyi rtogs pa phra mo de yang rang sar zhi nas sangs rgyas kyi thugs rnam par mi rtog pa'i ye shes mngon du byed pa yin zhes tshad ldan gye gzhung dang / dbu ma rang lugs smra bas skad gseng mthon pos sgogs pa 'dir bshad mi dgos so/ /yang khyed phyag rdzogs pas lta ba'i skabs so sor rtogs pa'i shes rab kyis dpyad bsgom byed 316

pa dor bas rgyal ba'i bstan pa'i rtsa ba so sor rtogs pa'i shes rab spangs pa'i nyes pa 'jug zer na/ de ga la 'jugadaper na gzugs brnyan du ma'i 'char gzhi rin chen shel dkar dri ma med pa'i me long rang gi lag tu 'bral med du bzung ba ltar/ so sor rtogs pa'i shes rab che ba myur ba gsal ba zab pa kun gyi 'byung gnas rig pa'i ngo bo stong gsal chos dbyings chen por mnyam par bzhag pa yin pas/de ni shes rab thams cad kyi pha dang ma lta bu rab dang phul dang rtse mo yin zhes ngo mtshar zung 'jug rdo rje'i lus la lhun grub sku gsum gyi rtsal gsum ma lus pa yongs su rdzogs shing /lung rtogs yon tan du ma'i g.yu ral sngon po ches cher rgyas pa chos dbyings skye med lha yi lam la yar gyen du 'phyur nas phyogs brgyar g.yo zhing / ya mtshan tshad med bzhi yi rab dkar mche ba rnon po bzhi gtsigs nas rdo rje'i glus nga ro ches cher bsgrags na skal ldan seng phrug dkar mo rnams mdun du gnas kyang dga' zhing spro la/ skal dman log smra wa skyes gcan gzan rnams rgyang na gnas kyang snying rtsa 'dar ba/ phul byung thabs mkhas bsdu bzhi'i gom pa gdul bya'i 'dzin ma'i khyon gang du bzhag kyang / rnam dkar dge ba'i bag chags kyi ri mo 317

gsal bar 'god cing / srid zhi'i 'jigs pa thams cad dang bral nas gang la nyam nga dang bag tsha spu tsam med pa bod gangs ri'i khrod na seṅge dkar mo ma bu srab med du 'phyo ba lta bu'i zla med grub pa'i dbang phyug chen po/ rje ras chen ras chung zhes snyan pa'i ba dan dkar po srid pa gsum na ches cher g.yo ba la sogs/ sgrub rgyud bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan srid pa'i rtse mo'i bar du ches cher bsgrengs mkhan sngon skyes bu dam pa rnams kyis mgrin gcig dbyangs gcig ltar gsungs pa mtha' yas la/ de bzhin du skyon kun zad yon tan kun rdzogs ston pa sangs rgyas sogs rgyal ba rnams kyis bka' dri ma med pa nas kyang yang yang gsungs te/ tshangs pa sems kyis zhus pa'i mdo las/ mi sems pa ni bsam gtan no/ /mi dmigs pa ni shes rab bo/ /zhes dang / rgyal ba'i yum las/shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ni/ yid la byar med de nam mkha' lta bu'o/ /zhes dang / smra bsam brjod med shes rab pha rol phyin/ /ma sgyes mi 'gag nam mkha'i ngo bo nyid/ /ces dang /brgyad stong pa las/ chos thams cad mi dmigs pa gang yin pa de ni shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'o/ /zhes dang /mdo sdud pa las/ gang la shes rab pha rol phyin mchog mi dmigs 318

shing / /byang chub sems dpa' mi dmigs byang chub sems mi dmigs/ /de skad thos nas rmongs pa med cing mi skrag pa/ /byang chub sems dpa' de ni bde gshegs shes rab spyod/ /ces dang / klong drug pa las/ brjod du med pa'i sems nyid la/ /zhi gnas lhag mthong rang shar bas/ /mnyam par bzhag dang rjes su ni/ /mi g.yo bsam gtan nyid du rdzogs/ /gsungs/ngas bltas na khyod kyis dus gsum rgyal ba bskyed pa'i yum chen mo shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di spangs 'dra med na/phyag rdzogs pas dam pa gong ma'i rnam thar gsung sgos la brten nas gang yin yang da dung ma spangs tsam du gda'/dper na rgya mtsho chen po rlung gis ma bskyod par sngo kyil le gnas dus/ rba rlabs ri mo gang yang dngos su mi snang yang gtan med du song ba ma yin te/ rlung cung zad re'i rkyen byas ngo mtshar ri mo sna tshogs g.yo ba bzhin/ phyag rdzogs pas ma yum chen mo chos nyid stong sangs chen po'i ngang la lhod kyil le mnyam par bzhag yod dus/ sor rtogs rags pa rnams dngos su mi snang yang gtan med ga la yin/ snang grags cung zad res rkyen byas so sor rtogs pa'i shes rab rno la myur ba mang po byung bas so sor rtogs pa'i sher rab spangs pa'i nyes 319

pa 'jug don med/ mnyam bzhag skabs sor rtogs rags pa dngos su med pa la/ so sor rtogs pa'i shes rab spangs pa'i nyes pa 'jug na/ khyed dbu ma sang gis kyang / zhi gnas kyi sems gnas rim pa dgu ba'i skabs dang / lta ba mthon por gyur nas lta ba'i dpyad pa rdzogs pa'i dus su/ sor rtogs shes rab spangs nas rgyal ba'i bstan pa la gnod chen po skyel gi yod rgyu red/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de dus kun rtog rags pa dngos su mi snang ba'i phyir ro/ /yang mi rtog par bsdad pas grol na bu chung khye rgan brgyal ba gnyid log dus rnams la rnam rtog zhi 'dug thams cad grol bar rig ste/ yon tan spu tsam mi 'dug phyag rdzogs pa sngar hwa shang gi ming gsal bo zhig ma btags pa ma gtogs hwa shang dngos red/ bla ma sgyes bu dam pa mang pos hwa shang gi rjes su 'brang ba bod na mang zer ba de da bsam na 'di tsho yin rgyu red/ da khyed phyag rdzogs pa dang hwa shang la khyad par ci yod/ shod cig zer na/ 'o de khyod kyis nga la dris/ ngas khyod la lan 'debs mi dgos te/ dpe cha la blta nus na sngon gye phyag rdzogs pa'i mkhas grub mang pos lan brgya dgos na stong btab 'dug mdor bsdus na/ hwa shang gis thabs kyi cha rnams gtan nas spangs te/ nya dang nyung ma 320

bzhin mi rtog pa thams cad bsgom du bzung nas/ de'i ngang du nyal nas 'dug pa yin zhes khyed tshos bshad pa de bden na de dang ga la gcig phyag rdzogs pas dper na yid bzhin nor bu dri mas gos pa rnams byi dor byas rgyal mtshan gye rtse mor brtan par 'jog pa ltar/ sems la sgrib g.yogs gang yod tshogs bsags sgrib sbyong gis dag par byas/ so sor rtogs pa'i shes rab kyis dpyad nas sems kyi gnas lugs stong gsal mtha' dbus dang bral ba sprin med nam mkha' lta bu'i ngang du bying rgod dang bral bar khyab gdal zang thal du 'jog pa gnyis/ mi rtog pa tsam gyi ngos nas 'dra yang / gsal cha dang stong cha yon tan yod med kyi cha nas 'dra jon med de/nor bu dang mching bu/ gser dang ra gan/ nyi zla dang mar me/gnam dang sa'i khyad par yod/ mching bu mchod bstod gsol ba btab na dgos 'dod med pa bzhin/ hwa shang gi lta ba ci tsam goms kyang yon tan mi 'byung la/ nor bur gsol ba btab na dgos 'dod 'byung ba ltar/ phyag rdzogs pa'i lta ba 'di'i ngang la mnyam bzhag na/ spyan dang mngon shes rdzu 'phrul sogs yon tan dpag med 'byung ste/ rje mi las/ dbyar ga'i spang la ci yang sgye/ /pag shi'i kha nas ci yang 'byung / /321

rtog med nyams la ci yang 'char/ /zhes dang / lung gzhan las/ bsam du med pa'i chos nyid la/ /bsam du med par mnyam bzhag na/ /bsam du med pa'i nyams myong 'byung / /gsungs/ de 'byung ba'i rtags su phyag rdzogs nyams su bzhes pa'i sngon byon dam pa rnams kyis mchog thun gyi dngos grub brnyes nas/ mngon shes dzun 'phrul dpag med bstan te/nam mkha'i snying bo nyi ma'i zer la chibs/ /sangs rgyas ye shes brag la phur ba 'debs/ /rgyal ba mchog dbyangs rta skad thengs gsum thon/ /mkhar chen mtsho rgyal bsad pa'i mi ngo slong / /dpal gyi ye shes ma mo mngon sum 'khol/ /dpal gyi seng ge lha srin bran du 'khol/ /bai ro tsā na ye shes spyan dang ldan/ /mnga' bdag rgyal po ting 'dzin mi g.yo grub/ /g.yu sgra snying bo rtogs pa mchog dang ldan/ /dzñān ku mār ni dzu 'phrul ston/ /rdo rje bdud 'joms rlung ltar thogs pa med/ /ye shes dbyangs ni mkha' spyod gnas su gshegs/ /sog po lha dpal gcan gzan gnya' nas 'dzin/ /sna nam ye shes mkha' la bya ltar lding / /dpal gyi dbang phyug phur ba gdengs tshad 'gum/ /ldan ma rtse mang mi brjed gzungs rnams thob/ /ka ba dpal brtsegs gzhan gyi sems rnams shes/ shud bu dpal 322

seng chu bo gyen du ldog /rgyal ba'i blo gros ro langs gser du bsgyur/ /khye'u chung lo yis nam mkha'i bya rnams 'dzin/ /dran pa nam mkha' byang nas g.yag rgod khug /'o bran dbang phyug chu la nya ltar 'dzul/ /rma thog rin chen pha bong zas su za/ /dpal gye rdo rje ri brag thogs pa med/ /langs 'gro dkon mchog thog chen mda' ltar 'phen/ /rgyal ba'i byang chub mkha' la skyil drung bca'/ /gsungs/ mi la sogs bka' rgyud pa'i bla ma rnams kyi sku gsung thugs kyi yon tan kun la grags che bas smos ci dgos/ des na kun mkhyen thu'u kwan rin po che'i zhal nas/ drug ldan brgyud pa'i chu bo gcig tu 'khyel/ /gdams ngag las tshogs rin chen gter gyis bkang / /grub mchog klu dbang 'bum phrag rol ba'i gnas/ /rnyogs bral snga 'gyur theg pa'i rgya mtsho zhes/ /sa lam rim par bgrod pa'i ngal ba yis/ /sangs rgyas gzhan du 'tshol la ltos min par/ /thod rgal khregs chod gdams pas zag bcas kyi/ /phung bo 'od skur grol ba'i che ba can/ /zhes dang / bka' brgyud 'chi med grub pa'i drang srong gis/ gangs dang ri sul yul ljongs kun bkang ste/ /ras dkar 'dab gshog can rnams 'phur lding gis/ /mkha' dbyengs bya rgod phung bor 'khrigs byed cing / /323

ngur smrig 'dzin pa 'dus pa'i khyu 'khrigs pas/ /sa kun li khri'i rdul gyis sbags pa bzhin/ /ngo mtshar phung bo de la lha'i dbang pos/ /mig stong sprul nas blta bar ma zad kyi/ /rab 'byams zhing gi rgyal ba rgya mtsho yang / /chos kyi dbyengs nas gzigs mor bzhengs sam snyam/ /gsungs/ sngon mi gcig gis/ gna' ma bshad da shod/ pha ma bshad bu shod smras pa ltar/ da gna' gi ched deng sang phyag rdzogs pa yon tan sgye ba du yod shod dang zer na/ deng sang kyang phyogs phyogs na sbas pa'i rnal 'byor pa mang po yod de/ nga gcig pus kyang rna thos mang po yod pa phar zhog mig gis mthong ba la yang kwa thog phyogs kyi bla ma'i mtshan bsod nams snyan grags zhu ba zhig sog phyogs su byon/ khong gis 'das ma 'ongs da lta'i lung bstan gang gsung kyang / kha dang lag pa sprad pa bzhin gcig 'chug rgyu mi snang / mkha' 'gro chos skyong lus dang grib ma bzhin 'grogs shing / rdzu 'phrul kyang phyogs phyogs nas mang po bstan/ wang gis khong tsho'i dad pa'i rten du grub rtags phyag rjes zhig gnong zhus pas/ mi mang po khrid nas song thams cad kyis mthong sar brag la phyag rjes bzhag pa sog phyogs na da lta yang yod/ yang bla ma zhig gis gzhan mi shi na/324

nyin re'i lam yin kyang 'pho ba btab na bem po 'gul zhing /spyi gtsug gi skra dong tse'i shul lta bu lhung ba sogs/ 'pho ba'i rtags khyad par can ston pa zhig kyang byung / thugs rje chen po'i rnal 'byor pa rje bla ma bstan 'dzin nyi ma'i mtshan can gyi smyung gnas stong phrag gcig dang lnga brgya bsrungs thugs rje chen po'i zhal mthong sgrub khang phyi nang du thal byung du bgrod pa byung /yang bon po zhig gis 'pho ba grong 'jug lan gsum mdzad pa byung / yang gcod nyams su len pa'i rnal 'byor pa mtshan yongs grags gcod pa zer ba zhig gis mnyam par bzhag tshe sangs rgyas kyi zhing khams mang po mthong zhing / sems can gyi skyid sdug legs nyes shes pa zhig kyang mthong byung / rje dus gsum mkhyen pa rwa stod rdo rje 'chang sogs skyes bu dam pa mang pos deng sang kyang sa lam drod rtags thob pa sbas pa'i rnal 'byor pa mang po yod gsung / dper na bsod chung 'ga' res rgyu noms cung zad yod pa mi la ngoms kyang /bsod nams can gyis gser dngul dar zab sogs ci yod su la'ang mi ston par sbas nas 'jog pa bzhin/ gang zag 'ga' res rang la lam rtags kyi yon tan nyag nyug re skyes pa mi la brjod nas blun po'i rang rtags ston kyang / skyes bu dam pas yon tan khyad 325

par can thams cad mi la mi ngom par gsang ba mkhas pa'i khyad chos yin te/ sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta kun dga' rgyal mtshan chen po'i legs bshad las/ blun pos yon tan kha ru 'byin/ /mkhas pas yon tan khog tu sbed/ /gsungs/ dper na 'dod 'byung nor bu gser dngul dar zab sogs nor rdzas rtsa can gang yod gzhan su la yang ma bstan par sbas na/ dgra rkun gyes 'tshe ba med pa/ gang yod lam gyi mdo sogs nas kun la bstan na/ rku 'phrog slong gsum sogs byung yal 'gro ba ltar/sa lam gyi yon tan gang rgyud la skyes pa'i phyi nang gsang ba'i rtogs pa byung ba gzhan la ma bstan na/ bar chad med par sa lam mthar phyin par 'gyur la/ gang yod kyi yon tan bstan na/ gzhan gyes rnyed bkur rnam g.yeng phrag dog sogs bar chad 'byung ste/ rnal 'byor dbang phyug rje btsun mi la ras pa'i mgur las/ rnal 'byor pa yi lus dang gcig /gsang sngags thabs kyi lam dang gnyis/ /nyams su myong ba'i 'bras bu gsum/ /'di gsum sbas na dgra nyung ste/ /'di gsum sbed pa'i mi re nyung / /de phyir bod na grub thob nyung / /gsungs/legs bshad las/ sgyu ma lan cig bstan na mjes/ /gsungs pa ltar sgyu ma mkhas pas/ sgyu ma'i rtsed mo lan gcig 326

lan gnyis bstan na mdzes kyi/ dus rgyun du bstan na snang ba sun pa tsam las mdzes rgyu chung / blta 'dod mi 'byung ba ltar/sa lam mthar phyin pa'i grub pa'i dbang phyug chen po rnams kyis kyang / grub rtags lan gcig lan gnyis bstan na ya mtshan du 'dzin gyi/ rgyun du byung rgyal du bstan pa la dgos pa chung / dper na phyug po'i gser dngul sogs rgyu noms rtsis can rnams/ rang gi sha tsha snying nye'i grogs sogs la dga' spro 'phel phyir dang / gzhan 'ga' zhig gis sprang slong 'dra ba khyed sang la nor rdzas cang med yod na ston dang zhes brnyas smod khyad gsod sun 'byin byed pa sogs ston dgos pa byung na/phyug rtags su nor re gnyis ston pa ltar/ skyes bu dam pas/rang gi dad gus dam tshig gcig gtsang ba'i grogs dang /slob bu skal ldan rnams yid dang pa 'dren phyir dang / gzhan log lta can gyes spyon pa khyod la yon tan cang med yod na ga re/zhes brnyas smod skur 'debs byed mkhan la bstan pa'i che ba 'byin phyir grub rtags yon tan sna re tsam ston srid/phyug pos rgyun du noms pa yod kyang sbas rgyu noms pa med pa ltar bsdad na/ gzhan gyis nor rdzas zur tsam mthong tshe/ 'dis nor rdzas thams cad sbas 'dug da dung 'di bas mang po yod 327

srid/ gzhan 'di 'dra'i mi'i rigs kyis nor rdzas mang po sbas nas yod rgyu red snyam srid pa langs/ kun la brnyas smod sogs mi byed par 'dangs rtsis che ba ltar/ skyes bu dam pas rang la yon tan gang yod thams cad sbas nas tha mal pa ltar mdzad na gzhan 'ga' res yon tan sna re tsam ma mthong tshe/'di skyes bu dam pa gzhan dang mi 'dra ba zhig red/ 'di la da dung 'di 'dra'i yon tan mang po sbas nas yod srid/ gzhan 'di 'dra'i sbas pa'i rnal 'byor pa mang po yod rgyu red snyam dad gus skyes/ brnyas smod khyad gsod sun 'byin mtshang 'bri sogs mi byed par yon tan bsgrags mchod bstod bkur ba sogs rang gzhan la phan pa'i dgos pa mang po 'byung / sngon gyi bka' gdams pa'i bla ma sogs skyes bu dam pa mang po mngon shes rdzu 'phrul sogs thogs pa med par ston rgyu yod kyang byung rgyal du mi ston par sbas pa'i rgyu mtshan de yin/ de rnams la ston rgyu med pa ma yin pa'i ha go dgos/ dper na rul ma'i bu lag tu 'phyar nas ngom pa ltar/ yon tan cung zad re yod pa mi la ngom e thub blta ba snyigs dus chos pa 'jig rten chos brgyad thob byar byed pa'i chos lugs shig yi na na ma gtogs/ gzhan sngon byon da lta'i skyes bu dam pa'i mdzad 328

spyod cig ga la yin/ skyes bu dam pas rang gi yon tan sbas pa phar zhog gzhan skal bzang gi gdul bya la yang / thugs brtse ba'i sgos yon tan sbas dgos zhes gsungs te/ byang chub sems dpa' nor bu'i phreng ba las/ rang gi yon tan sba bya zhing / /gzhan gye yon tan bsgrags par bya/ /la sogs pa mang po gsungs/ des na dad gus dag snang yod na/ deng sang kyang dbu rdzogs phyag gsum sogs bod du dar ba'i grub mtha' gang na yang sbas pa'i rnal 'byor pa brgya dgos na stong yod tshod du 'dug dag snang med/ log lta byas na sangs rgyas dngos yod kyang skyon gyi gong bur mthong ste/legs skar lhas byen sogs kyi lo rgyus na gsal bas de la ltos/ yang khyod kyis brgya'i mi tshad stong bshad kyang / de kun rdzun yin/ nga yid mi ches/ phyag rdzogs pa'i lta ba dang / gnyid ni gnyis la khyad med/ gnyid gi gnyid gi gti mug cher 'phel ba ltar/ lta ngan de bskyang gi bskyang gi dran brjed che ba sogs skyon 'phel ba ma gtogs yon tan gang yang mi 'byung zer na/ sngon gcig gis kho bo'i yi dam phur ba yin bshad tshe/ gcig na re/de yin na kho'i yi dam phur rdebs yin smras pa ltar/ phyag rdzogs pa gnyid log pa dang khyad med na/ khyed dbu ma sang gi 329

zhi gnas gnyid 'thug dang khyad med/lhag mthong dang tha mal gyi rnam rtog la khyad med par 'gyur te/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/de rnams mtshungs pa'i phyir ro/ /de yin na/ khyed sang gi zhi lhag la yon tan mang po 'byung zer tshad thams cad khyod kyis rdzun du btang 'dug pas/ da khyod kyi ha go des chog ni gyis/yang 'ga' res/ phyag rdzogs sogs bod kyi grub mtha' blun po kha cig na re/ rang sems sangs rgyas kyi rgyu yin zhes spras na rgyal ba'i gsung rab tshad ldan dang mthun pas shin tu legs te/gsung rab kha cig gi dgongs pa ma lon par rang sems ye nas sangs rgyas yin pas sangs rgyas rang la yod ces skad gseng mthon po'i kha po nam mkha'i 'brug bzhin blun po chu 'dzin lta bu'i gseb na ldir ba de rig pa smra ba'i mkhas pa dar seng dkar mo lta bu'i thag nyer 'ong nas sgogs rgyu'i gtam ma red/ blun po tsho sangs rgyas zer ba de ci 'dra zhig la zer na skyon gyi rigs su gyur pa mtha' dag sangs/ yon tan gye rigs su gyur pa mtha' dag rgyas pa zhig la zer dgos/ de yin na sangs sngon nas rgyas yod pa zhig slar yang 'grib nas sangs rgyas dgos na/ de 'dra'i gtam khyed cha bos kha 'di ma gtogs chung ma las skyes nas da snga yan su'i kha nas go ma 330

myong / de yin na sangs rgyas pa la kun dga' bar 'dug ste dgos pa mi snang zer 'gal ba du ma phud brnyes gtam rkyang smra na/ 'o khyod dogs pa skyes nas de skad dogs pa gcod kyi dri ba byas pa legs te/ khyod kyis kho chung ma las sgyes nas 'di 'dra'i gtam da snga go ma myong zer ba khyod mkhas pa zhig gi gtam zhig ma red shin tu btsog ste/ sangs rgyas tshun chad na khyod kyis go ma myong ba'i de 'dra'i gtam khri dgos na 'bum yod pas/ de nga rgyal gyi gtam zhig tu mngon pas dor zhig dang / ngas khyod la phyag rdzogs pa'i gtam khyod kyis gsar du go ba de'i don cung zad tsam zhig dpe'i sgo nas bshad kyis nyon cig dper na nyi ma mun pa dang ye nas gtan bral 'od zer rang chas lhun grub tu yod kyang / glo bur sprin nag pos bsgribs na/ 'od stong 'jig rten gyis mi mthong bar 'gyur ba phyis bltas na skyon gyis gos pa ltar snang yang nyi ma kho rang la skyon gyis cung zad tsam yang ma gos pas sngar bas ngan du ma song la sprin gyi phag na 'od lam me bsdad yod mod/ 'on kyang 'od stong 'jig rten du mi snang ba'i gegs sprin de dag gis bya ba dag cha yin pas skyi ser rlung gis sprin rnams dang bral bar byas tshe 'od lam me 'byung / 'od stong gis 'jig rten kun 331

khyab nas rgyal khams bde la bkod tshe/ sngar bas bzang du yang ma song / sprin gyis bsgrib ma bsgribs dus nam yin yang /nyi ma zhes zer dgos pa ltar rang sems 'od gsal stong pa ye nas skyon mtha' dag dang bral zhing / yon tan mtha' dag dang ldan yang / glo bur gyi dri mas bsgrib tshe/ sku dang ye shes sogs kyi yon tan mtha' dag mi mthong bar gyur pa/ phar bltas na skyon gyis gos pa ltar snang yang / sems nyid gsal stong pa/ kho rang skyon gyis cung zad tsam yang ma gos pas/sngar bas ngan du ma song bas glo bur dri mas bsgribs pa'i phag na gsal sing nge gnas yod mod/ 'on kyang sku dang ye shes gdul bya la mi snang ba'i gegs glo bur gyi sgrib pa de dag cha yin pas/ tshogs bsags sgrib sbyong byas dag par gyur tshe/ sku dang ye shes mngon sum du byung nas 'phrin las 'jig rten la khyab nas gdul bya rnams bde la 'god tshe/ yang sngar bas bzang du ma song / glo bur dri ma yod med gang gi dus su yang rang sems sangs rgyas zer dgos te/ brtag gnyis las/sems can rnams ni sangs rgyas nyid/ /'on kyang glo bur dri mas bsgribs/ /de nyid gsal na sangs rgyas nyid/ /ces dang /kun mkhyen klong chen rab 'byams pas/ ye sangs rgyas pa'i 332

rig pa la/ /yang sangs rgyas pas rtog pa 'khrungs/ /sgrib med zang thal gcer bu 'di/ /'bras bu re dogs bral ba lags/ /gsungs/ khyod kyi 'dod pa ltar yin na/ nyi ma sprin gyis bsgrib tshe skyon gyi gos nas smug por song yod/ 'od zer med/gsal sgrib che bas nyi ma zhig yod mi dpe/ de 'dra yod zer ba chung ma la skyes nas da bar go ma myong smras pa dang mtshungs pas/ tshig 'di mkhas pa'i mdun sar song nas skad gseng mthon pos smras na thugs mnyes nas/ zhal 'dzum bzhin khyod kyi de red ces zhal nas 'don mkhan 'dra yod na/ de dang khyod gnyis sngar bod du phebs ma myong ba'i mkhas pa zhig go /sangs rgyas la yang sgrib pa mi mnga' skyon gyi mi gos kyang /yon tan rnams glo bur gyi dri mas cung zad bsgrib srid ste/ston pa sangs rgyas mya ngan las 'da' khar kun dga' bo sogs la mya ngan ma byed/ nga ma 'ongs pa'i dus su dge ba'i bshes gnyen gye skur sprul nas 'gro ba'i don mdzad pa yin gsungs pa ltar/ deng sang sangs rgyas byang sems kyi sprul pa 'khrul med yin zer ba'i sku skye dge bshes/ grub thob/ gter ston mang pos bod gangs can gyi ljongs thams cad kha gang 'dug te/ de thams cad la yon tan gsar du slob dgos pa 333

phar zhog tha na bza' btung byed lugs yan chad slob dgos pa de/ ma'i mngal sogs glo bur gyi dri mas sgrib pa yin dgos/ de min na sku skye dge bshes gcig yin ni min/thams cad kyis sngar shes pa'i yon tan brjed kyang tha na skad cha yan chad brjed nas slar pha ma sems can gyis slob dgos pa ci zhig byung zer/ de la ngas bsam pa yin na sangs rgyas la ye nas sgrib pa mi mnga' zhing skyon gyi dri mas gos mi srid mod/ 'on kyang glo bur gye dri mas yon tan gyi cha shas cung zad sgrib pa de ka dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyis bsal nas/ sngar gyi yon tan slar mngon par 'dod la/ khyod kyi 'dod pa ltar yin na/ sangs rgyas mi yi gzugs su shar ba rgyal ba paṇa chen sogs la yang skyon mnga'/ yon tan mi ldan dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyi yon tan gsar du bslab pa yin zhes zer dgos pa'i tshod na 'dug khyod kyi ha ga na ro go 'o na sangs rgyas dang sems can la khyad par med dam zer na/ dper na 'dam du byeng ba'i nor bu dang / rgyal mtshan gyi rtse mo la bkur ba'i nor bu gnyis la don dam pa nor bu'i ngos nas khyad par med mod/ 'on kyang mi gtsang ba'i dri ma dag ma dag dang / dgos 'dod 'byung mi 'byung gi khyad che ba bzhin/ 'khor bar 334

'khyams pa'i sems can dang / mya ngan las 'das sangs rgyas gnyis/ don dam pa sangs rgyas pa'i ngos nas khyad med mod/ 'on kyang glo bur sgrib pa'i dri ma dag ma dag dang /gzhan don 'byung mi 'byung gi khyad par che'o/ /'o na rang sems sangs rgyas yin na 'khrul rgyu ma red zer na/ 'khrul ba med rung 'khrul ba ltar snang te/ dper na nyi ma'i 'od zer la sgrib pa med rung rgya mtsho la phog tshe/ des rkyen byas rlangs pa byung / rlangs pa de nam mkha' la song nas/ nyi ma kho rang la sgrib pa dang mtshungs so/ /'o na 'bras bu dang po nas yod na/ de'i rgyu tshogs gnyis la da slob ci la dgos zer na/ de glo bur sgrib gnyis kyi dri ma sel ba'i gnyen po yin pas/ ma bslabs na sgrib pa dang bral nas/ sku dang ye shes gdul bya'i ngor dngos su snang mi nus pa'i phyir ro/ /'o na sgrib gnyis sel ba'i thabs tsam ma gtogs/ 'bras bu sku gnyes kyi rgyu tshogs gnyis yin zhes gsungs pa ma yin nam zhe na/ dper na yid bzhin gye nor bu dgos 'dod 'byung ba'i thabs khrus ras sogs la dri ma sel thabs sam/ dgos 'dod 'byung thabs gang bshad kyang chog pa ltar tshogs gnyis la sgrib gnyis kyi gnyen po'i sku gnyis kyi rgyu gang smras kyang don gyis 'gal ba 335

med do/ /'o na ngo sprod zer ba de sems nyid sangs rgyas yin nas ngo sprod dam/ min nas ngo sprod dam/ de yang chu dang 'o ma bzhin bsre bar/ so sor ma 'dres par shod/ sangs rgyas yin nas ngo sprod pa yin zer na/ de yin na ngo sprod mi dgos te/ ji lta ba dang ji snyed pa mkhyen pa'i sangs rgyas gyis rang sangs rgyas par mkhyen pa smos ci dgos/ rang gis rang sangs rgyas yin pa tsam yang mi shes par/ mkhyen pa'i yon tan thams cad sangs nas/ mi shes gti mug mun pa kun rgyas yod pa'i sangs rgyas shig yod srid dam/ gtam de glen pa phyag rdzogs pa rnams ma gtogs mkhas pa su zhig gis smra/yang sangs rgyas min nas ngo sprod 'debs pa yin zer na/ des ci la phan/ dper na mching bu zhig la 'di ni 'dod 'byung nor bu'o zhes smras pa ltar/ 'gro ba kun bslu ba'i chos shig snyigs dus 'dir byung ba yin pas/ kun gyis 'bur 'joms byed par rigs so zer na/ yang ngas bshad khyod nyon/ dper na dbul bo'i sgyed rdo de/ dang po nas gser yin kyang g.ya' zhen nas ngo ma shes pa la/ gzhan gser rgyus shes pa'i mis bsreg bcad brdar nas/ gser yin pa mngon sum du ston pa ltar/ 'gro kun sems nyid ye nas sangs rgyas yin kyang / ma 336

rig pa sogs glo bur gyi dri mas bsgribs nas ngo ma shes pa/gnas lugs don dam rtogs pa'i mtshan ldan bla mas lung rigs man ngag la brten nas/ sgrib g.yog dang bral bar mngon sum du ngo sprod pa yin pas 'gal ba med pa la/ sangs rgyas yin zhes khas blangs phyin chad nas thog mtha' bar gsum dus rtag tu chos thams cad sa ler mkhyen dgos pa'i nges pa med la/ mkhyen dgos zer na/ sangs rgyas kyi sprul pa rgyal ba paṇa chen gter ston sogs skyes bu dam pa thams cad kyi drung du khyod song la kun e mkhyen gyi nyams tshad gyes/ mi mkhyen tshe de kun la kun mkhyen sangs rgyas yin pa mar bud ces sun dbyung rang gi bla ma yan chad la 'bur 'joms gyis/ de byed zer na/ khyod kyi ming de spor nas dge bshes 'bur 'joms zer bar rigs so/ /de yin na khyod sngar yod ma myong ba'i dge bshes gsar ba zhig byung ba yin pas dgod 'chor/ ha ha ha/ yang kho bo la dgod mi dgos/ 'di la nyon/ 'o na so skyes kyi stong nyid mngon gyur gye tshul du rtogs par 'dod dam/lkog 'gyur gye tshul du rtogs par 'dod/ mngon gyur gyi tshul du 'dod zer na/ gang zag de thams cad sa dang po thob pa sha stag cig yin de/ sa dang po ma thob par gnas lugs stong 337

nyid mngon sum du rtogs mi srid ces gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /gang zag de sa dang po par khas len na/ skad cig gcig la ting nge 'dzin gyi sgo brgya phyes/ sprul pa brgya 'gyed pa sogs sa dang po thob pa'i rtags rnams tshang dgos la/ de tshang zer na 'phags pa dngos yin pas/ slob ma 'phags pa stong nyid mngon sum du rtogs pa la/ bla ma'i rjes dpag kyi tshul du ngo sprod 'debs pa/ pha mar byis pas bslab bya bstan pa dang /dge bshes la ban chung gis ka kha bslab pa dang 'dra bas dgos pa ci yang med la/ gang zag de la yon tan cang med kyang / sa dang po thob pa'i gang zag yin dbos/ sa dang po thob rtags kyi yon tan rnams phyi nas yong ba yod do zer na/de ches shin tu mi rigs ste/ nyi ma sngon la shar nas 'od zer phyi nas 'ong smras pa dang / khyad par ci yang ma byung bas/gtam de mkhas pa'i bzhad gad kyi gnas shig yin la/ yang na lkog gyur gyi tshul du 'dod zer na/ de yin na bla mas rang sems chos kyi sku 'di yin/da ni khyed kyis mngon sum du mthong ba yin no zhes ngo sprod 'debs/ skya rengs tsam shar ba nam langs/ nyi zerwa tsam mthong ba nyi ma mngon sum du mthong ba yin no zhes smras pa dang 'dra bas sngar kyi de bas kyang bzhad 338

gad che ba yin no zer na/ 'o de dper na dbul bo'i sgyed rdo gser yin par ngo ma shes kyang / mig gis mngon sum du mthong ba la ma mthong zhes mi zer ba bzhin/ skal ldan dbang po rab kyi bla ma'i man ngag la brten nas sems kyi gnas lugs kyi don mngon sum du mthong ba la khyod ma gtogs gzhan mkhas grub su zhig gis ma mthong zer/ rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug mi la ras pas/ cer gyis bltas pas ngo bo mthong / /spros bral nam mkha' lta bur mthong / /zhes dang / bla ma zhang gis/rang sems sangs rgyas cer gyis mthong / /sangs rgyas rtsol ba'i nad dang bral/ /zhes dang /rgyal ba skal bzang rgyal mtsho'i zhal nas/ sems de yang brtag na skye 'gags bral/ /gnas lugs kyi ngo bo e ma ho/ /zhes gsungs so/ /dper na dbul bo'i sgyed rdo gser yin pa mthong ma thag nas/ dbul 'phong gi sdug bsngal zhi nas phyug po'i rtags gos rgyan thams cad sked kyang / don gyis phyug po'i gral du tshud pa bzhin/ gnas lugs don phyin ci ma log pa mthong ma thag nas/ mdo lugs nas bshad pa bzhin/ sa lam thob rtags kyi yon tan mngon shes dzun 'phrul med kyang / don gyis sa dang po chos nyid kyi bden pa mthong ba'i 'phags pa'i gral du chud pa yin zhes 339

smras kyang 'gal ba med ste/ po to bas/ sa dang lam gyi rim pa thams cad kyang / /rtog pa 'phel ba'i ming gi rnam grangs yin/ /zhes dang / btags grol las/ rang rig rnam dag sa gcig la/ /theg pa kun 'dus sa lam rdzogs/ /zhes dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i gsung rab las/ rtogs pas bcu bzhi'i sa la rgyun du gnas/ /zhes dang / mtshan brjod las/ skad cig gcig gis rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /gsungs na sa gcig smos ci dgos/ /'di ni mdo lugs nas bshad pa'i sa dngos min kyang / de'i dod thub cig tu 'dod de/ bla ma zhang gis/phyag rgya chen po gcig chod ma/ /pa na se yi 'bras bu bzhin/ /rgyu dang 'bras bu dus mtshungs pas/ /rmongs pa sa lam brtsi la 'khrul/ /'on kyang rmongs pa dga' ba'i phyir/ /mtshan nyid theg pa'i sa lam rnams/ /'dir yang dod po brtsi bar bya/ /zhes sa bcu lam lnga'i dod thub re brtsis yod pa'i phyir ro/ /khyod kyi gtam de dper na gser chen po yod pa'i mi de phyug po'i gral du mi 'jog par dbul bo'i gral du bzhag nas/ de ltar 'bod pa dang mtshungs byung mkhas pas bzhad gad kyi gnas yin la/ yang dper na dbul bos sgyed rdo mthong kyang gser yin pa ma shes pa'am/ shes kyang yin min gyi the tshom 340

can la/ gser rgyus shes pas bsreg bcad brdar nas/ 'di gser red/ ngo mtshar che/ da ni khyed phyug po'o zhes smras pa ltar/ gdul bya 'ga' zhig gis gnas lugs kyi don mthong kyang de yin pa ngo ma shes pa'am/ shes kyang yid gnyis je tshom byung ba la/ bla ma'i lung rigs la brten nas gtan la phab nas/ ngo sprod pa la dgos pa shin tu che'o/ /khyod kyi gtam de gser mthong kyang ngo ma shes pa'am/ shes kyang the tshom can la gzhan gyes gser red ces bshad pa dgos pa med smras pa dang khyad par ci yang med pas sngar bas kyang bzhad gad che la/dper na nyi ma dang 'od zer dus gcig tu 'byung ba bzhin/rtogs grol dus gcig tu 'byung ba'ang yod sred pas cha gcig na/ khyod bden de/ dper na rjes 'bangs nyer lnga'i re gnyis kyi gnas lugs stong pa nyid kyi bden pa mthong ba tsam nas nam mkha' la 'phur nus pa sogs byung ba bzhin no/ /'on kyang dper na phyug po'i rtags gos rgyan mi 'dogs par dbul bo'i cha byad can yod srid pa ltar/ sa dang po chos nyid kyi bden pa mngon sum du rtogs pa'i 'phags pa la yang sa lam thob rtags kyi yon tan med pa'ang yod srid de/ sngon rje btsun byams pa 'phags pa dngos yin kyang / mngon shes rdzu 341

'phrul sogs med pa'i tshul bstan pa la gzhan gyis cung zad brnyas pa byung tshe/ sangs rgyas kyi 'di ni 'phags pa dngos yin ma brnyas shig ma 'ongs pa na rgyal ba byams par 'gyur ba lung bstan pa mdo zhig na gsungs yod pa mkhas grub rā ga a gyes kyis mdzad pa'i ri chos na yod skad/ dper na nyi ma shar ma thag nas gangs ri'i 'khyag pa zhu/ sa chu dros nas chu rgyun dang rtsi shing me tog sogs dus gcig tu ma byung kyang nyi ma shar zhes zer dgos pa ltar/ gdul bya 'ga' zhig gis/ don dam chos nyid mngon sum du mthong ma thag nas/ spyan dang mngon shes dzu 'phrul sogs yon tan ma skyes kyang / chos nyid kyi bden pa mthong bar 'dod dgos/ zhes zhang g.yu brag 'gro mgon sogs skyes bu dam pa mang pos kyang gsungs so/ /des na mtha' gcig tu bzung nas smod ga la rung / de ltar mi 'dod na khyed kyis deng sang snyigs ma'i dus 'dir sa thob kyi byang chub sems dpa' gcig kyang med par khas len dgos pas/gtam de 'dra smras na kham re che/ khyod la dad gus dag snang med pa'i rgyu mtshan de yin sa snang / da ngas bsam na sems nyid sangs rgyas kyi rgyu yin nam/ sangs rgyas dngos yin/gang yin rung / de gnyis sha'i lam dus tshogs gnyis gang la 342

yang brtson dgos pas lam dus su yang gcig mthar thug 'bras bu sku gnyis thob dgos pas 'bras bu yang gcig pas/don gyi 'gal ba mi snang / tshig gi ngos nas rgyal ba rnams thabs mkhas la thugs rje che ba'i gdul bya rnams la nges don gsungs pa'i skabs su/ sher snying las/ lam med ye shes med/ thob pa med ma thob pa yang med/ ces pa dang / ye shes snang ba rgyan gyi mdo las/ sangs rgyas rnams ni mngon par rdzogs par sangs ma rgyas/ sangs mi rgya mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgya bar mi 'gyur ro/ /gsungs/ zhes sa lam bgrod rgyu dang sangs rgya rgyu med pa 'dra ba zhig gsungs/drang don gsungs pa'i skabs su/ mdo las/ dgon pa bsam nas gom pa bdun bor na/ /de ni sa bdun bar du 'phags par 'gyur/ / zhes dang / 'jam dpal rtsa rgyud las/ ras bris mthong pa tsam gyis ni/ /de yi mod la grol bar 'gyur/ /zhes pa lam dang sangs rgya rgyu yod par ma zad cung zad re'i sa lam dang sangs rgyas thob pa 'dra ba gsungs/ 'di ltar rgyu pha rol tu phyin pa'i theg pa dang / 'bras bu rdo rje theg pa'i skabs rnams su bzhed srol mi 'dra ba mtha' yas/ blo gros can rnams kyis tshig gi 'gal 'brel ma brtsi bar/ don gyi 'gal mi 343

'gal brtsi dgos/ des na de 'dra'i gsungs gi dgongs don 'tshol ba la 'bod/ tshig gi ngos nas mdo sngags gnyis mi dgos/ deng sang gi bla ma re la bzhed srol phyag len mi mthun pa re snang / de gang yin gang min zer/ don gyi ngos nas bsam na/ rig 'dzin gang shar rang grol gyi zhal nas/ deng sang chos lugs grub mtha' mang / /thams cad sangs rgyas lam du gcig /gsungs pa ltar/ /dgongs pa phyogs gcig tu babs 'dug dper na yul re re'i kha gso tshul gyi thabs bshad tshul mi 'dra ba rnams thabs kyi cha bshad dus mi 'dra yang / de ltar byas na kun gyis kha sos pas/ don gyi kha gso tshul mthun pa ltar/ rgyal ba'i gsung rab na sangs rgyas thabs la bshad srol mi 'dra ba rnams sgrub tshul tshig gi cha nas mi 'dra yang / de ltar bsgrub na kun gyis thams cad mkhyen pa'i go 'phang thob pa'i don gyis sangs rgyas bsgrub pa'i thabs su mthun pas/ des na tshig gi cha than thun re ma mthun tshe/ dug dang bdud rtsi ltar 'gal bar bzung nas gzhan khas btong mi rung / sems nyid rang bzhin gyes 'od gsal ba stong pa de nyid ye nas sangs rgyas yin/ zhes phyis deng sang gi phyag rdzogs pa blun po cha bos gros byas kha mthun par bshad pa'i 344

glen gtam du bsgrags pa ma yin te/ sngon byon rgyal ba sras bcas rgya bod kyi mkhas grub tshad ldan du mas gsungs ste/ rnam 'dren bzhi ba mnyam med shākya'i rgyal po'i zhal nas/ bde gshegs snying bo'i 'gro ba yongs la khyab/ /'gro ba 'di dag ma lus sangs rgyas nyid/ /ces dang / 'da' ka ye shes las/sems rtogs na ye shes yin pa'i sangs rgyas gzhan nas mi 'tshol ba'i 'du shes rab tu bsgom par bya'o/ /gsungs/rnam snang mngon byang las/ gsang ba'i bdag po/ de la byang chub gang zhe na/ rang gi sems yang dag pa ji lta ba bzhin du shes pa ste/ de yang bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub bo zhes dang / rgyud las/ sems can rnams ni sangs rgyas nyid de sangs rgyas chen po gzhan ni 'jig rten khams na yod ma yin/ zhes dang / rgyud gzhan las kyang / 'jig rten khams ni gang du yang / /sangs rgyas gzhan nas rnyed mi 'gyur/ /sems 'di rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas nyid/ /sangs rgyas gzhan nas btsal du med/ /ces dang / slob dpon dga' rab rdo rjes/ sems kyi rang bzhin ye nas bud+ngha ste/ /sems la skye 'gag med pa'i nam mkha' 'dra/ /chos kun mnyam nyid yang dag don rtogs nas/ /de nyid ma btsal 345

bzhag na bsgom pa yin/ zhes dang / /o rgyan rin po che'i zhal nas/ rang rig kun tu bzang po sangs rgyas kyi dgongs pa rnal ma skyon med 'di kho na yin/ zhes dang / lho brag mar pa lo tsā'i zhal nas/ spyir sems can thams cad sangs rgyas yin pa la rang gis rang ma rig par sdug bsngal gyi ngang la mchi/ zhes dang / do ha las/ mkhas pa thams cad bstan bcos 'chad pa yi/ /lus la sangs rgyas yod pa ma rtogs so/ /gsungs/rje btsun mi la ras pa'i zhal nas/ 'o skol sems can rnams kyi sems 'od gsal stong pa/ 'khor 'das kyi skyon yon gang gis kyang ma gos pa 'di la/ kun gzhi'i sangs rgyas zhes kyang bya/bde gshegs snying bo zhes kyang bya/ 'di rang ngo rang gis ma shes ma rig pa la/ glo bur gyi dri ma dang / nyon mongs pa dang sems can du ming btags nas/ 'khor bar 'khyams pa yin la/ sems rang ngo rang gis shes shing rig pa la/ ye shes dang / rnam dag dang / sangs rgyas su ming btags nas myang 'das su song ba yin gsungs/ grub chen las kyi rdo rje'i zhal nas/ sems nyid 'di dang po rgyus ma bskyed pa/ bar du rkyen gyis mi 'jig dus glo bur du ma byung / 'phel 'grib dang gang stongs med pa/ snang srid kun la khyab pas/ phyogs dang 346

ris su ma chad pa/ sems nyid ye nas dag pa 'khor ba'i skyon gyis ma gos pa ste/ sems nyid ye nas sangs rgyas yin gsungs/rgyal dbang thams cad mkhyen pas/ rtogs na rig pa'i ngo bo kun tu bzang / /gsungs/ des na 'di 'dra'i rgyal ba'i gsungs/ deng sang gi mkhas pa'i mdun sar song nas snyan du zhu bar mi rigs na/ mkhas pa de chos thams cad kyi pha rol tu son nges pas da sna rdal nas phar nang tsho'i g.yang re lhung 'gro ba'i dogs zon dgos te/ bla ma zhang rin po ches/ mdun gyi khye la 'jigs 'jigs nas/ /rgyab gyi g.yang la lhung gis dogs/ /gsungs pa ltar/ don med tshig gi 'gal 'brel brtsis brtsis nas/ don dam chos kyi dgongs pa ma lon par chos spong gi las ngan pas goms 'gros 'khyor nas/ rang dbang med par mar 'jigs rung ngan song gi g.yang la lhung nas/ phyag rdzogs blun po tshos 'phya smod byed pa'i gnas su 'gyur nyen che bas de ltar ma gyur pa zhig gyis/ yang 'ga' res phyag rdzogs zhi byed gcod sogs gyis dper na nam mkha'i 'ja' tshon ltar chos thams cad sems nyid stong pa las byung bas/ sems kyi rol ba'am/ cho 'phrul yin tsho zer/ ngo sprod 'debs pa 'di yang / 'e tsho dgod rgyu 'ong ba'i rgyu zhig red/347

chos thams cad rang sems kyi snang cha yin na/ khyod kyis tshe 'di'i snang ba nub tshe gzhan gye snang ba thams cad 'gag dgos pa dang / 'khor 'das kyi bde sdug kun sems kyi myong dgos/ de thams cad mkhyen yang dgos te sems kyi cho 'phrul yin pa'i phyir zer na/ 'o de dper na phyogs bcu'i nam mkha' la tha dad bzang ngan med par 'dres nas/ dus gsum 'pho 'gyur med par khyab gdal ye nas gnas pa de la/ rgya yul gyi nam mkha'/ bod yul gyi nam mkha' sogs ming sna tshogs 'dogs pa ltar/ sangs rgyas kyi thugs 'gro ba'i sems chos thams cad kyi gnas lugs stong pa nyid la tha dad bzang ngan med par dbyer med ro gcig tu 'dres nas dus gsum 'pho 'gyur med par khyab gdal du gnas pa/ de la sangs rgyas kyi thugs chos sku/ sems can gyi sems nyid 'od gsal stong pa nyid/ chos thams cad kyi gnas lugs mtha' bral chos dbyings sogs gang smras kyang chog la/ dper na nam mkha' nas nyi zla gza' skar lnga ldan 'ja' tshon/ sprin dkar gzhon nu ldang ba dang / smug nag chu 'dzin/ g.yu 'brug sngon mo/glog dmar 'khyug pa/ char dang ser drag sogs gang yin yang nam mkha' las byung / bar du nam mkha' la gnas/348

mthar 'thim yang nam mkha' la 'thim pa ltar/ chos thams cad kyi gnas lugs stong pa skye med chos dbyengs chen po las/yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi snang ngor dag pa'i snang ba sku dang ye shes tshad med/ ma rig 'khrul ba'i sems can la ma dag pa'i snang ba/ snod bcud snang ba de kun dang po yang chos kyi dbyengs chen po las byung / bar du chos dbyengs ngang la gnas/ mthar 'thim pa yang chos dbyings ngang la 'thim par 'gyur bas/ gnas lugs don dam gye ngos nas smras na/ chos thams cad sangs rgyas kyi thugs sems can gye sems/ gang gi snang ba yin zhes smras kyang 'gal ba med do/ /chos thams cad chos dbyings ngang na dbyer med ro gcig tu gnas pa'i phyir ro/ /thams cad rang snang yin na/ rang gi mthong snang 'gag tshe gzhan ngor yang 'gag dgos pa'i nges pa med de/ sems can gye las snang mi mthun pas/ chu gcig pu la yang / mi yi snang ngor chu/ dmyal bas me/ yi dwags la rnag khrag lha la bdud rtsi/ dud 'gro 'ga' res gnas khang sogs snang ba 'char la/ mi gcig la/ la las pha la las phu bo/ la las nu bo/ la las ming bo/ la las zhang bo/ la las gnyen dang / la las dgra sogs su mthong / de dag gi gcig 349
