gi mthong snang 'gag tshe/ gzhan 'gag mi dgos pa dang mtshungs so/ /las snang mthun kyang / dper na mi mang gis zla ba bltas pas zla ba gnyis snang ba dang / mkhris nad can mang pos dung la bltas na ser por snang ba/ de mi gcig gis mthong snang 'gag tshe/ gzhan 'gag mi dgos pa 'dra'o/ /dper na rgyal sras shig rgyal sar ma bsdad bar du/ 'khor 'bangs kyi legs nyes mi shes kyang / rgyal sar bton nas kun mkhyen pa ltar/ sems kyi gnas lugs rtogs nas g.yo med kyi btsan sa ma zin bar du/ 'khor 'das kyi bde sdug mi mkhyen yang / btsan sa zin pa'i rnal 'byor pas/ 'khor 'das kyi chos thams cad lag mthil du skyu ru ra rlon pa bzhag pa ltar sa ler mkhyen pa chos nyid yin/ des na kun mkhyen zhes bya'o/ /snang grags kyi chos thams cad sgyu ma rmi lam ltar rang bzhin gyis ma grub bzhin du sems nyid stong pa chos kyi dbyengs las byung zhes rgyal ba sras bcas thams cad kyis gsungs ste/ 'gro mgon 'phags mchog slob dpon klu sgrub kyi zhal nas/ 'dir ni gang yang skye ba med/ /gang yang 'gag pa yod ma yin/ /sems kyi rang bzhin rnam dag par/ /chos rnams nyid ni shes par bya/ /mi la sogs dang yul rnams 350

nyid/ /ye shes lnga bo 'di dag ste/ /phyi dang nang du rnam phye ba/ /thams cad sems las gzhan ma yin/ /zhes dang / phyi nang thams cad sems nyid de/ /sgyu ma tsam du gnas pa'o/ /sems de yang ni 'od gsal ba'o/ /mya ngan 'das bcas kun stong dang / /chos skur yang dag bshad pa yin/ /gsungs/slob dpon zhi ba lha'i zhal nas/ lcags bsregs sa bzhi su yis byas/ /mo tshogs de dag ci las byung / /de 'dra de dag thams cad ni/ /sdig sems yin par thub pas gsungs/ /zhes dang/ gzugs sogs lnga dang de bzhin skye mched bcu gnyis dang / /bco brgyad ces bshad khams ni gang yin de rnams dang / /shes pa lnga dang 'gro ba ma lus pa/ /thams cad rang gi sems nyid yin gyi gzhan ma yin/ /gang yang ri brgyad dang ni rgya mtsho brgyad rnams dang / /gling la sogs dang dmyal ba la sogs par dbye ba/ /gang yang brtan dang g.yo ba nyid du mthong ba gang / /thams cad sems nyid yin gyi gzhan ma yin/ /zhes dang / slob dpon zla ba grags pa'i zhal nas/chos thams cad sems las phyi rol na mi gnas te/ mig yor tsam du snang ba gang yin pa de thams cad ni rang gi sems te/rang gi sems nyid las gzhan ci yang med do/ /zhes dang / /351

o rgyan chen pos/ sems nyid nam mkha' lta bu la/ bag chags dang nyon mongs pa sprin dang char rlung lta bur byung yang sems nyid stong pa las byung / gnas kyang sems nyid stong pa'i ngang la gnas/ 'thim yang sems nyid stong pa'i ngang la 'thim/ zhes dang / rig pa cer mthong las sems las ma gtogs snang ba gang yang med/ /sems nyid ma 'gag snang ba gang yang 'char/ /shar yang mtsho yi chu dang chu rlabs bzhin/ /gnyis su med de sems nyid ngang du gcig /ces dang / gur las/ rin chen sems las phyir gyur pas/ /sangs rgyas med cing sems can med/ /ces dang / dgongs pa 'dus pa las/chos thams cad ni sems la gnas so/ /sems ni nam mkha' la gnas so/ /nam mkha' ni ci la yang mi gnas so/ /zhes dang / phal bo che las/ sems ni ri mo mkhan dang 'dra/ /sems kyis phung bo byas pa ste/ /'jig rten khams ni ji snyed pa/ /de dag sems kyi ri mo yin/ /zhes dang / gsang ba mdzod kyi rgyud las/ sems nyid ma gtogs sangs rgyas dang / /sems las ma gtogs chos gzhan yang / /sangs rgyas kyis kyang ma gzigs so/ /ma gsungs gsung par mi 'gyur ro/ /zhes dang / gsang snying las/ gzhi rtsa med pa'i sems 352

nyid ni/ /'khor 'das kun gyi rtsa ba yin/ /zhes dang / pha dam pas/ 'khor 'das rtsa ba rang gi sems la thug /sems la dngos po med do ding ri ba/ /zhes dang / rgyud las/ yul dang dbang bo'i rang bzhin ni/ /sems las phyi rol 'gyur med kyang / /gzugs sogs so sor snang ba rnams/ /sems nyid kho na snang ba yin/ /zhes dang / yang dgon pas/ snang tshad rig pa'i rang snang yin/ /grags tshad skye med rang sgra yin/ /dran tshad gnas lugs rang ngo yin/ /rang rig rtogs na sangs rgyas yin/ /zhes dang / shar pas/ rang gi sems nyid rtogs na phyag rgya chen po ste/ /ji ltar snang ba 'di yang sems las log na med/ /ces dang / ri khrod zhabs kyis/gaṅgā la sogs chu klung sna tshogs pa/ /ba tshwa can gyi rgya mtshor ro gcig ltar/ /btags pa'i sems dang sems byung sna tshogs kun/ /chos kyi dbyings su ro gcig shes par gyis/ /zhes dang /gsang ba'i rgyud las/ sems can kun gyi ma lus nor/ /chos rnams rang gi sems su 'dus/ /zhes dang / rdo rje gur gyi rgyud las/ sems kyi rdo rje las byung ba'i/ /sems can sna tshogs rang bzhin can/ /zhes dang / don dam rig pa'i glu las/sems nyid gcig pu kun gye sa bon te/ /gang la srid dang mya 353

ngan 'das 'phro ba/ /'dod pa'i 'bras bu ster bar byed pa yi/ /yid bzhin nor 'dra'i sems la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes dang / rje mi la'i zhal nas/ snang ba sems nyid yin pa cha med dam/ /rang sems sangs rgyas yin pa cha med dam/ /sangs rgyas chos sku yin pa cha med dam/ /chos sku chos nyid yin pa cha med dam/ /rtogs na cir snang sems su 'dus/ /sems la nyin dang mtshan du ltos/ /sems la bltas pas mthong ba med/ /mthong ba med pa'i ngang la zhog /nga nyid phyag rgya chen po la/ /rang bzhin lhag pa bsam du med/ /shes pa mi bzung ngang la bzhag /mnyam bzhag rjes thob dbyer med pas/ /bsgom pa'i rim pa bdag la med/ /ji ltar snang yang ngo bos stong / /dran pa'i bzung dang ma bzung med/ /ma sgyes pa yi ro myong bas/ /de bzhin bsgom pa rtog pa yis/ /las kyi phyag rgya bsgom pa dang / /rtsa rlung thig le bsgom pa dang / /sngags bzlas pa dang lhag bsgom dang / /tshangs pa'i gnas bzhi bsgom la sogs/ /theg pa chen bor 'jug thabs tsam de rnams ched du bsgom pas kyang / /chags sdang rtsa ba mi spong gyis/ /snang ba rang gi sems nyid lags/ /sems nyid stong par shes par gyis/ /rtogs pa nyams dang ma bral na/ /tshul 354

khrims mchod sogs dge ba'i tshogs/ /thams cad ma lus de la tshang / /gsungs/ yang dbu ma pa sogs grub mtha' gzhan 'dzin pa 'ga' res/ /dper na glang bu bor ba'i rjes ded nas rtsad gcod drag po byas na rnyed pa ltar/ so sor rtogs pa'i shes rab kyi dpyad stobs kyis lta ba mngon du gyur gyes/dper na glang bu stor bas phyir mi 'gro bar kha rog par sdod dang rnyed 'ong zer ba ltar/ deng sang phyag rdzogs sogs kyis gang yang mi rtogs par gzhag pa las lta ba mngon du 'gyur ba phar zhog phyogs tsam yang rtogs dka'/ zhes 'di ltar lung 'dren byed de/ de yang ji skad du/ ting 'dzin rgyal po las/gal te chos la bdag med so sor brtag /so sor de brtag gal te bsgom byed na/ /de ni mya ngan 'das thob 'bras bu'i rgyu/ /zhes dang /sgom rim bar ba las/ shes rab kyis dngos po mtha' dag gi ngo bo nyid so sor brtag nas gang gi phyir/ mi dmigs pa bsam gtan byed pa/ de'i phyir shes rab mchog gi bsam gtan pa zhes bya ste/ zhes dang / blo sbyong blo bzang dgongs rgyan las/ lta ba bsgom pa'i tshe sems rtse gcig pa gcig pus mi chog par/ so sor rtogs pa'i shes rab kyis dpyad na skyong ba shin tu gal che/ zhes dang / po to ba'i zhal 355

nas/ kha cig thos bsam dus na rig pas/ /rang bzhin med pa gtan la phab la/ /bsgom dus mi rtog 'ba' zhig bsgom zer/ /de ltar na ni 'brel med stong nyid/ /logs su bsgom phyir gnyen por mi 'gyur/ /de lta bas na bsgom dus nyid na'ang / /gcig dang du bral rten 'brel la sogs/ /gang la goms pas so sor brtag cing / /cung zad mi rtog nyid du gnas bya/ / de ltar bsgom na nyon mongs gnyen por/ /lha gcig rjes su 'brang bar 'dod cing / /pha rol phyin lugs spyod par 'dod pas/ /shes rab bsgom pa'i lugs ni 'di yin/ /zhes dang / rje skal ldan rgya mtshos/ yul gang shar gzhan la ma ltos par/ /tshur lam lam 'char 'di dgag bya dngos/ /de ltar du med pa stong pa nyid/ /blos de ltar 'dzin la lta ba zer/ /spyir snang stong gnyis la 'dor len med/ /gang snang tsam nyid nas stong par blta/ blo stong pa'i ngang nas snang ba shar/ /mi de yi 'dun ma gtan du legs/ /lar snang pas stong pa mi dgag cing / /yul stong pa'i ngang la snang ba bkra/ /gang shar kyang bden par mi zhen par/ /mtsho dwangs par shar ba'i zla gzugs ltar/ /don bden gnyis snang stong rnal 'byor la/ /dus nyin bzhin ltad mo blta ba la/ /blo 'gyur ba med pa'i 356

rnal 'byor bde/ /zhes dang / rgyu'i theg chen las/ ci nas ting 'dzin brtson pa ni/ /skad cig gcig kyang mi 'chor bar /bdag gi yid ni gar dpyod ces/ /de ltar yid la so sor brtag /ces dang / slob dpon zhi ba lhas/nyon mongs shes bya'i sgrib pa yi/ /mun pa'i gnyen por stong pa nyid/ /myur du thams cad mkhyen 'dod pas/ /de ni ci'i phyir bsgom mi byed/ /ces dang / thams cad gsang ba'i rgyud las/ rang sems rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas nyid/ /sems nyid la ni rtogs par bya/ /zhes dang / rgyal ba skal bzang rgya mtshos/ chos can gyi snang tshul mtha' yas 'di/ /blo 'khrul ba'i bzhag pa'i bslu ba can/ /don sdod lugs snying bo btsal ba na/ /dmigs gtad so bral ba'i stong par 'char/ /yul gang shar rang tshugs zhig pa na/ /ming rkyang pa tsam zhig shul du lus/ /don 'di la gzhan don rten 'brel zhes/ /chos kun gyi 'jog sa de ka tsam/ /dpal 'phags pa yab sras bzhed pa'i srol/ /pha blo bzang grags pas gtan la phab/ /mtha' bral gye lta ba ngo mtshar can/ /zhes dang / mi g.yo ba'i rtog pa las/ dngos po thams cad mdor bsdus pas/ /rang bzhin med nyid bsam pa las/ /byang chub sems ni nges par 'thob/ /gzhan du 'ba' 357

zhig 'gyur ba min/ /zhes dang / 'phags pa lhas/ yul la bdag med mthong nas ni/ /srid pa'i sa bon 'gag par 'gyur/ /zhes dang / byang chub sems 'grel las/ gang dag stong nyid mi shes pa/ /de dag thar ba brten ma yin/ /'gro drug srid pa'i btson rar ni/ /rmongs pa de dag 'khor bar 'gyur/ /zhes dang / kha sbyor las/ de nas bsam gtan gnas 'dug nas/ /chos rnams thams cad bdag med pa/ /yang dag rjes su blta bar bya/ /zhes dang / de'i rgyud phyi ma las/'dir stong pa nyid gang zhe na/ chos dang gang zag gi dngos po med pa stong pa nyid do/ /zhes dang / rdo rje snying bo rgyan gye rgyud las/ rnal 'byor gcig cig shes byas nas/ /bden pa song de rab 'bad na/ /sdig dag tshe 'dir sangs rgyas 'grub/ /chos bdag med par rab bsgoms pas/ /thams cad mkhyen pa khong du chud/ /ces dang / sems kyis rdul phran cha drug rnams/ /phyogs bcu dag tu phye nas su/ /chos kyi don rnams des gsal nas/ /shin tu dri med sems dag pa/ /'das dang ma 'ongs pa yi sems/ /da lta yang ni dmigs su med/ /gnyis med de la gnyis med med/ /nam mkha' zhes pa'ang gnas pa med/ /de ltar kun tu brtag nas su/ /'gro ba thams cad shin 358

tu stong / /dri med rnal 'byor nyid kyi yin/ /dngos po med par rang sems bsam/ /zhes dang / grub thob dpal 'dzin gyis/ /dngos po thams cad bden pa min/ /thog ma bar dang mtha' spangs pa/ /'di ltar dpyad na 'khor lo la/ /dam pa yang dag rtogs pa spangs/ /phung bo khams ni bdag med pa/ /bsgom bya bde ba dman pa'i gzugs/ /zhes dang / rnam par mi rtogs par 'jug pa'i gzungs las/ de yang dag par sbyor ba de brten pa'i rjes su 'gro'o/ /bsgom pa'i rjes su 'gro'o/ /mang du byas pa'i rjes su 'gro'o/ /yang dag pa'i yid la byed pa'i rjes su 'gro bas na/ mngon par 'du byed pa med cing lhun gyis grub pa'i rnam par mi rtog pa'i dbyings la reg ste/ zhes dang / tshad ma rnam par nges pa las/ bsam pas rang bzhin can gye shes rab la goms par byas na/ don dam pa ye shes 'khrul ba'i dben pa/ dri ma med pa/ 'jigs pa med par mngon par mngon du byed par 'gyur ro/ /zhes dang / brtag gnyis las/ rnam rtog las ni rnam rtog dang / /srid pa nyid kyis srid pa dag /ces dang / yang man snye las/ gang shes rab kyi mig gis nges par dpyad pa las/ yang dag pa'i ye shes kyi snang ba bskyed pa na/ chos thams cad ma mthong ba'o/ /de'i phyir 359

de kho na nyid kyi rnal 'byor pa spyod lam thams cad la gnas pa rnams kyis chos rnams thams cad mthong ba med pa'o/ /'di 'dra ba kho na mthong ba med par mngon par dgongs kyis/gnyid log pa dang mig btsums pa dag gis bzhin du/ gang yid la mi byed pas ni ma yin no/ /zhes dang / sngags rim chen mo las/ so sor rtogs pa'i shes rab kyis dpyad nas spros pa'i chos ci yang ma rnyed pa'i don la 'jog dgos kyis yid byed bsdus pa'i mi rtog pa tsam de kho na nyid bsgom pa min/zhes dang / dkon mchog brtsegs pa las/ blon pos zin pa'i rgyal po rnams kyi dgos pa thams cad byed pa de bzhin du/byang chub sems dpa' shes rab dang thabs mkhas pas zin pas/ sangs rgyas kyi mdzad pa thams cad byed do gsung /tshangs pas zhus pa las/tshul bzhin du chos la so sor rtogs pa de dag ni blo gros dang ldan pa yin no/ /zhes dang / dkon mchog sprin las/ lhag mthong gis brtag nas ngo bo nyid med par rtogs pa ni mtshan ma med pa la 'jug go /zhes dang /sdud pa las/ chos rnams rang bzhin med par yongs su shes gyur pa/ /'di ni shes rab pha rol phyin mchog spyod pa yin/ /zhes dang / gang tshe 'dus byas 'dus ma byas dang dkar nag 360

chos/ /shes rab kyis ni bshig nas rdul tsam mi dmigs tshe/ /'jig rten dag na shes rab pha rol phyin grang 'gro/ /zhes dang /chos dbyengs bstod pa las/ mchog tu sems ni spyod byed pa/ /chos ni rang bzhin med pa yin/ /zhes dang / bdag dang bdag gi zhes 'dzin pas/ /ji srid phyi rol rnams btags la/ /bdag med rnam pa gnyis mthong na/ /srid pa'i sa bon 'gag par 'gyur/ /zhes dang / 'jug pa las/ de'i phyir bdag dang bdag gir stong lta bas/ /rnal 'byor pa de rnam par grol bar 'gyur/ /zhes dang / dkon mchog brtsegs pa las/ sems yongs su 'tshol te/ ci 'das pa'am/ma 'ongs pa'am/ da lta byung ba zhig gam/ de las 'das pa'i sems gang yin ni zad pa'o/ /ma 'ongs pa gang yin pa de ni ma skyes pa'o/ /da ltar byung ba ni gnas pa med do/ /zhes dang / kye rdor las/ yid ni bsam gtan g.yo 'am ci/ /rang gi sems la so sor brtag /ces dang / gsang ba bsam gyes mi khyab pa'i rgyud las/ rtag chad skye 'gag la sogs pa/ /mtha' spangs sems ni rang rigs byed/ /gdod nas spros pa med pa nyid/ /de don bsam mi khyab par nges/ /zhes dang / slob dpon mda' bsnun gyis/de ltar bdag nyid nges par ma 'khrul 361

bar/ /rang gis rang la nges par shes par bya/ /rdul med rdul bral ma yin sems kyang med/ /mda' bsnun gyis smras de tsam zhig tu zad/ /ces dang / lang gar gshegs pa las/ sems tsam la ni rab brten nas/ /phyi rol don la mi brtag go /de bzhin nyid kyi dmigs gnas nas/ /sems tsam las kyang 'da' bar bya/ /sems tsam las ni 'das nas su/ /snang ba med la 'da' bar bya/ /snang med gnas pa'i rnal 'byor pa/ /de yi theg pa chen po mthong / /zhes dang / lung gzhan las/sgyu ma lta bu'i chos rnams la/ /sgyu ma lta bur bsgoms byas na/ /sgyu ma lta bur 'tshang rgya'o/ /nam mkha' lta bu'i chos rnams la/ /nam mkha' lta bur bsgoms byas na/ /nam mkha' lta bur 'tshang rgya'o/ /zhes dang /'od srung gi le'u las/ 'od srung dbu ma'i lam/ chos rnams la yang so sor rtogs pa gang zhe na/ 'od srung gang la bdag med so sor rtogs pa dang / sems can med pa dang / srog med pa dang / gso ba med pa dang / skyes bu med pa dang / gang zag med pa dang / shed las skye ba med pa dang / shed bu med par so sor rtogs pa ste/ 'od srung 'di ni dbu ma'i lam chos rnams la yang dag par so sor rtogs pa zhes bya'o/ /zhes dang /rje btsun 'jam dbyangs kyis rje rin po 362

che la dngos su gsungs pa'i zin bris las/ da lta'i gdams ngag pa rnams 'dod pa ltar/ sems ci yang mi rtog par bzhag nas/ de nas lta ba'i gnas lugs ci yang tha snyad gdags sa med par gtan la phab pa gnyis gcig tu bsres nas skyong lugs ci yang yid la mi byed pa 'dis sems gnas tsam ma gtogs lhag mthong la myong ba thon pa mi srid gsungs/ mtshan nyid theg pa nas gsungs pa'i dpyad bsgom ma byas na lta ba myong ba mi thon pas dpyad bsgom bya dgos/ zhes dang / lam rim chen mo las/ bdag gnyis su tshad mar bzung ba'i blos ji ltar bzung ba/ de 'dra ba zhig yin pa/ de legs par dpyad nas/ rnam par dag pa'i lung rigs kyis khos bzung ba ltar med pa la nges pa drangs pa'i sgo nas/ 'khrul ba'i rdzun phug rdib pa zhig dgos kyi/ de 'dra ba'i nges pa ci yang ma rnyed par sems bzung ba tsam ni/de'i tshe bdag gnyis kyi yul la mi 'phro ba yin du chug kyang de tsam gyis bdag med pa'i don rtogs pa ma yin te/ de ltar yin na gnyid 'thug po log pa dang /brgyal ba la sogs pa'i tshe yang / de dag la sems 'phro ba med pas/de dag gis kyang bdag med rtogs par ha cang thal bar 'gyur ro/ /zhes dang / rje btsun ye shes rgyal mtshan gyis/ da 363

lta'i dus na ni/ gnas lugs kyi don ci yang med pa'i don du bzung nas/ snang ba thams cad 'khrul ngo 'ba' zhig tu 'jog cing / don la shes bya gang yang med par ngo sprod par byed pa ches mang zhing / yang 'ga' zhig ni/ gnas lugs kyi don rnam rtog bkag nas ci yang yid la mi bya ba'i don du ngo sprod par byed/ de ltar ngo sprad pa na/ grong gi nang du tshe yol bar byas pa'i rgan po gang yang ma bslab pa dag la'ang / skad cig la sems ngo 'phrod pa dang / gnas lugs ngo bo 'phrod pa dang /chos sku'i zhal mthong zer bas sa steng khyab ste/ rgyal ba'i bstan pa rin po che snyigs ma las kyang ches snyigs mar gyur pa'i dus su snang bas/ snying nas bstan pa la gces par 'dzin pa'i dam pa rnams kyis ni/ rgyal ba'i bstan pa'i snying bo stong pa rten 'byung gi don du 'char ba'i tshul/ rgyal ba rang gi dgongs pa ji bzhin du 'grel ba la tshad mar gyur pa klu sgrub yab sras kyi lugs bzang 'di nyid mi nub pa'i phyir brtson par rigs so/ /zhes lung brgya stong 'dren pa 'di dang / yang phyag rdzogs sogs grub mtha' gzhan 'dzin pa 'ga' res/ dper na chu mgo zhig dwangs pa la mi gtsang ba gang yod bsal nas/ ma rnyog par bzhag na rim pas dwangs nas gzugs brnyan 'char 364

ba ltar/ mtshan ldan bla ma'i man ngag la brten nas gnas lugs stong gsal gye ngang la ma bcos par bzhag pas lta ba mngon du 'gyur gyis/ deng sang gi dbu ma pa sogs kyis dus rgyun du so sor rtogs pa'i shes rab kyis dpyad bsgom byed pa chu dwangs par 'dod pas rnyog pa dang 'dra bas/ bskal par 'bad kyang phyogs sgo tsam yang mthong dka' zhes rgyab skyor gyi lung 'di ltar 'dren ste/ rdzogs pa chen po tshig gsum pa'i rgyud las/ kye gsang ba'i bdag po rang gi rig pa 'gag pa med par wa ler gsal ba 'di sangs rgyas yin no/ /rang gi rig pa 'gag pa med pa 'di dang 'bral ba med pas sangs rgyas chos sku bsgom du med do/ /rang gi rig pa wa le ba 'di sangs rgyas yin par/ rang gi ngo shes pas chog go gsungs/ o rgyan rin po ches/ rtog pa snga ma 'gags/ phyi ma ma sgyes pa'i bar de na gsal stong rjen pa 'di yin med pa'i gsal dwangs smra rgyu med pa'i nyams su myong rgyu gcig 'dug pa de ka ltar/ ye gdod ma nas gnas pa yin te/ skabs su glo bur gyi rkyen gyis rtog pa sna tshogs su shar ba yin pas/ da ni dus de ring nas sangs rgyas lag tu gtad pa yin pas/ da phan chad gnas lugs 'di dang ma bral bar 'di ka ltar nyams su longs shig 365

dang / tshe gcig lus gcig gis sangs rgyas 'thob par gdon mi za'o/ /gsungs/ mkha' 'gro snying thig las/ dri med dag pa'i sangs rgyas ni/ /rang rig chos sku 'gyur ba med/ /sa le sing nge wa le ba/ /sprin med ston kha'i nam mkha' bzhin/ /mi 'gyur brtan pa ri bo bzhin du zhog /mi g.yo dwangs pa rgya mtsho bzhin du zhog /yang dog bral ba nam mkha' bzhin du zhog /ces dang / rin chen spungs pa las/ gzhi rtsa med pa'i chos nyid 'di/ /ma btsal bzhag pa ngo mtshar che/ /'gro dang 'ong med rig pa la/ /thug pa med pa ngo mtshar che/ / ye gnas chen po'i ye shes la/ /gnyen po med pa ngo mtshar che/ /zhes dang /dpal gsang ba'i bdag pos/mkha' ltar dag pa'i lta ba la/ /rig pa'i khyung lding yan du chug /gser gling bsam gtan bsgom pa la/ /ma yengs rgyun du gnas par mdzod/ /gling chen lta bu'i spyod pa la/ /'dzin chags med pa rol tu khrid/ /sgrub rgyu med pa'i 'bras bu la/ /brtson 'grus shin tu myur ba gces/ /zhes dang / mu mtha' bral ba'i lta ba la/ /gdengs kyis chod pa shin tu gces/ /bsam du med pa'i bsgom pa la/ /dran pas zin pa rab tu gces/ /blang dor med pa'i spyod pa la/ /bag dang ldan pa rab tu gces/ /thob du med pa'i 'bras bu la/ /re 366

dogs bral ba shin tu gces/ /zhes dang / gtsang pa rgya ras kyis/ sems ma bcos bzhag pa chos kyi sku/ /glo bur gyi rtog pa rang sar grol/ /bsam du med pa zhig nyams su myong / /zhes dang / slob dpon mda' bsnun gyis/ gcig dang du ma'i sems la dpyad byas na/ /gsal ba spangs nas srid pa dag tu 'gro/ /mthong bzhin du ni dong du 'jug pa na/ /de las snying rje gnas ni gang zhig yod/ /ces dang / bsam dang bsam bya thams cad dor nas su/ /ji ltar bu chung lhug par gnas pa bzhin/ /bla ma'i lung la bsgrims ste gus 'bad na/ /lhan cig skyes pa 'byung bar the tshom med/ /ces dang / seṅge rtsal rdzogs las/ /rig pa ma bsgom lhun grub la/ bsgoms pa byas pas nga ma rnyed/ /rang byung ye nas rtsol med la/ /dpyod pa byas pas da mi mthong / /chos sku ye nas mtha' bral la/ /lta ba bltas pas nga mi mthong / /zhes dang / thal 'gyur las/ lta ba'i ngo bo mthong ba la/ /yid dpyod tshig gis 'gyus pa med/ /ces dang /dpal ri khrod dbang phyug gis/ yid la mi byed phyag rgya chen po'i lam/ /'bras bu gang la'ang re ba ma byed cig /ces dang /rgyal sras thogs med kyis/ ji ltar snang ba 'di dag rang gi sems/ /sems nyid gdod nas spros pa'i mtha' dang bral/ /de 367

nyid shes nas gzung 'dzin mtshan ma rnams/ /yid la mi byed rgyal sras lag len yin/ /zhes dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis/rnam rtog ma rig chen po ste/ /'khor ba'i rgya mtshor ltung byed yin/ /mi rtog ting 'dzin la gnas na/ /mkha' bzhin dri ma med par gnas/ /zhes dang / slob dpon zhi ba lhas/ don dam blo yi spyod yul min/ /blo ni kun rdzob yin par 'dod/ /ces dang / rin chen sgron ma las/ cog bzhag gsum gye rang bzhin las/ /ka dag don nyid mngon du 'gyur/ /zhes dang /kun byed las/ rang byung ye shes ye nas shes/ /yul la rtog pa'i ye shes te/ /yul las byung ba rang byung min/ /zhes dang /rtsal rdzogs las/ ye shes rang snang ngo bo ni/ /yul gyi rnam rtog med pa ste/ /'das pa'i yul dang ma 'ongs yul/ /snang ba thad gar bcad pa'o/ /zhes dang / byang chub sems 'grel las/gang du rnam rtog snang byung ba/ /der ni stong nyid ga la yod/ /brtag bya rtog byed rnam pa'i sems/ /de bzhin gshegs rnams kyis ma gzigs/ /gang na brtag bya rtog byed yod/ /der ni byang chub yod ma yin/ /zhes dang / yum chen mo las/gzugs stong pa dang bdag med ces bya bar spyod na mtshan ma la spyod kyi/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la mi spyod do/ /zhes/ 368

dang / rin chen phreng ba las/ de ltar bdag dang bdag med pa/ /yang dag ji bzhin dmigs su med/ /bdag dang bdag med lta ba dag /de phyir thub pa chen pos bzlog /ces dang /kye rdor las/ bsgom bya med cing sgom byed med/ /gsang sngags med cing lha yang med/ /spros dang bral bas rang bzhin du/ /lha dang sngags su yang dag gnas/ /zhes dang / gsang 'dus rgyud las/ dngos po med cing bsgom pa med/ /bsgom par bya ba bsgom pa min/ /de ltar dngos po dngos med pa'i/ /bsgom pa dmigs su med pa'o/ /zhes dang / rgyan stug po bkod pa'i mdo las/ stong pa nyid kyi lta thos kyang / /de nyid lta ba ma zhugs na/ /gsor mi rung ba'i lta ba can/ /sman pas btang ba'i nad pa bzhin/ /zhes dang / stong phrag brgya ba las/phyi stong pa nyid yid la mi bya/ nang stong pa nyid yid la mi bya/dngos po med pa'i stong pa nyid yid la mi bya/ zhes dang / yid la mi byed pa gang yin pa de ni shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'o/ /zhes dang / gsang ba sdom pa gsum bstan pa'i mdo las/ gang yid la byed pa yod pa de la ngar 'dzin pa yod do/ /zhes dang / lung las/ rtog bcas rtog pa med pa yi/ /shes pa gnyis kyis mi rtog ste/ /zhes dang / bde ba'i rdo rjes 369

kyang / gcig dang du bral rig pa rnams/ /'od gsal rtogs phyir dgos pa med/ /bde chen der snang mngon sum la/ /zhes dang /rigs ldan grags pas/ phung po rnams dpyad stong pa nyid/ / chu shing bzhin du snying bo med/ /rnam pa kun gye mchog ldan pas/ /stong nyid de ltar 'gyur ma yin/ /zhes dang / rgyal tshab dam pas/ blo dang ldan pas mi rtog ye shes stobs/ /rtog tu kun nas mnyam par song ba yi/ /de la brten pa'i nyes tshogs tshang tshing rnams/ /dug sman chen po'i dug bzhin 'joms par byed/ /ces dang / rtsa shes las/ yod ces bya bar rtag par 'dzin/ /med ces bya bar chad par blta/ /de phyir yod dang med pa la/ /mkhas pas gnas par mi bya'o/ /zhes dang / klu'i rgyal po ma dros pas zhus pa'i mdo las/ gang zhig lam ni dngos byed min/ /dngos med dngos po med byed min/ /dngos dang dngos med bral ba ni/ /mchog gi lam gang bsgom pa'o/ /bcom ldan dngos dang dngos med pa/ /mkhyen pa'i ka t+ya ya na yis/ /gdams ngag las ni yod pa dang / /med pa gnyis ka bkag par mdzad/ /ces dang / slob dpon dpal dbyangs kyis/ /ci tsam zab pa'i tshig brjod kyang / /don dang ldan par mi 'gyur ro/ /zhes dang / /gser phreng 370

las/'dod dang rtsol ba yod na sangs mi rgya/ /zhes dang / sdud pa las/ byang chub sems dpas sngon gyi mtha' dang phyi mtha' dang / /da lta nyid kyang mi dmigs dus gsum dag pa ste/ /gang dag de ni 'dus ma byas yin spos med do/ /zhes dang /grub chen ti lo pas/ blo yi chos kyis blo 'das don mi mthong /byas pa'i chos kyis byar med sar mi slebs/ /blo 'das byar med don de 'thob 'dod na/ /sems kyi rtsad chod rig pa gcer bur zhog /ces dang / kye ho 'di ni rang rig ye shes te/ /ngag gi lam 'das yid kyi spyod yul min/ /te lo ngas ni ci yang bstan du med/ /rang gi rang nyid mtshon te shes par byos/ /zhes dang / mi mno mi bsam mi dpyad cing / /mi bsgoms mi sems rang babs bzhag /ces dang / rje nā ro pas/ bsgom pa'i mthar thug dngos med pa/ /de yang sems sa le ni ma bcos pa'o/ /zhes dang / sgra bsgyur mar pa lo tsās/nang 'dzin pa yid kyi rnam shes 'di/ /sngon chad mdza' bo 'phrad pa bzhin/ /sems nyid rang ngor rang gis shes/ /lkugs pa'i rmi lam rmis pa bzhin/ /brjod du med pa'i nyams shig shar/ /gzhon nu'i bde ba myong ba bzhin/ /smra ru med pa'i don gcig rtogs/ /zhes dang / rje mi las/ bu spros bral 371

sems la shar dus su/ /tha snyad tshig phyir ma 'brang zhig /chos brgyad sgog tu tshud nyen yod/ /bu nga rgyal med pa'i ngang la zhog /de go'am dbus pa gtsang ston pa/ /bu rang grol nang nas shar dus su/ /tshad ma'i sbyor bar ma 'god cig /don med 'bad rtsol byas nyen yod/ /bu rnam rtog med pa'i ngang la zhog /de go'am dbus pa gtsang ston pa/ /bu rang sems stong nyid rtogs tsa na/ /gcig dang du mar ma 'byed cig /chad pa'i stong par 'gro nyen yod/ /bu spros pa med pa'i ngang la zhog /de go'am dbus pa gtsang ston pa/ /bu phyag rgya chen po bsgom dus su/ /lus ngag dge sbyor ma brtson cig /mi rtog ye shes yal nyen yod/ /bu ma bcos lhug pa'i ngang la zhog /de go'am dbus pa gtsang ston pa/ /zhes dang / rang rig tsam gyi ye shes 'di/ /ngag tu brjod pa'i lam ma yin/ /nyon mongs byis pa'i yul min te/ /rtog ge pa'i yang spyod yul min/ /zhes dang / tshig bral chos la thos pa med/ /stong nyid don la gsang ba med/ /skye med don la bsgom pa med/ /mi dge bcu las rang log yin/ /zhes dang / lha med 'dre med lta ba'i gdengs/ /dmigs med yengs med bsgom pa'i gdengs/ /re med dogs med 'bras bu'i gdengs/ /zhes dang / rje dwags 372

po lha rjes/ sems nyid lhan cig skye ba/ dang po rtsol sgrub dang bral bar lus sems khong glen pa dang / bar du the tshom med par sems ma bcos so mar bzhag pa dang / tha ma byung tshor thams cad skye sked du shes par bya'o/ /zhes dang / blo 'das kyi lta ba mtha' bral la/ /the tshom du za yang mi 'tshal lo bde stong gi bsgom pa zhen med la/ /bsgom thun du bcad kyang mi 'tshal lo/ /rang shugs kyis spyod pa zhen med la/ /tshul 'chos kyi bgyes yang mi 'tshal lo/ /'bras bu rang sems kyi 'od gsal la/ /re dogs su bgyid yang mi 'tshal lo/ /zhes dang /mi rtog gi ched du mi sgrub pa/ /snyems bral gyi sems kyi ngo bo yin/ /gsal stong gi rig pa rjen pa 'di/ /ma yengs par skyongs pa man ngag yin/ /zhes dang / rnal 'byor dbang phyug chen pos/ ma bcos so mar bzhag na rtog pa 'char/ /chu bo'i rgyun bzhin bskyangs na yongs kyang 'char/ /dmigs gtad mtshan ma thams cad yongs spongs la/ /rtag tu mnyam par zhog cig rnal 'byor pa/ /zhes dang / dpal ldan zla 'od gzhon nus/ ma 'ongs pa ni sangs rgyas kun gyi lam/ /gsungs/ sher phyin las/ gzugs la sogs pa rnam par stong pa dang / bdag med pa'o snyam du spyod na mtshan ma la spyod/373

ces dang / rnam par mi rtog par 'jug pa'i gzungs las/yid la mi byed pa'i gzugs la sogs pa'i mtshan ma spongs/zhes dang / tshangs pas zhus pa las/ dpyod pa ji snyed pa de thams cad ni rtog pa'o/ /yongs su mi rtog pa ni byang chub bo/ /zhes dang / rje btsun yer ba pas/ bya bral rtsol med kyi rnal 'byor pa/ /mtshan med kyi rnal 'byor yang mi dmigs na/ /'jig rten gyi bya ba la lta ci smos/ /bya rtsol rnam gnyis kyi ma gos na/ /sngags lcags kyis 'ching las grol ba yin/ /zhes dang / pha dam pas/ chos nyid don mthong lkug pa'i rmi lam 'dra/ /tshig dang tha snyad bral lo ding ri ba/ /rtogs pa'i nyams shar gzhon nu'i bde ba 'dra/ /dga' bde brjod du med do ding ri ba/ /zhes dang / gsang 'dus las/ ma skyes pa yi chos rnams la/ /dngos po med de bsgom pa'ang med/ /nam mkha'i tshul du bsgom pa yi/ /de ltar dngos po rab tu bsgrags/ /zhes dang / rje rgod tshang pas/ gzhi thog na 'khrul ba mi 'dug pas/ /gol dogs gye sems khral mi dgos kyis/ /ma bcos pa'i shes pa so mar zhog /'dzin med kyi snang ba yan du chug /zung 'jug la rgyun chad mi 'dug pas/ /yang bral du shor dogs mi dgos kyis/ /mtshan ma'i chos spyod gshol la 374

thongs/ /lta bsgom dang bzlas pas 'di la sgrib/ /blo bral zang ma zang yug la/ /bcos pa dang rang bzhin ga la yod/ /byis pa'i dus kyi mdzad spyod de/ /rgan pa rnams la rtsi byar yod/ /ces dang / mkhas grub rā ga a gyes/ rnam rtog mang du mi 'phro kyil ler gnas/ /gzugs brnyan dngos po mi mthong brjod mi shes/ /rang gi sems la nges shes myong ba can/ /sa le sing nge hrig ge rjen ne ba/ /sprin med nam mkha' dwangs pa'i dkyil 'dra ba/ /'di ni mos gus phyag rgya chen po yin/ /ma yengs rang ngo ltos dang e ma ho/ /zhes dang / 'bar ra ba rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos/ lta ba 'di kun rtogs dang ma rtogs rung / /blta bya lta byed gnyis su mi 'dzin par/ /gnyis su med pa'i ngang la bzhag pa na/ /ma dpyad sgro 'dogs nang nas chod nas 'ong / /bsgom rgyu 'di kun 'dug rung mi 'dug rung / /bsgom bya sgom byed gnyis su mi rtogs par/ /mi bsgom shes pa rang sar bsdad pa na/ /blo bral gnyug ma'i don dang mjal nas 'ong / /sems nyid 'di kun stong rung mi stong rung / /stong dang mi stong ci yang mi bsam par/ /bsam bral ngang du ci bder bzhag pa na/ /stong pa'i rang bzhin nang du shar nas 'ong / /zhes dang / garma pa 375

bdud 'dul rdo rjes/ 'khor 'das chos rnams rang sems ngo 'phrod nas/ /gnyis 'dzin rtog pa thams cad dbyengs su dag /bde gsal mi rtog nyin mo'i rgya mtsho ltar/ /mtha' dbus bral ba'i ngang la mnyam par 'jog /zhes dang / rje rang byung rdo rjes/ yid byed bral ba 'di ni phyag rgya che/ /mtha' dang bral ba dbu ma chen po yin/ /zhes dang / rje 'jam dpal bzang pos/ bsgom bya blo dang bral ba dang / /rnam rtog ngo bo chos skur mthong / /zhes dang / rje dbang phyug rdo rjes/ bsgom rgyu ci yang med par skad cig kyang ma yengs/ rig pa trig be rang sar bzhag ces dang /me tri pas/ chos rnams rang rang ngo bos stong / /stong par 'dzin blo rang sar dag /blo bral yid la byar med pa/ /'di ni sangs rgyas kun gye lam/ /zhes dang / g.yu thog 'gro mgon gyis/ bcom ldan dgyes pa rdo rje 'di/ /gdod nas dag pa'i rang sems nyid/ /de ni stong dang stong min te/ /spros pa med pa'i ngang la gnas/ /spros bral rang byung ye shes te/ /sngon chad ma shes lam bsgom pa/ /'khrul bas 'khrul ba bsgom par go /da ni bsgom mkhan blo dang bral/ /bsgom 'dod bsgom gyes bsgom de sgrib/ /bsgom med rtogs tshe thams cad bsgom du 'char/ /zhes dang / bye tshang pa rin chen 376

dpal 'byor gyes/ phyi na yul gyi ched 'dzin med/ /nang du rig pa gsal la dwangs/ /rig pa phyi nang zang thal 'di/ /mnyam gzhag yin no a ne ma/ /de las cung zad yengs pa na/ /yul gyi rjes su thal gyi 'gyus/ /gzung 'dzin kun gye shar ba de/ /rjes shes yin no a ne ma/ /de la dran pa'i tsir gyis zin/ /gzung 'dzin rtog pa dwangs zhi nas/ /sngar gyi mnyam gzhag gsal thebs pa/ /rjes thob yin no a ne ma/ /zhes dang / rje rgod tshang pas/ sgye bo tsa na'i shes pa 'di/ /chos kyi sgu ru 'dug pa la/ /bla mas bstan kyang mi dgos par/ /rang gi shes su gsha' ba la/ /zhes dang / mnyam med nam mkhar spyod pas/ nga 'gro 'chag nyal 'dug gang byed kyang / /gang shar bsgom du ma shar na/ /gang shes sdug gi snon pa yin/ /gang shar gyi rnam rtog ma dgag mdzod/ /shar ba de'i rjes su ma 'brang mdzod/ /sems de ga'i steng du sgyur la zhog /ma bsgom pa'i ngang nas ma yengs pa/ /'di ka gcig pus chog pa lags/ /'di don go ba lta ba zer/ /nyams su len pa bsgom pa yin/ /rgyun du skyong ba spyod pa yin/ /brtan pa thob pa 'bras bu yin/ /zhes dang / gling ras pas/ rje yi zhal nas gnyug ma'i don/ /sgoms shig gsungs pas bsgoms lags 377

kyang / /bsgom bya sgom byed stor nas thal/ /bsgom thun mtshams su bcad du mi gda' ye/ /zhes dang / rnam par mi rtog pa'i gzungs las/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i rnam par mi rtog pa ye shes kyis chos thams cad nam mkha'i dkyil ltar mthong ngo / /zhes dang / 'phags pa'i chos yang dag par sdud pa'i mdo las/ gang yang mthong ba med de ni/ /de kho na nyid mthong ba'o/ /zhes dang / ting 'dzin rgyal po las/ bsod nams dpag med bye bas rab brgyan pa/ /ye shes bsam yas spros bral khyod kyi brnyes/ /zhes dang / rgya cher rol pa las/ zab zhi spros bral 'od gsal 'dus ma byas/ /bdud rtsi lta bu'i chos zhig kho bos rnyed/ /su la bstan kyang go bar mi nus pas/ /mi smra nags kyi tshal du gnas par bya/ /zhes dang / rgyas pa las/rdo rje lta bu'i ting 'dzin dang / nam 'kha' lta bu'i ting 'dzin la sogs mang po gsungs/ 'brug pa kun legs kyis/gting dpag dka' ba'i sems nyid 'di la/ phyag na rdo rjes kyang ma rnyed zer ba 'dug lags/ gcig dang du bral gye rig pas 'tshol ba 'di la theg pa'i bye brag cig yin yong bas khyad du ni mi gsod/ lam 'dir 'dug ni spre'u dkar khung nas 'bab pa las kyang dog 378

par 'dug nga rang ni lam 'di spong yang mi sgong / 'gro yang mi 'gro/ brtag dpyad kyi 'tshol ba 'di/ rkun ma nang thug pa 'dra/ blo byas kyis blo bsgom rnyed pa yin/ blo bral blos ga la rnyed gsungs/ mkhyen brtse rin po ches/ theg mchog snying bo'i lta ba'i nying khu yid dpyod kyi lta bsgom dang 'dres nas chos skad gya gyur smras shing 'chal bar shin tu 'phang / gsungs/zhang g.yu brag 'gro ba'i mgon pos/ mtshan nyid pha rol tu phyin pa'i theg pa dang / grub mtha' lam gye rim pa rnams kyi gcig dang du bral la sogs pa rnams kyi gtan tshig chen po bzhi la sogs pa'i/ snang ba 'di stong pa nyid du rtogs nus kyis/sems kyi dwangs ma skye ba med par rtogs mi nus te/ rdugs nas 'gro ba yin no/ /zhes dang / shes bya phra mo stong nyid kyi shes bya'am/ skye ba med pa bya bar 'dzin pas shes bya phra mo yod na/shes bya de shes par byed pa'i shes pa phra mo 'ong la/ shes bya phra mo yod na gzung 'dzin phra mo la sogs pa snga ma bzhin du 'byung ba yin no/ /zhes dang / zhus lan bdud rtsi'i sman mchog las/spyi'i lta ba stong pa mtha' bral du 'dod pa la/ gsang sngags 'di'i lugs kyi rnal 'byor pas mngon sum rjen par 'dod/de gnyis yang don dam par rtogs na dbyer med de/ ma rtogs 379

na spyi'i lta ba/ yid dpyod kyi tshig gi lta ba zhen pas don rang thog tu mi phebs te gol ba'i lta ba yin/ zhes dang / rang gi rig pa'i gnas lugs cir yang grub pa med pa'i stong gsal du/ ye gdod ma nas da lta'i shes pa bcos slad dang bral ba 'di ga ltar yod pa yin te/ de ga'i steng du mi 'jog par gang zag gis stong nyid du bsgoms pas/ stong 'dzin gyi blo dang ma bral bas/ stong pa phyad chad bya ba gol ba yin zhes mdo rgyud bstan bcos kyi lung brgya stong 'dren pas/ 'dod tshul 'di gnyis gtan nas mi gcig par 'dug pas 'di ci yin zer na/ 'o de khyod bden/ ngas de'i dgongs don dpe bzhag nas khyod la ston gyes khyod nyon dang / dbu ma pa sogs kyis bzhed srol 'di 'dra zhig yin te/ dper na gtsub shing bar nas me len mi shes pa zhig gzhan len shes mkhan gye drung du song / len tshul bslabs/ rang gi bzo lta kun 'grigs po byas/ de nas shing gnyis kyi 'og ma brtan par byas/ steng ma lag tu thogs/ steng 'og gnyis drag tu drud na skabs zhig bar nas me 'byung ba ltar/ gnas lugs stong pa nyid mi shes pas/ dang po mtshan ldan gye bla ma'i drung nas lam la rim pas bslab/ nges 'byung byang chub sems sogs kyis rang 380

rgyud dag par byas/ de nas zhi gnas kyi sems brtan par byas/ so sor rtogs pa'i shes rab kyis dpyad bsgom gtso cher byas pa la brten nas gnas lugs lta ba mngon du gyur pa la dgongs nas/ gzhan gyi phyag rdzogs pa kha cig gis lung rigs kyi lam nas chos thams cad kyi gnas lugs stong pa nyid du sgo 'dogs ma chod bzhin du mi rtog par bzhag pa tsam ni/ dper na rang gi glang bu bor ba'i rtsad ma chod bzhin du sos dal du bsdad pa 'dra bas/ de 'dra'i rigs kyi sa lam mi chod ces gsungs pa ma gtogs/ chos thams cad gnas lugs rang gsal chos dbyengs chen por thag chod de yi ngang du mi rtog par bzhag pa'i dpal nam mkha' lta bu'i rnal 'byor pas mi rtogs gsungs pa ma yin te/ 'on kyang gzhan kun gyes mi rtogs zhes gsungs pa lta bu'i tshig yod kyang 'khrul bar mi bya ste/ de dgongs gzhi che/ de skad smras na zab mo dbu ma'i lam de nyams su len mkhan gye gdul bya mang po 'du ba dang / gdul bya de rnams kyis gdams pa de la rtsis che zhing / rtse gcig tu nyams su blangs na sangs rgyas shing bstan pa mi nyams par yun ring du gnas pa sogs la phan par dgongs nas/ de skad gsungs pa yin pas de la dmigs 381

bsal yod/ gzhan phyag rdzogs pa sogs kyis glang bu stor ba'i rjes thog na bsdad nas phyogs sgo ma song ba bzhin/ ci tsam 'bad kyang lta ba'i phyogs sgo tsam la mi 'go zhes gsungs pa ma yin/ de yin zer na lung rigs mtha' yas pa dang 'gal bas chos spong gi las chen po yin par ma zad/ de gsung pa po sngon byon mkhas grub byin rlabs can thams cad kyang gnas lugs lta ba'i phyogs sgo tsam la yang ma song zhes skur ba 'debs dgos la/ phyag rdzogs pas lung rigs kyi lam nas rtog dpyod du btang nas gnas lugs gtan la 'bebs tshul mtha' yas gsungs pa/ de bzhin du byed pa mngon sum yod pa yang khyad gsod byed dgos pas a dzi'i de'ang sus phod/ khyad par rang gis nyams su len pa'i lam rim blo sbyong dang / de'i gsung ba rnams kyang spongs dgos te/ kun mkhyen jo bo rjes mdzad pa'i byang chung lam rim thams cad kyi ma lta bu'i byang chub lam sgon las/ de bas chos rnams ma lus pa'i/ /rang bzhin dag ni mi dmigs pas/ /bdag med par ni gang bsgom nyid/ /'dir ni shes rab bsgom pa yin/ /shes rab kyis ni chos rnams kun/ /gang gi rang bzhin ma mthong bzhin/ /shes rab de nyid rig dpyad 382

pa/ /rnam rtog med par de bsgom bya/ /rnam rtog las byung srid pa 'di/ /rnam par rtog pa'i bdag nyid de/ de phyir ma lus rtogs spangs pa/ /mya ngan 'das pa mchog yin no/ /de ltar yid ni bcom ldan gyis/ /rnam rtog ma rig chen po ste/ /'khor ba'i rgya mtshor ltung bar byed/ /rtog med ting 'dzin la gnas na/ /nam mkha' bzhin du rtog med gsal/ /zhes gsungs so/ /rnam par mi rtog pa la 'jug pa'i gzungs las kyang /dam chos 'di la rgyal ba'i sras/ /rnam par mi rtog bsam gyur na/ /rnam rtog bgrod dka' rnams 'das te/ /rim gyis mi rtog thos par gyur/ /zhes gsungs so/ /lung dang rig pa dag gis ni/ /chos rnams thams cad skye med pas/ /rang bzhin med par nges byas nas/ /rnam par rtog med bsgom par bya /de ltar de nyid bsgom byas na/ /rim gyis drod sogs thob byas nas/ /rab dga' la sogs thob 'gyur te/ /sangs rgyas byang chub yun mi ring / /zhes dang / rgyal ba'i sras po shes bya'i gnas kun thogs pa med par mkhyen pa'i mtshan snyan rgyal sras thogs med rin po ches mdzad pa'i blo sbyong thams cad kyi pha lta bu'i blo sbyong don bdun ma'i khrid yig las/ chos rnams rmi lam lta bur bsam/ /zhes gsungs te/ 'di ltar gzung ba'i 383

yul du snang ba'i snod bcud 'di dag thams cad rmi lam dang 'dra ste/ rang gi sems nyid 'khrul nas/ de ltar snang ba yin gyis/ sems las logs su gyur pa cung zad tsam yang med par sgro 'dogs bcad/ sems nyid bden nam snyam pa na/ /ma skyes rig pa'i gshis la spyod/ /ces gsungs te/ sems nyid skye 'gag gnas gsum gyis stong zhing kha dog dbyibs la sogs pa med la/ lus kyi phyi nang gang na mi gnas/ gshis cir yang ma grub pas/ gang du yang mi 'dzin par rtog med kyi ngang la bzhag go /de'i tshe lus sems thams cad stong pa'o snyam pa'i gnyen po'i rnam rtog byung na/ gnyen po nyid kyang rang sar grol/ /zhes gsungs te/ gnyen po de nyid kyi ngo bo la bltas te/rang bzhin med par shes par byas nas de'i ngang la bzhag go /de'i 'jog tshul bstan pa'i phyir/ lam gye ngo bo kun gzhi'i ngang la bzhag /ces gsungs te/ rnam shes tshogs bdun gye spro bsdu thams cad dang bral nas/ gshis cir yang ma grub pa la/ blos cir yang mi 'dzin par rtog med kyi ngang la gsal sing nge bzhag go /zhes gsungs/ de ltar 'grel ba mdzad pa/ blo sbyong kyi khungs kyi gtugs sa chu mgo gangs la thug pa lta bu'i bla ma dharmā rak+ṣi ta dang / bla ma gser gling pa gnyis 384

kyi dgongs pa ji bzhin te/ bla ma rak+ṣi tas mdzad pa'i blo sbyong mtshon cha'i 'khor lo las/ ka ye de dag thams cad rten 'brel yin/ /rten 'brel ltos dang rang tshugs med pa yin/ /phar bsgyur tshur bsgyur rdzun snang sgyu ma yin/ /bkar ske bzhin du snang ba'i gzugs brnyan yin/ /chu shing bzhin du srog ‘pa snying bo med/ /lbu ba bzhin du tshe la snying bo med/ /khug sna bzhin du btud na 'jig pa yin/ /smig rgyu bzhin du rgyang nas mdzes pa yin/ /me long gzugs brnyan lta bur bden bden 'dra/ /sprin dang na bun bzhin du sdod sdod 'dra/ /dgra bdag gshed ma 'di yang de bzhin du/ /yod yod 'dra ste nam yang yod ma myong / /bden bden 'dra ste gang du bden ma myong / /snang snang 'dra ste sgo skur yul las 'das/ /de la las kyi 'khor lo gang zhig yod/ /'di na de ltar rang bzhin med na yang / /chu dang zla ba'i dkyil 'khor shar ba ltar/ /las 'bras 'di ni rdzun pa sna tshogs bkra/ /snang ba tsam du blang dor bya'o ang / /rmi lam yul du la ma'i me 'bar tshe/ /rang bzhin med kyang tsha ba'i 'jigs pa ltar/ /dmyal khams la sogs rang bzhin med na yang / /btso bsreg tshogs la 'jigs pas spangs bar bya/ /tshad pas 'khrul tshe mun nag yod med kyang / /gting ring 385

phugs su rgyu zhing 'tshubs pa ltar/ /ma rig tshogs la rang bzhin med na yang / /shes rab gsum gyes 'khrul ba bsal bar bya/ /rol mo mkhan gyis pi wang glu blangs tshe/ /dpyad na sgra de rang bzhin ma mchis mod/ /ma dpyad 'tshogs pas snyan pa'i sgra 'byung bas/ /skye bo'i sems kyi gdung ba sel ba ltar/ /las dang rgyu 'bras yongs la dpyad pa na/ /gcig dang tha dad rang bzhin med na yang / /snang snang lta bur chos rnams sgye 'jig byed/ /yod yod lta bur bde sdug sna tshogs myong / /chu yi thigs pas bum pa 'gengs ba na/ /chu thigs dang pos bum pa mi khengs shing / /tha ma la sogs re res ma yin mod/ /rten 'brel 'tshogs pas bum pa gang ba ltar/ /bde sdug 'bras bu gang gis myong ba na/ /rgyu yi skad cig dang pos ma yin zhing / /tha ma'i skad cig sogs kyis ma yin kyang / /rten 'brel 'tshogs pas bde sdug myong bar 'gyur/ /e ma ma brtag gcig por nyams dga' ba'i/ /snang ba 'di la snying bo ma mchis mod/ /'on kyang yod pa lta bur snang ba yi/ /chos 'di zab ste dman pas mthong ba dka'/ /da ni ting 'dzin mnyam par 'jog pa na/ /nges par snang ba tsam yang ci zhig yod/ /yod pa ci yod med pa'ang ci zhig yod/ /yin min dam bca' 386

gang du su zhig yod/ /yul dang yul gyi chos nyid ma mchis shing / /blang dor kun bral spros dang bral ba yi/ /gnyug ma'i ngang du blo gros ma bcos pa/ /lhan ner gnas na skyes bu chen por 'gyur/ /gsungs/ /bla ma gsar gling pas/ rgyangs kyis skyur la lhog gis glod/ /log ste log la cher re ltos/ /shig se shig la 'bol le zhog /des na mi 'ching grol bar 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs/ /de bzhin du mkhas btsun bzang gsum 'dzom pa'i kha rag sgom chung pas/ 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal thams cad kun/ /rang gi ngo bo stong na yang / /las dang nyon mongs rgyu las byung / /bdag med don la rtog cig ang / /gzung 'dzin gnyis dang bral ba yi/ /rang sems gdod nas ma sgyes pa/ /blo yi yul las 'das pa'i phyir/ /zhe 'dod kun dang khrol zhig ang / /las dang po pa yi gang zag la/ /gsal cha yod de gnas cha med/ /rtog pa'i rlung la ma bskur bar/ /dran pa'i thag pas zungs shig ang / /gnas lugs cir yang ma grub pas/ /mtha' bzhi ngang gis bral ba la/ /shes pas cir yang mi rtog par/ /'dzin rtog bral bar gyis shig ang / /chos rnams rmi lam sgyu ma 'dra/ /bden pa'i dngos po gang yang med/ /med bzhin snang ba'i dngos po la/ /dngos por zhen pa ma che 387

ang / /gnas lugs don la ma grub pas/ /rmi lam dus kyi rgyu 'bras bzhin/ /'khrul ngo'i rgyu 'bras mi bslu bas/ /sdig spong dge la 'bod cig ang / /des na 'di 'dra'i rigs kyis nam yang gnas lugs rtogs par mi 'gyur zhes skyes bu dam pa de rnams kyi gsung khas mi len pa'i mkhas pa 'dra yod na/ khyod kyis 'dod pa'i lta ba de la lhag par su yid ches nas khas len/khyod la dbang skye rgyu 'dra zhig yin na/ rang gzhan gyi grub mtha'i nang na mar la 'phen rgyu mang po yod sa snang / khyod sngar med pa'i kun mkhyen kun dang mi mthun pa zhig byung ba yin pas ngo mtshar che/ yang phyag rdzogs pa sogs kyis 'dod tshul de yang /ngas dpe yi sgo nas bshad kyis yang khyod nyon cig phyag rdzogs sogs kyi bzhed srol 'di 'dra zhig yin te/ de la dper na/me shel las me len mi shes pa zhig gis thog mar gzhan len shes pa zhig gi drung du song / me len tshul rnams bslab/ de nas spra btsos me shel phyis nyi ma 'char du bcug nyi ma'i thad ka me shel btegs/ me shel thad du spra ba bzhag g.yo 'gul med par bzung na thog mar dros/ de nas rim pas skabs shig me 'byung ba bzhin/ gnas lugs stong pa nyid kyi don mi shes pas/dang po mtshan ldan bla mar brten nas lam thun mong dang /388

thun mong ma yin pas rgyud sbyangs tshogs bsags sgrib sbyong yang dag byas/ de nas so sor rtogs pa'i shes rab kyis snang srid 'khor 'das kyi bsdus pa'i chos thams cad sgyu ma rmi lam bzhin gyis grub pa rdul tsam med cing nam mkha'i 'ja' sprin ltar chos thams cad sems nyid stong pa'i ngang las byung bar thag bcad/ lung rigs du ma'i nges shes drangs/ sems kyi ngo bo sgye 'gag gnas gsum dang bral la stong gsal chos sku nam mkha' lta bur rjen cer gyes mthong tshe/ de'i ngang la bying rgod dang bral bar/ 'jog bsgom gtso cher byas pas lta ba mngon du 'gyur ba dgongs nas/ gzhan dper na byis pas 'ben drung du bzhag mda' rgyang du 'phangs nas/ drung gi 'ben la phog snyam pa ltar/ rtog ge ba kha cig gis/ blo kha tshur phyogs nas/ rang gi rgyud steng du bskor nas mi dpyad par/ kha phyir bltas kyi dpyad pas/ nang chos nyid kyi don mngon sum du rtog snyam pa'i byis pa'i blo can gyes mi rtogs zhes gsungs pa ma gtogs/ tshur nang rang rgyud la bskor nas lung rigs dri ma med pa'i lam nas gnas lugs kyi phu thag chod nas/ ngang du rtse gcig tu 'jog mkhan/ dper na nad thog tu me btsa' 'jog pa lta bu'i rnal 'byor pas mi rtogs zhes gsungs pa ma 389

yin/ 'on kyang gzhan dbu ma lung rigs smra ba kun gyis rtogs dka' ba lta bu gsungs pa de la dgongs gzhi de skad smras na/lam bzang de rnams nyams su len mkhan gyi skal bzang gdul bya mang po 'du ba dang / gdul bya rnams gdams pa de la rtsis che ba dang / rtse gcig nyams su blangs na mchog thun gyi dngos grub myur du thob pa dang / de mthus bstan pa mi nub par yun ring gnas pa sogs bstan 'gro la dngos sam brgyud nas phan pa'i dgos pa mang po yod pas/ de la dgongs nas de skad gsungs pa ma gtogs/ gzhan du dbu ma bas chu dwangs par 'dod nas rnyog pa bzhin lta ba rtog pa phar zhog 'grub pa'i rgyu yin bskal par 'bad kyang mi rtogs zhes gsungs pa ma yin te/ de yin na lung rigs mtha' yas pa dang 'gal bas/ chos spong gi las chen po gsog dgos par ma zad/ de gsungs pa bo rgyal ba sras bcas thams cad spongs dgos/dbu ma pas gnas lugs kyi ngang la rtse gcig tu mnyam par 'jog dgos zhes gsungs pa bzhin 'jog gi yod pa yang khyad gsod byed dgos/ de blo gros can su zhig gis phod/ khyad par rang gi chos rdzogs chen phyag chen sogs kyi bla ma grub thob kyi gsung thams cad kyang spangs dgos te/ rnying ma'i rgyud kyi 390

mchog rdzogs chen kun gyi gsum̐ng shing lta bu'i thal 'gyur las/sems ni dang po byung sa dang / /bar du gnas dang tha mar 'gro/ /da ltar gsum la brtag dpyad na/ /sems spangs sems kyi gnas lugs shes/ /zhes dang / /o rgyan rin po ches/sems de dang po gang nas byung / bar du gang na gnas/ tha ma gang du 'gro ltos shig de la rang gi sems 'di la rang gis bltas pas/ byung sa gnas sa 'gro sa mi rnyed/ de 'di 'dra zhes mtshon du med ces dang / phyag rgya chen po'i phug gi gtugs sa grub chen te lo pas/ blo 'das byar med don te thob 'dod na/ /sems kyi rtsad chod rig pa gcer bur zhog /ces dang / zhi byed kyi phug gi gtugs sa/ pha dam pas/ stong pa'i ngang du rig pa'i mdud skor gyis/ /lta ba thogs rdugs med do ding ri pa/ /dran med ngang du yengs med bya ra thongs/ /bsgom la bying rgod med do ding ri ba/ /gsungs/ gcod kyi phug gi gtugs sa ma cig gis/ sems la gnyis su ma mchis ste/ /blta ru med pa'i tshul du blta/ /bltas pas rang gi sems mi mthong / /ma mthong ba de chos mthong yin/ /mthong ba med pas ngang la zhog /ces dang / rje mi las kyang / shes rab zab mo'i dpyod pa dang bcas pa 'di lhag mthong thob par 391

byed pa'i thabs med mi rung skas la 'dzegs pa'i skas them 'og ma dang 'dra gsungs/ rje rgod tshang pas/ rang gi sems la cer gyes ltos/ /bltas pas mi mthong dngos po med/ /med pa'i ngang la lhod kyis glod/ /yal le chad de 'dzin med zhog /yang gcig rnam rtog skyes tsa na/ /ngo yi tsir gyes bzung mdzod la/ /kho rang thog tu lhod de zhog /rang sar grol bar je tshom med/ /ces dang / bde ba rab 'byams las/ rtsa ba med pa'i sems nyid ni/ /btsal pas mi rnyed ngos bzung med/ /de bzhin ye bzhin stong pa'i ngang / /brjod bral rang byung ye shes so/ /gsungs/ de ltar dpyad tshe sems zhes ming gis phar btags pa tsam ma gtogs/ rang bzhin gyis grub pa rdul tsam yang mi rnyed de/ sangs rgyas kyis/ sems ni kha dog med/dbyibs med/ gnas pa med/ nam mkha' lta bu'o zhes dang /dkon mchog brtsegs pa las/ sems ni sangs rgyas kyis ma gzigs/ /mi gzigs gzigs par mi 'gyur ro/ /zhes gsungs/ des na 'di 'dra'i rigs kyis nam yang gnas lugs mi rtogs/ zhes khas blangs na blun pos chos mi shes pa'i rang mtshang phyir bstan pa yin pas mkhas pa'i bzhad gad kyi gnas las gzhan ma sems/ khyod sngar med pa'i chos mi 392

shes pa'i grub thob bod du byung ba yin pas ya mtshan che/ de ltar dbu rdzogs phyag gsum sogs kyi dgongs pa lon na mi 'gal bar ma zad gcig grogs su gcig 'gro ste/ dper na me zhig khol mo'am rlung gis bskyod nas 'bar tshe sgul bskyod med par bzhag na/ sngar bas lhag par 'u ru ru 'bar ba bzhin/ skabs skabs so sir rtogs pa'i shes rab kyis dpyad nas gnas lugs stong pa nyi da nges tshe de'i ngang la 'jog bsgom byas na bogs che/ de ltar byed pa yang yin te/ rje skal ldan rgya mtshos/ chos spros bral nam mkha'i ngos yangs por/ /skabs la lar dpyad pas gshog rlabs bskyod/ /dus la lar mi mngon mi snang bar/ /sems tsen ne sdod tshe 'jog bsgom byed/ /ces dang / po to bas/ gcig dang du bral rten 'brel la sogs/ /gang la goms pa so sor brtag cing / /cung zad mi rtogs nyid du gnas bya/ /zhes gsungs/ dper na me 'u ru ru 'bar ba me lce chung ngur gyu ra tshe khol mo rlung gis bskyod na/sngar ltar cher 'bar ba bzhin/ bying rgod sogs kyis gnas lugs mi gsal bar gyur dus/ so sor rtogs pa'i shes rab kyis dpyad nas bsal na/ ba/nas lugs 'od gsal stong pa nyid/sngar bas cher gsal bar rdogyur bas bogs che/ de ltar dpyad 393

pa yang yin te/ rje mi las/ rtog pa rang shar yod kyang 'tshal/ /rtog pa rang shar ma byung na/ /so sor rtogs dang mi 'bral 'tshal/ /zhes dang / /o rgyan rin po ches/ ma gzhi stong pa nyid kyi zhi gnas la/ /rnam rtog mthar ded stong bskor rem du gyis/ /zhes gsungs so/ /da ngas bsam na/ dbu rdzogs phyag gsum sogs grub mtha' gang yin rung / thos bsam gnyis kyis sgro 'dogs gcod dgos/ dpyad 'jog gnyis kyi bsgom su la'ang yod/ thabs shes gnyis kyi nyams len sus kyang byed dgos/ mthar thug sku gnyis/ kun gyi thob par 'gyur bas/ lam dang 'bras bu'i skabs gang yin yang / don gyi mi mthun pa cung zad mi snang / tshig gi 'gal ba ltar snang ba rgyal ba'i gsung na mtha' yas/ 'gal 'brel brtsi mi rung /brtsi shes na gang la dad gus dag snang 'byung ba'i rgyu yin pas shin tu legs te/ brtsi mi shes na rang bzhin gyi chos gang la yid gnyis je tshom log lta skyes/ skyob mkhan dam pa'i chos dang / de mdzad pa po rgyal ba sras bcas spangs nas/ skyabs med mgon med du bar do'i 'phrang ring brgal nas/ ngan song gi dur khrod 'jigs su rung ba sdug bsngal du ma'i 'byung gnas su/ rang dbang med par 'gro dgos pas/ de bas 394

dad gus kyi zhabs tog bzang bos/ rtsa rgyud bla ma mchog gsum gyi ded dpon la brten nas/ nges legs rin chen gling du 'gro ma nus rung / mngon mtho lha ma'i rang yul nyams dga' skyid pa'i 'byung gnas su bsdad na legs/ yang phyag rdzogs pa blun po 'ga' res/ ri bo dge ldan pa sang la/ chos kun gyi gnas lugs 'di 'dra zhig red snyam pa'i nges shes skyes thabs tsam zhig ma gtogs/ nges don phyag rgya chen po bsgom tshul med/ dper na mar me sbar ste mun par song nas len dgos pa rnams mig gi gcig mthong kyang / tshur lag tu ma blangs pa dang 'dra zer/ yang dbu ma rtog ge ba 'ga' res phyag rdzogs pa rnams la zhi gnas tsam zhig ma gtogs/ lhag mthong gtan nas med/ ca/ra me rlung gis mi bskyod pa'i yol ba yod kyang / mar me me/da par mig btsums nas mun pa'i nang du zhugs pa dang 'dra zer/ smod pa 'di ci yin zer na/bla ma dam pas de skad gsungs pa la dgongs gzhi che/ de la dmigs bsal yod pas skyo na med/ blun po rang rtog ge ba gnyis kyi 'dod pa de/ chos rgyus chung bas lan pa yin te/ ri bo dge ldan pa sang la nges don phyag rgya chen po bsgom tshul ci la med/ so sor rtogs pa'i shes rab kyis gnad bzhi'i sgo 395

nas/ dpyad nas gnas lugs stong sang gi ngang la mnyam par 'jog pa de/ nges don phyag rgya chen po'i bsgom tshul yin te/phyag rdzogs pas kyang so sor rtogs pa'i shes rab kyis sems byung gnas 'gro gsum gyi sgo nas dpyad pas sems gnas lugs stong sing nge la 'jog pa la/ nges don phyag rgya chen po'i bsgom zer ba ma gtogs/ de bas lhag zhig med pa'i phyir ro/ /phyag rdzogs par lhag mthong ci la med/ so sor rtogs pa'i shes rab kyis brtag cing dpyad nas/ sems kyi gnas lugs 'od gsal stong pa nyid du mthong ba lhag mthong yin te/dbu ma bas kyang brtag dpyad byas gnas lugs kyi don ji bzhin mthong ba lhag mthong zer ba ma gtogs de bas lhag zhig med pa'i phyir ro/ /des na/ dbu ma sang la nges don phyag rgya chen po bsgom tshul med nas/ khyed phyag rdzogs pa sang gi sgo la bud 'ong ba lta bu dang / phyag rdzogs pa la lhag mthong med nas khyed dbu ma sang gi sgo ru bud 'ong ni 'dra gi bshad bshad ma byed dang bzang / kun la yod pa'i rtags su/ sngon dbu rdzogs phyag gsum la bla ma mkhas shing grub pa brnyes pa nam mkha'i skar tshogs lta bu byung tshul soms/ da lta yang mang po bzhugs pa la ltos/ med na de 'dra 'byung dogs med/ bla ma 396

zhang gis/ mdzod na gser zho gcig med par/ /gser rgyus che ba'i kha spyang po/ /bu ram mig gis ma mthong par/ /lo rgyus mkhus pa'i kha spyang po/ /ba/sungs pa ltar/da 'e tsho phar ded na/zhi gnas rjes mthun tsam da nga / gnas lugs kyi don 'di 'dra red ces nges shes tsam yang ma sgyes pa ngo tsha rgyu med par/gzhan la yod med bshad nga/ 'di bar skabs gi zhog la/rang rang gi chos la thos bsam sgom gsum gyis dang / yod med kyi ha go yong / sngon gye sa pa gzhon nu gnyis kyi gcig gis/ nged sang gi a pha'i de cig che gi bshad tshe/ gcig po na re/ a pha'i de che na/ a ma'i de'i kha grogs red smras/gnyis ka ha bgad byas pa ltar/ nged sang la yod/ khyed sang la med ces bshad gi 'dug dgos pa ma red/ kun la yod na skyid la/ phyag rdzogab/ dbu gsum gyi kha grogs red bzang mod ha ha/ gal te gcig sang la med kyang / yod ni sang gi sgo ru song na chog pas khas ma gtong / 'brug pa kun legs kyis/ khyod sang a ji rgyal 'dzoms 'di/ /mo sgo mtshar bas mi chog par/ /'og 'degs mkhas te ci bya ba/ /gsungs pa ltar rang rang gi lta ba legs pas chog par/ bdag bstod gzhan smod byas nas ci bya/ yang / gtan du 'chi ba bsgoms na yi 397

mug rgyu/ /gtan du stu tsho bsgoms na mje rgan langs/ /gsungs pa ltar/ rtag tu grub mtha'i bzang ngan bsam na chags sdang langs nas/ chos spong gi las ngan pa bsog nyen che bas mi rung / gal te khas gtong na/ ngas khyed phyag rdzogs dbu gsum la dri ba zhig byed pas nyon la lan thob/ khyed phyag rdzogs pas khong sang gi lta ba 'di rnam dag yin zer/dbu ma bas kyang lta ba yin min cha med/ zhi gnas bzang bo zhig red ces khas len par 'dug da de gnyis kyi gang yin yang / lam de nyams su len pa'i gang zag la lam rgyud la skyes pa'i rtags mngon shes rdzu 'phrul/ nyon mongs pa thams cad kyi ma gnon pa sogs dgos la/ da lta lam de nyams su len mkhan la mngon shes rdzu 'phrul phar zhog nyon mongs pa'i mgo yang non mi dgos/ chags sdang rmongs gsum gyi mgo langs 'dug pa ches shin tu mang bas/ de 'dra'i yon tan med pa'i lta ba zhig dang / zhi gnas shig yod mi srid/ khas len gnyis kyi gcig kyang ma red/ rdzun du btang 'dug yang dbu ma bas khong sang gi lta ba 'di yin rab chen po bco brgyad bshad/phyag rdzogs pas kyang lta ba 'dra yin min mi shes/ lta ba la nges shes skye thabs tsam zhig red zer khas len par 'dugade 398

gnyis kyi gang yin yang / lam de nyams su len mkhan la/lam de rgyud la skyes rtags mngon shes dzu 'phrul dang nyon mongs chung dgos pa la/ gzhan phar zhog dug gsum je chung du 'gro mi dgos/ steng du sngar med pa'i rang mthong nga rgyal/ gzhan mtho bar do gas pa'i phrag dog bsnan nas je sbom du song 'dug pa shin tu ma/nga bas/ sngar gyi khas len gang yin yang dzun du btang byung / gnyis ga'i gcig kyang ma red/ de 'dra'i yon tan skye rgyu med par ma zad skyon bskyed pa'i lam zhig yod mi sred/ sngon ban+de zhig shi bo zhig la dge rtsa bca' ba'i steng du 'gro ba la/ / ma khu zhig yod pas sngon tsho dang 'dra na/ dge thog na rtsam pa ma nga po yod pas/ ban+de khyod kyis snod che zhig khyer la song dang rtsa ma pa len dgos bshad tshe/ ban+de na re/ gna' dang deng sangari mi 'dra gi deng sang skal khug mi dgos gi smras pa ltar/ sngon gyi dus kyi phyag rdzogs dbu gsum gyi rnal 'byor dang 'dra na lam rtags kyi yon tan mtha' yas dgos pa la/ deng sang gi rnal 'byor pa dang gnyis ye mi 'dra gi da khyed rnams kyi chos la nor 'khrul byung zer ram/ gang zag tsho snying rus chung pas pan pa yin zer spros shig chos ngan pa yin zer na/ sngon kha sho gcig gis kha sho zhig la bltas/399

khyod kyi kha kha sho red/ kho bo'i kha 'di g.yang sho yin zhes smras pa ltar/ dbu rdzogs phyag gsum su yin yang gcig gis gcig la 'phya smod spu tsam mi 'dug thams cad 'chug 'dug da bu snying rus can yod na/ rgya gar la song nas bod la chos sgyur/ 'phya smod byas bsdad nas ci bya/ yang de mi zer/ gang zag ngan pa yin zer na/ sngon bla rgan gcig bla ma zhig gi mdun du song / khong gis zhal ta mang po byas/ khong dkor la 'bags pa sogs mi bzang tshul gsungs tshe bla rgan gyis/ bla ma mchod pa'i nang gi tshigs bzhi zhig gi lung 'dren byas/ bla ma la che bstod zhig bya snyam nas/ khyed skyes bu dam pa gzhan dang mi 'dra gi /sangs rgyas grangs med byon pas ma thul bas/ /ma red ga re na/ zhes 'phro ma 'ong tshe/ khong dbon slob thams cad bzhad gad byas pa ltar/ chos bzang nas rang nyid ngan pa yin na/ bla rgan gis bla ma sang la bshad bshad byas/ chos khas gtong ga la rung / khas gtong na dpon slob tshos/ bla rgan ngo la bltas nas bzhad gad byas pa ltar/ rang la snying rus med par gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa'i nye lam yang ring lam du btang tshul sogs bsam nas 'phya smod byed dgos/sngon dbu mdzad zhig gis lam rim bsdus don bton nas/400

ngal ba'i rten 'di yid bzhin nor las lhag zer tshe/ 'gab na grwa ba gcig gis/ 'di 'dra thos pa da res tsam zhig yin/zhes thams cad bzhad gad byas pa ltar/ phyin chad 'ga' res ma shes pa'i dbang gis skad gseng mthong pos gzhan la khas gtong ba go tshe/ 'di 'dra thos pa da res tsam zhig yin/ zhes de la bltas bzhad gad byed dgos/ da ban rgan ngas bsam na/ dbu ma pas lta ba nges shes tsam min/ 'dren mi nus kyang rung / phyag rdzogs pa sang ri gis kyang / so sor rtogs pa'i shes rab kyis dpyad nas/ nges shes 'dren dgos pas khyod sang gi grogs yin dgos/ phyag rdzogs pa zhi gnas tsam zhig yin rung / khyed dbu ma sang la zhi gnas mkho bas khyed sang gi grogs yin pas bzang / bla ma dam pa mang pos gdams ngag zab mi zab snying rus che chu nga yin gsungs pas/ khyed phyag rdzogs dbu gsum su sang yin yang / snying rus bskyed la nyams su longs dang / nga bzang khyod bzang rang gis bshad dgos pa ma red/ nyon mongs chung du song / mngon shes rdzu 'phrul sogs lam rtags kyi yon tan yod tshe/ bzang ngan thang gi rgan rgon yan chad kyis bshad yong / sngon mi gcig gis/bu nga mkhas khyod mkhas ma zer dang / /su mkhas sde bas 401

bshad gi 'gro/ /bu nga dpa' khyod dpa' ma zer dang / /su dpa' sde bas bshad nas 'gro/ /zhes glu blangs pa dang mtshungs/ sngon a rigs ban+de zer ba'i mgo che can zhig yod pas/ mi gnyis kyi gcig gis/ a rigs ban+de nga'i mgo na ba ma tsam zhig yod smras tshe/ gcig na re/ des mi tshad zang nga tsam zhig yod gi zhes smras/ gnyis ka kha ma 'cham de phar rtsod tshur rtsod byas/ spro langs nas brdung res byas zer ba ltar/chos kyi bzang ngan phar rtsod tshur rtsod byas chags sdang langs gcig gis gcig la khas btang / chos spong gi las ngan pa bsags nas ci bya/ a rigs ban+de'i mgo brtsad nas mi de gnyis gas 'phung rdzogs kyang / gnyis ka 'phung ba ma gtogs/a rig ban+de'i mgo la phan gnod gang yang ma byung ba ltar/bstan pa'i la rgya brtsad nas bla ma 'ga' res 'phung rdzogs kyang / kho rang gnyis 'phung ba ma gtogs/ bstan pa la phan gnod gang yang mi 'byung bas/ blo ldan rnams kyis snyigs dus tshe thung / nam 'chi cha med soms la/ bstan pa la phan mi thogs/ rang la pham ster ba'i tshig ngan spu tsam yang ma lab par/ da lta 'chi rung mi 'gyod pa'i gdengs zhig chos gang la brten nas thob thabs gyis dang bzang / yang 'ga' res/402

dbu rdzogs phyag gsum gye lta ba 'di/ gang gi sa nas bltas kyang mtshungs pa'i yul med la/ 'di gcig yin zer ba/mthun 'jug gi gtam zhig yin pa ma gtogs/ phyag rdzogs pas dbu ma bzhin stong nyid rten 'byung gi don du 'char tshul mi shes/ chad lta ba yin zer na/ 'o phyag rdzogs pa rnams kyis 'khor 'das kyi rtsa ba ser/sa nyid 'di/ phyi nang snod bcud ri ra ba khang khyem rang lus no/gas gang nas byung / gang na gnas/gang du 'gro/ dbyibs kha dog skye 'chi sogs e yod dpyad nas/ dper na nam mkha' stong pa la ming du nam mkha' 'dogs pa ma gtogs rang bzhin gyes grub pa med pa ltar/sems nyid stong pa la ming sems zhes phar btags pa tsam ma gtogs/ rang bzhin gyis grub pa rdul tsam yang med par gtan la phab nas/ de'i ngang la mnyam par 'jog pa dbu ma'i mnyam gzhag nam mkha' lta bu'i skyong tshul dang mthun la/ chos rnams thams cad sgyu ma ji/ lam bzhin sems nyid stong pa nyid kyi 'phrul du go zhing / rang bzhin gyes ma grub par bsgom pa/dbu ma'i rjes thob sgyu ma lta bu'i skyong tshul dang mtshungs pa yin la/ nam mkha'i 'ja' sprin nam mkha' la brten cing 'brel nas 'byung ba bzhin/ chos thams cad sems nyid stong gsal 403

khyab gdal chos kyi dbyings la brten cing 'brel nas 'byung ba dang / nam mkha' yang 'ja' sprin la brten cing 'brel ba ltar/ chos dbyengs chos thams cad la brten cing 'brel ba shes pas chad lta ba ga la yin/ 'khor 'das thams cad rten 'brel du go ba 'di las lhag pa zhig dbu ma pa sang la yang med de/ phyag na pad+mo dngos rgyal ba skal bzang rgya mtsho'i nyams mgur las/ gzhi 'khor 'das chos rnams ma lus pa/ /nang rang gi sems kyis btags pa tsam/ /sems de yang brtags na skye 'gag bral/ /gnas lus gyi ngo bo e ma ho/ /ston mkha' la chu 'dzin dwangs pa bzhin/ /dbyengs rang sems dbyer med snang ngo la/ /myong snang gi spros pa ma lus nub/ /nga skye med nam mkha' rnal 'byor pa/ /gshis cir yang ma grub rdzun po che/ /snang grags kun sgyu ma'i ltad mor mthong / /nyams dga' ba snang stong zung 'jug 'dis/ /bslu med kyi rten 'brel nges pa rnyed/ /rje mkhyen pa'i gter dang dbyer med pa'i/ /pha blo bzang grags pa'i legs bshad dang / /rje mtshan ldan bla ma'i bka' drin las/ /ngas nges don glu ru blangs pa yin/ /zhes gsungs so/ /yang 'ga' res phyag rdzogs pas/ las 'bras 'jog mi shes zer na/ 'o phyag rdzogs pas ci la mi shes/404

dper na sgyu ma mkhan gyeb4 stag seng gshin rjes mi gson por 'cha' ba sprul na/ de'i rang mtshang ma shes pa'i byis pa dngangs skrag 'jigs nas snying gas sdug bsngal myong ba dang /lha yul tshong 'dus ltad mor sprul na/ mi rnams dga' bde myong ba dang / rmi lam du mes 'tshig chus khyer tshe sdug bsngal myong ba dang / bza' btung sogs 'dod yon la longs spyod pa sogs rmis tshe bde ba rnams don la grub pa med kyang bde sdug myong ba bzhin/ lha mi'i bde ba dmyal ba'i sdug bsngal sogs don la rang bzhin gyes grub pa med kyang / las 'bras dkar nag gang gi rnam spe na nyams su myong bas shin tu bden zer de/ rgyal dbang thams cad mkhyen pas/ ka dag dngos gzhir chu las chu bur bzhin/ /ye nas btsal du med pa'i chos rnams kun/ /sems kyi sngang cha yin phyir snang ba kun/ /sems su thag bcad myong ba thon par bya/ /phra zhib gnas la phyi rol gzung ba'i yul/ /me long gzugs ltar rang gi sems la shar/ /de bzhin bzang ngan rtogs byed 'dzin pa yi/ /rang sems la shar gzung dang 'dzin pa'i chos/ /sgyu ma'i rta glang lta bur med bzhin du/ /gzhi med rtsa bral ye nas dag na yang / /stong zhing ma 'gags snang ba sems tsam du/ /khas len snga 405

'gyur rig 'dzin rnams kyi lugs/ /zhes dang / chos kun ka nas dag pas ma rnyed stong / /stong kyang sgyu ma lta bur mngon sum snang / /snang ba'i ngo bor bltas na ngos bzung med/ /med kyang bde sdug thams cad nyams myong nus/ /yong yong chu zla ltar 'char rang gi sems/ /sems kyi gshis lugs nam mkha' lta bur dag /dge sdug bde sdug sprin 'brug 'ja' glog bzhin/ /'char yang byung gnas 'gro gsum dmigs su med/ /med kyang don byed nus pa rmi lam 'dra/ /gsungs/yang 'ga' res phyag rdzogs pa'i lta ba 'dis nyon mongs thul mi dgos phyogs tsam la ma song 'dug zer na/ 'o phyag rdzogs pa'i lta bas nyon mongs thul thul zhig dbu ma'i lta ba sogs kyis mi thul smras na chog ste/ sems nyid rang bzhin gyi 'od gsal ba skye med chos sku yangs pa sprin bral mkha' ltar gnas pa'i ngang la mnyam par bzhag pa'i tshe/sprin med mkha' la nyi ma shar tshe/ mun pa sdod pa'i go skabs cung zad tsam med pa ltar/nyon mongs pa phra rags thams cad mthar grol rjes med du sangs nas/ rin chen gling na rdo med pa bzhin/ 'od gsal chos sku nyag gcig yin te/ rje mi las/rtogs pa nang nas shar tsa na/ /mun la nyi ma shar ba bzhin/ /nyon mongs rnam par 406

rtog pa'i tshogs/ /bcos/ med rang sar yal nas thal/ /zhes dang / mar pa lo tsās/ sems nyid gnyug ma'i rang bzhin gdod nas stong/ /tho bas dngos po 'joms pa bzhin/ /mthong dang reg dang dran pas grol/ /don 'di legs par go bar mdzod/ /'di rgyag rgya chen po'i bsgom dbyangs yin/ /gsungs/ dper na se/ṅge'i gsob seṅge dngos yin snyam/'jigs skrag skyes yod pa gzhan mas seṅge dngos min gsob yin zhes bshad/ rang yang thag nyer song zhib tu bltas/gsob dngos yin par thag chod tshe/ phyis nam mthong kyang /mthong ba dang dus mnyam/ gsob yin pa'i nges shes kyang lhang gis sgye 'jigs pa spu tsam med par blo bde 'bol ler gnas pa ltar/ rjes thob skabs su sngar nyon mongs dug lnga khyad par zhe sdang langs na/ snying nang na yod pa'i mi tshad/ na rgyu yod pa lta bu de/ bla myo/sa rang bzhin med par ye shes lnga ru ngo sprad pa de ltar/ rang gis kyang dug lnga skye ru bcug skye 'gag gnas gsum dbye‘bas kha dog sogs e grub ltos/ ming tsam ma gtogs rang bzhin gye grub pa rdul tsam med par thag bcad tshe/ phyis nyon mongs gang sgyes kyang / skyes ba dang dus mnyam bden med kyi nges shes kyang lhang gis skye/ shar grol dus 407

mnyam du gyur nas/ dper na shing ci tsam mang kyang me yi grogs yin pa bzhin/ nyon mongs gang skyes rnal 'byor pa'i grogs su 'char te/ jo bo rjes/ nyi ma nyin gcig la yang bdag 'dzin la/ /mi dgos dgu dgos rnam par rtog pa brgya/ /'phros ma thag tu gnyen pos btsal ba yi/ /ma rnyed chos dbyings kho na yin par gda'/ /zhes dang / ma cig gis/nyon mongs ye shes yin pa la/ nyon mongs spangs pa'i pha rol nas/ /ye shes 'tshol ba snying re rje/ /zhes dang / /o rgyan rin po ches/ 'gyu ba rang sar bzhag pas chos skur grol/ /gsungs/ dper na rdzas sngags sman gyes dug kun 'tsho ba'i zas su bsgyur ba dang / gser 'gyur rtsi yis lcags rnams gser du bsgyur ba ltar/ nyon mongs thams cad ma spangs par ye shes su bsgyur ba phyag rdzogs a ma'i bu rgod tsho'i khyad chos yin pas/ dbu ma sang la ma grags pa'i khyad chos shig 'dir mchis so/ /de bzhin du blo sbyong mtshon cha'i 'khor lo las kyang /btsan dug nags su rma bya rgyu ba na/ /sman gye ldum ra legs par mdzes gyur kyang / /rma bya'i tshogs rnams dga' bar mi 'gyur gyi/ /btsan dug bcud kyis rma bya 'tsho ba ltar/ /dpa' bo 'khor ba'i gnas su 'jug pa na/ /bde skyid dpal gye ldum 408

ra mdzes gyur kyang / /nga pa' bo dag ni chags par mi 'gyur gyi/ /sdug bsngal nags cwa / sems dpa' 'tsho ba yin/ /de phyir bde skyid dang du len len pas/ /sngar ma'i dab nga gis sdug la skyel ba yin/ /sdug bsngal dang du len pa'i sems dpa' rnams/ /dpa' bo'i stobs kyis rtag tu bde ba yin/ /da 'dir 'dod chags btsan dug nags dang 'dra/ /dpa' bo rma bya lta bus gcun par 'gyur/ /sngar ma bya rog lta bu'i srog la 'tshe/ /rang 'dod can gyi dug 'di ga la gcun/ /nyon mongs gzhan yang de bzhin sbyar ba na/ /bya rog lta bus thar ba'i srog la 'bab/ /de phyir ser/sa dpa' rma bya lta bu yis/ /dug gi nags dang 'dra ba'i nyon mongs rnams/ /bcud du sbyar la 'khor ba'i nags su 'jug /dang du blangs la dug 'di gzhom par bya/ /zhes gsungs so/ /spyir chos kyi phung bo brgyad khri bzhi stong sems can gyi nyon mongs brgyad khri ba'i stong 'dul ba'i gnyen por gsungs pa yin pas/ rgyal ba'i gsung rab gang yin yang / nyon mongs nga/'i gnyen por mi 'gro ba gcig tsam yang med la/ khyad par ba/sang sngags bla na med pa'i chos phyag rdzogs kyi lta ba 'dis nyon mongs pa thul ba phar zhog phyogs sgo tsam la yang ma song zheca/ smras na/ sngon tshe gcig lus gcig 409

la sangs rgyas pa'i rje btsun mi la ras pa la sogs phyag rdzogs nyams su blangs pa'i skyes chen dam pa thams cad kyis nyon mongs ma thul yan par btang nas sangs rgyas song ba yin/zhes khyod kyi khas len dgos/ de khas len na 'e tsho'i 'khor ba thog med nas da bar nyon mongs yan par btang bas sangs ma rgyas par ma zad/ rang nyid zhi bde'i go 'phang tsam zhig kyang ma thob par/ 'khor ba sdug bsngal gyi rgya mtshor lhung / skye rga na 'chi sogs sdug bsngal myong dgos pa ci byung ba yin khyod la dri bas/ sor bzhi thugs gar zhog spyan yang re zhig zum la thugs bsam thongs/ bla ma zhang rin po ches/ kye ma long bas mig ldan smod/ /sgo mi 'byed par nad rgyus bshad/ /long bas lam sna khrid bzhed de/ /be'u sbrel g.yangs la ma bskur mdzod/ /rang gzhan gnyis ka 'phung bar mchi'o/ /zhes dang /khrel bdas kyi glu chung las/ dad pa med/ sdig la dga'/dmyal bar skye/ 'chi khar 'gyod pa 'di gyong re che/ bya brel mang / sems khral che/ kun slong ngan/ bya ba don med 'di gyong re che/ thos pas khengs/ tshig la dga'/ man ngag med/rlom pa'i bdud langs 'di gyong re che/ bsgom sran chung /thos pa spong / sngags la gshe/ dam chos spangs pa 'di gyong re 410

che/ shes rab chung / yid ches dka'/ skyon la rtog man ngag mi rnyed pa 'di gyong re che/ gsungs/ dbu rdzogs phyag gsum sogs grub mtha' myo/tha' dag mi 'grig pa'i rtsa ba 'di phar ded na/ lta ba 'di mtha' gcig tu bzung bas lan par gda'/ mtha' gcig tu 'dzin ga la rung / gzugs sku'i rgyu thabs kyi cha mtha' yas pa bzhin/ chos sku'i rgyu shes rab lhag mthong ngam lta ba'ang mtha' yas ste/ mgon po klu sgrub kyis/gang tshe sangs rgyas gzugab/ sku yi/ /rgyu yang de lta 'jig rten bzhin/ /gzhal med de che chos sku yi/ /rgyu lta ji ltar gzhal du yod/ /ces gsungs/ lta ba mtha' yas pa de kun gyi la las dngos/ la las brgyud nas chos sku mngon du byed pas/ don gye snying bo phyogs gcig tu 'bab/ rang gi 'dod phyogs kyi lta ba sgom dang cung ma mthun tshe/ rang gzhan gyi grub mtha' gang rung zhig ma yin rgyu red snyam/ chos spong gi las ngan pa gsog mi rung / sgye bu dam pa 'ga' res dgos pa'i dbang gi rang gi grub mtha' 'di bzang / gzhan rnam dag ma yin zhes gsungs pa dgongs gzhi che/ 'e tsho'i dgos pa mchod cig med bzhin lad mo byed mi rung / sangs rgyas rol ba bsam mi khyab/ /dam pa'i chos kyang bsam mi khyab/ /ma gsungs sam/ blo 411

gros can gyis rang gi gzhung dang mi mthun yang / de 'dra'i chos kyang yod/ de la khas gtong mi rung snyam du dad gus dang / nam zhig de'i don go bar smon lam thob dang bzang /dper na ri chen po zhig gi rtse la 'gro ba phyogs phyogs na lam che chung mang po yod pa/ sngar skya ser pho mo brgyad khri bzhi stong song / da dung de bzhin mi mang 'gro gi yod pa'i lam gang la yang / 'di lam min zer tshul med pa ltar/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa'i sa ru 'gro ba la/ dbu rdzogs phyag gsum sogs kyi dam pa'i chos kyi lam rab 'bring mang bo yod pa/sngar rgya bod kyi mkhas grub pho mo bye ba phrag brgya gshegs/da dung yang skal bzang gi gdul bya mang po rgyun mi 'chad du 'gro ba'i ma nor lam bzang gang la yang lam log yin sus zer/dper na lam de rnams kyi che chung nye ring /de ru 'gro mkhan gye mi rnams kyang / skya mi rkang thang mi gcig kyang / kun ri rtse la snga phyi byas thon 'gro ba bzhin/ dam pa'i chos kyi lam rnams kyi rgya che chung / nye ring nyams su len pa'i gang zag chags ldan/chags bral mtha' gcig tu ma nges kyang thams cad kyi skye ba re'am/ skye ba bzang bo brgyud nas thams cad mkhyen pa'i go 'phang thob par 'gyur bas/ lam thams cad rnam dag yin te/412

bla ma zhang rin po ches/ rang rang lam la mngon zhen pas/ /phan tshun lam la smad mi bya/ /gang nas zhugs kyang 'dod sar slebs/ /e ma ngo mtshar dru/ da kyi chos/ /zhes dang / rje skal ldan rgya mtshos/ mchog sa ngas rgyas thob pa'i thabs dam pa/ /sa dge ldan gsar rnying kun la yod/ /gzhan ma smod kun la dag snang sbyongs/ /gsungs/ dpal gsang ba'i bdag po'i zhal nas/ lhag mthong gi myong ba thon pa'i thabs khyad par can/ gsang sngags kyi gdams pa thun mong min pa/ sbyor drug dang rdzogs chen yin/ zhes dang /lta ba'i phyogs la klu sgrub dang zla grags kyi bkral ba 'di yang 'khrul med gsungs/ 'o na yang jo bo rje'i zhal nas/ dang po'i sangs rgyas rgyud chen las/ /rab tu 'bad pas / bkag pa'i phyir/ /gsang ba shes rab dbang bskur bya/ /cha ngas par spyad pa'i blangs mi bya/ /gal te dbang bskur de 'dzin na/ /tshangs spyod dka' thub la gnas pas/ /bkag pa za sgrod par 'gyur ba'i phyir/ /dka' thub sdom pa de nyams te/ /brtul zhugs can de pham pa yi/ /ltung ba dag ni 'byung 'gyung zhing / /de ni ngan song de ltung bas/ /grub pa nam yang yi da ma yin/ /gsungs/ zhang g.yu brag 'gro mgon gyi zhal nab // gsang mchog bla na med pa yi/ /413

dkyil 'khor cho ga thams cad las/ /dang po so sor thar ba dang / /theg chen sdom pa gnyis byin pas/ /de ma thag tu bum pa'i dbang / /de rjes gsang ba'i dbang bskur nas/ /yol ba sogs kyis dben byas te/ /las kyi phyag rgya der gtad nas/ /thabs kyi gdong ni g.yog pa dang / /shes rab 'dod kyang g.yog byas la/ /bo la ka ko la sbyar nas/ /gsum pa nyams su myong byas la/ /gong gi dka' thub sdom pa de/ /ma nyams steng du slar 'phel ba/ /mchog thob rnams la myong bas grub/ /gsungs/ 'di gnyis kyi gnad bkag kyang mi gcig pa ci yin zer na/ mnyam med jo bo chen pos/ dang po'i sangs rgyas rgyud chen gyis/ lung khungs su drangs nas/ dbang gsum pa shes rab ye shes kyi dbang bskur/so thar sdom ldan la bskur mi rung sdom pa nyams nas dmyal bar 'gro gsungs pa de/ spyir snyigs dus 'dir sngags kyi chos seṅge dkar mo'i 'o ma lta bu blugs pa'i snod gdul bya skal bzang dbang bo yang rab rin chen gser snod lta bu dkon zhing / gang zag dbang bo rtul bo rdza snod bzhin mang bas/ gang zag dbang bo rtul bo nyon mongs rags pa'i steng du bla ma ngan pas/ lam thun mong ba'i rgyud kyang ma sbyangs/ 'phrad ma thag nas gsang dbang bsgur na/414

khwa tar dug byen na/ lus zung bskyed pa phar zhog skyag pa yan chad shor nas 'chi ba ‘bzhin/ sngags lam gyi grogs su gyur nas lam nyams su lopho pa phar zhog sngar gye sdom pa yan chad shor nas dmyal bar 'gro ba snying rje nas/ de rnams la phan pa dang / yang cha gcig na/ bstan zhabs 'dul bas 'dzin dgos pas/ 'dul 'dzin mang na bstan pa mi nub bar yun ring gnas pa sogs nga/stan 'gro la phan pa'i dgongs gzhi mang po yod nas/ de skad gsungs pa ma gtogs/ gsang dbang bskur tshad thams cad kyi sdom pa shor nas dmyal bar 'gro zhes gsungs pa ma yin pa'i dgongs pa lon dgos/ de ltar dgongs pa ma lon na/ sdom gsum ldan pas gsang sngags nyams su lon zhes mkhas grub tshad ldan du mas gsungs pa thams cad dang 'gal zhing / 'brom rin po ches/ 'dul ba sngags gnyis gcig grogs su gcig song ba nga'i bla ma'i bka' brgyud min pa med gsungs pa dang / bstan pa thams cad gru bzhi lam gyes 'khyer shes pa nga'i bla ma zhes jo bo rje la bsngags brjod mang po gnang pa la 'a/nga don 'bras ma byung bas/bstan pa thams cad nar mo lam du 'khyer shes pa nga'i bla ma zhes zer dgos par 'gyur ba'i phyir ro/ /yang bla ma zhang rin 415

po ches/ gsang sngags kyi cho ga mang po lung khungs su drangs nas/ gsang dbang bskur na/ sdom pa nyams pa phar zhogagong 'phel du 'gyur zhes gsungs pa de/ sngags kyi gdul bya dbang bo yang rab gser snod lta bu la mtshan ldan bla mas lam thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa'i rgyud sbyangs/ sngags kyi dbang bzhi bsgur ba'i snod rung byas/ da nges par dbang bskur na/ 'dod yon nyon mongs pa'i grogs su 'gro ba phar zhog nges par gsang sngags kyi bskyed rdzogs kyi lam gyi grogs su gyur nas/ mchog gi dngos grub tshe 'dir thob gi snyam pa'i gang zag re gnyis la shin tu gsang ba'i tshul du gsang ba shes rab ye shes kyi dbang dngos su bskur na/ rma bya la dug byin na lus la gnod pa phar zhog sngar bas sgo mdongs legs pa ltar/ sdom pa 'chor ba phar zhog yar ldan du 'gyur ba la dgongs nas de skad gsungs pa ma gtogs/ spyir so thar gyi sdom ldan thams cad la bud med sngo mchu re gtod la/mtshan ma gnyis legs par sprod dang / sdom pa mi 'chor ba'i steng du gong 'phel du 'gyur zhes gsungs pa ma yin pa'i dgongs pa lon dgos/ spyir kun la dngos dbang bskur gtan nas mi chog par ma zad/ dbang 'og ma gnyis kyang bskur mi chog pa 416

mang / gal te dbang bzhi bskur yang las rgya'i gzugs brnyan shog gu tshor bris pa lta bu la bltas/ yid kyis ye shes kyi phyag rgya tshor mos pa tsam re ma gtogs ga la rung / de ltar dgongs pa ma lon na/ mdo rgyud du ma dang 'gal zhing / rta bong yan chad kyi sngags kyi sdom pa yar ldan du gtong zhes khas len dgos pa'i phyir ro/ /de ltar dgongs pa lon na khong rnam gnyis ga'i gsung de/ don gyi mi 'gal ba tsam du ma zad/bstan 'gro la dngos sam /brgyud nas phan pa'i dgos pa chen po yod/ sngags kyi rten du so thar gyi sdom pa dgos pa'i tshul ni/ dgyes rdor las/ dang po bsnyen gnas sdom pa phog /de rjes bslab pa'i gnas bcu sbyin/ /de rjes bye brag smra ba bstan/ /mdo sde pa yang de bzhin no/ /de rjes dbu ma bstan par bya/ /rgyud kun gzhung ni shes byas la/ /de rjes dgyes pa rdo rje bslab/ /ces dang / rgyud rdo rje'i phreng ba las/ nang du 'dus pa la rab dga'/ /phyi rol nyan thos kyi spyod pa/ /de lta'i man ngag rim pa yis/ /slob ma rnams la rjes su bslab/ /ces dang / gab nga ba ye shes las/ phyi ltar lag len 'dul ba'i lugs su spyod/ /rgyu 'bras spang blang zhib pa'i dgos pa yod/ /nang ltar gsang sngags thun mong lugs su 417

spyod/ /bskyed rdzogs don dang 'brel ba'i dgos pa yod/ /gsang ba gsang chen a ti'i lugs su spyod/ /tshe gcig 'od sgur grol ba'i dgos pa yod/ /ces gsungs so/ /'o na yang /dgyes rdor rgyud las/ dbang bo gnyis ni mnyam sbyar bas/ /sangs rgyas byang chub thob par 'gyur/ /zhes dang / gsang rgyud las/ma dang bu mo sring mo la/ /(ma ni rang gi gsang dbang mnos pa/ bu mo ni rang dbang bskur ba/ sring mo ni rang dang dbang dus mnyam du thob pa la zer)'dod pa'i sems kyis spyad byas na/ /pad+ma rigs kyi zhing du sgye/ /zhes dang / yang kye rdo rje las/ shin tu bzhin bzang mig yangs ma/ /rang gis dbang bskur snying rje can/ /rdo rje'i bu mo 'di khyer nas/ /spyod pa bya ba rtogs par gyis/ /zhes dang / gsang ba 'dus pa'i rgyud phyi ma las/ bsgrubs byas bsgrub par yang dag sbyor/ /gang yin de ni bsnyen par bshad/ /rdo rje pad+ma mnyam sbyor ba/ /nye bar bsgrub pa zhes bshad do/ /yi ge hūṃ dang phaṭa ldan pa/ /bskyod pa bsgrub pa zhes bshad pa/ /ngo bo nyid bde zhi bde ba/ /sgrub pa chen po zhes bshad do/ /zhes dang / gsang 'dus kyi dam tshig chen po'i le'u las/ 'dod pa'i longs spyod thams cad la/ /ji ltar 'dod par bsten na ni/ /'di lta bu yi sbyor ba yis/ /418

sangs rgyas myur du thob pa ja 'gyur/ /zhes dang / nyi zla sgrib pa las/ /mtshan nyid ldan ba'i bu mo la/ /skyabs 'gro dbang bskur snod du byas/ /gduthugs sgras chags pa rgyas par bya/ /spyod des dngas ma g.yo ba do bya/ /zhes dang / mdo las/ thabs chen rnams dang ldan pa la/ /nyon mongs byang chub yan lag 'gyur/ /zhes dang / ḍa dul ba don yod par grub pa'i rgyud las/ gang gi blun po 'chi ri gyur pa/ /de yi mkhas pa yongs su grol/ /zhes dang / dpal don dam pa'i bsnyen pa las/ 'dod chags gang zhig gis ni sems can lhung gyur pa/ /de nyid kyis ni rnal 'byor srid pa'i pha rol bgrod/ /ces dang / snyan rgyud las/ chags pas las rgya/ 7 mang du sbyar/ /bde chen ro mnyam dag tu bya/ /zhes dang / dus 'khor rtsa rgyud las/ bcu drug lo lon lus can ma/ /gzugs dang lang tshos brgyan pa la/ /dang po byin gyes brlabs byas nas/ /dbang bskur bsgrub pa nas brtsams te/ /bud med spyod pa de rnams kyi/ /rnal 'byor pa yi bya ba yi/ /tshangs par spyo da pa la gnas nas/ /bud med la bsrung spyod pa ste/ /zhes nga) nga / phyag rgya chen po'i yan lag bsgom/ /'gyur med bde gu bsgrubs nas ni/ /tshe 'di nyid la sangs rgyas 'gyur/ /zhes dang / chags bral las ni sdig 419
