gzhan med/ /de las bsod nams gzhan pa med/ /de bas rtag par mi 'gyur bde/ /sems ni dbugs bya mi dbang kye/ /zhes dang / mi 'gyur ba las thams cad mkhyen/ /skye ba ma rig the tshom za/ /yid la bden min de lta'ang / /chags bral bar ni mi bya'o/ /'pho ba las ni chags bral 'gyur/ /chags gral las ni sdug bsngal 'byung / /sdug bsngal las ni skyes bu'i khams/ /zad las 'chi ba zhes su brjod/ /shi las de nas slar yang srid/ /srid pa las ni slar 'chi 'pho/ /zhes dang / 'og min gyis ni mthar thug pa/ /gzugs khams ye shes phyag rgya'o/ /zhes dang / yid 'ong lha mo rab bsam te/ /de la kun tu snyoms 'jug bya/ /nges par bde chen rgyas par 'gyur/ /zhes dang / rnal 'byor bla med rgyud chen las/ srog chags bsad par mi bya zhing / /slob dpon smad par mi bya ste/ /bud med sangs rgyas spangs mi bya/ /zhes dang / shes rab ye shes sbyor ba ni/ /lha mo gzhan dang kun sbyor ba/ /'dod la chags par gyur pa dang / /bud med dbang phyug shin tu sbyor/ /zhes dang / tshe ring mched lngas/ bka' rgyud sde bla na med pa nas/ /lha dang klu dang gnod sbyin gyi/ /bu mo 'gugs zhes gsungs pas na/ /bsnyen bkur rnams kyi nang nas kyang / /phyag rgya ya 420

mtshan che'o gsungs/ /zhes smras pa'i lan du/ /rje btsun mi la'i zhal nas/ nga nā ro paṇa chen rgyud pa 'di/ /lam rtsa dang rlung la rang dbang thob/ /mchod pa rnams kyi nang nas kyang / /phyag rgya mtshan ldan 'bul ba 'di/ /khyad par 'phags pa'i 'bul ba yin/ /gsungs nas bzhes/ slob dpon klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa'i rim lnga las/ sgyu ma dag ni thams cad las/ /bud med sgyu ma khyad par 'phags/ /ye shes gsum gyi dbye ba yis/ /gsal ba de la mtshon pa'o/ /zhes dang / te lo pas/ phyag rgya la brten bde stong ngang gis rachar/ /tshe ring mgyogs la skyon rnams mtha' dag sel/ /skra dkar med kyang rang lus zla ltar rgyas/ /mdangs gsal sto bas 'phel ci 'dod las la sbyor/ /zhes dang / lho brag mar pas/ gzhan lus lam du slong tsa na/ /las kyi phyag rgya'i gdams ngag yod/ /phyag rgya mi brten rang la sdig /ces dang / bram ze chen po sa rā has/ mda' mkhan gye bu mo phyag rgyar bzhes nas/ de snga phan chad dge slong min/ /de ring dus nas dge slong ste/ /tshangs par spyod na dge slong yin/ /he ru ka dpal dge slong mchog /de bas de ni brten par bya/ /zhes dang / 'khor lo bde mchog las/rtag tu tshangs par spyod gyu ra nas/ /rkang ba brgyad pa'i sngags 421

kyis mchod/ /'jigs pa thams cad rnam spangs ste/ /de ltar rnal 'byor bdag nyid bsam/ /zhes dang / rnal 'byor bla med rgyud las/ bcu drug lo lon shes rab ma/ /lag pa gnyis kyis yang dag 'khyud/ /rdo rje dril bu mnyam sbyor ba/ /slob dpon gyi ni dbang du bshad/ /ces dang / bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku dang gsung dang thugs rdo rje btsun mo'i bha ga la bzhugs so/ /zhes dang / e yi cha byad bzang po gang / /dbus su baṃ gyis rnam par brgyan/ /sangs rgyas rin chen za ma tog /bde ba can na rtag tu bzhugs/ /zhes dang / dpal sgyu 'phrul chen po'i rgyud las/kye grogs po dag rdo rje dang pad+ma kha 'byed par mdzad pa a la la hoḥ zhes dang / rgyud gzhan las kyang / thabs gzhan gyes ni sangs mi rgya/ /zhes sogs gsungs nas/ rmongs pa gang zhig 'di spongs pa/ /de la mchog gi dngos grub med/ /ces gsungs/ bde mchog rtsa rgyud las/ khyad par du ni sgrub pa po/ /rang gi mgo pang par bzhag la/ /dpa' bo gnyis med rab tu mchod/ /ma'am yang na srid mo'am/ /bu mo yang na chung mar ni/ /rnam pa 'di lta'i cho ga yis/ /bcings pa las ni rab grol bya/ /de nas sngags ni 'grub gyur te/ /ji srid 'byung ba 422

yod du'o/ /zhes dang / reg 'dzin zil gnod drag rtsal gyis/mdzes sdug lang tsho'i khur 'dzin bzhin ras ngom/ /mnyen lcug sor mo'i 'khri shing zlos gar bsgyur/ /gnag snum skra yi lan bu sil bur grol/ /zlum rgyas / nu 'bur mtho zhing sked skabs phra/ /bde chen khong nas rgod pa'e bzhin 'gyur zhing / /zam bu'i zur mig pho nyas gzhan yi da 'gugs/ /byang sems rngul chu'i rgyun 'bab chu skyes kyis/ /rab mdzes smad kyi kho lag yangs shing rgyas/ /dhu ti'i mar sna phye ba'i sid sgra sgog /'degs 'jog 'gyur khug spom phra'i dbyangs snyan ldan/ /dri zhim lus dang kha yi ngad pa 'thul/ /ma mchus sbrang rtsi mngar po ci yang ster/ /reg pas lhag par myos pa'i dga' chen 'dren/ /bde chen do lis bskyod pa bu mos bzung / /brla bcings rkang sbyor sa mnan mnyam du bcingab// /'phrul 'khor zhon pa bung dra rkang ba can/ /rus sbal kun tu bzang bos bcings pa dang / /ri mo can sogs 'khrig pas ‘redod yon gyi/ /sbyor thabs 'o 'khyud so dang sen mo 'debs/ /mnyam sbyor bsrub dang 'degs 'jog sgyu rtsal gyi/ /yon tan drug cu bzhi la lhag par mkhas/ /pad+ma glang bo ri dwags dung can ma/ /zhing sngags lhan skyes phyag rgya'i pho nya mo/ /zhes dang / pad+ma can sogs yid 'phrog lha mo'i 423

gzugs/ /sked phra nu 'bur bha sa mngon par rgyas/ /dbang bo drug la dga' ba'i bde ster ma/ /zhes dang / snyan ngag me long gi dka' 'grel las/ u dum wā ra 'dzum pa'i zhal/ /tshems phreng ze'u 'bru rgod pa can/ /ha ri tsan dan dri bro ba'i/ /dga' ma mthong bas 'dod 'phel 'gyur/ /zhes dang / snyim pa'i rmad byung reg bya can/ /'dod pas myos pa'i yid can gyi/ /lus la reg pa'i bde ba yis/ /sngon med snying gi bdud rtsir byas/ /zhes dang / rje rin po che'i mtha' gcod myu gu las/de yang phyi nang gi gzugs kyi skye mched thams cad yongs su gyur pa las/ gzugs rdo rje ma lag pa pad+ma 'jam bos me long bzung nas/ zhi ba'i mig gis blta zhing / mu tig gi chun po 'chang ba/ nu ma rgyas shing 'bur la bar dog pa/ gos cung zad grol zhing / ro smad mdzes par ston par bsam nas de'i gzugs la rgyun du bltas pas/ bde ba chen po 'byung bar bsam/ de bzhin du sgra rnams sgra rdo rje ma glu snyan pa len zhing pi wang gi sgra sgrogs par bskyed pa dang / dri rnams dri rdo rje ma gar byed cing / nor bu'i snod du gur gum dang / a ka ru dang / tsan dan sbrul gyi snying bo dang / ga bur la sogs pa'i dris bkang ba phyogs bcur dri bzang bos khyab par bskyed pa 424

dang / ro rnams ro rdo rje ma gser dngul la sogs pa'i rin po che sna tshogs pas bkang nga/ dang / lha'i bdud rtsis bkang ba bzung bar bskyed pa dang / reg bya rnams reg bya rdo rje ma mtshan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ khro gnyer gsum gyis mdzes pa/ sked pa shin tu phra ba/ lte ba yangs shing g.yas su 'khyil ba/ro smad dang 'dom stug pa/ 'gros dal zhing sgeg pa/ thams cad kyi bzhin 'dzum zhing / chags pa'i mig gis blta bar bskyed nas/ sgra dri ro la 'o/ngas spyod pa dang / phan tshun 'khyud de reg bya la longs spyod pas/ bde ba chen po rgyas par bsam mo/ /zhes gsungs/ yang mdo las/ dper na bco lnga'i zla shar la/ /sprin gyis g.yogs par gyur pa na/ /'od stong 'jig rten mi mthong ltar/ /skye ma bu dge ba'i zla ba la/ /bud med lho sprin de bzhin no/ /zhes dang / dper na til 'bras sā lu yi/ /lo tog phun sum tshogs pa la/ /rdo yi ser ba babs gyur na/ /'bras bu blang du med pa ltar/ /sgyes bu dge ba'i lo tog la/ /bud med ser ba de bzhin no/ /zhes dang / bltas shing gtams kyang phongs gyur na/ /de nyid brten pa smos ci dgos/ /yud tsam bde ‘pa chags pa ni/ /'bar ba'i khri la chags pa'o/ /zhes dang / dran pa nyer bzhag las/ legs pa 425

brgya ni chud gzan pa/ /ma legs gcig pu dran par byed/ /sdig pa'i sa gzhi bud med yin/ /snying ni glog gi ngo bo bzhin/ /skye ba chags pa'i sems yod pa/ /'jigs pa'i rgyu ni bud med byed/ /'jig rten 'di dang pha rol tu/ /'jigs byed nang nas bud med 'jigs/ /gal te bde ba mchog 'dod na/ /de ltar bud med rnam par spong / /bud med rtag tu spangs pa ni/ /'jig rten 'di dang pha rol bde/ /gang zhig dbul ba spong 'dod kyang / gang zhig bdag ni 'byor 'dod dang / /gang zhig mya ngan 'da' 'dod pa/ /mi des bud med spangs bar bya/ /zhes dang / mdo rgya cher rol pa las/ 'dod pa sdug bsngal mang po bsags shing sdug bsngal rtsa ba ste/ /mi mkhas rnams la bsam gtan dzu 'phrul dka' thub nyams par byed/ /bud med 'dod pa'i yon tan chog pa med ces mkhas pas smras/ /zhes dang / mi gang 'dod pa'i bud med rnams kyi khol bor gyur pa dang / /gang zhig chos kyi dga' ba bor de 'dod pa'i dga' byed cing / /dga' la bsgom pa de ni tshul khrims lam las gol 'gyur zhing / /bsam gtan lam gol blo nyams ye shes las ni rab ring gnas/ /zhes dang / zla ba sgon me'i mdo las/ 'jigs pa chen po'i zhags pa ni/ /bud med 426

zhags pa mi zad pas/ /sangs rgyas rnams kyi 'dod pa dang / /bud med brten pa yongs ri/ bsngags/ /lam 'dis byang chub mi 'gyur bas/ /bud med rnams la mi brten par/ /sbrul gdug shin tu khro ba ltar/ /mkhas pas de ni rnam par spangs/ /zhes dang / dpung bzang gi rgyud las/ 'dzum zhing 'gro la smra zhing mig zur can/ /yan 'a/ga thams cad mig 'phrog byed pa'i gzugs/ /bud med gzug sa kyi mtshon cha 'jebs 'dra bas/ /skye bo'i sems dag mngon du 'phrog par byed/ /lcags kyi thong lcags rab tu 'bar ba yis/ /mig ni rnam par bkab pa btsags sla yi/ /des na dran pa nyams pas bud med kyi/ /dkyus ring mig can bzhin ni ma mthong sla/ /zhes dang / skyes rabs su/ e ma ho/ 'di meng 'di ltar btags pa ni/ don dang rjes su mthun zhing tshig kyang mnyan/ /'dzum pa'i mdangs dkar myos byed ma zhes pas/ /bdag gi sems kyang myos pa bzhin du byed/ /de ni brjed par bdag 'dod na/ /sems kyi mthong ba bzhin du gyur/ /bdag gi sems ni de la gnas/ /sems de de yi da‘nang du gyur/ /ces dang / bu mo zla ba mchog gi zhus pa'i mdo 'a/sa/ gang dag gzhan gyi chung ma mthong gyur na/ /ma dang sring mo'i 'du shes bskyed byed pa/ /de 427

dag mjes shing blta na sdug pa dang / /sdug pa mchog tu yid du 'ong bar 'gyur/ /zhes dang / dran pa nyer bzhag las/ ri mo bris pa'i bud med la'ang / /mig gis blta bar mi byed de/ /'jig rten 'dod pa dam bcos pa/ /de lta bu ni grol zhes bya/ /zhes dang / rje mi las/ lus la dmar smug gi nang rul ma/ /yid la khyo 'dod kyi gzhung ngan ma/ /lar 'phung gi rtsa ba bud med yin/ /gsungs/ kha rag sgom chung pas/ zhen chags bral ba'i dam pa la/ /las kyi phyag rgya'i dogs pa med/ /zhen chags sems dang 'dres pa yis/ /phyag rgyas ngan 'gror 'khrid do ang / /zhes dang / dang po'i sangs rgyas rgyud las/ las kyi phyag rgya rnam par spangs/ /zhes dang / dus 'khor rtsa rgyud las/ las kyi phyag rgya yongs dor zhing / /btags pas ye shes phyag rgya spangs/ /mchog tu mi 'gyur sbyor ba yis/ /phyag rgya chen po rnam bsgom bya/ /zhes dang / he ru ka mngon byung las/rnal 'byor med pa rnal 'byor chos/ /phyag rgya las ni bgrod gyur dang / /ye shes med pa ye shes tshul/ /dmyal bar 'gro bar the tshom med/ /ces dang / slob springs las/ bud med yan lag dri ngan rul ba mi sdug dang / /pad+ma zla ba ut+pal dag tu snyoms byed pa/ /snyan ngag mkhan gyi rdzun de'i 'bras bu mi 428

zad pa/ /de dag de yi mngal nas 'jug pa de yin no/ /zhes dang / slob dpon klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa'i rin chen phreng ba las/ bud med chags pa phal cher ni/ /bud med gzugs gtsang sems las byung / /bud med gzugs la don du ni/ /gtsang ba cung zad yod ma yin/ /kha ni kha mchu rul ba dang / /mi gtsang so skyag snod yin te/ /sna ni rnag 'dra'i snabs kyi snod/ /mig ni mig rdul ma chi ma'i snod/ /lto ba'i khung ni gshang gci dang / /glo ba mchin pa'i snod yin par/ /rmongs pas bud med ma mthong ba/ /de yi lus la chags par byed/ /mi shes gang zhig mi gtsang ba'i/ /bum pa'i rgyan la chags pa ltar/ /'jig rten mi shes rmongs pa yis/ /bud med rnams la de bzhin no/ /zhes dang / bud med la ni lto sprad de/ /mi gtsang phung bo de'i brlan gyis/ /brlan par gyur pas pags pa yis/ /g.yogs pa dang ni nyal bar zad/ /gzugs bzang ba dang gzugs ngan dang / /rgan rnams yang na gzhon yang rung / /bud med gzugs kun mi gtsang na/ /khyod chags khyad par ga la skyed/ /gal te mi gtsang kha dog bzang / /shin tu gsar la dbyibs legs kyang / /de la chags par mi 'os ltar/ /bud med gzugs /pa yang de bzhin/ /zhes dang / gang 429

dag mi gtsang lus 'di la/ /sgeg chos snyan ngag byed pa gang / /e ma gzu lums e ma'o blun/ /e ma'o skye bos khrel du rung / /mi shes mun pas bsgribs pa yi/ /sems can 'di ni phal cher yang / /'dod pa'i don du rtsod 'byung ba/ /mi gtsang don du khyi rnams bzhin/ /g.yan pa phrugs na bde 'gyur ba/ /de bas g.yan pa med na bde/ /de bzhin 'jig rten 'dod ldan bde/ /'dod pa med na de bas bde/ /zhes dang / slob dpon bai ro tsā na'i zhal nas/ bud med bya ba btsan dug ha la yin/ /sems can gang gis zos kyang 'chi bar 'gyur/ /bud med bya ba las kyi srin mo yin/ /sems can gang gis 'dod kyang la 'ur 'chi/ /bud med bya ba dmyal ba'i 'dam rdzab yin/ /sems can gang gis 'khor ba'i 'dam la 'dzin/ /bud med bya ba 'khor ba'i btson ra yin/ /gang gis 'bags kyang thar ba 'thob mi srid/ /bud med bya ba bdud kyi mya ngan yin/ /gang gis 'brel kyang sdug bsngal tshad med myong / /gsungs/ gsang bdag gi zhal nas/ lam gye bogs 'don pa'i phyag rgya ma gser bas dkon/ bud med ngan ma mos gus byi pho la byed/ dag snang snying sdug la byed/ tshogs bsags byi pho la 'bul/ zhen log lha chos la byed/ nyan na khye la spyod/430

dad pa kha nas skye/ ldog na snying nas ldog ser sna dang mig ser che/ yar 'gro'i las mi gsog par/ mar 'dren pa'i lcags gyu byed/ chos 'phel ba'i bogs 'don mi yongs par chags sdang dang sdug bsnga/pa gyi sna sun byed/chags pa'i grol du re nas bsten par gda' ste/ nyon mongs 'phel ba'i rgyur song /khams rgyas pa'i yong du re tsa na/ nyams grib gyi thum por khyer yong / dam tshig mi ba srung bud med 'chol ma bdud mo yin gsungs/ po to ba'i zha'/ nas/ bud med 'di ni bdag gi chos dang mthun pa'i yid pham par byed pa'i dgra'o/ /thar ba'i srog rtsa gcod pa'i gshed ma'o/ /dkar bo'i lo tog 'joms par byed pa'i ser ba'o/ /phun sum tshogs pa thams cad 'phrog par byed pa'i chom rkun ma'o/ /dge ba'i rtsa ba thams cad kyi bar du gco da par byed pa'i bdud mo'o/ /'khor ba'i sdug bsngal las thar du mi ster ba'i btson bsrung ma'o/ /nyon mongs pa mtha' dag kun nas slong bar byed pa'i dkrug ma'o/ /sdug bsngal thams cad kyi 'byung gnas su gyur pa'i dmyal ba'i me khang lta bu'o/ /snyam du bsams pas chags pa zlog par nges so/ /gaṭa/ngas/ gnang bkag mi 'dra ba 'di ci yin zer na/ de dpe ra na dge bskos shig gis/ dge 431

'dun pa stong phrag mang po 'tshogs pa la spyir tshogs gtam gtong dus khyed thams cad kyang nyin re bzhin tshogs la 'ong dgos/ gcig kyang yul nas bsdad mi chog gzhan du 'gro sa gcig med/ chang 'thung ba sogs chos min gyi bya ba byas mi chog ces 'tshogs gtam 'jigs pa btang kyang / dgon pa'i sku don chen po sgrub mkhan dang / rgan pa tshogs su 'gro mi nus pa dang / na nas nad de la phan pa'i sman chang bsten dgos pa byung ba sogs la gnang ba yod pa de bzhin du/sngags nas gnang ba phal cher/ 'dul ba nas bkag pa de spyir 'dul ba bsrung ba las lhag gi gzhan phan gye dgos pa chen po med pa dang / bde stong dbyer med kyi rdzogs rim gyi rtogs pa mthon po la slebs pa'i gdul bya shes che bas/ de 'dra'i gang zag gi dbang du mdzad nas bkag cing / de la sngags nas kyang ma gnang / gzhan phan gyi dgos pa chen po dang / rdzogs rim gyi rtogs pa mthon por slebs pa'i gang zag bye brag pa rnams sngags nas gnang zhing / 'dod yon la spyad na nyes pa med pa ni 'dul ba'i yang dgongs pa yin pas 'gal ba med de/ sngon bcom ldan 'das bram ze'i khye'u skar mar 'khrungs ba'i tshe lo bzhi khri bzhi stong du tshangs par spyad 432

nas bzhugs pa'i tshe/ bu mo zhig chags pa'i dbang gis srog 'chad du nye bar gzigs nas snying rje chen po 'khrungs te/de'i khyem du lo bcu gnyis gnas nas/ yang khyem nas byung ste tshangs par spyad pas/ bskal pa khri'i 'khor ba bsnyil te tshogs rdzogs par gsungs/ sngon sangs rgyas kyi rdzogs rim gye rtogs pa mthon por slebs nas yum thig le mchog ma zhes bya ba zhig la brten nas rdzogs rim gye rtogs pa mngon du byas skad/ rje rin po che la yang gsang ‘bdag gi lung bstan las/ dbyangs can ma ni las rgya ste/ /nge sa pa kho nar byang chub bo/ /gsungs/de ltar gnang bkag gis mtshams shes na/ 'dul ba dang sngags gnyis 'gal ba med par ma zad gcig grogs su gcig 'gro/ 'dul ba sngags kyi grogs su 'gro ste/ dpung bzang gis zhus pa las/ sngags kyi rtsa ba dang po tshul khrims te/ /tshul khrims med na sngags ni mi 'grub te/ /zhes gsungs/ 'jam dpal rtsa brgyud las/ tshupa khrims 'chal la thub dbang gis/ /sngags rnams 'grub par ma gsungs te/ /mya ngan 'das grong 'gro ba yi/ /yul dang phyogs kyang ma yin no/ /zhes gsungs/sngags kyi rten de dge slong mchog yin te/ /dus 'khor las/gsum las dge slong mchog yin 'bring / /dge tshul zhes bya de 433

dag las/ /khyem na gnas pa tha ma'o/ /zhes gsungs/sngags 'dul ba'i grogs su 'gro ste/ sngags la ma zhugs pa'i dge slong gis phyi dro'i kha zas zos na/ ltung byed tsam las min kyang / sngags la zhugs pa'i dge slong zhig yin na/ de'i steng du bde gshegs bka' 'das kyi rtsa ltung 'byung ste/ rtsa ltung bcu bzhi ba las/ bde gshegs bka' las 'das pa na/ /ltung pa gnyis pa yin par bshad/ /ces gsungs/ sngags kyi sgor zhugs pas sngar bas lhag par tshul khrims mig 'bras bzhin bsrung dgos/ de la dgongs nas/ dge bshes ston pa'i zhal nas/ kha cig gis 'dul ba'i phyogs bzung nas sngags la mi gus/ tshan gcig gis sngags kyi phyogs bzung nas 'dul ba la theg dman zhes skur ba 'debs/ de gnyis gcig grogs su gcig song ba nga'i bla ma'i bka' rgyud min pa med gsungs/ rje rin po che'i zhal nas/ theg pa gong 'og dang /mdo sngags gnyis la gnang bkag mi 'dra ba mang du yod pa dang / de rnams gang zag gcig gis nyams su len pa gnyis gsung rab kyi dgongs pa 'tshol ba la blo'i mthu med pas rmongs pa la 'gal yang / mkhas pa la mi 'gal ba'ang shes rab kyi byed pa yin no/ /de ltar shes rab med pa la 'gal ba 434

shes rab can la mi 'gal ba mtha' yas/ zhes gsungs pa ltar blo gros can gyis gnang bkag mi mthun pa rnams kyang gang zag gi blo kha'i mtho dman/ dgos pa'i che chung / gnang bkag gi so 'tshams sogs la mkhas na/ bstan pa thams cad nang phan tshun 'gal ba phar zhog gcig grogs su gcig 'gro ba sha stag yin pas smod mi rung ste/ bla ma zhang rin po ches/ de phyir chags lam gang sgod de/ /grub pa'i bka' las smad pas sdig /mi zad khur nas ltung nyen che'o/ /gzob shig smos shig skyes bu kun/ /chags lam dag gi kha 'dzin phyir/ /chags bral grol lam gang smod rnams/ /de yi sdig kyang de bzhin no/ /de phyir phan tshun ma smod mdzod/ /gsungs/ lam rim chen mo las/ yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas ni skyon phyogs re zad pa dang / yon tan phyogs re rdzogs pa min gyi/skyon gyi rigs thams cad zad cing / yon tan gyi rigs mtha' dag rdzogs pa yin la/de bsgrub pa'i theg pa chen pos yang skyon mtha' dag 'gog cing / yon tan mtha' dag bskyed pas na/theg pa gzhan thams cad kye spangs rtogs kyi yon tan gyi rigs thams cad theg pa chen po'i lam du 'du ba yin no/ /de'i phyir sangs rgyas bsgrub pa'i theg pa chen po'i lam gye yan 435

lag tu gsung rab thams cad 'du ste/ skyon sna re zad pa'am yon tan sna re bskyed pa min pa'i thub pa'i gsung med pa'i phyir dang / de thams cad theg pa chen pos mi bsgrub pa med pa'i phyir ro/ /gal te pha rol tu phyin pa'i theg pa chen por 'jug pa la theg dman gyi sde snod nas bshad pa'i lam rnams dgos na'ang / rdo rje theg par 'jug pa la ni phar phyin gyi theg pa'i lam rnams/ thun mong par mi 'gyur te lam mi mthun pa'i phyir ro zhe na/ 'di yang ches mi rigs te pha rol tu phyin pa'i lam gyi ngo bo ni/ bsam pa byang chub tu sems bsgyed pa dang / spyod pa pha rol tu phyin pa drug la slob par 'du ba yin la/ de ni rnam pa thams cad du bsten dgos par dpal rdo rje rtse mo las/ ji skad du/ 'tsho ba'i srog gi phyir yang ni/ /byang chub sems ni dor mi bya/ /zhes dang / pha rol phyin drug spyod pa ni/ /nam yang dor bar mi bya'o/ /zhes gsungs shing /gzhan yang sngags kyi gzhung du mar gsungs so/ /rnal 'byor bla na med pa'i dkyil 'khor du 'jug pa'i skabs du mar yang thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa'i sdom pa gnyis gnyis bzung dgos par gsungs la/ snga ma ni byang chub sems dpa'i sdom pa nyid yin zhing / sdom pa bzung ba ni/ tshul khrims 436

gsum la sogs pa'i byang chub sems dpa' bslab pa la slob par khas blangs pa yin pas sems bskyed nas bslab pa la slob par khas blangs pa bzhin du slob pa las gzhan pa'i lam pha rol tu phyin pa'i theg pa la'ang med pa'i phyir dang / rdo rje mkha' 'gro dang saspu ṭa dang / rdo rje rtse mo rnams su/ phyi dang gsang ba theg pa gsum/ /dam pa'i chos ni ma lus bzung / /zhes 'od dpag med kyi da ma tshig bzung ba'i skabs su gsungs pa ltar/ sngags kyi sdom nga/ 'dzin pa na khas blangs dgos pa'i phyar ro/ /'di dag la gnang bkag mi 'dra ba'i cha than thun mthong nas/ tsha grang ltar thams cad du 'gal bar 'dzin pa ni rtog pa shin tu rtsing bar garngagal lo/ /de ltar na dmigs bsal can gyi gnang bkag 'ga' re ma gtogs pa gsung rabs rnams shin tu mthun pas/ theg pa gsum mam lam lnga lta bu gong ma gong mar 'jug pa na/ zeg pa dang lam 'og ma 'og ma'i yon tan gye rigs tshang ba dgos so/ /pha rol tu phyin pa'i lam ni rgyal ba'i yum las/ rgyal ba 'das dang ma byon da lta gang bzhugs pa/ /kun lam pha rol phyin pa 'di yin gzhan ma yin/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ sangs rgyas su bgrod pa'i lam gyi gzhung shing lta bu yin pas dor du mi rung ngo / /'di nyid rdo rje 437

theg pa las kyang mang du bka' bstsal pas na/ mdo rgyud gnyis ga'i lam thun mong pa'o/ /de'i steng du gsang sngags kyi lam thun mong min pa dbang dang dam tshig dang sdom pa dang rim gnyis 'khor dang bcas pa bsnan pas sangs rgyas su bgrod pa myur ba yin gyi lam thun mong pa dor na ni nor ba chen po'o/ /de lta bu'i go ba ma rnyed na/ chos re re la nges pa ltar snang re rnyed pa na/ gzhan rnams spongs shing khyad par du theg pa gong ma la mos pa ltar snang zhig byung ba na/ rim pa ltar theg dman gyi sde snod dang / pha rol tu phyin pa rnams spongs shing / sngags la'ang rgyud sde 'og ma gsum la sogs pa spongs par 'gyur bas 'brel che la 'byung nye zhing / rnam par smin pa ches lci ba'i chos spong gi las sgrib chen po gsog par 'gyur gsungs/ des na gnang bkag gi so mtshams mi shes par dus kun tsha grang ltar 'gal ba'i log shes kyi sngon gyi chos rgyal chen po rnams kyis gser phye bre la gzhal nas rgya gar du bskur/ lo tsā ba rnams kyis lus srog la 'phangs pa med par rgya gar du song /dka' ba dpag tu med pa spyad nas bod du bsgyur pas/ mdo sngags kyi chos bdud rtsi lta bu 'dor len gnyis byas phyin chad bstan pa nub pa'i ltas ngan a wa po slebs pa yin/ des na 438

chos la bzang ngan phyes/ 'then sprugs rgyongs gsum byas/chos nub du bcug nas ra nga gzhan kun gyi kha stong par ma gtong / bod yul mun nga /'i gling lta bu/ dbu rdzogs phyag chen sogs dam pa'i chos kyi sgo na me sngon gyi rgyal blon paṇa grub rnams kyis sbar yod pa/ log rtogs kyi rlung gis bsad na/bod gangs can gye thar 'dod rnams la de bas lhag gi ngan zhig byed rgyu med/ gsar rnying phyag chen gye chos gang yin yang /rgya gar nas tshur bod du sa steng brgyud nas mtshan g.yu 'brug bzhin grags gi grags gis 'ong ba zhig red/ sa 'og brgyud nas deng sang 'e tsho'i thad tsho 'dir yar sa steng du bud bzhag ni ma red/ rgyal dbang ri/na po ches/ dbu rdzogs phyag gsum lta ba bod 'dir grags/ /gsungs/ des na/ chos gang yin yang khungs mi btsun pa ga cig med/ log lta byed mi rung / rgya bod kyi sgyes chen dam pas bstan bcos brtsams pa rnams kyang / mdo rgyud kyi lung drangs nas/ de dang mthun par brtsams pa sha stag yin pa‘ sa rang bzo gcig med/ snyigs ma'i dus su rgyal ba rnams dge ba'i bshes gnyen du sprul nas/'gro ba'i don mdzad ces mdo rgyud mang po nas gsungs/ des na skyes bu dam pa de rnams kyang don gyi sangs rgyas dngos yin 439

gsungs pas/ bstan bcos rnams kyang sangs rgyas kyi gsung dang khyad par med pa'i tshad mar bzung nas spyi bor len pa gal che ste/ 'bar ra bas/ bzang ngan med thams cad gong du khur la/ kun la dam par ltos dang rang re tsho gsungs/dper na nad bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi'i gnyen por/ sman gye rigs sna tshogs pa yod kyang / de'i nang na dor bya gcig med pa bzhin/sems can gyi nyon mongs pa'i gnyen por/ chos lugs sna tshogs pa yod kyang / de'i nang na dor bya gcig med/ sman gyi rigs mi 'dra ba mang kyang / de sman min mi zer ba ltar/ chos lugs mang yang de chos min sus zer/ dper na rgya mtsho ma nyams na sems can thams cad kyi skom gdungs sel ba ltar/grub mtha' thams cad ma nyams na sems can mang por phan thogs che/ rgya mtsho chen po skam nas chu mig gcig gis sems can kha shas ma gtogs kun la phan mi thogs pa ltar/ grub mtha' gzhan thams cad nub nas gcig gis sems can mang po la phan mi thogs pa thag chod/ 'jig rten gtam dpe la'ang rdo gcig gis 'phrang dgu mi chod mi zer ram/ des na rgyal ba'i bstan pa thams cad phyogs thams cad du dar zhing rgyas na ci ma rung/ rgyas par gyur cig ces smon lam 'debs 440

dgos/ deng sang 'ga' res phyogs ris chags sdang gi dbang gis/ rang lugs dri ra/ med pa 'di dar zhing rgyas par shog zer ba gor gor chung chung zhig gi smon lam 'debs pa 'di phyogs lhung gi smon lam zhig tu 'dug pas ya mtshan che rgyu mi snang te/ rgyal ba kun gye dam pa'i chos 'dzin cing / /zhes sogs kyi smon lam la ltos dang ha go yongs/ yang bla ma 'ga' res gzhan la chos bshad ceg byed na/ de'i zhor la chos lugs gzhan ngan tshul ngan rab zer mig gnyis gcer gi tsho bsdad/rang lugs 'di bzang tshul bzang rab zer mig gnyis zum gi tsho bsdad/ rang lugs kyi bden dzun mi rtogs par gang smras thams cad bzang gral du nan gyis bzhag gzhan gyi don dang 'grel ba'i legs bshad kyang sun 'byen byas 'khyog pa'i lam du 'jug pa 'di ngo mtshar che ste/ rje ngag dbang sangs rgyas rdo rjes/ rang lugs kun la bden rdzun mi rtogs par/ /smras tshad bzang ba'i gral du nan gyis 'jug /gzhan lugs don dang 'grel ba'i legs bshad kyang / /sun 'byin 'khyog pa'i lam du 'dren du mtshar/ /gsungs/ 'di chos bshad mi shes pa'i mtshang zhig yin pas tshos bshad byas/ gzhan la phan 'dogs na spang bya'i gtso khro yin te/ dpung bzang las/441

bdag la bstod pa nam yang mi bya zhing / /gsungs/ gur las/gzhan gyi chos ni sun mi 'byen/ /gsungs/ bdag nyid sgrogs shing gzhan gyi skyon gleng ba sogs chos 'chad pa'i skyon yin pas spangs dgos zhes lam rim sogs gzhung du ma nas gsungs/ skyon de ma spangs na chos thun re la 'bul ba dang phan yon ci 'ong mi shes/ chos spong gi las dang rtsa ltung gi nyes pa re 'byung nges/ grub mtha' gzhan la dad pa che bas nyan yod na/ dad pa ldog chos nyan pa 'ga' res ang / skyabs su mchi dang / khong yang phyogs ris shig che gi zer/ grub mtha' gzhan kun mig nang gi ling tog du song / rig sa mthong sa med/ chos pa thams cad dgra ru ldang / 'gro don phar zhogarang don yang mi 'ong ste/ gtsang pa rgya ras kyis/ chos kyi bdag 'dzin mi bgyid 'tshal/ /chos kyi bdag 'dzin ches pa na/ /gdams pa'i che ba 'dod 'dod nas/ /chos pa thams cad dgra ru 'ong / /gsungs/ nag po bas/ smod pa ni nga rgyal gyis kun nas bslangs pa ste/ gzhan gyi yon tan la phrag dog pa'i rtsa ba nga rgyal nyid de/ rang nyid de la mchog tu mthong bas bag chags kyi mthu brtas par byed cig gzhan khyad du gsod pa'i pha rol pa'i sems 'khrugs par 'gyur te/ byang chub 442

sems dpa' gzhan gyi don du mi 'gyur zhing / rang gi don du yang cher mi 'gyur ro gsungs/ deng sang snyigs ma'i dus kyi sems can rnams nyon mongs rags/ phyogs ris che bas na/bla ma tsho'i chos gsungs yang grub mtha' gzhan thams cad la bstod ra brjod/ lag nga/ thal mo sbyor/ dad gus dag snang sbyongs bzhin rang lugs spel ba dang / bsdu bzhi'i nang gi snyan par smra ba'i che shos shig kyang de yin/ kun gyis skyabs su mchi/ de pa grub mtha' phyogs ris med zer/ dad pa byed mkhan mang / kun kyis rgyan du song / yon tan phyogs bcur sgogs/ gdul bya mang po 'du/ 'gro don rgya chen po 'ongs te/rje rgod tshang pas/ phyogs med dag snang 'byongs pa na/ /snyan pa phyogs bcur grags pa da ra / /kun gyi spyi bor khur legs te/ /gsungs/ sngon nga'i bla ma (ga rig dge bshes rin po ches/gzhan nyams su mi len kyang thabs mkhas thugs rje che bas rgya za lar yan chad kyis yon tan brjod/ rgya mkhar tsho song na/ 'di'i nang nas thob kyi byang chub sems dpa' mang po yod gsungs/bskor ba mdzad dad gus dag snang sbyangs tshe/ rgya za lar yan chad kyis khong gi gsungs chos nyan/ rgya 'ga' res bla ma na bla ma a rig dge bshes bla ma red zer/ 'ga' res bod kyi bla ma 443

nges nges po ga red zer/ noms pa mang po phul skad/ spyan snga pas/ rje btsun 'jam dpal rgya mtshos sgom chen pa dang mi skya ci rigs la/ gsal stong 'dzin med kyi lta ba'i chos bshad en re yang mdzad/ dbang po dang 'tshams pa'i chos ston pa mkhyen pa 'di bdag gi bla ma min pa gzhan gyi shes pa dkon par gda'/ bla ma 'di thabs mkhas pa chen por snang snyam pa byung /de'i rgyu mtshan ci yin zhe na/ bzhi brgya par/ skye bo gang gang la dga' ba/ /de ni de yi sngar sbyang bya/ /nyams par gyur pa dam chos kyi/ /snod ni cis kyang ma yin no/ /zhes pa ltar mdo bstan bcos nas slob ma dang por dbang bo dang mos pa dang 'tshams pa zhig nas 'khrid pa 'di la nan tan che bar mdzad gda'/ de'i yang rgyu mtshan ci yin zhe na/ de ltar byas na nges par phan thogs la/ gzhan phan mi thogs pas so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyi chos ston lugs la'ang gcig rang min pa'i dbang bo dang 'tshams pa'i chos rim pa'i skad de khrig ge ba zhig gda'/ de dkon mchog za ma tog las/ 'jam dpal gyis gcer bu bden pa po btul ba'i lo rgyus thos na gsal bo zhig bdog des na grub mtha' mi mthun pa'i mi ris/sa dang 'phrad byung na'ang skyon brjod re byas kyang phan mi thogs pa'i 444

steng du/ gang zag spongs pa dang chos spongs pa'i sdig gsog re sogs nyes dmigs mang po re yong / bka' ni rgya che/ lung ni grangs mang ba yin pas/ dang po mos pa dang mthun pa'i chos skad re byas pa yin na/ slob ma yin na lta ci smos/ grogs mched yin yang nyes dmigs med pa'i steng du/ phan yon rgya cher 'ong bas 'di yang gal shin tu che ba zhig yin no gsungs/rgyal dbang rin po ches/ lugs gnyis blang dor gsal bar ston pa'i shel dkar me long las/ yid dang ngang tshul rjes mthun smra ba'i gtam/ /bag phebs gleng mor bgyis te thabs mkhas kyis/ /gang yin don gyi thog tu 'bebs pa gnad / /gsungs/ de'i mchan bu'i yig chung las/ sangs rgyas kyis kyang ma skyes dgra la pha bsad byar gsungs pas 'gyod pa bsal ba'i mdo dang / gdul bya 'ga' zhig la gang zag gi bdag yod par bstan pa lta bu'o/ /gsungs/ des na bla ma rnams kyis 'gro don byed par 'dod na zhal nas yin min bco brgyad ma gsungs par/ gangs can 'gro ba'i skyabs mgon zla med bla ma rgyal ba paṇa chen sogs ris med bstan 'gro'i don mdzad pa'i skyes chen dam pa gong ma rnams kyi rnam thar ltar grub mtha' thamaca/ cad la phyogs ris med par/ dag 445

snang sbyongs bzhin gdul bya'i blo kha dang 'tshams pa'i chos ston la/ 'gro ba'i don gyes dang bzang ste/ mdo las/ ji ltar nad pa na ba la/ sman pas sman ni gtong ba ltar/ /de bzhin sangs rgyas sems can la/ /ji tsam bzod pa'i chos ston to/ /gsungs/ dper na khyim tshang zhig gi rgyu noms zas gos sga cha khab skud yan chad mkho bar shes nas gcig kyang mi 'dor bar tshags byed pa ltar/ rgyal ba sras bcas kyi gsungs tshigs bzhi gcig yan chad sems can la phan par go nas/ gcig tsam yang nyams su mi 'jug pa gal che/ dper na sman pa zhig gis/ tsha ba'i sman zhig sman 'tshong gi lag nas nyo na/ grang sman zhig ster rgyu yin na/ de min zer ba de/ tsha ba'i sman min zer ba ma gtogs/ de sman min dug yin zhes bshad ni min pa ltar/ bla ma dam pa 'ga' res legs bshad rtsom tshe/ gzhan lugs gi 'dod pa brjod nas de min zhes bkag pa de/ rang lugs kyi skabs su de min zer ba ma gtogs/ de chos min chos log yin zhes brjod pa min pas ha go dgos/ yang skyes bu dam pa 'ga' res chos gzhan 'ga' re ngan zhes smad smad/rang lugs dri rma med pa 'di bzang zhes bstod bstod 'jog pa de/ rang gzhan la phan pa'i dgongs gzhi du ma yod pas de 446

skad gsungs pa yin thugs kyi gting nas smad pa min/dgongs gzhi ci 'dra yod zer na/ rang gi chos lugs bzang zhes bstod na/ rjes 'jug gi gdams pa de la rtsis che zhing nyams su len pa la spro/ gzhan ya ki ma ki mang po nyams su blangs na mi snyam par/ de rtse gcig tu nyams su blangs na myur du nyams rtogs khyad par can skye ba'i phyir gsungs/ gzhan la smad na/ grub mtha smad pa de bas rang gi chos kyi che ba 'byen phyir nyams len byab// mngon shes rdzu 'phrul sogs lam rtags kyi yon tan bzang ze4 e thob phyir 'bad pa dang / grub mtha' de 'dzin pa'i bla ma dam pa rnams kyi lung rigs dang mthun pa'i lan btab nas// slar bstan pa la gad bdar byed pa dang / bstan pa'i dro /la nub 'gro gi snyam nas 'dzin skyong spel gsum lhag par mdzad pa dang / rang gzhan gyi grub mtha' ma 'dres par bsdad na/ tsha grang dro sman ltar sems can rigs mi 'dra ba mang por phan che bar dgongs nas gsungs pa yin/ yang bla ma dam nga/ 'ga' res legs bshad na gzhan gye grub mtha' la smad pa 'dra ba mang ba de/ thugs kyi gting nas ma yin te/ dper na rta la me tog gcod 'dod kyi bsam pa med kyang brgyug na shugs kyis gcod pa ltar/ bla mar grub 447

mtha' gzhan smod pa'i kun slong ngan pa med kyang / rang lugs 'jog tshe mkhyen dpyod rlabs che ba'i shugs kyis de 'dra 'byung ba yin pas/ thugs kyi gting nas smad par ma sems/de ltar shes na de 'dra'i gtam dang dpe cha mthong kyang / log rtog gi sprin nag gis nam yang bsgribs mi nus kyang grub mtha' thams cad dad gus dag snang gi nyi ma phyogs med du 'char/ bla ma 'i dgongs gzhi de 'dra yin par ma go bar nges par thugs kyi gting nas smad par 'dod na/ bla ma dam pa mang po yang log rtog gi gdon gyis rang dbang med par myos/chags sdang gi zhabs bgrad/ rtsa ltung drug pa'i nyes pa dang /chos spong gi las ngan pa'i phyag gnyis brgyangs/ blang dor la blta ba'i shes rab kyi spyan gnyis btsums te mar dmyal ba'i me nang du shed kyis mchongs pa yin zhes khas ma smras pa ma gtogs don gyis skur ba btab pa yin pas gzhan ma sems/'o na bla ma rnams kyis thugs kyi gting nas min kyang / zhal nas de skad gsungs pa la nyes pa med dam snyam na/ lung las/sems dge ba la nyes pa med gsungs/ 'jug pa las/ gal te de nyid rnam par dpyod pa'i tshe/ /gzhan gzhung 'jig par gyur na'ang nyes pa med/ /ces dang / 'brug pa kun legs kyis/ khye 448

'ga' shor nas 'ong tshe/ dgag bya ba la dgos pa gtso/ /khyi la bo snyi'i bkra shis shog /gsungs/ chos shig rgyab tu khur yod pa lag tu blangs nas khye'i mgo la brdungs pa bzhin/ rang gzhan la phan pa'i dgos / che na nyes pa med par ma zad bsod nams che ste/ rtsa ltung gi 'grel ba las/ lta ba 'og ma gong ma la gzud pa dang / 'dul ba'i bsam pas gzhan gyi grub mtha' smod pa ni nyes pa med de/ bsod nams kyang mang du 'phel lo/ /zhes gsungs/ yang bla ma 'ga' re kho la rnyed bkur mi 'ong gis dogs nas chags sdang gi dbang gis gzhan gyi gang zag dang chos la smad tshe/ blan po 'ga' res bla ma de bas bla ma gcig sang dang chos gcig de mi bzang gsungs pas de los bden zer kun la bshad/ smod shes mi shes gnyis ga'i smod thub thub byed pa do/ khyi rgan 'ga' res sngas kyi rus khog gzhan gyes 'khyer gyis dogs chags sdang gi skad drag po bton nas zug na/ sde ba'i khye thams cad kyis khye de'i skad go tsho dgra zhig yod rgyu red snyam thams cad 'ur langs 'jog pa dang 'dra bas/ de la blo gtad mchod cig med de/ rje sa skya paṇ+ḍi tas/ khyi rgan ku co bton pa na/ /rgyu mtshan med par gzhan dag rgyug /gsungs pa'i thog tu bab snang / de'i khar 449

rgyug mi nyan/ rgyugs na dmyal ba tsho yang rgyugs 'gro dgos/des na rang gis thams cad la dad gus dag snang byas na/ kho tsho yang 'ga' res khog tu chags sdang gi gdon chen po zhugs nas dgos pa mchod cig med bzhin/ grub mtha' gcig gi gcig la ngan rab thu rab kyi sngon byung gtam rgyud 'khyag 'khyog lung rigs dri ma can mang po phyogs gcig tu bsdus nas/ sngon yod ma myong ba'i nyes bshad mang po brtsams nas/ming la bstan pa'i bye dor/ chos log sun 'byin tsho zer snyan mi snyan mang po btags nas/ kun la bstan nas 'di gsungs ni red zer 'grel ba tsho rgyag pa 'di bstan pa'i bye dor du mi 'gro bshig rkyen du 'gyur/ dad pa can zhig gis mthong ngam thos tshe sngar dad pa yod pa nyams log rtog gi khur gyis non gzhan la khas btang nas dmyal ba'i rgyu gsog pa yin te/rgyal dbang thams cad mkhyen pa'i zhal nas/ khengs pa'i gdengs can dregs pa'i phung sgra sgogs/ /nyes bshad dug gi thar ba'i srog 'phrog kyang / /zang zing nor gyis gzhan mgo bskor byed pa'i/ /deng dus bstan 'dzin phal cher klu dbang bzhin/ /gsungs/ rje sangs rgyas rdo rjes/ des na gcig bstod gcig smod pa/ /kun slong ngan pa'i gdon gyis sbyar/ /zhes 450

dang / 'bar ra bas/ snyigs ma lnga dus skye bo bsod nams dman/ /chos mdzad dar/ pa tshul bzhin bsgom na smod/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa bag ce/da spyod pas bsgrubs/ /ngan byed spyod pa mtha' rnams kun )/du rgyas/ /gsungs/ bla ma zhang rin po ches/ jo bo bka' gdar/sa pa 'ga' res/ chos dang chos ma yin pa 'byed pa'i 'byams yig zer nas yig sna mdzad nas gda'/ ma dgengs pa'i sdig khams chen po de tsam la gzigs rtog ma mdzad/ phyogs su ma bsnyen mdzod/ ces gsungs/des na dpe ngan de 'dra'i /ba phye nas bltas pa las zum nas bzhag pa dga'/ de la dad gus dag snang gi bdud dpe zer dgos/ der bltas sngas mgor bzhag na rten 'brel gyi chos nyid kyis/ chos dang ga/nga zag gzhan la log lta the tshom skyes nas skur 'debs byed pa stso/sa ci dgos/ rang gi bla ma dang chos la sngar dad gus che ba /zheg yin na'ang rgyud la log lta the tshom skye nyen che ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kun gyis chos bzang skyes bu dam pa yin zhes tsha da mar 'dzin pa yang 'di 'dra zhig ngan na nga'i bla ma'i chos 'de yang ga 'dra zhig yin nam snyam skyon rtogs mang du byas na/ rang gi bla ma dang chos la yang log lta je tshom mang po 'phel ba chos nyid yin pa'i phyir ro/ /spyir 451

chos log ma log de/ chos kyi steng nas mi 'jog gang zag gi steng nas 'jog dgos/ dper na byis pa chung ngu la 'o ma rtsam nyog sogs 'ju sla ba byen na legs gyes/ sha thud sogs zas stobs can 'ju dka' ba byin na log par 'gyur/ mi gzhon par sha thud sogs zas stobs can byen na legs kyis/ 'o ma rtsam nyog sogs zas nyams chung byen na log pa yin pa/ de bzhin du gang zag las dang po pa blo kha chung ngu dag la/ theg pa chung ngu'i chos bstan legs kyis/ theg chen gyi chos bstan na blo khar mi shong ba'i log par 'gyur/ gang zag chos la sbyangs pa'i blo kha mthon po la/ theg chen gye chos bstan pa legs kyis/ theg dman la khrid na log pa yin no/ /de ltar go na chos log pa zhig rgyal ba'i gsung rabs la yod mi srid pa shes so/ /des na chos log zer gzhan gyi grub mtha' smod pa rnams kyis rang blo log par shor ba'i rang mtshang du go nas dug bzhin du spong ba gal che/ sngon bla brang bkra shis 'khyil ba'i grwa ba gnyis kyi nang nas gcig spyos pas/ ma spyos pa de song nas gzhan gyi grwa ba gcig la kho bo'i grogs po da nang smyos 'dug da bkyig dgos kyi/ khyod kho bo'i bkyig grogs su gcig 'gro zhes khrid 'ong tshe/ spyos yod pas kyang / khyod 452

'dir 'ong ba bzang / kho ba'i grogs po 'di da nang smyos yod kyi/ da bkyig dgos smras 4sa/ gzhan grwa pa des gnyis ka la gcig bltas nas/ ga red da khyed gnyis kyi gcig spyos 'dug kyang su yin mi shes gi kho phyir 'gro zer langs song ba bzhin/grub mtha' gcig gis gci ga la/ thabs du ma'i sgo nas chos log ngan pa yin zhes smad na/ skya ser pho mo thams cad gang la yang dad pa mi 'ong bar 'atsukhyar la/ dad pa bla ma dang chos kyi yon tan brjod na sgye ba yin / skyon brjod nas sgyes mi srid/dper na zas zhig la zhim mngar che tshul brjod na za 'dod skye/dug 'dres yod sogs ngan rab thu rab brjod na za 'dod mi sgye ba dang 'dra/ des na da da gus dag snang gi bdud la 'dis che zhig med/ yang ngan zi/sa mang po go tshe/ chos lugs gang yin yang nyams su len dub / ze tshom za bzhin nyams su blangs na nyams rtogs gang yang skye mi srid/ dper na khab rtse gnyis kyi tshems bu mi 'ong ba dang /'dra/ des na nyams rtogs skye ba'i gegs la yang 'di ngan/ gcig gis gcig la khas mang bo btang na/ chos kyi sgor 'ju ga mkhan nyung / zhugs kyang log lta je tshom gyes non nas/ rgyur la yon tan mi skye ba mang / des na bshad sgrub kyi bstan pa nub pa'i rkyen du 'di che/ yang 453

'ga' res legs bshad cig rtsom kyang grub mtha' gzhan la brnyas smod du 'gyur pa'i zur gtam bsres pa de yang legs bshad nyes bshad kyis brjod pa yin pas gdul bya la phan pa'i dgos pa che na ma gtogs/ de'i 'dra legs bshad nang du ma bcug na bzang / de mthong na phal cher dad pa sgye sems la phan kyang / 'ga' res bltas nas/ ang skyabs su mchi dang / 'di na'ang gcig sang la skyon gtam gye mda' zhig 'phang 'dug bla rgan mda' kha yang bzang ni red zer dgod/'ga' re ci tsho gsung gi zer blor mi 'bab khas btang / ngan brjod nas/ de'i rgyud la mi dge ba 'jog pa ngas kyang mthong /des na legs bshad rtsom kyang /chos lugs gang la dad gus dag snang skye zhing / kun gyi rgyud la phan pa zhig brtsams na bzang / yang 'ga' res chos zhig bshad kyang rgyal ba'i bka' dri ma med pa 'di mi zer/ rang lugs dri ma med pa 'di zer gzhan thams cad shugs kyis smad/ nyan pa 'ga' res lags/dri ma can po de gang yin zhes 'dri rgyu yin na ha go yongs/des na dgos ched che na ma gtogs/ de 'dra'i tshig tsam yang smras na mi bzang / yang 'ga' res/ gsar ma ba 'di'i rigs rtog ge kha phyi bltas shor song nas rgyud la phan dka'/454

yid dpyod tshig gis lta ba tsam zhig min/ nges don gyi lta ba bsgom tshul 'di ba sang la med/ lam ring gsang sngags myur lam lta bu min zer/ smod shes rung mi shes rung thabs sna tshogs pas smad/ gsar ma 'ga' res/ rnying ma 'di ba sang /skyur dad che/ yon tan cang mi shes/ zhi gnas tsam zhig min/lta ba'i phyogs sgo tsam yang ma rtogs/ rtogs ldan pa zer/smin ma lta stangs kyis gzengs mtho ba mang ste/ don go chung zer smad/ bstan pa'i la rgya brtsad zer bsam ngan sbyor rtsub gcig gis gcig la mthu dunyis/ 'ga' re 'khon 'dzings byed pa 'di mi rung / sngon rgya za lar gye chos so rnying gnyis brtsad nas chos lugs so mas dmag drangs/ rnying ba ngan byas pas mthar so ma kho rang yang gong ma'i ngan gsod byas bsad/phan tshun gnyis ka chos la nga/rten nas/ tshe 'di phyir 'phung tshul dang / 'ga' res mthu byed re byas/ phan tshun gnyis ga'i shul chad rjes ldog tshul rnams zheb tu soms dang bzang mi bzang ha go yongs/ 'ga' res rang bstan 'dzin tu rlom/ gzhan bstan pa 'dzin pa'i sa thob kyi byang chub sems dpa' rnams dgra ru bzung / mthong na stas ngan dgun sbrul mthong ba ltar/mi blta bar sdang gi tsho song / bstan bshig ka shi na'ang snyam ma 455

thub pa'i dgra byas/khros nas ngan brgya phrag smra/ des bshad pa'i chos de chos log yin pas sus nyan mi rung / bton na bkra mi shis 'don sa med zer dgag pa tsho gtong ba de/ khong sang gi chos kyis kho'i rgyud ko skam lta bu ma thul lhag par gyong /ma rig nyon mongs las sgrib kyi ling tog gis kho bo'i blang dor 'byed pa'i shes rab kyi mig bsgribs nas gang yang mi mthong /kho'i rgyud na yon tan thams cad bskyed pa'i gzhi ma/ dad gus til 'bru tsam yang gtan nas med ces rang mtshang thams cad phyir phud kun la 'dir ltos/ da nga bstan 'dzin gyi khyu nas ro ltar bud yod ces gzhan la sngar mthong ma myong ba'i ltas ngan a wa po bstan pa yin pas blo ldan rnams kyis de'i lad mo phar zhog blta mi rung / skyes bu dam pa rnams kyis mthong ngam thos na skyo ba skye ba'i rgyu zhig yin te/ rje dge 'dun grub kyis gsung shar gangs ri ma las/ lar da lta gangs ri'i khrod 'di na/ /rang bstan pa 'dzin par khas len yang / /gzhan bstan 'dzin dgra bo'i dwangs mar 'dzin/ /tshul 'di la skyo ba gting nas skyes/ /gzhan 'phung bar 'dod pa'i kun slong dang / /rgyud mtshan 'dzin dam pos bcings lags kyang / /lam mthon por gnas pa'i khas len byed/ /'di 456

brtags na kun gyis khrel ba'i rgyu/ /lam gol sar rgas pa'i sdug yus kyis/ /chos tshu pa bzhin sgrub pa'i gang zag la/ /rgyud khong nas 'khrugs pa'i gdug sems can/ /gdon thugs la zhugs pa ma lags sam/ /dgra nyon mongs 'dul thabs mi byed par/ /shags 'gyed pa tsam gyi 'chad nyan yang / /'dre shar sgo'i phyogs su gnas pa la/ /glud nub sgor gtong bzhin don re chung / /don de ltar go ba'i bshes gnyen pa/ /spyir lus can kun la bka' drin soms/ /dgos chos mdzad yongs la dag snang sbyongs/ /dgra nang na 'dug pa'i nyon mongs thul/ /mi kho bo'i rjes 'jug grogs po rnams/ /yid phyogs su lhung pas mi 'ching bar/ /blo gzu bor gnas pa'i rtogs dpyod kyis/ /lam drang bor zhugs pa cis kyang legs/ /gsungs/ mnyam med po to ba'i zhal nas/ dam pa phan tshun gcig gis gcig bstod pa/ /deng sang dus na thams cad 'gran par 'gyur/ /dben par gnas nas tshul bzhin sems pa de/ /deng sang dus na nyin par skar ma tsam/ /gdams ngag bsam bzhin rtogs pa 'bul ba de/ /deng sang dus na lugs yang med par gyur/ /zang zing mi lta sgrub pa lhur len pa/ /deng sang dus na snying rje'i yul du gyur/ /chos kyi bar 457

chad za ra zi ra de/ /deng sang dus na bsod nams can du grags/ /shes bya mi sbyongs gdams ngag sems pa de/ /deng sang dus na dga' ba med par 'gyur/ /tshig zin skam po'i grangs bskyed byed pa de/ /deng sang dus na kun gyis go bar byed/ /tshe 'di blos btang thar lam sgrub pa de/ /deng sang dus na rang 'do med par byed/ /tshe 'di don gnyer yo byad gsog pa de/ /deng sang dus na rang 'do can du byed/ /bya byed bzhag nas snying bo bgrang ba de/ /deng sang dus na bya rgyu med par byed/ /tshe 'di 'dod nas bya bzhag byed pa de/ /deng sang dus na phan sems can du byed/ /tshogs gsog ming btags kha lan byed pa de/ /deng sang dus na chos kyi mchog tu byed/ /bslab la gus shing dman sa 'dzin pa de/ /deng sang dus na kun gyi brnyas bcos byed/ /sdig la mi 'dzem rtsab ral byed pa de/ /deng sang dus na kun gyis spyi bor 'khur/ /gzhon pas rgan la bsnyen bkur byed pa de/ /rgan pas gzhon la blo sbyongs byed pa dang / /dge slong rgan la dge tshul bsten pa de/ /deng sang dus na bzlog nas byed par 'gyur/ /dam pa thams cad rim gyes gshegs gyur pas/ /deng sang dus na bstan pa med par 'gyur/ /rang gis 'khor ba'i skyon la 458

bsam byas nas/ /shes pa nang du bzlog te blta bar bya/ /zhes dang / rje rgod tshang pas/ 'gro don byed pa'i tshul ston yang / /rang che bar 'dod pas gzhan mgo smod/ /nye ring phyogs ris ngang la gnas/ /chos brgyad can la skyo ba skyes/ /bsod nams tshogs kyang mi bsog cing / /ye shes tshogs dang mi ldan par/ /rang nyid sangs rgyas yin zer nas/ /log par shor la skyo ba skyes/ /zhes gsungs pa 'di thugs shin tu mad de/ /deng sang 'e tsho'i bla ca/ 'di bzang /'dis chos shes snyam/re bzhag che ba rnams kyi mdun du song na re ba bzhin ma byung /re log ge gtong ba mang / des nas dge rnying 'brug sogs kyi bla ma su yin yang / rang rang gi grub mtha' skyong yang / grub mtha' gzhan 'dzin skyong spel ba'i bla ma dge ba'i bshes gnyen yongs la dad gus dag snang sbyongs mchod bstod bkur ba 'di shin tu gal che ste/ rig 'dzin gang shar rang grol gyi zhal nas/zhwa ser dmar sogs chos lugs ma lus pa/ /zhwa ltar gtsug gi rgyan du gus bsten cing / /zhwa lham zas gos ngan ngon tsam gyon nas/ /zha long bzhin du kheng sa skyung dman sa bzung / /gsungs/rje mi la'i zhal nas/ nga mi las bud pas lha dang mjal/ /dman sa bzung ba'i rgyal sa/ thob/ /gsungs pas na de lugs 459

kyis/ 'o skol rnams kyis ngas rgyal sa bzung bas dman sar lhung zer ba zhig gi gnas su 'gyur bar mdzod/ yang dper na zas bzang ngan rab 'bring tha gsum yod na/ sems can gyi rigs sna tshogs la phan che ba ltar/ chos lugs grub mtha' sna tshogs yod kyang thams cad ma nyams dar na/ sems can la gcig gi phan mi thogs pa gcig gis phan pas bzang / khyim pa so nams byed mkhan mang na gcig gis gcig la 'gran bzhin so nams la rem na thams cad phyug por 'gyur ba bzhin/ grub mtha' mang na gcig gis gcig la 'gran bzhin nyams len byas na myur du sangs rgya bas kyang bzang / grub mtha' gzhan thams cad nyams nas rang lugs 'di dar na snyam pa de bas bsam nag zhig gzhan na med/ grub mtha' gzhan thams cad nub nas gcig shul du lus pa skyid che snyam pa de/ khyim tshang kun shi nas rgan mo'i mo gcig pu shul du lus na za 'thung che snyam pa dang 'dra bas gzhan ma sems/ dper na zas mang po ma 'dres kha spos nas gang 'dod zos na/ lhag par phan che ba ltar grub mtha' rnams ma 'dres na/ rang gis gang mos nyams su blangs chog pas bzang / 'dres song yang khrag dang 'o ma 'dres pa bzhin sems pa de'i gnad ma go ba 460

yin/ chos shig yin phyin sems can la dngos sam brgyud nas phan thogs 'byung ba sha rte/ga yin/ de rnams 'dres song yang ka ra bu ram sbrang rtsi rnams/ 'dres pa dang 'dra bas 'gal ba med/ dper na zas zhir/ po phyogs gcig tu bsdus nas zos na lhag par zhim pa ltar/ blo'i mthu yod pa rnams kyis dbu rdzogs phyag chen rnams gung bsgrigs nas nyams su blangs kyang lhag par zab ste rgyal dbang rjes theg pa sna tshogs kyi chos skad kyang / rang rang gi sa na bden mod kyang / gung gcig tu 'grigs na zab pa yin gsungs/ des na dam pa gong ma 'ga' res grub mtha' phyogs ris med par dad gus dag snang sbyangs/ bla ma mang por dbang lung 'khrid gsum zhus nyams su blangs pa'i rgyu mtshan yang de yin/ dug dang bdud rtsi bzhin 'gal na/ dam pa de rnams kyis nyams su mi len/ deng sang 'e tsho'i tsha grang ltar 'gal bar sems pa de rang gi blos mthu chung bas lan pa yin pas gzhan ma sems/ phyag na pad+mo lnga pa rgyal dbang rin po che'i zhal nas/ dge ldan bstan pa'i gzhi ma yin pas brtan dgos/ rnying ma bstan pa'i lcags ri yin pas mtho dgos gsungs/ yang sngags 'chang gos dkar lcang lo can gyi sde/ rab byung ngur sprig chos gos can gyi sde gnyis/461

'brong rwa g.yas g.yon bzhin gcig gcig gis rgyan yin/gnyis ka dar dgos gsungs skad/ des na gsar rnying gi bstan 'dzin rnams spun zla bzhin 'grogs nas/ brtse gdungs rgyun mi chad du byas/ phyogs ris med par bstan pa 'dzin skyong spel gsum gyis dang bzang / yang rnying ma'i chos mi bzang zhes smod ga la rung / rjes 'bangs nyer lnga sogs mngon shes dzu 'phrul mnga' ba'i grub chen ri brag 'dra ba de tsho gang nas byung /gsar ma'i chos mi bzang zhes smod ga la rung /'brom khu rdog sogs bka' gdams bla ma mkhas grub gnyis 'dzom gnam gyis sa bkab lta bu de tsho gang nas byung / de tsho mi bsam par chos la dad log byas khas btang na/ chos de brgyud pa'i bla ma gsungs pa po ston pa sangs rgyas rdo rje 'chang sogs la yang khas mi bzang smras pa ma gtogs/ don gyi mi bzang zhes skur ba btab pa yin pas/ mi dge ba thams cad kyi nang nas skur 'debs nyes pa che/ rta kha 'then min mtha' ltung gi zer ba ltar/ tshod bzung min dmyal ba'i me nang du lhung nyen yod/ yang de rnams smad ni min/ de rnams kyi chos gsungs pa bzang kyang / de'i 'phro la rgya bod kyi lo tsā ba chos pa yin zer ba'i ngan pa 'ga' res/ chos bzang po bsre slad 462

rgyab rgyab pas mi bzang ba yin zer na/ de 'dra'i zhib cha su la yod/ de dus drung na yod ni 'dra gi bshad bshad de mi rung /chos 'di bzang 'di mi bzang chos log yin zhes thag bcad gis bcad gi bshad pa 'di 'e tsho'i gtam zhig min/ thams cad mkhyen pa'i gsungs rgyu zhig yin/ dper na mi chen zhig gis bshad rgyu zhig byis pa 'ga' res smras na rgan pa rnams ha bgad byed pa ltar de 'dra smras pa mkhyen rgya che ba'i rgyal ba sras bcas kyis gsan na bzhad gad kyi gnas yin pas gzhan ma sems/ phyi rabs pas chos/ bsre slad byas brdzad yod na/ deng sang sa dge rnying gsum sogs kyi chos nyams su len mkhan gyi nang na/ mkhas shing grub pa brnyes pa'i skyes chen dam pa mang po 'dug pa mig gis ltos/ rna bas nyon dang brdzad yod na de 'dra 'byung dogs med/ des na ma brdzad par chos rnam dag yin pa'i rtags de lhang nger yod pas log rta dang the tshom gyi 'chang bu dor la/ dad gus dag snang gi nor bu longs dang bzang / rje rgod tshang pas/ bka' gdams dang rdzogs chen la sogs pa chos thams cad la mi zab pa gcig kyang med/'on kyang spang bya nyon mongs/ pa gcig po'i gnyen por gsungs pa las med/ thub pa chen pos gsungs pa'i chos la mi zab pa 463

gang yod/ zab mi zab thams cad rang re'i blo tshod dang /mthun mi mthun/ rang res las 'phro gang bzhag pa de zab par yong pa yin/ bka' rgyud 'di'i lugs kyi mos gus zab par 'dod gsungs/ yang chos 'di khung dag mi dag bzang mi bzang gi dogs pa za rgyu zhig gi dbang du song na/ sangs rgyas kyi bka' yang phyi nas nyan thos dgra bcom pa mang pos bsdus/yi ger phab pa yin pas/ de'i dus kyang 'jug pa dang / dag mi dag e yod snyam the tshom za dgos/ de nas lo tsā ba brgya phrag mang po'i chos de bod skad du bsgyur ba yin pas/ de'i dus su 'jug e yod snyam the tshom za dgos/ de nas bod kyi 'bri shes mi shes gnyis gas bris pa yin pas/ lhag chad e yod snyam dogs pa skye/ rnam rtog ngan pa rkyang bslang na/skabs shig sangs rgyas kyi bka' yang e yin mi yin snyam yid ches skyes dka'/ des na rgyud las/ rtog cing dpyod pa'i rtog ge ba/ /de la mchog gi dngos grub ring / /gsungs pa yin la/da sa 'og rdo 'og min tshad nas rang gi rang la dogs pa ngan pa rkyang ma bslang bar/ nyan thos dgra bcom lo paṇa mkhas grub sogs chos 'di 'dzin skyong spel gsum byed mkhan thams cad sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i sprul pa sha stag yin/ /464

de la nor 'khrul zhig mi srid snyam du yid ches kyi dad pa lhang lhang bskyed nas phyogs ris spong ba gal che ste/ 'bar ra bas/sems can sna tshogs bas/ma pa la/ /rgyal bas theg pa sna tshogs bstan/ /snod dang mthun pa'i chos de zab/ /phyogs ris spongs shig rgyal mtshan dpal/ /gsungs/ yang bsam pa mi la nag na/ sbyor ba rang la 'du zer ba ltar/ gzhan la bsam ngan bzung na/ rang gi bstan pa nyams pa'i ges/sa yin te/ sngon lho kha'i phyogs kyi dgon chung dge lugs pa la shin tu sdang pa zhig yod pas/ rje rin ngo/ che la skur ba rkyang btab/ dgon pa'i khyi zhig yod pa'i ming la yang blo bzang grags pa zhes bos/lo gcig dgon pa'i khri ba gsar ba la khri ston byed snyam dgung mo 'du khang du khri gdan bting / ston mo'i bza' btung yo byad rnams bzhag yod pa/ mtshan mo khyi de nang du 'dzul nas/zas yod tshad zos/ nang du skyag pa mang po btang / bla ma bzhugs pa'i khri thog na nyal yod pa/ snga mo sku gnyer gyis mthong nas kun la 'o mngangs khyi rgan blo bzang grags pa nang du 'dzul nas ston mo'i sha sogs zos nas khri ba bzhugs pa'i khri thog tu song nas nyal 'dug smras pas/ thams cad kyi ma bzang rten 'brel btsog pa zer rnam rtog zos/ de'i phyi lor 465

dgon pa de dmag cig gis brgyab nas/ shul du dge lugs pa'i dgon pa zhig tshugs skad/ yang sngon dbus phyogs kyi dgon chung rnying ma ba la khas btang sdang po byed mkhan zhig yod pa'i grwa ba gcig lam du song bas brag 'phrang zhig na o rgyan gyi sku rdo la bzos pa'i byin can zhig yod pa mthong nas yid la ma song khong khro skyes/ 'di med sa mi snang sa zad rdo 'phrang tsho na yang sa bcad nas 'dug zer rdo mang pang bo 'phang nas/ zhal ras kyi shangs bsnad skur zhus mang po byas pas/ phyis tshe ring po ma lon/ nad ngan pa zhig gi na nas/ngo skrangs sna chad nas shi/ dgon pa de yang 'thor song skad/des na rang lugs dri med dar gi 'jug rgyu yin tsho zer/ gzhan gyi grub mtha' rnams sdig rgyal tshor zhus nas nyams su bcug na/grub mtha' pha rol po de ba sang btsan po zhig yin na dmag 'dren/ snyom chung zhig yin na mthu btang nas/ bla ma rgyal po rnams kyi sku tshe je thung du btang / bstan pa dar mi dgos rgud du 'jug chags sdang mkhan 'ga' res kho skye ba phyi ma la ka sang gi bstan pa la gnod skyel nus shing / rang lugs dar rgyas su gtong ba zhig tu skye bar shog zer smon lam log par btab na/ gdon chen po 'jigs su rung ba'am sdig rgyal tsho'i 466

skye sa bstan pa gcig gis gcig la gnod bskyal nas thams cad nyams 'gro bas mi bzang / deng sang sa dge rnying gsum sogs kyi bla ma rnams phal cher sku tshe thung ba rnams grub mtha'i phyogs ris chags sdang byas/ de'i dbang gis gcig gis gcig la bsam ngan sbyor rtsub byas pas lan pa yin/ bla ma rnams kyi sku tshe ring bar 'dod na yang tshe sgrub zhabs brtan byas rgyu nom brlag pa bas/ grub mtha'i phyogs ris ma byed par gcig gis gcig dad gus dag snang sbyongs gcig grogs gcig gis gyis dang sgu tshe ring / tshe sgrub kyi chog gcig de na snang / gzhan rang bzhin gyis dad nas chos sgor ma zhugs na/btsan tshugs byas chos sgor bcug na rang bzhin gnyis ka phan las gnod che/ snga sor khams phyogs kyi dge lugs pa dang bon po'i dgon pa gnyis thag nye byas yod pas gcig sang gis gcig sang la/ khyed sang gi chos bzhag nas/ khong tsho'i chos 'di 'don dgos zhes ma 'grig phyis dge lugs pa sang gis bon po'i dgon pa btsan tshugs byas/ ban chos 'don du bcugs pa'i tshe/ bon rnams kyis dngos su 'don pa ltar byas/lkog nas mthu brgyab pas/ dge lugs pa'i dgon pa'i khri ba dang grwa ba mang po bkrongs/ sdod mkhan ma byung / ban bon 467

gnyis ka dar mi dgos je rgud du song skad/ des na bong bu brag them du 'gro 'dod med pa phar gtad na tshur gtad nas gnyis ka mtha' la 'phen pa dang / rtsid bu chu 'thung 'dod med na btsan tshugs byas mchu chu nang du btsugs na 'ba' 'phags nas chu gtsang rnyog pa dang 'dra/ des na btsan tshugs byas chos spor bcug pa don go spu tsam med / sngon sangs rgyas kyis kyang chos 'khor bskor dus thabs mkhas bsdu bzhi'i sgo nas chos bstan zer ba go btsan tshugs byas khyod kyis chos 'di la nyan rgyu e yin/ mi nyan na gsod rgyu yin zhes gsungs zer ba go ma myong / sangs rgyas kyis mkha' mnyam sems can thams cad la chos kyi sgo mo mtha' yas gsungs/ chos lugs grub mtha'i rigs mi 'dra ba mtha' yas yod/ bod gangs can khab mig gi nam mkha'i cha tsam la/ chos skud pa tsam zhig dar yod pa kun gyis yin min bzang mi bzang zer/ dpe ngan lung rigs ngan pas ro shed kyis 'jen sprugs rgyongs gsum byas bcad ma gtong dang bzang chos la la bzang bar 'du shes/ la la ngan par 'du shes nas dor na chos spong gi las ngan pa yin ste/ rnam par 'thag pa thams cad 'dus pa'i mdo las/ /de bzhin gshegs pas gsungs pa'i bka' la la ni 468

bzang bar ‘nadu shes/ la la ni ngan par 'du shes pa ni chos spong pa'o/ /chos spang ba des chos spangs pas/ de bzhin gshegs pa la skur ba 'debs pa yin no/ /dge 'dun la ngan du brjod pa yin no/ /zhes dang / mi blun po dag nga'i chos 'di la/ 'di ni nyan thos rnams la bshad pa'o/ /'di rang sangs rgyas rnams la bshad pa'o/ /'di ni byang chub sems dpas bshad pa'o/ /zhes tha dad du dbye ste/ de tha dad pa'i 'du shes kyi chos de la brnyas na chos spong ba yin no/ 'di ni byang chub sems dpa'i bslab pa'o/ 'di ni byang chub sems dpa'i bslab pa ma yin no/ /zhes zer nas dor na chos spong ba yin no/ /chos smra ba'i sbyo/da pa sun 'byen te/ skyon bdog na chos spong ba yin no/ /chos smra ba la sgrub pa phun sum tshogs pa ma yin no zhes zer na chos spong ba yin no/ /de bzhin du bag med pa'i gleng na/ spyod lam gyi gleng na/ spyod pa dang tshul khrims nyams pa'i gleng na/ spobs pas don go bar mi byed do/ /zhes zer na/ chos spong ba yin no/ /zhes dang / dge slong ngam/ dge slong ma'am/ dge bsnyen nam/ dge bsnyen mas chos smra ba la 'di ni 'di 'dra'o/ /zhes sems sam smras na dam pa'i chos spong ba yin no/ /zhes gsungs/ chos spong gi las 469

ngan pa de bsags na nyes pa shin tu lci bas dmyal ba nas thon pa'i dus mi 'byung ste/ de nyid las/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams la brnyas pa de dag ni sems can dmyal ba na gnas pa mthar phyin pa nga mi smra'o/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ gang byang chub sems dpa' chos smra ba la brnyas pa de ni sangs rgyas la smod pa yin no/ de ni chos spong ba yin no/ /de ni dge 'dun la gshung ba yin no/ /zhes dang / sdud pa las/ thos nas blo chung de yi 'di ni spong byed de/ /spangs nas skyabs med gyur pa de ni mnar med 'gro/ /zhes dang / ting 'dzin rgyal po las/ gang gis 'dzam bu gling 'dir ni/ /mchod rten thams cad bshig byed pas/ /gang gis mdo sde spong byed pa'i/ /sdig pa 'di na ches khyad 'phags/ /gang gis gaṅgā'i bye snyed kyi/ /dgra bcom bsod par gyur pa pas/ /gang gis mdo sde sgong byed pa'i/ /sdig pa 'di ni ches khyad 'phags/ /zhes dang / ston pa rin po che'i zhal nas/ chos la brten pa'i sdig pa'i gam na/ mi dge ba bcu sdig pa brud brud yin gsungs pa shin tu mad par snang /de la dgongs nas/ ljon shing gi mdo las/ pha dang ma yi don du'ang sdig pa'i las mi bya/ /lus dang srog gi phyir yang dam pa'i chos mi spong/ /gsungs/ gzhan gyi grub mtha' smad na byang 470

chub sems dpa' dang / rig 'dzin sngags kyi sdom pa gnyis ka 'jig ste/ rje bud+ngha badz+ra gyes/ chos la sgod pa'i sdom pa gnyis/ /'jig na phyag rgya chen po dang / /de 'dzin dkar rgyud la smod mkhan/ /rnams kyis thugs bsam gtong re ran/ /gsungs pa thugs mad de/ sdom bzung las/ phyi dang gsang ba theg pa gsum/ /dam chos so sor bzung bar bgyi/ /zhes gsungs pa dang / byang chu ba sems dpa'i sdom pa nyi shu ba las/rnyed dang bkur sti chags pa yi/ /bdag bstod gzhan la smod pa dang / /zhes smod mi rung gsungs pa dang / byang sems rtsa ltung bsdus pa'i tshigs su bcad pa las/ dam pa'i chos ni spong byed pa/ /gnyis par thub pas gsungs pa yin/ /zhes dang / sngags kyi rtsa ltung bcu bzhi ba las/ /bde gshegs bka' las 'das pa ni/ /ltung ba gnyis pa yin par brjod/ /zhes dang / rang ngam gzhan gyi grub pa'i mtha'/ /chos la smod pa drug pa yin/ /gsungs pa sogs mang po 'gal bar 'gyur bas/ sdom pa thams cad rtsa ba nas shor ba yin la/ de la bshags pa byed dgos ste/ slob dpon bha ba pas/ phyi rol pa dang nyan thos rang rgyal dang / /theg pa che dang gsang sngags bla na med/ /lam tshol zhugs/ dang lam zhugs lam chen zhugs/ /471

grub pa'i mtha' rnams smad pa mthol lo bshags/ /gsungs/grub thob gling ras pas/ chos sku ro gcig 'dug pa so sor mthong / /chos la phyogs ris byas pa mthol lo bshags/ /gsungs pa ltar bshags pa byas 'dag gi ma bcug na gsang sngags kyi dam tshig gcig tsam nyams yang / tshe 'dir nad sogs kyi btab nas sdug bsngal phyong zhing shi ma thag nas kha thur du bltas nas mar dmyal bar 'gro dgos ste/ rtsa ltung bcu bzhi ba las/ gzhan du dam tshig las nyams na/ /nyams pa bdud kyi bzung bar 'gyur/ /de nas sdug bsngal myong 'gyur zhing / /thur du bltas te dmyal bar 'gro/ /gsungs/ yang kha cig na re/ rang ngam gzhan gyi grub pa'i mtha'/ /chos la smod pa drug pa yin/ /zhes dang / don dam bsnyen par grub pa'i mtha' la skyon bzung bas na drug pa ste/ zhes gsungs pa de mdo sngags kyi phyogs bzung nas phan tshun gong 'og smad na rtsa ltung drug par 'gyur bar gsungs pa yin gyes gzhan pha rol pa sogs smad na nyes byas su 'gyur kyang / rtsa ltung du mi 'gyur te/ dri med 'od las/ drug pa grub pa'i mtha' la smod pa ste/grub pa'i mtha' ni shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang / sngags kyi tshul de kho na nyid kyi le'u'o/ /de la smod pa gang yin pa de ni 472

drug pa'o/ /zhes dang / r+ha ri ka pa'i tshig 'byed las/grub pa'i mtha' ni shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i theg pa yin la/ smad ces pa de dang sngags kyi tshul tha dad par 'dzin pa ni rtsa ba'i ltung ba yin zhing / de las gzhan pa'i theg pa la smad pa ni rtsa ba'i ltung ba ma yin la/ des kyang thun mong gi dngos grub 'phrog pa yin no/ /gsungs/ nag po pas/ bdag gzhan chos la smod mi bya/ /zhes pa pa/ bdag ni sangs rgyas pa'o/ /gzhan ni mu stegs can no/ /chos ni mngon par mtho ba'i lam du mthong ba'o/ /smad nga/ra bya yang theg pa'i rim pas nyes pa yang / /de bzhin du 'gyur gsungs/ kun mkhyen pad+ma dkar po'i dmar nag gi rgyud du rang gzhan chos ni sun mi 'byin/ /zhes gsungs pa la/ 'grel ba man ngag gi snye ma dang /sdom 'byung gi 'grel ba dang / bstan pa'i nor thams cad sgrub pa'i thabs dang / gsang ba 'dus pa'i rgyan rnams su ltung ba 'di la theg pa gtsu/ma la smod pa zhes pa'i ming 'dogs mdzad do zhes gsungs so zer na/ de la khyod kyis lung 'dren mang po byed mi dgos khyed bden/ theg pa'i mtho dman gyi khyad yin te/ rnam snang mngon byang las/ dman pa mu stegs theg pa dang / /mchog gyur sangs rgyas theg pa'o/ /gsungs pa'i phyir 473

ro/ /'on kyang khyod la dri rgyu gnyis snang / khyod kyi bod la dar ba'i sa dge rnying 'brug sogs kyi grub mtha' rnams sangs rgyas kyi gsungs mdo sngags kyi chos su 'dod dam mi 'dod/ shod dang / de 'dod zer na/ lags so/ /da phyin chad nas bzung bod du dar ba'i grub mtha' gang la smad na/ mgo thur du bstan nas dmyal bar ltung ba'i rgyu'i rtsa ba rtsa ltung drug pa zhes yongs su grags pa de 'phog nges pas gzab 'tshal/ gzhan phyi rol pa sogs la smad na yang / bcom ldan 'das rnam par snang mdzad la sogs phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba rnams la rang zhal mjal ba'i dus mi 'byung bar je ring du 'gro ba'i rgyu dang / zhi rgyas dbang drag grub pa brgyad sogs thun mong gi dngos grub thams cad 'phrog pa'i rgyu dang / 'khor ba ngan song gi gnas ngan len gyi rgyu nyes byas su 'gyur ba thugs na mnga' ba de red/'jem dgos mi dgos thugs bsam thongs/yang kho bo ni de ltar mi 'dod mdo sngags zhes pa/ sa dge rnying 'brug sogs rang rang gi grub mtha' rang gang 'thad gcig la 'dod do zer na/ de chos chen po ma sbyangs pa'i rang mtshang phyir bstan pa yin te/ byer rgyal ba rnams kyis sems can gyi nyon mongs brgyad khri bzhi stong gi gnyen por/ chos phung brgyad khri bzhi 474

stong gsungs pa thams cad glegs bam du byas phyogs gcig tu brtsigs rgyu yin na/ nam mkha'i dbyengs dang mnyam la/ de kun gye tshig don mtha' yas pa/ rags rim tsam mdor hril gyis dril nas/ rgyu pha rol tu phyin pa'i theg pa dang / 'bras bu rdo rje theg pa gnyis su 'du / des na mdo sngags zhes gsungs pa rgya chung zhig tu go mi rung / bod du dar ba'i grub mtha' 'di rnams mdo sngags kyi chos kye khongs su gtogs pa tsam du ma zad/ mdo sngags chos kun gyis kyang snying bo'i yang snying yin zhes sngon byon mkhas grub rgenam gyis sa bkab pa lta bu ri dang brag 'dra ba mtshan bskal par mi nub pa'i skyes bu dam pa mang pos lung rigs gnyis kyi sgo nas lan cig ma yin yang yang bsgrubs zin pa/ khyod kyis de rnams min zhes smras na/ khyod phyogs bcu'i chos pa thams cad kyi khyu nas bud pa yin pas ngo mi tsha'am/ da khyod chos mdzad mi mang 'tshogs pa lta bu'i khrod nas mar ro ltar bud ma 'jog yar tshongs dang / ngas khyod la blo bsgyed gcig ster/ spyir dge mi dge gnyis su 'gyur mi 'gyur lus ngag gnyis kyi steng nas mi 'jog sems kho na'i steng nas 'jog ste/ lung las/ yid ni rab tu 'khrugs pa yis/ /byas pa dang ni bab/gas pa dag /thams cad mi dge'i 475

las su gyur/ /yid ni rab tu dwangs pa yis/ /byas pa dang ni bsags pa dag /thams cad dge ba'i las su gyur/ /zhes dang / slob dpon klu sgrub kyis/ 'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug gsum/ /des bskyed las ni mi dge ba'o/ /ma chags mi sdang gti mug med/ /des bskyed las ni dge ba'o/ /zhes dang /rje rin po ches/ dkar nag las rnams bsam pa bzang ngan lags/ /bsam pa bzang na sa dang lam yang bzang bsam pa dman na sa dang lam yang dman/ /thams cad bsam pa dag la rag las pas/ /gsungs/ jo bo rjes/ kho bo'i sgom pa rin chen bla ma bsgoms skad/ sgom tsa na bsgoms pas dar yug dang ja sig mang po yongs sems na/ ji tsam bsgoms kyang sdig shā yin/ sgom tsa na skye ba'i rgya mtsho mthar dbyung byang chub mchog gi sa bon btab sems na/ sems pa tsam zhig byas pa'i bsod nams nam mkhar mi shong gsungs/ yang rtsa ba dug yin na yal ga dang lo ma dug rtsa ba sman yin na yal ga dang lo ma sman du yong ba bzhin/ rtsa ba 'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug gsum gyis kun nas bslangs pa'i las ci byas pa thams cad mi dge ba yin gsungs/ kun bzang snying thig las/ rang gi sems la sems can 'di gsod do snyam pa lan cig shar kyang /476

des phyi mar lan cig gsod do/ /gzhan gsod par bskul na pha rol gyi rgyud kyang chud gson pa ste/ skye ba nyis brgyar srog lan smin par 'gyur ro gsungs/ kun mkhyen pad+ma dkar pos/byang chub sems dpa' snying rje can gyis mi nag po bsad pa'i tshe ma chags pa dang / zhe sdang med pa dang / gti mug med pa'i sems kyis pha rol srog dang bral bar byas pa yin pas/ 'phen rdzogs gnyis ka nyon mongs med pa'i phyir srog gcod pa'i mi dge ba'i las lam yod pa ma yin pas/ gnas ngan len ma yin gye/ mi dge ba'i gzugs brnyan tsam du zad do/ /de bzhin du dge slong ma ser skya bzang mo la rgyal po ma skyes dgras/'dod pa lan mang du spyad du zin kyang / dge slong ma la 'dod chags kyi sems med pa'i phyir des pham pa bskyed mi nus par nyan thos kyi theg par yang gsungs so/ /zhes pa dang /sngon sprang po gnyis kyi gcig gis/ dge 'dun pa 'di rnams kyi ske 'khor los bcad pa zhig byung na zhes khros te smras pas rnam smin gyis kho bo lam du nyal bas shing rta'i 'khor lo zhig gis kho bo'i mgo bo bcad/ gcig gis dge 'dun pa 'di rnams lha'i bdud rtsi'i mchod du yod na'ang snyam pas/ bsod nams chen po skyes/tshong dpon chen po zhig gi tshab du dbang bskur nas bde skyid 477

myangs/ sngon lam 'gram zhig na thub pa'i 'dra sku zhig yod pa char dang thig pas 'jigs kyis dogs nas/ mi gcig gis lham chad cig thub pa'i dbu la skyon nas song / phyi nas mi gcig gis mthong nas a kha btsog pa 'di thub pa'i dbu la bskon mi rung snyam mar blangs/ mi de gnyis gar bsod nams thob skad/ rje rgod tshang pas/ chags na yi dam gyi lha la chags na yang 'phung bya ba yin/ tshe 'di'i rnam bzhag 'dod nas sam/ bla ma las yi dam bzang bar bzung na ni/ mgon po phyag drug pa 'grub nas yi dwags su skyes pa'i lo rgyus dang / te ru gar grub kyang / zhal gsum phyag drug par krong nge dmyal bar song ba'i lo rgyus yod de/ kun slong ngan pa'i lha sgrub tsa na/ lha gsal ba dang / nyon mongs de gsal/lha de grub pa dang nyon mongs pa de'i yang nus pa 'grub nas/ dmyal bar song ba yin/he ru ga'i gzugs brnyan du song bas/ lan pa lags mod/mdor na nyon mongs pas kun nas bslang nas/ sgo gsum bya ba ci byed mi dgos par 'gyur bas/ yid dam des sgrub pa byas tshad mi dag par song nas yod pa lags mod/ las mi dge ba bsags na/ zhal gsum phyag drug pa bas/ phyag 'bum par song yang dmyal bar 'gro/ des na kun slong ma 'chugs pa gal 478

che gsungs/ de la dgongs nas paṇa chen rin po ches/ chos rnams kun gyi dang po'i mgo /rgya gar skad mtshungs rang rgyud la/ /legs par brtags pa yin no zhes/ /zla med bla ma mchog des bzhed/ /gsungs so/ /khyad par grub mtha' phan tshun smad na rtsa ltung du 'gyur mi 'gyur te/ dgos pa yod med/ bsam pa bzang ngan gye steng nas 'jog dgos te/ de yang bstan pa dang gdul bya la phan pa'i dgos pa chen po yod nas/ phan sems kyi kun nas bslang nas mdo sngags kyi nang phan tshun brgya smad rung / sngags kyi rtsa ltung du mi 'gyur ba tsam du ma zad/nyes ltung chung ngur yang mi 'gyur la/ nyes pa med par ma zad bsod nams kyang mang du raphel la/ de 'dra'i dgos chen phan sems dang mi ldan par/ rang dgar smras na sngags kyi rtsa ltung phog par ma zad/ byang sems so thar gyi ltung pa yang phog la/de yi mi tshad chos spong gi las ngan pa yang gsog par 'gyur ro/ /de bzhin tu mdo sngags na las rgya 'dod yon sogs kyi gnang bkag mi 'dra ba mang po yod pa rnams kyang dgos pa yod med/yod na che chung / bsam pa bzang ngan/ nyon mongs pa'i gnyen por 'gyur mi 'gyur sogs la rtogs dpyod zhib tu btang nas/sdom pa gsum gyi bcas pa dang 'gal mi 'gal gyi dgongs pa 479

lon nas blang dor byed pa gces so/ /rang dgar tshig tsam bden par bzung nas 'khrul bar mi bya'o/ /yang 'ga' res rang rang gi grub mtha' gong 'og phan tshun smod mi rung nyes pa yod/ gzhan smad na nyes pa med zer na/ yang khyod la dri ba gnyis byed rgyu snang /khyod kyis bstan 'gro la phan pa'i dgos pa chen po zhig yod pa shes nas phan sems kyis smad na nyes pa med zer ram/ kun slong ngan pa'am/ rang dgar smras na yang nyes pa med zer so sor ma 'dres par shod dang / dgos ched yod tshe phan sems kyis smad na nyes pa med zer na/ skyon cher med la/ 'on kyang rang 'dod dang ma 'dres pa'i gzhan phan gyi kun slong skye ba u dum wa ra las kyang dkon la/ kun slong bzang kyang sbyor ba ngan na 'bras bu bde sdug spel mar bshad pa yang yod/ skyon yon tan du bsgyur nus pa sa thob kyi byang chub sems dpa' zhig gis spyod yul yin gyi/ 'o skol shes rgyud nyon mongs kyis gang 'dug pa rnams kyi mtha' gcig tu dag snang kho na la brten na legs/ kun slong ngan pa'am/rang dgar smras kyang nyes pa med do zer na/ de chos gtan nas ma shes pa'i rang mtshang thams cad bstan pa yin te/ de ngo tsha rgyu med pa'i spyon pa zhig gis lab rgyu zhig yin pas/ chos 480

pa zhig gis kha nas thon par ma sems/ rgyal ba'i gsung rab mdo rgyud bstan bcos nas kun slong ngan pas brnab sems log lta 'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug nga rgyal phrag dog ser sna/'jig rten chos brgyad sogs kyis kun nas bslang / gzhan chos dang gang zag la brnyas smod khyad gsod sun 'byin skur 'debs sogs lus ngag gi mi dge bdun byas na nyes dmigs che tshul bsam gyis mi khyab brjod kyis mi lang pa/ rgyal ba'i gsung rab na yod pa'i nang nas ngas zur tsam re ston pas/khyed kyi de rnams la thugs bsam re thongs/ de yang grub mtha' gzhan smad na mi de nam yang thar ba thob mi srid de/ rje mi las/mkhas btsun thabs cad thugs mthun pas/ /pho rus chags sdang byed pa rnams/ /bablo/ba tshad chu la 'bo ba yin/ /chos la dkar nag med pa la/ /grub mtha'i kha 'dzin chos la smod/ /thar ba'i 'ju thag chad pa yin/ /gsungs/ gzhan yang nga rgyal byang chub sgrub mkhan gyi lam la bar chad byed pa'i bdud yin/yon tan la yar bskyed mi 'byung mar 'grib ste/ rje mi las/bdud du nga rgyal che'o gsungs/ rje skal ldan rgya mtshos/ nga rgyal can la yon tan yar bskyed med/ /ha cang skad mgo ma mtho ri khrod pa/ /gsungs/ 'brom rin po ches/ nga rgyal can gzigs 481

tsa na/ rka 'go ma mtho/ rka 'go ma mtho/ rka 'go mtho na yur ba la mar chu mi 'ong / nga rgyal can la yon tan mi skye gsungs/des na jo bo chen pos/ dregs rlom nga rgyal khengs pa'i sems kun smod la zhi zhing dul bar gyis/ yon tan can la phrag dog mi bya gus par gyis la yon tan longs gsungs/ rje mi las/slob ma rnams la dman pa'i sa bzung / hrul ba'i gos gyon/gyong lto gos gtam gsum la thongs/ yang / ga ler skyod dang mgyogs por slebs/ /dman sa bzung dang rgyal sa zin/ /gsungs/ gzhan yang rang phyogs kyi chos dang / gang zag la chags shing zhen pa che/ gzhan chos dang gang zag mthong thos khong khro skye ba rnams phyi nas 'khor bar 'khyams/ sdug bsngal myong/ myang 'das kyi bde ba nam yang mi thob ste/ting 'dzin rgyal bo las/ gang zhig chos 'di thos nas chags byed cing / /chos ma yin par thos nas khong khro byed/ /nga rgyal rgyags pas bcom pa log pa ste/ /nga rgyal dbang gi sdug bsngal rjes su myong / /zhes dang / brgya pa las/ rang gi phyogs la chags yod cing / /gzhan phyogs la khyod mi dga' na/ /mya ngan 'das par mi 'gro ste/ /gnyis spyod zhi bar yongs mi 'gyur/ /zhes dang /yongs 'dzin ye shes rgyal mtshan rin po ches/ rang gi lta ba la 482

chags pa dang / de bzhin du gzhan phyogs kyi lta ba la rgyud 'khrugs pa gang yin pa de ni 'ching ba'i rtog pa nyid yin pas/khro chags kyi rtog pa ma log par 'phel bas 'ching ba nyid du 'gyur gyi/thar ba ni min no zhes gsungs/ gzhan yang dmyal bar skye ba'i rgyu'i gtso bo 'o/ga lta yin te/ sngon gter ston zhig la grwa ba zhig gis gsang sngags kyi chos zhus/ gsungs tshe grwa ba'i blor ma shong / 'gal 'brel mang po bsdebs nas/ de ma red 'di ma red zhus/ chos log cig red snyam nyams su len mi dgos dad log byas pas sa gas nas dmyal ba rdo rje gdan du lhung song skad/ yang bla ma zhig gis kho bo'i ring lugs 'di ma gtogs gzhan thams cad chos rnam dag min zhes log par bltas zhe sdang gis chos lugs gzhan la dgag pa mang po btang bas tshe der dug sbrul 'dom pa gang tsam du gyur nas nags gseb cig tu song skad/ yang sngon chos smra ba chos shes pa gcig gis/ ngas bstan pa'i chos 'di yin gyis gzhan ma yin no/ /zhes chos smra ba ba/cig la smad pas/ bskal pa bdun cur dmyal bar skyes/ tshe dgu khrir dud 'gror skyes/ drug khrir mi dbul bo lce med par gyur/ gsungs/ kun bzang snying thig las/ log lta zhes pa bsar/ blos mthong snang log pa ste/ legs 483

pa nyes par mthong ba/ yin pa min par 'dzin pa/ bden pa rdzun du blta ba/ phan byas gnod du blta ba/ bzang byas ngan du blta ba sogs bla ma dang sangs rgyas la bdud sbrul du blta ba/skyon gyi gong bur blta zog khram bslu byed du blta ba/don phyin log phyogs ris don med du blta ba/ khyad par las rgya brten pa dang / bsgral pa'i drag las sogs gsang sngags kyi lta spyod zab mo la chos min 'chal par blta ba/ smyo spyod tshul min du blta ba 'di dag ni log par mthong nas bltas pa yin te/nyes ltung ni/ 'khor ba ma stongs kyi bar du rdo rje dmyal ba nas thon mi srid pas gang la'ang ngo mtshar bar mthong zhing log lta yud tsam ma skyes par bya'o/ /zhes gsungs/ gzhan yang brnab sems sgyes na nyes pa che ste/ yang kun bzang snying thig las/brnab sems zhes pa tshogs drug gi yul la/ dung sems byed pa ste/ gzhan gyi mnga' thang longs spyod bza' btung gos grogs thams cad bdag gi dbang du bya snyam pa'i 'dun pa bskyed pas yi dwags kyi gnas su bskal pa stong phrag gcig tu gnas shing sdug bsngal pas/ ci la'ang zhen chags kyi snang ba skad cig kyang ma skyes par bya'o gsungs/ gzhan yang bde skyid rnyed bkur sogs 'jig rten chos brgyad 'dod nas/ las 484

dge ba byas kyang nyes pa che ste/ 'brom ston pa rin po ches/ jo bo rje/ tshe 'di'i bde skyid rnyed bkur 'dod nas byas pa'i las rnams la 'bras bu ci mchi zhus pas/ lan du 'bras bu de kho na nyid mchi gsungs/ phyi mar ci mchi zhus pas/ dmyal ba mchi/ yi dwags mchi/ dud 'gro mchi gsungs/ dge bshes dgon pa pa'i zhal nas/ chos brgyad kyi bsam pas byas pa rnams la 'bras bu 'dod pa bzhin byung na/ tshe 'di la 'bras bu de rang yin/ phyi mar phan pa med/ mi 'dod pa bzhi byung na/tshe 'di la yang phan pa med gsungs/ de la dgongs nas/ bla ma zhang gis/ kun slong ngan pa dang ma 'dres par/ 'jig rten bya ba mtha' dag spangs te/ shin tu dgon pa zhig tu 'du long la sogs pa tshar bcad gsungs/ rje bdag nyid chen pos kyang / dge 'dis mtshon nas dus gsum dang 'brel ba'i/ /bdag gzhan dge ba'i rtsa ba ji snyed pa/ /de dag thams cad skye zhing skye ba ru/ /byang chub mchog gi rjes su mi mthun pa'i/ /shes kyi khe 'dod 4 dang grags pa dang / /'khor dang rnyed bkur grags sogs nude ba'i rgyur/ /skad cig tsam yang smin par mi 'gyur zhing / /bla med byang chub kho na'i rgyur gyur cig /ces sgon lam btab pa lags so/ /gzhan yang bstan 485

pa 'dzin skyong spel gsum mdzad pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i sprul pa bla ma chos mdzad rnams la khros nas/rgyab kyis phyogs smad na nyes dmigs shin tu che ste/ dad pa'i stobs bskyed pa la 'jug pa'i phyag rgya'i mdo las/ 'ga' zhig khros nas phyogs bcu'i sems can btson ra mun nag tu bcug pa las/ khros te byang sems la rgyab kyis phyogs te/ 'dug nas ma rungs pa 'di mi blta'o zer na/ sdig ches grangs med pa bskyed pa dang / 'dzam bu gling gi sems can thams cad kyi bdog pa thams cad 'phrog pa pas/ byang sems gang yang rung ba smad na sdig ches gra ngas med pa bskyed pa dang / mchod rten gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed bshig pa dang / bsreg pa las theg pa chen por mos pa'i byang sems la/ gnod sems dang khong khro bskyed cing mi snyan pa smras na sdig ches grangs med bskyed gsungs/ ta thā ga ta bdun gyi smon lam gyi mdo las/'jam dpal gzhan yang sems can gang dag bdag gis bsngags pa brjod cing / phrag dog gis gzhan la mi snyan pa brjod pa yod pa de/ bdag la bstod cing / gzhan la smod pa'i sems can de dag ngan song gsum po dag tu lo stong phrag mang por sdug bsngal myong bar 'gyur ro/ /de dag lo stong phrag 486

du mar 'das nas/ de nas shi 'phos nas/ ba glang dang / rta dang / rnga mong dang / bong bu la sogs par dud 'gro'i skye gnas rnams su skye bar 'gyur/ lcug lcags dang / dbyeg lcags rnams kyis brdeg par 'gyur/ bkres pa dang skom pa'i nyon mongs pa dang / khal chen po bkal te lam du 'gro bar 'gyur ro/ /gal te brgya 'a/ mi'i rnyed pa rnyed na yang / rtag tu rigs dma' ba rnams kyi nang du skye bar 'gyur/ bran du 'gyur zhing gzhan gyi dbang du 'gyur ro zhes gsungs/ 'od bsrung gi le'u las/ bangag gi skyon ni 'chab byed dang / /pha rol nyes pa rtog byed pa/ /'di gnyis dug gi rma dang 'dra/ /rtogs pa rnams kyis rma 'di spongs/ /zhes dang / rje mi las/bdag bstod gzhan la smod pa ni/ /'jigs pa'i g.yang sar lhung ngo gsungs/ /zhes / nga / dam tshig rdo rje'i rnam bshad las/ g.yo sgyu sna tshogs sgo nas smod pa ni/ /lce gtub zhing rmos dmyal bar ltung bar 'gyur/ /zhes dang / bla ma lnga bcu pa las/ slob dpon la ni smod pa de/ /yams dang 'tshe ba'i nad rnams dang / /gdon dang rims dang dug rnams kyis/ /rmongs chen de ni 'chi bar 'gyur/ /rgyal po me dang sbrul gdug dang / /chu dang mkha' 'gro rkun po dang / /gdon dang log 487

'dren rnams kyis kyang / /bsad nas sems can dmyal bar 'gro/ /gsungs/ de bzhin du mdo rgyud bstan bcos thams cad nas bdag bstod gzhan smod 'di sdig che bar gsungs/byang chub sems dpa'i chos kyi sbyin pa gtong ba la dgag pa btang nas bar chad byas na nyes pa che ba smos ci dgos/ tha na dud 'gro la zan zhig ster ba'i bar chad byas na nyes dmigs shin tu che ste/ rab tu zhi ba rnam par nges pa'i cho 'phrul gye mdo las/ 'dzam gling gi sems can thams cad kyi srog bcad dam bdog pa thams cad 'phrog pa las/ byang sems kyis tha na dud 'gro la zan chang gcig sbyin pa'i dge ba la bar chad byas na sdig pa ches grangs med par bskyed par gsungs/ rdzogs chen 'bring po bya ba nas/ gzhan chos byed pa'i gegs byas na lam pas srog gcod pa bya ba yin pas/ khams gsum gyes sems can thams cad bsad pa pas sdig che zhes gsungs/gzhan grub mtha' 'dzin pa'i rgyal sras byang chub sems dpa' la gnod 'tshe zhig byung na snyam pa'i ngan sems skad cig ma ci tsam skyes pa'i grangs dang mnyam par bskal par dmyal bar gnas pa sogs nyes dmigs shin tu che ste/ spyod 'jug las/gang zhig de 'dra'i rgyal sras sbyin bdag la/ /gal te ngan 488

sems bskyed par byed pa de/ /ngan sems bskyed pa'i grangs bzhin nga bskal par ni/ /dmyal bar gnas par 'gyur zhes thub pas gsungs/ /zhes dang / kun bzang snying thig las/gnod sems zhes pa pha rol gang la 'ong tshe dpal mthu stobs snyan grags sogs nyams pa dang brlag pa gcig byung nas zad cing stongs na ci ma rung snyam pa'i sems ngan shar na bskal pa 'bum du tsha ba'i dmyal ba bar 'tshams med pa myong dgos gsungs/ bde mchog bsdus pa las/ rnal 'byor che la gang zhig sdang / /khye yi skye ba brgyar skyes kyang / /rme sha can du skye bar 'gyur/ /gsungs/ de'i rnam smin dge ba gang byas kyang skyob mi nus te/ ting 'dzin rgyal po las/ gcig la gcig ni gnod sems byas na ni/ /de la tshul khrims thos pas skyob mi nus/ /bsam gtan mi skyob dgon gnas skyob mi nus/ /sbyin pas mi skyob sangs rgyas mchod pas min/ /zhes gsungs/ byang chub sems dpa' la dmigs nas khong khro gcig sgyes kyang /bskal pa grangs med par bsags pa'i dge kun 'joms na tshe 'dir bsags tshad smos ce dgos/ spyod 'jug las/ bskal pa stong du bsags pa yi/ /sbyin dang bde gshegs mchod la sogs/ /legs spyad gang yin de kun kyang / /khong khro gcig 489
