gis 'joms par byed/ /ces dang / 'jug pa las/ gang phyir rgyal sras rnams la khros pa yis/ /sbyin dang khrims byung dge ba bskal pa brgyar/ /bsags pa skad cig gcig 'joms de yi phyir/ /mi bzod las gzhan sdig pa yod ma yin/ /gsungs/ bla ma dam pa 'ga' res/ zhe sdang skad cig gcig gis kyang / /bskal pa stong gi dge rtsa 'joms/ /gsungs/byang chub sems dpa' zer ba de'i rgyud na gzhan phan gyes bsam pa yod tshad yongs la byang chub sems dpa' zer/ byang chub sems dpa' ni thal bas bkab pa'i me bzhin/ gang la yod mi shes gzab dgos zhes 'brom ston pa rin po ches gsungs/ de bzhin du rje skal ldan rgya mtshos kyang / byang chub sems dpa' gang na bzhugs mi shes/ /mthong thos kun la ma smod ri khrod pa/ /gsungs/ dam pa 'ga' res dge slong bzhi sde zhig 'tshogs pa'i nang na'ang byang chub sems dpa' re yod gsungs/ rgad po 'ga' res rkun ma dang byang chub sems dpa' gar yod mi shes zer/ des na su la brnyas smod khong khro skye mi rung / gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' phar zhogagang zag mchog dman gang la brten nas/ khong khro sgyes na sngar byas dge rtsa kun 'joms nas sgren mo lag stong lta bur 490

'gyur te/ rgyal dbang lnga ba rin po che'i zhal nas/ skye bar bsags pa'i dge tshogs na gas kyi klung / /khong khro'i me dpung gcig gis rab bsregs nas/ /mi dge'i sdong dum srid pa'i rtser srungs pa'i/ /mi bzod dgra 'di sdug bsngal kun gyi gzhi/ /zhes dang / rig 'dzin gang shar rang grol gyis/khong khro zer ba'i sdig can de/ /lan cig byung na dge kun 'joms/ /mang po byung na smos ci dgos/ /rus rang sa sud ma byed ang / /zhes dang / kun mkhyen klong chen rab 'byams pas/ gdug sems nagab/ kyi me chen 'dra/ /rang rgyud dge ba'i bud shing bsregs/ /da res bzod pa'i go gyon la/ /khong khro'i zug rngu phyungs na legs// /zhes gsungs/ dper na rtswa phung ri rab tsam zhig spungab/ yod pa'i nang du me chen mi dgos/me stag chung chung zhig lhung kyang thams cad rtsa ba nas 'tshig pa ltar/ sngar skye ba 'di dang sngon ma rnams su dge ba ci byas pa thams cad khong khro yun ring mi dgos/ se gol gtogs pa'i yun tsam zhig skyes kyang rtsa ba nas 'joms par 'gyur/ sngar dge ba ma thub gi de thub cung zad re byas yod pa thams cad rtsa ba nas khong khros 'joms du bcug nas/ don med chud zos su btang na/ rang gis rang la pham de phan ster rgyu med/491

'ga' res dge sbyor re byas/ cung zad re khong khro re ldang ba 'di dper na me re sbar/ chu re blugs nas bsad/ rtswa re spungs sar me re bzhag nas bsreg pa dang 'dra bas rang gi rang la sdug bskol ba ma gtogs don go mchod cig med/ deng sang 'di gnyis ka byed pa mang / zhe sdang dmyal bar 'phen byed kyi rgyu'i gtso bo yin te/ rje mi las/ zhe ldang che na dmyal ba'i sgrog /gsungs/ rgyal ba garma pas/ zhe sdang 'bras bus dmyal ba dang / /gsungs/ khong khro'i dbang gis gzhan la tshig rtsub smras na rnam smin lci ste/ tshig rtsub gang smras phyi mar dmyal ba'i nang du skyes tshe/ gshin rje'i pho nya rnams kyis mi de'i kha nas/ lce phyir phyungs gri rnon pos bcad nas slar kha nang du 'jog ces mdo dran pa nyer bzhag las gsungs/ sngon sangs rgyas 'od bsrung gi bstan pa la/ tshems bu mkhan gyes rang gi phu bo phyir mi 'ong ba la/ 'phye bo zhes tshig rtsub smras pas/tshe rabs mang por 'phye bor gyur/ dge slong ma zhig gis/ dge slong ma gzhan mang po la ba lang dzi bo zhes smras pas/tshe rabs mang por ba lang rdzir gyur/ bu mo gser mdog gis dge 'dun rnams la byad gzugs mi sdug pa dang rigs ngan sogs kyi tshig rtsub smras pas/ gang du skyes kyang gzugs byad mi sdug 492

pa dang rigs ngan du skyes/ byang chub sems dpa' snang ba bsam gyis mi khyab pas/ byang sems lha bzang la nal bu khyod la yon tan cang med smras pas/ bskal pa dgu bcur nal bur skyes/ btsas ma thag tu mas bor bas/ khyi spyang sogs kyis zos/ dge slong gcig gis/ dge slong gzhan kha ton byed pa sbal pa ltar skad 'byin zhes smras pas/ skye ba lnga brgyar sbal bar skyes/ dge slong gcig gis dge slong gzhan gcig la spre'u 'dra smras pas/ spre'u'i skye ba lnga brgya blangs/ dge tshul gcig gis/ dge slong dgra bcom pa zhig la/ khyod dbyangs 'then pa khye zug pa 'dra'o smras pas khye'i skye ba lnga brgya blangs/ de rnams la dgongs nas rig 'dzin gang shar rang grol gyis/ gtam 'jam pos smra ba ma gtogs pa/ /ngo gnag cing tshig rtsub smra ba sogs/ /dug bzhin spong ba gnad du che/ /gsungs/ gzhan yang chos gang zag su la yang skur ba btab na sdig pa che ste/ rje mi las/ sdig tu skur ba che'o gsungs/ grub chen gling ras pas/ skur 'debs dmyal bar skur ba yin gsungs/ dam tshigs rdo rje'i rnam bshad las/ sgo bskur btab na dge slong 'bum bsad mtshungs/ /rnam smin mnar med dmyal ba kho nar lhung / /zhes gsungs/ sngon rgyal po gcig gis byang chub sems 493

dpa' la mchod pa'i phyir zhag bdun/ bud med lnga brgyas glu gar rol mo byas pa la/ khye'u bcus chos spra ba'i byang chub sems dpa' de la bud med kyi skur ba btab pas lo dgu khrir dmyal bar skyes/ tshe lnga brgyar za ma dang kla klo dang log lta can du skyes/ tshe drug brgyar dmus long dang lce med par 'gyur gsungs/ gzhan yang dus 'khor ye shes kyi le'u las/ sems can rnams ni sangs rgyas nyid de sangs rgyas chen po gzhan ni 'jig rten khams na yod ma yin/ de dag mnyes par byas pas dpag med srid pa gcod par byed de rnam par mi rtog pa las so/ /rnal 'byor pa ni 'khu bar byed na dmyal ba ngu 'bod chen po'i mtha' ru 'gro bar 'gyur/ de phyir sems ni dag pa na yang mkhas dang mi mkhas skye bo rnams la 'gal ba mi bya'o gsungs/ gzhan yang rab byung gis gzhan la 'tshe ba smos ci dgos/ tshur la mi 'dod pa byas pa la lan byed mi rung ste/ rje btsun ye shes rgyal mtshan gyis/ gshe yang slar mi gsho khro yang slar mi khro/ 'ardeg kyang slar mi brdeg mtshang brus kyang slar mi 'bru 'di dge sbyong gi chos bzhi yin gsungs pa ltar/rgyal ba sras bcas kyis mgrin gcig ltar gsungs pas na /phar la khong khro'am brdeg brdung mtshang 'bru gang byas kyang dge 494

sbyong gi chos bzhi shor ba yin la/ de shor ma thag nas nang ba sangs rgyas kyi rjes su 'jug dge slong rab byung chos pa rnams kyi gral du mi chud de/ mdo las/ bzod pa dka' thub bzod pa dam pa ni/ /mya ngan 'das la mchog ces sangs rgyas gsungs/ /rab tu byung ba gzhan la gnod pa dang / /gzhan la 'tshe ba dge sbyong ma yin no/ /zhes gsal bar gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /ston pa'i rjes 'jug rnams kyi gral nas mar bud phyin chad da ha go grong gi rgan rgon khong khro can sdang mig bltas bza' sdig thug pa bzhin bskol ba'i gral yin/ de min na bstan pa'i bla btsong / rab byung gi rkang 'dren sngar med pa'i rgad po mgo ril khyad chos can zhig gsar du byung ba yin pas/ ming la sngar med rgad po mig ril zhes ngas btags pa yin pas/ kun gyis de lta ra 'bod par rigs so/ /gzhan yang bla ma dge ba'i bshes gnyen rnams la mnar sems sogs skyes na/ rang rgyud la yon tan gang yang mi 'ong / gzhan theg pa gsum gye gang zag dang chos smra ba la gus pa sogs ma byas na chos nub par 'gyur te/ da ltar gyi sangs rgyas mngon sum pa'i ting 'dzin rgyal po las/ gal te des de la mnar sems sam/ tha ma'am sdang ba jo'i sems kyi gnas na/ de'i yon 495

tan thob pa'i gnas med do/ /ston pa'i 'du shes mi skyed na'ang de bzhin 'di ltar theg pa gsum ga'i gang zag dang chos ston pa'i dge slong la gus pa dang / bla ma'am ston pa'i 'du shes mi bskyed na de dag ma 'thob pa'i chos thob pa'am/thob pa chud mi za ba ni gnas med de/ ma gus pas ni chos nub par 'gyur ba'i phyir ro zhes gsungs so/ /gzhan yang mkhas btsun bzang gsum gang na yid mi shes pas/ ma shes bzhin nam/ shes bzhin mkhas pa'i gral gong du bsdad na lci ba bzhi'i nang nas gcig yin la/ rgyal sras kyi spyod las nyams par 'gyur zhing / khyad par chos 'brel cung zad tsam zhig yod pa'i gong du bsdad na nyes pa de bas che ste/ dam tshig rdo rje'i rnam bshad las/ chos tshig gsum tshun zhus pa'i gong du bsdad na shes rab 'chal pa'i rigs su skye zhes dang / dgra nag dka' 'grel las/ tshigs bcad gcig tsam nyan pa yang / /gang gis bla mar mi 'dzin dpa/ /khyi yi sgye ba brgya blangs nas/ /rme sha can du skye bar 'gyur/ /gsungs pa sogs nyes dmigs mtha' yas pa gsungs so/ /gzhan yang dper na rdo rtsig gi nang nas rdo gcig tsam phyir 'then kyang gzhan thams cad mi brtan par 'jigs pa ltar/ zhe sdang gi dbang 496

gis sems can gcig tsam yal bar 'dor ba'i blo skad cig ma gcig skyes kyang byang chub kyi sems nyams pa yin/ byang chub kyi sems rin po che nyams ma thag nas/ theg chen byang chub sems dpa'i gral nas mar ro ltar bud pa yin no/ /byang chub kyi sems bla med sangs rgyas kyi rgyu sa bon lta bu/ gzhan phar phyin drug rim gnyis sogs chu lud drod gsher dang mtshungs pas/ sa bon med par chu lud sbyar kyang ston thog mi 'byung ba ltar/ byang chub kyi sems nyams pas dge sbyor bskal par 'bad kyang bla med rjogs pa'i sangs rgyas mi thob gsungs/chos shes kyin rang rgyud kyi nyon mongs chung du 'gro dgos pa la/dug gsum gru ma nyams nga/'i steng du rang mthong nga rgyal gzhan mtho bar dogs pa'i phrag dog sogs bsnan nas/ je cher btang na rang theg pa chen po'i chos pa bstan 'dzin du brgya rlom kyang phyin chad gting mtha' med pa'i 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho chen por bying nas/ las dang nyon mongs pa'i rba rlabs drag pos g.yengs shing 'khyer sdug bsngal du ma'i chu srin 'jigs rung dang srin bu du mas za bzhin skabs re mtho ris kyi mtsho khar son rgyun du ngan song gsum gyi mtsho gting du bying nas 'khor ba na ma gnas bar du 'o brgyal myong bzhin du sdod 497

dgos/ thar ba'i dus mi 'byung / theg chen byang chub kyi sems mnga' ba gar yod mi shes pas yongs la dad gus byas/yon tan brjod/ mchod bstod bkur na bsod nams che ste/nges pa dang ma nges pa la 'jug pa phyag rgya'i mdo las/ phyogs bcu'i sems can gyi mig phyung ba byams pa'i sems kyis mig slar bskyed pa dang / sems can snga ma rnams btson ra nas bton te 'khor bsgyur ram/ tshangs pa'i bde la bkod pa bas/rim pa ltar theg chen la mos pa'i byang sems la dang bas blta ba dang / dang bas blta 'dod cing / de'i bsngags pa brjod na bsod nams ches grangs med par bskyed par gsungs/sdong bo bkod pa'i mdo las/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen la bsnyen bkur byas pa'i byang chub sems dpa' rnams ni spyod pa thams cad la mi brjed par spyod pa yin no/ /dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyis yongs su bzung ba'i byang chub sems dpa' rnams ni/las dang nyon mongs pa rnams kyis thub par dka' ba yin no/ /zhes dang / skyes rabs las/ dam pa rnams ni sus kyang mi srid ste/ /dul ba'i tshul gyis dge ba brten par bya/ /nga dang nye na de yi yon tan rdul/ /ched du ma bsgos par yang gos par 'gyur/ /zhes pa la sogs mdo rgyud bstan bcos du ma 498

nas phan yon mtha' yas par gsungs/ 'gro don gyi mchog kyang chos pa bkur na yin te/ rje rgod tshang pas/ snyigs ma'i dus su 'gro don chos pa thams cad spyi bor khur nas/ rang gis 'gro don ma byas par sgrub pa tshul bzhin byas na 'gro don che gsungs/ rgyal sras lag len kyang de yin/ rgyal sras thogs med kyis/ rang dang mnyam pa'am dman pa'i skye bo yi/ /nga rgyal dbang gis brnyas thabs byed na'ang / /bla ma bzhin du gus pas bdag nyid kyi/ /spyi bor len pa rgyal sras lag len yin/ /gsungs/ des na srid zhi'i bde skyid kyi dpal la rol 'dod pa'i blo gros can rnams kyi gzhan gyi chos dang gang zag rab 'bring tha gsum gang la yang dad gus dag snang byas/ yon tan phyogs bcur bsgrags/ dngos sam yid kyi phyag mchod byas/ dus rgyun du mchod bstod bsnyen bkur phun sum tshogs pa byas na phan yon dpag tu med pa 'byung tshul dang / bdag 'dzin nye ring chags sdang nga rgyal phrag dog gi dbang gis gzhan gyi chos dang gang zag bzang ngan su la brnyas smod tshig rtsub khyad gsod sun 'byin skur 'debs sogs byas na nyes dmigs bsam gyis mi khyab pa yod ces rgyal ba'i bka' mdo rgyud bstan bcos/ bla ma gong ma du mas gsungs pa rnams la 499

zhib tu rtog dpyod btang nas/ gshe skur sogs mi byed par/snyan pa sgogs pa gces te/ rgyal ba rgod tshang pas/ spyir sems can thams cad/ sgos chos thams cad la mi gshe mi skur bar/ snyan pa'i ba dan phyogs bcur sgrogs gsungs/ dper na khyem tshang 'ga' res rgyu nom che chung thams cad bsags na phyug por 'gro bar shes nas rgyu nom rnyed tshad bsags/ gcig kyang mi 'dor ma rnyed pa rnams kyang rnyed pa'i thabs la 'bad nas/ yid smon byed pa ltar/ skyes bu blo gros can rnams kyis chos thams cad nyams su blangs nas sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par shes nas/ rgyal ba'i gsung rab rnams ci nus kyi nyams su blangs/ mi lon pa rnams kyang mi spangs par nam zhig nyams su lon pa zhig 'ong na snyam/ de'i rgyur tshogs bsags sgrib sbyong smon lam 'debs dgos ste/ rje bdag nyid chen pos/ gsung rabs thams cad gang zag gcig 'tshang rgya ba'i cha rkyen du 'gyur ba'i tshul la nges pa bstan par byas la/da lta nyams su lon pa rnams nyams su blangs shing / dngos su 'jug ldog ma nus kyang / de rang nyid kyis 'jug ldog ma nus pa rgyu mtshan du byas nas mi spangs par/ de dag la dngos su 'jug ldog gi sgo nas nyams su len pa zhig nam zhig na 'ong 500

snyam du bsam nas/ de'i rgyur tshogs bsags pa dang / sgrib pa sbyangs pa dang / smon lam gdab par bya'o/ /de nas ring bor mi thogs par blo'i mthu je che je cher song ste/ de dag thams cad nyams su len nus par 'gyur ro/ /zhes gsungs/paṇa chen thams cad mkhyen pas/ 'phags pa'i skye bo rnams kyi mdzad pa rnam thar so so'i skye bo rnams kyi yul las 'das shing /chos dang skyes bu dam pa la brten pa'i sdig pa ni shin tu mi zad pas/ phyogs 'dzin gyi sdang shugs dor nas/ dag snang nor bu'i 'od kyis khyab par mdzad du gsol zhes chos kyi rgyal mtshan gyis gsol ba 'debs so gsungs/ grub thob 'brug pa kun legs gyis/ byas pas chos rnams thams cad 'jig pa yin/ /ma byas chos ni kun gyes rtogs par dka'/ /chos spong grub mtha' 'dzin pa'i shes rab can/ /da khyod phyogs ris ma mdzad thugs la zhog /gsungs/ rig 'dzin gang shar rang grol gyis/ deng sang chos lugs grub mtha' mang thams cad sangs rgyas lam du gceg /don med kha sdig ma gsog par/ /kun la dag snang mdzod cig ang / /gsungs/glang ri thang pas/ sangs rgyas kyi chos thams cad 'bras bu dang bcas pa yin pas chos la bzang ngan du mi spyad gsungs/ rje sna 501

tshogs rang grol gyis/ grub mtha' chos rgyud rtsod pa'i bstan pa'i gzhog 'then dang / /chos la bzang ngan 'dzin pa'i cal sgrog rjes 'brang dang / /rang phyogs rgyal na dga' ba'i chags sdang kha 'dzin sogs/ /kun gyis nan ltar 'bad mod spang bya'i gtso bor gda'/ /gsungs/ rje btsun bsod nams seṅge'i zhal nas/ chos pas chos kyi rnam dbye la dpyad nas/ /gzhan skyon rtog pa shes rab yin snyam yang / /de la brten nas rang sdig bsog pa'i rgyu/ /dag snang phyogs med kho bo'i snying gtam yin/ /gsungs/ rje dge legs bstan 'dzin gyis/ rang snang dag na thams cad sangs rgyas dngos/ /dag snang phyogs med gyis shig shes ldan rnams/ /gsungs/ rje ngag dbang sangs rgyas rdo rjes/ phyogs ris zhen pa'i sgrib pa'i chur mig /ji tsam bltas kyang bstan bcos rgya che zhing / /mthong ba'i skabs bral de phyir dag snang gis/ /mig sman gsar ba bsten pa man ngag yin/ /gsungs/ stag tshang lo tsā bas/ phyogs 'dzin nyes pa kun gyi 'byung khungs phyir/ /sdang shugs tshul gyis gzhan sde smad mi rung / /gsungs/ sbyan snga pas/ rnying ma'i rdzogs rim sogs gtso bo yin pas/ rdzogs chen la sangs rgyas kyi chos med ces byar mi rung la/ chos spong ni mtshams med pa las lci ba 502

mang du gsungs pas bag yod par gyis gsungs/ rje btsun mi la ras pas/ theg pa'i khyad par mi rtog par/ /rang sems ming la zhen pa yis/ /lta ba nga yis bzung nas ni/ /gzhan la skur ba ma gdab 'tshal/ /gsungs/ bu ston rin po ches/chos kyi mtshan nyid gang la yod med dag /mi shes mthong ba med par rgyu bzhi yi/ /rnam dbye smra ba'i kha ni bdud kyi phye/ /chos la brnyas smod thub pa'i gzhung las bkag /gsungs/dpal gsang ba'i bdag pos/ des na thams cad la dag pa'i snang ba bskyed dgos gsungs/ rje rgod tshang pas/ ngas chos thams cad gcig tu bsdus/ nas bzhag tshe 'di blos gtong ba/sprang bos dman sa bzung nas thams cad spyi bor khur ba/kun la dag snang sbyong ba gsum yin/ bslab pa rin bo che gsum mam/ sdom pa gsum kyang 'dus sam snyam gsungs/ de bzhin du sngon gyi skyes chen dam pa mang pos gzhan chos lugs gang la dad gus dag snang sbyongs la/ rang nyid gang mos chos de nyams su longs zhes gsungs pa sha stag yin/ skyes chen dam pa gong ma gcig gis gsung yang mi brtsi bar/ dad gus dag snang gi gos lham phud/ ngo tsha med par gcer bur phyung /chags sdang gi gom pa shugs drag spos/ bdag bstod gzhan 503

smod kyi lab lob mang po kha nas bshad/ gti mug gi mig shes blang dor blta ba'i shes rab kyi mig 'bras rang dbang med par zums nas/ chos spong dang rtsa ltung gi nyes pas/ lag pa gnyis brgyangs nas shed gi dmyal ba'i me nang du mar mchongs ma 'jug ces rje dus gsum mkhyen pa paṇa chen rin po ches gsungs pa'i rjes bzlos byas/ phran chung ngas kyang lag pa thal mo sbyar nas/ khyod mchog dman 'bring gsum la/ 'o dod drag pos bos nas lan gsum gsol ba 'debs pas rgyal po'i gsungs la 'dangs rgyag rang gi rang nyid snying rje na tshig 'di kun gyis sgo gsum gus pas dang du longs dang / bde skyid snyan gsum 'byung bar gdon mi za'o/ /yang lha'i bdud rtsi dang 'phrad kyang len snod med pa'i lag stong ltar/ dam chos bdud rtsi dang 'phrad kyang / dang po'i snod med pa'i skal chad log lta can 'ga' res/ khyed kyis de ltar brgya stong bshad kyang kho bo da dung yid ches kyi dad pa zhig mi 'ong gi zhes zer na/ khyod nga dang nga 'dra'i gtam la yid mi ches pa bden kyang /dus gsum mkhyen pa'i rgyal ba sras bcas kyi zhal nas don med kyi rdzun nam yang mi gsungs pas na/ khyod mdo rgyud kyi lung dang bla ma mkhas grub du ma'i gsung la yid ches dgos ste/504

ting 'dzin rgyal po las/ zla ba skar mar bcas pa gnas ltung zhing / /ri dang grong dang bcas pas sa gzhi la/ /nam mkha'i khams ni rnam pa gzhan gyur kyang / /khyod ni mi bden pa yi tshig mi gsungs/ /zhes dang / rgyal dbang lnga bas/ rgyal ba'i gsung rabs bgrang yas chos phung tshogs/ /bsdu na rgyu 'bras theg pa gnyis su 'dus/ /mtha' dag 'gro la sman pa sha stag las/ /don med don log ston par mi srid kyang / /gsungs/slob dpon rnya rma kirti'i zhal nas/ lung ni yid ches tshig yin te/ /nyes pa zad pa rdzun gyi tshig /smra bar mi byed rgyu med phyir/ /nyes zad lung du shes par bya/ /zhes dang / rje btsun byams pas mdzad pa'i mardo sde rgyan las/ lung ma gtogs par rtog ge yi/ /chos gzhan rnam dag gnas ma yin/ /drang srong rnams kyis shes na yang / /de yang lung ni sngon du btang / /zhes dang / dbu ma rin chen sgro na me las/ bsgom pa gang yin lung dang ni/ /rig pa dang yang mi 'gal la/ /bla ma'i gdams ngag dang ldan pa'i/ /bsgom pa de nyid bsgom par 'os/ /zhes dang /bla ma gong ma 'ga' res/ rtog ldan nyams myong bde gshegs bka' dang 'dra/ /zhes gsungs/slob dpon ār+ya de wa sa brgyad par grags pa dang / slob dpon klu sgrub sa drug par grags pa 505

dang / slob dpon zhi ba lhar mkha' spyod kyi dngos grub thob pa dang / slob dpon a bh+ya logs ldan gyis rang gzhan gyi grub mtha' rgya mtsho tsam mkhyen cing / sku tshe de nyid kyi rig 'dzin gyes la gshegs pa'i mkhas pas kyang mdo rgyud kyi lung tshad mar 'dzin na/ 'o skol rnams kyis tshad mar 'dzin dgos pa smos ci dgos/ bstan bcos rtsom kyang gzhan yid ches pa'i phyir mdo rgyud kyi lung khungs su drangs nas rtsom pa yin/ khyod rgyal ba'i bka' la yid ches pa yon tan zhig ma yin/ bdud sdig can gyi byin gyes brlabs pa yin/ yid ches na sangs rgyas kyis rjes su bzung ba yin te/ 'phags pa dkon mchog sprin chen po'i mdo las/ de la yid mi ches pa thams cad ni bdud kyi byen gyis brlabs pas gti mug can no/ /de la sems pa ni sangs rgyas kyis yongs su bzung ba'o/ /gsungs/gal te khyod mdo rgyud bstan bcos kyi lung khungs la yid mi ches na/ 'o na da ha ha/ khyod 'di la yid e ches gi ltos/sngon sog po'i sman pas bod skad cher mi shes pa zhig gis/ bod kyi nad pa zhig gi rtsa myang nas bltas/ nad pa la khyod kyi lce gcig ston zer ba ma shes/ khyod kyi mje gcig ston smras pas/nad pa'i 'og gi mje gcig bstan tshe/ sog po'i sman pa de 506

'dzum nas khyod kyi de bzang bas/ da kha nang gi de cig ston bshad pa ltar/ khyod kyi he ran skad cha de bzang bas/ da khyod kyi yid ches sa po de su yin gcig ston dang / de sngar bshad pa pas kyang bzang yin sa snang / sngon bud med zhig gis tshod ma nyin re bzhin bco tsa na/ pho sgyes la rab/ mo rang la 'bring /bu tsha la tha ma re bcos/ tshod ma'i mgo la rtswa thur re'i rtags bzhag nas khon thog tu bzhag nas 'tshod pa/ nyin gcig ma sgo ru song shul nas/ bu yis zang kha phyes/ pha bu gnyis kyi tshod ma'i rtags go brjes nas bzhag pas/ tshod ma blangs nas zos pas pho skyes kyis de ring gi tshod ma 'di ci byung / zhim po ma red smras tshe/ chung mas kha rog za rgyu zo dang / yin rgyu yin smras pa ltar/ khyod kyis deng sang khas yar thongs dang / phyi nas 'gro sa po mar yin/ sngon 'ug pa la bya rnams kyis khyod kyi mgo leb leb yin no ci yin dris pas/ de khos bla ma'i drung du chos nyan mang po byas dus lan mang mjal ba'i stabs yin smras/ rna ba thu thu yin no ci yin dris pas/ de khos chos skad rna bas ma thos pa yin smras pa ltar/ mkhas kyang dad pa med na/ gzhan gyis khyed sang chos la mkhas pa ci yin dris na/ de khos bla ma mang po'i drung nas chos nyan pa'i stabs yin smras chog kyang /507

khyed dad pa med pa ci yin zhes 'dri rgyu yin na/ de khos nang ba sangs rgyas kyi chos skad rna bas ma thos pa yin zhes khas len dgos pas/ gzhan la chos bshad brgya byas kyang dad pa med na/'ug pa'i bshad bshad dang 'dra bas gzhan gyi rna bar mi 'gro/mkhas pas bzhad gad kyi rgyu yin/ 'ug pas kho bya brgya'i a ba gso no yin zer rgyu la/ kha 'chugs nas kho bya brgya'i a ba gsod no yin smras pas/ bya thams cad kyis rig sa med pa ltar/ grub mtha' thams cad bzang po yin gyi red mi zer/ kha byad dam gdon gyis 'khred par ltar/ ngan rab thu rab smras na/ mkhas blun bar gsum gyis rig sa mthong sa med/ 'ug pas nam yang nyi ma rig dka' bzhin/ tshe 'di spyir bde skyid kyi nyi ma mthong dka'/ 'ug pas rang la mi phan kyang / gzhan gyi thag nyer song nas/ ung zer 'khun/ ha ha zer bgad/ltas ngan bstan nas gzhan la rnam rtog ngan pa rkyang slong ba ltar/ rang la mi phan kyang / gzhan dad can rnams kyi thag nyer song / thog mar ung zer 'khun/ de nas chos dang gang zag la khas btang / ha ha zer bgad/ rang la dad pa med pa'i mtshang phyir bstan nas/ gzhan la log lta the tshom gyis rnam rtog ngan pa rkyang bslang na/ sngar yod ma myong pa'i gshog sgo 508

med pa'i 'ug pa zhig snyigs dus 'dir byung ba yin pas/ ltas ngan nang gi ltas ngan mi srid pa zhig yin/ de la 'ug rgan gye cho longs byen pa yin pas/ kun gyis de ltar bos/ rje btsun mi las/ phyogs lhung kha 'dzin gyi grwa ba la/ /mi mthun rtsod pa'i gzhung ring du drongs/ /gsungs pa de drongs/ bla ma zhang gis/de 'dra smras pa'i khar skyag pa chug gsungs pa/ de khar chuga'abrug pa kun legs kyis/ ya/ mi la la lha yul yangs par dga'/ /la la klu yul nor la dga'/ /lha dga' klu dga'i bkra shis shog /mi la la bsod nams skyid la dga'/ /la la byung 'dod sdug la dga'/ /skyid dga' sdug dga'i bkra shis shog /pha ngag dbang chos rgyal rta la dga'/ /bya btang kun legs stu la dga'/ /rta dga' stu dga'i bkra shis shog /nye gnas legs shes chang la dga'/ /dpal bzang rdo rje sha la dga'/ sha dga' chang dga'i bkra shis shog /skyob skyob shwa ral shwa la dga'/ /a zhang khyung skyabs glu la dga'/ /shwa dga' glu dga'i bkra shis shog /'ba' leb zung zung ma ṇir dga'/ /don 'grub dpal bzang nya la dga'/ /chos dga' nya dga'i bkra shis shog /a ne a btsun nyal bar dga'/ /a pa a skyabs langs par dga'/ /nyal dga' langs dga'i 509

bkra shis shog /stod pa tshe dpal chos la dga'/ /bya btang kun legs gnas mor dga'/ /chos dga' gnas dga'i bkra shis shog /btsun chung bkra shis bod la dga'/ /brtson 'grus bzang po lho la dga'/ /bod dga' lho dga'i bkra shis shog /gsungs pas/ thams cad kyi bzhad gad byas pa bzhin/ kun gyis rgyal ba'i gsung la yid mi ches pa'i kha ngo la ltos/ bzhad gad kyis/ rig pa'i dbang phyug gis/ log pa'i lam la mtha' med phyir/ /de dag 'dir ni spro bya min/ /gsungs pas na/ de tsam gyis/ slob dpon dherma bo rnyis/ lar yin lugs bshad pas gnong la phog /'khyus pa byas na phung gzhi che/ /kha rog bsdad pa gdams pa zab/ /gsungs pa zab par go bu ston rin po ches/ bdag gi chos min smras na chos dang 'gal/ /chos bzhin smras na bod rnams dgra ru sdang / /ci yang ma smras kun gyis blun zhes brnyas/ /kye ma nga ni bdag gis ji ltar bya/ /gsungs pa ltar/ da ci bya/ paṇa chen thams cad mkhyen pas/ sangs rgyas grangs med byon pas ma thul ba'i/ /ma rung gdul dka'i snyigs dus 'gro ba la/ /bde gshegs lam bzang ji bzhin ston pa yi/ /skyabs mgon thugs rje can la gsol ba 'debs/ /gsungs pa'i thog tu babs byung / da 510

gsol ba 'debs pa las gzhan 'os ci yod/ rgad po 'ga' res/ sngon gyi las la bcos pa'i thabs yang med/ /rgas pa'i gnyer ma bkrus nas dag yang med/ /zer ba yang bden par gda'/ rgyal ba'i gsungs rab mdo rgyud skyes bu dam pa'i gsungs 'di dag mthong thos tshe mtshang la 'phog na chos sems rgyab 'gal tu shor ba'i rtags yin la/ 'di dag bton pa nam thos tshe mthun zhing rgyan du 'gyur na/ gang zag des rgyud na/ theg chen chos kun yod pas shes par gyis/ /legs bshad 'di chos pa'i skyon dang yon tan gang yod la blta ba'i me long gtsang ma zhig yin te/ po to ba rin po ches/ gang zhig chos 'di mthong bar gyur pa na/ /mtshang du shes nas blta bar mi 'dod na/ /sna chad me long blta ba mi 'dod bzhin/ /rgyud dang chos su 'dzol bar shes par bya/ /'di dang mthun na gang zag de nyid la/ /theg chen chos kun yod par shes par bya/ /gsungs so/ /yang bla ma zhang gis/ dkyu sa bstan pa'i rta rgod bzhin/ /zab mo'i chos la kha ma thub/ /nyung bar 'dod kyang bag tsam mang / /mang kyang dam chos bdud rtsi yin/ /gsungs pa ltar/ chos bshad 'di nyid nyung bar 'dod kyang cung zad mang song yang / dam chos bdud rtsi yin pas 'gal ba med 511

snyam/ yang bla ma zhang gis/ gzhan la bstan pa'i sgon me des/ /rang gi lam yang gsal ba ltar/ /gzhan don bya ba'i gdams ngag 'di/ /rang la shin tu phan par byung / /tha snyad tshig phyir mi 'brang zhing / /rang rtog ngan pa mi dga' bar/ /drangs pa'i blo yis legs gzigs na/ /'di nyid ngo mtshar ci'i mi che/ /rgya mtsho'i gling nas nor bu rin po che/ /ded dpon gyis blangs rigs ngan lag tu rgyud/ /rigs ngan dag la bram zes mi 'dud kyang / /nor bu la ni bram ze dga' nas 'dud/ /rgya mtsho'i gling 'dra mdo rgyud rnams las ni/ /ded dpon dang 'dra bla ma mkhas rnams kyi/ /nor bu dang 'dra dam chos bdud rtsi 'di/ /rigs ngan dang 'dra dbul bo bdag la gtad/ /bram ze dang 'dra thar ba don gnyer khyod/ /rigs ngan 'dra ba bdag la mi 'dud kyang / /nor bu dang 'dra dam chos zab mo 'di/ /blo ldan rnams kyi gus pas blangs par rigs/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ chos bshad gzhan phan nor bu zhes bya ba 'di nyid blo gros can rnams kyis ngo mtshar ba'i gnas su mthong nas blangs par rigs so/ /de ltar phyi rol gyi dpe mang po bzhag mdo rgyud kyi lung 'dren mang po byas/ bla ma dam pa mang po'i gsungs sgos kyis brgyan nas bshad kyang / da dung 512

phyogs ris med pa'i dad gus dag snang zhig ma skye na/ sngon las kyi sgrib pa shin tu 'thug pa yin pas/ bla ma dkon mchog la gsol 'debs dang / tshogs gsog sgrib sbyong yang dag byed pa shin tu gal che ste/ rje rin po ches nyan na tshig mi zin/bsam na don mi go bsgom na rgyud la mi sgye ba'i dus su zhing gi mthu la brten pa man ngag yin gsungs so/ /da bshad pa kun mdor hril gyis dril na/ dper na lha bzo mkhas pas/ras gzhi thang lhod med par brgyangs/ ka rag bar 'tshams med par skus brdar nas/ steng du rang gang mos kyis sangs rgyas byang sems sogs kyi sku'i ri mo bris/ tshon btang / bcad mdangs gser bris brgyab na je legs je legs su gyur pa'i mthar 'grub tshe/ kun gyis mchod gnas su gyur pa ltar/ 'o skol rnams kyi chos dang gang zag mchog dman yongs la phyogs ris 'gyur ldog med pa'i dad gus dag snang sbyangs/ rang nyid gang mos chos la thos bsam bsgom gsum byas na je mjo je mthor 'gyur bas mthar thug sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob nas/ 'gro ba kun gye phyag dang mchod pa'i gnas su 'gyur zhes bla ma rgyal ba sras bcas pas gsungs pas/ de ltar kun gyis byas na legs so/ /ngas 'di ltar chos bshad byas pa rang 513

che 'dod grags 'dod sogs 'jig rten chos brgyad dang /grub mtha'i nye ring chags sdang sogs kyi kun slong ngan pas nam yang ma slad par skye bo pho mo thams cad bla ma dang chos la phyogs med kyi dad gus dag snang skyes/ phyogs bcu'i chos mdzad thams cad phan tshun thugs mthun/ khrims gtsang bar gyur/ bstan 'dzin gyi skyes bu rnams kyis sdang zhen phyogs ris med par bstan pa 'dzin skyong spel gsum mdzad/ de'i mthus sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa thams cad 'jig rten gyi khams 'dir yun ring du gnas/ de'i mthus yul phyogs thams cad kyi nad rims mu ge sad ser than pa sogs mi mthun rgud pa'i rigs lhag med du zhi nas ming tsam yang mi grags par byas/ /char chu dus su babs/ lo phyugs rtag tu legs/ phun tshogs dge legs bkra shis bde skyid kyi nyi ma phyogs ris med par shar na ci ma rung / myur du 'char bar 'gyur cig 'char ba zhig bdag gis bya'o snyam pa'i bsam pa gangs dang dung las dkar ba'i sgo nas chos bshad gzhan phan nor bu zhes bya ba 'di nyid bshad tshar song / dper na blo chung byes pa 'ga' res drin can gyi pha ma sogs rgan pa la phan sems kyis bslab bya bstan na cung zad re nor kyang pha mas byis pa 'dis 'di 'dra dran pa 514

la ya mtshan zer/ rab tu byams shing byis pas bslab pa ltar sgrub pa bzhin/ blo gros dman zhing sbyangs pa chung bas bdag blo byis pa'i ngang tshul can bdag gis lhag bsam bzang po'i sgo nas/ khyed mkhas grub yongs la chos bshad byas pa 'gal 'khrul lhag chad kyi nor ba cung zad mchis srid/ 'on kyang khyed sa dge rnying gsum la sogs pa'i lung rigs la sbyangs pa'i mkhas pas kyang / chos bshad 'di 'grig ma 'grig 'phrod ma 'phrod kyi 'gal 'brel zhib tu mi brtsi bar/ lhag bsam bzang bos bshad pa ngo mtshar che zhes brjod la/ thugs rab tu brtse bas je gsal je rgyas su thongs la kun la ston dang legs tshogs yar ngo'i zla ltar 'phel zhing rgyas par 'gyur ro//smras pa/ phul byung ston pa shākya thub pa de/ /mi rnams thams cad tshe lo brgya pa'i dus/ /zhing 'dir byon nas mtshan dpe gsal rdzogs kyi/ /sku las gzi brjid 'od zer 'bar bzhin du/ /lha mis gtso byas 'gro ba mtha' dag la/ /zab rgyas chos kyi sgo mo mtha' yas gsungs/ /rgya gar bod kyi mkhas grub mtha' yas kyis/ /snga phyi byas nas dgongs 'grel mtha' yas mdzad/ /shin tu mkhas pa zhig gis rgyal ba'i bka'/ /dgongs 'grel rnams kyi dgongs pa so sor bkral/ /nyan shes 515

mkhan la bshad rgyu zhig yin na/ /'gal ba phar zhog gcig kyang gcig grogs 'gyur/ /rab 'byams gzhung la sbyangs pa'i mkhas pa dang / /bsgom pa'i nyams myong can gyi rnal 'byor pas/ /dpyad nas dgongs pa lon tshe gang la yang / /smod pa phar zhog dad gus dag snang byed/ /sman gyi rigs ni bye brag mtha' yas kyang / /de dang sman min sman pas mi zer bzhin/ /rgyal ba'i chos lugs mi 'dra mtha' yas kyang / /de dag chos min mkhas pa su zhig smra/ /deng sang mi rnams bla dman bsod nams dman/ /rang gi mi shes shes mkhan 'dri sa med/ /grub mtha' thams cad phan tshun 'gal bar bzung / /dad pa phar zhog brnyas smod byed pa mang / /sngon byon da lta'i mkhas grub phal cher gyis/ /legs bshad mgur na gzhan lugs smad 'dra'i gsungs/ /snang yang phan pa'i dgongs gzhi dmigs bsal yod/ /'o skol rnams kyis lad mo byed mi rung / /'ga' re rnyed bkur gdon gyis dbang med myos/ /dad gus dag snang ngo/sa phud gcer bur rgyug /gzhan la brnyas smod smyo gtam rkyang ba smra/ /de yi kha la nyan rgyu mchod cig med/ /'ga' re phrag dog 'tsho med nad kyis zin/ /bdag bstod 'khun bu gzhan smod mchil snabs 'phen/ /blo dman khye rgan sa der ma rgyug 516

dang / /de na phan pa'i za rgyu ci yang med/ /'ga' res ma shes log rtog dug chu 'thung / /chags sdang zug rngu byung nas ma bzod par/ ngan smra tshig rtsub gshang gci dbang med shor/ /drung du ma 'gro mi brdzod bdag brdzod 'ong / /blo ldan rnams kyi go zhing shes bzhin du/ /shes rab mig gnyis rang dbang med par btsums/ /chos spong rtsa ltung nyes pa'i lag pa brgyangs/ /shed gi dmyal ba'i g.yang du mchongs ma 'jog /dad gus dag snang cang shes rta pho zhon/ /shes rab mig gis zab rgyas lam la ltos/ /brtson 'grus lcags phyor legs bshad snyan pa'i glu/ /len bzhin thams cad mkhyen pa'i sa rung song / /bdag 'dras rgyal ba'i dgongs pa/ lon dka' yang / /chos spong las kyis dmyal bar mar 'gro mthong / /shin tu 'phang nas ma bzod e phan snyam/ /rmongs blor shar tshod tsam zhig smras pa yin/ /rgyal ba'i dgongs pa mkha' ltar gting dpag dka'/ /bdag gi blo gros khab mig las kyang chung / /'di la 'gal 'khrul nongs pa cis mi 'byung / /byung tshad chos kyi spyan ldan sbyan sngar bshags/ /chos bshad gzhan phan nor bu 'od 'bar 'dis/ /bdag gzhan khang stong log rtog rmongs mun gsal/ /shes rab mig phyes bla ma zab chos mdzod/ /mthong 517

tshad dad gus snod du len par shog /de yang 'gro ba yongs kyi re ba mtha' dag skong nus pa'i nor 'jig rten khams na dkon pa/ 'dod dgu 'byung ba'i yid bzhin gye nor bu rin po che lta bus srid zhi'i bde skyid ma lus pa 'byung ba'i chos bshad gzhan phan nor bu zhes bya ba 'di nyid/ sngon sbyangs las 'phro can skal ldan snying gi bu mchog thos bsam bsgom gsum/ bslab pa rnam gsum/ 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum sogs gang la'ang mi rmongs pa'i shes rab can kun bzang rang grol/ dad gtong shes rab sogs 'phags nor bdun gyes rgyud blug pa'i bu chen grub rig 'dzin rnam gnyis kyi gus pas phyag dang bkra shis pa'i lha rdzas dri med bcas/deng sang snyigs ma'i dus kyi bdag 'dra'i gdul bya 'gro ba rnams blo gros shin tu dman cing sbyangs pa chung bas rang gi mi shes par ma zad/ bsod nams kyang dman nas gzhan gzhung lugs rab 'byams kun la sbyangs pa'i kun shes dge ba'i bshes gnyen la 'dri sa yang mi rnyed par gda'/ grub mtha' thams cad tsha grang ltar 'gal bar bzung nas phan tshun gcig gis gcig la dad gus dag snang byed pa phar zhog brnyas smod khyad gsod sogs byas/ dngos sam brgyud nas bshad sgrub kyi 518

bstan pa dang / bstan 'dzin 'gro ba yongs la gnod cing /rang nyid 'khor ba dang khyad par ngan song gsum du gtan 'khyams byed pa'i rgyu chos sgong sogs las ngan pa gsog pa mang po 'dug pas/ rgyal sras byang chub sems dpa' chen po khyed mi med dben pa'i bsil grib tu/ rang nyid zhi bde sgrub pa'i nyan rang drang srong bzhin thugs gtang snyoms su bzhugs par mi rigs pas/ chos dang gang zag mchog dman yongs la dad gus dag snang rtsol med du 'byung ba'i chos bshad lung rigs kyi lam nas drangs pa zhig ci nas kyang gsung dgos zhes yang yang nan tan chen pos bskul tshe/ rang gis kyang dad gus dag snang gi gsos su phan par go nas/ 'khor ba'i chos las 'das shing / myang 'das kyi go 'phang ma thob parami med dben pa'i brag phug tu nyal nas thob tu re ba'i kun spangs/ sangs rgyas dang sems can gnyis rang la mngon shes med pas ma shes tshe/ gang zag mchog dman gang la ston pa'i 'du shes bzhag nas/ dngos sam yid kyis phyag mchod 'bul ba'i blo rmongs/ rgyal ba'i gsung rabs kun gyi pha mtha' 'di'o zhes ma rtogs par/ tha na phyi rol pa sogs grub mtha' yongs la dag snang sbyangs/ spang blang gnyis su mi 'byed par thams 019

cad spyi bor 'khur ba'i 'chol po dus rtag tu tshogs drug gi yul la dung sems che yang / ming tregs drug rang grol du 'bod pa'i ming don rgyab 'gal bdag gis phyogs med kyi rgyal khams/ nges med kyi ri khrod 'grims dus/ dbul bos nor sgrub pa ltar/ phyogs phyogs kyi rgyal ba'i gsung rab dkor mdzod nas/ nyer mkho lung 'dren gyi nor mang po bsgrub/dbul bo sbyin gtong la dga' bas zas nor cung zad 'dzoms tshe/ yul bzang po zhig nas kun mchod sbyin du gtong ba ltar/lung 'dren kha shas 'byor tshe/ yul bzang po las can dag pa'i gzigs ngor/ phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba sras bcas bye ba ther 'bum til gyi gang bu bzhin bzhugs pa'i ngo mtshar lha'i pho brang / gnas gsum gyi dpa' bo mkha' 'gro chos skyong srung ma bye ba dung phyur sprin bzhin du 'du ba'i zhing khams kun gyi mchog gyur/ sar gnas dag pa mkha' spyod dpal gyi tsā ri tra zhes snyan grags dbyar gyi rnga bo che phyogs kun tu ldir ba'i byang phyogs rtswa mchog klu bdud nag po zhes bya ba skye 'gro gang gi khar song na/ klu nad sogs nad kun sel zhing mchog thun gyi dngos grub kun ster ba'i ngo mtshar rtswa de skye ba'i sa phun sum tshogs pa mtshan snyan pa gcig char zhes bya ba'i dben gnas/520

phyag na pad dkar bsnams pa'i rnam 'phrul kun mkhyen chen po 'brug pa pad+ma dkar po'i sku ring la bzhengs pa'i byin rlabs gzi brjid rab 'bar phag mo zhal gnyis ma dngos dang mtshungs pa'i sku rin po che du ma las grub pa'i mi tshad las lhag pa zhig sogs sku gsung thugs rten byin can du ma bzhugs pa'i gtsug lag khang gser gyi rgya phib tog gis kun nas mdzes par byas pa'i thag nye'i ri ngos ljon shing sna tshogs g.yu dang mu min mu tig gi dra ba dra phyed ltar bres pa'i gseb/ rang shong bsam gtan khang bu nyams dga' zhig nas/ bag phebs sos dal du bsdad nas/ dag sbyor byed zhor la rang gi blo gros kyi rtsal ci yod kyi chos bshad yongs rdzogs legs par tshar nas/ rang nyid byang chub sems dpa' kun tu bzang po'i skur gsal btab/ thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros phyogs bcu dus gsum gye mchod 'os skyabs gyur ma lus pa spyan drangs nas/ dngos 'byor yid kyi mchod sprin nam mkha' gang bar spros nas mchod bstod gsol ba btab/ bstan 'gro yongs la phan pa'i byin rlabs zhus/ sems can thams cad rang gi mdun du gsal btab/ stong gsum mi mjed khams kyi 'gro ba yongs kyi rna lam du chos kyi sgra snyan pa'i dbyangs kyis bsgrags 521

pa kun gyis thos/ tshig don gyi gnas kun rtogs par dmigs nas/ slob bu kun bzang rang grol la lung byen nas tshar tshe/glegs bam spyi bor bzhag nas/ chos 'di mthong thos dran reg gis 'gro ba yongs la phan pa'i smon lam rgya chen mdzad tshe/gnas kyi byen rlabs sam/ gang yin yang rang nyid kyi nyams snang la/ rang gnas pa'i sa phyogs dag pa'i zhing khams chen por gsal ba'i mdun gyi nam mkhar rgyal ba sras bcas khra lam mer bzhugs pa rnams thugs dgyes pa'i rtags zhal ras 'dzum zhing thugs ka nas 'od zer mang po spros/ kye rgyal ba'i sras po de de bzhin no/ de de bzhin te/ rgyal ba rnams kyi thugs dam skong zhing / 'gro ba kun gyi yid tshim pa'i sngon med legs bshad de yin pas ngo mtshar che/ rigs kyi bu khyod rgyal ba kun gyi sras kyi thu bo/ 'gro ba yongs kyi mgon skyabs su mnga' gsol ba yin no/ /zhes dbugs dbyung gzengs bstod cing dpa' bo mkha' 'gro chos skyong rnams rab tu dgyes pa'i gar stabs sna tshogs pa bsgyur bzhin/ mi 'gyur lhun po ma sogs bkra shis pa'i glu dbyangs blangs/ 'ja' 'od kyi sprin bsdus/ me tog gi char phab/ rol mo'i sgra bsgrags pa sogs ngo mtshar ba'i nyams snang shar zhing / dngos su yang nam 522

mkha' la 'ja' tshon kha dog lnga ldan shar/ me tog dkar po'i char babs/ dung dang rnga sogs rol mo'i sgra grags pa nye 'khor ba phal cher gyis mthong zhing thos pa byung / nged dpon slob gnyis kyi rten 'brel bzang snyam rab dga'i sa thob pa lta bu'i dga' spro shar nas/ nyams dga' skyid pa'i rgyang glu mang po blangs so/ /'dis kyang bstan 'gro ji srid nam gnas kyi bar du phan pa dpag tu med pa thogs par gyur cig /sku dang ye shes gnyis su med gang tshogs gnyis mthar son dag pa nyis ldan chos kyi sku/ /snang dang stong pa gnyis su med gang drug pa rdor 'chang nges pa lnga ldan longs spyod rdzogs/ /thabs dang shes rab gnyis su med gang rang gzhan grol mdzad mtshan dpe gsal rdzogs sprul pa'i sku/ /sku gsum 'dus zhal zhabs zung bdag snying pad dkar rtser bzhugs byang chub thob kyang rigs kyi bdag /tshogs gnyis kho lag rab rgyas don gnyis mthar son 'bras bus brjid/ /bden gnyis zung 'jug lo ma me tog rab rgyas g.yur za ldem/ /ldan grol nyis ldan yal ga rab rgyas 'gro ba'i gdung sel mkhan/ /rin chen rnam gsum dpag bsam ljon pa skye rgu'i bla na brjid/ /gang gi bstan pa lung rtogs rgya mtsho'i 'jings/ /'gro 'dren 523

drang srong dza hu'i ltor 'khyil ba/ /las ldan skal ldan shing rtas nyer drangs te/ /lus can 'jug bcu'i zhabs bsil sgrengs 'di rmad/ /rmad byung mdzad pas drug khri'i log rtog dri/ /sbyang phyir las kyi 'khor los yur ba ru/ /shugs drag brtson pas nye bar drangs pa 'dis/ /las ldan zhing sa'i lo tog cis mi bskrun/ /de lta mod kyang nyi zer phog pa na/ /'byung bo'i bya rnams ldong pa chos nyid de/ /de bzhin tshig gis spros pa'i ston chen la/ /mkho ba min te log rtog goms pa'i 'bras/ /chos la brten nas chos bzhin spyod 'dod pa'i/ /chos kyi dbyings la chos kun brten pa'i tshul/ /chos kyi rgyal pos chos nas gsungs pa gang / /chos kyi rje des chos bshad 'dir 'dus nas/ /chos kyis phongs pa'i chos mdzad ji snyed la/ /chos ltar bcos pas chos min ma gsog par/ /chos dbyengs ngang las chos rnams snang zhing stong / /chos kun rang bzhin chos dbyings bsam mi khyab/ /chos tshul rgya mtsho'i chos nyid shes mdzod la/ /chos la brten nas chos dbyings 'thob bya'i phyir/ /chos sku 'pho med chos kyi rgyal srid bskyangs/ /chos nyid rgyal po'i chos srid zin par mdzod/ /chos rje chos bshad gzhan phan nor bu 'di/ /chos spong las ngan gsog pa ma bzod nas/ /chos bzhin 524

spyod na 'di bzhin byed dgos zhes/ /chos sbyin gtan med sgo 'phar 'di phyes so/ /chos kyi spyan ldan gzur gnas mkhas rnams dang / /chos bzhin spyod pa'i skal bzang ji snyed la/ /chos dang chos can gnas lugs rtogs pa'i ched/ /chos sbyin 'dzad med par gye 'dod 'byung nor/ /mang mang skye bar legs smon mthu brtas pa'i/ /bzang bzang dben gnas brgya phrag la brten te/ /zab zab gdams pa rtse gcig bsgom pa'i mthus/ /gsal gsal nyams rtogs sbrang rtsis rtag myos pa'i/ /drang srong rgyal mtshan 'dzin pa'i ri ba mchog /bstan 'dzin nor bus yab rje'i drin bsab phyir/ /rma klung nyin srib skye rgu mtha' dag la/ /dge bskul gyis mtshon 'bad pa lhur blang nas/ /dad gshin rdzas rnams don dang ldan pa dang / /bstan dang 'gro ba'i nyer 'tsho'i gzhir gyur slad/ /lhag bsam dag pas rgyal mtshan rtser bkod de/ /thar 'dod skye bo yongs kyi dpal du byin/ /'dis mtshon dge ba dung dang kun+da ltar/ /dkar ba'i dge tshogs ji snyed bsags pa dang / /gsog 'gyur dge rnams gcig tu sdom byas nas/ /mkha' mnyam ma gyur 'gro dang thab cig par/ /mu med rab 'byams rgyal ba sras bcas la/ /dpag med sgo gsum gus pas 'dud phyag bgyi/ /rab 525

'byams zhing kun gang ba'i mchod pa'i sprin/ /rab 'a byams zhing gi rgyal ba sras bcas mchod/ /thog med nas bsags sdig lhung nyes pa'i tshogs/ /'chab med 'gyod pas snying nas bshags par bgyi/ /rgyal sras nyan rang so skyes dge tshogs la/ /rgyal ba'i mdzad pa sgrub phyir yi rang ngo / /phyogs bcu'i zhing gi rgyal ba sras bcas la/ /phyogs bcu'i 'gror sman chos 'khor bskor bar bskul/ /mya ngan 'da' bzhed rgyal sras ji snyed pa/ /mya ngan mi 'da' bskal brgyar bzhugs gsol 'debs/ /'dis mtshon rnam dkar phung bo ji snyed pa/ /'brel thogs las byed khur 'dzin gtso byas pa'i/ /mkha' mnyam 'gro ba'i tshogs rnams ma lus pa/ /kun mkhyen rgyal ba'i go 'phang thob phyir bsngo/ /gzhan yang 'dir 'bad bsod nams phung bo yis/ /thub pa'i bstan pa slar yang ches cher 'phel/ /bstan 'dzin bshes gnyen dge 'dun thugs mthun zhing / /bshad sgrub bya ba yar zla ltar 'phel shog /khyad par mchog sprul nyi ma gzhon nu dang / /gang gi rjes 'jug skyes mchog ji snyed pa/ /sku tshe nyi zla mnga' thang chos srid rnams/ /dbyar gyi chu gter bzhin du rgyas gyur cig /de'i mthus snyigs ma'i rgud pa mthar dbyung zhing / /nad yams 'khrug rtsod 526

sad ser than pa zhi/ /char chu dus babs lo phyugs rtag tu legs/ /rdzogs ldan gsar ba'i dpal la spyod par shog /bdag kyang 'di nas nying mtshams sbyar ma thag /'chi ba 'od gsal chos sku mngon gyur nas/ /mkha' nyams ma rnams rnam byang la 'god pa'i/ /sku bzhi'i dpal la spyod pa nyid gyur cig /glegs bam gang du 'phel ba'i sa phyogs su/ /mi shis rgud pa'i ming yang mi grags shing / /chos mdzad chos lugs yongs la dag snang 'byongs/ /rang snang dag pa 'og min ltar gyur cig /ma dag zhing rnams dag pa'i zhing du gyur/ /ma dag 'gro rnams rgyal dang rgyal sras gyur/ /ma dag 'khor ba'i ming yang mi grags shing / /ma rnams byang chen brnyes pa'i bkra shis shog /ces par byang nyung 'dus rang bzhin brjod pa'i ngag gi phreng ba blo ldan dga' bskyed tshigs su bcad pa de nyid kyi grangs ldan 'di ni dam pa gang gi thugs sras drang srong rgyal mtshan 'dzin pa bstan 'dzin nor bu'i legs smon dar ba'i mthu las glegs bu re la dong rtse khron gcig lnga brgya'i par yon dga' ston dang bcas rab yid shing byi'i lo dbo zla'i dga' ba dang po'i tshes la dbu btsugs/ 'gro ba'i bla ma zas gtsang sras pos zhi ba mchog gi go 'phang brnyes shing 'gro la bdud rtsi'i bgo skal thog mar 'gyed nas bgrang bya nyis stong brgyad brgya nyer dgu/bod yul gangs can gyi ljongs su 'phags pa kun tu bzang po'i rnam sprul lha tho tho ri gnyan btsan gyi sku ring la tsin+ta ma ṇi sogs dam pa chos kyi dbu brnyes nas zla ba'i phung bo gzugs mtsho rigs byed se ru/ chos rgyal srong btsan sgam pos ra sa 'phrul snang gi gtsug lag khang btab cing dam pa chos kyi srol btod nas lo mtsho lag mig gzugs(1224)/ chos rgyal khri srong 527

sde'u btsan gyis dam pa'i chos dar zhing rgyas par mdzad cing / sad mi bdun rab tu byung nas bgrang bya klu mtsho mkha' zla(1048)'das pa me yos gnam lo'i rang zhal gsar du ngom pa'i dus tshes dge ba la par du bsgrubs par bgyis skabs gang gi bka' drin kho nas 'tsho ba'i ban rgan gyi na ba burta rat+nas sug las su bstar ba 'dis kyang rje btsun dpal ldan bla mas tshe rabs kyi phreng bar rjes su 'dzin pa'i rgyur gyur cig /shu ba ma stu sarba dzag te//

༄༅/ /legs bshad gser gyi thur ma zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /༄༅/ /na mo gu ru mañdzu sgog ya/ mtha' bral chos sku'i nam mkha' yangs pa nas/ /skyabs mgon rgyal dbang nyi ma gzhon nu shar/ /ris med legs bshad 'od stong 'gyed pa'i mod/ /gsar rnying chos kyi pad tshal bzhad pa mtshar/ /chos dbyengs mkha' ltar yangs pa'i klong chen por/ /nyin mtshan med par rab tu 'byams klas pa'i/ /klong chen rab 'byams bzang bo'i legs bshad mdzod/ /mthong bas rtogs pa mkha' dang mnyam pa byung / /mkhyen pas shes bya'i chos rnams gsal ler gzigs/ /brtse bas legs bshad 'gro la stsol mkhas pa'i/ /mkhyen brtse rab byung rdo rje'i gsung 'bum la/ /bltas pas rdzogs chen lta ba'i gnad 'gag rigs/ /ji lta ji snyed chos kyi gzugs brnyan rnams/ /mkhyen pa'i me long gtsang ma'i ngos yangs por/ /yongs shar chos kyi rgyal po'i bka' drin gyis/ /chos nyid bden pa mngon sum mthong ba byung / /de phyir legs bshad gser gyi thur ma yis/ /mi shes rab rib bsal nas ye 529

shes spyan/ /gsal bar phyes nas sems nyid chos sku'i zhal/ /mngon gsum ston pas kun gyis legs par ltos/ /de yang phyag na pad dkar 'chang ba ngur smrig gar gyis rnam rol rgyal dbang lnga ba rin po ches mdzad pa'i rdzogs chen rig 'dzin zhal lung las/ lus rnam snang gi chos bdun bcas te/ mig cung zad thur du bltas pas sems dwangs la mi rtog pa 'char/de'i ngang nas mig drang thad du har rer gtad pas sngar gye mi rtog pa'i dwangs de zhig kyang byung tshor gyi rtog pa dang dran 'dzin gyi gnyen po med pa'i shes pa rang gsal rgya yan gzhi phyal yas pa zhig 'char te/ de nyid rig pa rang gnas kyi bsam gtan du ngo shes par bya/ de nyid ngos zin nas phyis shes pa 'phrog nas dgag sgrub nyon mongs mi rtogs pa'i ting nge 'dzin la gnas pa la sogs gang gi dus su yang rang rig rang babs la cer gyis bltas pas 'dzin med rang gnas kyi bsam gtan te rjen sangs rgyas kyis 'char te/ 'di kho na ma byas lhun grub kyi bsgom pa chu bo'i rgyun lta bu yin no/ /de ngo shes na mnyam gzhag re 'ga' ba'i bsgom gyes rkyen mi thub cing bar do'i bsam gtan ngos mi zin pa'i skyon yod de/ klong drug pa las/ rang bzhin gnas pa'i bsam gtan dang / /rtsa rlung 530

sems kyi ngal gso gnyis/ /'dra'o 'dra'o nor ra re/ /zhes 'byung bas/ chos 'di'i dka' ba'i gnad 'di rang byung pad+ma'i byin rlabs las rang babs pas shes pa yin zhes kun mkhyen klong chen pa'i gsungs don la gnas zhes gsungs/rgyal ba'i yang mes kun bzang mi yi gzugs kyis rnam rol kun mkhyen klong chen rab 'byams pa'i legs bshad zla med rnams las/ ngo bo stong pa/ gsal ba gang du yang ma grub pa/rang byung bcos bslad med pa dwangs sang nge / yangs phyal le/gsal sing nge / bde la rtog pa med pa/ gsal la ngos bzung med pa/ rig pa rjes mthud med pa/ yul la ma yengs/sems su mi 'dzin/ bsgom bya sgom byed kyi chos las 'das pa de ngos bzung la ma yengs par rtag tu bsgom mo/ /de lta bu de bsgom dus rgya cher snang ba ri rtse la sogs par song nas kyang bsgom la/ sems rtse gcig tu mi bsdud par rgya bskyed de lta stangs glod pa'i ngang nas yangs pa khrol ler bsgom pa yin no/ /de ltar bsgoms pas bde gsal mi rtog pa'i drod rtags 'byung / zhes dang / lus skyil krung dang / mig bar snang la trig ge bltas te/ sems 'phro 'du bcad nas rig pa dwangs sangs phyed pa'i ngos bzung bas rang snang dag pa'i 'od gsal/531

phyi du ba/ smig sgyu/ 'ja' 'od la sogs pa dang / nang chos nyid stong gsal bar snang dag pa ltar 'char/ zhes dang / ngo sprod pa'i ngang la blos 'dzin rtsol dang / ched du bsgoms pas gnyen po ma zhugs par rig pa rgya yan ye bzhag dbang bstod la phyal ba bar med rang dwangs su bzhag pa ste/ seng ge rtsal rdzogs las/ 'dzin rtog med pa'i nam mkha' la/ /rnam shes yid ma 'gyus pa ni/ /yengs pa med pa'i ting 'dzin mchog /sangs rgyas nyag gcig gnas lugs yin/ /zhes gsungs/tshogs drug yul gyi snang ba la 'dzin pas bzo rgya mi byed par/phyi nang bar med har sangs su phyal ler bzhag nas gnyid du 'gro khar yang / de'i ngang la nyal bas rmi lam 'od gsal tu 'char ro/ /zhes dang / sgo gsum lhug par glod la gang shar car phog tu rang sangs la phyal phyal song ba'i ngang ngos bzung ba'o/ /zhes dang / rig pa 'phro 'du med par gnas pa'i dus na gnas cha'i mi rtog pa de nyid bsgom du 'dod pa ma yin/'di'i dus kyi rig ge sing nge ba'i gsal dwangs kyi rig pa rjen pa de ma yengs par phyal le skyongs pa'o/ /yang rig pa yul la 'char dus gang shar la blta ba de bsgom du 'dod pa ma yin/de'i dus su rig pa rang gsal rjen pa'i cha de yengs par 532

skyongs pa'o/ /gnad 'di ma go na gnas pa dang 'char ba gnyis la lta ba de bsgom pa'i ngo bo yin snyam nas 'khrul bar 'gyur ro/ /sems gnas pa tsam bsam gtan gyi lha dang 'dra la/ 'char ba tsam tha mal gye rtog pa dang 'dra bas de la bsgom kyang sangs rgyas thob re skan no/ /'dir gang gi dus yin kyang rig pa'i cha rjen pa zang thal shel gong 'dra ba de klong du ma gyur bar du skyongs shing gyur nas de'i ngang la mi 'bral bar gnas pa yin no/ /khregs chod kyi don go rig pa rjen la phud nas sal sal skyong ba de la zer ba'i gnad 'di kho na gal che bar yod pas ngo shes par bya'o/ /zhes dang / 'od gsal spyir bsgom pa ni/ nyin dus lus gnad dang rlung gnad bstun nas shes pa dwangs gsal phyed par sa ler rgya bskyed nas bsgom zhing / mtshan dus seng ge nyal lugs kyis gnyid du 'gro kha'i shes pa rtogs med kyi 'od gsal ngos bzung bas ngang la nyal bas rmi lam gang yang med par de nyid la gnas shing nye 'khor gyi snang ba'ang mthong la rtog dpyod gang yang mi 'gyur bar gnas te/ gnyid du song byas na snang ba so so na gsal bar nges la/ ma song byas na sad rgyu 'byung ba'o/ /'di'i dus na 'od lnga'i snang ba thig le dang zer dang mar me lta bu'i snang ba 533

yang gsal bar mthong ste snang ba'i 'od gsal zhes bya'o/ /shes pa gsal dwangs phyed pa ni/ stong pa'i 'od gsal te bde gsal mi rtog pa gsum du gnas so/ /zhes dang / rig pa rang gsal gdangs dang bcas pa dbang bo'i sgo la lta bar gtan la phab nag/ yod med kyi yid dpyod rtog pa'i mtha' bral nas rang dwangs rang sangs lta ba'i dgongs pa nang du thag bcad la gol sa bcad pa ni/ thal 'gyur las/ lta ba'i ngo bo mthong ba la/ /yid dpyod tshig gis 'gyu ba med/ /ces so/ /rang sangs rang snang gi ngang la sal le bsgom yang / tis phur gzung 'dzin du ma song bas/ yangs pa khrol chags su rgya bskyed dwangs phyin ma yengs gting gsal gyi ye shes ngos bzung la phyal yas par bsgoms pas gol sa med/ ces dang / thal byung du shar nas thal byung du grol te/ bar der spang gnyen gyi 'khris ma zhugs/ ngo sprod kyi phan yon mi bsgom gang snang gi dus na snang thog der bzhag pas rig thog tu grol nas har sangs ris med phyal bar bun bun sangs nas gnyis bcas kyi chos la 'dzin pa ma zhugs ste/ zhes dang / rig pa ka dag zang ma 'di rjen par ngos ma zin na lta sgom thams cad yid dpyod sems kyi sgrib par song bas/ gnyen po dug tu song ba bshal 534

sman brdzangs pa lta bu zhig yin no/ /zhes dang / khregs chod thod rgal gang la'ang rig pa zang thal 'di rjen la 'bud dgos/ zhes dang / khregs chod de sgom chen pa rmongs pa kun gyi lam dang 'dres nas sems 'dzin gyi thabs skol tshe bar 'chor bas 'khor ba las mi 'da' ba dang / thod rgal de dngos po dang mtshan mar zhen pas gzugs khams kyi gnas su gol 'gro ba yin pas/ 'dir zang ka rjen pa ngo shes pa gal che'o/ /'di shes pa tsam gyis mi chog gtan sred zin dgos/ de la de'i ngang las ma g.yos pa gal che bas/ zhes dang / 'dir snang shes gnyis med ro gcig tu nyams su blangs pa ni/ de'ang thun mong pa'i tshul dang ma 'dres par gces te/ gang shar ba de la bltas na rtog pa'i nying 'khrul ngang la glod na rang ngo ma shes pas mun sgom cer cer nya ma shor bar bcad nas bar gye dwangs btsal na blang dor ris chad du 'gro ba ste/ de dag la rang shar gye gnad med pa ni phying ba 'dra sar khye la lto chen med pa bzhin no/ /'dir snying thig gsang ba'i rang gnad ni/snang ngam shar ram gang gi dus na'ang / rig pa zang ka de ngos bzung bas/ gzhan gang la ltos mi dgos te/ de'i dus su dus gsum yid kyi 'brel thag chad pa'i/ rig pa rjen pa zang nge ba 535

de chos sku rang babs kyi dgongs par rang shar bas 'od gsal mnyam pa'achen por lhun gyis grub ste/ 'di la gang shar yang 'das pa la yang mi rtog ma 'ongs pa la yang mi bsam/da lta ba la bar du mi dpyod par rig pa zang ma rjen ne ngos 'dzin pas ngang las ma g.yos par bya/ zhes dang / bsdu na rang ngo rang bzhin gyes bsam gtan la gnas pa dang / de las rtsal snang yul thog tu 'char ba'i dus na ngos bzung ba gnyis las rang babs ni re dogs 'byung 'jug med par lhan ne gnas dus kyi gnas cha de bsam gtan yin pas bzhag la/rig ge seng nge bcar phog tu ngos bzung nas ngang la skyongs/zhes dang / rig pa'i gdangs las rtsal yul thog tu 'char 'char 'dra ba'i dus kyi gya ma gyu 'phro ba'i cha de rtog pa rlung gi rtas bskyod pa yin pas bzhag la/ de'i cha la rig cha gcig 'dug pa de car phog tu ngos bzung nas/ 'phro cha de gar 'gror btang bas rang yal 'gro/ zhes dang / 'di la lag len du byed pa ni/ rig pa zang ka de'i rtsal shes pa yul snang ba gsum 'dzom dus shes pa yul la 'char yang / de gnyis la mi bsam par rig pa gcig pu de ngos bzung bas yul sems gnyis rgya grol la 'gro ste/ do thag gi rtod phur gcig pu de 536

bton pas khal thams cad rgya grol la 'gro ba bzhin no/ /de yang yul shes pa yid la byed pa gsum po de la kun rtog 'khor ba'i chos zhes brjod pas/ rig pa gcig pu ngos zin pas de gsum rgya grol la ar sangs pa ni/ tshig dang blo zad pa'i chos nyid rang byung gi ye shes so/ /zhes dang / 'ubs kyis dril na phyi snang ba dang nang shes pa gnyis po cog bzhag la bskyur ba'i bar der shes pa zang ka gcig tu 'gag bsdams/ /zhes dang /chos sku dang kun gzhi'i dbye ba ni/ rig pa'i rang ngo me long lta bu'i rtsal dwangs cha lta bu las rol ba gzugs brnyan dang 'dra bar shar dus rig pa'i ngo bo chos skur gnas pa'i ngang las ma g.yos par bya ba ni chos sku'o/ /kun gzhi nirig pa zang ma ma rtogs pa'i lung ma bstan te/ de'i ngang la gnas na khams gong ma'i las gsog pa'i bsam gtam gyi sgrib pa'o/ /de'i ngang la kun gzhi rnam par shes pa'i cha dang / tshogs drug yul la 'char ba'i dbang shes yul la phar 'phro ba ni 'khor ba zang ga'i las gsog ste/ mdor na 'khor ba'i chos thams cad kun gzhi la brten pa'o/ /'di rnal 'byor pa'i kun gzhi dang chos sku ma phyed na 'khor 'das kyi rtsa ba mi chod pa'i chos byas tshad 'khor ba'i snon par 'gro ba las bzlog par bshad de/ chos 537

sku ni zang ga'i rig pa rjen la bud pa spros bral stong gsal 'di yin pas/ las dang bag chags kyi rten ma yin/ ngo bo stong pa'i chos sku/ rang bzhin gsal ba'i longs sku/ thugs rje'i 'char gzhi ma 'gag pas sprul skur gnas pa'o/ /kun gzhi'i ngo bo lung ma bstan gzugs med pa'i shes pa dang cha 'dra ba gti mug gi sa pa'o/ /rang bzhin kun gzhi'i rnam par shes pa'i cha dbang shes rnams kyi 'char gzhir gyur pa'o/ /thugs rje'i dod du tshogs drug gi shes pa yul 'dzin pa dwangs pa'o/ /de dag gis 'khor ba'i las du ma gsog pa'o/ /da lta kun gzhi sgom pa dang / kun gzhi'i rnam shes shes pa dwangs la mi rtog pa tsam sgom pa dang / tshogs drug gi shes pa rtog pa shar grol tu skyong ba thams cad kyang khams gsum las mi 'da'o/ /'dir rig pa zang thal de ngos 'dzin pas rtsa ba chos sgu yin/rtog med kyi zhi gnas la bsgom mi re bas kun gzhi log dwangs dwangs po bsgom pa lam du mi byed pas kun gzhi'i rnam shes logartog pa phyir shar ba lam du mi byed pas tshogs drug gi shes pa log pa ste/ sku gsum gye ye shes la rgyun du gnas te/ngo bo gang du'ang ma grub pa'i rig pa stong pa babs kyis gnas pa'i chos sku ye shes zang thal gsal dwangs bcas pas longs sku ye shes 538

'char gzhi ma 'gag pa'i rig pa zang mar rtogs pa'i sprul sku'i ye shes so/ /nam yang rig pa zang thal du rjen la bud pa dgos pa'i gnad de yin no/ /zhes gsungs pas na 'di dag rdzogs chen pa rnams la shin tu gal che bar yod pas rtogs par bya'o/ /kun mkhyen chen po klong chen rab 'byams pa slar yang snyigs dus 'gro ba'i dpal du shar ba mkhyen brtse'i 'od zer ram 'jigs med gling pa'i zhal gyi bum bzang las/ thun mong ma yin pa dmus long mig phye ba ltar mngon sum bcar phog tu ngo sprad pa ni/ slob ma mi 'gyur rdo rje'i 'dug stangs byed du bcug la ḍā dril dang bcas brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs snang ba 'gyur ba'i dbyangs kyis brjod pa'i mthar/ kye khyed kyi da lta'i rig pa 'di la bca' bcos dang spro ba bsdu ma byed par thad gar zhog dang / de la yod med dang phyogs cha ma grub/snang stong gi spu ris mi byed/ rtag chad kyi mtshan ma ma grub/ ma grub pa 'di ga'i ngang la lta sgom gyi rtsol bas 'bad mi dgos shing bsdams pas dkrol ba lta bu ma yin par ye grol chen po blos mi bcos pas rang gsal/ rnam rtog gis ma bzos pa'i ye shes/ lta sgom gyis ma bslad pa'i chos nyid/ 'jog tu med pa'i mnyam bzhag rtsis gdab med pa'i rjes thob/ gsal ba 539

la dngos po med pa/ yangs pa la phyal bar ma shor/ ye babs rang gnas kyi dgos pa 'di lta bu sems can thams cad dang skad cig kyang 'bral ma myong bar yod kyang / de ngo ma shes pas chu rang grol du yod pa 'khyams pas bsdams pa ltar/ nang 'dzin pa'i sems kyis rgyu byas/ phyi gzung ba'i yul gyes rkyen byas/ 'khor ba mtha' med du 'khyams pa yin te/ de ni bla ma'i gdams ngag gis rig pa skad cig ma'i mtshang rig pa tsam nas yin lugs kyi thog tu bzo mi 'chos shing / 'di las gang du'ang ma yengs gang du'ang mi bsgom par 'jog pa ni/gdod ma'i sangs rgyas kun tu bzang bo'i dgongs pa'i mthil lhag ger bstan pa yin/ zhes dang / rig pa rgya yan ma bcas mi 'chos/ mi bsgoms ma yengs/ ma 'khrul/ bsam yas de la lta sgom gyis gzengs mi bstod pa/ rtog dpyod kyis zhabs tog ma byas pa/ 'og 'gyus dbu 'phang ma smad pa/ zang thal du lhag ba stong nyid du rjen ne/ ka dag tu lhod de ba la lta bas bla dwags su btags pa tsam las/ zhes dang / gshis ma bcos pa'i gnas lugs bcar phog tu ngos zin na/ rang ngo ka dag chen po la gzung 'dzin gyi zhen pas 'ching mi nus shing /de yang yengs yul chos nyid du song bas 'khrul ma 'khrul dang 540

yin ma yin gyi tha snyad gang gis kyang mi thug pa'i nam mkha' lta bu yin pas stong par ma bsgom/ gsal bar ma 'dzin/ gnyis med du stangs mi dpyod/ grol tu mi re/ 'khrul du mi dgos/rtsol bas mi sgrub/ rang bzhin yongs shes kyi rig pa dmigs gtad bral ba'i zang ma thal du 'dug pa la/ bsgom bya sgom byed kyis bslad pa mi gzhug ces dang / bsgom med ni gnas lugs kyi lhums su zhugs nas bsgom mi bsgom gyi zhen pa dag ste/ sems la bzo bcos dang dmigs gtad gang yang med par khyab brdal gye dran pa'i mkhar tshugs pa la zer gyes blos btang bas btang snyoms tha mal du sdod pa'am/ci yin 'di yin med pa'i ngang du lung ma bstan tu rgya 'byams na nor/ zhes dang / gang du'ang mi rtag pa'i mnyam bzhag lhod lhod 'bol 'bol 'di skyes dus bde nyams kho na shes che bas/nga'i sgom 'di yin/ 'di las lhag pa sus kyang mi shes/ ngas 'di lta bu rtogs so snyam pa'i rang mthong kyang skye ba yod pa'i 'di'i tshe bla ma mtshan ldan gyis ma zin na/ ji skad du/ rdzogs chen las/ go ba lhan pa 'dra ste kog nas 'gro/ zhes bshad pa ltar rkyen bzang ngan dang 'phrad tshe chu dang 'o ma so sor phye ba mang / zhes dang / snying nas dam chos byed pa dag 'di'i tshe 541

mtshan ma can gyi lta ba thom yo re ba de la bsgom go mi bcad par thun bzhir bla ma'i rnal 'byor la rtsal 'don cing dbang bzhi blangs rjes thugs yid bsres pa'i ngang la rig pa kha yan du glod la nyams de'i ngo bo gtad med khungs med du ma song bar snying la rdo rus gtug go /ces dang / khang ba stong pa'i nang du rkun po zhugs kyang chom rkun la thob rgyu med/ khang stong la shor rgyu med pa'i phan gnod thob shor gyi rang bzhin las ye nas 'das pa ltar/ 'dir rig pa'i ngo bo zang thal rtog dpyod kyi shes sgrib dang bral ba'i tshugs ma shor ba de nyid bsgom gyi snying rdo gnyug ma'i dran rig yin la/ rtsal gyi rnam rtog ji ltar g.yo yang dpyod byed kyi 'du shes dag pas shar mkhan med pa'i rig stong rjen pa blo 'das rgya yan gyi ngang du chos sku 'pho med rgyal po'i btsan sa zin pa'i phyir rnam rtog gis phan gnod ma byas pa'i sgra bshad bzhag la/ 'di shin tu rnam dag bshad du 'phangs pa'i u pa de sha ste/ zhes dang /pad 'byung thugs sprul bdag gi bla ma chos kyi rgyal po'i zhal gyi bum bzang las/ sems gang du'ang mi rtog pa'i mnyam bzhag lhod lhod 'bol 'bol po dang / rang byung rig pa'i ye shes gnyis nam langs kyang nyi ma shar ma shar dang 'dra ba'i khyad 542

par shin tu che/ bla mas man ngag du ma'i sgo nas rang byung rig pa'i ye shes rjen la phud nas ngo ma sprad par mi rtog pa thams cad bsgom gyi mthar thug tu ngo sprad nas bsgom na hwa shang dang mtshungs la/ slar yang 'khor ba'i rgyu bsam bzhin sgrub pa yin no/ /rje bdag nyid chen pos kyang 'di la lam rim zhi lhag skabs nas dgag pa mang du mdzad pa yin/ des na kun bzang mi yi zlos gar kun mkhyen klong chen rab 'byams pa'i legs bshad chos dbyings mdzod sogs nas ngo sprod man ngag yod pa rnams kyis shan phye nas zang thal rjen pa'i ye shes ngos bzung nas ngang du goms pa shin tu gces/ zhi gnas dang rig pa'i ye shes gnyis zang thal ma thal dang rig cha dang gnas cha'i khyad yod pas 'dzol sa med rdzogs chen chos 'di'i dka' gnad 'di kho bos kyang klong chen legs bshad drin las shes rgasungs/ rang byung rig pa'i ye shes bla ma'i rang la ngo sprod pa'i tshe/ rang gsal rgya yan nam langs pa dang 'dra la/ngang du gnas tshe ri rtse mthon por phyin nas phyogs kun tu bltas pa dang 'dra'o/ /de'i ngang du goms na spyan dang mngon shes sogs lam rtags kyi yon tan mngon du 'gyur la/ sems dwangs la mi rtog pa ni dgung mo dang 'dra la/ ngang du bzhag 543

'phro bying rmugs gnyid gsum smag rum 'thibs pa dang 'dra'o/ /des na zhi gnas tsam dang rig pa'i ye shes gnyis chu dang 'o ma bzhin bsres nas mi skyong ba gal che gal che gsungs/yang rdzogs chen las/ nyams na bun 'dra ste yal nas 'gro/rtogs pa nam mkha' 'dra ste 'gyur ba med/ ces gsungs pa ltar/ rkyen dang 'phrad tshe sems dwangs la mi rtog pa'i nyams ji ltar bzang yang rlung dang 'phrad tshe na bun nam mkha' la yal ba bzhin 'gro ba'i rkyen mi thub/ zang thal rjen pa'i ye shes ngos zin nas ngang du goms na rkyen dang 'phrad kyang rtog pa 'gyur ba med pa rlung ji ltar g.yo yang nam mkha' 'gyur ba med pa dang 'dra gsungs/ lta ba bsgom dus lus drang bor bsrang / rlung dal bar byas/ mig har re bsgrad nas las dang po pas bsgom na bying rmugs gnyid gsum mi 'byung /byung yang ngo shes par sla gsungs/ bying rmugs gnyid gosum shin tu che na/ gon pa srab par byas ri bo mthon po'i rtser phyin la nam mkha' dang rig pa bsre/ nam mkha'i gar khyab rig pas khyab/ /rig pa'i gar khyab chos skus khyab par mos la/phyogs gang bde bde la rig pa rgya bskyed dbang bstod la yangs pa khrol ler bzhag mig cher bgrad mthong tshad kyi 544

phyogs mtshams nam mkha' yangs pa la blta zhing / lus kyi sha bsgrims la yar rgyug mar rgyug lding bskor bya/ ngag gis phaṭa sgra lhang lhang brjod/ de ltar byas na sprin dang na bun rlung gis gtor nas nam mkha' sngo rjen gyis mthong ba bzhin byeng rmugs gnyid gsum gang yang gtan med du sangs nas zang thal rig pa rjen la 'bud gsungs/ mnyam bzhag nyag nyog ldab ldib ci yin 'di yin med pa'i ngang du lo zlar bzhag pa las/ zang thal rjen pa'i rig pa ngos zin nas ngang du cung zad bzhag pa yon tan che/ lus sems bde zhing dwangs la mi rtog pa tsam byung na bsgom gyi mchog tu bzung nas/ ri sul rnams su de'i ngang la mi tshe ma gzad gsungs/ 'di yang brjed kyis dogs nas bris/ rdzogs chen pa rnams la shin tu mkho bas/ legs par khong du chud par gyis/ phyogs thams cad du bsgrags pa'i gnas ma yin no/ /smras pa/ skye med chos dbyengs nam mkha' bde la yangs/ /'gag med rig pa'i nyi ma gsal la dwangs/ /tshad med byams brtse'i nyi 'od dro la 'jam/ /dri med legs bshad 'od stong 'gyed la spro/ /e ma skal bzang skye bo pho mo rnams/ /mig gnyis bar snang khams la har re ltos/ /rig pa rang gsal rgya 545

yan phyal yas pas/ /ngang du gu yangs yan par glod la thongs/ /rig pa'i ngo bo gsal stong 'dzin pa med/ /zang thal khyab brdal klong yangs nam mkha' 'dra/ /mnyam bzhag thang ma phyogs bcur brdal tsa na/ /'od gsal nyi ma mtha' dbus med par 'char/ /bying rmugs 'phro rgod rong khung dog sa nas/ /bde gsal mi rtog la kha mthon por bud/ /'od gsal nam mkha' mtha' dbus med pa la/ /bltas pas dga' zhing spro la rgod yang 'chor/ /de tshe rig pa'i gzhon nu mig yangs pos/ /'od gsal chos dbyengs spang gzhongs yangs pa ru/ /bde stong nyams kyi gar stabs bsgyur bzhin du/ /nyams mgur glu dbyangs blangs na bogs thon yong / /mdor na dus dang rnam pa thams cad du/ /gang du bsdad kyang snang ba yangs khrol le/ /su dang 'grogs kyang shes pa dga' yal le/ /gnas pa'i rnal 'byor pa re kun gyis mdzod/ /glu 'di thos tshad skal bzang pho mo yis/ /dga' zhing spro bzhin sems ngo bskyangs pa'i mthus/ /nam zhig sems nyid nam mkha'i klong yangs nas/ /sku gnyis nyi zla 'gro la 'char bar shog /ces legs bshad gser gyi thur ma zhes bya ba 'di mdo smad kyi skal ldan slob ma yongs la phan pa'i phyir/ rnal 'byor zhabs dkar pas dben gnas nyams dga' bkra shis 'khyil ba'i yang rtse 'od gsal nyi 'od 'khyil ba'i lha khang bde ba can nas sbyar pa'o/ /'dis kyang kun la 546

phan thogs par gyur cig/ na mo gu ru bh+yaḥ tshogs gnyis dbyengs su rdzogs pa khyad chos drug ldan gzhon nu bum pa'i sku/ /rang bzhin 'pho 'gyur spangs kyang zhing khams rgya mtshor nges pa lnga dang ldan/ /rnam mang gdul byar skal ba dang 'tshams rnam grol dpal ster sprul pa'i gar/ /gdul bya'i rjes 'gro sku gsum 'dus zhal bdag gi 'dren pa rgyal gyur cig /gang gi gsung gsang dbyar gyi rnga bo che/ /lus can mdongs mtha'i mngal khur sbrum slad du/ /las kyi 'khor lo'i sprin gyi lding khang las/ /lhongs pa'i dge mtshan lha mi'i rna bar 'jebs/ /de phyir phyogs kyi bu mo'i rna lung du/ /dbyangs 'di lhag bsam dbyar gyi dpal mos bsus/ /'dzad med chos char 'bebs pa'i chu khur can/ /las ldan chu mthongs ngos su rtag par phyur/ /legs byas 'od stong 'bar ba'i gzi 'od kyis/ /bdag gi pha mas gtso byas 'brel thogs dang / /rgyud lngas bsdus pa'i skye 'gro'i kun gzhi'i mun/ /chos dbyengs 'od gsal klong du sangs gyur cig /bdag kyang dengs nas nyer zhi gdod ma'i grong / /ma phyin de srid rnam smin brgyad kyi rten/ /thob cing dam pa'i mgon dang mi 'bral bar/ /tshogs gnyis dpal la spyod pa'i 547
mang du thos pa'i nor gyis phyug pa'i spong ba po lha bzo ye shes bstan ga par/ rmongs rtul sangs rgyas rin chen gyis g.yar khral du bgyis pa

༄༅/ /legs bshad bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /༄༅/ /rje btsun bla ma dam pa dmigs pa med pa'i brtse ba'i gter chen po mnga' ba rnams la rab tu gus pas phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su mchi'o/ /thugs brtse ba chen po'i sgo nas bdag gzhan sems can thams cad kyi rgyud la byams snying rje byang chub kyi sems skye bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ de yang 'o skol rnams kyi tshe 'khor ba thog ma ma mchis pas na/ sems can thams cad kyi ma ma byas pa gcig kyang med/ ma nam byas res kyi tshe 'di'i mas ji ltar bskyangs pa bzhin du drin gyis bskyangs pa sha stag yin zhes bdag cag gi ston pa sangs rgyas kyis lan cig ma yin par yang yang zhal nas gsungs pa la yid mi ches pa su yod/ des na sems can thams cad mar shes pa/ drin dran pa/ drin gzo ba/ yid 'ong gi byams pa/snying rje chen po/ lhag bsam rnam dag byang chub kyi sems te/rgyu 'bras man ngag bdun gyi sgo nas byang chub kyi sems la blo 549

sbyangs pa dang / bdag gzhan mnyam brjes kyi sgo nas byang chub kyi sems la blo yang yang sbyangs nas/ bla ma dkon mchog sems bskyed pa'i dpang bor bzhag smon 'jug gi sems bskyed cho gas blangs nas bzung / dus rgyun du sems can thams cad la ma yi 'du shes bzhag sha mthong ba la yang ma sha'i 'du shes bzhag nas kha ru za ba phar zhog tha na lag tu yang mi len par/ sha'i dri ma mi tshor ba byas sdod dgos zhes snying rje'i rang gzugs bla ma dam pa gong ma mang pos gsungs/ de yi rgyu mtshan gang yin zhe na/ drin can ma ru gyur pa'i ma sems can ra lug sogs kyi sha'i ched du/ de'i kha zum khog tu lag pa btang / srog rtsa dmar bo bcad/ sha dmar po za ba 'di bdud dang srin po 'dre'i spyod pa ma rabs kyi bya ba kho na yin pas/ sangs rgyas kyis thabs tshul du ma'i sgo nas smad de/ ji skad du/ glang bo rtsal dang sprin chen mdo/ /mya ngan 'das dang sor phreng can/ /lang gar gshegs pa'i mdo las kyang / /ngas ni sha dag rnam par smad/ /ces gsungs pa ltar/ mdo rgyud bstan bcos mang po nas sha yi nyes dmigs mtha' yas pa gsungs pa rnams kyi rgya che ba'i tshig bzhag nas/ don gye mdo 'gag che long tsam zhig bshad na/ sdig zas pha ma sems can 53 0

gye sha khrag zos na tshe phyi mar dmyal khams bco brgyad kyi nang nas tsha ba'i dmyal ba ngu 'bod du skyes shing / sngar sha ci tsam zos pa de tsam gyi lcags kyi thu lum me 'bar ba mang po khar bcug nas khog thams cad 'tshig nas ro smad nas byung / sdug bsngal mtha' yas pa myong dgos par gsungs/ gal te thar nas 'jig rten khams 'dir skyes na yang / mi sha za ba'i phra men pha dang / phra men ma dang / bdud dang 'dre srin shan pa'i lus lnga brgya re len cing / rig ngan sme sha can dang / gtso brlag mkhan dang / seng ge stag gzig dom dred dug sbrul spyang ki wa dang byi la khra glag la sogs pa'i sems can gzhan gyi sha la rngams pa'i ma rung gdug pa can gye lus grangs med par len par gsungs/ des na mtho ris lha mi dang / thar ba'i lam la bgrod pa'i gegs su sha 'di che bar gda'/ khyad par du thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes ni byang chub kyi sems las byung / byang chub kyi sems de snying rje'i rtsa ba las byung /thabs pha rol tu phyin pa drug sogs kyi mthar phyin par gsungs te/ bcom ldan rnam par snang mdzad mngon par byang chub pa'i rgyud las/ thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes ni/ byang chub kyi sems las byung / snying rje rtsa ba las byung / thabs kyi 551

mthar phyin pa'o/ /zhes gsungs/ des na snying rje chen po rgyud la skyes pa'i gegs kyi gtso bo ni/ sha'i sred pa 'di yin par gsungs/ snying rje chen po rgyud la ma skyes na byang chub kyi sems kyi rkang mi tshugs/ de ma tshugs na theg pa chen po ru brgya rloms rung / theg chen byang chub sems dpar mi 'gyur bas/ des na thams cad mkhyen pa'i go 'phang 'thob pa'i gegs kyang sha'i sred pa spong ma thub pa 'dis lan par 'dug pas/ de'i phyir chos pa 'jig rten pa kun gyis sdig zas pha ma'i sha 'di spongs ci thub la 'bad dgos/ yang kha cig na re/ las ma byas pa dang mi 'phrad/ byas pa chud mi za gsungs pa yin pas/ las rgyu 'bras nang ltar byas na mthong thos dogs gsum gang yang ma mchis pa'i sha zos na skyon med de/ nged rnams kyis lug gsod pa'i las gang yang ma byas pas na/ de'i rnam smin gsod mkhan la yong na ma gtogs nged tshor gtan nas mi yong ba ngas thag chod zer/ de la dpyad par bya ste/ dper na dgon pa stobs can grwa ba zha kho na za ba zhig gi mtha' na khyem tshang zhig yod na/ de'i bsam pa la/ lug 'di bsad nas phyi sha dpyid ka dgon pa'i grwa ba tshor btsong na rin las lhag pa 'ong gi de'i lug gcig khug gi nang sha mgo sug pags pa 552

rnams khe red snyam lug de bsad yong / bsad nas kho rang gi bshad pa ltar byas nas/ dge 'dun par btsong / dge 'dun rnams kyis khyem tshang de'i lug bsad nas phyi sha bzhag yod pa shes nas nyos song tshe lo rjes mar de las je mang du btang bsad nas sha btsong yong / de yang yag po khe che/ de'i lo rjes mar de bas brgya 'gyur gyi mang tsam bsad pas kho phyug por gyur pa dang / 'o lug bsad na phyug por 'gro gi snyam/ kho shan pa byed par ma zad/ rang gi bu tsha gnyen nye ba tsho la yang bslab/ma bslab na yang phal cher gyis dmigs lam gtsog pa der bltas nas/ sdig tshab chen po byas/ shan pa'i sde chags nas sdig rgyun chen po 'khor ba ma stong gi bar du tshugs pa 'byung ngo / /de dge 'dun pa sogs sha za ba rnams la brten nas byung ba yin/ de las lhag gi las ngan tshab che ba rgyun ring ba zhig su yis byed/ sha za ba po med na gsod pa po mi 'byung ste/dper na rgya gar bal bo'i mis ja mi 'thung bas ja btsong mkhan med pa bzhin no/ /sha za ba po dang gsod pa po gnyis gas thun mong du las ngan byas pa yin pas/ las ngan byas bzhin da dung phyi mar rnam smin sdug po mi 'phrad zer ba 'di gtan nas mi rigs te/ sangs rgyas kyis dngos sam brgyud 553

nas sems can la gnod pa'i las ngan pa thams cad sdig nga/ yin gsungs pa de bden na za ba po 'di'i rgyud nas sems can gyi srog la gnod gnod cig zas gzhan gang gis kyang mi gnod/ des na dus 'khor gyi rgyud dang 'grel ba gnyis gar za ba po dang gsod pa po gnyis kyi za ba po la nyes pa che bar gsungs pas/ za mkhan po nyes pa ma che rung / nyes pa mnyam mnyam/ ma mnyam rung nyes pa med/ za ba po la nyes pa mi yong zer ba rnams snying khams che ba yin/ yong mi yong byas za gang na dgos/ thog ma nas sha la sred pa spang bsdad na bzang mod snyam/ gzhan yang dper na dgon pa stobs med/ grwa ba cang med ser sna che ba rnams dang / sngon gye bka' gdams pa'i rnam thar bzhin zas dkar gsum kho na la brten pa'i dgon pa zhig yin na/ de'i rtsa na yod pa'i khyim pa rnams kyis yid la 'char mi srid na lag la 'debs pa smos ci dgos/ des na rang gzhan gnyis ka dngos sam brgyud nas phan pa'i las dge bar gsungs na/ de bas lhag gi dge rgyun zhig 'dzugs rgyu med snyam pas snying rje can gyi dge 'dun pa re gnyis thugs la re re zungs/ yang dper na bla ma sha bzhes mkhan zhig dbyar ston bsod snyoms la phebs na yon bdag dad can rnams kyis sha 554

bzhes pa shes tshe/ de ring khong phebs rgyu red skal ba bzang /de ba cig gi sprul pa yin/ bla ma gyan gyin zhig min/ 'tsho ba zhig 'dren dgos zhes lug gcig bsad nas bla ma la phyi sha drangs/gzhan yon bdag thams cad kyis nang cho kun zos nas lug 'di ci 'dra'i las can zhig da re bla ma'i 'tsho ba'i thebs su song ba bzang zer thams cad kyis lug la phan btags 'dra ba zhig byas/ lug kyang las can gyi gral la 'jog gin 'dug ste/ thams cad las can yin min tshe phyi mar ma song gi mi shes sam snyam lags/ yang sha mi bzhes pa'i bla ma zhig phebs na yon bdag gi lug bsha' ba phar zhog sngar sha 'dra yod pa thams cad sbas nas/ de'i nyin kun gyis sha mi za ba byas/zas bzhan gro ma zho sogs drangs nas yon mchod kun zhe gtsang sing nge sdig dang ma 'dres par gnas/ lug rnams bde 'bol le gnas par mngon sum du 'dug pas/ bla ma rnams kyis mdzad pa de 'dra re ston pa'i sgon lam thob/ de ma yin par mdzad spyod ngan pa bstan na gzhan bla ma sku skye thams cad kyis de'i lad mo byas dbyar ston yon mchod kun gyis/ phyogs gcig na chos kyi 'khor lo bskor/ phyogs gcig na sdig pa'i sa bon btab na rang sdug gzhan sdug tshe 'di sdug phyi sdug mi yong 555

las che/ bla ma dkon mchog mkhyen ma gtogs gang bshad tshod cig mi thub par gda'/ yang kha cig na re/ so thar sdom pa'i skabs na rnam gsum dag pa'i sha zos chog pa'i lung khungs dang bcas te rje yab sras sogs sngon gyi mkhas grub rgyal ba yab sras kyi gsung 'dug pas/ gzhan deng sang ri khrod pa sogs chos pa gti thug rnams kyis cal col mang po lab nas 'gog pa dge 'dun pa'i 'du sgo khegs pa'i sdig 'dre nag po yin/ sha zos nas dge 'dun pa'i lus zungs gsos/ chos byas na de ma phan na dge 'dun pa'i za skal rnams shan pa 'jig rten pas zos nas bag med kyi spyod pa ngan pa 'di ngan/des na sha ma za zhes brgya tham pa stong rtsa gcig bshad rung sdig dang ma 'dres pa'i sha zos mi chog na 'jig rten pas zos mi chog chos pa rnams kyis lhag pas zos chog pa'i rgyu mtshan mang zhes rang gis zos pas mi chog gzhan la yang chos bshad dang kha brda 'dra gi zhor la bshad pa rnams kyi kha za 'dres khrid pa dang khyad par med de/ rgyu mtshan gang yin zhe na/ de yang so thar gyi gzhi bzung nas theg chen byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed nas rgyu pha rol tu phyin pa'i theg pa dang / 'bras bu rdo rje theg pa'i lam la bslab nas gsum ldan rdo rje 'dzin pa byed 556

dgos zhes rgyal ba gong ma rnams kyis mgrin gcig dbyangs gcig tu gsungs pa'i nang ltar/ deng sang chos pa'i khur 'dzin pa rnams kyis/ dang po bla ma bsten nas so thar sdom pa blangs/ de nas lam rim blo sbyong phyag chen rdzogs chen lam 'bras zhi byed gcod yul rnams nyams su len rtsis yin pas/gal te nyams su ma lon rung skyabs 'gro byas sems bskyed zhus nas nyin rer skyabs sems re ma mtha' mi byed pa med pa med mod snyam/ de yin na sgon 'jug gi sems bskyed nas rgyal sras kyi spyod pa slob ces lha dang bla ma dpang por bzhag nas khas blangs nas/ snga dro khas blangs gi phyi dro nas dngos su ma gnod rung / rgyud nas sems can la gnod pa'i las sha za mi rung zhes sangs rgyas kyis byang sems bslab bya'i skabs nas brgya stong gsungs pa rnams shes bzhin khyad du bsad nas sha zos chog zer ba 'di rnams sha zos rgyags thal bas spyos nas ci zer 'di zer ma byung ba yin pa ma gtogs/ sems can rnal du phebs pa'i gtam zhig tu mi rigs so/ /'on kyang nged rnams la mdo sngags kyi chos thams cad nyams su len tu yod pas skyon gyis mi gos pa'i gdangs shig yod ces de 'dra'i gtam la brten na mdzes/ rang gzhan la phan pa'i dgos pa che 557

na sdom pa gsum gang gi skabs na yang dmigs bsal gyi gnang ba brgya dgos na stong yod pas/ de thams cad rang dgar gnang bar ma sems shig 'o na mkhas grub rin po ches lung rigs du ma'i lam nas rnam gsum dag pa'i sha zos chog ces sdom gsum yod pas der blta bar gyis zhes zer na/ de la yang rig pa phyogs bzhir bkram nas dpyad par bya ste/ khong rnams kyis rgyal ba'i bka' yi ge na gcig yan chad 'dor rgyu med par gdams ngag du 'char ba dang / mdo sngags kyi chos gnyis 'gal ba phar zhog gcig grogs su gcig 'gro tshul lung rigs kyis bsgrubs nas sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa gru bzhi lam gyis 'khyer ba la byang sems sdom pa'i skabs su lang gshegs kyi mdo nas/ nyan thos sha za ba nga'i rjes 'jug ma yin/ nga de'i ston pa ma yin/ ma 'ongs bskal pa snyigs dus su sha ston pas gnang ba yin zhes bshad pa'i ngag la bdud zhugs pa yin zhes gsungs pa dang / so thar na nya sha dang sha skam sogs zos chog ces gsungs pa mi 'gal ba'i dgongs pa gang yin na/ so thar nas bkag yod pa sngags kyi sdom pa bzung nas da dung sha'i sred pas zos na chog ces bshad pa rnams mkhas grub rjes phyogs sngar langs nas bkag pa yin no/ /de'i 558

dgongs gzhi byang sems sdom pa blangs dus su yang zos chog bshad pa min/ de skabs zos mi chog ces gsal bar gsungs bzhin du da dung rje yab sras sogs bla ma gong ma tshor khegs ngan bkal nas sha nan gyis za ba rnams kyi snying rje byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed pa'i yul phyogs su ma nye bar 'dug pas/ khyod byang chub sems dpa' mtho 'bring dma' gsum kun gyi bslab pa'i las 'brel med pa zhig go /da ni sha za dus nga nyan thos pa yin gyis zo/ skabs re nga gsang sngags pa yin gyis bzhes pa la rem/ mthar ci 'gyur blta 'ong /yang kha cig na re/ sha nyes pa yod rung mdo sngags kyi gzhung na de bzhin gshegs pa'i mtshan re brjod pa dang / gzungs sngags tshar re bton pa dang / yi dam lha'i bsgom bzlas yud tsa ma re byas kyang dag 'gro ba gsungs yod pas skyon med/ lhag par du dud 'gro bsad pa de la dmigs nas bton na/ shi bo de la yang phan pa'i las can yin/ gzhan skye bo mi nag pa tshos ra lug g.yag gsum mang po bsad nas sha khrag dron po zos nas sdig pa kho na byed tshul la ltos dang / de bas chos ngo shes pa tshos zos nas rgyal ba'i gsung rab byin rlabs can bton na phan yon che/ sred pa chen po ma skyes pa byas nas sha zos na 559

chog pas/ zo zo zer mkhan kyang mang po 'dug zer na/ de la khyed rnams kyis 'di ltar ba sam blo thongs dang ha go yong /sngon sangs rgyas thugs rje can gyis dang po chos 'khor bskor ba'i dus su sdig pa 'dzems/ dge ba sgrubs/ dus rgyun du sems bzang bo gyis gsung ba ma gtogs/ sangs rgyas khong gis dang po nas/ 'o khyed chos pa tshos sha zos chog za dgos/za dus nga'i gsungs 'di tsho thon dang / sdig pa'i nyes dmigs kyi skyon gyis mi gos/ ngas khag theg zhes gsungs med pas 'dzems na bzang / 'o na khong gis sha'i don du srog bcad pa dang sha zos pa la sogs pa'i sdig pa thams cad dag yong zhes gsungs pa tsho'i dgongs pa gang yin snyam na/ de ni tshe 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas ma rig nyon mongs kyi dbang du song nas/da bar du bsags pa'i sdig pa dang / khyad par tshe 'dir yang tshe stod sogs la kha ma sos/ mi shes chags sdang gi dbang du song / nyon mongs pa'i gdon gyis myos nas sdig pa byas song ba la rjes nas sdig pa'i nyes dmigs shes nas/ sngar byas sdig pa dug khong du shor ba lta bu'i gnong 'gyod skyes nas bshags pa dang / phyin chad srog la babs kyang nam yang shes bzhin mi byed pa'i sdom sems can gyis/ stobs bzhi'i nang gi 560
