gnyen po kun tu spyod pa'i stobs kyi skabs kyi de bzhin gshegs pa'i mtshan brjod pas gzungs sngags bzla ba sāts+tsha 'debs pa phyag bskor byed pa sogs byas na sdig pa 'dag gsungs pa yin la/ de 'dra ma yin par sangs rgyas kyis nged kyi rjes 'jug chos pa rnams la dngos sam brgyud nas sems can gzhan la gnod pa'i las thams cad mi dge sdig pa yin pas spong dgos zhes mdo sde du ma nas yang dang yang du gsungs pa'i bka' de dag thams cad khyad du bsad nas/rang gis shes bzhin du sha'i ched du gzhan la sdig pa byed du bcug nas/ nga la mdo sngags kyi gzhung nas gsungs pa'i sdig pa sbyong thabs yod pas nga la skyon gyis mi gos par ma zad/ ra lug g.yag gsum sogs sems can gang bsad pa de yang ngan song du mi ltung ba'i thabs kha la ldud rgyu rna bar sgogs rgyu sems la 'jog rgyu mang po yod ces kha nas kyang de ltar du smra/ lag len la yang 'debs pa byung na/ de ni sangs rgyas kyi bka'i dgongs pa ma lon par phyin ci log tu spyod pa'i rgya za lar mu stegs pa'i lugs ka yin te/ rgya za lar bla ma 'ga' res kyang /gzhan gyis sems can bsad na sdig pa che/ khos bsad na sdig pa med par ma zad/ bsad pa de la chos sprad pa yin pas 561

phyi mar phan zer/ bla ma kho rang lug gi ske la 'jus nas mgo bcad nas gsod skad/ de bden na khyed 'ga' zhig gi bsam sbyor dang de gnyis la khyad par gang yang mi 'dug pas/ phyin chad tsho kha sha za 'dod pa rnams kyis sngar rang gis shes pa de'i thog tu rgya za lar bla mar bsten nas/ de'i lugs ka de yang bslab na skyon gyis mi gos pa la phan thogs yong ba'i tshod na 'dug pas/ 'ga' res slob par rigs so/ /dper na byi la 'ga' res/ tsi gu zin pa byung na kho dga' nas gsod snyam yang bar skabs der snying rje ba ltar byas tsi gu btang nas/rtsed mo rtse rgyu med rung yod pa ltar/ rtsed mo 'dra mang po rtses nas mthar kha nang du bzung sgam 'og tsho khyer nas za ba bzhin/chos pa 'ga' zhig gis gsod rgyu'i ra lug chen po bzung nas btags yod dus snying rje ba ltar byas/ ma ṇi tsho 'don pa mang / bsad tshar nas sha btsos pa dang / kun gyi mi mthong ba'i lkog zhig tu khyer nas rngam nas za ba mang / sngon byi la zhig gis tsi gu gcig bzung nas khyer yong / sa na sil bo zhig kha sbub tu yod pa'i rtsa nas btang / rtsed mo zhig rtse snyam tshe/ tsi gu sil bo'i 'og tu shor song tshe/ byi la'i nang du bltas/snying rje ltar skad gnyom po zhig bton nas grag tshe/ tsi gu lhag par du 562

phug la bros tshe/ byi las yar lta mar lta byas pa mi gcig gi mthong tshe rgod shor zer skad/ de bzhin du deng sang 'di na chos pa 'ga' zhig gis lug gsod dus snying rje ba ltar byas ma ṇi sogs gcig re tsho bton kyang / skabs rer gsod dus 'dra ma byung tshe/ yar blta mar blta byed pa mthong tshe mi mngon dbyings na bzhugs pa'i rgyal ba rnams bzhad mo 'chor bar ma zad/ deng sang gi chos pa 'ga' res bsam sbyor go tshe thang gi mi tsho yang rang ga rgod kha 'chor snyam/ 'on kyang snying rje khrag khrig 'dra skyes nas 'don pa 'dra bton ni yin na shi bo der phan mi thogs rung / kho la bsam pa bzang bo sgyes ba tsam gye phan yon re los yod snyam/ da mdor hril gyis dril na/chos pa bzang po snying rje can zhig yin na rang la sdig pa'i skyon gyes gos mi gos kyi ci bya/ gzhan pha rol gyi ma rgan ra lug sogs gsod pa de snying rje nas sha'i ched du gsod du ma 'jug par tshe thar srog bslu la rem/ de ma yin par mi song rjes kyi lag g.yug gi dpe ltar/ bsad tshar zos tshar ba'i rjes kyi snying rje de dang / rgyags rtsed kyi 'don pa 'dra bton na skye bo mi nag pa tsho'i mig sngar mdzes kyang / bsam sbyor gang la bltas rung phan pa'i tshod na mi 'dug des na de dang de 563

'dra'i rgyal ba'i bka'i dgongs pa ma lon par phyin ci log tu spyad na/ rgyal ba'i bka' ma log rung / rang gi bsam sbyor log pa yin pas/ rgyal ba'i bka' dri ma med pa dang / rgya za lar gyi lugs ka gnyis la khyad par ma byung ba yin pas/ de 'dra zhig tu ma song ba zhig kun gyis gyis dang bzang / spyir sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa la brten nas sems can la phan bde zhig 'byung dgos ste/ phan bde 'byung ba'i gnas gcig pu/bstan pa yun ring gnas pa dang / zhes gsungs/ des na bstan pa dang de 'dzin yod pa'i phyogs kyi mi phyugs thams cad bde mo skyid po zhig byung na bstan pa gnas pa yin/ de ma yin par mi phyugs thams cad la sdug btang byung na/ bstan pa gnas pa ma yin/ deng sang grwa ba 'ga' res dgon pa'i dge 'dun pa'i gtong sgo sogs la khag ngan bkal nas/ grong gi mi phyugs thams cad sdug sna dgu gtong mkhan la ltos dang skyo ba skyes yong / da mang po bshad na mi nyan/ deng sang gi chos pa dbang can pha‘pa cher gye mtshang la phog tshe tshig ngan smra zhing / shed can 'ga' res bzung nas kha yang gri yis gshag nyen che bas tshod 'dzin dgos snyam/ 'on kyang khyed shes ldan snying rje can la de tsam bshad kyang phan/ khrel med rnams la ci 564

tsam bshad kyang bshad mkhan rang gi sdug gyong du 'dug de bas kha rog bsdad pa gdams ngag zab gsungs pa ltar bya lags/ yang bdag cag gi ston pa thabs mkhas la thugs rje che ba de nyid kyis/ so thar gyi skabs su nyan thos rnams la thog mar sems can rmig pa kha gas kyi sha ma gtogs rmig sdum gyi sha zos mi chog pa'i bcos pa mdzad/ de nas rnam gsum dag pa'i sha ma gtogs sha gzhan thams cad zos mi chog pa'i bcos pa mdzad/ byang sems kyi skabs su sems can thams cad drin can gyi pha mar ma gyur pa gcig kyang med pas/ shi sha log sha'i rigs su gyur pa zos mi chog pa'i bcos pa mdzad pa de la/ bka' gdams bla ma gong ma rnams kyis so thar skabs kyi bcos pa gnyis po de/ gang zag sha la sred pa che ba'i rigs rnams sha gtan nas zos mi chog ces thog ma nas gsungs na bstan pa la mi 'jug gi dgongs nas thog mar gsungs kyang /bstan pa la zhugs nas rim gyes blo kha mtho ru song ba dang byang sems kyi skabs su/ sha thams cad gcod pa'i don du gsungs pa yin pa'i dgongs pa lon dgos gsung / de thugs bden de/ sangs rgyas kyis theg pa chen po'i chos 'khor bskor ba'i dus su nyan rang mang po'i blo kha mtho ru song nas byang chub 565

mchog tu sems bskyed pa grangs med byung ba de rnams kyis sha gtan nas mi za bas/ des na nyan thos thams cad kyis sha za bar ma sems shig rgyal ba gnyis pa rje bdag nyid chen po'i gsung 'bum na gnang bkag kyi so mtshams shes na mdo sngags gnyis ka gcig tu 'gro tshul lung rigs kyis bsgrubs nas yang yang gsungs/ sdom gsum gyi skabs su bkag bya ba la dgos pa gtso bas rang gzhan la phan pa'i dgos pa chen po yod na sha tsam du ma zad/ chang dang phyag rgya ma sogs 'dod yon ma spang rgyan du rol na chog tshul gsungs/ dgos pa med par rang dgar gnang ba zhig mi snang / mkhas grub rjes sdom gsum rnam bshad du yang / byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed pa'i theg chen byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis sha'i rigs su gyur pa mi bzhes pa zhig byung na shin tu ngo mtshar che/ so thar gyi skabs su yang rnam gsum dag pa'i sha ma gtogs sha gzhan zos mi chog de yang sred pa'i dbang gis zos mi chog ces rmi lam du yang smra bar mi bya'o/ /gsungs/ des na deng sang bsngos sha ma gtogs rnam gsum dag pa'i sha dkon/ de yang sha la sred pa med pa'i chos pa zhig de bas dkon pas/ des na sha zos chog ces ki btab lcag g.yug pa tshos sdig tshod dran pa'i bzung na 566

mi dga' 'am/ sha 'di zos che na phug skyon yod par ma zad/'phral du yang sha dug gis 'chi ba yang mang po mthong yang yon bdag la sha zhig gi mkho bzhed 'dug bshad na/ dngos su yang de'i ched du yon bdag gis lug gsod pa mthong thos mang la/ dgon pa'i las tshan pa mang po zhig gis gtong sgo chen po yod ces 'brog nas lug nyi shu sum cu nyos nas ston kha gsod pa dgon pa che chung mang po na yod pa mngon sum du snang / mchod mjal byed dus lha sku ma mthong gong du sha khog mang po mjal bar gda'/ de dag thams cad log 'tsho sbyar ba ma yin nam/ log 'tsho gang la zer/ smros shig ra lug gi srog la dngos sam brgyud nas gnod pa 'di mi mthong ba'i chos pa rnams mig gsal bo med pa yin nam/ gsal na mthong rung ma mthong ba'i dzu bag ma byed cig da lta kun gyis rta sha dang khye sha mi sha mi za ba'i stabs kyis sha de rnams kyi ched du dmigs nas rta dang khyi dang mi gsod pa ma mthong mi rta khye yi sha za rgyu yin na/ rta bong mi khyi gsod pa'i shan pa yang 'dir yong srid do/ /smad rgya nag gi yul na yod skad/ ra lug g.yag gsum gyi sha za mkhan mang ba'i shan pa yang mang ba mngon sum du grub pa la ltos shig sangs rgyas kyis sems can 567

la dngos sam brgyud nas gnod pa thams cad sdig pa mi dge ba yin pas spong zhes gsung go bzhin du/ sha zos pa'i sems can la mi gnod zer ba'i khog tu gdon ci zhig zhugs pa yin/sha 'dis dngos sam brgyud nas sems can gyi srog la gnod gnod cig zas gzhan gyis mi gnod/ thabs mkhas la thugs rje che ba'i sangs rgyas kyis yul dus kyi dbang gi sha ma gtogs 'tsho ba ma 'byor ba'i tshe/ de ma zos na tshe srog gi bar chad du 'gro 'gyur ba/ yon bdag dad can gyis kyang rnam gsum dag pa'i sha'i 'tsho ba sbyar zin pa ma zos na chud zos su 'gro ba/zos na tshogs rdzogs pa sogs dgos pa chen po byung na dmigs bsal gyis rnam gsum dag pa'i sha re bzhes dgos byung ba yin gyis/ dgos pa med par bzhes pa yin snyam nas de skad smra bar 'dod na/ sangs rgyas kyang byang chub sems dpa' min zhes don gyi bskur ba btab par 'gyur la/ laṅkar gshegs pa las/ ngas mi za smra zhing za na nga de'i slob dpon ma yin/ de nga'i rjes 'jug ma yin zhes gsungs pa yang khyad du bsad nas/ lhas sbyin gyis phrag dog mi za ba'i dbang gis sangs rgyas la rgyag rdo 'phang / glang chen rbad gsod grab shom mang po byas pa'i dgras sha mi za ba bzhin du sangs rgyas kyis sha 568

za zhes skur ba btab/ rang gi lkog nas za bzhin dngos su rnam gsum dag pa spangs pas zog dang gsob byed pa'i kha bzung rgyab skyor nas sangs rgyas kyi lhas sbyin gyi rtul zhugs tsam yang ma byung bar skye bo tha mal pa ltar sha za ba zhig tu ltos/de skad spra ba thams cad lhas sbyin gyi phyogs su don gyis song zhing / sangs rgyas 'khor bcas kyis dgos ched med bzhin du dus rgyun du rnam gsum dag pa'i sha'i gung tshigs gsol zhes skur ba 'debs mkhan rnams kyis sangs rgyas 'khor bcas zhabs tog med pa'i zhabs 'dren byas pa yin pas gtam de 'dra nang ba sangs rgyas nang du sgogs pa phar zhog phyi rol pa la bsgrags na rang ga ston pa'i lhas sbyin la yang 'gran ma nus sha za dgos zhes sngo lo 'phyar ba yin pas de 'dra lab pa'i kha zums/ mi 'tshum na kha la skyag gong chug gcig sngon sangs rgyas 'khor bcas kyi zas bsod snyoms gnas shing drung ba yin pa'i gnas nges med/ zas nor gyi gsog 'jog dang nyo tshong mi byed pa'i sha yi nyo tshong mi byed pa smos ci dgos/ de ltar mdzad pa la rnam gsum dag pa zhig ma gtogs log 'tsho 'ong thabs med la/ deng sang grong ltag dgon pa btab/ khyim pa las lhag gi gsog 'jog rgya chen po byas/ de'i thag nyer shan pa 569

bsam bzhin sdod du bcug shan pas kyang dge 'dun pas sha nyo yong shag byas bsad/ dge 'dun pas kyang bsad nas sha mang po yod shag byas nyos/ gsod mkhan nyo mkhan gnyis ga'i rgyu rkyen la brten nas sems can ra lug brgya stong mang po'i srog mngon sum gcod pa 'di la nyes pa gang yang med/ rnam gsum dag pa yin na thams cad dag pa rab 'byams 'ba' zhig tu song 'dug pas/ snyigs dus kyi sems can bsod te che bar gda'/ sems can dngos sam brgyud nas gnod pa 'di sdig pa min/ ston pas bcas pa'i gral du dngos sam shugs kyis yang ma thebs/ shan pa'i lag gi sha zos tshad la nyes pa med pa yin na ston pa'i bcas pa yang mi dgos par/grub chen tsho ltar dge slong rnams kyis kyang snang ba ku yangs byas chog par gda' bas rem zhig sha za mkhan gyis sangs rgyas dang bla ma dang / de'i rjes 'jug sha za mkhan rnams/de'i zhabs tog mkhan yon bdag shan pa gsum po sngar med pa'i chos gsar ba ra lug gi rabs rtsa ba dgu rgyud nas gcod pa'i bstan pa zhig byung ba yin pas/ ha cang yun ring na/ ra lug g.yag gsum zad pa byung na/ mi rta khye gsum yang gsod nyen che bas phyi rabs ston pa'i rjes 'jug rnams kyis bag 570

yod par byos shig sngon sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das 'khor bcas lha klu mi dang dri za sogs 'gro ba thams cad kyis bsnyen bkur zhus pa'i tshul mang ste/ zas dkar gsum mngar gsum sogs kyi 'tsho ba sbyar zhes mang po mdo nas gsungs te/dmar gsum skyur gsum drangs zhes pa zhig kyang mi 'dug ces gsungs pa yang ma mthong / de bzhin du sangs rgyas gnyis pa jo bo yab sras kyis yer ba lha ri sogs nas bzhugs dus zas dkar gsum mngar gsum sogs ston pas gnang ba bzhes pa ma gtogs/ rnam gsum dag pa'i sha mang po bzhes zhes rnam thar gsung 'bum na mi snang / rgyal ba'i bstan pa la rgyal ba rang nyid mtshungs pa'i rje rin po che yab sras kyi rnam thar na yang sha mang po bzhes zer ba zhig med/ rjes 'jug rnams la yang rnam gsum dag pa'i sha 'ba' zhig nyos/ sred pa'i dbang gis zo zhes zer ba mi 'dug 'o na rgyal ba'i khab kyi khyim bdag cig gis sha thug drangs pa dge slong mang pos bzhes pa'i lo rgyus 'dug zer na/ de ni yon bdag gis sangs rgyas 'khor bcas bsnyen bkur chen po byas na tshe 'dir yang bsod nams chen po 'ong bar go nas/ de yin na sha thug 'di zhim zhing / 'jig rten pa rnams kyi mchog tu mthong nas za ba la 571

dpag nas sha'i bsnyen bkur bsnyen bkur gyi mchog tu 'gyur ram snyam nas sha thug bskol ba ma bzhes na chud zos su song nas yon bdag gi tshogs mi rdzogs shing / zos na tshogs rdzogs par dgongs nas de'i nyin bu sha ma yis za ba ltar sred pa med rung / rma la phan na khyi tshil yin yang klan zer ba ltar/ gzhan la phan phyir lan cig bzhes dgos byung ba yin gyis/ dus rgyun du sangs rgyas kyis sha thug bzhes par ma sems shigasangs rgyas 'khor bcas kyis gzhan la phan na sgyu ma mkhan gyis dug dang sbyar ba'i zas ngan pa yang gsol na/ gzhan gsol ba smos ci dgos/ 'o na sangs rgyas kyi nyan thos rnams kyis dus rgyun du sha zos pa'i rtags su/ lhas sbyin gyis sangs rgyas 'khor gyi sha bzhes pas/ nged rnams kyis mi za bar bya'o zhes bcas pa mdzad pa dang / sdom gsum nyan thos rnams rnam gsum dag pa'i sha rgyun du za tshod na 'dug zer na/ de ni dgos ched kyi dbang gis lan re srid mtha' re byung ba la lhas sbyin gyis phrag dog gis skur ba btab pa la su zhig yid ches/lhas sbyin legs skar gnyis kyi gtam la su zhig gis bden par 'dzin/ de bden par bzung nas de'i kha 'dzin rgyab skyor pa rnams kyis sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dang bu rgyud rnams blos 572

spong 'dod pa yin/ 'o na mkhas grub rjes rnam gsum dag pa'i sha za dgos tshul lung rigs kyi lam nas gsar bar gsungs so zer na/ de bden/ dgos ched byung na mkhas grub rjes gsungs par ma zad sangs rgyas kyis kyang gnang bas/ rnam gsum dag pa gang la zer na/ da lta'i 'di la zer/ ma dag pa de gang la zer/ gang na yod ltos dang / de yang za ba la yang rnam pa mang / sred pa'i dbang gis za zhes mkhas grub rjes kyang ma gsungs te/ de yang sdom gsum rnam bzhag las/ de na sred pa med pa de gang 'dra zhig yin snyam na/ sngon rgyal po yab yum gyis sras kyi sha zos nas la rtol ba 'dra ba zhig dgos/de 'dra e 'dug soms dang / dper na skyug nad can la zas sred pa med pas bstan na yang zhen pa log la/ nad kyi dbang gis cung zad re bsten pa byung na yang sred pa med bzhin za ba 'dra ba zhig dgos pa'i tshod na 'dug pas/ mkhas grub rjes gnang zer ba sogs gda' ste/ de ni rje yab sras kyi zhabs tog min zhabs 'dren yin/ de yin na rje yab sras kyis rtogs pa mthon por slebs skabs bde stong gi grogs su sha chang bsten dgos zhes dmigs gsal gsungs 'dug pas/rang gi gnang ba min bkag bya ba la dgos pa gtso bas/573

dgos pa med pa'i sred pa can la gnang bar ma sems shig dgos pa chen po byung tshe so thar byang sems sngags sdom gang gi skabs su'ang gang zag dbang bo'i bye brag gi dbang gis sha chang bud med gsum sogs dus gcig tu bsten chog pa'i dmigs bsal yang yod srid pas de la 'gal ba sus 'phud/kho bo cag ni sangs rgyas 'khor bcas rje yab sras kyi dgongs don 'tshol la 'bad kyis tshig tsam 'grig mi 'grig brtsi ba ma yin/ sems la gnod na re zhig 'jog par rigs so/ /yang kha cig na re/ dus 'khor dang de'i 'grel chen las/ za ba po med na gsod pa po mi 'byung zer ba de phyi rol mu stegs pa gcer bu pas 'dod tshul khas len du khyad ma byung ba yin/ de yin na rig lam du 'gal bas na 'grel chen gyi mi tshad yang chen yin rung de mi 'thad do snyam na/ sangs rgyas kyis dngos sam brgyud nas sems can la phan na sdig pa ltar snang yang sgrub na chog sems can la dngos sam brgyud nas gnod na dge ba zhig yin rung re zhig 'jog dgos/ bsod nams bsags pa sdig tu 'gyur na/ de yang sdig pa yin par gsungs/ des na/ sdig pa ci yang mi bya zhing / /zhes gsungs pa ltar byung na/ phyi rol hwa shang rgya za lar mu stegs pa gang yin 574

rung khas len dgos te/ sangs rgyas kyi chos dang mthun pa phyi rol pa'i nang dang skye bo mi nag gi nang na yod na yang de ngas gsungs bzhin du bkur bar bya'o/ phyi rol pa dang 'dod pa lag len dang mthun pa rnams byed mi rung na/ nang rig pa ma gtogs rig gnas gzhan rnams kyang 'dor dgos/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ phyi rol pa 'dod pa gcig pa dang lag len mthun pa'i phyi nang gnyis ga'i thun mong pa yin pa'i phyir ro/ /des na phyi nang su yin yang srog gcod kyi sdig pa zhig ma byung na mi nga'i 'dod pa 'grub pa yin pas des chog go /yang kha cig na re/ 'o na sangs rgyas kyi jes 'jug rnams la so thar byang sems sngags sdom gang gi skabs su gnang ba byin pa mang bas/rnam gsum dag pa'i sha yang gsum ldan rdo rje 'dzin pa tshos bzhes na/ so so thar ba tsho smos ci dgos/ 'dul ba yul dus dang bstun dgos pas/ sdig zas yin rung bod la mthun rkyen zas dkon pa'i dbang gis sha zos nas rgyal ba'i bka' la sbyang na skyon med par ma zad chos pa de ma 'ongs pa na sangs rgyas tshe 'brel thogs rnams drangs chog gzhan 'jig rten mi nag pa shan pa dang rngon pa tshos zos pa lta bu ga la yin/ khyed kyis brgya stong bshad rung tha za dgos par snang / deng sang 575

chos pa 'jig rten pa su la yang sha za mi nyan/ da lta rang la sa gas nas dmyal bar lhung 'gro bshad rung spong thub mkhan med/de bas sha zos rung skyon mi gos pas gdam pa 'dra yod na gsung lags/ de ma yin par da phyin chad khyed dang khyed 'dra'i kha lan chag len rag gi nam 'chi cha med bsam nas rang don la ma ṇi re thon dang bzang / chos bshad kyag kyog gi dgon pa'i nang bshig ga de bas kha rog par bzhugs/bzhugs tshugs mi tshugs khyed la gsal/ khyed kyang sha ma zos pas rlung 'dra langs pa yin nam/ thugs mi bde ba 'dra med dam/ dred po nga dang 'dra ba'i ci bshad rung nyan pa'i tshod na mi 'dug da dung khyed kyis sa stong tsho us stong rgyab lags zer na/ 'o de khyod bden/ da phyin chad thams cad kha la mi nyan rung / blo ldan snying rje can re gnyis kha la nyan srid/de'i phyir bdag gis shes rab yangs po byas/ rig pa phyogs bzhir bkram nas bshad par bya/ de la sdom pa gsum gye bcas pa'i skabs su gnang bkag mang po yod pa khyod bden de/ de'i so mtshams shes dgos te/ rang ga gnang yod ces thams cad ra chu la brgal brgal byas/ sdom pa gsum po kha chag sna ral byed ga la rung / de la gnang tshul ni/ so thar 576

skabs su/ yul mdo smad nas dbus gtsang lta bu'i thag ring re phyin tshe lam nas za rgyu ma rnyed/ ma zos na srog gi bar chad du 'gro dus dang / nad pa zungs zad 'chi la nye ba sha zhig ma zos na mi 'tsho bar thag chod pa'i dus dang / byang sems skabs su sar gnas kyi byang chub sems dpa' chen po gshegs na bstan pa'i sgon me nub/ sku tshe yun ring 'tsho na bstan 'gro'i don rlabs chen 'ong ba'i bla ma skyes chen 'ga' res sku na bgres dus rlung bcos 'dra byed dgos pa'i dus dang /gsang sngags kyi skabs su bskyed rdzogs kyi gdengs thob pa'i rnal 'byor pas tshogs kyi 'khor lo dang / bde stong gi rtogs pa bskyed pa'i thabs sogs rang gzhan la phan pa'i dgos pa che dus sogs la/ gang zag 'ga' re la dmigs bsal gyi gnang ba byin pa ma gtogs thams cad la dus thams cad du gnang ba byen pa ma yin te/ dper na dge skos kyis dge 'dun pa thams cad la/ khyed dge 'dun pa rnams dus rgyun du tshogs la yong dgos/ grwa shag tu chang dang bud med kyi 'grim 'grul gtan nas byed mi rung / zhes tshogs gdams gtong na/ kun gyis tshogs gdams kyi nang bzhin byed dgos pa bden mod/ 'on kyang las tshan pa gnyer ba dgon pa'i 577

las don gal can gyi dbang gis grwa shag nas sdod dgos byung nas/ tshogs su yong ma thub pa'i rgyu mtshan zhus na/ de la dmigs bsal gye dgongs pa khrol nas bsdad chog pa dang /yang grwa ba bgres po sku snyung ba la yang dgongs pa zhus na yong /gzhan na ba la chang gi sman rta byed dgos byung na de la dgongs pa yong ba dang / grwa ba 'chi la nye ba sring mo dang a ma thug gi yong na dmigs bsal byas dgongs pa ster ba bzhin/bkag bya ba la dgos pa gtso bas/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa snying rje'i rab tu phye ba yin gshis/ rang gzhan la dngos sam brgyud nas phan pa'i dgos pa che tshe sdom gsum gang gi skabs na dmigs bsal byas gnang ba yod cing / dgos pa chen po med bzhin du rang gar dgongs pa gtan nas med tshul rnams shes na/ phan bde'i 'byung gnas rgyal bstan mi 'chol zhing /mdo sngags gnyis gcig grogs su gcig song nas/ gsung rabs thams cad gdams ngag tu 'char ba'i gnad khyad par can yod/ bstan pa la gces spras mdzad cing / sems can la phan sems can rnams kyis phyin chad 'di dang 'di 'dra'i dka' gnas la nges pa rnyed par byas te/ rang ga dgos pa med bzhin du sdom gsum ldan pas rnam gsum dag pa'i sha 578

yang bzhes mi rung na/ bsngos sha mi rung ba smos ci dgos/gal te rlung shas 'dra che ba sogs kyi mis dgos nga 'i dbang gis sha spong ma thub par za dgos pa byung na/ sha'i nyes dmigs dran par byas pa sha la sred pa skyes pa spangs te/ rang gi don du ra lug sogs gzhan gyis bsad pa mthong ba dang /thos pa dang / bsad yod dam med dam snyam pa'i dogs pa yang med pa ste/ mthong thos dogs gsum med pa'i rnam gsum dag pa'i sha gzhan gyi lag nas nyos te cung zad re zos chogade 'dra ma yin par deng sang bla ma 'bul sdud pa dbyar ston rong 'brog tu phebs na/ yon bdag rnams kyis nyin re bzhin ra lug mang bo bsad nas drangs pa dang / dge 'dun pa mang po grong chog tu song nas ra lug g.yag gsum bsad nas sha drangs pa dang / chos ston sogs kyi dus su sems can mang po bsad nas drangs pa'i sha zos na/ bsngos sha tsam du ma zad chos la brten pa'i sdig zas yin pas/ sdig pa kun gyi nang nas de shin tu lci bar gsungs pas dug bzhin du rgyang ring du spong ba gal che/ yang kha cig na re/ sha zos rung deng sang gi bla ma dge ba'i bshes gnyen gye nang na sangs rgyas kyi sprul pa dang / shan pa rnams kyi nang na yang sangs rgyas kyi rnam 'phrul 579

'dra yod yong ba'i skyon med dam zer/ a ho ho/ da ci tso bshad ni red/ sngon lha bzo shing bzo gnyis kyis gcig gis gcig la g.yo sgyu mang po byas pas mthar gnyis ka tshe 'di phyir 'phung ba'i lo rgyus bzhin du/ sngon bla ma zhig gis sems can bsad tshad po yar drangs pa'i lo rgyus dang / shan pa zhig gis drangs pa'i gtam rgyud dang / chos skyong tshos drangs song zer ba'i skad cha 'khyag 'khyog mang po bshad pa tsho la yid brtan ci yang med/ de bas sangs rgyas kyi gsungs rdo rje tshig rnams la yid ches par gyis la/ gzhan chos pa 'jig rten pa kha bde mgo bde gang gi kha la ma nyan par/ sems can thams cad drin can gyi ma ru soms la/ drin bzang bo'i lan du byams snying rje byang chub sems nyin re bzhin du sgoms/ sdig zas pha ma'i sha khrag gi skyon gyis ma gos pa re la 'bad par mdzod cig /ces dad can snying rje che ba byang chub sems dpa'i rigs can rnams la snying gtam du smras pa yin pas kun gyis ma brjed par yid la zungs shig ces sdig zas pha ma'i sha khrag la rngam pa'i 'dod sred me chen gsod pa'i legs bshad bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun zhes bya ba 'di ni/bstan pa dang 'gro ba yongs la phan pa'i lhag bsam can rnal 'byor zhabs dkar pas nyams dga' rig pa dwangs pa'i 'brong lung dben pa'i nags khrod nas sbyar ba'o/ /'dis kyang dngos sam brgyud nas bstan pa dang 'gro ba yongs la phan thogs par gyur cig sarba maṅga lo/ /580

༄༅/ /'od gsal rdzogs pa chen po'i khregs chod lta ba'i glu dbyangs lam ma lus myur du bgrod pa'i rtsal ldan mkha' lding gshog rlabs zhes bya ba bzhugs so//na mo gu ru bh+yaḥ kun gsal mkhyen brtse'i rta bdun dkyil 'khor las/ /tshad med thugs rje'i 'od zer rab spros nas/ /khams gsum 'gro ba'i ma rig mun pa kun/ /dus gcig sel mdzad chos kyi rgyal por 'dud/ /stong gsal chos sku'i lha lam yangs pa'i ngos/ /byams dang brtse ba'i chu 'dzin rab 'khrigs nas/ /skal bar ldan pa'i gdul bya'i 'dzin ma la/ /chos char 'bebs mkhas sngags 'chang rdo rjer 'dud/ /lta ba'i gru dbus lhag bsam dar chen 'phyar/ /brtson 'grus rlung gis bskyod nas srid mtsho ru/ /byings pa'i 'gro rnams sku gsum nor bu'i 581

gling / /'god mdzad ded dpon 'jam dbyangs rgya mtshor 'dud/ /de gsum mkhyen brtse rta bdun dkyil 'khor las/ /'phros pa'i byen rlabs nus mthu'i tsha ba'i zer/ /skal ldan bya btang pad dkar bdag la phog /rig pa'i kha phye nyams rtogs 'dab stong bzhad/ /bdag blo'i ge sar lto bar legs 'khyil ba'i/ /lta ba'i glu dbyangs myong grol bdud rtsi'i bcud/ /skal ldan slob ma rkang drug tshogs la 'bul/ /ngoms pa med par gus pa'i yid kyis rol/ /e ma ho/ bya btang gu yangs yan pa blo bde ngas/ /sa lam ma lus myur du bgrod byed pa'i/ /lta ba'i glu dbyangs mkha' lding gshog rlabs len/ /skal ldan sems kyi bu rnams lhan ner nyon/ /'khor 'das gnyis la 'brug gi sgra bzhin du/ /yongs grags sangs rgyas zer ba'i sgra bo che/ /'gro drug sems can rgyud la rtag zhugs nas/ /skad cig tsam yang g.yel med 'grogs 'di mtshar/ /sangs rgyas rang la yod par ma shes par/ /phyi rol gzhan du sangs rgyas btsal ba mtshar/ /gsal dwangs nyi ma'i snying bo ji bzhin du/ /mngon sum gsal kyang mthong mkhan nyung ba mtshar/ /pha ma med pa'i rang sems sangs rgyas nyid/ /skye ma myong zhing 'chi rgyu med pa 'tshar/ /bde sdug 582

sna tshogs ji ltar myong na yang / /bzang dang ngan du cung zad mi 'gro mtshar/ /ma skyes gdod nas dag pa'i sems nyid 'di/ /ma bcos ye nas lhun gyes grub pa mtshar/ /rang bzhin ye nas grol ba'i rang rig nyid/ /gang byung gang bder bzhag pas grol ba mtshar e ma ho/ skal ldan rigs kyi bu rnams ma yengs nyon/ /dus gsum rgyal ba ma lus thams cad kyis/ /chos phung brgyad khri bzhi stong la sogs pa'i/ /gsung rab nam 'kha'i mtha' mnyam dpag med kyang / /don la rang sems rtogs phyir gsung pa las/ /gzhan du ci yang rgyal bas gsung pa med/ /dper na sdong bo'i rtsa ba gcig bcad na/ /yal ka lo ma khri 'bum dus gcig bskam/ /de bzhin sems kyi rtsa ba gcig bcad na/ /gzung 'dzin la sogs 'khor ba'i lo 'dabs bskam/ /khang stong mun pa lo stong bon pa yang / /sgon mes skad cig nyid la sel ba bzhin/ /rang sems 'od gsal rtogs pa'i skad cig la/ /bskal pa grangs med bsags pa'i sdig sgrib 'dag/ /gsal dwangs nyi ma'i snying bo'i rang bzhin de/ /bskal pa stong gi mun pas sgrib mi nus/ /de bzhin rang sems snying bo'i 'od gsal de/ /bskal par 'khrul bas sgrib par mi nus so/ /nam 583

'kha'i rang bzhin mdog dbyibs tshad las 'das/ /dkar nag sprin gyis gos par mi 'gyur ltar/ /sems kyi rang bzhin mdog dbyibs tshad las 'das/ /dge sdig dkar nag chos kyis gos mi 'gyur/ /dper na 'o ma mar gye rgyu yin kyang / /ma bskrogs bar du mar ni mi 'byung ltar/ /'gro kun bder gshegs snying bo'i rgyu yin kyang / /nyams su ma blangs sems can sangs ma rgyas/ /'di nyid nyams su blangs na kun grol te/ /dbang bo rnams la rno brtul khyad par med/ /nyams su blangs na ba glang rdzi yang grol/ /mngon sum rang sems 'od gsal don rtogs na/ /kha bshad mkhas pa 'di la mi dgos te/ /bu ram rang gi kha ru zos pa'i tshe/ /bu ram ro bshad mi dgos ji bzhin no/ /'di nyid ma rtogs paṇ+ḍi ta yang 'khrul/ /theg dgu'i bshad pa yongs la mkhas gyur kyang / /ma mthong rgyang gi gtam rgyud bshad pa bzhin/ /sangs rgyas sa la gnam sa bas kyang ring / /yang dag rang sems 'od gsal ma rtogs na/ /bskal pa'i bar du tshul khrims bsrungs pa dang / /yun ring bar du bzod pa bsgoms byas kyang / khams gsum 'khor ba'i gnas nas mi 'phags pas/ /de'i phyir 'bad pas sems kyi rtsad gcod gyis/ /584

e ma ho/ da yang ska'/ ldan bu mchog kun gyis nyon/ /rang gi sems kyi rtsad brdar ma chod na/ /dge sbyor gang byas gnad du mi 'gro ste/ /dper na 'ben ni drung du bzhag nas kyang / /mda' ni thag ring phyogs su 'phen dang mtshungs/ /rkun ma rang gi khyem du bzhag nas kyang / /rtsad gcod drag po phyi ru byed dang mtshungs/ /'dre ni shar sgo'i phyogs su bzhag nas kyang / /glud ni nub kyi phyogs su gtong dang mtshungs/ /dbul bo'i skyed rdo gser du ma shes par/ /gzhan nas slong mo byed pa ji bzhin no/ /des na rang gi sems kyi rtsad brdar rnams/ /'di bzhin chod cig skal ldan snying gi bu/ /sems zhes bya ba'i rig rig 'gyu 'gyu bo/ /bdas na mi zin yal yal bun bun po/ /bzhag na mi sdod tshub tshub yer yer po/ /'di zhes mtshon med stong pa phyang chad po/ /bde sdug sna tshogs myong mkhan rang gi sems/ /dang po 'di ni byung sa gang nas byung / /phyi yi snang ba ri brag chu shing dang / /nam mkha'i rlung sogs brten bcas rten med pa/ /gang las byung ngam 'dri zhing rtsad brdar chod/ /yang na pha ma gnyis kyi khu khrag las/ /byung ngam snyam na ji ltar byung tshul dpyod/ /de ltar dpyad pa'i byung sa ma rnyed tshe/ /bar du da lta rang lus stod smad dang / /dbang bo don snying la 585

sogs gang la gnas/ /snying la gnas na mgo mjug gang na gnas/ /dbyibs dang kha dog la sogs ji ltar 'dug /legs par dpyod la gnas sa ma rnyed tshe/ /tha mar 'gro dus yul gyi dbang bo'i sgo/ /gang nas 'gro dang phyi rol yul rnams su/ /yud tsam nyid la slebs pa'i dus de ru/ /lus kyis phyin nam sems nyid kho nas phyin/ /lus sems tshogs pas phyin sogs rtsad brdar chod/ /de yang nyon mongs rnam rtog skye ba'i tshe / /dang po gang nas skyes dang da lta'i dus/ /gang la gnas dang mdog dbyebs e 'dug ltos/ /tha mar rang sar zhi nas yal ba'i tshe/ /gang du yal nas 'gro sogs rtsad brdar chod/ /'chi ba'i tshe na ji ltar byas nas 'gro/ /zhib tu dpyod la skye 'chi 'gro 'ong dang / /dngos bzung bral ba'i stong sangs brjod med du/ /nges par gtan la ma phebs bar du dpyod/ /gzhan gye dpe dang kha bshad skam po yis/ /stong pa nyid yin zer bas mi phan te/ /dper na stag yod zer ba'i sa cha ru/ /gzhan gyes stag ni med par brjod na yang / /rang nyid de la yid ches mi skye bar/ /yid gnyis je tshom za ba ji bzhin no/ /rang gi sems kyi rtsa ba rang nyid kyis/ /zhib tu bcad nas gtan la phab pa'i tshe/ /dper na stag yod zer ba'i lung ba der/ /rang nyid song 586

nas phu mdo thams cad du/ /stag ni e yod rtsad brdar bcad gyur na/ /ma rnyed tshe na rang nyid yid ches te/ /phyin chad sa der stag yod snyam pa yi/ /yid gnyis the tshom med pa ji bzhin no/ /e ma ho/ da yang skal ldan bu rnams tshur nyon dang / khyed rnams de ltar brtags shing dpyad pa'i tshe/ /sems zhes mdzub mo btsugs nas 'di yin zhes/ /dngos por grub pa rdul tsam ma rnyed tshe/ /ma rnyed pa de rnyed pa'i mchog yin no/ /'o skol sems la dang po byung sa med/ /ye nas stong pas ngo bo ngos bzung med/ /bar du gnas sa dbyibs dang kha dog med/ /tha mar 'gror med 'dir song rjes med de/ /'gyu ba stong 'gyu stong pa stong snang yin/ /sems nyid 'di ni dang po rgyus ma bskyed/ /tha ma phyi rol rkyen gyes 'di mi 'jig /'phel dang 'grib dang gang stong 'di la med/ /'khor 'das yongs la khyab pas phyogs ris med/ /'di zhes mi mtshon cir yang 'gags med 'char/ /cir yang ma grub yod med mtha' las 'das/ /'gro 'ong med cing skye 'chi gsal 'grib med/ /sems kyi rang bzhin dri med shel gong bzhin/ /ngo bo stong pa rang bzhin gsal ba dang / /thugs rje 'gag pa med par sa 587

ler gnas/ /'khor ba'i skyon gyis ci yang ma gos te/ /sems nyid ye nas sangs rgyas yin par nges/ /'di ni gzhi yi sems nyid gnas lugs kyi/ /rang bzhin gtan la phab pa'i ngo sprod do/ /e ma ho/ da yang skal ldan sems kyi bu rnams nyon/ /dang po chos sku kun tu bzang po yis/ /bsgom pa rdul tsam ma byas grol tshul dang / /'gro ba drug gis mi dge sdig pa'i las/ /sru tsam ma byas 'khor bar 'khyams tshul ni/ /ye thog dang po kun gyi sngon rol tu/ /'khor 'das ming med gdod ma'i gzhi la gnas/ /de dus rig pa gzhi nas 'phags tshul ni/ /shel la nyi 'phog rang 'od phyir gsal ltar/ /rig pa'i ye shes srog rlung gis bskyod nas/ /gzhon nu bum pa sku yi rgya ral te/ /lhun grub 'od gsal sku dang ye shes kyi/ /zhing khams mkha' la nyi shar bzhin du gsal/ /de dus chos sku kun tu bzang bo yis/ /rang snang yin par shes pas skad cig la/ /phyir gsal sku dang ye shes nang du thim/ /ka dag gdod ma'i gzhi la sangs rgyas so/ /'o skol rnams kyis rang bzhin lhun grub kyi/ /snang ba rang gdangs yin par ma shes pas/ /shes pa dran med 'thom me ba de nyid/ /de la lhan cig skyes pa'i ma rig zer/ /de nas gzhi 588

snang 'od gsal de nyid la/ /gnyis su 'dzin pa'i shes pa skyes pa de/ /kun tu brtags pa'i ma rig pa zhes zer/ /ma rig gnyis 'dzin sbubs su de dus tshud/ /de nas bag chags rim bzhin rgyas nas kyang / /'khor ba'i bya ba 'di rnams thams cad byung / /de nas nyon mongs dug gsum dug lnga dang / /brgyad khri bzhi stong la sogs rgyas nas kyang / /'khor ba'i gnas su zo chu'i 'khyud mo bzhin/ /'khor zhing bde sdug da lta'i bar du myangs/ /rgyas par 'dod na kun mkhyen theg mchog mdzod/ /zab don rgya mtsho'i sprin phung sogs la ltos/ /da ni bla ma'i man ngag zab mo yis/ /'khrul ba'i rang mtshang thams cad rig nas kyang / /rang sems sangs rgyas rang ngo mthong ba yin/ /gdod ma'i mgon po'i rang zhal mjal ba yin/ /kun tu bzang por skal ba mnyam pa yin/ /snying nas dga' ba sgoms shig sems kyi bu/ /'khrul ba gtan la phab pa'i ngo sprod do/ /e ma ho/ da yang skal ldan snying gi bu rnams nyon/ /sems zhes bya ba'i yongs grags sgra bo che/ /yod ni gcig kyang yod pa ma yin te/ /'byung ni 'khor 'das bde sdug sna tshogs 'byung / /'dod ni theg pa'i rnam grangs mang du yod/ /ming ni 589

bsam gyis mi khyab so sor btags/ /so so skye bo rnams kyis nga yang zer/ /mu stegs la las bdag ces ming du btags/ /nyan thos pa yis gang zag bdag med zer/ /sems tsam pa yis sems zhes ming du btags/ /la las shes rab pha rol phyin pa zer/ /la las bder gshegs snying bo ming du btags/ /la las phyag rgya chen po ming du btags/ /la las dbu ma zhes pa'i ming du btags/ /la las thig le nyag gcig ming du btags/ /la las chos kyi dbyings zhes ming du btags/ /la las kun gzhi zhes pa ming du btags/ /la las tha mal shes pa ming du btags/ /ming ni bsam gyes mi khyab ci btags kyang / /don la 'di nyid yin pas shes par gyis/ /khyed rnams sems nyid rang sar glod la zhog /bzhag dus tha mal shes pa rjen ne ba/ /bltas pas mthong rgyu med pa'i sa le ba/ /rig pa mngon sum sa le hrig ge ba/ /cir yang ma grub stong zhing seng nge ba/ /gsal stong gnyis su med pa'i ye re ba/ /rtag pa ma yin cir yang grub pa med/ /chad pa ma yin sa le trig ge ba/ /gcig bu ma yin du ma rig cing gsal/ /du ma ma yin dbyer med ro gcig pa/ /gzhan na med de rang rig 'di nyid do/ /snying dbus bzhugs pa'i gdod ma'i mgon po'i 590

zhal/ /mngon sum da lta'i dus 'dir mthong ba yin/ /'di dang 'bral med gyis shig snying gi bu/ /'di min gzhan las lhag pa su'i 'dod pa/ /glang po rnyed kyang rjes 'tshol ji bzhin du/ /stong gsum thams cad thags su btags na yang / /sangs rgyas ming tsam rnyed par mi srid do/ /dngos gzhi'i gnas lugs don gyi ngo sprod do/ / e ma ho/ da yang rigs kyi bu rnams legs par nyon/ /da lta'i rang rig rang gsal 'di nyid la/ /sku gsum ngo bo rang bzhin thugs rje dang / /sku lnga ye shes lnga sogs thams cad tshang / /rig pa'i ngo bo kha dog dbyibs la sogs/ /cir yang ma grub stong pa chos kyi sku/ /stong pa'i rang gdangs gsal ba longs sku'o/ /sna tshogs 'char gzhi ma 'gag sprul pa'i sku/ /de rnams mtshon pa'i dpe ni 'di dang 'dra/ /shel kyi me long chos kyi sku dang mtshungs/ /rang bzhim/ dwangs shing gsal ba longs sku'i mtshon/ /gzugs brnyan 'char gzhi ma 'gag sprul sku'i dpe/ /'gro rnams sems nyid ye nas sku gsum du/ /gnas pa yin te rang ngo shes nus na/ /'gro ba rnams kyi bsgom pa rdul tsam yang / /bya mi dgos te dus gcig 'tshang rgya'o/ /sku gsum ngo sprod tha dad bstan pa ni/ /don la dbyings gcig ma 591

gtogs tha dad du/ /bzung nas 'khrul bar ma 'gro snying gi bu/ /sku gsum ye nas stong pa ka dag ste/ /gsal stong zung 'jug ngo bo gcig pa ru/ /shes par gyis la 'dzin med ngang la spyod/ /ngo bo rang bzhin thugs rje gsum po yang / /chos sku longs sku sprul sku nyid dang mtshungs/ /gsum ka gsal stong zung 'jug chen po ru/ /shes par gyis la 'dzin med ngang la spyod/ /de yang rang byung rig pa'i ye shes 'di/ /cir yang snang bas rnam par snang mdzad sku/ /'gyur ba med pas mi bskyod rdo rje sku/ /mtha' dbus med pas snang ba mtha' yas sku/ /mchog dang thun mong dngos grub kun 'byung ba'i/ /nor bu 'dra bas rin chen 'byung ldan sku/ /don kun 'grub pas don yod grub pa'i sku/ —/de rnams rig pa'i rtsal las logs na med/ /rig pa'i ye shes ngo bo ma 'gag par/ /mngon sum gsal bas me long ye shes so/ /kun la khyab pas mnyam nyid ye shes so/ /rtsal las sna tshogs 'char bas sor rtog go /don kun 'grub pas bya grub ye shes so/ /de dag rnams kyi ngo bo ka dag tu/ /'dus pas chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes so/ /de rnams thams cad rang gi rig rtsal las/ /logs na grub pa rdul tsam med pa'o/ /sku gsum ngo bo rang bzhin thugs rje dang / /sku lnga ye shes lnga bo 592

gcig char du/ /mngon sum mdzub mo btsugs nas ngo sprod na/ /da lta'i shes pa bzo bcos ma byas pa/ /rkyen gyis ma bsgyur 'dzin pas ma bslad pa'i/ /rig pa sa le hrig ge 'di ka yin/ /dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad 'di las byung / /'di ni dus gsum sangs rgyas thugs yin pas/ /'di dang 'bral med gyis shig skal ldan kun/ /ma bcas rang gsal 'di ka yin pa la/ /rang sems sangs rgyas ma mthong ci la zer/ /'di la bsgom rgyu ci yang med pa la/ /bsgom rgyu ma byung bya ba ci la zer/ /rig pa mngon sum 'di ka yin pa la/ /rang sems ma rnyed bya ba ci la zer/ /gsal trig rgyun chad med pa 'di ka yin/ /sems ngo ma mthong bya ba ci la zer/ /'di la bya rgyu rdul tsam med pa la/ /byas pas ma byung bya ba ci la zer/ /gnas dang mi gnas gnyis su med pa la/ /gnas su ma gtub bya ba ci la zer/ /rang rig sku gsum rtsol med lhun grub la/ /bsgrubs pas ma 'grub bya ba ci la zer/ /byar med cog ges bzhag pas chog pa la/ /de la mi nus bya ba ci la zer/ /rtog pa shar grol dus mnyam yin pa la/ /gnyen pos ma byung bya ba ci la zer/ /da lta'i shes pa 'di ka yin pa la/ /'di la mi shes bya ba ci la zer /593

e ma ho/ da yang skal ldan bu rnams gus pas gson/ /rang sems dngos med nam mkha' stong pa 'dra/ /'dra 'am mi 'dra skal ldan bu rnams kun/ /blta ru med pa'i tshul du rang sems la/ /cer gyis ltos la phyam gyis zhog dang shes/ /stong pa phyang chad dag kyang ma yin par/ /rang rig ye shes ye nas gsal bar nges/ /rang byung rang gsal nyi ma'i snying bo 'dra/ /'dra 'am mi 'dra rang gi sems nyid la/ /cer gyes ltos la phyam gyis zhog dang shes/ /rnam rtog 'gyu dran ngos bzung med par nges/ /'gyu ba nges med bar snang bser bu 'dra/ /'dra 'am mi 'dra rang gi sems nyid la/ /cer gyis ltos la phyam gyis zhog dang shes/ /cir snang thams cad rang snang yin par nges /gang snang thams cad me long gzugs brnyan 'dra/ /'dra 'am mi 'dra rang gi sems nyid la/ /cer gyis ltos la phyam gyes zhog dang shes/ /sems las ma gtogs gzhan na chos med pas/ /lta ba blta rgyu gzhan na chos med do/ /sems las ma gtogs gzhan na chos med pas/ /bsgom pa bsgom rgyu gzhan na chos med do/ /sems las ma gtogs gzhan na chos med pas/ /spyod pa spyod rgyu gzhan na chos med do/ /sems las ma gtogs gzhan na chos med pas/ /dam tshig bsrung rgyu gzhan na chos 594

med do/ /sems las ma gtogs gzhan na chos med pas/ /'bras bu bsgrub rgyu gzhan na chos med do/ /yang ltos yang ltos rang gi sems la ltos/ /phyi rol nam mkha'i khams la sems thongs la/ /rang sems nyid la 'gro 'ong e 'dug ltos/ /bltas tshe 'gro 'ong sems la mi gda' na/ /nang gi rang gi sems la tshur bltas la/ /rtogs pa 'phro ba'i 'phro mkhan e 'dug ltos/ /rtog pa 'phro ba'i 'phro mkhan mi gda' na/ /sems la kha dog dbyebs sogs e 'dug ltos/ /kha dog dbyibs med stong par thug pa'i tshe/ /stong pa nyid la mtha' dbus e 'dug ltos/ /mtha' dbus med tshe phyi nang e 'dug ltos/ /phyi dang nang med rig pa mkha' ltar yangs/ /zang nge thal ler rgya chad phyogs lhung bral/ /rang rig khyab gdal klong chen yangs pa'i ngang / /'khor 'das chos rnams bar snang 'ja' tshon bzhin/ /sna tshogs snang yang sems kyi rol pa ste/ /rang rig g.yo med ngang las phar ltos dang / /chos rnams thams cad sgyu ma chu zla bzhin/ /snang stong so sor dbye bar mi nus so/ /rig pa'i ngang la 'khor 'das gnyis su med/ /rang rig g.yo med ngang las phar ltos dang / /'khor 'das chos rnams me long gzugs brnyan bzhin/ /ji ltar snang yang gdod nas 595

yod ma myong / /'khor 'das ming med thams cad chos sku yin/ /khams gsum 'khor bar 'khyams pa'i 'gro kun gyis/ /ye nas 'khor 'das chos kun mnyam nyid du/ /gnas pa'i ye shes rang ngo ma rtogs par/ /gnyis 'dzin 'khrul ba'i dbang gis so sor bzung / /gnyi sa med don la gnyis 'dzin phyir ma grol/ /kun gyi rang sems 'khor 'das dbyer med la/ /spang blang 'dor len byas pas 'khor bar 'khyams/ /rang rig sku gsum rtsol med lhun grub las/ / 'di min thag ring gzhan du 'gro thabs kyi/ /sa lam btsal nas blun rmongs 'gro ba kun/ /sangs rgyas sa la slebs pa'i dus ma byung / /gang snang thams cad rang snang yin par nges/ /rang rig g.yo med ngang nas phar ltos dang / /snang zhing srid pa thams cad gzugs brnyan 'dra/ /snang stong grag stong rang bzhin ye nas stong / /de ltar blta mkhan sems la tshur ltos dang / /dran rtog rang yal stong pa nam mkha' 'dra/ /spros med spros bral smra bsam brjod las 'das/ /gang snang thams cad sems kyis cho 'phrul te/ /cho 'phrul thams cad gzhi med stong pa yin/ /thams cad rang gi sems su rtogs gyur na/ /mthong snang thams cad stong pa chos sku yin/ /snang bas mi 'ching zhen pas 'ching ba yin/ /zhen 596

chags 'khrul ba chod cig snying gi bu//e ma ho/ skal bar ldan pa'i sems kyi bu mchog rnams/ /lcag gis ma brgyab rta la bang mi ldang / /mang du ma bsrubs 'o mar mar mi chags/ /zhib tu ma bshad gtan la mi pheb pas/ /tshig ka mang po'i glu dbyangs blangs pa la/ /snang ba ma sun dga' ba'i sems kyis nyon/ /snang ba thams cad sems su ma shes na/ /stong nyid don de nam yang mi rtogs pas/ /snang ba 'di dag dang po gang las byung / /bar du gar gnas tha ma gang du 'gro/ /skal ldan bu kun legs par rtog dpyod thongs/ /brtags tshe dper na nam mkha'i na bun de/ /mkha' las byung zhing slar yang mkha' la 'gro/ /de bzhin snang ba sems kyi cho 'phrul te/ /rang gi sems su shar zhing sems su 'gro/ /dper na mig gi dbang po bslad pa'i mis/ /bar snang khams bltas rab rib snang ba de/ /nam mkhar yod yod 'dra bar snang na yang / /mkha' la med de mig gis cho 'phrul yin/ /de bzhin dngos 'dzin bag chags ngan pa yis/ /sems kyi dbang bo bslad pa'i mthu yis ni/ /kun rdzob snang grags chos rnams thams cad kun/ /bden par yod yod 'dra bar snang na yang / /gdod nas dngos por grub pa rdul tsam yang / /med de 597

rang gi sems kyis cho 'phrul yin/ /cho 'phrul thams cad gzhi med stong pa yin/ /med pa gsal snang sgyu ma chu zla 'dra/ /snang stong dbyer med don la mnyam par zhog /da lta rang cag gnyid kyi rmi lam na/ /pha yul gnas khang nye 'brel la sogs pa/ /mngon sum snang nas bde sdug myong ba'i tshe/ /rang gi nye du 'brel ba gcig kyang med/ /rang nyid mal nas cung zad ma g.yos kyang / /nyin par ji bzhin nyams su mngon sum myong / /de bzhin tshe 'di'i snang ba thams cad kun/ /mdang gi rmi lam nyams su myong ba bzhin/ /rang gis sems kyis der btags der bzung nas/ /de ltar snang ste sems kyis myong ba yin/ /rmi lam gnyid kyi skabs su'ang rang bzhin med/ /de bzhin ji ltar snang yang stong pa'o/ /e ma ho/ skal bar ldan pa'i sems kyi bu gcig po/ /snang ba thams cad nges pa ma yin te/ /la las snang ba la las mun pa'o/ /de yang sems can 'ga' zhig sa gzhi la/ /sa la sa yi 'du shes sems can yod/ /sa la me yis 'du shes sems can yod/ /sa la longs spyod 'du shes sems can yod/ /sa la sdug bsngal 'du shes sems can yod/ /chu la chu yi 'du shes sems can yod/ /chu la me yi 'du shes sems can yod/ /chu la bdud 598

rtsi'i 'du shes sems can yod/ /chu la gnas khang 'du shes sems can yod/ /chu la sa ru 'du shes sems can yod/ /me la me yi 'du shes sems can yod/ /me la longs spyod 'du shes sems can yod/ /me la gnas su 'du shes sems can yod/ /me la zas su 'du shes sems can yod/ /nam mkha' nam mkhar 'du shes sems can yod/ /nam mkha' gnas su 'du shes sems can yod/ /nam mkha' sa ru 'du shes sems can yod/ /des na snang ba nges pa med pa'i phyir/ /bag chags dbang gis gang ltar snang ba yin/ /de ltar 'byung ba bzhi bo rang rang du/ /'du shes nga ni mi yi snang ngo yin/ /'gro ba gzhan gyis sa gzhi 'di la yang / /dmyal ba'i me dang zhing pa'i longs spyod dag /rgyud kyis non pas sdug bsngal 'du shes pa'o/ /de bzhin me la me lha'i longs spyod dang / /yi dwags me lus can gyi gnas khang dang / /me yi srin bu'i zas su 'du shes pa'o/ /de bzhin chu la dmyal ba'i 'gro bas me/ /yi dwags sems can rnams la rnag khrag dang / /ha sti glang po'i sa dang lha'i bdud rtsi/ /gzhan 'phrul dbang byed lha la rin chen dang / /me tog char dang klu yi gnas khang ngo / /nam mkha' la yang de ltar byas nas gnas/ /lha rnams kun gyis sa yi 'du shes so/ /des na 599

thams cad rang gi gang ltar du/ /btags pa de ltar bzhin du snang ba'o/ /de yang lha yi bu yis sangs rgyas la/ /ri rab nyi zla la sogs su yis byas/ /zhus tshe sangs rgyas nyid kyi zhal nas kyang / /'di la byed mkhan gzhan ni su yang med/ /rang gi rtogs pa'i bag chags a 'thas kyis/ /der btags der bzung de ltar snang ba yin/ /thams cad rang gi sems kyis byas par gsungs/ /lha yi bu yis sangs rgyas yang zhus te/ /rang gi rtog pa ji ltar a 'thas kyang / /ri rab nyi ma zla ba la sogs pa'i/ /sra zhing brtan pa 'di 'dra ga na 'ongs/ /zhus tshe sangs rgyas nyid kyi zhal nas kyang / /wā ra ṇa sir rgan mos rang lus ni/ /stag tu bsgoms pas grong khyer de yis kyang / /stag tu mthong nas grong khyer stongs pas na/ /yun ni thung ngu'i de ltar snang nus na/ /skye ba thog ma med nas bag chags sems/ /goms na 'di 'dra los snang thub pas gsungs/ /des na thams cad sems kyis byas pa'o/ /de yang phyi rol mu stegs kha cig gis/ /'jig rten 'du 'dzi'i g.yeng ba 'gog pa'i phyir/ /dben gnas bsgoms pas dben gnas mngon sum du/ /grub nas gzhan gyi mis kyang mthong ba byung / /gcig gis nam mkha' brag tu bsgoms nas kyang / /brag tu gyur nas phung bo 600

thogs pa skad/ /des na thams cad sems kyi rtog pa yis/ /byas pa yin pa'i sems kyi rang snang ste/ /rang snang thams cad don la stong pa'o/ /de yang dmyal ba nyi tshe'i sems can gyis/ /sgo dang ka ba thab dang thag pa sogs/ /gzugs su 'du shes sdug bsngal myong ba'o/ /des na sems kyi rtog pos gang ltar du/ /btags pa de ltar bzhin du snang ba'o/ /'gro drug sems can bde sdug thams cad ni/ /rang gi sems nyid gcig pus byas pa'i phyir/ /thams cad rang gi sems kyi cho 'phrul gyis/ /med snang stong pa nyid kyi rang gzugs su/ /blo thag rbad kyis chod la phyam gyis zhog /de yang thub pa gang chen mtsho yi ni/ /phyag gi pad+ma'i rdul gcig stong nyid na/ /stong gsum mi mjed 'jig rten yod par gsungs/ /thod rgal rig pa chod la phab pa'i tshe/ /rang lus ba spu'i khong ni re re na/ /sangs rgyas zhing khams tshad med mthong ba dang / /'gro drug sems can gnas kyang tshad med mthong / /de la 'gro 'dul sprul pa bkye nas kyang / /rmi lam ji bzhin 'gro don byed par gsungs/ /des na 'khor 'das chos rnams rang snang yin/ /rang snang thams cad gzhi med stong pa yin/ /stong gsal 'dzin med ngang la blo gdeng 'chos/ /gzhan yang rdul gcig steng na rdul snyed kyi/ /601

sangs rgyas zhing khams dpag tu med pa dang / /'gro drug gnas kyang grangs med yod par gsungs/ /de rnams thams cad 'dres med rnyog pa med/ /gnod par gyur pa med pa rgyal bas gsungs/ /gzhan yang srin 'bu re re'i khog na yang / /srin 'bu'i grong khyer dpag med yod par gsungs/ /nam mkha'i khams na grong khyer mang po yis/ /mgo bo thur du bstan nas chags pa dang / /de bzhin 'phred dang gyen du chags pa yi/ /grong khyer dpag tu med par yod par gsungs/ /'di 'dra 'di dag su yis byas snyam na/ /thams cad sems kyis byas par rgyal bas gsungs/ /sems kyi rang bzhin gdod nas nam mkha' 'dra/ /chos rnams thams cad de bzhin shes par gyis/ /kun rdzob snang grags chos rnams thams cad kun/ /rang gi sems nyid gcig pu'i rang snang ste/ /'chi tshe rang gi sems rgyud 'gyur bas na/ /phyi rol 'gyur ba med kyang rang snang 'gyur/ /des na thams cad sems kyi rang snang ste/ /rang snang thams cad gzhi med stong pa yin/ /med pa gsal snang gzugs brnyan chu zla 'dra/ /gsal stong gnyis med rig pa'i ngang nyams skyongs/ /mthong snang thams cad sems kyi rang snang yin/ /snod kyi 'jig rten bem por snang ba sems/ /bcud kyi sems can 602

rigs drug snang ba'ang sems/ /mtho ris lha ma'i bde ba snang ba'ang sems/ /ngan song gsum gyi sdug bsngal snang ba'ang sems/ /ma rig nyon mongs dug lnga'i snang ba'ang sems rang byung ye shes rig pa snang ba'ang sems/ /ngan rtog 'khor ba'i bag chags snang ba'ang sems/ /bzang rtog sangs rgyas zhing —khams snang ba'ang sems/ /bdud dang 'dre yis bar chad snang ba'ang sems/ /lha dang dngos grub legs par snang ba'ang sems/ /rnam par rtog pa sna tshogs snang ba'ang sems/ /mi rtog rtse gcig bsgom par snang ba'ang sems/ /dngos po mtshan ma kha dog snang ba'ang sems/ /mtshan ma med cing spros pa med pa'ang sems/ /gcig dang du ma gnyis med snang ba'ang sems yod med gang yang ma grub snang ba'ang sems sems las ma gtogs snang ba gang yang med/ /sems ni dper na ri mo mkhan dang 'dra/ /rang gi lus kyang sems kyis byas pa ste/ /stong gsum 'jig rten khams ni ji snyed pa/ /de dag thams cad sems kyis bris pa ste/ /rang gi rtog pas bris pa'i ri mo yis/ /byes pa'i blo can 'gro kun bslus pa yin/ /des na thams cad sems kyi cho 'phrul du/ /thag chod nges shes bskyed pa gal che'o/ /'di ni rnam rtog sems su ngo sprod do//603

e ma ho/ da yang sems kyi bu mchog thams cad nyon/ /de ltar byed mkhan rang gi sems nyid la/ /ngo bo ngos bzung dbyebs dang kha dog sogs/ /sangs rgyas kyis kyang bstan du med pa ste/ /ye nas stong pa 'dzin med nam mkha' 'dra/ /sems nyid stong pa gzhi med yin par nges/ /sems nyid mtshon don nam mkha' dper bzhag kyang / /re zhig stong phyogs tsam gyi mtshon dpe ste/ /sems nyid rig bcas stong pa cir yang 'char/ /nam mkha' rig med stong chad had po ste/ /de'i phyir sems don nam mkha'i mtshon du med/ /'di ni sems nyid stong par ngo sprod do/ /sems nyid gsal stong de yi rang rtsal las/ /snang ba sna tshogs gang yang 'char ba yin/ /shar yang me long nang gi gzugs brnyan bzhin/ /gnyis su med de stong pa'i ngang du gcig /'di ni stong pa snang bar ngo sprod do/ye nas snang stong gnyis su med pa ste/ /rang sems stong pas snang ba mi 'gag cing / /stong pa'i ngang las snang ba 'dzin med bkra/ /snang ba rnams kyis stong pa mi 'gag cing / /snang kyang rang bzhin ye nas stong pa'o/ /nam mkha'i 'ja' tshon chu nang zla gzugs ltar/ /snang stong gnyis med rtog pa'i rnal 'byor la/ /'khor 'das chos rnams sgyu ma'i ltad mo yin/ /snang stong 604

gnyis med ltad mor bltas pa'i tshe/ /blo sems 'gyur ba med pa'i rnal 'byor bde/ /de ltar yin min skal ldan bu rnams kun/ /rang sems stong pa nyid dang snang ba gnyis/ /so sor dbye rgyu e yod ltos dang shes/ /ye nas snang stong gnyis su med pa'o/ /'di ni snang stong gnyis med ngo sprod do/ /de ltar snang stong gnyis med rang byung gi /rig pa rang gsal sa le trig ge ba/ /sku gsum lhun gyes grub pa'i dgongs pa ste/ /thun mtshams med par khor yug nyams len la/ /nyin mtshan med par skyongs shig sems kyi bu/ /'di ni gnyis med rang grol ngo sprod do//e ma ho/ da yang bya btang bdag gi glu la nyon/ /gzhi yi rig par sku gsum tshang tshul dang / /gzhi snang dus kyi sku gsum tshang tshul gyi/ /rnam dbye 'di gnyis legs par shes byas nas/ /'khor 'das sku gsum zhing du rtogs par bya/ /gzhi yi rig par sku gsum tshang tshul ni/ /sngon du'ang bshad kyang da dung 'dir yang 'chad/ /rang rig gzhi ni shel gye gong bu 'dra/ /de yi stong pa chos sku'i rang bzhin dang / /gsal ba'i rang gdangs longs spyod rdzogs pa dang / /'char gzhi ma 'gag sgo ni sprul pa'i sku/ /gzhi yi rig par sku gsum tshang tshul yin/ /605

'di la nam yang 'du 'bral med pa'o/ /dper na shel las 'od lnga shar ba bzhin/ /de las shar ba gzhi snang dus na yang / /dag pa rgyal ba'i zhing khams snang ba dang / /ma dag snod bcud snang ba gang snang yang / /thams cad ngo bo stong pa chos kyi sku/ /rang bzhin snang ba longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku/ /sna tshogs ma 'gag shar ba sprul pa'i sku/ /gzhi snang dus kyi sku gsum tshang tshul lo/ /gzhan du 'di yi rnam dbye phye ba nyung / /gnad 'di legs par rtogs dgos pa zhig yin/ /ngas kyang kun mkhyen legs bshad drin las shes/ /de ltar shes na snang srid thams cad kyang / /sku gsum lhun grub dkyil 'khor ye nas yin/ /sku gsum zhing khams gzhan nas btsal du med/ /'gro drug sems can rnams kyang sku gsum du/ /gnas pa yin te rang ngo shes nus na/ /'gro ba rnams kyis bsgom pa rdul tsam yang / /bya mi dgos par thams cad sangs rgya'o/ /de yang don la gzhi yi sku gsum yang / /chos sku yin pas so sor ma 'dzin cig /gzhi snang dus kyi sku gsum de nyid kyang / /gzugs sku yin pas so sor ma 'dzin cig /chos gzugs gnyis kyang don la so sor min/ /stong pa chos sku'i ngang du ro gcig go /mthar thug gzhi snang gzhi la rang thim nas/ /gzhi yi chos sku'i 606

dgongs pa mngon gyur tshe/ /don gye 'bras bu mngon du gyur pa yin/ /de nas chos sku'i mkha' las ma g.yos bzhin/ /gzugs sku rnam gnyis 'ja' tshon ji bzhin du/ /bstan nas 'gro don rgyun mi 'chad pa'o/ /e ma ho/ da yang bya btang bdag gi glu la nyon/ /khyed rang rnams la sngo na la gnod pa bskyal/ /sun ni 'byung dang brdung btsog byas pa dang / /ngo tsha gtad dang sems la gnod pa'i las/ /ji ltar gzhan gyes byas pa'i tshul rnams kun/ /rang gi yid la tshul bzhin bsam byas nas/ /zhe sdang skyer chug skyes tshe ngo bo la/ /cer gyis ltos la zhe sdang mkhan po de/ /dang po gang nas byung dang da lta'i dus/ /gang du gnas dang tha ma gang du 'gro/ /dbyibs dang kha dog la sogs e 'dug ltos/ /bltas tshe ye nas stong pa 'dzin med yin/ /zhe sdang ma spangs me long ye shes so/ /khyed rnams snying la sdug pa'i bud med dang / /sha sogs rang nyid za ma gang 'dod dang / /gos sogs rang gi gon pa gang 'dod dang / /rta sogs rang gi phyugs rnams gang 'dod rnams/ /tshul bzhin rang gi yid la bsam byas nas/ /'dod chags skyer chug skyes tshe ngo bo la/ /cer gyis ltos la 'dod chags mkhan po de/ /dang po gang nas byung dang da lta'i 607

dus/ /gang du gnas dang tha ma gang du 'gro/ /dbyibs dang kha dog la sogs e 'dug ltos/ /bltas tshe ye nas stong pa 'dzin med yin/ /'dod chags ma spangs sor rtog ye shes so/ /khyed rnams gnyid dang bying rmugs la sogs pa'i/ /gti mug skyer chug skyes tshe ngo bo la/ /cer gyis ltos la gti mug mkhan po de/ /dang po gang nas byung dang da lta'i dus/ /gang du gnas dang tha ma gang du 'gro/ /dbyebs dang kha dog la sogs e 'dug ltos/ /bltas tshe ye nas stong pa 'dzin med yin/ /gti mug ma spangs chos dbyengs ye shes so/ /khyed rnams rang gi rigs rus stobs 'byor dang / /gzugs byad legs dang ngag gi dbyangs snyan dang / /thos bsam sgom gsum yi ge 'bri klog dang / /rig gnas mkhas dang grong chog gdul bya sogs/ /rang la yod tshad yon tan bsam byas nas/ /gzhan las cung zad nga bzang snyam pa yi/ /nga rgyal skyer chug skyes tshe ngo bo la/ /cer gyes ltos la nga rgyal mkhan po de/ /dang po gang nas byung dang da lta'i dus/ /gang du gnas dang tha ma gang du 'gro/ /dbyebs dang kha dog la sogs e 'dug ltos/ /bltas tshe ye nas stong pa 'dzin med yin/ /nga rgyal ma spangs mnyam nyid ye shes so/ /rang las che ba'i gzhan gyi stobs 'byor dang / /yon 608

tan mkhan dang gdul bya mang ba dang / /rig gnas mkhas dang 'don bzang skad bzang dang / /chos kyi go ba 'jig rten gtam la sogs/ /gzhan gyi yon tan thams cad bsam byas nas/ /rang las mtho bar dogs pa'i phrag dog sems/ /skyer chug skyes tshe phrag dog ngo bo la/ /cer gyis ltos la phrag dog mkhan po ste/ /dang po gang nas byung dang da lta'i dus/ /gang du gnas dang tha ma gang du 'gro/ /dbyibs dang kha dog la sogs e 'dug ltos/ /bltas tshe ye nas stong pa 'dzin med yin/ /phrag dog ma spangs bya grub ye shes so/ /de ltar rtogs na nyon mongs ye shes yin/ /nyon mongs rtog pa spangs pa'i pha rol nas/ /stong nyid ye shes 'tshol ba dgod re bro/ /btsal bas ma rnyed tshe na snying re rje/ /'di ltar dug lnga stong par shes nas kyang / /phyin chad dug lnga'i rtog pa gang shar yang / /ngo sprod 'di bzhin skyes sa gnas sa dang / /'gro sa dbyibs dang kha dog dpyad mi dgos/ /sngon du dug lnga stong par shes pa'i phyir/ /shar ma thag tu rjes su mi 'brang bar/ /sems nyid ngang du rang sar glod la zhog /rang yal nyid du 'gro bar the tshom med/ /'di ni ngo sprod rtsal sbyong gnyis ka yin/ /'di ltar sngon la rtsal sbyong byas gyur na/ /phyin chad nyon mongs dug ldan ma 609

shar tshe/ /nyon mongs rang mtshang sngon la shes stabs kyis/ /stong nyid ye shes gnyis ka mnyam shar nas/ /shar grol dus mnyam shar grol dus mnyam mo/ /bla ma gong ma'i rnam thar gsung rgyun du/ /nyon mongs rtog pa mang na chos sku mang / /gsungs pa ji bzhin yin pas shes par gyis/ /las ni dang po pa la nyon mongs sems/ /shugs drag shar tshe dpyad 'jog byas na bzang / /'di ni zhal shes yin pas thugs la zhog /'di ni dug lnga rang grol ngo sprod do/ /e ma ho/ de yang snying dang 'dra ba'i bu rnams nyon/ /gos la sogs pa'i 'jam po lus la dril/ /'jam mo snyam pa'i rang gi sems la ltos/ /re ba la sogs rtsub mo lus la dril/ /rtsub po snyam pa'i rang gi sems la ltos/ /bltas tshe gnyis ka stong par ro mnyam mo/ /gser sku la sogs mdzes pa'i gzugs la ltos/ /mdzes so snyam pa'i rang gi sems la ltos/ sbal ba la sogs mi mdzes gzugs la ltos/ /mi mdzes snyam pa'i rang gi sems la ltos/ /bltas tshe gnyis ka stong par ro mnyam mo/ /bu ram la sogs zhim po kha ru zo/ /mngar ro snyam pa'i rang gi sems la ltos/ /bca' lga la sogs kha ru myangs nas kyang / /kha kha snyam pa'i rang gi sems la ltos/ /bltas tshe gnyis ka stong 610

par ro mnyam mo/ /dril bu pi wang gling bu'i sgra la nyon/ /snyan no snyam pa'i rang gi sems la ltos/ /rdo dang thal mo rdob la sgra la nyon/ /mi snyan snyam pa'i rang gi sems la ltos/ /bltas tshe gnyis ka stong par ro mnyam mo/ /khyed rnams gling bzhi'i khams la dbang bsgyur ba'i/ /'khor los bsgyur rgyal zhig tu skyes nas kyang / /btsun mo blon po mang po'i 'khor gyis bskor/ /rin chen sna lnga las grub khang ba na/ /ro brgya ldan pa'i kha zas za bar bsgoms/ /de 'dra'i snang ba sems la shar ba'i tshe/ /bde'o snyam pa'i rang gi sems la ltos/ /khyed rnams dbul bo 'khor g.yog gcig kyang med/ /gyang ra zhig po zhig tu mal bcas nas/ /steng nas char babs 'og nas sas brlan zhing / /lus la mje sogs nad sna mang pos btab/ /rkang lag tshang nas sdug bsngal du ma yis/ /mnar nas sdug bsngal myong ba cig tu bsgoms/ /de 'dra'i snang ba yid la shar ba'i tshe/ /sdug go snyam pa'i rang gi sems la ltos/ /bltas tshe bde sdug stong par ro mnyam mo/ /'di ltar tshogs drug stong par shes nas kyang / /phyin chad tshogs drug bzang ngan gang shar tshe/ /ngo sprod 'di bzhin dpyad pa mi dgos te/ /gzhi med ye grol stong pa yin pa'i phyir/ /shar tsam nyid nas rjes su mi 'brang bar/ /611

sems nyid ngang du rang sar glod la zhog /rang grol nyid du 'gro bar the tshom med/ /'di ni tshogs drug rang grol ngo sprod do/ /e ma ho/ da yang rigs kyi bu rnams legs par nyon/ /khyed rnams rang sems glod la rang babs su/ /zhog la ji ltar gnas pa'i tshul la ltos/ /bltas tshe rig pa'i ngang la gnas pa'i phyir/ /gnas kyang stong pa rig pa'i ngang yin pas/ /skal ldan sems kyi bu rnams shes par gyis/ /gnas pa sems kyi rgyan du ngo sprod do/ /rnam rtog spros la ji ltar 'phro tshul la/ /ltos dang stong gsal rig pa'i ngang nyid las/ /cung zad tsam yang g.yo ba med pa'i phyir/ /'phro yang stong pa rig pa'i ngang yin pas/ /skal ldan rigs kyi bu rnams shes par gyis/ /'phro ba sems kyi rol bar ngo sprod do/ /dper na rgya mtshor rba rlabs ci shar yang / /rgya mtsho nyid las cung zad ma g.yos ltar/ /sems ni gnas bsam 'gyu yang rig stong ngang / /cung zad tsam yang g.yo ba med pa'i phyir/ /glang ltar gnas kyang rig pa'i ngang yin zhog /gang ltar shar yang rig pa'i gdangs yin zhog /sems ni gnas na sgom ni yin par 'dod/ /'phro na sgom ni min par 'dod pa de/ /gnas 'gyu gnyis kyi rang 612

mtshang ma shes par/ /gnas 'gyu rig gsum gcig tu ma 'dres rtags/ /de phyir skal ldan sems kyi bu mchog kun/ /gnas rung 'gyu rung rig pa'i ngang yin pas/ /'di rnams sngon la thugs su chud nas kyang / /gnas 'gyu rig gsum gcig tu nyams su longs/ /'phro gnas gnyis su med par ngo sprod do/ /e ma ho/ skal bar ldan pa'i sems kyi bu gcig po/ /khyed rnams ma yengs dal le rna bas nyon/ /glu ba bya btang tshogs drug grol ngas/ /glu dbyangs snyan mo'i gangs dkar sems la 'jog /chos rnams thams cad ro gcig stong pa ru/ /gtan la phebs na 'khor 'das spang blang bral/ /dgra dang gnyen du 'dzin pa'i 'khrul ba 'jig /bdag gzhan gnyis su 'dzin pa'i snang ba med/ /thams cad ro gcig stong par rtogs phyir ro/ /rgyas bshad mdo 'gag bsdu na 'di yin te/ /theg pa'i yang rtse rdzogs pa chen po ru/ /'khor ba myang 'das thams cad gzhi rtsa bral/ /ye nas sangs rgyas chos skur ro gcig go /rdzogs chen ngang la lha 'dres gnyis su med/ /rdzogs chen yul las sangs rgyas sems can med/ /rdzogs chen gzhi la bzang dang ngan pa med/ /rdzogs chen lam la nye dang ring ba med/ /rdzogs chen 'bras bur thob dang ma thob med/ /rdzogs chen chos 613

la spyod dang mi spyod med/ /rdzogs chen don la sgom dang mi bsgom med/ /rdzogs chen rgyal po'i lta ba de bzhin gnas/ /de 'dra'i rdzogs chen lta ba rtogs pa'i tshe/ /sgo gsum phra rags rtogs pa kun zhi nas/ /dper na bal la chu btab dzi bzhin du/ /sgo gsum zhi zhing dul ba'i ngang la gnas/ /bde gsal mi rtogs ting 'dzin skye ba dang / /de ltar ma rtogs 'khor 'khyams 'gro kun la/ /ma yis bu gcig dag la brtse ba ltar/ /bcos min snying rje skye ba rdzogs chen gyi/ /lta ba'i khyad chos yin pa'ang shes par gyes/ /thams cad stong pa nyid du thag bcad nas/ /dge spangs sdig la 'jem med spyad gyur na/ /nag po kha 'byams bdud kyi lta ba ste/ /de 'dra'i bdud lta'i dbang du ma shor gces/ /'di rnams rdzogs pa chen po'i ngo sprod do/ /ngo sprod 'di rnams shin tu gal che te/ /phyi rol kun rdzob snang grags chos rnams kun/ /thams cad stong pa nyid du ma rtogs par/ /lta ba bsgom na snyam yang ci zhig bsgoms/ /de yis phyir na dang po 'di ltar du/ /re 'ga' bla mar gsol ba 'debs kyin ltos/ /re 'ga' glod kyin bsgrims kyin legs par ltos/ /de ltar bltas tshe sems la dga' ba dang / /thams cad stong pa nyid du lam lam du/ /shar nas phyi rol snang ba'i yul rnams 614

la/ /lag pas reg kyang 'dzin rgyu med snyam dang / /lta ba 'di nyid nges par yin par 'dug /snyam pa'i nges shes gting tshugs skye bar nges/ /de dus lta ba'i nges shes rnyed pa yin/ /'dzin pas ma bslad 'dzin med ngang la glod/ /ngo sprod thebs nas nyams su ma lon kyang / /'chi tshe bar dor 'jigs skrag ci byung yang / /thams cad rang snang stong pa'i rang gzugs su/ /shes nas ka dag gzhi la 'tshang rgya'o/ /ngo sprod ma jebs nyams su len pa de/ /dper na tshes pa gcig nas 'phyugs pa na/ /bco lnga'i bar du 'phyug pa ji bzhin no/ /kun rdzob chos rnams thams cad bden med du/ /ma rtogs stong nyid rtogs zer rdzun chen yin/ /des na ngo sprod 'di bzhin dang po'i dus/ /bla ma'i drung du sdod la gnas lugs kyi/ /steng du gtan la phobs dang gol sa med/ /de'i phyir skal ldan bu rnams snying la chongs/ /e ma ho/ da yang skal ldan rigs kyi bu rnams nyon/ /de ltar lta ba'i gnas lugs khong chud nas/ /'khor yul chags sdang 'brel thag rbad kyis chod/ /gcig pur nags kyi gseb dang ri sul du/ /lus kyis bya rtsol thongs la rnal mar sdod/ /ngag gis smra brjod chod la brjod med kyis/ /sems ni nam mkha' bsam pa'i yul las 'das/ /de yi ngang la btang 615

bzhag med par glod/ /sems la gtad so med na lta ba yin/ /bsgom du med pa'i ngang la gnas par gyis/ /thob med rdzogs chen 'bras bu 'thob par mdzod/ /de yang lta bar mnyam par 'jog pa'i tshe/ /'di ltar rig pa'i ngang la 'jog snyam dang / /bying rgod dbang du shor 'gro snyam byed kyi/ /rtog pa'i dra ba gang gis mi bcings par/ /dmigs gtad chos med har sang rgya yan ngang / /zang thal kha yan nyid du glod la zhog /blo yi chos kyis blo 'das don mi mthong / /byas pa'i chos kyis byar med sar mi slebs/ /blo 'das byar med don de thob 'dod na/ /bcos bslad ma byed rig pa gcer bur zhog /gzung 'dzin kun bral lta ba'i mchog yin no/ /spang blang med pa bsgom pa'i mchog yin no/ /bya rtsol las 'das spyod pa'i mchog yin no/ /re med rang gnas 'bras bu'i mchog yin no/ /bltas pas mi mthong lta ba'i 'tshol 'phro zhog /bsgoms pas mi rnyed dran 'dzin dmigs gtad dor/ /spyod pas mi 'grub sgyu mar 'dzin pa thongs/ /btsal bas mi rnyed 'bras bu'i re ba bor/ /da lta'i shes pa bzo med lhug pa la/ /phyogs ris ma byed 'dzin pas ma bslad cig /da lta'i rig pa dngos med gsal ba 'di/ /'di ka lta ba kun gye yang rtse yin/ /dmigs gtad khyab gdal blo 616

dang bral ba 'di/ /'di ka sgom pa kun gyi yang rtse yin/ /ma bcos 'dzin med lhug par bzhag pa 'di/ /'di ka spyod pa kun gyi yang rtse yin/ /ma btsal ye nas lhun gyis grub pa 'di/ /'di ka 'bras bu kun gyi yang rtse yin/ /lta ba'i snying bo stong gsal 'dzin med ltos/ /sgom pa'i snying bo rang grol 'dzin med skyongs/ /spyod pa'i snying bo tshogs drug lhug par zhog /'bras bu'i snying bo re dogs zhig pa yin/ /mu mtha' bral na lta ba'i rgyal po mchog /gza' gtad bral na sgom pa'i rgyal po mchog /blang dor bral na spyod pa'i rgyal po mchog /re dogs bral na 'bras bu'i rgyal po mchog /blta ru med gyis lta ba'i dmigs gtad dor/ /bsgom du med kyis gang byung gang bder thongs/ /spyad du med kyis dgag sgrub spang blang khrol/ /'thob sgyu med kyis 'bras bu'i re ba bor/ /gang yin yin gyis cher 'dzin ma byed cig /'di yin med kyis dgag sgrub ma byed cig /gza' gtad med kyis phyogs ris ma byed cig /gdod nas dag pa'i rang rig rang gsal la/ /bsam yul blo las 'das pas lta ru med/ /ngo bo gzhi nas bral bas bsgom du med/ /rang grol mtha' las 'das pas spyad du med/ /rtsol sgrub zhen pa las 'das 'bras bu med/ /ngo bo stong nyid yin 617

pas spangs thob med/ /rang bzhin gsal stong yin pas rtsol sgrub cig /thams cad 'gag med yin pas phyogs ris med/ /gang ltar shar yang de ltar ma 'dzin cig /rnal 'byor shes pa nam mkha'i bya lam 'dra/ /bya rjes snga ma 'gag nas mi mthong ltar/ /dran bsam snga ma 'gag cing mthong ba med/ /de la rjes bsnyegs 'dzin pas ma mthud cig /bya rjes phyi ma ma 'ongs dngos med ltar/ /dran bsam phyi mas bsu ma ma byed cig /bya rjes da lta kha dog dbyibs med ltar/ /da lta'i dran bsam tha mal rang 'gros la/ /'di zhes gnyen pos bcos bslad ma byed cig /ji ltar shar yang de ltar ma 'dzin cig /'di ni mthar thug snying bo'i lam 'khyer yin/ /gang ltar shar yang de ltar ma bzung na/ /nyon mongs rang yal ye shes chen po yin/ /skye med bsam 'das ye grol lta ba ste/ /nan tan byas na lta rgyu med pa lags/ /rang babs lhod chags rang gnas sgom pa ste/ /nan tan byas na bsgom rgyu med pa lags/ /spang blang gnyis med sgyu ma'i spyod pa ste/ /nan tan byas na spyod rgyu med pa lags/ /re dogs gnyis med 'bras bu'i rang bzhin ste/ /nan tan byas na 'bras bu med pa lags/ /dus gsum rtsa ba bral ba'i sems nyid 'di/ /ma bsgoms mngon sum snang ba blo re bde/ /thog ma 618

tha ma rang bzhin dag pa'i chos/ /ye grol yongs grol 'bad rtsol zhig pa mtshar/ /tha mal shes pa bzo med lhug pa 'di/ /rgyal ba'i dgongs pa mtha' bral klong yangs yin/ /de bas 'bad pas dpyad cing bsgoms pa yis/ /sems nyid gnas lugs gnyug ma mthong mi 'gyur/ /ma bsams ma dpyad tha mal chos nyid la/ /bsgom dang mi bsgoms yengs dang ma yengs med/ /ma bsgoms lhug pas mang po grol ba yin/ /grol dang ma grol don la gnyis su med/ /gnas lugs shes na rtsol med blo bde'o/ /rtog med 'dod pa'i rtog pas bcings pa na/ /rnam rtog langs nas phyogs bcur 'gro bar brtson/ /'gro 'ong med pa'i rig pa'i gshis thog tu/ /kha yan glod nas rang yan bzhag pa na/ /mi g.yo ri bo bzhin du brtan par gnas/ /go ldog 'gros 'di bu rnams shes par gyis/ /'di la bsgom rgyu rdul tsam mi dmigs kyang / /yengs med dran pas zin pa rab tu gces/ /e ma ho/ da yang skal ldan bu rnams tshur nyon dang / /phyi yul med snang stong pa'i rang gzugs 'di/ /ye stong chu zla 'dra bas sbyangs mi dgos/ /nang gi dran rtog rang yal rjes med pas/ /'bad rtsol gnyen po de la 'jug mi dgos/ /snang sems 619

ye grol lhug pa'i ye shes la/ /spang blang re dogs gang gi'ang sgro mi 'dogs/ /rig pa zang ka gcer bu 'di nyid la/ /yid dpyod spros pa'i gon pa ma bskon par/ /shigs se khres se bun ne rjes med du/ /ris med mnyam pa chen por glod la zhog /de yi ngang la dran bsam ci shar yang / /ris med rang byung rig pa'i rang gdangs su/ /shes par gyis la rjes ni mi bsnyegs par/ /snang sems khral ma khrol dang sangs ma sangs 'al ma 'ol gyi chos nyid yo langs su/ /rgya phyam nyid du btang na kun bzang gi /dgongs pa'i klong du da lta slebs pa yin/ /rdzogs pa chen po ye grol lhun grub kyi/ /sna tshogs rang grol rnal 'byor de la zer/ /ma phyin na yang sangs rgyas sa ru slebs/ /ma bsgrubs na yang 'bras bu lhun gyis grub/ /ma spangs bzhin du nyon mongs rang sar dag /bla ma dam pa'i dgongs pa dang mnyam mo/ /rjes su snyogs so las rnams zin pa'o/ /gnad 'di yin pas bu rnams shes par gyes/ /pha rgan chos kyi rgyal po'i bka' drin gyis/ /bya bral lhun gyis grub pa'i dgongs pa ru/ /tshogs drug rang grol da res slebs pa'o/ /gnad 'di yin kyang la las ma go 'dug /thams cad ye zin 'dug ste yang byed do/ /ye grol nyid du 'dug ste yang dgrol lo/ /ye bzhag 620

nyid du 'dug ste yang 'jog go /ye bsgom nyid du 'dug ste yang bsgom mo/ /ye ltos nyid du 'dug ste yang blta'o/ /ye bgrod nyid du 'dug ste yang bgrod do/ /zer nas yid dpyod lta bar re ba'i mis/ /thos kyang tshig ro go yang rnam rtog go /rtogs kyang pho tshod bsgoms kyang blos byas so/ /dpyad kyang gnyis 'dzin bsgrubs kyang 'khor ba'o/ /chos nyid yid dpyod mkhan gyi mi de la/ /rdzogs chen snying thig las 'brel med par nges/ /bya byed mi dgos byas pas zin pa med/ /bya dang mi bya'i rtsis las 'das pa'o/ /bsgom med bsgom pa las 'das bsgoms kyang 'phung / /bltar med lta ba las 'das gang la blta/ /btsal med btsal ba las 'das rnyed pa med/ /'di ltar rig pa zang ma thal byung du/ /'dug ste bshad kyang mi nyan ༄7de la/ /rdzogs chen las 'brel med pa dgod re bro/ /gang la bltas kyang ka dag klong chen gyi/ /dgongs par shar bas 'khor 'das gnyis su med/ /de 'dra'i dgongs pa glu ru blangs pa la/ /dus gsum rgyal ba dgyes par gdon mi za/ /'o na phyi rol 'khrul ba'i snang yul du/ /rang sar yan du bcug na slar la yang / /'khrul bar mi 'gro 'am zhes brjod gyur na/ /tha mal mi yi bdag tu bzung bas 'khrul/ /rnal 'byor pa yis gzhi med 621

rtsa bral du/ /shes pas bcos bslad blang dor mi byed par/ /rang babs 'dzin med bzhag pas mi 'khrul lo/ /'di la gol sa e yod brjod gyur na/ /'di la gol sa nor sa gcig kyang med/ /gol sa zhen cing chags na yod pa yin/ /gang shar nyid la 'dzin pa med pa na/ /gol sar lhung rgyu zhig ni ga la 'ongs/ /'on kyang rig pa yul la 'char dus su/ /gang shar rnam par rtog pa'i ngo bo la/ /lta ba de nyid bsgom du 'dod pa min/ /de yi dus kyi rig pa sa le ba/ /rjen pa'i cha de phyal le skyong ba'o/ /de yang rig pa 'phro 'du med pa ru/ /gnas pa'i dus kyi gnas cha'i mi rtog pa/ /de nyid bsgom gyi dngos gzhi ma yin te/ /de yis dus kyi hrig ge sang nge ba'i/ /gsal dwangs ngar cha de nyid skyong ba'o/ /gnad 'di ma go 'char gnas gnyis ka la/ /blta ba de nyid bsgom pa'i ngo bo yin/ /snyam na 'khrul bar 'gyur ro snying gi bu/ /gnas pa tsam ni bsam gtan lha dang 'dra/ /'char ba tsam ni tha mal rtog pa 'dra/ /de la bsgoms kyang sangs rgyas 'thob mi 'gyur/ /mdor na gang gi dus su'ang rig pa'i cha/ /rjen pa zang thal shel gong 'dra ba de/ /klong du ma gyur bar du sa ler skyongs/ /gyur nas de yi ngang la 'bral med gyis/ /khregs chod lta ba'i gnad 'gag rig 622

pa ni/ /rjen la phud nas sa ler skyong ba la/ /zer bas gnad 'di kho na gal che ste/ /'di ni tshig brgya'i mdo 'gags yin pas na/ /skal ldan snying gi bu rnams shes par gyis/ /e ma ho/ da yang sems kyi bu rnams gus pas nyon/ /nor sa med pa'i thig chen bzhi bstan pa/ /lta ba nor sa med pa'i thig chen ni/ /da lta'i shes pas sa le 'di ka yin/ /gsal la mi nor bas na thig ces bya/ /bsgom pa nor sa med pa'i thig chen ni/ /da lta'i shes pa sa le 'di ka yin/ /gsal la mi nor bas na thig ces bya/ /spyod pa nor sa med pa'i thig chen ni/ /da lta'i shes pa sa le 'di ka yin/ /gsal la mi nor bas na thig ces bya/ /'bras bu nor sa med pa'i thig chen ni/ /da lta'i shes pa sa le 'di ka yin/ /gsal la mi nor bas na thig ces bya/ /mi 'gyur ba yi gzer chen gzhi bstan pa/ /lta ba 'gyur ba med pa'i gzer chen ni/ /da lta'i shes pa sa le 'di ka yin/ /dus gsum brtan pa'i phyir na gzer zhes bya/ /bsgom pa 'gyur ba med pa'i gzer chen ni/ /da lta'i shes pa sa le 'di ka yin/ /dus gsum brtan pa'i phyir na gzer zhes bya/ /spyod pa 'gyur ba med pa'i gzer chen ni/ /da lta'i shes pa sa le 'di ka yin/ /dus gsum brtan pa'i phyir na gzer zhes bya/ /'bras 623

bu 'gyur ba med pa'i gzer chen ni/ /da lta'i shes pa sa le 'di ka yin/ /dus gsum brtan pa'i phyir na gzer zhes bya/ /lta ba mi mthun rgya che grangs mang yang / /da lta'i rang rig rang byung ye shes la/ /blta bya dang ni lta byed gnyis su med/ /lta ba ma blta lta ba'i mkhan po tshol/ /lta ba'i mkhan po btsal bas ma rnyed na/ /de'i tshe lta ba zad sar 'khrol ba yin/ /lta ba blta rgyu ci yang med pa la/ /ye med stong chad had por ma song bar/ /da lta'i shes pa ma bcos sa le ba/ /rdzogs pa chen po'i lta ba de ka yin/ /bsgom pa mi mthun rgya che grangs mang yang / /da lta'i tha mal shes pa zang thal la/ /bsgom bya dang ni sgom byed gnyis su med/ /bsgom pa ma bsgoms sgom pa'i mkhan po tshol/ /sgom pa'i mkhan po btsal bas ma rnyed na/ /de'i tshe sgom pa zad gar 'khyol ba yin/ /sgom pa bsgom rgyu ci yang med pa la/ /bying rgod 'thibs rmugs dbang du ma song bar/ /da lta'i shes pa ma bcos rang gsal la/ /ma bcos mnyam par 'jog pa bsgom pa yin/ /spyod pa mi mthun rgya che grangs mang yang / /rang rig ye shes thig le nyag gcig la/ /spyad bya dang ni spyod byed gnyis su med/ /spyod pa ma spyod spyod pa'i mkhan po tshol/ /spyod pa'i mkhan po btsal bas ma rnyed na/ /de'i tshe spyod pa zad sar 624

'khyol ba yin/ /spyod lam spyod rgyu ci yang med pa la/ /bag chags 'khrul ba'i dbang du ma song bar/ /da lta'i shes pa ma bcos rang gsal la/ /bcos bslad blang dor gang yang mi byed pa/ /de ga rnam par dag pa'i spyod pa yin/ /'bras bu mi mthun rgya che grangs mang yang / /rang rig sku gsum rtsol med lhun grub la/ /bsgrub bya dang ni sgrub byed gnyis su med/ /'bras bu ma bsgrubs sgrub pa'i mkhan po tshol/ /'bras bu sgrub mkhan btsal bas ma rnyed na/ /de'i tshe 'bras bu zad sar 'khyol ba yin/ /'bras bu sgrub rgyu ci yang med pa la/ /blang dor re dogs dbang du ma song bar/ /da lta'i shes rig rang gsal lhun grub nyid/ /mngon gyur sku gsum rang gsal stong pa nyid/ /ye sangs rgyas pa'i 'bras bu de nyid do/ /e ma ho/ da yang rigs kyi bu rnams legs par nyon/ /de ltar dang po yengs med bskyangs pa na/ /bar du yan par btang yang don thog nas/ /tha mal btang yang 'gro 'ong med pa'o/ /snang dang stong pa gnyis ka dbyer med na/ /de'i tshe lta ba klong du gyur pa yin/ /rmi lam nyin par gnyis ka khyad med na/ /de'i tshe sgom pa klong du gyur pa yin/ /bde dang sdug bsngal gnyis ka khyad med na/ /de'i tshe spyod pa klong du gyur pa yin/ /625

'di dang phyi ma gnyis ka khyad med na/ /de'i tshe gnas lugs klong du gyur pa yin/ /sems dang nam mkha' gnyis ka khyad med na/ /de'i tshe chos sku klong du gyur pa yin/ /rang sems sangs rgyas gnyis ka khyad med na/ /de'i tshe 'bras bu klong du gyur pa yin/ /e ma ho/ da dung rigs kyi bu rnams bdag la gson/ /gdos bcas lus 'di chu zla ltar du ltos/ /ngag gi smra brjod brag cha bzhin du zlos/ /sems kyi rtog tshogs rang sar sangs su chug /snang grags chos rnams thams cad sgyu ma dang / /smig rgyu rmi lam gzugs brnyan chu zla dang / /dri za'i grong khyer mig yor sprul pa dang / /chu bur brag cha bzhin du 'dzin med spyod/ /spyod lam thams cad de yi ngang nas gyis/ /thun mtshams ma gcod nyin mtshan khor yug sprod/ /dran bsam bcos bslad ma byed rang babs ngang / /rang mdangs rang grol 'dzin med gsal stong du/ /bden med bsgom med rtsol med rjes med zhog /sngar 'das rnam par rtog pa thams cad kyang / /bya lam nam mkhar rjes med ltar du zhog /da lta'i shes pa rdul bral bar snang ltar/ /ma 'ongs rtog pa rang 'thag chu bcad ltar/khreg ger yod la bzo bcos mi byed par/ /rang babs rgya yan 626

ngang du lhag par zhog /phra rags rtog pa dug gsum dug lnga sogs/ /khang stong rkun ma slebs pa ltar du zhog /tshogs drug yul snang thams cad rjes med du/ /sgyu ma'i grong khyer zhig pa ltar du zhog /mdor na skye 'gag gnas gsum gzhi lam 'bras/ /lta sgom spyod 'bras dus gnas brjod tshig dang / /bzhag bya bzhag byed dgrol bya dgrol byed sogs/ /rang gsal res med 'dzin rtsol spang blang med/ /rgya mtsho chen por chu phran thim pa ltar/ /chos kun sems kyi dbyings su ka dag par/ /blo gdeng bca' zhing 'dzin med la zla'o/ /de ltar bsgoms tshe rnam rtog mang 'phros kyang / /bsgom ni ma 'ong snyam nas sdug mi dgos/ /sems ni 'phro yang stong la gnas kyang stong / /gang ltar shar yang rig pa'i ngang yin pas/ /dgag sgrub blang dor gang yang mi byed par/ /ma bcos gnyug ma'i ngang du glod la zhog /de yis rnam rtog rang sar grol bar nges/ /blo dman skye bo ngang la mi gnas na/ /ngo sprod skabs bzhin dpyad 'jog spel ma gyis/ /yang na 'di bzhin rnam rtog ar la gtod/ /dgos sam mi dgos rnam rtog bslang nas kyang / /gcig rjes gcig mthud rnam pa sna tshogs pa/ /rang sems sun rag bar du spros nas kyang / /de nas mi 'dod tshe na glod la zhog /yang na snying 627

dbus mtshan ldan bla ma sgoms/ /de la sems ni yun ring bzung nas kyang / /de rjes 'dzin med rig pa'i ngang la zhog /yang na snying gi dbus su thig le sgoms/ /de nyid mar la babs nas dbang chen gye/ /sa gzhi thug rag bar du song bar bsam/ /de yis 'phro rgod rbad kyis chod par nges/ /rgod pa chod tshe rig pa'i ngang la zhog /bying ba che na lta stangs ngar bskyed la/ /rig pa rjen la phud nas sa ler skyongs/ /yang na rang gi sems nyid thig le ru/ /dmigs la ngag nas phaṭa sgra brjod ma thag /tshangs bug nas 'thon dpag chen mda' 'phangs ltar/ /song nas mkha' la khrug gis 'dres par bsam/ /de nas nam mkha'i mtshan nyid yid la gyes/ /de yis byeng ba mi sangs mi srid do/ /bying ba sangs tshe 'dzin med ngang la zhog /'di rnams zhal shes yin pas shes par gyis/ /rtog med 'dod pa'i rtog pas ma bcings par/ /rig pa rgya bskyed dpangs bstod phyal yas su/ /thongs la gu yangs yan pa blo bde gyes/ /dang po rnam rtog gcong rong chu dang 'dra/ /bar du chu bo gaṅgā dal babs 'dra/ /tha ma chu rnams rgya mtshor ro gcig ltar/ /'od gsal ma bu mjal ba'i ngang la gnas/ /khyad par nad gdon cho 'phrul ci byung yang / /bca' bcos rim gro gang 628

yang mi byed par/ /'di ltar ro snyoms thog badzis spyod pa gyis/ /nags dang dur khrod mtsho gling skyed mo'i tshal/ /brag phug khang stong shing gcig drung la sogs/ /'jigs shing nyam nga'i gnas su song nas kyang / /rang lus snod bcud snang srid bdud rtsir bsgyur/ /phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba sras bcas thams cad mchod/ /de rnams mnyes nas brtse ba'i rnam 'gyur gyis/ /'od du zhu nas 'khor 'das thams cad kun/ /'od gsal bdud rtsis yongs su gang bar dmigs/ /yon tan mgron gyur dam can chos skyong dang / /snying rje'i zhing mchog rigs drug sems can dang / /lan chags gdon bgegs 'byung bo thams cad dang / /nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i 'gro ba kun/ /myong grol bdud rtsis tshims par byas nas kyang / /'khor 'das ro gcig sems su thag bcad la/ /sems nyid ma bcos chos sku'i ngang nyid nas/ /'gro dang 'dug dang mchongs dang rgyug pa dang / /smra dang dgod dang ngu dang glu len dang / /bcags dang dkrug log spyon pa'i spyod pa bya/ /mthar ni zhi zhing bde ba'i ngang la 'dug /mtshan dus rang babs bde bar nyal nas kyang / /dran bsam 'phro 'du'i rnam rtog kun bral te/ /skye med dran rdzogs gnyug ma'i ngang la nyal/ /de ltar byas na nad gdon 629

rang zhi nas/ /lta sgom bogs 'byen rtog pa nam mkha' 'dra/ /bsgom pa rang gsal spyod pa bu chung 'dra/ /gza' gtad kun bral ngang gis smyon pa 'dra/ /bdag gzhan gnyis med 'phags pa'i gang zag 'dra/ /ci smra 'dzin med brag cha'i sgra dbyangs 'dra/ /gang la'ang chags med 'dab chags mkha' lding 'dra/ /ya nga bag tsha med pa'i seng ge 'dra/ /thams cad ye grol mkha' la sprin dwangs 'dra/ /de 'dra'i rnal 'byor bde gshegs rig 'dzin dngos/ /dad brgya'i spyi bos btud nas phyag bya'i 'os/ /yid bzhin nor bu bas kyang ches lhag go /e ma ho/ de yang skal ldan bya btang glu la nyon/ /rnam snang phyi na med de nang na yod/ /sems nyid spros dang bral ba chos dbyings ngang / /gti mug rang sar dag pa'i ngo bo nyid/ /bcom ldan rnam par snang mdzad dngos yin no/ /rdor sems phyi na med de nang na yod/ /rig rtsal 'char gzhi ma 'gag me long ngang / /zhe sdang rang sar dag pa'i ngo bo nyid/ /bcom ldan rdo rje sems dpa' dngos yin no/ /rin 'byung phyi na med de nang na yod/ /blang dor dgag sgrub med pa mnyam nyid dang / /nga rgyal rang sar dag pa'i ngo bo nyid/ /bcom ldan rin chen 'byung ldan dngos yin no/ /'od dpag phyi na med de nang na yod/ /bde 630

stong dbyengs su nub pa sor rtog ngang / / /'dod chags rang sar dag pa'i ngo bo nyid/ /bcom ldan 'od dpag med pa dngos yin no/ /don grub phyi na med de nang na yod/ /rig pa thal phyung rang grol bya grub ngang / /phrag dog rang sar dag pa'i ngo bo nyid/ /bcom ldan don yod grub pa dngos yin no/ /e ma ho/ da yang skal ldan sems kyi bu gcig po/ /dga' zhing spro bas rdo rje'i glu la nyon/ /de ltar rtogs na snang srid thams cad kun/ /gdams ngag dpe cha don gyi dkyil 'khor yin/ /snang ba dkar dmar sna tshogs shog gu la/ /rang byung ye shes rig pa'i smyu gu yis/ /gzhi med ye grol 'dzin med yi ge bris/ /snang stong gnyis med ngang du dpe blta byas/ /stong gsum thams cad lhun grub dkyil 'khor la/ /char chu rang babs chu yis chag chag gdab/ /lam srang rang bzhin thig chen gdab pa dang / /rkang pa'i rjes ni kha dog rdul tshon ris/ /rang lus snang stong yi dam lha yi sku/ /smra brjod grags stong rdo rje'i bzlas pa dang / /dran bsam 'dzin med rang grol lha yi thugs/ /yan lag 'gul bskyod thams cad phyag rgya'o/ /bza' dang btung ba chos nyid mchod pa dang / /gzugs su snang ba thams cad lha yi sku/ /sgra chen brjod pa thams cad rol mo 631
